name: Udyoga Parva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kRRitvA vivAhaM tu kurupravIrA;stadAbhimanyormuditasvapakShAH |
vishramya chatvAryuShasaH pratItAH; sabhAM virATasya tato.abhijagmuH
shlokas.2:
sabhA tu sA matsyapateH samRRiddhA; maNipravekottamaratnachitrA |
nyastAsanA mAlyavatI sugandhA; tAmabhyayuste nararAjavaryAH
shlokas.3:
athAsanAnyAvishatAM purastA;dubhau virATadrupadau narendrau |
vRRiddhashcha mAnyaH pRRithivIpatInAM; pitAmaho rAmajanArdanAbhyAm
shlokas.4:
pA~nchAlarAjasya samIpatastu; shinipravIraH saharauhiNeyaH |
matsyasya rAj~nastu susaMnikRRiShTau; janArdanashchaiva yudhiShThirashcha
shlokas.5:
sutAshcha sarve drupadasya rAj~no; bhImArjunau mAdravatIsutau cha |
pradyumnasAmbau cha yudhi pravIrau; virATaputrashcha sahAbhimanyuH
shlokas.6:
sarve cha shUrAH pitRRibhiH samAnA; vIryeNa rUpeNa balena chaiva |
upAvishandraupadeyAH kumArAH; suvarNachitreShu varAsaneShu
shlokas.7:
tathopaviShTeShu mahAratheShu; vibhrAjamAnAmbarabhUShaNeShu |
rarAja sA rAjavatI samRRiddhA; grahairiva dyaurvimalairupetA
shlokas.8:
tataH kathAste samavAyayuktAH; kRRitvA vichitrAH puruShapravIrAH |
tasthurmuhUrtaM parichintayantaH; kRRiShNaM nRRipAste samudIkShamANAH
shlokas.9:
kathAntamAsAdya cha mAdhavena; sa~NghaTTitAH pANDavakAryahetoH |
te rAjasiMhAH sahitA hyashRRiNva;nvAkyaM mahArthaM cha mahodayaM cha
shlokas.10:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
sarvairbhavadbhirviditaM yathAyaM; yudhiShThiraH saubalenAkShavatyAm |
jito nikRRityApahRRitaM cha rAjyaM; punaH pravAse samayaH kRRitashcha
shlokas.11:
shaktairvijetuM tarasA mahIM cha; satye sthitaistachcharitaM yathAvat |
pANDoH sutaistadvratamugrarUpaM; varShANi ShaTsapta cha bhAratAgryaiH
shlokas.12:
trayodashashchaiva sudustaro.aya;maj~nAyamAnairbhavatAM samIpe |
kleshAnasahyA.nshcha titikShamANai;ryathoShitaM tadviditaM cha sarvam
shlokas.13:
evaM gate dharmasutasya rAj~no; duryodhanasyApi cha yaddhitaM syAt |
tachchintayadhvaM kurupANDavAnAM; dharmyaM cha yuktaM cha yashaskaraM cha
shlokas.14:
adharmayuktaM cha na kAmayeta; rAjyaM surANAmapi dharmarAjaH |
dharmArthayuktaM cha mahIpatitvaM; grAme.api kasmi.nshchidayaM bubhUShet
shlokas.15:
pitryaM hi rAjyaM viditaM nRRipANAM; yathApakRRiShTaM dhRRitarAShTraputraiH |
mithyopachAreNa tathApyanena; kRRichChraM mahatprAptamasahyarUpam
shlokas.16:
na chApi pArtho vijito raNe taiH; svatejasA dhRRitarAShTrasya putraiH |
tathApi rAjA sahitaH suhRRidbhi;rabhIpsate.anAmayameva teShAm
shlokas.17:
yattatsvayaM pANDusutairvijitya; samAhRRitaM bhUmipatInnipIDya |
tatprArthayante puruShapravIrAH; kuntIsutA mAdravatIsutau cha
shlokas.18:
bAlAstvime tairvividhairupAyaiH; samprArthitA hantumamitrasAhAH |
rAjyaM jihIrShadbhirasadbhirugraiH; sarvaM cha tadvo viditaM yathAvat
shlokas.19:
teShAM cha lobhaM prasamIkShya vRRiddhaM; dharmAtmatAM chApi yudhiShThirasya |
sambandhitAM chApi samIkShya teShAM; matiM kurudhvaM sahitAH pRRithakcha
shlokas.20:
ime cha satye.abhiratAH sadaiva; taM pArayitvA samayaM yathAvat |
ato.anyathA tairupacharyamANA; hanyuH sametAndhRRitarAShTraputrAn
shlokas.21:
tairviprakAraM cha nishamya rAj~naH; suhRRijjanAstAnparivArayeyuH |
yuddhena bAdheyurimA.nstathaiva; tairvadhyamAnA yudhi tA.nshcha hanyuH
shlokas.22:
tathApi neme.alpatayA samarthA;steShAM jayAyeti bhavenmataM vaH |
sametya sarve sahitAH suhRRidbhi;steShAM vinAshAya yateyureva
shlokas.23:
duryodhanasyApi mataM yathAva;nna j~nAyate kiM nu kariShyatIti |
aj~nAyamAne cha mate parasya; kiM syAtsamArabhyatamaM mataM vaH
shlokas.24:
tasmAdito gachChatu dharmashIlaH; shuchiH kulInaH puruSho.apramattaH |
dUtaH samarthaH prashamAya teShAM; rAjyArdhadAnAya yudhiShThirasya
shlokas.25:
nishamya vAkyaM tu janArdanasya; dharmArthayuktaM madhuraM samaM cha |
samAdade vAkyamathAgrajo.asya; sampUjya vAkyaM tadatIva rAjan

shlokas.1:
baladeva uvAcha||
shrutaM bhavadbhirgadapUrvajasya; vAkyaM yathA dharmavadarthavachcha |
ajAtashatroshcha hitaM hitaM cha; duryodhanasyApi tathaiva rAj~naH
shlokas.2:
ardhaM hi rAjyasya visRRijya vIrAH; kuntIsutAstasya kRRite yatante |
pradAya chArdhaM dhRRitarAShTraputraH; sukhI sahAsmAbhiratIva modet
shlokas.3:
labdhvA hi rAjyaM puruShapravIrAH; samyakpravRRitteShu pareShu chaiva |
dhruvaM prashAntAH sukhamAvisheyu;steShAM prashAntishcha hitaM prajAnAm
shlokas.4:
duryodhanasyApi mataM cha vettuM; vaktuM cha vAkyAni yudhiShThirasya |
priyaM mama syAdyadi tatra kashchi;dvrajechChamArthaM kurupANDavAnAm
shlokas.5:
sa bhIShmamAmantrya kurupravIraM; vaichitravIryaM cha mahAnubhAvam |
droNaM saputraM viduraM kRRipaM cha; gAndhArarAjaM cha sasUtaputram
shlokas.6:
sarve cha ye.anye dhRRitarAShTraputrA; balapradhAnA nigamapradhAnAH |
sthitAshcha dharmeShu yathA svakeShu; lokapravIrAH shrutakAlavRRiddhAH
shlokas.7:
eteShu sarveShu samAgateShu; paureShu vRRiddheShu cha sa~NgateShu |
bravItu vAkyaM praNipAtayuktaM; kuntIsutasyArthakaraM yathA syAt
shlokas.8:
sarvAsvavasthAsu cha te na kauTyA;dgrasto hi so.artho balamAshritaistaiH |
priyAbhyupetasya yudhiShThirasya; dyUte pramattasya hRRitaM cha rAjyam
shlokas.9:
nivAryamANashcha kurupravIraiH; sarvaiH suhRRidbhirhyayamapyatajj~naH |
gAndhArarAjasya sutaM matAkShaM; samAhvayeddevitumAjamIDhaH
shlokas.10:
durodarAstatra sahasrasho.anye; yudhiShThiro yAnviShaheta jetum |
utsRRijya tAnsaubalameva chAyaM; samAhvayattena jito.akShavatyAm
shlokas.11:
sa dIvyamAnaH pratidevanena; akSheShu nityaM suparA~NmukheShu |
sa.nrambhamANo vijitaH prasahya; tatrAparAdhaH shakunerna kashchit
shlokas.12:
tasmAtpraNamyaiva vacho bravItu; vaichitravIryaM bahusAmayuktam |
tathA hi shakyo dhRRitarAShTraputraH; svArthe niyoktuM puruSheNa tena
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM bruvatyeva madhupravIre; shinipravIraH sahasotpapAta |
tachchApi vAkyaM parinindya tasya; samAdade vAkyamidaM samanyuH

shlokas.1:
sAtyakiruvAcha||
yAdRRishaH puruShasyAtmA tAdRRishaM samprabhAShate |
yathArUpo.antarAtmA te tathArUpaM prabhAShase
shlokas.2:
santi vai puruShAH shUrAH santi kApuruShAstathA |
ubhAvetau dRRiDhau pakShau dRRishyete puruShAnprati
shlokas.3:
ekasminneva jAyete kule klIbamahArathau |
phalAphalavatI shAkhe yathaikasminvanaspatau
shlokas.4:
nAbhyasUyAmi te vAkyaM bruvato lA~Ngaladhvaja |
ye tu shRRiNvanti te vAkyaM tAnasUyAmi mAdhava
shlokas.5:
kathaM hi dharmarAjasya doShamalpamapi bruvan |
labhate pariShanmadhye vyAhartumakutobhayaH
shlokas.6:
samAhUya mahAtmAnaM jitavanto.akShakovidAH |
anakShaj~naM yathAshraddhaM teShu dharmajayaH kutaH
shlokas.7:
yadi kuntIsutaM gehe krIDantaM bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
abhigamya jayeyuste tatteShAM dharmato bhavet
shlokas.8:
samAhUya tu rAjAnaM kShatradharmarataM sadA |
nikRRityA jitavantaste kiM nu teShAM paraM shubham
shlokas.9:
kathaM praNipatechchAyamiha kRRitvA paNaM param |
vanavAsAdvimuktastu prAptaH paitAmahaM padam
shlokas.10:
yadyayaM paravittAni kAmayeta yudhiShThiraH |
evamapyayamatyantaM parAnnArhati yAchitum
shlokas.11:
kathaM cha dharmayuktAste na cha rAjyaM jihIrShavaH |
nivRRittavAsAnkaunteyAnya AhurviditA iti
shlokas.12:
anunItA hi bhIShmeNa droNena cha mahAtmanA |
na vyavasyanti pANDUnAM pradAtuM paitRRikaM vasu
shlokas.13:
ahaM tu tA~nshitairbANairanunIya raNe balAt |
pAdayoH pAtayiShyAmi kaunteyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
atha te na vyavasyanti praNipAtAya dhImataH |
gamiShyanti sahAmAtyA yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.15:
na hi te yuyudhAnasya sa.nrabdhasya yuyutsataH |
vegaM samarthAH sa.nsoDhuM vajrasyeva mahIdharAH
shlokas.16:
ko hi gANDIvadhanvAnaM kashcha chakrAyudhaM yudhi |
mAM chApi viShahetko nu kashcha bhImaM durAsadam
shlokas.17:
yamau cha dRRiDhadhanvAnau yamakalpau mahAdyutI |
ko jijIviShurAsIdeddhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam
shlokas.18:
pa~nchemAnpANDaveyA.nshcha draupadyAH kIrtivardhanAn |
samapramANAnpANDUnAM samavIryAnmadotkaTAn
shlokas.19:
saubhadraM cha maheShvAsamamarairapi duHsaham |
gadapradyumnasAmbA.nshcha kAlavajrAnalopamAn
shlokas.20:
te vayaM dhRRitarAShTrasya putraM shakuninA saha |
karNena cha nihatyAjAvabhiShekShyAma pANDavam
shlokas.21:
nAdharmo vidyate kashchichChatrUnhatvAtatAyinaH |
adharmyamayashasyaM cha shAtravANAM prayAchanam
shlokas.22:
hRRidgatastasya yaH kAmastaM kurudhvamatandritAH |
nisRRiShTaM dhRRitarAShTreNa rAjyaM prApnotu pANDavaH
shlokas.23:
adya pANDusuto rAjyaM labhatAM vA yudhiShThiraH |
nihatA vA raNe sarve svapsyanti vasudhAtale

shlokas.1:
drupada uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH |
na hi duryodhano rAjyaM madhureNa pradAsyati
shlokas.2:
anuvartsyati taM chApi dhRRitarAShTraH sutapriyaH |
bhIShmadroNau cha kArpaNyAnmaurkhyAdrAdheyasaubalau
shlokas.3:
baladevasya vAkyaM tu mama j~nAne na yujyate |
etaddhi puruSheNAgre kAryaM sunayamichChatA
shlokas.4:
na tu vAchyo mRRidu vacho dhArtarAShTraH katha~nchana |
na hi mArdavasAdhyo.asau pApabuddhirmato mama
shlokas.5:
gardabhe mArdavaM kuryAdgoShu tIkShNaM samAcharet |
mRRidu duryodhane vAkyaM yo brUyAtpApachetasi
shlokas.6:
mRRidu vai manyate pApo bhAShyamANamashaktijam |
jitamarthaM vijAnIyAdabudho mArdave sati
shlokas.7:
etachchaiva kariShyAmo yatnashcha kriyatAmiha |
prasthApayAma mitrebhyo balAnyudyojayantu naH
shlokas.8:
shalyasya dhRRiShTaketoshcha jayatsenasya chAbhibhoH |
kekayAnAM cha sarveShAM dUtA gachChantu shIghragAH
shlokas.9:
sa tu duryodhano nUnaM preShayiShyati sarvashaH |
pUrvAbhipannAH santashcha bhajante pUrvachodakam
shlokas.10:
tattvaradhvaM narendrANAM pUrvameva prachodane |
mahaddhi kAryaM voDhavyamiti me vartate matiH
shlokas.11:
shalyasya preShyatAM shIghraM ye cha tasyAnugA nRRipAH |
bhagadattAya rAj~ne cha pUrvasAgaravAsine
shlokas.12:
amitaujase tathogrAya hArdikyAyAhukAya cha |
dIrghapraj~nAya mallAya rochamAnAya chAbhibho
shlokas.13:
AnIyatAM bRRihantashcha senAbindushcha pArthivaH |
pApajitprativindhyashcha chitravarmA suvAstukaH
shlokas.14:
bAhlIko mu~njakeshashcha chaidyAdhipatireva cha |
supArshvashcha subAhushcha pauravashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.15:
shakAnAM pahlavAnAM cha daradAnAM cha ye nRRipAH |
kAmbojA RRiShikA ye cha pashchimAnUpakAshcha ye
shlokas.16:
jayatsenashcha kAshyashcha tathA pa~nchanadA nRRipAH |
krAthaputrashcha durdharShaH pArvatIyAshcha ye nRRipAH
shlokas.17:
jAnakishcha susharmA cha maNimAnpautimatsyakaH |
pA.nsurAShTrAdhipashchaiva dhRRiShTaketushcha vIryavAn
shlokas.18:
auDrashcha daNDadhArashcha bRRihatsenashcha vIryavAn |
aparAjito niShAdashcha shreNimAnvasumAnapi
shlokas.19:
bRRihadbalo mahaujAshcha bAhuH parapura~njayaH |
samudraseno rAjA cha saha putreNa vIryavAn
shlokas.20:
adArishcha nadIjashcha karNaveShTashcha pArthivaH |
samarthashcha suvIrashcha mArjAraH kanyakastathA
shlokas.21:
mahAvIrashcha kadrushcha nikarastumulaH krathaH |
nIlashcha vIradharmA cha bhUmipAlashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.22:
durjayo dantavaktrashcha rukmI cha janamejayaH |
AShADho vAyuvegashcha pUrvapAlI cha pArthivaH
shlokas.23:
bhUritejA devakashcha ekalavyasya chAtmajaH |
kArUShakAshcha rAjAnaH kShemadhUrtishcha vIryavAn
shlokas.24:
udbhavaH kShemakashchaiva vATadhAnashcha pArthivaH |
shrutAyushcha dRRiDhAyushcha shAlvaputrashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.25:
kumArashcha kali~NgAnAmIshvaro yuddhadurmadaH |
eteShAM preShyatAM shIghrametaddhi mama rochate
shlokas.26:
ayaM cha brAhmaNaH shIghraM mama rAjanpurohitaH |
preShyatAM dhRRitarAShTrAya vAkyamasminsamarpyatAm
shlokas.27:
yathA duryodhano vAchyo yathA shAntanavo nRRipaH |
dhRRitarAShTro yathA vAchyo droNashcha viduShAM varaH

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
upapannamidaM vAkyaM somakAnAM dhurandhare |
arthasiddhikaraM rAj~naH pANDavasya mahaujasaH
shlokas.2:
etachcha pUrvakAryaM naH sunItamabhikA~NkShatAm |
anyathA hyAcharankarma puruShaH syAtsubAlishaH
shlokas.3:
kiM tu sambandhakaM tulyamasmAkaM kurupANDuShu |
yatheShTaM vartamAneShu pANDaveShu cha teShu cha
shlokas.4:
te vivAhArthamAnItA vayaM sarve yathA bhavAn |
kRRite vivAhe muditA gamiShyAmo gRRihAnprati
shlokas.5:
bhavAnvRRiddhatamo rAj~nAM vayasA cha shrutena cha |
shiShyavatte vayaM sarve bhavAmeha na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.6:
bhavantaM dhRRitarAShTrashcha satataM bahu manyate |
AchAryayoH sakhA chAsi droNasya cha kRRipasya cha
shlokas.7:
sa bhavAnpreShayatvadya pANDavArthakaraM vachaH |
sarveShAM nishchitaM tannaH preShayiShyati yadbhavAn
shlokas.8:
yadi tAvachChamaM kuryAnnyAyena kurupu~NgavaH |
na bhavetkurupANDUnAM saubhrAtreNa mahAnkShayaH
shlokas.9:
atha darpAnvito mohAnna kuryAddhRRitarAShTrajaH |
anyeShAM preShayitvA cha pashchAdasmAnsamAhvayeH
shlokas.10:
tato duryodhano mandaH sahAmAtyaH sabAndhavaH |
niShThAmApatsyate mUDhaH kruddhe gANDIvadhanvani
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH satkRRitya vArShNeyaM virATaH pRRithivIpatiH |
gRRihAnprasthApayAmAsa sagaNaM sahabAndhavam
shlokas.12:
dvArakAM tu gate kRRiShNe yudhiShThirapurogamAH |
chakruH sA~NgrAmikaM sarvaM virATashcha mahIpatiH
shlokas.13:
tataH sampreShayAmAsa virATaH saha bAndhavaiH |
sarveShAM bhUmipAlAnAM drupadashcha mahIpatiH
shlokas.14:
vachanAtkurusiMhAnAM matsyapA~nchAlayoshcha te |
samAjagmurmahIpAlAH samprahRRiShTA mahAbalAH
shlokas.15:
tachChrutvA pANDuputrANAM samAgachChanmahadbalam |
dhRRitarAShTrasutashchApi samAninye mahIpatIn
shlokas.16:
samAkulA mahI rAjankurupANDavakAraNAt |
tadA samabhavatkRRitsnA samprayANe mahIkShitAm
shlokas.17:
balAni teShAM vIrANAmAgachChanti tatastataH |
chAlayantIva gAM devIM saparvatavanAmimAm
shlokas.18:
tataH praj~nAvayovRRiddhaM pA~nchAlyaH svapurohitam |
kurubhyaH preShayAmAsa yudhiShThiramate tadA

shlokas.1:
drupada uvAcha||
bhUtAnAM prANinaH shreShThAH prANinAM buddhijIvinaH |
buddhimatsu narAH shreShThA narANAM tu dvijAtayaH
shlokas.2:
dvijeShu vaidyAH shreyA.nso vaidyeShu kRRitabuddhayaH |
sa bhavAnkRRitabuddhInAM pradhAna iti me matiH
shlokas.3:
kulena cha vishiShTo.asi vayasA cha shrutena cha |
praj~nayAnavamashchAsi shukreNA~Ngirasena cha
shlokas.4:
viditaM chApi te sarvaM yathAvRRittaH sa kauravaH |
pANDavashcha yathAvRRittaH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTrasya vidite va~nchitAH pANDavAH paraiH |
vidureNAnunIto.api putramevAnuvartate
shlokas.6:
shakunirbuddhipUrvaM hi kuntIputraM samAhvayat |
anakShaj~naM matAkShaH sankShatravRRitte sthitaM shuchim
shlokas.7:
te tathA va~nchayitvA tu dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram |
na kasyA~nchidavasthAyAM rAjyaM dAsyanti vai svayam
shlokas.8:
bhavA.nstu dharmasa.nyuktaM dhRRitarAShTraM bruvanvachaH |
manA.nsi tasya yodhAnAM dhruvamAvartayiShyati
shlokas.9:
vidurashchApi tadvAkyaM sAdhayiShyati tAvakam |
bhIShmadroNakRRipANAM cha bhedaM sa~njanayiShyati
shlokas.10:
amAtyeShu cha bhinneShu yodheShu vimukheShu cha |
punarekAgrakaraNaM teShAM karma bhaviShyati
shlokas.11:
etasminnantare pArthAH sukhamekAgrabuddhayaH |
senAkarma kariShyanti dravyANAM chaiva sa~nchayam
shlokas.12:
bhidyamAneShu cha sveShu lambamAne cha vai tvayi |
na tathA te kariShyanti senAkarma na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
etatprayojanaM chAtra prAdhAnyenopalabhyate |
sa~NgatyA dhRRitarAShTrashcha kuryAddharmyaM vachastava
shlokas.14:
sa bhavAndharmayuktashcha dharmyaM teShu samAcharan |
kRRipAluShu parikleshAnpANDavAnAM prakIrtayan
shlokas.15:
vRRiddheShu kuladharmaM cha bruvanpUrvairanuShThitam |
vibhetsyati manA.nsyeShAmiti me nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.16:
na cha tebhyo bhayaM te.asti brAhmaNo hyasi vedavit |
dUtakarmaNi yuktashcha sthavirashcha visheShataH
shlokas.17:
sa bhavAnpuShyayogena muhUrtena jayena cha |
kauraveyAnprayAtvAshu kaunteyasyArthasiddhaye
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathAnushiShTaH prayayau drupadena mahAtmanA |
purodhA vRRittasampanno nagaraM nAgasAhvayam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gate dvAravatIM kRRiShNe baladeve cha mAdhave |
saha vRRiShNyandhakaiH sarvairbhojaishcha shatashastathA
shlokas.2:
sarvamAgamayAmAsa pANDavAnAM vicheShTitam |
dhRRitarAShTrAtmajo rAjA dUtaiH praNihitaishcharaiH
shlokas.3:
sa shrutvA mAdhavaM yAtaM sadashvairanilopamaiH |
balena nAtimahatA dvArakAmabhyayAtpurIm
shlokas.4:
tameva divasaM chApi kaunteyaH pANDunandanaH |
AnartanagarIM ramyAM jagAmAshu dhana~njayaH
shlokas.5:
tau yAtvA puruShavyAghrau dvArakAM kurunandanau |
suptaM dadRRishatuH kRRiShNaM shayAnaM chopajagmatuH
shlokas.6:
tataH shayAne govinde pravivesha suyodhanaH |
uchChIrShatashcha kRRiShNasya niShasAda varAsane
shlokas.7:
tataH kirITI tasyAnu pravivesha mahAmanAH |
pashchArdhe cha sa kRRiShNasya prahvo.atiShThatkRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.8:
pratibuddhaH sa vArShNeyo dadarshAgre kirITinam |
sa tayoH svAgataM kRRitvA yathArhaM pratipUjya cha
tadAgamanajaM hetuM paprachCha madhusUdanaH
shlokas.9:
tato duryodhanaH kRRiShNamuvAcha prahasanniva |
vigrahe.asminbhavAnsAhyaM mama dAtumihArhati
shlokas.10:
samaM hi bhavataH sakhyaM mayi chaivArjune.api cha |
tathA sambandhakaM tulyamasmAkaM tvayi mAdhava
shlokas.11:
ahaM chAbhigataH pUrvaM tvAmadya madhusUdana |
pUrvaM chAbhigataM santo bhajante pUrvasAriNaH
shlokas.12:
tvaM cha shreShThatamo loke satAmadya janArdana |
satataM saMmatashchaiva sadvRRittamanupAlaya
shlokas.13:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
bhavAnabhigataH pUrvamatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH |
dRRiShTastu prathamaM rAjanmayA pArtho dhana~njayaH
shlokas.14:
tava pUrvAbhigamanAtpUrvaM chApyasya darshanAt |
sAhAyyamubhayoreva kariShyAmi suyodhana
shlokas.15:
pravAraNaM tu bAlAnAM pUrvaM kAryamiti shrutiH |
tasmAtpravAraNaM pUrvamarhaH pArtho dhana~njayaH
shlokas.16:
matsaMhananatulyAnAM gopAnAmarbudaM mahat |
nArAyaNA iti khyAtAH sarve sa~NgrAmayodhinaH
shlokas.17:
te vA yudhi durAdharShA bhavantvekasya sainikAH |
ayudhyamAnaH sa~NgrAme nyastashastro.ahamekataH
shlokas.18:
AbhyAmanyataraM pArtha yatte hRRidyataraM matam |
tadvRRiNItAM bhavAnagre pravAryastvaM hi dharmataH
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu kRRiShNena kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
ayudhyamAnaM sa~NgrAme varayAmAsa keshavam
shlokas.20:
sahasrANAM sahasraM tu yodhAnAM prApya bhArata |
kRRiShNaM chApahRRitaM j~nAtvA samprApa paramAM mudam
shlokas.21:
duryodhanastu tatsainyaM sarvamAdAya pArthivaH |
tato.abhyayAdbhImabalo rauhiNeyaM mahAbalam
shlokas.22:
sarvaM chAgamane hetuM sa tasmai saMnyavedayat |
pratyuvAcha tataH shaurirdhArtarAShTramidaM vachaH
shlokas.23:
viditaM te naravyAghra sarvaM bhavitumarhati |
yanmayoktaM virATasya purA vaivAhike tadA
shlokas.24:
nigRRihyokto hRRiShIkeshastvadarthaM kurunandana |
mayA sambandhakaM tulyamiti rAjanpunaH punaH
shlokas.25:
na cha tadvAkyamuktaM vai keshavaH pratyapadyata |
na chAhamutsahe kRRiShNaM vinA sthAtumapi kShaNam
shlokas.26:
nAhaM sahAyaH pArthAnAM nApi duryodhanasya vai |
iti me nishchitA buddirvAsudevamavekShya ha
shlokas.27:
jAto.asi bhArate va.nshe sarvapArthivapUjite |
gachCha yudhyasva dharmeNa kShAtreNa bharatarShabha
shlokas.28:
ityevamuktaH sa tadA pariShvajya halAyudham |
kRRiShNaM chApahRRitaM j~nAtvA yuddhAnmene jitaM jayam
shlokas.29:
so.abhyayAtkRRitavarmANaM dhRRitarAShTrasuto nRRipaH |
kRRitavarmA dadau tasya senAmakShauhiNIM tadA
shlokas.30:
sa tena sarvasainyena bhImena kurunandanaH |
vRRitaH pratiyayau hRRiShTaH suhRRidaH sampraharShayan
shlokas.31:
gate duryodhane kRRiShNaH kirITinamathAbravIt |
ayudhyamAnaH kAM buddhimAsthAyAhaM tvayA vRRitaH
shlokas.32:
arjuna uvAcha||
bhavAnsamarthastAnsarvAnnihantuM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
nihantumahamapyekaH samarthaH puruShottama
shlokas.33:
bhavA.nstu kIrtimA.Nlloke tadyashastvAM gamiShyati |
yashasA chAhamapyarthI tasmAdasi mayA vRRitaH
shlokas.34:
sArathyaM tu tvayA kAryamiti me mAnasaM sadA |
chirarAtrepsitaM kAmaM tadbhavAnkartumarhati
shlokas.35:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
upapannamidaM pArtha yatspardhethA mayA saha |
sArathyaM te kariShyAmi kAmaH sampadyatAM tava
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM pramuditaH pArthaH kRRiShNena sahitastadA |
vRRito dAshArhapravaraiH punarAyAdyudhiShThiram

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shalyaH shrutvA tu dUtAnAM sainyena mahatA vRRitaH |
abhyayAtpANDavAnrAjansaha putrairmahArathaiH
shlokas.2:
tasya senAnivesho.abhUdadhyardhamiva yojanam |
tathA hi bahulAM senAM sa bibharti nararShabhaH
shlokas.3:
vichitrakavachAH shUrA vichitradhvajakArmukAH |
vichitrAbharaNAH sarve vichitrarathavAhanAH
shlokas.4:
svadeshaveShAbharaNA vIrAH shatasahasrashaH |
tasya senApraNetAro babhUvuH kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.5:
vyathayanniva bhUtAni kampayanniva medinIm |
shanairvishrAmayansenAM sa yayau yena pANDavaH
shlokas.6:
tato duryodhanaH shrutvA mahAsenaM mahAratham |
upAyAntamabhidrutya svayamAnarcha bhArata
shlokas.7:
kArayAmAsa pUjArthaM tasya duryodhanaH sabhAH |
ramaNIyeShu desheShu ratnachitrAH svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.8:
sa tAH sabhAH samAsAdya pUjyamAno yathAmaraH |
duryodhanasya sachivairdeshe deshe yathArhataH
AjagAma sabhAmanyAM devAvasathavarchasam
shlokas.9:
sa tatra viShayairyuktaH kalyANairatimAnuShaiH |
mene.abhyadhikamAtmAnamavamene pura.ndaram
shlokas.10:
paprachCha sa tataH preShyAnprahRRiShTaH kShatriyarShabhaH |
yudhiShThirasya puruShAH ke nu chakruH sabhA imAH
AnIyantAM sabhAkArAH pradeyArhA hi me matAH
shlokas.11:
gUDho duryodhanastatra darshayAmAsa mAtulam |
taM dRRiShTvA madrarAjastu j~nAtvA yatnaM cha tasya tam
pariShvajyAbravItprIta iShTo.artho gRRihyatAmiti
shlokas.12:
duryodhana uvAcha||
satyavAgbhava kalyANa varo vai mama dIyatAm |
sarvasenApraNetA me bhavAnbhavitumarhati
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kRRitamityabravIchChalyaH kimanyatkriyatAmiti |
kRRitamityeva gAndhAriH pratyuvAcha punaH punaH
shlokas.14:
sa tathA shalyamAmantrya punarAyAtsvakaM puram |
shalyo jagAma kaunteyAnAkhyAtuM karma tasya tat
shlokas.15:
upaplavyaM sa gatvA tu skandhAvAraM pravishya cha |
pANDavAnatha tAnsarvA~nshalyastatra dadarsha ha
shlokas.16:
sametya tu mahAbAhuH shalyaH pANDusutaistadA |
pAdyamarghyaM cha gAM chaiva pratyagRRihNAdyathAvidhi
shlokas.17:
tataH kushalapUrvaM sa madrarAjo.arisUdanaH |
prItyA paramayA yuktaH samAshliShya yudhiShThiram
shlokas.18:
tathA bhImArjunau hRRiShTau svasrIyau cha yamAvubhau |
Asane chopaviShTastu shalyaH pArthamuvAcha ha
shlokas.19:
kushalaM rAjashArdUla kachchitte kurunandana |
araNyavAsAddiShTyAsi vimukto jayatAM vara
shlokas.20:
suduShkaraM kRRitaM rAjannirjane vasatA vane |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha rAjendra kRRiShNayA chAnayA saha
shlokas.21:
aj~nAtavAsaM ghoraM cha vasatA duShkaraM kRRitam |
duHkhameva kutaH saukhyaM rAjyabhraShTasya bhArata
shlokas.22:
duHkhasyaitasya mahato dhArtarAShTrakRRitasya vai |
avApsyasi sukhaM rAjanhatvA shatrUnparantapa
shlokas.23:
viditaM te mahArAja lokatattvaM narAdhipa |
tasmAllobhakRRitaM ki~nchittava tAta na vidyate
shlokas.24:
tato.asyAkathayadrAjA duryodhanasamAgamam |
tachcha shushrUShitaM sarvaM varadAnaM cha bhArata
shlokas.25:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sukRRitaM te kRRitaM rAjanprahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA |
duryodhanasya yadvIra tvayA vAchA pratishrutam
ekaM tvichChAmi bhadraM te kriyamANaM mahIpate
shlokas.26:
bhavAniha mahArAja vAsudevasamo yudhi |
karNArjunAbhyAM samprApte dvairathe rAjasattama
karNasya bhavatA kAryaM sArathyaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.27:
tatra pAlyo.arjuno rAjanyadi matpriyamichChasi |
tejovadhashcha te kAryaH sauterasmajjayAvahaH
akartavyamapi hyetatkartumarhasi mAtula
shlokas.28:
shalya uvAcha||
shRRiNu pANDava bhadraM te yadbravIShi durAtmanaH |
tejovadhanimittaM mAM sUtaputrasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.29:
ahaM tasya bhaviShyAmi sa~NgrAme sArathirdhruvam |
vAsudevena hi samaM nityaM mAM sa hi manyate
shlokas.30:
tasyAhaM kurushArdUla pratIpamahitaM vachaH |
dhruvaM sa~NkathayiShyAmi yoddhukAmasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.31:
yathA sa hRRitadarpashcha hRRitatejAshcha pANDava |
bhaviShyati sukhaM hantuM satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.32:
evametatkariShyAmi yathA tAta tvamAttha mAm |
yachchAnyadapi shakShyAmi tatkariShyAmi te priyam
shlokas.33:
yachcha duHkhaM tvayA prAptaM dyUte vai kRRiShNayA saha |
paruShANi cha vAkyAni sUtaputrakRRitAni vai
shlokas.34:
jaTAsurAtparikleshaH kIchakAchcha mahAdyute |
draupadyAdhigataM sarvaM damayantyA yathAshubham
shlokas.35:
sarvaM duHkhamidaM vIra sukhodarkaM bhaviShyati |
nAtra manyustvayA kAryo vidhirhi balavattaraH
shlokas.36:
duHkhAni hi mahAtmAnaH prApnuvanti yudhiShThira |
devairapi hi duHkhAni prAptAni jagatIpate
shlokas.37:
indreNa shrUyate rAjansabhAryeNa mahAtmanA |
anubhUtaM mahadduHkhaM devarAjena bhArata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathamindreNa rAjendra sabhAryeNa mahAtmanA |
duHkhaM prAptaM paraM ghorametadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.2:
shalya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanpurA vRRittamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sabhAryeNa yathA prAptaM duHkhamindreNa bhArata
shlokas.3:
tvaShTA prajApatirhyAsIddevashreShTho mahAtapAH |
sa putraM vai trishirasamindradrohAtkilAsRRijat
shlokas.4:
aindraM sa prArthayatsthAnaM vishvarUpo mahAdyutiH |
taistribhirvadanairghoraiH sUryendujvalanopamaiH
shlokas.5:
vedAnekena so.adhIte surAmekena chApibat |
ekena cha dishaH sarvAH pibanniva nirIkShate
shlokas.6:
sa tapasvI mRRidurdAnto dharme tapasi chodyataH |
tapo.atapyanmahattIvraM sudushcharamari.ndama
shlokas.7:
tasya dRRiShTvA tapovIryaM sattvaM chAmitatejasaH |
viShAdamagamachChakra indro.ayaM mA bhavediti
shlokas.8:
kathaM sajjeta bhogeShu na cha tapyenmahattapaH |
vivardhamAnastrishirAH sarvaM tribhuvanaM graset
shlokas.9:
iti sa~nchintya bahudhA buddhimAnbharatarShabha |
Aj~nApayatso.apsarasastvaShTRRiputrapralobhane
shlokas.10:
yathA sa sajjettrishirAH kAmabhogeShu vai bhRRisham |
kShipraM kuruta gachChadhvaM pralobhayata mAchiram
shlokas.11:
shRRi~NgAraveShAH sushroNyo bhAvairyuktA manoharaiH |
pralobhayata bhadraM vaH shamayadhvaM bhayaM mama
shlokas.12:
asvasthaM hyAtmanAtmAnaM lakShayAmi varA~NganAH |
bhayametanmahAghoraM kShipraM nAshayatAbalAH
shlokas.13:
apsarasa UchuH||
tathA yatnaM kariShyAmaH shakra tasya pralobhane |
yathA nAvApsyasi bhayaM tasmAdbalaniShUdana
shlokas.14:
nirdahanniva chakShurbhyAM yo.asAvAste taponidhiH |
taM pralobhayituM deva gachChAmaH sahitA vayam
yatiShyAmo vashe kartuM vyapanetuM cha te bhayam
shlokas.15:
shalya uvAcha||
indreNa tAstvanuj~nAtA jagmustrishiraso.antikam |
tatra tA vividhairbhAvairlobhayantyo varA~NganAH
nRRityaM sa.ndarshayantyashcha tathaivA~NgeShu sauShThavam
shlokas.16:
vicheruH sampraharShaM cha nAbhyagachChanmahAtapAH |
indriyANi vashe kRRitvA pUrNasAgarasaMnibhaH
shlokas.17:
tAstu yatnaM paraM kRRitvA punaH shakramupasthitAH |
kRRitA~njalipuTAH sarvA devarAjamathAbruvan
shlokas.18:
na sa shakyaH sudurdharSho dhairyAchchAlayituM prabho |
yatte kAryaM mahAbhAga kriyatAM tadanantaram
shlokas.19:
sampUjyApsarasaH shakro visRRijya cha mahAmatiH |
chintayAmAsa tasyaiva vadhopAyaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
sa tUShNIM chintayanvIro devarAjaH pratApavAn |
vinishchitamatirdhImAnvadhe trishiraso.abhavat
shlokas.21:
vajramasya kShipAmyadya sa kShipraM na bhaviShyati |
shatruH pravRRiddho nopekShyo durbalo.api balIyasA
shlokas.22:
shAstrabuddhyA vinishchitya kRRitvA buddhiM vadhe dRRiDhAm |
atha vaishvAnaranibhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAvaham
mumocha vajraM sa~NkruddhaH shakrastrishirasaM prati
shlokas.23:
sa papAta hatastena vajreNa dRRiDhamAhataH |
parvatasyeva shikharaM praNunnaM medinItale
shlokas.24:
taM tu vajrahataM dRRiShTvA shayAnamachalopamam |
na sharma lebhe devendro dIpitastasya tejasA
hato.api dIptatejAH sa jIvanniva cha dRRishyate
shlokas.25:
abhitastatra takShANaM ghaTamAnaM shachIpatiH |
apashyadabravIchchainaM satvaraM pAkashAsanaH
kShipraM Chindhi shirA.nsyasya kuruShva vachanaM mama
shlokas.26:
takShovAcha||
mahAskandho bhRRishaM hyeSha parashurna tariShyati |
kartuM chAhaM na shakShyAmi karma sadbhirvigarhitam
shlokas.27:
indra uvAcha||
mA bhaistvaM kShiprametadvai kuruShva vachanaM mama |
matprasAdAddhi te shastraM vajrakalpaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.28:
takShovAcha||
kaM bhavantamahaM vidyAM ghorakarmANamadya vai |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tattvena kathayasva me
shlokas.29:
indra uvAcha||
ahamindro devarAjastakShanviditamastu te |
kuruShvaitadyathoktaM me takShanmA tvaM vichAraya
shlokas.30:
takShovAcha||
krUreNa nApatrapase kathaM shakreha karmaNA |
RRiShiputramimaM hatvA brahmahatyAbhayaM na te
shlokas.31:
indra uvAcha||
pashchAddharmaM chariShyAmi pAvanArthaM sudushcharam |
shatrureSha mahAvIryo vajreNa nihato mayA
shlokas.32:
adyApi chAhamudvignastakShannasmAdbibhemi vai |
kShipraM Chindhi shirA.nsi tvaM kariShye.anugrahaM tava
shlokas.33:
shiraH pashoste dAsyanti bhAgaM yaj~neShu mAnavAH |
eSha te.anugrahastakShankShipraM kuru mama priyam
shlokas.34:
shalya uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu takShA sa mahendravachanaM tadA |
shirA.nsyatha trishirasaH kuThAreNAchChinattadA
shlokas.35:
nikRRitteShu tatasteShu niShkrAma.nstrishirAstvatha |
kapi~njalAstittirAshcha kalavi~NkAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.36:
yena vedAnadhIte sma pibate somameva cha |
tasmAdvaktrAnviniShpetuH kShipraM tasya kapi~njalAH
shlokas.37:
yena sarvA disho rAjanpibanniva nirIkShate |
tasmAdvaktrAdviniShpetustittirAstasya pANDava
shlokas.38:
yatsurApaM tu tasyAsIdvaktraM trishirasastadA |
kalavi~NkA viniShpetustenAsya bharatarShabha
shlokas.39:
tatasteShu nikRRitteShu vijvaro maghavAnabhUt |
jagAma tridivaM hRRiShTastakShApi svagRRihAnyayau
shlokas.40:
tvaShTA prajApatiH shrutvA shakreNAtha hataM sutam |
krodhasa.nraktanayana idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.41:
tapyamAnaM tapo nityaM kShAntaM dAntaM jitendriyam |
anAparAdhinaM yasmAtputraM hi.nsitavAnmama
shlokas.42:
tasmAchChakravadhArthAya vRRitramutpAdayAmyaham |
lokAH pashyantu me vIryaM tapasashcha balaM mahat
sa cha pashyatu devendro durAtmA pApachetanaH
shlokas.43:
upaspRRishya tataH kruddhastapasvI sumahAyashAH |
agniM hutvA samutpAdya ghoraM vRRitramuvAcha ha
indrashatro vivardhasva prabhAvAttapaso mama
shlokas.44:
so.avardhata divaM stabdhvA sUryavaishvAnaropamaH |
kiM karomIti chovAcha kAlasUrya ivoditaH
shakraM jahIti chApyukto jagAma tridivaM tataH
shlokas.45:
tato yuddhaM samabhavadvRRitravAsavayostadA |
sa~NkruddhayormahAghoraM prasaktaM kurusattama
shlokas.46:
tato jagrAha devendraM vRRitro vIraH shatakratum |
apAvRRitya sa jagrAsa vRRitraH krodhasamanvitaH
shlokas.47:
graste vRRitreNa shakre tu sambhrAntAstridashAstadA |
asRRija.nste mahAsattvA jRRimbhikAM vRRitranAshinIm
shlokas.48:
vijRRimbhamANasya tato vRRitrasyAsyAdapAvRRitAt |
svAnya~NgAnyabhisa~NkShipya niShkrAnto balasUdanaH
tataH prabhRRiti lokeShu jRRimbhikA prANisa.nshritA
shlokas.49:
jahRRiShushcha surAH sarve dRRiShTvA shakraM viniHsRRitam |
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM vRRitravAsavayoH punaH
sa.nrabdhayostadA ghoraM suchiraM bharatarShabha
shlokas.50:
yadA vyavardhata raNe vRRitro balasamanvitaH |
tvaShTustapobalAdvidvA.nstadA shakro nyavartata
shlokas.51:
nivRRitte tu tadA devA viShAdamagamanparam |
sametya shakreNa cha te tvaShTustejovimohitAH
amantrayanta te sarve munibhiH saha bhArata
shlokas.52:
kiM kAryamiti te rAjanvichintya bhayamohitAH |
jagmuH sarve mahAtmAnaM manobhirviShNumavyayam
upaviShTA mandarAgre sarve vRRitravadhepsavaH

shlokas.1:
indra uvAcha||
sarvaM vyAptamidaM devA vRRitreNa jagadavyayam |
na hyasya sadRRishaM ki~nchitpratighAtAya yadbhavet
shlokas.2:
samartho hyabhavaM pUrvamasamartho.asmi sAmpratam |
kathaM kuryAM nu bhadraM vo duShpradharShaH sa me mataH
shlokas.3:
tejasvI cha mahAtmA cha yuddhe chAmitavikramaH |
grasettribhuvanaM sarvaM sadevAsuramAnuSham
shlokas.4:
tasmAdvinishchayamimaM shRRiNudhvaM me divaukasaH |
viShNoH kShayamupAgamya sametya cha mahAtmanA
tena saMmantrya vetsyAmo vadhopAyaM durAtmanaH
shlokas.5:
shalya uvAcha||
evamukte maghavatA devAH sarShigaNAstadA |
sharaNyaM sharaNaM devaM jagmurviShNuM mahAbalam
shlokas.6:
Uchushcha sarve deveshaM viShNuM vRRitrabhayArditAH |
tvayA lokAstrayaH krAntAstribhirvikramaNaiH prabho
shlokas.7:
amRRitaM chAhRRitaM viShNo daityAshcha nihatA raNe |
baliM baddhvA mahAdaityaM shakro devAdhipaH kRRitaH
shlokas.8:
tvaM prabhuH sarvalokAnAM tvayA sarvamidaM tatam |
tvaM hi deva mahAdevaH sarvalokanamaskRRitaH
shlokas.9:
gatirbhava tvaM devAnAM sendrANAmamarottama |
jagadvyAptamidaM sarvaM vRRitreNAsurasUdana
shlokas.10:
viShNuruvAcha||
avashyaM karaNIyaM me bhavatAM hitamuttamam |
tasmAdupAyaM vakShyAmi yathAsau na bhaviShyati
shlokas.11:
gachChadhvaM sarShigandharvA yatrAsau vishvarUpadhRRik |
sAma tasya prayu~njadhvaM tata enaM vijeShyatha
shlokas.12:
bhaviShyati gatirdevAH shakrasya mama tejasA |
adRRishyashcha pravekShyAmi vajramasyAyudhottamam
shlokas.13:
gachChadhvamRRiShibhiH sArdhaM gandharvaishcha surottamAH |
vRRitrasya saha shakreNa sandhiM kuruta mAchiram
shlokas.14:
shalya uvAcha||
evamuktAstu devena RRiShayastridashAstathA |
yayuH sametya sahitAH shakraM kRRitvA puraHsaram
shlokas.15:
samIpametya cha tadA sarva eva mahaujasaH |
taM tejasA prajvalitaM pratapantaM disho dasha
shlokas.16:
grasantamiva lokA.nstrInsUryAchandramasau yathA |
dadRRishustatra te vRRitraM shakreNa saha devatAH
shlokas.17:
RRiShayo.atha tato.abhyetya vRRitramUchuH priyaM vachaH |
vyAptaM jagadidaM sarvaM tejasA tava durjaya
shlokas.18:
na cha shaknoShi nirjetuM vAsavaM bhUrivikramam |
yudhyatoshchApi vAM kAlo vyatItaH sumahAniha
shlokas.19:
pIDyante cha prajAH sarvAH sadevAsuramAnavAH |
sakhyaM bhavatu te vRRitra shakreNa saha nityadA
avApsyasi sukhaM tvaM cha shakralokA.nshcha shAshvatAn
shlokas.20:
RRiShivAkyaM nishamyAtha sa vRRitraH sumahAbalaH |
uvAcha tA.nstadA sarvAnpraNamya shirasAsuraH
shlokas.21:
sarve yUyaM mahAbhAgA gandharvAshchaiva sarvashaH |
yadbrUta tachChrutaM sarvaM mamApi shRRiNutAnaghAH
shlokas.22:
sandhiH kathaM vai bhavitA mama shakrasya chobhayoH |
tejasorhi dvayordevAH sakhyaM vai bhavitA katham
shlokas.23:
RRiShaya UchuH||
sakRRitsatAM sa~NgataM lipsitavyaM; tataH paraM bhavitA bhavyameva |
nAtikrametsatpuruSheNa sa~NgataM; tasmAtsatAM sa~NgataM lipsitavyam
shlokas.24:
dRRiDhaM satAM sa~NgataM chApi nityaM; brUyAchchArthaM hyarthakRRichChreShu dhIraH |
mahArthavatsatpuruSheNa sa~NgataM; tasmAtsantaM na jighA.nseta dhIraH
shlokas.25:
indraH satAM saMmatashcha nivAsashcha mahAtmanAm |
satyavAdI hyadInashcha dharmavitsuvinishchitaH
shlokas.26:
tena te saha shakreNa sandhirbhavatu shAshvataH |
evaM vishvAsamAgachCha mA te bhUdbuddhiranyathA
shlokas.27:
shalya uvAcha||
maharShivachanaM shrutvA tAnuvAcha mahAdyutiH |
avashyaM bhagavanto me mAnanIyAstapasvinaH
shlokas.28:
bravImi yadahaM devAstatsarvaM kriyatAmiha |
tataH sarvaM kariShyAmi yadUchurmAM dvijarShabhAH
shlokas.29:
na shuShkeNa na chArdreNa nAshmanA na cha dAruNA |
na shastreNa na vajreNa na divA na tathA nishi
shlokas.30:
vadhyo bhaveyaM viprendrAH shakrasya saha daivataiH |
evaM me rochate sandhiH shakreNa saha nityadA
shlokas.31:
bADhamityeva RRiShayastamUchurbharatarShabha |
evaM kRRite tu sandhAne vRRitraH pramudito.abhavat
shlokas.32:
yattaH sadAbhavachchApi shakro.amarShasamanvitaH |
vRRitrasya vadhasa.nyuktAnupAyAnanuchintayan
randhrAnveShI samudvignaH sadAbhUdbalavRRitrahA
shlokas.33:
sa kadAchitsamudrAnte tamapashyanmahAsuram |
sandhyAkAla upAvRRitte muhUrte ramyadAruNe
shlokas.34:
tataH sa~nchintya bhagavAnvaradAnaM mahAtmanaH |
sandhyeyaM vartate raudrA na rAtrirdivasaM na cha
vRRitrashchAvashyavadhyo.ayaM mama sarvaharo ripuH
shlokas.35:
yadi vRRitraM na hanmyadya va~nchayitvA mahAsuram |
mahAbalaM mahAkAyaM na me shreyo bhaviShyati
shlokas.36:
evaM sa~nchintayanneva shakro viShNumanusmaran |
atha phenaM tadApashyatsamudre parvatopamam
shlokas.37:
nAyaM shuShko na chArdro.ayaM na cha shastramidaM tathA |
enaM kShepsyAmi vRRitrasya kShaNAdeva nashiShyati
shlokas.38:
savajramatha phenaM taM kShipraM vRRitre nisRRiShTavAn |
pravishya phenaM taM viShNuratha vRRitraM vyanAshayat
shlokas.39:
nihate tu tato vRRitre disho vitimirAbhavan |
pravavau cha shivo vAyuH prajAshcha jahRRiShustadA
shlokas.40:
tato devAH sagandharvA yakSharAkShasapannagAH |
RRiShayashcha mahendraM tamastuvanvividhaiH stavaiH
shlokas.41:
namaskRRitaH sarvabhUtaiH sarvabhUtAni sAntvayan |
hatashatruH prahRRiShTAtmA vAsavaH saha daivataiH
viShNuM tribhuvanashreShThaM pUjayAmAsa dharmavit
shlokas.42:
tato hate mahAvIrye vRRitre devabhaya~Nkare |
anRRitenAbhibhUto.abhUchChakraH paramadurmanAH
traishIrShayAbhibhUtashcha sa pUrvaM brahmahatyayA
shlokas.43:
so.antamAshritya lokAnAM naShTasa~nj~no vichetanaH |
na prAj~nAyata devendrastvabhibhUtaH svakalmaShaiH
pratichChanno vasatyapsu cheShTamAna ivoragaH
shlokas.44:
tataH pranaShTe devendre brahmahatyAbhayArdite |
bhUmiH pradhvastasa~NkAshA nirvRRikShA shuShkakAnanA
vichChinnasrotaso nadyaH sarA.nsyanudakAni cha
shlokas.45:
sa~NkShobhashchApi sattvAnAmanAvRRiShTikRRito.abhavat |
devAshchApi bhRRishaM trastAstathA sarve maharShayaH
shlokas.46:
arAjakaM jagatsarvamabhibhUtamupadravaiH |
tato bhItAbhavandevAH ko no rAjA bhavediti
shlokas.47:
divi devarShayashchApi devarAjavinAkRRitAH |
na cha sma kashchiddevAnAM rAjyAya kurute manaH

shlokas.1:
shalya uvAcha||
RRiShayo.athAbruvansarve devAshcha tridasheshvarAH |
ayaM vai nahuShaH shrImAndevarAjye.abhiShichyatAm
te gatvAthAbruvansarve rAjA no bhava pArthiva
shlokas.2:
sa tAnuvAcha nahuSho devAnRRiShigaNA.nstathA |
pitRRibhiH sahitAnrAjanparIpsanhitamAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
durbalo.ahaM na me shaktirbhavatAM paripAlane |
balavA~njAyate rAjA balaM shakre hi nityadA
shlokas.4:
tamabruvanpunaH sarve devAH sarShipurogamAH |
asmAkaM tapasA yuktaH pAhi rAjyaM triviShTape
shlokas.5:
parasparabhayaM ghoramasmAkaM hi na sa.nshayaH |
abhiShichyasva rAjendra bhava rAjA triviShTape
shlokas.6:
devadAnavayakShANAmRRiShINAM rakShasAM tathA |
pitRRigandharvabhUtAnAM chakShurviShayavartinAm
teja AdAsyase pashyanbalavA.nshcha bhaviShyasi
shlokas.7:
dharmaM puraskRRitya sadA sarvalokAdhipo bhava |
brahmarShI.nshchApi devA.nshcha gopAyasva triviShTape
shlokas.8:
sudurlabhaM varaM labdhvA prApya rAjyaM triviShTape |
dharmAtmA satataM bhUtvA kAmAtmA samapadyata
shlokas.9:
devodyAneShu sarveShu nandanopavaneShu cha |
kailAse himavatpRRiShThe mandare shvetaparvate
sahye mahendre malaye samudreShu saritsu cha
shlokas.10:
apsarobhiH parivRRito devakanyAsamAvRRitaH |
nahuSho devarAjaH sankrIDanbahuvidhaM tadA
shlokas.11:
shRRiNvandivyA bahuvidhAH kathAH shrutimanoharAH |
vAditrANi cha sarvANi gItaM cha madhurasvaram
shlokas.12:
vishvAvasurnAradashcha gandharvApsarasAM gaNAH |
RRitavaH ShaTcha devendraM mUrtimanta upasthitAH
mArutaH surabhirvAti manoj~naH sukhashItalaH
shlokas.13:
evaM hi krIDatastasya nahuShasya mahAtmanaH |
samprAptA darshanaM devI shakrasya mahiShI priyA
shlokas.14:
sa tAM sa.ndRRishya duShTAtmA prAha sarvAnsabhAsadaH |
indrasya mahiShI devI kasmAnmAM nopatiShThati
shlokas.15:
ahamindro.asmi devAnAM lokAnAM cha tatheshvaraH |
AgachChatu shachI mahyaM kShipramadya niveshanam
shlokas.16:
tachChrutvA durmanA devI bRRihaspatimuvAcha ha |
rakSha mAM nahuShAdbrahma.nstavAsmi sharaNaM gatA
shlokas.17:
sarvalakShaNasampannAM brahmastvaM mAM prabhAShase |
devarAjasya dayitAmatyantasukhabhAginIm
shlokas.18:
avaidhavyena sa.nyuktAmekapatnIM pativratAm |
uktavAnasi mAM pUrvamRRitAM tAM kuru vai giram
shlokas.19:
noktapUrvaM cha bhagavanmRRiShA te ki~nchidIshvara |
tasmAdetadbhavetsatyaM tvayoktaM dvijasattama
shlokas.20:
bRRihaspatirathovAcha indrANIM bhayamohitAm |
yaduktAsi mayA devi satyaM tadbhavitA dhruvam
shlokas.21:
drakShyase devarAjAnamindraM shIghramihAgatam |
na bhetavyaM cha nahuShAtsatyametadbravImi te
samAnayiShye shakreNa nachirAdbhavatImaham
shlokas.22:
atha shushrAva nahuSha indrANIM sharaNaM gatAm |
bRRihaspatera~Ngirasashchukrodha sa nRRipastadA

shlokas.1:
shalya uvAcha||
kruddhaM tu nahuShaM j~nAtvA devAH sarShipurogamAH |
abruvandevarAjAnaM nahuShaM ghoradarshanam
shlokas.2:
devarAja jahi krodhaM tvayi kruddhe jagadvibho |
trastaM sAsuragandharvaM sakiMnaramahoragam
shlokas.3:
jahi krodhamimaM sAdho na krudhyanti bhavadvidhAH |
parasya patnI sA devI prasIdasva sureshvara
shlokas.4:
nivartaya manaH pApAtparadArAbhimarshanAt |
devarAjo.asi bhadraM te prajA dharmeNa pAlaya
shlokas.5:
evamukto na jagrAha tadvachaH kAmamohitaH |
atha devAnuvAchedamindraM prati surAdhipaH
shlokas.6:
ahalyA dharShitA pUrvamRRiShipatnI yashasvinI |
jIvato bharturindreNa sa vaH kiM na nivAritaH
shlokas.7:
bahUni cha nRRisha.nsAni kRRitAnIndreNa vai purA |
vaidharmyANyupadhAshchaiva sa vaH kiM na nivAritaH
shlokas.8:
upatiShThatu mAM devI etadasyA hitaM param |
yuShmAkaM cha sadA devAH shivamevaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.9:
devA UchuH||
indrANImAnayiShyAmo yathechChasi divaspate |
jahi krodhamimaM vIra prIto bhava sureshvara
shlokas.10:
shalya uvAcha||
ityuktvA te tadA devA RRiShibhiH saha bhArata |
jagmurbRRihaspatiM vaktumindrANIM chAshubhaM vachaH
shlokas.11:
jAnImaH sharaNaM prAptamindrANIM tava veshmani |
dattAbhayAM cha viprendra tvayA devarShisattama
shlokas.12:
te tvAM devAH sagandharvA RRiShayashcha mahAdyute |
prasAdayanti chendrANI nahuShAya pradIyatAm
shlokas.13:
indrAdvishiShTo nahuSho devarAjo mahAdyutiH |
vRRiNotviyaM varArohA bhartRRitve varavarNinI
shlokas.14:
evamukte tu sA devI bAShpamutsRRijya sasvaram |
uvAcha rudatI dInA bRRihaspatimidaM vachaH
shlokas.15:
nAhamichChAmi nahuShaM patimanvAsya taM prabhum |
sharaNAgatAsmi te brahma.nstrAhi mAM mahato bhayAt
shlokas.16:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
sharaNAgatAM na tyajeyamindrANi mama nishchitam |
dharmaj~nAM dharmashIlAM cha na tyaje tvAmanindite
shlokas.17:
nAkAryaM kartumichChAmi brAhmaNaH sanvisheShataH |
shrutadharmA satyashIlo jAnandharmAnushAsanam
shlokas.18:
nAhametatkariShyAmi gachChadhvaM vai surottamAH |
asmi.nshchArthe purA gItaM brahmaNA shrUyatAmidam
shlokas.19:
na tasya bIjaM rohati bIjakAle; na chAsya varShaM varShati varShakAle |
bhItaM prapannaM pradadAti shatrave; na so.antaraM labhate trANamichChan
shlokas.20:
moghamannaM vindati chApyachetAH; svargAllokAdbhrashyati naShTacheShTaH |
bhItaM prapannaM pradadAti yo vai; na tasya havyaM pratigRRihNanti devAH
shlokas.21:
pramIyate chAsya prajA hyakAle; sadA vivAsaM pitaro.asya kurvate |
bhItaM prapannaM pradadAti shatrave; sendrA devAH praharantyasya vajram
shlokas.22:
etadevaM vijAnanvai na dAsyAmi shachImimAm |
indrANIM vishrutAM loke shakrasya mahiShIM priyAm
shlokas.23:
asyA hitaM bhavedyachcha mama chApi hitaM bhavet |
kriyatAM tatsurashreShThA na hi dAsyAmyahaM shachIm
shlokas.24:
shalya uvAcha||
atha devAstamevAhurguruma~NgirasAM varam |
kathaM sunItaM tu bhavenmantrayasva bRRihaspate
shlokas.25:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
nahuShaM yAchatAM devI ki~nchitkAlAntaraM shubhA |
indrANIhitametaddhi tathAsmAkaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.26:
bahuvighnakaraH kAlaH kAlaH kAlaM nayiShyati |
darpito balavA.nshchApi nahuSho varasa.nshrayAt
shlokas.27:
shalya uvAcha||
tatastena tathokte tu prItA devAstamabruvan |
brahmansAdhvidamuktaM te hitaM sarvadivaukasAm
evametaddvijashreShTha devI cheyaM prasAdyatAm
shlokas.28:
tataH samastA indrANIM devAH sAgnipurogamAH |
UchurvachanamavyagrA lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.29:
tvayA jagadidaM sarvaM dhRRitaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
ekapatnyasi satyA cha gachChasva nahuShaM prati
shlokas.30:
kShipraM tvAmabhikAmashcha vinashiShyati pArthivaH |
nahuSho devi shakrashcha suraishvaryamavApsyati
shlokas.31:
evaM vinishchayaM kRRitvA indrANI kAryasiddhaye |
abhyagachChata savrIDA nahuShaM ghoradarshanam
shlokas.32:
dRRiShTvA tAM nahuShashchApi vayorUpasamanvitAm |
samahRRiShyata duShTAtmA kAmopahatachetanaH

shlokas.1:
shalya uvAcha||
atha tAmabravIddRRiShTvA nahuSho devarATtadA |
trayANAmapi lokAnAmahamindraH shuchismite
bhajasva mAM varArohe patitve varavarNini
shlokas.2:
evamuktA tu sA devI nahuSheNa pativratA |
prAvepata bhayodvignA pravAte kadalI yathA
shlokas.3:
namasya sA tu brahmANaM kRRitvA shirasi chA~njalim |
devarAjamathovAcha nahuShaM ghoradarshanam
shlokas.4:
kAlamichChAmyahaM labdhuM ki~nchittvattaH sureshvara |
na hi vij~nAyate shakraH prAptaH kiM vA kva vA gataH
shlokas.5:
tattvametattu vij~nAya yadi na j~nAyate prabho |
tato.ahaM tvAmupasthAsye satyametadbravImi te
evamuktaH sa indrANyA nahuShaH prItimAnabhUt
shlokas.6:
nahuSha uvAcha||
evaM bhavatu sushroNi yathA mAmabhibhAShase |
j~nAtvA chAgamanaM kAryaM satyametadanusmareH
shlokas.7:
shalya uvAcha||
nahuSheNa visRRiShTA cha nishchakrAma tataH shubhA |
bRRihaspatiniketaM sA jagAma cha tapasvinI
shlokas.8:
tasyAH sa.nshrutya cha vacho devAH sAgnipurogamAH |
mantrayAmAsurekAgrAH shakrArthaM rAjasattama
shlokas.9:
devadevena sa~Ngamya viShNunA prabhaviShNunA |
UchushchainaM samudvignA vAkyaM vAkyavishAradAH
shlokas.10:
brahmahatyAbhibhUto vai shakraH suragaNeshvaraH |
gatishcha nastvaM devesha pUrvajo jagataH prabhuH
rakShArthaM sarvabhUtAnAM viShNutvamupajagmivAn
shlokas.11:
tvadvIryAnnihate vRRitre vAsavo brahmahatyayA |
vRRitaH suragaNashreShTha mokShaM tasya vinirdisha
shlokas.12:
teShAM tadvachanaM shrutvA devAnAM viShNurabravIt |
mAmeva yajatAM shakraH pAvayiShyAmi vajriNam
shlokas.13:
puNyena hayamedhena mAmiShTvA pAkashAsanaH |
punareShyati devAnAmindratvamakutobhayaH
shlokas.14:
svakarmabhishcha nahuSho nAshaM yAsyati durmatiH |
ka~nchitkAlamimaM devA marShayadhvamatandritAH
shlokas.15:
shrutvA viShNoH shubhAM satyAM tAM vANImamRRitopamAm |
tataH sarve suragaNAH sopAdhyAyAH saharShibhiH
yatra shakro bhayodvignastaM deshamupachakramuH
shlokas.16:
tatrAshvamedhaH sumahAnmahendrasya mahAtmanaH |
vavRRite pAvanArthaM vai brahmahatyApaho nRRipa
shlokas.17:
vibhajya brahmahatyAM tu vRRikSheShu cha nadIShu cha |
parvateShu pRRithivyAM cha strIShu chaiva yudhiShThira
shlokas.18:
sa.nvibhajya cha bhUteShu visRRijya cha sureshvaraH |
vijvaraH pUtapApmA cha vAsavo.abhavadAtmavAn
shlokas.19:
akampyaM nahuShaM sthAnAddRRiShTvA cha balasUdanaH |
tejoghnaM sarvabhUtAnAM varadAnAchcha duHsaham
shlokas.20:
tataH shachIpatirvIraH punareva vyanashyata |
adRRishyaH sarvabhUtAnAM kAlAkA~NkShI chachAra ha
shlokas.21:
pranaShTe tu tataH shakre shachI shokasamanvitA |
hA shakreti tadA devI vilalApa suduHkhitA
shlokas.22:
yadi dattaM yadi hutaM guravastoShitA yadi |
ekabhartRRitvamevAstu satyaM yadyasti vA mayi
shlokas.23:
puNyAM chemAmahaM divyAM pravRRittAmuttarAyaNe |
devIM rAtriM namasyAmi sidhyatAM me manorathaH
shlokas.24:
prayatA cha nishAM devImupAtiShThata tatra sA |
pativratAtvAtsatyena sopashrutimathAkarot
shlokas.25:
yatrAste devarAjo.asau taM deshaM darshayasva me |
ityAhopashrutiM devI satyaM satyena dRRishyatAm

shlokas.1:
shalya uvAcha||
athainAM rupiNIM sAdhvImupAtiShThadupashrutiH |
tAM vayorUpasampannAM dRRiShTvA devImupasthitAm
shlokas.2:
indrANI samprahRRiShTA sA sampUjyainAmapRRichChata |
ichChAmi tvAmahaM j~nAtuM kA tvaM brUhi varAnane
shlokas.3:
upashrutiruvAcha||
upashrutirahaM devi tavAntikamupAgatA |
darshanaM chaiva samprAptA tava satyena toShitA
shlokas.4:
pativratAsi yuktA cha yamena niyamena cha |
darshayiShyAmi te shakraM devaM vRRitraniShUdanam
kShipramanvehi bhadraM te drakShyase surasattamam
shlokas.5:
shalya uvAcha||
tatastAM prasthitAM devImindrANI sA samanvagAt |
devAraNyAnyatikramya parvatA.nshcha bahU.nstataH
himavantamatikramya uttaraM pArshvamAgamat
shlokas.6:
samudraM cha samAsAdya bahuyojanavistRRitam |
AsasAda mahAdvIpaM nAnAdrumalatAvRRitam
shlokas.7:
tatrApashyatsaro divyaM nAnAshakunibhirvRRitam |
shatayojanavistIrNaM tAvadevAyataM shubham
shlokas.8:
tatra divyAni padmAni pa~nchavarNAni bhArata |
ShaTpadairupagItAni praphullAni sahasrashaH
shlokas.9:
padmasya bhittvA nAlaM cha vivesha sahitA tayA |
bisatantupraviShTaM cha tatrApashyachChatakratum
shlokas.10:
taM dRRiShTvA cha susUkShmeNa rUpeNAvasthitaM prabhum |
sUkShmarUpadharA devI babhUvopashrutishcha sA
shlokas.11:
indraM tuShTAva chendrANI vishrutaiH pUrvakarmabhiH |
stUyamAnastato devaH shachImAha pura.ndaraH
shlokas.12:
kimarthamasi samprAptA vij~nAtashcha kathaM tvaham |
tataH sA kathayAmAsa nahuShasya vicheShTitam
shlokas.13:
indratvaM triShu lokeShu prApya vIryamadAnvitaH |
darpAviShTashcha duShTAtmA mAmuvAcha shatakrato
upatiShTha mAmiti krUraH kAlaM cha kRRitavAnmama
shlokas.14:
yadi na trAsyasi vibho kariShyati sa mAM vashe |
etena chAhaM santaptA prAptA shakra tavAntikam
jahi raudraM mahAbAho nahuShaM pApanishchayam
shlokas.15:
prakAshayasva chAtmAnaM daityadAnavasUdana |
tejaH samApnuhi vibho devarAjyaM prashAdhi cha

shlokas.1:
shalya uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa bhagavA~nshachyA punarathAbravIt |
vikramasya na kAlo.ayaM nahuSho balavattaraH
shlokas.2:
vivardhitashcha RRiShibhirhavyaiH kavyaishcha bhAmini |
nItimatra vidhAsyAmi devi tAM kartumarhasi
shlokas.3:
guhyaM chaitattvayA kAryaM nAkhyAtavyaM shubhe kvachit |
gatvA nahuShamekAnte bravIhi tanumadhyame
shlokas.4:
RRiShiyAnena divyena mAmupaihi jagatpate |
evaM tava vashe prItA bhaviShyAmIti taM vada
shlokas.5:
ityuktA devarAjena patnI sA kamalekShaNA |
evamastvityathoktvA tu jagAma nahuShaM prati
shlokas.6:
nahuShastAM tato dRRiShTvA vismito vAkyamabravIt |
svAgataM te varArohe kiM karomi shuchismite
shlokas.7:
bhaktaM mAM bhaja kalyANi kimichChasi manasvini |
tava kalyANi yatkAryaM tatkariShye sumadhyame
shlokas.8:
na cha vrIDA tvayA kAryA sushroNi mayi vishvasa |
satyena vai shape devi kartAsmi vachanaM tava
shlokas.9:
indrANyuvAcha||
yo me tvayA kRRitaH kAlastamAkA~NkShe jagatpate |
tatastvameva bhartA me bhaviShyasi surAdhipa
shlokas.10:
kAryaM cha hRRidi me yattaddevarAjAvadhAraya |
vakShyAmi yadi me rAjanpriyametatkariShyasi
vAkyaM praNayasa.nyuktaM tataH syAM vashagA tava
shlokas.11:
indrasya vAjino vAhA hastino.atha rathAstathA |
ichChAmyahamihApUrvaM vAhanaM te surAdhipa
yanna viShNorna rudrasya nAsurANAM na rakShasAm
shlokas.12:
vahantu tvAM mahArAja RRiShayaH sa~NgatA vibho |
sarve shibikayA rAjannetaddhi mama rochate
shlokas.13:
nAsureShu na deveShu tulyo bhavitumarhasi |
sarveShAM teja Adatsva svena vIryeNa darshanAt
na te pramukhataH sthAtuM kashchidichChati vIryavAn
shlokas.14:
shalya uvAcha||
evamuktastu nahuShaH prAhRRiShyata tadA kila |
uvAcha vachanaM chApi surendrastAmaninditAm
shlokas.15:
apUrvaM vAhanamidaM tvayoktaM varavarNini |
dRRiDhaM me ruchitaM devi tvadvasho.asmi varAnane
shlokas.16:
na hyalpavIryo bhavati yo vAhAnkurute munIn |
ahaM tapasvI balavAnbhUtabhavyabhavatprabhuH
shlokas.17:
mayi kruddhe jaganna syAnmayi sarvaM pratiShThitam |
devadAnavagandharvAH kiMnaroragarAkShasAH
shlokas.18:
na me kruddhasya paryAptAH sarve lokAH shuchismite |
chakShuShA yaM prapashyAmi tasya tejo harAmyaham
shlokas.19:
tasmAtte vachanaM devi kariShyAmi na sa.nshayaH |
saptarShayo mAM vakShyanti sarve brahmarShayastathA
pashya mAhAtmyamasmAkamRRiddhiM cha varavarNini
shlokas.20:
evamuktvA tu tAM devIM visRRijya cha varAnanAm |
vimAne yojayitvA sa RRiShInniyamamAsthitAn
shlokas.21:
abrahmaNyo balopeto matto varamadena cha |
kAmavRRittaH sa duShTAtmA vAhayAmAsa tAnRRiShIn
shlokas.22:
nahuSheNa visRRiShTA cha bRRihaspatimuvAcha sA |
samayo.alpAvasheSho me nahuSheNeha yaH kRRitaH
shakraM mRRigaya shIghraM tvaM bhaktAyAH kuru me dayAm
shlokas.23:
bADhamityeva bhagavAnbRRihaspatiruvAcha tAm |
na bhetavyaM tvayA devi nahuShAdduShTachetasaH
shlokas.24:
na hyeSha sthAsyati chiraM gata eSha narAdhamaH |
adharmaj~no maharShINAM vAhanAchcha hataH shubhe
shlokas.25:
iShTiM chAhaM kariShyAmi vinAshAyAsya durmateH |
shakraM chAdhigamiShyAmi mA bhaistvaM bhadramastu te
shlokas.26:
tataH prajvAlya vidhivajjuhAva paramaM haviH |
bRRihaspatirmahAtejA devarAjopalabdhaye
shlokas.27:
tasmAchcha bhagavAndevaH svayameva hutAshanaH |
strIveShamadbhutaM kRRitvA sahasAntaradhIyata
shlokas.28:
sa dishaH pradishashchaiva parvatA.nshcha vanAni cha |
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha vichIyAtimanogatiH
nimeShAntaramAtreNa bRRihaspatimupAgamat
shlokas.29:
agniruvAcha||
bRRihaspate na pashyAmi devarAjamahaM kvachit |
ApaH sheShAH sadA chApaH praveShTuM notsahAmyaham
na me tatra gatirbrahmankimanyatkaravANi te
shlokas.31:
shalya uvAcha||
tamabravIddevagururapo visha mahAdyute |
agniruvAcha||
nApaH praveShTuM shakShyAmi kShayo me.atra bhaviShyati |
sharaNaM tvAM prapanno.asmi svasti te.astu mahAdyute
shlokas.32:
adbhyo.agnirbrahmataH kShatramashmano lohamutthitam |
teShAM sarvatragaM tejaH svAsu yoniShu shAmyati

shlokas.1:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
tvamagne sarvadevAnAM mukhaM tvamasi havyavAT |
tvamantaH sarvabhUtAnAM gUDhashcharasi sAkShivat
shlokas.2:
tvAmAhurekaM kavayastvAmAhustrividhaM punaH |
tvayA tyaktaM jagachchedaM sadyo nashyeddhutAshana
shlokas.3:
kRRitvA tubhyaM namo viprAH svakarmavijitAM gatim |
gachChanti saha patnIbhiH sutairapi cha shAshvatIm
shlokas.4:
tvamevAgne havyavAhastvameva paramaM haviH |
yajanti satraistvAmeva yaj~naishcha paramAdhvare
shlokas.5:
sRRiShTvA lokA.nstrInimAnhavyavAha; prApte kAle pachasi punaH samiddhaH |
sarvasyAsya bhuvanasya prasUti;stvamevAgne bhavasi punaH pratiShThA
shlokas.6:
tvAmagne jaladAnAhurvidyutashcha tvameva hi |
dahanti sarvabhUtAni tvatto niShkramya hAyanAH
shlokas.7:
tvayyApo nihitAH sarvAstvayi sarvamidaM jagat |
na te.astyaviditaM ki~nchittriShu lokeShu pAvaka
shlokas.8:
svayoniM bhajate sarvo vishasvApo.avisha~NkitaH |
ahaM tvAM vardhayiShyAmi brAhmairmantraiH sanAtanaiH
shlokas.9:
shalya uvAcha||
evaM stuto havyavAho bhagavAnkaviruttamaH |
bRRihaspatimathovAcha prItimAnvAkyamuttamam
darshayiShyAmi te shakraM satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.10:
pravishyApastato vahniH sasamudrAH sapalvalAH |
AjagAma sarastachcha gUDho yatra shatakratuH
shlokas.11:
atha tatrApi padmAni vichinvanbharatarShabha |
anvapashyatsa devendraM bisamadhyagataM sthitam
shlokas.12:
Agatya cha tatastUrNaM tamAchaShTa bRRihaspateH |
aNumAtreNa vapuShA padmatantvAshritaM prabhum
shlokas.13:
gatvA devarShigandharvaiH sahito.atha bRRihaspatiH |
purANaiH karmabhirdevaM tuShTAva balasUdanam
shlokas.14:
mahAsuro hataH shakra namuchirdAruNastvayA |
shambarashcha balashchaiva tathobhau ghoravikramau
shlokas.15:
shatakrato vivardhasva sarvA~nshatrUnniShUdaya |
uttiShTha vajrinsampashya devarShI.nshcha samAgatAn
shlokas.16:
mahendra dAnavAnhatvA lokAstrAtAstvayA vibho |
apAM phenaM samAsAdya viShNutejopabRRiMhitam
tvayA vRRitro hataH pUrvaM devarAja jagatpate
shlokas.17:
tvaM sarvabhUteShu vareNya IDya;stvayA samaM vidyate neha bhUtam |
tvayA dhAryante sarvabhUtAni shakra; tvaM devAnAM mahimAnaM chakartha
shlokas.18:
pAhi devAnsalokA.nshcha mahendra balamApnuhi |
evaM sa.nstUyamAnashcha so.avardhata shanaiH shanaiH
shlokas.19:
svaM chaiva vapurAsthAya babhUva sa balAnvitaH |
abravIchcha guruM devo bRRihaspatimupasthitam
shlokas.20:
kiM kAryamavashiShTaM vo hatastvAShTro mahAsuraH |
vRRitrashcha sumahAkAyo grastuM lokAniyeSha yaH
shlokas.21:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
mAnuSho nahuSho rAjA devarShigaNatejasA |
devarAjyamanuprAptaH sarvAnno bAdhate bhRRisham
shlokas.22:
indra uvAcha||
kathaM nu nahuSho rAjyaM devAnAM prApa durlabham |
tapasA kena vA yuktaH ki.nvIryo vA bRRihaspate
shlokas.23:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
devA bhItAH shakramakAmayanta; tvayA tyaktaM mahadaindraM padaM tat |
tadA devAH pitaro.atharShayashcha; gandharvasa~NghAshcha sametya sarve
shlokas.24:
gatvAbruvannahuShaM shakra tatra; tvaM no rAjA bhava bhuvanasya goptA |
tAnabravInnahuSho nAsmi shakta; ApyAyadhvaM tapasA tejasA cha
shlokas.25:
evamuktairvardhitashchApi devai; rAjAbhavannahuSho ghoravIryaH |
trailokye cha prApya rAjyaM tapasvinaH; kRRitvA vAhAnyAti lokAndurAtmA
shlokas.26:
tejoharaM dRRiShTiviShaM sughoraM; mA tvaM pashyernahuShaM vai kadAchit |
devAshcha sarve nahuShaM bhayArtA; na pashyanto gUDharUpAshcharanti
shlokas.27:
shalya uvAcha||
evaM vadatya~NgirasAM variShThe; bRRihaspatau lokapAlaH kuberaH |
vaivasvatashchaiva yamaH purANo; devashcha somo varuNashchAjagAma
shlokas.28:
te vai samAgamya mahendramUchu;rdiShTyA tvAShTro nihatashchaiva vRRitraH |
diShTyA cha tvAM kushalinamakShataM cha; pashyAmo vai nihatAriM cha shakra
shlokas.29:
sa tAnyathAvatpratibhAShya shakraH; sa~nchodayannahuShasyAntareNa |
rAjA devAnAM nahuSho ghorarUpa;statra sAhyaM dIyatAM me bhavadbhiH
shlokas.30:
te chAbruvannahuSho ghorarUpo; dRRiShTIviShastasya bibhIma deva |
tvaM chedrAjannahuShaM parAjaye;stadvai vayaM bhAgamarhAma shakra
shlokas.31:
indro.abravIdbhavatu bhavAnapAM pati;ryamaH kuberashcha mahAbhiShekam |
samprApnuvantvadya sahaiva tena; ripuM jayAmo nahuShaM ghoradRRiShTim
shlokas.32:
tataH shakraM jvalano.apyAha bhAgaM; prayachCha mahyaM tava sAhyaM kariShye |
tamAha shakro bhavitAgne tavApi; aindrAgno vai bhAga eko mahAkratau
shlokas.33:
evaM sa~nchintya bhagavAnmahendraH pAkashAsanaH |
kuberaM sarvayakShANAM dhanAnAM cha prabhuM tathA
shlokas.34:
vaivasvataM pitR^INAM cha varuNaM chApyapAM tathA |
AdhipatyaM dadau shakraH satkRRitya varadastadA

shlokas.1:
shalya uvAcha||
atha sa~nchintayAnasya devarAjasya dhImataH |
nahuShasya vadhopAyaM lokapAlaiH sahaiva taiH
tapasvI tatra bhagavAnagastyaH pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.2:
so.abravIdarchya devendraM diShTyA vai vardhate bhavAn |
vishvarUpavinAshena vRRitrAsuravadhena cha
shlokas.3:
diShTyA cha nahuSho bhraShTo devarAjyAtpura.ndara |
diShTyA hatAriM pashyAmi bhavantaM balasUdana
shlokas.4:
indra uvAcha||
svAgataM te maharShe.astu prIto.ahaM darshanAttava |
pAdyamAchamanIyaM cha gAmarghyaM cha pratIchCha me
shlokas.5:
shalya uvAcha||
pUjitaM chopaviShTaM tamAsane munisattamam |
paryapRRichChata deveshaH prahRRiShTo brAhmaNarShabham
shlokas.6:
etadichChAmi bhagavankathyamAnaM dvijottama |
paribhraShTaH kathaM svargAnnahuShaH pApanishchayaH
shlokas.7:
agastya uvAcha||
shRRiNu shakra priyaM vAkyaM yathA rAjA durAtmavAn |
svargAdbhraShTo durAchAro nahuSho baladarpitaH
shlokas.8:
shramArtAstu vahantastaM nahuShaM pApakAriNam |
devarShayo mahAbhAgAstathA brahmarShayo.amalAH
paprachChuH sa.nshayaM deva nahuShaM jayatAM vara
shlokas.9:
ya ime brahmaNA proktA mantrA vai prokShaNe gavAm |
ete pramANaM bhavata utAho neti vAsava
nahuSho neti tAnAha tamasA mUDhachetanaH
shlokas.10:
RRiShaya UchuH||
adharme sampravRRittastvaM dharmaM na pratipadyase |
pramANametadasmAkaM pUrvaM proktaM maharShibhiH
shlokas.11:
agastya uvAcha||
tato vivadamAnaH sa munibhiH saha vAsava |
atha mAmaspRRishanmUrdhni pAdenAdharmapIDitaH
shlokas.12:
tenAbhUddhatatejAH sa niHshrIkashcha shachIpate |
tatastamahamAvignamavochaM bhayapIDitam
shlokas.13:
yasmAtpUrvaiH kRRitaM brahma brahmarShibhiranuShThitam |
aduShTaM dUShayasi vai yachcha mUrdhnyaspRRishaH padA
shlokas.14:
yachchApi tvamRRiShInmUDha brahmakalpAndurAsadAn |
vAhAnkRRitvA vAhayasi tena svargAddhataprabhaH
shlokas.15:
dhva.nsa pApa paribhraShTaH kShINapuNyo mahItalam |
dasha varShasahasrANi sarparUpadharo mahAn
vichariShyasi pUrNeShu punaH svargamavApsyasi
shlokas.16:
evaM bhraShTo durAtmA sa devarAjyAdari.ndama |
diShTyA vardhAmahe shakra hato brAhmaNakaNTakaH
shlokas.17:
triviShTapaM prapadyasva pAhi lokA~nshachIpate |
jitendriyo jitAmitraH stUyamAno maharShibhiH
shlokas.18:
shalya uvAcha||
tato devA bhRRishaM tuShTA maharShigaNasa.nvRRitAH |
pitarashchaiva yakShAshcha bhujagA rAkShasAstathA
shlokas.19:
gandharvA devakanyAshcha sarve chApsarasAM gaNAH |
sarA.nsi saritaH shailAH sAgarAshcha vishAM pate
shlokas.20:
upagamyAbruvansarve diShTyA vardhasi shatruhan |
hatashcha nahuShaH pApo diShTyAgastyena dhImatA
diShTyA pApasamAchAraH kRRitaH sarpo mahItale

shlokas.1:
shalya uvAcha||
tataH shakraH stUyamAno gandharvApsarasAM gaNaiH |
airAvataM samAruhya dvipendraM lakShaNairyutam
shlokas.2:
pAvakashcha mahAtejA maharShishcha bRRihaspatiH |
yamashcha varuNashchaiva kuberashcha dhaneshvaraH
shlokas.3:
sarvairdevaiH parivRRitaH shakro vRRitraniShUdanaH |
gandharvairapsarobhishcha yAtastribhuvanaM prabhuH
shlokas.4:
sa sametya mahendrANyA devarAjaH shatakratuH |
mudA paramayA yuktaH pAlayAmAsa devarAT
shlokas.5:
tataH sa bhagavA.nstatra a~NgirAH samadRRishyata |
atharvavedamantraishcha devendraM samapUjayat
shlokas.6:
tatastu bhagavAnindraH prahRRiShTaH samapadyata |
varaM cha pradadau tasmai atharvA~Ngirase tadA
shlokas.7:
atharvA~NgirasaM nAma asminvede bhaviShyati |
udAharaNametaddhi yaj~nabhAgaM cha lapsyase
shlokas.8:
evaM sampUjya bhagavAnatharvA~NgirasaM tadA |
vyasarjayanmahArAja devarAjaH shatakratuH
shlokas.9:
sampUjya sarvA.nstridashAnRRiShI.nshchApi tapodhanAn |
indraH pramudito rAjandharmeNApAlayatprajAH
shlokas.10:
evaM duHkhamanuprAptamindreNa saha bhAryayA |
aj~nAtavAsashcha kRRitaH shatrUNAM vadhakA~NkShayA
shlokas.11:
nAtra manyustvayA kAryo yatkliShTo.asi mahAvane |
draupadyA saha rAjendra bhrAtRRibhishcha mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.12:
evaM tvamapi rAjendra rAjyaM prApsyasi bhArata |
vRRitraM hatvA yathA prAptaH shakraH kauravanandana
shlokas.13:
durAchArashcha nahuSho brahmadviTpApachetanaH |
agastyashApAbhihato vinaShTaH shAshvatIH samAH
shlokas.14:
evaM tava durAtmAnaH shatravaH shatrusUdana |
kShipraM nAshaM gamiShyanti karNaduryodhanAdayaH
shlokas.15:
tataH sAgaraparyantAM bhokShyase medinImimAm |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito vIra draupadyA cha sahAbhibho
shlokas.16:
upAkhyAnamidaM shakravijayaM vedasaMmitam |
rAj~nA vyUDheShvanIkeShu shrotavyaM jayamichChatA
shlokas.17:
tasmAtsa.nshrAvayAmi tvAM vijayaM jayatAM vara |
sa.nstUyamAnA vardhante mahAtmAno yudhiShThira
shlokas.18:
kShatriyANAmabhAvo.ayaM yudhiShThira mahAtmanAm |
duryodhanAparAdhena bhImArjunabalena cha
shlokas.19:
AkhyAnamindravijayaM ya idaM niyataH paThet |
dhUtapApmA jitasvargaH sa pretyeha cha modate
shlokas.20:
na chArijaM bhayaM tasya na chAputro bhavennaraH |
nApadaM prApnuyAtkA~nchiddIrghamAyushcha vindati
sarvatra jayamApnoti na kadAchitparAjayam
shlokas.21:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamAshvAsito rAjA shalyena bharatarShabha |
pUjayAmAsa vidhivachChalyaM dharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.22:
shrutvA shalyasya vachanaM kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
pratyuvAcha mahAbAhurmadrarAjamidaM vachaH
shlokas.23:
bhavAnkarNasya sArathyaM kariShyati na sa.nshayaH |
tatra tejovadhaH kAryaH karNasya mama sa.nstavaiH
shlokas.24:
shalya uvAcha||
evametatkariShyAmi yathA mAM samprabhAShase |
yachchAnyadapi shakShyAmi tatkariShyAmyahaM tava
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tata Amantrya kaunteyA~nshalyo madrAdhipastadA |
jagAma sabalaH shrImAnduryodhanamari.ndamaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yuyudhAnastato vIraH sAtvatAnAM mahArathaH |
mahatA chatura~NgeNa balenAgAdyudhiShThiram
shlokas.2:
tasya yodhA mahAvIryA nAnAdeshasamAgatAH |
nAnApraharaNA vIrAH shobhayAM chakrire balam
shlokas.3:
parashvadhairbhiNDipAlaiH shaktitomaramudgaraiH |
shaktyRRiShTiparashuprAsaiH karavAlaishcha nirmalaiH
shlokas.4:
khaDgakArmukaniryUhaiH sharaishcha vividhairapi |
tailadhautaiH prakAshadbhistadashobhata vai balam
shlokas.5:
tasya meghaprakAshasya shastraistaiH shobhitasya cha |
babhUva rUpaM sainyasya meghasyeva savidyutaH
shlokas.6:
akShauhiNI hi senA sA tadA yaudhiShThiraM balam |
pravishyAntardadhe rAjansAgaraM kunadI yathA
shlokas.7:
tathaivAkShauhiNIM gRRihya chedInAmRRiShabho balI |
dhRRiShTaketurupAgachChatpANDavAnamitaujasaH
shlokas.8:
mAgadhashcha jayatseno jArAsandhirmahAbalaH |
akShauhiNyaiva sainyasya dharmarAjamupAgamat
shlokas.9:
tathaiva pANDyo rAjendra sAgarAnUpavAsibhiH |
vRRito bahuvidhairyodhairyudhiShThiramupAgamat
shlokas.10:
tasya sainyamatIvAsIttasminbalasamAgame |
prekShaNIyataraM rAjansuveShaM balavattadA
shlokas.11:
drupadasyApyabhUtsenA nAnAdeshasamAgataiH |
shobhitA puruShaiH shUraiH putraishchAsya mahArathaiH
shlokas.12:
tathaiva rAjA matsyAnAM virATo vAhinIpatiH |
pArvatIyairmahIpAlaiH sahitaH pANDavAniyAt
shlokas.13:
itashchetashcha pANDUnAM samAjagmurmahAtmanAm |
akShauhiNyastu saptaiva vividhadhvajasa~NkulAH
yuyutsamAnAH kurubhiH pANDavAnsamaharShayan
shlokas.14:
tathaiva dhArtarAShTrasya harShaM samabhivardhayan |
bhagadatto mahIpAlaH senAmakShauhiNIM dadau
shlokas.15:
tasya chInaiH kirAtaishcha kA~nchanairiva sa.nvRRitam |
babhau balamanAdhRRiShyaM karNikAravanaM yathA
shlokas.16:
tathA bhUrishravAH shUraH shalyashcha kurunandana |
duryodhanamupAyAtAvakShauhiNyA pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.17:
kRRitavarmA cha hArdikyo bhojAndhakabalaiH saha |
akShauhiNyaiva senAyA duryodhanamupAgamat
shlokas.18:
tasya taiH puruShavyAghrairvanamAlAdharairbalam |
ashobhata yathA mattairvanaM prakrIDitairgajaiH
shlokas.19:
jayadrathamukhAshchAnye sindhusauvIravAsinaH |
AjagmuH pRRithivIpAlAH kampayanta ivAchalAn
shlokas.20:
teShAmakShauhiNI senA bahulA vibabhau tadA |
vidhUyamAnA vAtena bahurUpA ivAmbudAH
shlokas.21:
sudakShiNashcha kAmbojo yavanaishcha shakaistathA |
upAjagAma kauravyamakShauhiNyA vishAM pate
shlokas.22:
tasya senAsamAvAyaH shalabhAnAmivAbabhau |
sa cha samprApya kauravyaM tatraivAntardadhe tadA
shlokas.23:
tathA mAhiShmatIvAsI nIlo nIlAyudhaiH saha |
mahIpAlo mahAvIryairdakShiNApathavAsibhiH
shlokas.24:
Avantyau cha mahIpAlau mahAbalasusa.nvRRitau |
pRRithagakShauhiNIbhyAM tAvabhiyAtau suyodhanam
shlokas.25:
kekayAshcha naravyAghrAH sodaryAH pa~ncha pArthivAH |
saMharShayantaH kauravyamakShauhiNyA samAdravan
shlokas.26:
itashchetashcha sarveShAM bhUmipAnAM mahAtmanAm |
tisro.anyAH samavartanta vAhinyo bharatarShabha
shlokas.27:
evamekAdashAvRRittAH senA duryodhanasya tAH |
yuyutsamAnAH kaunteyAnnAnAdhvajasamAkulAH
shlokas.28:
na hAstinapure rAjannavakAsho.abhavattadA |
rAj~nAM sabalamukhyAnAM prAdhAnyenApi bhArata
shlokas.29:
tataH pa~nchanadaM chaiva kRRitsnaM cha kurujA~Ngalam |
tathA rohitakAraNyaM marubhUmishcha kevalA
shlokas.30:
ahichChatraM kAlakUTaM ga~NgAkUlaM cha bhArata |
vAraNA vATadhAnaM cha yAmunashchaiva parvataH
shlokas.31:
eSha deshaH suvistIrNaH prabhUtadhanadhAnyavAn |
babhUva kauraveyANAM balena susamAkulaH
shlokas.32:
tatra sainyaM tathAyuktaM dadarsha sa purohitaH |
yaH sa pA~nchAlarAjena preShitaH kauravAnprati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa tu kauravyamAsAdya drupadasya purohitaH |
satkRRito dhRRitarAShTreNa bhIShmeNa vidureNa cha
shlokas.2:
sarvaM kaushalyamuktvAdau pRRiShTvA chaivamanAmayam |
sarvasenApraNetR^INAM madhye vAkyamuvAcha ha
shlokas.3:
sarvairbhavadbhirvidito rAjadharmaH sanAtanaH |
vAkyopAdAnahetostu vakShyAmi vidite sati
shlokas.4:
dhRRitarAShTrashcha pANDushcha sutAvekasya vishrutau |
tayoH samAnaM draviNaM paitRRikaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTrasya ye putrAste prAptAH paitRRikaM vasu |
pANDuputrAH kathaM nAma na prAptAH paitRRikaM vasu
shlokas.6:
evaM gate pANDaveyairviditaM vaH purA yathA |
na prAptaM paitRRikaM dravyaM dhArtarAShTreNa sa.nvRRitam
shlokas.7:
prANAntikairapyupAyaiH prayatadbhiranekashaH |
sheShavanto na shakitA nayituM yamasAdanam
shlokas.8:
punashcha vardhitaM rAjyaM svabalena mahAtmabhiH |
ChadmanApahRRitaM kShudrairdhArtarAShTraiH sasaubalaiH
shlokas.9:
tadapyanumataM karma tathAyuktamanena vai |
vAsitAshcha mahAraNye varShANIha trayodasha
shlokas.10:
sabhAyAM kleshitairvIraiH sahabhAryaistathA bhRRisham |
araNye vividhAH kleshAH samprAptAstaiH sudAruNAH
shlokas.11:
tathA virATanagare yonyantaragatairiva |
prAptaH paramasa~Nklesho yathA pApairmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.12:
te sarve pRRiShThataH kRRitvA tatsarvaM pUrvakilbiSham |
sAmaiva kurubhiH sArdhamichChanti kurupu~NgavAH
shlokas.13:
teShAM cha vRRittamAj~nAya vRRittaM duryodhanasya cha |
anunetumihArhanti dhRRitarAShTraM suhRRijjanAH
shlokas.14:
na hi te vigrahaM vIrAH kurvanti kurubhiH saha |
avinAshena lokasya kA~NkShante pANDavAH svakam
shlokas.15:
yashchApi dhArtarAShTrasya hetuH syAdvigrahaM prati |
sa cha heturna mantavyo balIyA.nsastathA hi te
shlokas.16:
akShauhiNyo hi saptaiva dharmaputrasya sa~NgatAH |
yuyutsamAnAH kurubhiH pratIkShante.asya shAsanam
shlokas.17:
apare puruShavyAghrAH sahasrAkShauhiNIsamAH |
sAtyakirbhImasenashcha yamau cha sumahAbalau
shlokas.18:
ekAdashaitAH pRRitanA ekatashcha samAgatAH |
ekatashcha mahAbAhurbahurUpo dhana~njayaH
shlokas.19:
yathA kirITI senAbhyaH sarvAbhyo vyatirichyate |
evameva mahAbAhurvAsudevo mahAdyutiH
shlokas.20:
bahulatvaM cha senAnAM vikramaM cha kirITinaH |
buddhimattAM cha kRRiShNasya buddhvA yudhyeta ko naraH
shlokas.21:
te bhavanto yathAdharmaM yathAsamayameva cha |
prayachChantu pradAtavyaM mA vaH kAlo.atyagAdayam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA praj~nAvRRiddho mahAdyutiH |
sampUjyainaM yathAkAlaM bhIShmo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
diShTyA kushalinaH sarve pANDavAH saha bAndhavaiH |
diShTyA sahAyavantashcha diShTyA dharme cha te ratAH
shlokas.3:
diShTyA cha sandhikAmAste bhrAtaraH kurunandanAH |
diShTyA na yuddhamanasaH saha dAmodareNa te
shlokas.4:
bhavatA satyamuktaM cha sarvametanna sa.nshayaH |
atitIkShNaM tu te vAkyaM brAhmaNyAditi me matiH
shlokas.5:
asa.nshayaM kleshitAste vane cheha cha pANDavAH |
prAptAshcha dharmataH sarvaM piturdhanamasa.nshayam
shlokas.6:
kirITI balavAnpArthaH kRRitAstrashcha mahAbalaH |
ko hi pANDusutaM yuddhe viShaheta dhana~njayam
shlokas.7:
api vajradharaH sAkShAtkimutAnye dhanurbhRRitaH |
trayANAmapi lokAnAM samartha iti me matiH
shlokas.8:
bhIShme bruvati tadvAkyaM dhRRiShTamAkShipya manyumAn |
duryodhanaM samAlokya karNo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.9:
na tanna viditaM brahma.Nlloke bhUtena kenachit |
punaruktena kiM tena bhAShitena punaH punaH
shlokas.10:
duryodhanArthe shakunirdyUte nirjitavAnpurA |
samayena gato.araNyaM pANDuputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.11:
na taM samayamAdRRitya rAjyamichChati paitRRikam |
balamAshritya matsyAnAM pA~nchAlAnAM cha pArthivaH
shlokas.12:
duryodhano bhayAdvidvanna dadyAtpadamantataH |
dharmatastu mahIM kRRitsnAM pradadyAchChatrave.api cha
shlokas.13:
yadi kA~NkShanti te rAjyaM pitRRipaitAmahaM punaH |
yathApratij~naM kAlaM taM charantu vanamAshritAH
shlokas.14:
tato duryodhanasyA~Nke vartantAmakutobhayAH |
adhArmikAmimAM buddhiM kuryurmaurkhyAddhi kevalam
shlokas.15:
atha te dharmamutsRRijya yuddhamichChanti pANDavAH |
AsAdyemAnkurushreShThAnsmariShyanti vacho mama
shlokas.16:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kiM nu rAdheya vAchA te karma tatsmartumarhasi |
eka eva yadA pArthaH ShaDrathA~njitavAnyudhi
shlokas.17:
na chedevaM kariShyAmo yadayaM brAhmaNo.abravIt |
dhruvaM yudhi hatAstena bhakShayiShyAma pA.nsukAn
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTrastato bhIShmamanumAnya prasAdya cha |
avabhartsya cha rAdheyamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.19:
asmaddhitamidaM vAkyaM bhIShmaH shAntanavo.abravIt |
pANDavAnAM hitaM chaiva sarvasya jagatastathA
shlokas.20:
chintayitvA tu pArthebhyaH preShayiShyAmi sa~njayam |
sa bhavAnpratiyAtvadya pANDavAneva mAchiram
shlokas.21:
sa taM satkRRitya kauravyaH preShayAmAsa pANDavAn |
sabhAmadhye samAhUya sa~njayaM vAkyamabravIt

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
prAptAnAhuH sa~njaya pANDuputrA;nupaplavye tAnvijAnIhi gatvA |
ajAtashatruM cha sabhAjayethA; diShTyAnagha grAmamupasthitastvam
shlokas.2:
sarvAnvadeH sa~njaya svastimantaH; kRRichChraM vAsamatadarhA niruShya |
teShAM shAntirvidyate.asmAsu shIghraM; mithyopetAnAmupakAriNAM satAm
shlokas.3:
nAhaM kvachitsa~njaya pANDavAnAM; mithyAvRRittiM kA~nchana jAtvapashyam |
sarvAM shriyaM hyAtmavIryeNa labdhvA; paryAkArShuH pANDavA mahyameva
shlokas.4:
doShaM hyeShAM nAdhigachChe parikSha;nnityaM ka~nchidyena garheya pArthAn |
dharmArthAbhyAM karma kurvanti nityaM; sukhapriyA nAnurudhyanti kAmAn
shlokas.5:
gharmaM shItaM kShutpipAse tathaiva; nidrAM tandrIM krodhaharShau pramAdam |
dhRRityA chaiva praj~nayA chAbhibhUya; dharmArthayogAnprayatanti pArthAH
shlokas.6:
tyajanti mitreShu dhanAni kAle; na sa.nvAsAjjIryati maitrameShAm |
yathArhamAnArthakarA hi pArthA;steShAM dveShTA nAstyAjamIDhasya pakShe
shlokas.7:
anyatra pApAdviShamAnmandabuddhe;rduryodhanAtkShudratarAchcha karNAt |
teShAM hIme hInasukhapriyANAM; mahAtmanAM sa~njanayanti tejaH
shlokas.8:
utthAnavIryaH sukhamedhamAno; duryodhanaH sukRRitaM manyate tat |
teShAM bhAgaM yachcha manyeta bAlaH; shakyaM hartuM jIvatAM pANDavAnAm
shlokas.9:
yasyArjunaH padavIM keshavashcha; vRRikodaraH sAtyako.ajAtashatroH |
mAdrIputrau sRRi~njayAshchApi sarve; purA yuddhAtsAdhu tasya pradAnam
shlokas.10:
sa hyevaikaH pRRithivIM savyasAchI; gANDIvadhanvA praNudedrathasthaH |
tathA viShNuH keshavo.apyapradhRRiShyo; lokatrayasyAdhipatirmahAtmA
shlokas.11:
tiShTheta kastasya martyaH purastA;dyaH sarvadeveShu vareNya IDyaH |
parjanyaghoShAnpravapa~nsharaughA;npata~Ngasa~NghAniva shIghravegAn
shlokas.12:
dishaM hyudIchImapi chottarAnkurU;ngANDIvadhanvaikaratho jigAya |
dhanaM chaiShAmAharatsavyasAchI; senAnugAnbalidA.nshchaiva chakre
shlokas.13:
yashchaiva devAnkhANDave savyasAchI; gANDIvadhanvA prajigAya sendrAn |
upAharatphalguno jAtavedase; yasho mAnaM vardhayanpANDavAnAm
shlokas.14:
gadAbhRRitAM nAdya samo.asti bhImA;ddhastyAroho nAsti samashcha tasya |
rathe.arjunAdAhurahInamenaM; bAhvorbale chAyutanAgavIryam
shlokas.15:
sushikShitaH kRRitavairastarasvI; dahetkruddhastarasA dhArtarAShTrAn |
sadAtyamarShI balavAnna shakyo; yuddhe jetuM vAsavenApi sAkShAt
shlokas.16:
suchetasau balinau shIghrahastau; sushikShitau bhrAtarau phalgunena |
shyenau yathA pakShipUgAnrujantau; mAdrIputrau neha kurUnvishetAm
shlokas.17:
teShAM madhye vartamAnastarasvI; dhRRiShTadyumnaH pANDavAnAmihaikaH |
sahAmAtyaH somakAnAM prabarhaH; santyaktAtmA pANDavAnAM jayAya
shlokas.18:
sahoShitashcharitArtho vayaHsthaH; shAlveyAnAmadhipo vai virATaH |
saha putraiH pANDavArthe cha shashva;dyudhiShThiraM bhakta iti shrutaM me
shlokas.19:
avaruddhA balinaH kekayebhyo; maheShvAsA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha santi |
kekayebhyo rAjyamAkA~NkShamANA; yuddhArthinashchAnuvasanti pArthAn
shlokas.20:
sarve cha vIrAH pRRithivIpatInAM; samAnItAH pANDavArthe niviShTAH |
shUrAnahaM bhaktimataH shRRiNomi; prItyA yuktAnsa.nshritAndharmarAjam
shlokas.21:
giryAshrayA durganivAsinashcha; yodhAH pRRithivyAM kulajA vishuddhAH |
mlechChAshcha nAnAyudhavIryavantaH; samAgatAH pANDavArthe niviShTAH
shlokas.22:
pANDyashcha rAjAmita indrakalpo; yudhi pravIrairbahubhiH sametaH |
samAgataH pANDavArthe mahAtmA; lokapravIro.aprativIryatejAH
shlokas.23:
astraM droNAdarjunAdvAsudevA;tkRRipAdbhIShmAdyena kRRitaM shRRiNomi |
yaM taM kArShNipratimaM prAhurekaM; sa sAtyakiH pANDavArthe niviShTaH
shlokas.24:
apAshritAshchedikarUShakAshcha; sarvotsAhairbhUmipAlaiH sametAH |
teShAM madhye sUryamivAtapantaM; shriyA vRRitaM chedipatiM jvalantam
shlokas.25:
astambhanIyaM yudhi manyamAnaM; jyAkarShatAM shreShThatamaM pRRithivyAm |
sarvotsAhaM kShatriyANAM nihatya; prasahya kRRiShNastarasA mamarda
shlokas.26:
yashomAnau vardhayanyAdavAnAM; purAbhinachChishupAlaM samIke |
yasya sarve vardhayanti sma mAnaM; karUSharAjapramukhA narendrAH
shlokas.27:
tamasahyaM keshavaM tatra matvA; sugrIvayuktena rathena kRRiShNam |
samprAdrava.nshchedipatiM vihAya; siMhaM dRRiShTvA kShudramRRigA ivAnye
shlokas.28:
yastaM pratIpastarasA pratyudIyA;dAsha.nsamAno dvairathe vAsudevam |
so.asheta kRRiShNena hataH parAsu;rvAtenevonmathitaH karNikAraH
shlokas.29:
parAkramaM me yadavedayanta; teShAmarthe sa~njaya keshavasya |
anusmara.nstasya karmANi viShNo;rgAvalgaNe nAdhigachChAmi shAntim
shlokas.30:
na jAtu tA~nshatruranyaH saheta; yeShAM sa syAdagraNIrvRRiShNisiMhaH |
pravepate me hRRidayaM bhayena; shrutvA kRRiShNAvekarathe sametau
shlokas.31:
no chedgachChetsa~NgaraM mandabuddhi;stAbhyAM suto me viparItachetAH |
no chetkurUnsa~njaya nirdahetA;mindrAviShNU daityasenAM yathaiva
mato hi me shakrasamo dhana~njayaH; sanAtano vRRiShNivIrashcha viShNuH
shlokas.32:
dharmArAmo hrIniShedhastarasvI; kuntIputraH pANDavo.ajAtashatruH |
duryodhanena nikRRito manasvI; no chetkruddhaH pradaheddhArtarAShTrAn
shlokas.33:
nAhaM tathA hyarjunAdvAsudevA;dbhImAdvApi yamayorvA bibhemi |
yathA rAj~naH krodhadIptasya sUta; manyorahaM bhItataraH sadaiva
shlokas.34:
alaM tapobrahmacharyeNa yuktaH; sa~Nkalpo.ayaM mAnasastasya sidhyet |
tasya krodhaM sa~njayAhaM samIke; sthAne jAnanbhRRishamasmyadya bhItaH
shlokas.35:
sa gachCha shIghraM prahito rathena; pA~nchAlarAjasya chamUM paretya |
ajAtashatruM kushalaM sma pRRichCheH; punaH punaH prItiyuktaM vadestvam
shlokas.36:
janArdanaM chApi sametya tAta; mahAmAtraM vIryavatAmudAram |
anAmayaM madvachanena pRRichChe;rdhRRitarAShTraH pANDavaiH shAntimIpsuH
shlokas.37:
na tasya ki~nchidvachanaM na kuryA;tkuntIputro vAsudevasya sUta |
priyashchaiShAmAtmasamashcha kRRiShNo; vidvA.nshchaiShAM karmaNi nityayuktaH
shlokas.38:
samAnIya pANDavAnsRRi~njayA.nshcha; janArdanaM yuyudhAnaM virATam |
anAmayaM madvachanena pRRichCheH; sarvA.nstathA draupadeyA.nshcha pa~ncha
shlokas.39:
yadyattatra prAptakAlaM parebhya;stvaM manyethA bhAratAnAM hitaM cha |
tattadbhAShethAH sa~njaya rAjamadhye; na mUrChayedyanna bhavechcha yuddham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rAj~nastu vachanaM shrutvA dhRRitarAShTrasya sa~njayaH |
upaplavyaM yayau draShTuM pANDavAnamitaujasaH
shlokas.2:
sa tu rAjAnamAsAdya dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
praNipatya tataH pUrvaM sUtaputro.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.3:
gAvalgaNiH sa~njayaH sUtasUnu;rajAtashatrumavadatpratItaH |
diShTyA rAja.nstvAmarogaM prapashye; sahAyavantaM cha mahendrakalpam
shlokas.4:
anAmayaM pRRichChati tvAmbikeyo; vRRiddho rAjA dhRRitarAShTro manIShI |
kachchidbhImaH kushalI pANDavAgryo; dhana~njayastau cha mAdrItanUjau
shlokas.5:
kachchitkRRiShNA draupadI rAjaputrI; satyavratA vIrapatnI saputrA |
manasvinI yatra cha vA~nChasi tva;miShTAnkAmAnbhArata svastikAmaH
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
gAvalgaNe sa~njaya svAgataM te; prItAtmAhaM tvAbhivadAmi sUta |
anAmayaM pratijAne tavAhaM; sahAnujaiH kushalI chAsmi vidvan
shlokas.7:
chirAdidaM kushalaM bhAratasya; shrutvA rAj~naH kuruvRRiddhasya sUta |
manye sAkShAddRRiShTamahaM narendraM; dRRiShTvaiva tvAM sa~njaya prItiyogAt
shlokas.8:
pitAmaho naH sthaviro manasvI; mahAprAj~naH sarvadharmopapannaH |
sa kauravyaH kushalI tAta bhIShmo; yathApUrvaM vRRittirapyasya kachchit
shlokas.9:
kachchidrAjA dhRRitarAShTraH saputro; vaichitravIryaH kushalI mahAtmA |
mahArAjo bAhlikaH prAtipeyaH; kachchidvidvAnkushalI sUtaputra
shlokas.10:
sa somadattaH kushalI tAta kachchi;dbhUrishravAH satyasandhaH shalashcha |
droNaH saputrashcha kRRipashcha vipro; maheShvAsAH kachchidete.apyarogAH
shlokas.11:
mahAprAj~nAH sarvashAstrAvadAtA; dhanurbhRRitAM mukhyatamAH pRRithivyAm |
kachchinmAnaM tAta labhanta ete; dhanurbhRRitaH kachchidete.apyarogAH
shlokas.12:
sarve kurubhyaH spRRihayanti sa~njaya; dhanurdharA ye pRRithivyAM yuvAnaH |
yeShAM rAShTre nivasati darshanIyo; maheShvAsaH shIlavAndroNaputraH
shlokas.13:
vaishyAputraH kushalI tAta kachchi;nmahAprAj~no rAjaputro yuyutsuH |
karNo.amAtyaH kushalI tAta kachchi;tsuyodhano yasya mando vidheyaH
shlokas.14:
striyo vRRiddhA bhAratAnAM jananyo; mahAnasyo dAsabhAryAshcha sUta |
vadhvaH putrA bhAgineyA bhaginyo; dauhitrA vA kachchidapyavyalIkAH
shlokas.15:
kachchidrAjA brAhmaNAnAM yathAva;tpravartate pUrvavattAta vRRittim |
kachchiddAyAnmAmakAndhArtarAShTro; dvijAtInAM sa~njaya nopahanti
shlokas.16:
kachchidrAjA dhRRitarAShTraH saputra; upekShate brAhmaNAtikramAnvai |
kachchinna hetoriva vartmabhUta; upekShate teShu sa nyUnavRRittim
shlokas.17:
etajjyotiruttamaM jIvaloke; shuklaM prajAnAM vihitaM vidhAtrA |
te chellobhaM na niyachChanti mandAH; kRRitsno nAsho bhavitA kauravANAm
shlokas.18:
kachchidrAjA dhRRitarAShTraH saputro; bubhUShate vRRittimamAtyavarge |
kachchinna bhedena jijIviShanti; suhRRidrUpA durhRRidashchaikamitrAH
shlokas.19:
kachchinna pApaM kathayanti tAta; te pANDavAnAM kuravaH sarva eva |
kachchiddRRiShTvA dasyusa~NghAnsametA;nsmaranti pArthasya yudhAM praNetuH
shlokas.20:
maurvIbhujAgraprahitAnsma tAta; dodhUyamAnena dhanurdhareNa |
gANDIvamuktAnstanayitnughoShA;najihmagAnkachchidanusmaranti
shlokas.21:
na hyapashyaM ka~nchidahaM pRRithivyAM; shrutaM samaM vAdhikamarjunena |
yasyaikaShaShTirnishitAstIkShNadhArAH; suvAsasaH saMmato hastavApaH
shlokas.22:
gadApANirbhImasenastarasvI; pravepaya~nshatrusa~NghAnanIke |
nAgaH prabhinna iva naDvalAsu; cha~Nkramyate kachchidenaM smaranti
shlokas.23:
mAdrIputraH sahadevaH kali~NgA;nsamAgatAnajayaddantakUre |
vAmenAsyandakShiNenaiva yo vai; mahAbalaM kachchidenaM smaranti
shlokas.24:
udyannayaM nakulaH preShito vai; gAvalgaNe sa~njaya pashyataste |
dishaM pratIchIM vashamAnayanme; mAdrIsutaM kachchidenaM smaranti
shlokas.25:
abhyAbhavo dvaitavane ya AsI;ddurmantrite ghoShayAtrAgatAnAm |
yatra mandA~nshatruvashaM prayAtA;namochayadbhImaseno jayashcha
shlokas.26:
ahaM pashchAdarjunamabhyarakShaM; mAdrIputrau bhImasenashcha chakre |
gANDIvabhRRichChatrusa~NghAnudasya; svastyAgamatkachchidenaM smaranti
shlokas.27:
na karmaNA sAdhunaikena nUnaM; kartuM shakyaM bhavatIha sa~njaya |
sarvAtmanA parijetuM vayaM che;nna shaknumo dhRRitarAShTrasya putram

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yathArhase pANDava tattathaiva; kurUnkurushreShTha janaM cha pRRichChasi |
anAmayAstAta manasvinaste; kurushreShThAnpRRichChasi pArtha yA.nstvam
shlokas.2:
santyeva vRRiddhAH sAdhavo dhArtarAShTre; santyeva pApAH pANDava tasya viddhi |
dadyAdriposhchApi hi dhArtarAShTraH; kuto dAyA.NllopayedbrAhmaNAnAm
shlokas.3:
yadyuShmAkaM vartate.asau na dharmya;madrugdheShu drugdhavattanna sAdhu |
mitradhruksyAddhRRitarAShTraH saputro; yuShmAndviShansAdhuvRRittAnasAdhuH
shlokas.4:
na chAnujAnAti bhRRishaM cha tapyate; shochatyantaH sthaviro.ajAtashatro |
shRRiNoti hi brAhmaNAnAM sametya; mitradrohaH pAtakebhyo garIyAn
shlokas.5:
smaranti tubhyaM naradeva sa~Ngame; yuddhe cha jiShNoshcha yudhAM praNetuH |
samutkRRiShTe dundubhisha~Nkhashabde; gadApANiM bhImasenaM smaranti
shlokas.6:
mAdrIsutau chApi raNAjimadhye; sarvA dishaH sampatantau smaranti |
senAM varShantau sharavarShairajasraM; mahArathau samare duShprakampyau
shlokas.7:
na tveva manye puruShasya rAja;nnanAgataM j~nAyate yadbhaviShyam |
tvaM chedimaM sarvadharmopapannaH; prAptaH kleshaM pANDava kRRichChrarUpam
shlokas.8:
tvamevaitatsarvamatashcha bhUyaH; samIkuryAH praj~nayAjAtashatro |
na kAmArthaM santyajeyurhi dharmaM; pANDoH sutAH sarva evendrakalpAH
shlokas.9:
tvamevaitatpraj~nayAjAtashatro; shamaM kuryA yena sharmApnuyuste |
dhArtarAShTrAH pANDavAH sRRi~njayAshcha; ye chApyanye pArthivAH saMniviShTAH
shlokas.10:
yanmAbravIddhRRitarAShTro nishAyA;majAtashatro vachanaM pitA te |
