sahAmAtyaH sahaputrashcha rAja;nsametya tAM vAchamimAM nibodha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
samAgatAH pANDavAH sRRi~njayAshcha; janArdano yuyudhAno virATaH |
yatte vAkyaM dhRRitarAShTrAnushiShTaM; gAvalgaNe brUhi tatsUtaputra
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ajAtashatruM cha vRRikodaraM cha; dhana~njayaM mAdravatIsutau cha |
Amantraye vAsudevaM cha shauriM; yuyudhAnaM chekitAnaM virATam
shlokas.3:
pA~nchAlAnAmadhipaM chaiva vRRiddhaM; dhRRiShTadyumnaM pArShataM yAj~nasenim |
sarve vAchaM shRRiNutemAM madIyAM; vakShyAmi yAM bhUtimichChankurUNAm
shlokas.4:
shamaM rAjA dhRRitarAShTro.abhinanda;nnayojayattvaramANo rathaM me |
sabhrAtRRiputrasvajanasya rAj~na;stadrochatAM pANDavAnAM shamo.astu
shlokas.5:
sarvairdharmaiH samupetAH stha pArthAH; prasthAnena mArdavenArjavena |
jAtAH kule anRRisha.nsA vadAnyA; hrIniShedhAH karmaNAM nishchayaj~nAH
shlokas.6:
na yujyate karma yuShmAsu hInaM; sattvaM hi vastAdRRishaM bhImasenAH |
udbhAsate hya~njanabinduvatta;chChukle vastre yadbhavetkilbiShaM vaH
shlokas.7:
sarvakShayo dRRishyate yatra kRRitsnaH; pApodayo nirayo.abhAvasa.nsthaH |
kastatkuryAjjAtu karma prajAna;nparAjayo yatra samo jayashcha
shlokas.8:
te vai dhanyA yaiH kRRitaM j~nAtikAryaM; ye vaH putrAH suhRRido bAndhavAshcha |
upakruShTaM jIvitaM santyajeyu;stataH kurUNAM niyato vai bhavaH syAt
shlokas.9:
te chetkurUnanushAsya stha pArthA; ninIya sarvAndviShato nigRRihya |
samaM vastajjIvitaM mRRityunA syA;dyajjIvadhvaM j~nAtivadhe na sAdhu
shlokas.10:
ko hyeva yuShmAnsaha keshavena; sachekitAnAnpArShatabAhuguptAn |
sasAtyakInviShaheta prajetuM; labdhvApi devAnsachivAnsahendrAn
shlokas.11:
ko vA kurUndroNabhIShmAbhiguptA;nashvatthAmnA shalyakRRipAdibhishcha |
raNe prasoDhuM viShaheta rAja;nrAdheyaguptAnsaha bhUmipAlaiH
shlokas.12:
mahadbalaM dhArtarAShTrasya rAj~naH; ko vai shakto hantumakShIyamANaH |
so.ahaM jaye chaiva parAjaye cha; niHshreyasaM nAdhigachChAmi ki~nchit
shlokas.13:
kathaM hi nIchA iva dauShkuleyA; nirdharmArthaM karma kuryushcha pArthAH |
so.ahaM prasAdya praNato vAsudevaM; pA~nchAlAnAmadhipaM chaiva vRRiddham
shlokas.14:
kRRitA~njaliH sharaNaM vaH prapadye; kathaM svasti syAtkurusRRi~njayAnAm |
na hyeva te vachanaM vAsudevo; dhana~njayo vA jAtu ki~nchinna kuryAt
shlokas.15:
prANAnAdau yAchyamAnaH kuto.anya;detadvidvansAdhanArthaM bravImi |
etadrAj~no bhIShmapurogamasya; mataM yadvaH shAntirihottamA syAt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kAM nu vAchaM sa~njaya me shRRiNoShi; yuddhaiShiNIM yena yuddhAdbibheShi |
ayuddhaM vai tAta yuddhAdgarIyaH; kastallabdhvA jAtu yudhyeta sUta
shlokas.2:
akurvatashchetpuruShasya sa~njaya; sidhyetsa~Nkalpo manasA yaM yamichChet |
na karma kuryAdviditaM mamaita;danyatra yuddhAdbahu yallaghIyaH
shlokas.3:
kuto yuddhaM jAtu naraH prajAna;nko daivashapto.abhivRRiNIta yuddham |
sukhaiShiNaH karma kurvanti pArthA; dharmAdahInaM yachcha lokasya pathyam
shlokas.4:
karmodayaM sukhamAsha.nsamAnaH; kRRichChropAyaM tattvataH karma duHkham |
sukhaprepsurvijighA.nsushcha duHkhaM; ya indriyANAM prItivashAnugAmI
kAmAbhidhyA svasharIraM dunoti; yayA prayukto.anukaroti duHkham
shlokas.5:
yathedhyamAnasya samiddhatejaso; bhUyo balaM vardhate pAvakasya |
kAmArthalAbhena tathaiva bhUyo; na tRRipyate sarpiShevAgniriddhaH
sampashyemaM bhogachayaM mahAntaM; sahAsmAbhirdhRRitarAShTrasya rAj~naH
shlokas.6:
nAshreyasAmIshvaro vigrahANAM; nAshreyasAM gItashabdaM shRRiNoti |
nAshreyasaH sevate mAlyagandhA;nna chApyashreyA.nsyanulepanAni
shlokas.7:
nAshreyasaH prAvarAnadhyavaste; kathaM tvasmAnsampraNudetkurubhyaH |
atraiva cha syAdavadhUya eSha; kAmaH sharIre hRRidayaM dunoti
shlokas.8:
svayaM rAjA viShamasthaH pareShu; sAmasthyamanvichChati tanna sAdhu |
yathAtmanaH pashyati vRRittameva; tathA pareShAmapi so.abhyupaiti
shlokas.9:
AsannamagniM tu nidAghakAle; gambhIrakakShe gahane visRRijya |
yathA vRRiddhaM vAyuvashena shoche;tkShemaM mumukShuH shishiravyapAye
shlokas.10:
prAptaishvaryo dhRRitarAShTro.adya rAjA; lAlapyate sa~njaya kasya hetoH |
pragRRihya durbuddhimanArjave rataM; putraM mandaM mUDhamamantriNaM tu
shlokas.11:
anAptaH sannAptatamasya vAchaM; suyodhano vidurasyAvamanya |
sutasya rAjA dhRRitarAShTraH priyaiShI; sambudhyamAno vishate.adharmameva
shlokas.12:
medhAvinaM hyarthakAmaM kurUNAM; bahushrutaM vAgminaM shIlavantam |
sUta rAjA dhRRitarAShTraH kurubhyo; na so.asmaradviduraM putrakAmyAt
shlokas.13:
mAnaghnasya AtmakAmasya cherShyoH; sa.nrambhiNashchArthadharmAtigasya |
durbhAShiNo manyuvashAnugasya; kAmAtmano durhRRido bhAvanasya
shlokas.14:
aneyasyAshreyaso dIrghamanyo;rmitradruhaH sa~njaya pApabuddheH |
sutasya rAjA dhRRitarAShTraH priyaiShI; prapashyamAnaH prajahAddharmakAmau
shlokas.15:
tadaiva me sa~njaya dIvyato.abhU;nno chetkurUnAgataH syAdabhAvaH |
kAvyAM vAchaM viduro bhAShamANo; na vindate dhRRitarAShTrAtprasha.nsAm
shlokas.16:
kShatturyadA anvavartanta buddhiM; kRRichChraM kurUnna tadAbhyAjagAma |
yAvatpraj~nAmanvavartanta tasya; tAvatteShAM rAShTravRRiddhirbabhUva
shlokas.17:
tadarthalubdhasya nibodha me.adya; ye mantriNo dhArtarAShTrasya sUta |
duHshAsanaH shakuniH sUtaputro; gAvalgaNe pashya saMmohamasya
shlokas.18:
so.ahaM na pashyAmi parIkShamANaH; kathaM svasti syAtkurusRRi~njayAnAm |
Attaishvaryo dhRRitarAShTraH parebhyaH; pravrAjite vidure dIrghadRRiShTau
shlokas.19:
Asha.nsate vai dhRRitarAShTraH saputro; mahArAjyamasapatnaM pRRithivyAm |
tasmi~nshamaH kevalaM nopalabhyo; atyAsannaM madgataM manyate.artham
shlokas.20:
yattatkarNo manyate pAraNIyaM; yuddhe gRRihItAyudhamarjunena |
Asa.nshcha yuddhAni purA mahAnti; kathaM karNo nAbhavaddvIpa eShAm
shlokas.21:
karNashcha jAnAti suyodhanashcha; droNashcha jAnAti pitAmahashcha |
anye cha ye kuravastatra santi; yathArjunAnnAstyaparo dhanurdharaH
shlokas.22:
jAnantyete kuravaH sarva eva; ye chApyanye bhUmipAlAH sametAH |
duryodhanaM chAparAdhe charanta;mari.ndame phalgune.avidyamAne
shlokas.23:
tenArthabaddhaM manyate dhArtarAShTraH; shakyaM hartuM pANDavAnAM mamatvam |
kirITinA tAlamAtrAyudhena; tadvedinA sa.nyugaM tatra gatvA
shlokas.24:
gANDIvavisphAritashabdamAjA;vashRRiNvAnA dhArtarAShTrA dhriyante |
kruddhasya chedbhImasenasya vegA;tsuyodhano manyate siddhamartham
shlokas.25:
indro.apyetannotsahettAta hartu;maishvaryaM no jIvati bhImasene |
dhana~njaye nakule chaiva sUta; tathA vIre sahadeve madIye
shlokas.26:
sa chedetAM pratipadyeta buddhiM; vRRiddho rAjA saha putreNa sUta |
evaM raNe pANDavakopadagdhA; na nashyeyuH sa~njaya dhArtarAShTrAH
shlokas.27:
jAnAsi tvaM kleshamasmAsu vRRittaM; tvAM pUjayansa~njayAhaM kShameyam |
yachchAsmAkaM kauravairbhUtapUrvaM; yA no vRRittirdhArtarAShTre tadAsIt
shlokas.28:
adyApi tattatra tathaiva vartatAM; shAntiM gamiShyAmi yathA tvamAttha |
indraprasthe bhavatu mamaiva rAjyaM; suyodhano yachChatu bhAratAgryaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dharme nityA pANDava te vicheShTA; loke shrutA dRRishyate chApi pArtha |
mahAsrAvaM jIvitaM chApyanityaM; sampashya tvaM pANDava mA vinInashaH
shlokas.2:
na chedbhAgaM kuravo.anyatra yuddhA;tprayachChante tubhyamajAtashatro |
bhaikShacharyAmandhakavRRiShNirAjye; shreyo manye na tu yuddhena rAjyam
shlokas.3:
alpakAlaM jIvitaM yanmanuShye; mahAsrAvaM nityaduHkhaM chalaM cha |
bhUyashcha tadvayaso nAnurUpaM; tasmAtpApaM pANDava mA prasArShIH
shlokas.4:
kAmA manuShyaM prasajanta eva; dharmasya ye vighnamUlaM narendra |
pUrvaM narastAndhRRitimAnvinighna.N;lloke prasha.nsAM labhate.anavadyAm
shlokas.5:
nibandhanI hyarthatRRiShNeha pArtha; tAmeShato bAdhyate dharma eva |
dharmaM tu yaH pravRRiNIte sa buddhaH; kAme gRRiddho hIyate.arthAnurodhAt
shlokas.6:
dharmaM kRRitvA karmaNAM tAta mukhyaM; mahApratApaH saviteva bhAti |
hAnena dharmasya mahImapImAM; labdhvA naraH sIdati pApabuddhiH
shlokas.7:
vedo.adhItashcharitaM brahmacharyaM; yaj~nairiShTaM brAhmaNebhyashcha dattam |
paraM sthAnaM manyamAnena bhUya; AtmA datto varShapUgaM sukhebhyaH
shlokas.8:
sukhapriye sevamAno.ativelaM; yogAbhyAse yo na karoti karma |
vittakShaye hInasukho.ativelaM; duHkhaM shete kAmavegapraNunnaH
shlokas.9:
evaM punararthacharyAprasakto; hitvA dharmaM yaH prakarotyadharmam |
ashraddadhatparalokAya mUDho; hitvA dehaM tapyate pretya mandaH
shlokas.10:
na karmaNAM vipraNAsho.astyamutra; puNyAnAM vApyatha vA pApakAnAm |
pUrvaM karturgachChati puNyapApaM; pashchAttvetadanuyAtyeva kartA
shlokas.11:
nyAyopetaM brAhmaNebhyo yadannaM; shraddhApUtaM gandharasopapannam |
anvAhAryeShUttamadakShiNeShu; tathArUpaM karma vikhyAyate te
shlokas.12:
iha kShetre kriyate pArtha kAryaM; na vai ki~nchidvidyate pretya kAryam |
kRRitaM tvayA pAralokyaM cha kAryaM; puNyaM mahatsadbhiranuprashastam
shlokas.13:
jahAti mRRityuM cha jarAM bhayaM cha; na kShutpipAse manasashchApriyANi |
na kartavyaM vidyate tatra kiM chi;danyatra vai indriyaprINanArthAt
shlokas.14:
eva.nrUpaM karmaphalaM narendra; mAtrAvatA hRRidayasya priyeNa |
sa krodhajaM pANDava harShajaM cha; lokAvubhau mA prahAsIshchirAya
shlokas.15:
antaM gatvA karmaNAM yA prasha.nsA; satyaM damashchArjavamAnRRisha.nsyam |
ashvamedho rAjasUyastatheShTaH; pApasyAntaM karmaNo mA punargAH
shlokas.16:
tachchedevaM desharUpeNa pArthAH; kariShyadhvaM karma pApaM chirAya |
nivasadhvaM varShapUgAnvaneShu; duHkhaM vAsaM pANDavA dharmahetoH
shlokas.17:
apravrajye yojayitvA purastA;dAtmAdhInaM yadbalaM te tadAsIt |
nityaM pA~nchAlAH sachivAstaveme; janArdano yuyudhAnashcha vIraH
shlokas.18:
matsyo rAjA rukmarathaH saputraH; prahAribhiH saha putrairvirATaH |
rAjAnashcha ye vijitAH purastA;ttvAmeva te sa.nshrayeyuH samastAH
shlokas.19:
mahAsahAyaH pratapanbalasthaH; puraskRRito vAsudevArjunAbhyAm |
varAnhaniShyandviShato ra~Ngamadhye; vyaneShyathA dhArtarAShTrasya darpam
shlokas.20:
balaM kasmAdvardhayitvA parasya; nijAnkasmAtkarshayitvA sahAyAn |
niruShya kasmAdvarShapUgAnvaneShu; yuyutsase pANDava hInakAlam
shlokas.21:
apraj~no vA pANDava yudhyamAno; adharmaj~no vA bhUtipathAdvyapaiti |
praj~nAvAnvA budhyamAno.api dharmaM; sa.nrambhAdvA so.api bhUterapaiti
shlokas.22:
nAdharme te dhIyate pArtha buddhi;rna sa.nrambhAtkarma chakartha pApam |
addhA kiM tatkAraNaM yasya hetoH; praj~nAviruddhaM karma chikIrShasIdam
shlokas.23:
avyAdhijaM kaTukaM shIrSharogaM; yashomuShaM pApaphalodayaM cha |
satAM peyaM yanna pibantyasanto; manyuM mahArAja piba prashAmya
shlokas.24:
pApAnubandhaM ko nu taM kAmayeta; kShamaiva te jyAyasI nota bhogAH |
yatra bhIShmaH shAntanavo hataH syA;dyatra droNaH sahaputro hataH syAt
shlokas.25:
kRRipaH shalyaH saumadattirvikarNo; vivi.nshatiH karNaduryodhanau cha |
etAnhatvA kIdRRishaM tatsukhaM syA;dyadvindethAstadanubrUhi pArtha
shlokas.26:
labdhvApImAM pRRithivIM sAgarAntAM; jarAmRRityU naiva hi tvaM prajahyAH |
priyApriye sukhaduHkhe cha rAja;nnevaM vidvAnnaiva yuddhaM kuruShva
shlokas.27:
amAtyAnAM yadi kAmasya heto;reva.nyuktaM karma chikIrShasi tvam |
apAkrameH sampradAya svamebhyo; mA gAstvaM vai devayAnAtpatho.adya

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM sa~njaya satyameta;ddharmo varaH karmaNAM yattvamAttha |
j~nAtvA tu mAM sa~njaya garhayestvaM; yadi dharmaM yadyadharmaM charAmi
shlokas.2:
yatrAdharmo dharmarUpANi bibhra;ddharmaH kRRitsno dRRishyate.adharmarUpaH |
tathA dharmo dhArayandharmarUpaM; vidvA.nsastaM samprapashyanti buddhyA
shlokas.3:
evametAvApadi li~Ngameta;ddharmAdharmau vRRittinityau bhajetAm |
AdyaM li~NgaM yasya tasya pramANa;mApaddharmaM sa~njaya taM nibodha
shlokas.4:
luptAyAM tu prakRRitau yena karma; niShpAdayettatparIpsedvihInaH |
prakRRitisthashchApadi vartamAna; ubhau garhyau bhavataH sa~njayaitau
shlokas.5:
avilopamichChatAM brAhmaNAnAM; prAyashchittaM vihitaM yadvidhAtrA |
ApadyathAkarmasu vartamAnA;nvikarmasthAnsa~njaya garhayeta
shlokas.6:
manIShiNAM tattvavichChedanAya; vidhIyate satsu vRRittiH sadaiva |
abrAhmaNAH santi tu ye na vaidyAH; sarvochChedaM sAdhu manyeta tebhyaH
shlokas.7:
tadarthA naH pitaro ye cha pUrve; pitAmahA ye cha tebhyaH pare.anye |
praj~naiShiNo ye cha hi karma chakru;rnAstyantato nAsti nAstIti manye
shlokas.8:
yatki~nchidetadvittamasyAM pRRithivyAM; yaddevAnAM tridashAnAM paratra |
prAjApatyaM tridivaM brahmalokaM; nAdharmataH sa~njaya kAmaye tat
shlokas.9:
dharmeshvaraH kushalo nItimA.nshchA;pyupAsitA brAhmaNAnAM manIShI |
nAnAvidhA.nshchaiva mahAbalA.nshcha; rAjanyabhojAnanushAsti kRRiShNaH
shlokas.10:
yadi hyahaM visRRijansyAmagarhyo; yudhyamAno yadi jahyAM svadharmam |
mahAyashAH keshavastadbravItu; vAsudevastUbhayorarthakAmaH
shlokas.11:
shaineyA hi chaitrakAshchAndhakAshcha; vArShNeyabhojAH kaukurAH sRRi~njayAshcha |
upAsInA vAsudevasya buddhiM; nigRRihya shatrUnsuhRRido nandayanti
shlokas.12:
vRRiShNyandhakA hyugrasenAdayo vai; kRRiShNapraNItAH sarva evendrakalpAH |
manasvinaH satyaparAkramAshcha; mahAbalA yAdavA bhogavantaH
shlokas.13:
kAshyo babhruH shriyamuttamAM gato; labdhvA kRRiShNaM bhrAtaramIshitAram |
yasmai kAmAnvarShati vAsudevo; grIShmAtyaye megha iva prajAbhyaH
shlokas.14:
IdRRisho.ayaM keshavastAta bhUyo; vidmo hyenaM karmaNAM nishchayaj~nam |
priyashcha naH sAdhutamashcha kRRiShNo; nAtikrame vachanaM keshavasya

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
avinAshaM sa~njaya pANDavAnA;michChAmyahaM bhUtimeShAM priyaM cha |
tathA rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya sUta; sadAsha.nse bahuputrasya vRRiddhim
shlokas.2:
kAmo hi me sa~njaya nityameva; nAnyadbrUyAM tAnprati shAmyateti |
rAj~nashcha hi priyametachChRRiNomi; manye chaitatpANDavAnAM samartham
shlokas.3:
suduShkarashchAtra shamo hi nUnaM; pradarshitaH sa~njaya pANDavena |
yasmingRRiddho dhRRitarAShTraH saputraH; kasmAdeShAM kalaho nAtra mUrchChet
shlokas.4:
tattvaM dharmaM vicharansa~njayeha; mattashcha jAnAsi yudhiShThirAchcha |
atho kasmAtsa~njaya pANDavasya; utsAhinaH pUrayataH svakarma
yathAkhyAtamAvasataH kuTumbaM; purAkalpAtsAdhu vilopamAttha
shlokas.5:
asminvidhau vartamAne yathAva;duchchAvachA matayo brAhmaNAnAm |
karmaNAhuH siddhimeke paratra; hitvA karma vidyayA siddhimeke
nAbhu~njAno bhakShyabhojyasya tRRipye;dvidvAnapIha viditaM brAhmaNAnAm
shlokas.6:
yA vai vidyAH sAdhayantIha karma; tAsAM phalaM vidyate netarAsAm |
tatreha vai dRRiShTaphalaM tu karma; pItvodakaM shAmyati tRRiShNayArtaH
shlokas.7:
so.ayaM vidhirvihitaH karmaNaiva; tadvartate sa~njaya tatra karma |
tatra yo.anyatkarmaNaH sAdhu manye;nmoghaM tasya lapitaM durbalasya
shlokas.8:
karmaNAmI bhAnti devAH paratra; karmaNaiveha plavate mAtarishvA |
ahorAtre vidadhatkarmaNaiva; atandrito nityamudeti sUryaH
shlokas.9:
mAsArdhamAsAnatha nakShatrayogA;natandritashchandramA abhyupaiti |
atandrito dahate jAtavedAH; samidhyamAnaH karma kurvanprajAbhyaH
shlokas.10:
atandritA bhAramimaM mahAntaM; bibharti devI pRRithivI balena |
atandritAH shIghramapo vahanti; santarpayantyaH sarvabhUtAni nadyaH
shlokas.11:
atandrito varShati bhUritejAH; saMnAdayannantarikShaM divaM cha |
atandrito brahmacharyaM chachAra; shreShThatvamichChanbalabhiddevatAnAm
shlokas.12:
hitvA sukhaM manasashcha priyANi; tena shakraH karmaNA shraiShThyamApa |
satyaM dharmaM pAlayannapramatto; damaM titikShAM samatAM priyaM cha
etAni sarvANyupasevamAno; devarAjyaM maghavAnprApa mukhyam
shlokas.13:
bRRihaspatirbrahmacharyaM chachAra; samAhitaH sa.nshitAtmA yathAvat |
hitvA sukhaM pratirudhyendriyANi; tena devAnAmagamadgauravaM saH
shlokas.14:
nakShatrANi karmaNAmutra bhAnti; rudrAdityA vasavo.athApi vishve |
yamo rAjA vaishravaNaH kubero; gandharvayakShApsarasashcha shubhrAH
brahmacharyaM vedavidyAH kriyAshcha; niShevamANA munayo.amutra bhAnti
shlokas.15:
jAnannimaM sarvalokasya dharmaM; brAhmaNAnAM kShatriyANAM vishAM cha |
sa kasmAttvaM jAnatAM j~nAnavAnsa;nvyAyachChase sa~njaya kauravArthe
shlokas.16:
AmnAyeShu nityasa.nyogamasya; tathAshvamedhe rAjasUye cha viddhi |
sa.nyujyate dhanuShA varmaNA cha; hastatrANai rathashastraishcha bhUyaH
shlokas.17:
te chedime kauravANAmupAya;madhigachCheyuravadhenaiva pArthAH |
dharmatrANaM puNyameShAM kRRitaM syA;dArye vRRitte bhImasenaM nigRRihya
shlokas.18:
te chetpitrye karmaNi vartamAnA; ApadyerandiShTavashena mRRityum |
yathAshaktyA pUrayantaH svakarma; tadapyeShAM nidhanaM syAtprashastam
shlokas.19:
utAho tvaM manyase sarvameva; rAj~nAM yuddhe vartate dharmatantram |
ayuddhe vA vartate dharmatantraM; tathaiva te vAchamimAM shRRiNomi
shlokas.20:
chAturvarNyasya prathamaM vibhAga;mavekShya tvaM sa~njaya svaM cha karma |
nishamyAtho pANDavAnAM svakarma; prasha.nsa vA ninda vA yA matiste
shlokas.21:
adhIyIta brAhmaNo.atho yajeta; dadyAdiyAttIrthamukhyAni chaiva |
adhyApayedyAjayechchApi yAjyA;npratigrahAnvA viditAnpratIchChet
shlokas.22:
tathA rAjanyo rakShaNaM vai prajAnAM; kRRitvA dharmeNApramatto.atha dattvA |
yaj~nairiShTvA sarvavedAnadhItya; dArAnkRRitvA puNyakRRidAvasedgRRihAn
shlokas.23:
vaishyo.adhItya kRRiShigorakShapaNyai;rvittaM chinvanpAlayannapramattaH |
priyaM kurvanbrAhmaNakShatriyANAM; dharmashIlaH puNyakRRidAvasedgRRihAn
shlokas.24:
paricharyA vandanaM brAhmaNAnAM; nAdhIyIta pratiShiddho.asya yaj~naH |
nityotthito bhUtaye.atandritaH syA;deSha smRRitaH shUdradharmaH purANaH
shlokas.25:
etAnrAjA pAlayannapramatto; niyojayansarvavarNAnsvadharme |
akAmAtmA samavRRittiH prajAsu; nAdhArmikAnanurudhyeta kAmAn
shlokas.26:
shreyA.nstasmAdyadi vidyeta kashchi;dabhij~nAtaH sarvadharmopapannaH |
sa taM duShTamanushiShyAtprajAna;nna chedgRRidhyediti tasminna sAdhu
shlokas.27:
yadA gRRidhyetparabhUmiM nRRisha.nso; vidhiprakopAdbalamAdadAnaH |
tato rAj~nAM bhavitA yuddhameta;ttatra jAtaM varma shastraM dhanushcha
indreNedaM dasyuvadhAya karma; utpAditaM varma shastraM dhanushcha
shlokas.28:
steno haredyatra dhanaM hyadRRiShTaH; prasahya vA yatra hareta dRRiShTaH |
ubhau garhyau bhavataH sa~njayaitau; kiM vai pRRithaktvaM dhRRitarAShTrasya putre
yo.ayaM lobhAnmanyate dharmametaM; yamichChate manyuvashAnugAmI
shlokas.29:
bhAgaH punaH pANDavAnAM niviShTa;staM no.akasmAdAdadIranpare vai |
asminpade yudhyatAM no vadho.api; shlAghyaH pitryaH pararAjyAdvishiShTaH
etAndharmAnkauravANAM purANA;nAchakShIthAH sa~njaya rAjyamadhye
shlokas.30:
ye te mandA mRRityuvashAbhipannAH; samAnItA dhArtarAShTreNa mUDhAH |
idaM punaH karma pApIya eva; sabhAmadhye pashya vRRittaM kurUNAm
shlokas.31:
priyAM bhAryAM draupadIM pANDavAnAM; yashasvinIM shIlavRRittopapannAm |
yadupekShanta kuravo bhIShmamukhyAH; kAmAnugenoparuddhAM rudantIm
shlokas.32:
taM chettadA te sakumAravRRiddhA; avArayiShyankuravaH sametAH |
mama priyaM dhRRitarAShTro.akariShya;tputrANAM cha kRRitamasyAbhaviShyat
shlokas.33:
duHshAsanaH prAtilomyAnninAya; sabhAmadhye shvashurANAM cha kRRiShNAm |
sA tatra nItA karuNAnyavocha;nnAnyaM kShatturnAthamadRRiShTa ka~nchit
shlokas.34:
kArpaNyAdeva sahitAstatra rAj~no; nAshaknuvanprativaktuM sabhAyAm |
ekaH kShattA dharmyamarthaM bruvANo; dharmaM buddhvA pratyuvAchAlpabuddhim
shlokas.35:
anuktvA tvaM dharmamevaM sabhAyA;mathechChase pANDavasyopadeShTum |
kRRiShNA tvetatkarma chakAra shuddhaM; suduShkaraM taddhi sabhAM sametya
yena kRRichChrAtpANDavAnujjahAra; tathAtmAnaM nauriva sAgaraughAt
shlokas.36:
yatrAbravItsUtaputraH sabhAyAM; kRRiShNAM sthitAM shvashurANAM samIpe |
na te gatirvidyate yAj~naseni; prapadyedAnIM dhArtarAShTrasya veshma
parAjitAste patayo na santi; patiM chAnyaM bhAmini tvaM vRRiNIShva
shlokas.37:
yo bIbhatsorhRRidaye prauDha AsI;dasthiprachChinmarmaghAtI sughoraH |
karNAchCharo vA~NmayastigmatejAH; pratiShThito hRRidaye phalgunasya
shlokas.38:
kRRiShNAjinAni paridhitsamAnA;nduHshAsanaH kaTukAnyabhyabhAShat |
ete sarve ShaNDhatilA vinaShTAH; kShayaM gatA narakaM dIrghakAlam
shlokas.39:
gAndhArarAjaH shakunirnikRRityA; yadabravIddyUtakAle sa pArthAn |
parAjito nakulaH kiM tavAsti; kRRiShNayA tvaM dIvya vai yAj~nasenyA
shlokas.40:
jAnAsi tvaM sa~njaya sarvameta;ddyUte.avAchyaM vAkyamevaM yathoktam |
svayaM tvahaM prArthaye tatra gantuM; samAdhAtuM kAryametadvipannam
shlokas.41:
ahApayitvA yadi pANDavArthaM; shamaM kurUNAmatha chechchareyam |
puNyaM cha me syAchcharitaM mahodayaM; muchyera.nshcha kuravo mRRityupAshAt
shlokas.42:
api vAchaM bhAShamANasya kAvyAM; dharmArAmAmarthavatImahi.nsrAm |
avekSherandhArtarAShTrAH samakShaM; mAM cha prAptaM kuravaH pUjayeyuH
shlokas.43:
ato.anyathA rathinA phalgunena; bhImena chaivAhavada.nshitena |
parAsiktAndhArtarAShTrA.nstu viddhi; pradahyamAnAnkarmaNA svena mandAn
shlokas.44:
parAjitAnpANDaveyA.nstu vAcho; raudrarUpA bhAShate dhArtarAShTraH |
gadAhasto bhImaseno.apramatto; duryodhanaM smArayitvA hi kAle
shlokas.45:
suyodhano manyumayo mahAdrumaH; skandhaH karNaH shakunistasya shAkhAH |
duHshAsanaH puShpaphale samRRiddhe; mUlaM rAjA dhRRitarAShTro.amanIShI
shlokas.46:
yudhiShThiro dharmamayo mahAdrumaH; skandho.arjuno bhImaseno.asya shAkhAH |
mAdrIputrau puShpaphale samRRiddhe; mUlaM tvahaM brahma cha brAhmaNAshcha
shlokas.47:
vanaM rAjA dhRRitarAShTraH saputro; vyAghrA vane sa~njaya pANDaveyAH |
mA vanaM Chindhi savyAghraM mA vyAghrAnnInasho vanAt
shlokas.48:
nirvano vadhyate vyAghro nirvyAghraM Chidyate vanam |
tasmAdvyAghro vanaM rakShedvanaM vyAghraM cha pAlayet
shlokas.49:
latAdharmA dhArtarAShTrAH shAlAH sa~njaya pANDavAH |
na latA vardhate jAtu anAshritya mahAdrumam
shlokas.50:
sthitAH shushrUShituM pArthAH sthitA yoddhumari.ndamAH |
yatkRRityaM dhRRitarAShTrasya tatkarotu narAdhipaH
shlokas.51:
sthitAH shame mahAtmAnaH pANDavA dharmachAriNaH |
yodhAH samRRiddhAstadvidvannAchakShIthA yathAtatham

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
Amantraye tvA naradevadeva; gachChAmyahaM pANDava svasti te.astu |
kachchinna vAchA vRRijinaM hi kiM chi;duchchAritaM me manaso.abhiSha~NgAt
shlokas.2:
janArdanaM bhImasenArjunau cha; mAdrIsutau sAtyakiM chekitAnam |
Amantrya gachChAmi shivaM sukhaM vaH; saumyena mAM pashyata chakShuShA nRRipAH
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
anuj~nAtaH sa~njaya svasti gachCha; na no.akArShIrapriyaM jAtu ki~nchit |
vidmashcha tvA te cha vayaM cha sarve; shuddhAtmAnaM madhyagataM sabhAstham
shlokas.4:
Apto dUtaH sa~njaya supriyo.asi; kalyANavAkShIlavAndRRiShTimA.nshcha |
na muhyestvaM sa~njaya jAtu matyA; na cha krudhyeruchyamAno.api tathyam
shlokas.5:
na marmagAM jAtu vaktAsi rUkShAM; nopastutiM kaTukAM nota shuktAm |
dharmArAmAmarthavatImahi.nsrA;metAM vAchaM tava jAnAmi sUta
shlokas.6:
tvameva naH priyatamo.asi dUta; ihAgachChedviduro vA dvitIyaH |
abhIkShNadRRiShTo.asi purA hi nastvaM; dhana~njayasyAtmasamaH sakhAsi
shlokas.7:
ito gatvA sa~njaya kShiprameva; upAtiShThethA brAhmaNAnye tadarhAH |
vishuddhavIryA.nshcharaNopapannA;nkule jAtAnsarvadharmopapannAn
shlokas.8:
svAdhyAyino brAhmaNA bhikShavashcha; tapasvino ye cha nityA vaneShu |
abhivAdyA vai madvachanena vRRiddhA;stathetareShAM kushalaM vadethAH
shlokas.9:
purohitaM dhRRitarAShTrasya rAj~na; AchAryAshcha RRitvijo ye cha tasya |
taishcha tvaM tAta sahitairyathArhaM; sa~NgachChethAH kushalenaiva sUta
shlokas.10:
AchArya iShTo.anapago vidheyo; vedAnIpsanbrahmacharyaM chachAra |
yo.astraM chatuShpAtpunareva chakre; droNaH prasanno.abhivAdyo yathArham
shlokas.11:
adhItavidyashcharaNopapanno; yo.astraM chatuShpAtpunareva chakre |
gandharvaputrapratimaM tarasvinaM; tamashvatthAmAnaM kushalaM sma pRRichCheH
shlokas.12:
shAradvatasyAvasathaM sma gatvA; mahArathasyAstravidAM varasya |
tvaM mAmabhIkShNaM parikIrtayanvai; kRRipasya pAdau sa~njaya pANinA spRRisheH
shlokas.13:
yasmi~nshauryamAnRRisha.nsyaM tapashcha; praj~nA shIlaM shrutisattve dhRRitishcha |
pAdau gRRihItvA kurusattamasya; bhIShmasya mAM tatra nivedayethAH
shlokas.14:
praj~nAchakShuryaH praNetA kurUNAM; bahushruto vRRiddhasevI manIShI |
tasmai rAj~ne sthavirAyAbhivAdya; AchakShIthAH sa~njaya mAmarogam
shlokas.15:
jyeShThaH putro dhRRitarAShTrasya mando; mUrkhaH shaThaH sa~njaya pApashIlaH |
prashAstA vai pRRithivI yena sarvA; suyodhanaM kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.16:
bhrAtA kanIyAnapi tasya manda;stathAshIlaH sa~njaya so.api shashvat |
maheShvAsaH shUratamaH kurUNAM; duHshAsanaM kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.17:
vRRindArakaM kavimartheShvamUDhaM; mahApraj~naM sarvadharmopapannam |
na tasya yuddhaM rochate vai kadA chi;dvaishyAputraM kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.18:
nikartane devane yo.advitIya;shChannopadhaH sAdhudevI matAkShaH |
yo durjayo devitavyena sa~Nkhye; sa chitrasenaH kushalaM tAta vAchyaH
shlokas.19:
yasya kAmo vartate nityameva; nAnyaH shamAdbhAratAnAmiti sma |
sa bAhlikAnAmRRiShabho manasvI; purA yathA mAbhivadetprasannaH
shlokas.20:
guNairanekaiH pravaraishcha yukto; vij~nAnavAnnaiva cha niShThuro yaH |
snehAdamarShaM sahate sadaiva; sa somadattaH pUjanIyo mato me
shlokas.21:
arhattamaH kuruShu saumadattiH; sa no bhrAtA sa~njaya matsakhA cha |
maheShvAso rathinAmuttamo yaH; sahAmAtyaH kushalaM tasya pRRichCheH
shlokas.22:
ye chaivAnye kurumukhyA yuvAnaH; putrAH pautrA bhrAtarashchaiva ye naH |
yaM yameShAM yena yenAbhigachChe;ranAmayaM madvachanena vAchyaH
shlokas.23:
ye rAjAnaH pANDavAyodhanAya; samAnItA dhArtarAShTreNa kechit |
vasAtayaH shAlvakAH kekayAshcha; tathAmbaShThA ye trigartAshcha mukhyAH
shlokas.24:
prAchyodIchyA dAkShiNAtyAshcha shUrA;stathA pratIchyAH pArvatIyAshcha sarve |
anRRisha.nsAH shIlavRRittopapannA;steShAM sarveShAM kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.25:
hastyArohA rathinaH sAdinashcha; padAtayashchAryasa~NghA mahAntaH |
AkhyAya mAM kushalinaM sma teShA;manAmayaM paripRRichCheH samagrAn
shlokas.26:
tathA rAj~no hyarthayuktAnamAtyA;ndauvArikAnye cha senAM nayanti |
AyavyayaM ye gaNayanti yuktA; arthA.nshcha ye mahatashchintayanti
shlokas.27:
gAndhArarAjaH shakuniH pArvatIyo; nikartane yo.advitIyo.akShadevI |
mAnaM kurvandhArtarAShTrasya sUta; mithyAbuddheH kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.28:
yaH pANDavAnekarathena vIraH; samutsahatyapradhRRiShyAnvijetum |
yo muhyatAM mohayitAdvitIyo; vaikartanaM kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.29:
sa eva bhaktaH sa guruH sa bhRRityaH; sa vai pitA sa cha mAtA suhRRichcha |
agAdhabuddhirviduro dIrghadarshI; sa no mantrI kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.30:
vRRiddhAH striyo yAshcha guNopapannA; yA j~nAyante sa~njaya mAtarastAH |
tAbhiH sarvAbhiH sahitAbhiH sametya; strIbhirvRRiddhAbhirabhivAdaM vadethAH
shlokas.31:
kachchitputrA jIvaputrAH susamya;gvartante vo vRRittimanRRisha.nsarUpAm |
iti smoktvA sa~njaya brUhi pashchA;dajAtashatruH kushalI saputraH
shlokas.32:
yA no bhAryAH sa~njaya vettha tatra; tAsAM sarvAsAM kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH |
susa~NguptAH surabhayo.anavadyAH; kachchidgRRihAnAvasathApramattAH
shlokas.33:
kachchidvRRittiM shvashureShu bhadrAH; kalyANIM vartadhvamanRRisha.nsarUpAm |
yathA cha vaH syuH patayo.anukUlA;stathA vRRittimAtmanaH sthApayadhvam
shlokas.34:
yA naH snuShAH sa~njaya vettha tatra; prAptAH kulebhyashcha guNopapannAH |
prajAvatyo brUhi sametya tAshcha; yudhiShThiro vo.abhyavadatprasannaH
shlokas.35:
kanyAH svajethAH sadaneShu sa~njaya; anAmayaM madvachanena pRRiShTvA |
kalyANA vaH santu patayo.anukUlA; yUyaM patInAM bhavatAnukUlAH
shlokas.36:
ala~NkRRitA vastravatyaH sugandhA; abIbhatsAH sukhitA bhogavatyaH |
laghu yAsAM darshanaM vAkcha laghvI; veshastriyaH kushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.37:
dAsIputrA ye cha dAsAH kurUNAM; tadAshrayA bahavaH kubjakha~njAH |
AkhyAya mAM kushalinaM sma tebhyo; anAmayaM paripRRichCherjaghanyam
shlokas.38:
kachchidvRRittirvartate vai purANI; kachchidbhogAndhArtarAShTro dadAti |
a~NgahInAnkRRipaNAnvAmanA.nshcha; AnRRisha.nsyAddhRRitarAShTro bibharti
shlokas.39:
andhAshcha sarve sthavirAstathaiva; hastAjIvA bahavo ye.atra santi |
AkhyAya mAM kushalinaM sma teShA;manAmayaM paripRRichCherjaghanyam
shlokas.40:
mA bhaiShTa duHkhena kujIvitena; nUnaM kRRitaM paralokeShu pApam |
nigRRihya shatrUnsuhRRido.anugRRihya; vAsobhirannena cha vo bhariShye
shlokas.41:
santyeva me brAhmaNebhyaH kRRitAni; bhAvInyatho no bata vartayanti |
pashyAmyahaM yuktarUpA.nstathaiva; tAmeva siddhiM shrAvayethA nRRipaM tam
shlokas.42:
ye chAnAthA durbalAH sarvakAla;mAtmanyeva prayatante.atha mUDhAH |
tA.nshchApi tvaM kRRipaNAnsarvathaiva; asmadvAkyAtkushalaM tAta pRRichCheH
shlokas.43:
ye chApyanye sa.nshritA dhArtarAShTrA;nnAnAdigbhyo.abhyAgatAH sUtaputra |
dRRiShTvA tA.nshchaivArhatashchApi sarvA;nsampRRichChethAH kushalaM chAvyayaM cha
shlokas.44:
evaM sarvAnAgatAbhyAgatA.nshcha; rAj~no dUtAnsarvadigbhyo.abhyupetAn |
pRRiShTvA sarvAnkushalaM tA.nshcha sUta; pashchAdahaM kushalI teShu vAchyaH
shlokas.45:
na hIdRRishAH santyapare pRRithivyAM; ye yodhakA dhArtarAShTreNa labdhAH |
dharmastu nityo mama dharma eva; mahAbalaH shatrunibarhaNAya
shlokas.46:
idaM punarvachanaM dhArtarAShTraM; suyodhanaM sa~njaya shrAvayethAH |
yaste sharIre hRRidayaM dunoti; kAmaH kurUnasapatno.anushiShyAm
shlokas.47:
na vidyate yuktiretasya kA chi;nnaiva.nvidhAH syAma yathA priyaM te |
dadasva vA shakrapuraM mamaiva; yudhyasva vA bhAratamukhya vIra

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
uta santamasantaM cha bAlaM vRRiddhaM cha sa~njaya |
utAbalaM balIyA.nsaM dhAtA prakurute vashe
shlokas.2:
uta bAlAya pANDityaM paNDitAyota bAlatAm |
dadAti sarvamIshAnaH purastAchChukramuchcharan
shlokas.3:
alaM vij~nApanAya syAdAchakShIthA yathAtatham |
atho mantraM mantrayitvA anyonyenAtihRRiShTavat
shlokas.4:
gAvalgaNe kurUngatvA dhRRitarAShTraM mahAbalam |
abhivAdyopasa~NgRRihya tataH pRRichCheranAmayam
shlokas.5:
brUyAshchainaM tvamAsInaM kurubhiH parivAritam |
tavaiva rAjanvIryeNa sukhaM jIvanti pANDavAH
shlokas.6:
tava prasAdAdbAlAste prAptA rAjyamari.ndama |
rAjye tAnsthApayitvAgre nopekShIrvinashiShyataH
shlokas.7:
sarvamapyetadekasya nAlaM sa~njaya kasyachit |
tAta saMhatya jIvAmo mA dviShadbhyo vashaM gamaH
shlokas.8:
tathA bhIShmaM shAntanavaM bhAratAnAM pitAmaham |
shirasAbhivadethAstvaM mama nAma prakIrtayan
shlokas.9:
abhivAdya cha vaktavyastato.asmAkaM pitAmahaH |
bhavatA shantanorva.nsho nimagnaH punaruddhRRitaH
shlokas.10:
sa tvaM kuru tathA tAta svamatena pitAmaha |
yathA jIvanti te pautrAH prItimantaH parasparam
shlokas.11:
tathaiva viduraM brUyAH kurUNAM mantradhAriNam |
ayuddhaM saumya bhAShasva hitakAmo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
atho suyodhanaM brUyA rAjaputramamarShaNam |
madhye kurUNAmAsInamanunIya punaH punaH
shlokas.13:
apashyanmAmupekShantaM kRRiShNAmekAM sabhAgatAm |
tadduHkhamatitikShAma mA vadhIShma kurUniti
shlokas.14:
evaM pUrvAparAnkleshAnatitikShanta pANDavAH |
yathA balIyasaH santastatsarvaM kuravo viduH
shlokas.15:
yannaH prAvrAjayaH saumya ajinaiH prativAsitAn |
tadduHkhamatitikShAma mA vadhIShma kurUniti
shlokas.16:
yattatsabhAyAmAkramya kRRiShNAM kesheShvadharShayat |
duHshAsanaste.anumate tachchAsmAbhirupekShitam
shlokas.17:
yathochitaM svakaM bhAgaM labhemahi parantapa |
nivartaya paradravye buddhiM gRRiddhAM nararShabha
shlokas.18:
shAntirevaM bhavedrAjanprItishchaiva parasparam |
rAjyaikadeshamapi naH prayachCha shamamichChatAm
shlokas.19:
kushasthalaM vRRikasthalamAsandI vAraNAvatam |
avasAnaM bhavedatra ki~nchideva tu pa~nchamam
shlokas.20:
bhrAtR^INAM dehi pa~nchAnAM grAmAnpa~ncha suyodhana |
shAntirno.astu mahAprAj~na j~nAtibhiH saha sa~njaya
shlokas.21:
bhrAtA bhrAtaramanvetu pitA putreNa yujyatAm |
smayamAnAH samAyAntu pA~nchAlAH kurubhiH saha
shlokas.22:
akShatAnkurupA~nchAlAnpashyema iti kAmaye |
sarve sumanasastAta shAmyAma bharatarShabha
shlokas.23:
alameva shamAyAsmi tathA yuddhAya sa~njaya |
dharmArthayoralaM chAhaM mRRidave dAruNAya cha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
anuj~nAtaH pANDavena prayayau sa~njayastadA |
shAsanaM dhRRitarAShTrasya sarvaM kRRitvA mahAtmanaH
shlokas.2:
samprApya hAstinapuraM shIghraM cha pravivesha ha |
antaHpuramupasthAya dvAHsthaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.3:
AchakShva mAM dhRRitarAShTrAya dvAHstha; upAgataM pANDavAnAM sakAshAt |
jAgarti chedabhivadestvaM hi kShattaH; pravisheyaM vidito bhUmipasya
shlokas.4:
dvAHstha uvAcha||
sa~njayo.ayaM bhUmipate namaste; didRRikShayA dvAramupAgataste |
prApto dUtaH pANDavAnAM sakAshA;tprashAdhi rAjankimayaM karotu
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
AchakShva mAM sukhinaM kAlyamasmai; praveshyatAM svAgataM sa~njayAya |
na chAhametasya bhavAmyakAlyaH; sa me kasmAddvAri tiShTheta kShattaH
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH pravishyAnumate nRRipasya; mahadveshma prAj~nashUrAryaguptam |
siMhAsanasthaM pArthivamAsasAda; vaichitravIryaM prA~njaliH sUtaputraH
shlokas.7:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa~njayo.ahaM bhUmipate namaste; prApto.asmi gatvA naradeva pANDavAn |
abhivAdya tvAM pANDuputro manasvI; yudhiShThiraH kushalaM chAnvapRRichChat
shlokas.8:
sa te putrAnpRRichChati prIyamANaH; kachchitputraiH prIyase naptRRibhishcha |
tathA suhRRidbhiH sachivaishcha rAja;nye chApi tvAmupajIvanti taishcha
shlokas.9:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
abhyetya tvAM tAta vadAmi sa~njaya; ajAtashatruM cha sukhena pArtham |
kachchitsa rAjA kushalI saputraH; sahAmAtyaH sAnujaH kauravANAm
shlokas.10:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sahAmAtyaH kushalI pANDuputro; bhUyashchAto yachcha te.agre mano.abhUt |
nirNiktadharmArthakaro manasvI; bahushruto dRRiShTimA~nshIlavA.nshcha
shlokas.11:
paraM dharmAtpANDavasyAnRRisha.nsyaM; dharmaH paro vittachayAnmato.asya |
sukhapriye dharmahIne na pArtho;.anurudhyate bhArata tasya viddhi
shlokas.12:
paraprayuktaH puruSho vicheShTate; sUtraprotA dArumayIva yoShA |
imaM dRRiShTvA niyamaM pANDavasya; manye paraM karma daivaM manuShyAt
shlokas.13:
imaM cha dRRiShTvA tava karmadoShaM; pAdodarkaM ghoramavarNarUpam |
yAvannaraH kAmayate.atikAlyaM; tAvannaro.ayaM labhate prasha.nsAm
shlokas.14:
ajAtashatrustu vihAya pApaM; jIrNAM tvachaM sarpa ivAsamarthAm |
virochate.ahAryavRRittena dhIro; yudhiShThirastvayi pApaM visRRijya
shlokas.15:
a~NgAtmanaH karma nibodha rAja;ndharmArthayuktAdAryavRRittAdapetam |
upakroshaM cheha gato.asi rAja;nnoheshcha pApaM prasajedamutra
shlokas.16:
sa tvamarthaM sa.nshayitaM vinA tai;rAsha.nsase putravashAnugo.adya |
adharmashabdashcha mahAnpRRithivyAM; nedaM karma tvatsamaM bhAratAgrya
shlokas.17:
hInapraj~no dauShkuleyo nRRisha.nso; dIrghavairI kShatravidyAsvadhIraH |
evandharmA nApadaH santitIrShe;ddhInavIryo yashcha bhavedashiShTaH
shlokas.18:
kule jAto dharmavAnyo yashasvI; bahushrutaH sukhajIvI yatAtmA |
dharmArthayorgrathitayorbibharti; nAnyatra diShTasya vashAdupaiti
shlokas.19:
kathaM hi mantrAgryadharo manIShI; dharmArthayorApadi sampraNetA |
eva.nyuktaH sarvamantrairahIno; anAnRRisha.nsyaM karma kuryAdamUDhaH
shlokas.20:
tavApIme mantravidaH sametya; samAsate karmasu nityayuktAH |
teShAmayaM balavAnnishchayashcha; kurukShayArthe nirayo vyapAdi
shlokas.21:
akAlikaM kuravo nAbhaviShya;npApena chetpApamajAtashatruH |
ichChejjAtu tvayi pApaM visRRijya; nindA cheyaM tava loke.abhaviShyat
shlokas.22:
kimanyatra viShayAdIshvarANAM; yatra pArthaH paralokaM dadarsha |
atyakrAmatsa tathA saMmataH syA;nna sa.nshayo nAsti manuShyakAraH
shlokas.23:
etAnguNAnkarmakRRitAnavekShya; bhAvAbhAvau vartamAnAvanityau |
balirhi rAjA pAramavindamAno; nAnyatkAlAtkAraNaM tatra mene
shlokas.24:
chakShuH shrotre nAsikA tvakcha jihvA; j~nAnasyaitAnyAyatanAni jantoH |
tAni prItAnyeva tRRiShNAkShayAnte; tAnyavyatho duHkhahInaH praNudyAt
shlokas.25:
na tveva manye puruShasya karma; sa.nvartate suprayuktaM yathAvat |
mAtuH pituH karmaNAbhiprasUtaH; sa.nvardhate vidhivadbhojanena
shlokas.26:
priyApriye sukhaduHkhe cha rAja;nnindAprasha.nse cha bhajeta enam |
parastvenaM garhayate.aparAdhe; prasha.nsate sAdhuvRRittaM tameva
shlokas.27:
sa tvA garhe bhAratAnAM virodhA;danto nUnaM bhavitAyaM prajAnAm |
no chedidaM tava karmAparAdhA;tkurUndahetkRRiShNavartmeva kakSham
shlokas.28:
tvamevaiko jAtaputreShu rAja;nvashaM gantA sarvaloke narendra |
kAmAtmanAM shlAghase dyUtakAle; nAnyachChamAtpashya vipAkamasya
shlokas.29:
anAptAnAM pragrahAttvaM narendra; tathAptAnAM nigrahAchchaiva rAjan |
bhUmiM sphItAM durbalatvAdanantAM; na shaktastvaM rakShituM kauraveya
shlokas.30:
anuj~nAto rathavegAvadhUtaH; shrAnto nipadye shayanaM nRRisiMha |
prAtaH shrotAraH kuravaH sabhAyA;majAtashatrorvachanaM sametAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dvAHsthaM prAha mahAprAj~no dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
viduraM draShTumichChAmi tamihAnaya mAchiram
shlokas.2:
prahito dhRRitarAShTreNa dUtaH kShattAramabravIt |
IshvarastvAM mahArAjo mahAprAj~na didRRikShati
shlokas.3:
evamuktastu viduraH prApya rAjaniveshanam |
abravIddhRRitarAShTrAya dvAHstha mAM prativedaya
shlokas.4:
dvAHstha uvAcha||
viduro.ayamanuprApto rAjendra tava shAsanAt |
draShTumichChati te pAdau kiM karotu prashAdhi mAm
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
praveshaya mahAprAj~naM viduraM dIrghadarshinam |
ahaM hi vidurasyAsya nAkAlyo jAtu darshane
shlokas.6:
dvAHstha uvAcha||
pravishAntaHpuraM kShattarmahArAjasya dhImataH |
na hi te darshane.akAlyo jAtu rAjA bravIti mAm
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH pravishya viduro dhRRitarAShTraniveshanam |
abravItprA~njalirvAkyaM chintayAnaM narAdhipam
shlokas.8:
viduro.ahaM mahAprAj~na samprAptastava shAsanAt |
yadi ki~nchana kartavyamayamasmi prashAdhi mAm
shlokas.9:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sa~njayo vidura prApto garhayitvA cha mAM gataH |
ajAtashatroH shvo vAkyaM sabhAmadhye sa vakShyati
shlokas.10:
tasyAdya kuruvIrasya na vij~nAtaM vacho mayA |
tanme dahati gAtrANi tadakArShItprajAgaram
shlokas.11:
jAgrato dahyamAnasya shreyo yadiha pashyasi |
tadbrUhi tvaM hi nastAta dharmArthakushalo hyasi
shlokas.12:
yataH prAptaH sa~njayaH pANDavebhyo; na me yathAvanmanasaH prashAntiH |
sarvendriyANyaprakRRitiM gatAni; kiM vakShyatItyeva hi me.adya chintA
shlokas.13:
vidura uvAcha||
abhiyuktaM balavatA durbalaM hInasAdhanam |
hRRitasvaM kAminaM choramAvishanti prajAgarAH
shlokas.14:
kachchidetairmahAdoShairna spRRiShTo.asi narAdhipa |
kachchinna paravitteShu gRRidhyanviparitapyase
shlokas.15:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
shrotumichChAmi te dharmyaM paraM naiHshreyasaM vachaH |
asminrAjarShiva.nshe hi tvamekaH prAj~nasaMmataH
shlokas.16:
vidura uvAcha||
niShevate prashastAni ninditAni na sevate |
anAstikaH shraddadhAna etatpaNDitalakShaNam
shlokas.17:
krodho harShashcha darpashcha hrIstambho mAnyamAnitA |
yamarthAnnApakarShanti sa vai paNDita uchyate
shlokas.18:
yasya kRRityaM na jAnanti mantraM vA mantritaM pare |
kRRitamevAsya jAnanti sa vai paNDita uchyate
shlokas.19:
yasya kRRityaM na vighnanti shItamuShNaM bhayaM ratiH |
samRRiddhirasamRRiddhirvA sa vai paNDita uchyate
shlokas.20:
yasya sa.nsAriNI praj~nA dharmArthAvanuvartate |
kAmAdarthaM vRRiNIte yaH sa vai paNDita uchyate
shlokas.21:
yathAshakti chikIrShanti yathAshakti cha kurvate |
na ki~nchidavamanyante paNDitA bharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
kShipraM vijAnAti chiraM shRRiNoti; vij~nAya chArthaM bhajate na kAmAt |
nAsampRRiShTo vyupayu~Nkte parArthe; tatpraj~nAnaM prathamaM paNDitasya
shlokas.23:
nAprApyamabhivA~nChanti naShTaM nechChanti shochitum |
Apatsu cha na muhyanti narAH paNDitabuddhayaH
shlokas.24:
nishchitya yaH prakramate nAntarvasati karmaNaH |
avandhyakAlo vashyAtmA sa vai paNDita uchyate
shlokas.25:
AryakarmaNi rajyante bhUtikarmANi kurvate |
hitaM cha nAbhyasUyanti paNDitA bharatarShabha
shlokas.26:
na hRRiShyatyAtmasaMmAne nAvamAnena tapyate |
gA~Ngo hrada ivAkShobhyo yaH sa paNDita uchyate
shlokas.27:
tattvaj~naH sarvabhUtAnAM yogaj~naH sarvakarmaNAm |
upAyaj~no manuShyANAM naraH paNDita uchyate
shlokas.28:
pravRRittavAkchitrakatha UhavAnpratibhAnavAn |
Ashu granthasya vaktA cha sa vai paNDita uchyate
shlokas.29:
shrutaM praj~nAnugaM yasya praj~nA chaiva shrutAnugA |
asambhinnAryamaryAdaH paNDitAkhyAM labheta saH
shlokas.30:
ashrutashcha samunnaddho daridrashcha mahAmanAH |
arthA.nshchAkarmaNA prepsurmUDha ityuchyate budhaiH
shlokas.31:
svamarthaM yaH parityajya parArthamanutiShThati |
mithyA charati mitrArthe yashcha mUDhaH sa uchyate
shlokas.32:
akAmAnkAmayati yaH kAmayAnAnparidviShan |
balavantaM cha yo dveShTi tamAhurmUDhachetasam
shlokas.33:
amitraM kurute mitraM mitraM dveShTi hinasti cha |
karma chArabhate duShTaM tamAhurmUDhachetasam
shlokas.34:
sa.nsArayati kRRityAni sarvatra vichikitsate |
chiraM karoti kShiprArthe sa mUDho bharatarShabha
shlokas.35:
anAhUtaH pravishati apRRiShTo bahu bhAShate |
vishvasatyapramatteShu mUDhachetA narAdhamaH
shlokas.36:
paraM kShipati doSheNa vartamAnaH svayaM tathA |
yashcha krudhyatyanIshaH sansa cha mUDhatamo naraH
shlokas.37:
Atmano balamaj~nAya dharmArthaparivarjitam |
alabhyamichChannaiShkarmyAnmUDhabuddhirihochyate
shlokas.38:
ashiShyaM shAsti yo rAjanyashcha shUnyamupAsate |
kadaryaM bhajate yashcha tamAhurmUDhachetasam
shlokas.39:
arthaM mahAntamAsAdya vidyAmaishvaryameva vA |
vicharatyasamunnaddho yaH sa paNDita uchyate
shlokas.40:
ekaH sampannamashnAti vaste vAsashcha shobhanam |
yo.asa.nvibhajya bhRRityebhyaH ko nRRisha.nsatarastataH
shlokas.41:
ekaH pApAni kurute phalaM bhu~Nkte mahAjanaH |
bhoktAro vipramuchyante kartA doSheNa lipyate
shlokas.42:
ekaM hanyAnna vA hanyAdiShurmukto dhanuShmatA |
buddhirbuddhimatotsRRiShTA hanyAdrAShTraM sarAjakam
shlokas.43:
ekayA dve vinishchitya trI.nshchaturbhirvashe kuru |
pa~ncha jitvA viditvA ShaTsapta hitvA sukhI bhava
shlokas.44:
ekaM viSharaso hanti shastreNaikashcha vadhyate |
sarAShTraM saprajaM hanti rAjAnaM mantravisravaH
shlokas.45:
ekaH svAdu na bhu~njIta ekashchArthAnna chintayet |
eko na gachChedadhvAnaM naikaH supteShu jAgRRiyAt
shlokas.46:
ekamevAdvitIyaM tadyadrAjannAvabudhyase |
satyaM svargasya sopAnaM pArAvArasya nauriva
shlokas.47:
ekaH kShamAvatAM doSho dvitIyo nopalabhyate |
yadenaM kShamayA yuktamashaktaM manyate janaH
shlokas.48:
eko dharmaH paraM shreyaH kShamaikA shAntiruttamA |
vidyaikA paramA dRRiShTirahi.nsaikA sukhAvahA
shlokas.49:
dvAvimau grasate bhUmiH sarpo bilashayAniva |
rAjAnaM chAviroddhAraM brAhmaNaM chApravAsinam
shlokas.50:
dve karmaNI naraH kurvannasmi.Nlloke virochate |
abruvanparuShaM ki~nchidasato nArthaya.nstathA
shlokas.51:
dvAvimau puruShavyAghra parapratyayakAriNau |
striyaH kAmitakAminyo lokaH pUjitapUjakaH
shlokas.52:
dvAvimau kaNTakau tIkShNau sharIraparishoShaNau |
yashchAdhanaH kAmayate yashcha kupyatyanIshvaraH
shlokas.53:
dvAvimau puruShau rAjansvargasyopari tiShThataH |
prabhushcha kShamayA yukto daridrashcha pradAnavAn
shlokas.54:
nyAyAgatasya dravyasya boddhavyau dvAvatikramau |
apAtre pratipattishcha pAtre chApratipAdanam
shlokas.55:
trayo nyAyA manuShyANAM shrUyante bharatarShabha |
kanIyAnmadhyamaH shreShTha iti vedavido viduH
shlokas.57:
traya evAdhanA rAjanbhAryA dAsastathA sutaH |
yatte samadhigachChanti yasya te tasya taddhanam
shlokas.58:
chatvAri rAj~nA tu mahAbalena; varjyAnyAhuH paNDitastAni vidyAt |
alpapraj~naiH saha mantraM na kuryA;nna dIrghasUtrairalasaishchAraNaishcha
shlokas.59:
chatvAri te tAta gRRihe vasantu; shriyAbhijuShTasya gRRihasthadharme |
vRRiddho j~nAtiravasannaH kulInaH; sakhA daridro bhaginI chAnapatyA
shlokas.60:
chatvAryAha mahArAja sadyaskAni bRRihaspatiH |
pRRichChate tridashendrAya tAnImAni nibodha me
shlokas.61:
devatAnAM cha sa~NkalpamanubhAvaM cha dhImatAm |
vinayaM kRRitavidyAnAM vinAshaM pApakarmaNAm
shlokas.62:
pa~nchAgnayo manuShyeNa paricharyAH prayatnataH |
pitA mAtAgnirAtmA cha gurushcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.63:
pa~nchaiva pUjaya.Nlloke yashaH prApnoti kevalam |
devAnpitR^InmanuShyA.nshcha bhikShUnatithipa~nchamAn
shlokas.64:
pa~ncha tvAnugamiShyanti yatra yatra gamiShyasi |
mitrANyamitrA madhyasthA upajIvyopajIvinaH
shlokas.65:
pa~nchendriyasya martyasya ChidraM chedekamindriyam |
tato.asya sravati praj~nA dRRiteH pAdAdivodakam
shlokas.66:
ShaDdoShAH puruSheNeha hAtavyA bhUtimichChatA |
nidrA tandrI bhayaM krodha AlasyaM dIrghasUtratA
shlokas.68:
arakShitAraM rAjAnaM bhAryAM chApriyavAdinIm |
grAmakAmaM cha gopAlaM vanakAmaM cha nApitam
shlokas.69:
ShaDeva tu guNAH pu.nsA na hAtavyAH kadAchana |
satyaM dAnamanAlasyamanasUyA kShamA dhRRitiH
shlokas.70:
ShaNNAmAtmani nityAnAmaishvaryaM yo.adhigachChati |
na sa pApaiH kuto.anarthairyujyate vijitendriyaH
shlokas.71:
ShaDime ShaTsu jIvanti saptamo nopalabhyate |
chorAH pramatte jIvanti vyAdhiteShu chikitsakAH
shlokas.72:
pramadAH kAmayAneShu yajamAneShu yAjakAH |
rAjA vivadamAneShu nityaM mUrkheShu paNDitAH
shlokas.73:
sapta doShAH sadA rAj~nA hAtavyA vyasanodayAH |
prAyasho yairvinashyanti kRRitamUlAshcha pArthivAH
shlokas.74:
striyo.akShA mRRigayA pAnaM vAkpAruShyaM cha pa~nchamam |
mahachcha daNDapAruShyamarthadUShaNameva cha
shlokas.75:
aShTau pUrvanimittAni narasya vinashiShyataH |
brAhmaNAnprathamaM dveShTi brAhmaNaishcha virudhyate
shlokas.76:
brAhmaNasvAni chAdatte brAhmaNA.nshcha jighA.nsati |
ramate nindayA chaiShAM prasha.nsAM nAbhinandati
shlokas.77:
naitAnsmarati kRRityeShu yAchitashchAbhyasUyati |
etAndoShAnnaraH prAj~no buddhyA buddhvA vivarjayet
shlokas.78:
aShTAvimAni harShasya navanItAni bhArata |
vartamAnAni dRRishyante tAnyeva susukhAnyapi
shlokas.79:
samAgamashcha sakhibhirmahA.nshchaiva dhanAgamaH |
putreNa cha pariShva~NgaH saMnipAtashcha maithune
shlokas.80:
samaye cha priyAlApaH svayUtheShu cha saMnatiH |
abhipretasya lAbhashcha pUjA cha janasa.nsadi
shlokas.81:
navadvAramidaM veshma tristhUNaM pa~nchasAkShikam |
kShetraj~nAdhiShThitaM vidvAnyo veda sa paraH kaviH
shlokas.82:
dasha dharmaM na jAnanti dhRRitarAShTra nibodha tAn |
mattaH pramatta unmattaH shrAntaH kruddho bubhukShitaH
shlokas.83:
tvaramANashcha bhIrushcha lubdhaH kAmI cha te dasha |
tasmAdeteShu bhAveShu na prasajjeta paNDitaH
shlokas.84:
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
putrArthamasurendreNa gItaM chaiva sudhanvanA
shlokas.85:
yaH kAmamanyU prajahAti rAjA; pAtre pratiShThApayate dhanaM cha |
visheShavichChrutavAnkShiprakArI; taM sarvalokaH kurute pramANam
shlokas.86:
jAnAti vishvAsayituM manuShyA;nvij~nAtadoSheShu dadhAti daNDam |
jAnAti mAtrAM cha tathA kShamAM cha; taM tAdRRishaM shrIrjuShate samagrA
shlokas.87:
sudurbalaM nAvajAnAti kaM chi;dyukto ripuM sevate buddhipUrvam |
na vigrahaM rochayate balasthaiH; kAle cha yo vikramate sa dhIraH
shlokas.88:
prApyApadaM na vyathate kadA chi;dudyogamanvichChati chApramattaH |
duHkhaM cha kAle sahate jitAtmA; dhurandharastasya jitAH sapatnAH
shlokas.89:
anarthakaM vipravAsaM gRRihebhyaH; pApaiH sandhiM paradArAbhimarsham |
dambhaM stainyaM paishunaM madyapAnaM; na sevate yaH sa sukhI sadaiva
shlokas.90:
na sa.nrambheNArabhate.arthavarga;mAkAritaH sha.nsati tathyameva |
na mAtrArthe rochayate vivAdaM; nApUjitaH kupyati chApyamUDhaH
shlokas.91:
na yo.abhyasUyatyanukampate cha; na durbalaH prAtibhAvyaM karoti |
nAtyAha ki~nchitkShamate vivAdaM; sarvatra tAdRRiglabhate prasha.nsAm
shlokas.92:
yo noddhataM kurute jAtu veShaM; na pauruSheNApi vikatthate.anyAn |
na mUrchChitaH kaTukAnyAha kiM chi;tpriyaM sadA taM kurute jano.api
shlokas.93:
na vairamuddIpayati prashAntaM; na darpamArohati nAstameti |
na durgato.asmIti karoti manyuM; tamAryashIlaM paramAhuragryam
shlokas.94:
na sve sukhe vai kurute praharShaM; nAnyasya duHkhe bhavati pratItaH |
dattvA na pashchAtkurute.anutApaM; na katthate satpuruShAryashIlaH
shlokas.95:
deshAchArAnsamayA~njAtidharmA;nbubhUShate yastu parAvaraj~naH |
sa tatra tatrAdhigataH sadaiva; mahAjanasyAdhipatyaM karoti
shlokas.96:
dambhaM mohaM matsaraM pApakRRityaM; rAjadviShTaM paishunaM pUgavairam |
mattonmattairdurjanaishchApi vAdaM; yaH praj~nAvAnvarjayetsa pradhAnaH
shlokas.97:
damaM shauchaM daivataM ma~NgalAni; prAyashchittaM vividhA.NllokavAdAn |
etAni yaH kurute naityakAni; tasyotthAnaM devatA rAdhayanti
shlokas.98:
samairvivAhaM kurute na hInaiH; samaiH sakhyaM vyavahAraM kathAshcha |
guNairvishiShTA.nshcha purodadhAti; vipashchitastasya nayAH sunItAH
shlokas.99:
mitaM bhu~Nkte sa.nvibhajyAshritebhyo; mitaM svapityamitaM karma kRRitvA |
dadAtyamitreShvapi yAchitaH saM;stamAtmavantaM prajahatyanarthAH
shlokas.100:
chikIrShitaM viprakRRitaM cha yasya; nAnye janAH karma jAnanti ki~nchit |
mantre gupte samyaganuShThite cha; svalpo nAsya vyathate kashchidarthaH
shlokas.101:
yaH sarvabhUtaprashame niviShTaH; satyo mRRidurdAnakRRichChuddhabhAvaH |
atIva sa~nj~nAyate j~nAtimadhye; mahAmaNirjAtya iva prasannaH
shlokas.102:
ya AtmanApatrapate bhRRishaM naraH; sa sarvalokasya gururbhavatyuta |
anantatejAH sumanAH samAhitaH; svatejasA sUrya ivAvabhAsate
shlokas.103:
vane jAtAH shApadagdhasya rAj~naH; pANDoH putrAH pa~ncha pa~nchendrakalpAH |
tvayaiva bAlA vardhitAH shikShitAshcha; tavAdeshaM pAlayantyAmbikeya
shlokas.104:
pradAyaiShAmuchitaM tAta rAjyaM; sukhI putraiH sahito modamAnaH |
na devAnAM nApi cha mAnuShANAM; bhaviShyasi tvaM tarkaNIyo narendra

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
jAgrato dahyamAnasya yatkAryamanupashyasi |
tadbrUhi tvaM hi nastAta dharmArthakushalaH shuchiH
shlokas.2:
tvaM mAM yathAvadvidura prashAdhi; praj~nApUrvaM sarvamajAtashatroH |
yanmanyase pathyamadInasattva; shreyaskaraM brUhi tadvai kurUNAm
shlokas.3:
pApAsha~NkI pApamevAnupashya;npRRichChAmi tvAM vyAkulenAtmanAham |
kave tanme brUhi sarvaM yathAva;nmanIShitaM sarvamajAtashatroH
shlokas.4:
vidura uvAcha||
shubhaM vA yadi vA pApaM dveShyaM vA yadi vA priyam |
apRRiShTastasya tadbrUyAdyasya nechChetparAbhavam
shlokas.5:
tasmAdvakShyAmi te rAjanbhavamichChankurUnprati |
vachaH shreyaskaraM dharmyaM bruvatastannibodha me
shlokas.6:
mithyopetAni karmANi sidhyeyuryAni bhArata |
anupAyaprayuktAni mA sma teShu manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.7:
tathaiva yogavihitaM na sidhyetkarma yannRRipa |
upAyayuktaM medhAvI na tatra glapayenmanaH
shlokas.8:
anubandhAnavekSheta sAnubandheShu karmasu |
sampradhArya cha kurvIta na vegena samAcharet
shlokas.9:
anubandhaM cha samprekShya vipAkA.nshchaiva karmaNAm |
utthAnamAtmanashchaiva dhIraH kurvIta vA na vA
shlokas.10:
yaH pramANaM na jAnAti sthAne vRRiddhau tathA kShaye |
koshe janapade daNDe na sa rAjye.avatiShThate
shlokas.11:
yastvetAni pramANAni yathoktAnyanupashyati |
yukto dharmArthayorj~nAne sa rAjyamadhigachChati
shlokas.12:
na rAjyaM prAptamityeva vartitavyamasAmpratam |
shriyaM hyavinayo hanti jarA rUpamivottamam
shlokas.13:
bhakShyottamapratichChannaM matsyo baDishamAyasam |
rUpAbhipAtI grasate nAnubandhamavekShate
shlokas.14:
yachChakyaM grasituM grasyaM grastaM pariNamechcha yat |
hitaM cha pariNAme yattadadyaM bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.15:
vanaspaterapakvAni phalAni prachinoti yaH |
sa nApnoti rasaM tebhyo bIjaM chAsya vinashyati
shlokas.16:
yastu pakvamupAdatte kAle pariNataM phalam |
phalAdrasaM sa labhate bIjAchchaiva phalaM punaH
shlokas.17:
yathA madhu samAdatte rakShanpuShpANi ShaTpadaH |
tadvadarthAnmanuShyebhya AdadyAdavihi.nsayA
shlokas.18:
puShpaM puShpaM vichinvIta mUlachChedaM na kArayet |
mAlAkAra ivArAme na yathA~NgArakArakaH
shlokas.19:
kiM nu me syAdidaM kRRitvA kiM nu me syAdakurvataH |
iti karmANi sa~nchintya kuryAdvA puruSho na vA
shlokas.20:
anArabhyA bhavantyarthAH kechinnityaM tathAgatAH |
kRRitaH puruShakAro.api bhavedyeShu nirarthakaH
shlokas.21:
kA.nshchidarthAnnaraH prAj~no laghumUlAnmahAphalAn |
kShipramArabhate kartuM na vighnayati tAdRRishAn
shlokas.22:
RRiju pashyati yaH sarvaM chakShuShAnupibanniva |
AsInamapi tUShNIkamanurajyanti taM prajAH
shlokas.23:
chakShuShA manasA vAchA karmaNA cha chaturvidham |
prasAdayati lokaM yaH taM loko.anuprasIdati
shlokas.24:
yasmAttrasyanti bhUtAni mRRigavyAdhAnmRRigA iva |
sAgarAntAmapi mahIM labdhvA sa parihIyate
shlokas.25:
pitRRipaitAmahaM rAjyaM prAptavAnsvena tejasA |
vAyurabhramivAsAdya bhra.nshayatyanaye sthitaH
shlokas.26:
dharmamAcharato rAj~naH sadbhishcharitamAditaH |
vasudhA vasusampUrNA vardhate bhUtivardhanI
shlokas.27:
atha santyajato dharmamadharmaM chAnutiShThataH |
pratisa.nveShTate bhUmiragnau charmAhitaM yathA
shlokas.28:
ya eva yatnaH kriyate pararAShTrAvamardane |
sa eva yatnaH kartavyaH svarAShTraparipAlane
shlokas.29:
dharmeNa rAjyaM vindeta dharmeNa paripAlayet |
dharmamUlAM shriyaM prApya na jahAti na hIyate
shlokas.30:
apyunmattAtpralapato bAlAchcha parisarpataH |
sarvataH sAramAdadyAdashmabhya iva kA~nchanam
shlokas.31:
suvyAhRRitAni sudhiyAM sukRRitAni tatastataH |
sa~nchinvandhIra AsIta shilAhArI shilaM yathA
shlokas.32:
gandhena gAvaH pashyanti vedaiH pashyanti brAhmaNAH |
chAraiH pashyanti rAjAnashchakShurbhyAmitare janAH
shlokas.33:
bhUyA.nsaM labhate kleshaM yA gaurbhavati durduhA |
atha yA suduhA rAjannaiva tAM vinayantyapi
shlokas.34:
yadataptaM praNamati na tatsantApayantyapi |
yachcha svayaM nataM dAru na tatsaMnAmayantyapi
shlokas.35:
etayopamayA dhIraH saMnameta balIyase |
indrAya sa praNamate namate yo balIyase
shlokas.36:
parjanyanAthAH pashavo rAjAno mitrabAndhavAH |
patayo bAndhavAH strINAM brAhmaNA vedabAndhavAH
shlokas.37:
satyena rakShyate dharmo vidyA yogena rakShyate |
mRRijayA rakShyate rUpaM kulaM vRRittena rakShyate
shlokas.38:
mAnena rakShyate dhAnyamashvAnrakShatyanukramaH |
abhIkShNadarshanAdgAvaH striyo rakShyAH kuchelataH
shlokas.39:
na kulaM vRRittahInasya pramANamiti me matiH |
antyeShvapi hi jAtAnAM vRRittameva vishiShyate
shlokas.40:
ya IrShyuH paravitteShu rUpe vIrye kulAnvaye |
sukhe saubhAgyasatkAre tasya vyAdhiranantakaH
shlokas.41:
akAryakaraNAdbhItaH kAryANAM cha vivarjanAt |
akAle mantrabhedAchcha yena mAdyenna tatpibet
shlokas.42:
vidyAmado dhanamadastRRitIyo.abhijano madaH |
ete madAvaliptAnAmeta eva satAM damAH
shlokas.43:
asanto.abhyarthitAH sadbhiH ki~nchitkAryaM kadAchana |
manyante santamAtmAnamasantamapi vishrutam
shlokas.44:
gatirAtmavatAM santaH santa eva satAM gatiH |
asatAM cha gatiH santo na tvasantaH satAM gatiH
shlokas.45:
jitA sabhA vastravatA samAshA gomatA jitA |
adhvA jito yAnavatA sarvaM shIlavatA jitam
shlokas.46:
shIlaM pradhAnaM puruShe tadyasyeha praNashyati |
na tasya jIvitenArtho na dhanena na bandhubhiH
shlokas.47:
ADhyAnAM mA.nsaparamaM madhyAnAM gorasottaram |
lavaNottaraM daridrANAM bhojanaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.48:
sampannataramevAnnaM daridrA bhu~njate sadA |
kShutsvAdutAM janayati sA chADhyeShu sudurlabhA
shlokas.49:
prAyeNa shrImatAM loke bhoktuM shaktirna vidyate |
daridrANAM tu rAjendra api kAShThaM hi jIryate
shlokas.50:
avRRittirbhayamantyAnAM madhyAnAM maraNAdbhayam |
uttamAnAM tu martyAnAmavamAnAtparaM bhayam
shlokas.51:
aishvaryamadapApiShThA madAH pAnamadAdayaH |
aishvaryamadamatto hi nApatitvA vibudhyate
shlokas.52:
indriyairindriyArtheShu vartamAnairanigrahaiH |
tairayaM tApyate loko nakShatrANi grahairiva
shlokas.53:
yo jitaH pa~nchavargeNa sahajenAtmakarshinA |
Apadastasya vardhante shuklapakSha ivoDurAT
shlokas.54:
avijitya ya AtmAnamamAtyAnvijigIShate |
amitrAnvAjitAmAtyaH so.avashaH parihIyate
shlokas.55:
AtmAnameva prathamaM desharUpeNa yo jayet |
tato.amAtyAnamitrA.nshcha na moghaM vijigIShate
shlokas.56:
vashyendriyaM jitAmAtyaM dhRRitadaNDaM vikAriShu |
parIkShyakAriNaM dhIramatyantaM shrIrniShevate
shlokas.57:
rathaH sharIraM puruShasya rAja;nnAtmA niyantendriyANyasya chAshvAH |
tairapramattaH kushalaH sadashvai;rdAntaiH sukhaM yAti rathIva dhIraH
shlokas.58:
etAnyanigRRihItAni vyApAdayitumapyalam |
avidheyA ivAdAntA hayAH pathi kusArathim
shlokas.59:
anarthamarthataH pashyannarthaM chaivApyanarthataH |
indriyaiH prasRRito bAlaH suduHkhaM manyate sukham
shlokas.60:
dharmArthau yaH parityajya syAdindriyavashAnugaH |
shrIprANadhanadArebhya kShipraM sa parihIyate
shlokas.63:
kShudrAkSheNeva jAlena jhaShAvapihitAvubhau |
kAmashcha rAjankrodhashcha tau praj~nAnaM vilumpataH
shlokas.64:
samavekShyeha dharmArthau sambhArAnyo.adhigachChati |
sa vai sambhRRitasambhAraH satataM sukhamedhate
shlokas.65:
yaH pa~nchAbhyantarA~nshatrUnavijitya matikShayAn |
jigIShati ripUnanyAnripavo.abhibhavanti tam
shlokas.66:
dRRishyante hi durAtmAno vadhyamAnAH svakarmabhiH |
indriyANAmanIshatvAdrAjAno rAjyavibhramaiH
shlokas.67:
asantyAgAtpApakRRitAmapApAM;stulyo daNDaH spRRishate mishrabhAvAt |
shuShkeNArdraM dahyate mishrabhAvA;ttasmAtpApaiH saha sandhiM na kuryAt
shlokas.68:
nijAnutpatataH shatrUnpa~ncha pa~nchaprayojanAn |
yo mohAnna nigRRihNAti tamApadgrasate naram
shlokas.69:
anasUyArjavaM shauchaM santoShaH priyavAditA |
damaH satyamanAyAso na bhavanti durAtmanAm
shlokas.70:
Atmaj~nAnamanAyAsastitikShA dharmanityatA |
vAkchaiva guptA dAnaM cha naitAnyantyeShu bhArata
shlokas.71:
AkroshaparivAdAbhyAM vihi.nsantyabudhA budhAn |
vaktA pApamupAdatte kShamamANo vimuchyate
shlokas.72:
hi.nsA balamasAdhUnAM rAj~nAM daNDavidhirbalam |
shushrUShA tu balaM strINAM kShamA guNavatAM balam
shlokas.73:
vAksa.nyamo hi nRRipate suduShkaratamo mataH |
arthavachcha vichitraM cha na shakyaM bahu bhAShitum
shlokas.74:
abhyAvahati kalyANaM vividhA vAksubhAShitA |
saiva durbhAShitA rAjannanarthAyopapadyate
shlokas.75:
sa.nrohati sharairviddhaM vanaM parashunA hatam |
vAchA duruktaM bIbhatsaM na sa.nrohati vAkkShatam
shlokas.76:
karNinAlIkanArAchA nirharanti sharIrataH |
vAkShalyastu na nirhartuM shakyo hRRidishayo hi saH
shlokas.77:
vAksAyakA vadanAnniShpatanti; yairAhataH shochati rAtryahAni |
parasya nAmarmasu te patanti; tAnpaNDito nAvasRRijetpareShu
shlokas.78:
yasmai devAH prayachChanti puruShAya parAbhavam |
buddhiM tasyApakarShanti so.apAchInAni pashyati
shlokas.79:
buddhau kaluShabhUtAyAM vinAshe pratyupasthite |
anayo nayasa~NkAsho hRRidayAnnApasarpati
shlokas.80:
seyaM buddhiH parItA te putrANAM tava bhArata |
pANDavAnAM virodhena na chainAmavabudhyase
shlokas.81:
rAjA lakShaNasampannastrailokyasyApi yo bhavet |
shiShyaste shAsitA so.astu dhRRitarAShTra yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.82:
atIva sarvAnputrA.nste bhAgadheyapuraskRRitaH |
tejasA praj~nayA chaiva yukto dharmArthatattvavit
shlokas.83:
AnRRisha.nsyAdanukroshAdyo.asau dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
gauravAttava rAjendra bahUnkleshA.nstitikShati

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
brUhi bhUyo mahAbuddhe dharmArthasahitaM vachaH |
shRRiNvato nAsti me tRRiptirvichitrANIha bhAShase
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
sarvatIrtheShu vA snAnaM sarvabhUteShu chArjavam |
ubhe ete same syAtAmArjavaM vA vishiShyate
shlokas.3:
ArjavaM pratipadyasva putreShu satataM vibho |
iha kIrtiM parAM prApya pretya svargamavApsyasi
shlokas.4:
yAvatkIrtirmanuShyasya puNyA lokeShu gIyate |
tAvatsa puruShavyAghra svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.5:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
virochanasya sa.nvAdaM keshinyarthe sudhanvanA
shlokas.6:
keshinyuvAcha||
kiM brAhmaNAH svichChreyA.nso ditijAH svidvirochana |
atha kena sma parya~NkaM sudhanvA nAdhirohati
shlokas.7:
virochana uvAcha||
prAjApatyA hi vai shreShThA vayaM keshini sattamAH |
asmAkaM khalvime lokAH ke devAH ke dvijAtayaH
shlokas.8:
keshinyuvAcha||
ihaivAssva pratIkShAva upasthAne virochana |
sudhanvA prAtarAgantA pashyeyaM vAM samAgatau
shlokas.9:
virochana uvAcha||
tathA bhadre kariShyAmi yathA tvaM bhIru bhAShase |
sudhanvAnaM cha mAM chaiva prAtardraShTAsi sa~Ngatau
shlokas.10:
sudhanvovAcha||
anvAlabhe hiraNmayaM prAhrAde.ahaM tavAsanam |
ekatvamupasampanno na tvAseyaM tvayA saha
shlokas.11:
virochana uvAcha||
anvAharantu phalakaM kUrchaM vApyatha vA bRRisIm |
sudhanvanna tvamarho.asi mayA saha samAsanam
shlokas.12:
sudhanvovAcha||
pitApi te samAsInamupAsItaiva mAmadhaH |
bAlaH sukhaidhito gehe na tvaM ki~nchana budhyase
shlokas.13:
virochana uvAcha||
hiraNyaM cha gavAshvaM cha yadvittamasureShu naH |
sudhanvanvipaNe tena prashnaM pRRichChAva ye viduH
shlokas.14:
sudhanvovAcha||
hiraNyaM cha gavAshvaM cha tavaivAstu virochana |
prANayostu paNaM kRRitvA prashnaM pRRichChAva ye viduH
shlokas.15:
virochana uvAcha||
AvAM kutra gamiShyAvaH prANayorvipaNe kRRite |
na hi deveShvahaM sthAtA na manuShyeShu karhichit
shlokas.16:
sudhanvovAcha||
pitaraM te gamiShyAvaH prANayorvipaNe kRRite |
putrasyApi sa hetorhi prahrAdo nAnRRitaM vadet
shlokas.17:
prahrAda uvAcha||
imau tau sampradRRishyete yAbhyAM na charitaM saha |
AshIviShAviva kruddhAvekamArgamihAgatau
shlokas.18:
kiM vai sahaiva charato na purA charataH saha |
virochanaitatpRRichChAmi kiM te sakhyaM sudhanvanA
shlokas.19:
virochana uvAcha||
na me sudhanvanA sakhyaM prANayorvipaNAvahe |
prahrAda tattvAM pRRichChAmi mA prashnamanRRitaM vadIH
shlokas.20:
prahrAda uvAcha||
udakaM madhuparkaM chApyAnayantu sudhanvane |
brahmannabhyarchanIyo.asi shvetA gauH pIvarIkRRitA
shlokas.21:
sudhanvovAcha||
udakaM madhuparkaM cha patha evArpitaM mama |
prahrAda tvaM tu nau prashnaM tathyaM prabrUhi pRRichChatoH
shlokas.22:
prahrAda uvAcha||
putro vAnyo bhavAnbrahmansAkShye chaiva bhavetsthitaH |
tayorvivadatoH prashnaM kathamasmadvidho vadet
shlokas.23:
atha yo naiva prabrUyAtsatyaM vA yadi vAnRRitam |
etatsudhanvanpRRichChAmi durvivaktA sma kiM vaset
shlokas.24:
sudhanvovAcha||
yAM rAtrimadhivinnA strI yAM chaivAkShaparAjitaH |
yAM cha bhArAbhitaptA~Ngo durvivaktA sma tAM vaset
shlokas.25:
nagare pratiruddhaH sanbahirdvAre bubhukShitaH |
amitrAnbhUyasaH pashyandurvivaktA sma tAM vaset
shlokas.26:
pa~ncha pashvanRRite hanti dasha hanti gavAnRRite |
shatamashvAnRRite hanti sahasraM puruShAnRRite
shlokas.27:
hanti jAtAnajAtA.nshcha hiraNyArthe.anRRitaM vadan |
sarvaM bhUmyanRRite hanti mA sma bhUmyanRRitaM vadIH
shlokas.28:
prahrAda uvAcha||
mattaH shreyAna~NgirA vai sudhanvA tvadvirochana |
mAtAsya shreyasI mAtustasmAttvaM tena vai jitaH
shlokas.29:
virochana sudhanvAyaM prANAnAmIshvarastava |
sudhanvanpunarichChAmi tvayA dattaM virochanam
shlokas.30:
sudhanvovAcha||
yaddharmamavRRiNIthAstvaM na kAmAdanRRitaM vadIH |
punardadAmi te tasmAtputraM prahrAda durlabham
shlokas.31:
eSha prahrAda putraste mayA datto virochanaH |
pAdaprakShAlanaM kuryAtkumAryAH saMnidhau mama
shlokas.32:
vidura uvAcha||
tasmAdrAjendra bhUmyarthe nAnRRitaM vaktumarhasi |
mA gamaH sasutAmAtyo.atyayaM putrAnanubhraman
shlokas.33:
na devA yaShTimAdAya rakShanti pashupAlavat |
yaM tu rakShitumichChanti buddhyA sa.nvibhajanti tam
shlokas.34:
yathA yathA hi puruShaH kalyANe kurute manaH |
tathA tathAsya sarvArthAH sidhyante nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.35:
na ChandA.nsi vRRijinAttArayanti; mAyAvinaM mAyayA vartamAnam |
nIDaM shakuntA iva jAtapakShA;shChandA.nsyenaM prajahatyantakAle
shlokas.36:
mattApAnaM kalahaM pUgavairaM; bhAryApatyorantaraM j~nAtibhedam |
rAjadviShTaM strIpumA.nsorvivAdaM; varjyAnyAhuryashcha panthAH praduShTaH
shlokas.37:
sAmudrikaM vaNijaM chorapUrvaM; shalAkadhUrtaM cha chikitsakaM cha |
ariM cha mitraM cha kushIlavaM cha; naitAnsAkShyeShvadhikurvIta sapta
shlokas.38:
mAnAgnihotramuta mAnamaunaM; mAnenAdhItamuta mAnayaj~naH |
etAni chatvAryabhaya~NkarANi; bhayaM prayachChantyayathAkRRitAni
shlokas.39:
agAradAhI garadaH kuNDAshI somavikrayI |
parvakArashcha sUchI cha mitradhrukpAradArikaH
shlokas.40:
bhrUNahA gurutalpI cha yashcha syAtpAnapo dvijaH |
atitIkShNashcha kAkashcha nAstiko vedanindakaH
shlokas.41:
sruvapragrahaNo vrAtyaH kInAshashchArthavAnapi |
rakShetyuktashcha yo hi.nsyAtsarve brahmahaNaiH samAH
shlokas.42:
tRRiNolkayA j~nAyate jAtarUpaM; yuge bhadro vyavahAreNa sAdhuH |
shUro bhayeShvarthakRRichChreShu dhIraH; kRRichChrAsvApatsu suhRRidashchArayashcha
shlokas.43:
jarA rUpaM harati hi dhairyamAshA; mRRityuH prANAndharmacharyAmasUyA |
krodhaH shriyaM shIlamanAryasevA; hriyaM kAmaH sarvamevAbhimAnaH
shlokas.44:
shrIrma~NgalAtprabhavati prAgalbhyAtsampravardhate |
dAkShyAttu kurute mUlaM sa.nyamAtpratitiShThati
shlokas.45:
aShTau guNAH puruShaM dIpayanti; praj~nA cha kaulyaM cha damaH shrutaM cha |
parAkramashchAbahubhAShitA cha; dAnaM yathAshakti kRRitaj~natA cha
shlokas.46:
etAnguNA.nstAta mahAnubhAvA;neko guNaH sa.nshrayate prasahya |
rAjA yadA satkurute manuShyaM; sarvAnguNAneSha guNo.atibhAti
shlokas.47:
aShTau nRRipemAni manuShyaloke; svargasya lokasya nidarshanAni |
chatvAryeShAmanvavetAni sadbhi;shchatvAryeShAmanvavayanti santaH
shlokas.48:
yaj~no dAnamadhyayanaM tapashcha; chatvAryetAnyanvavetAni sadbhiH |
damaH satyamArjavamAnRRisha.nsyaM; chatvAryetAnyanvavayanti santaH
shlokas.49:
na sA sabhA yatra na santi vRRiddhA; na te vRRiddhA ye na vadanti dharmam |
nAsau dharmo yatra na satyamasti; na tatsatyaM yachChalenAnuviddham
shlokas.50:
satyaM rUpaM shrutaM vidyA kaulyaM shIlaM balaM dhanam |
shauryaM cha chitrabhAShyaM cha dasha sa.nsargayonayaH
shlokas.51:
pApaM kurvanpApakIrtiH pApamevAshnute phalam |
puNyaM kurvanpuNyakIrtiH puNyamevAshnute phalam
shlokas.52:
pApaM praj~nAM nAshayati kriyamANaM punaH punaH |
naShTapraj~naH pApameva nityamArabhate naraH
shlokas.53:
puNyaM praj~nAM vardhayati kriyamANaM punaH punaH |
vRRiddhapraj~naH puNyameva nityamArabhate naraH
shlokas.54:
asUyako dandashUko niShThuro vairakRRinnaraH |
sa kRRichChraM mahadApnoti nachirAtpApamAcharan
shlokas.55:
anasUyaH kRRitapraj~naH shobhanAnyAcharansadA |
akRRichChrAtsukhamApnoti sarvatra cha virAjate
shlokas.56:
praj~nAmevAgamayati yaH prAj~nebhyaH sa paNDitaH |
prAj~no hyavApya dharmArthau shaknoti sukhamedhitum
shlokas.57:
divasenaiva tatkuryAdyena rAtrau sukhaM vaset |
aShTamAsena tatkuryAdyena varShAH sukhaM vaset
shlokas.58:
pUrve vayasi tatkuryAdyena vRRiddhaH sukhaM vaset |
yAvajjIvena tatkuryAdyena pretya sukhaM vaset
shlokas.59:
jIrNamannaM prasha.nsanti bhAryAM cha gatayauvanAm |
shUraM vigatasa~NgrAmaM gatapAraM tapasvinam
shlokas.61:
gururAtmavatAM shAstA shAstA rAjA durAtmanAm |
atha prachChannapApAnAM shAstA vaivasvato yamaH
shlokas.62:
RRiShINAM cha nadInAM cha kulAnAM cha mahAtmanAm |
prabhavo nAdhigantavyaH strINAM dushcharitasya cha
shlokas.63:
dvijAtipUjAbhirato dAtA j~nAtiShu chArjavI |
kShatriyaH svargabhAgrAja.nshchiraM pAlayate mahIm
shlokas.64:
suvarNapuShpAM pRRithivIM chinvanti puruShAstrayaH |
shUrashcha kRRitavidyashcha yashcha jAnAti sevitum
shlokas.65:
buddhishreShThAni karmANi bAhumadhyAni bhArata |
tAni ja~NghAjaghanyAni bhArapratyavarANi cha
shlokas.66:
duryodhane cha shakunau mUDhe duHshAsane tathA |
karNe chaishvaryamAdhAya kathaM tvaM bhUtimichChasi
shlokas.67:
sarvairguNairupetAshcha pANDavA bharatarShabha |
pitRRivattvayi vartante teShu vartasva putravat

shlokas.1:
vidura uvAcha||
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
Atreyasya cha sa.nvAdaM sAdhyAnAM cheti naH shrutam
shlokas.2:
charantaM ha.nsarUpeNa maharShiM sa.nshitavratam |
sAdhyA devA mahAprAj~naM paryapRRichChanta vai purA
shlokas.3:
sAdhyA devA vayamasmo maharShe; dRRiShTvA bhavantaM na shaknumo.anumAtum |
shrutena dhIro buddhimA.nstvaM mato naH; kAvyAM vAchaM vaktumarhasyudArAm
shlokas.4:
ha.nsa uvAcha||
etatkAryamamarAH sa.nshrutaM me; dhRRitiH shamaH satyadharmAnuvRRittiH |
granthiM vinIya hRRidayasya sarvaM; priyApriye chAtmavashaM nayIta
shlokas.5:
AkrushyamAno nAkroshenmanyureva titikShitaH |
AkroShTAraM nirdahati sukRRitaM chAsya vindati
shlokas.6:
nAkroshI syAnnAvamAnI parasya; mitradrohI nota nIchopasevI |
na chAtimAnI na cha hInavRRitto; rUkShAM vAchaM rushatIM varjayIta
shlokas.7:
marmANyasthIni hRRidayaM tathAsU;nghorA vAcho nirdahantIha pu.nsAm |
tasmAdvAchaM rushatIM rUkSharUpAM; dharmArAmo nityasho varjayIta
shlokas.8:
aruntudaM paruShaM rUkShavAchaM; vAkkaNTakairvitudantaM manuShyAn |
vidyAdalakShmIkatamaM janAnAM; mukhe nibaddhAM nirRRitiM vahantam
shlokas.9:
parashchedenamadhividhyeta bANai;rbhRRishaM sutIkShNairanalArkadIptaiH |
virichyamAno.apyatirichyamAno; vidyAtkaviH sukRRitaM me dadhAti
shlokas.10:
yadi santaM sevate yadyasantaM; tapasvinaM yadi vA stenameva |
vAso yathA ra~NgavashaM prayAti; tathA sa teShAM vashamabhyupaiti
shlokas.11:
vAdaM tu yo na pravadenna vAdaye;dyo nAhataH pratihanyAnna ghAtayet |
yo hantukAmasya na pApamichChe;ttasmai devAH spRRihayantyAgatAya
shlokas.12:
avyAhRRitaM vyAhRRitAchChreya AhuH; satyaM vadedvyAhRRitaM taddvitIyam |
priyaM vadedvyAhRRitaM tattRRitIyaM; dharmyaM vadedvyAhRRitaM tachchaturtham
shlokas.13:
yAdRRishaiH sa.nvivadate yAdRRishA.nshchopasevate |
yAdRRigichChechcha bhavituM tAdRRigbhavati pUruShaH
shlokas.14:
yato yato nivartate tatastato vimuchyate |
nivartanAddhi sarvato na vetti duHkhamaNvapi
shlokas.15:
na jIyate nota jigIShate.anyA;nna vairakRRichchApratighAtakashcha |
nindAprasha.nsAsu samasvabhAvo; na shochate hRRiShyati naiva chAyam
shlokas.16:
bhAvamichChati sarvasya nAbhAve kurute matim |
satyavAdI mRRidurdAnto yaH sa uttamapUruShaH
shlokas.17:
nAnarthakaM sAntvayati pratij~nAya dadAti cha |
rAddhAparAddhe jAnAti yaH sa madhyamapUruShaH
shlokas.18:
duHshAsanastUpahantA na shAstA; nAvartate manyuvashAtkRRitaghnaH |
na kasyachinmitramatho durAtmA; kalAshchaitA adhamasyeha pu.nsaH
shlokas.19:
na shraddadhAti kalyANaM parebhyo.apyAtmasha~NkitaH |
nirAkaroti mitrANi yo vai so.adhamapUruShaH
shlokas.20:
uttamAneva seveta prApte kAle tu madhyamAn |
adhamA.nstu na seveta ya ichChechChreya AtmanaH
shlokas.21:
prApnoti vai vittamasadbalena; nityotthAnAtpraj~nayA pauruSheNa |
na tveva samyaglabhate prasha.nsAM; na vRRittamApnoti mahAkulAnAm
shlokas.22:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
mahAkulAnAM spRRihayanti devA; dharmArthavRRiddhAshcha bahushrutAshcha |
pRRichChAmi tvAM vidura prashnametaM; bhavanti vai kAni mahAkulAni
shlokas.23:
vidura uvAcha||
tapo damo brahmavittvaM vitAnAH; puNyA vivAhAH satatAnnadAnam |
yeShvevaite sapta guNA bhavanti; samyagvRRittAstAni mahAkulAni
shlokas.24:
yeShAM na vRRittaM vyathate na yoni;rvRRittaprasAdena charanti dharmam |
ye kIrtimichChanti kule vishiShTAM; tyaktAnRRitAstAni mahAkulAni
shlokas.25:
anijyayAvivAhaishcha vedasyotsAdanena cha |
kulAnyakulatAM yAnti dharmasyAtikrameNa cha
shlokas.26:
devadravyavinAshena brahmasvaharaNena cha |
kulAnyakulatAM yAnti brAhmaNAtikrameNa cha
shlokas.27:
brAhmaNAnAM paribhavAtparivAdAchcha bhArata |
kulAnyakulatAM yAnti nyAsApaharaNena cha
shlokas.28:
kulAni samupetAni gobhiH puruShato.ashvataH |
kulasa~NkhyAM na gachChanti yAni hInAni vRRittataH
shlokas.29:
vRRittatastvavihInAni kulAnyalpadhanAnyapi |
kulasa~NkhyAM tu gachChanti karShanti cha mahadyashaH
shlokas.30:
mA naH kule vairakRRitkashchidastu; rAjAmAtyo mA parasvApahArI |
mitradrohI naikRRitiko.anRRitI vA; pUrvAshI vA pitRRidevAtithibhyaH
shlokas.31:
yashcha no brAhmaNaM hanyAdyashcha no brAhmaNAndviShet |
na naH sa samitiM gachChedyashcha no nirvapetkRRiShim
shlokas.32:
tRRiNAni bhUmirudakaM vAkchaturthI cha sUnRRitA |
satAmetAni geheShu nochChidyante kadAchana
shlokas.33:
shraddhayA parayA rAjannupanItAni satkRRitim |
pravRRittAni mahAprAj~na dharmiNAM puNyakarmaNAm
shlokas.34:
sUkShmo.api bhAraM nRRipate syandano vai; shakto voDhuM na tathAnye mahIjAH |
evaM yuktA bhArasahA bhavanti; mahAkulInA na tathAnye manuShyAH
shlokas.35:
na tanmitraM yasya kopAdbibheti; yadvA mitraM sha~Nkitenopacharyam |
yasminmitre pitarIvAshvasIta; tadvai mitraM sa~NgatAnItarANi
shlokas.36:
yadi chedapyasambandho mitrabhAvena vartate |
sa eva bandhustanmitraM sA gatistatparAyaNam
shlokas.37:
chalachittasya vai pu.nso vRRiddhAnanupasevataH |
pAriplavamaternityamadhruvo mitrasa~NgrahaH
shlokas.38:
chalachittamanAtmAnamindriyANAM vashAnugam |
arthAH samativartante ha.nsAH shuShkaM saro yathA
shlokas.39:
akasmAdeva kupyanti prasIdantyanimittataH |
shIlametadasAdhUnAmabhraM pAriplavaM yathA
shlokas.40:
satkRRitAshcha kRRitArthAshcha mitrANAM na bhavanti ye |
tAnmRRitAnapi kravyAdAH kRRitaghnAnnopabhu~njate
shlokas.41:
arthayedeva mitrANi sati vAsati vA dhane |
nAnarthayanvijAnAti mitrANAM sAraphalgutAm
shlokas.42:
santApAdbhrashyate rUpaM santApAdbhrashyate balam |
santApAdbhrashyate j~nAnaM santApAdvyAdhimRRichChati
shlokas.43:
anavApyaM cha shokena sharIraM chopatapyate |
amitrAshcha prahRRiShyanti mA sma shoke manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.44:
punarnaro mriyate jAyate cha; punarnaro hIyate vardhate punaH |
punarnaro yAchati yAchyate cha; punarnaraH shochati shochyate punaH
shlokas.45:
sukhaM cha duHkhaM cha bhavAbhavau cha; lAbhAlAbhau maraNaM jIvitaM cha |
paryAyashaH sarvamiha spRRishanti; tasmAddhIro naiva hRRiShyenna shochet
shlokas.46:
chalAni hImAni ShaDindriyANi; teShAM yadyadvartate yatra yatra |
tatastataH sravate buddhirasya; ChidrodakumbhAdiva nityamambhaH
shlokas.47:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tanuruchChaH shikhI rAjA mithyopacharito mayA |
mandAnAM mama putrANAM yuddhenAntaM kariShyati
shlokas.48:
nityodvignamidaM sarvaM nityodvignamidaM manaH |
yattatpadamanudvignaM tanme vada mahAmate
shlokas.49:
vidura uvAcha||
nAnyatra vidyAtapasornAnyatrendriyanigrahAt |
nAnyatra lobhasantyAgAchChAntiM pashyAmi te.anagha
shlokas.50:
buddhyA bhayaM praNudati tapasA vindate mahat |
gurushushrUShayA j~nAnaM shAntiM tyAgena vindati
shlokas.51:
anAshritA dAnapuNyaM vedapuNyamanAshritAH |
rAgadveShavinirmuktA vicharantIha mokShiNaH
shlokas.52:
svadhItasya suyuddhasya sukRRitasya cha karmaNaH |
tapasashcha sutaptasya tasyAnte sukhamedhate
shlokas.53:
svAstIrNAni shayanAni prapannA; na vai bhinnA jAtu nidrAM labhante |
na strIShu rAjanratimApnuvanti; na mAgadhaiH stUyamAnA na sUtaiH
shlokas.54:
na vai bhinnA jAtu charanti dharmaM; na vai sukhaM prApnuvantIha bhinnAH |
na vai bhinnA gauravaM mAnayanti; na vai bhinnAH prashamaM rochayanti
shlokas.55:
na vai teShAM svadate pathyamuktaM; yogakShemaM kalpate nota teShAm |
bhinnAnAM vai manujendra parAyaNaM; na vidyate ki~nchidanyadvinAshAt
shlokas.56:
sambhAvyaM goShu sampannaM sambhAvyaM brAhmaNe tapaH |
sambhAvyaM strIShu chApalyaM sambhAvyaM j~nAtito bhayam
shlokas.57:
tantavo.apyAyatA nityaM tantavo bahulAH samAH |
bahUnbahutvAdAyAsAnsahantItyupamA satAm
shlokas.58:
dhUmAyante vyapetAni jvalanti sahitAni cha |
dhRRitarAShTrolmukAnIva j~nAtayo bharatarShabha
shlokas.59:
brAhmaNeShu cha ye shUrAH strIShu j~nAtiShu goShu cha |
vRRintAdiva phalaM pakvaM dhRRitarAShTra patanti te
shlokas.60:
mahAnapyekajo vRRikSho balavAnsupratiShThitaH |
prasahya eva vAtena shAkhAskandhaM vimarditum
shlokas.61:
atha ye sahitA vRRikShAH sa~NghashaH supratiShThitAH |
te hi shIghratamAnvAtAnsahante.anyonyasa.nshrayAt
shlokas.62:
evaM manuShyamapyekaM guNairapi samanvitam |
shakyaM dviShanto manyante vAyurdrumamivaikajam
shlokas.64:
avadhyA brAhmaNA gAvaH striyo bAlAshcha j~nAtayaH |
yeShAM chAnnAni bhu~njIta ye cha syuH sharaNAgatAH
shlokas.65:
na manuShye guNaH kashchidanyo dhanavatAmapi |
anAturatvAdbhadraM te mRRitakalpA hi rogiNaH
shlokas.66:
avyAdhijaM kaTukaM shIrSharogaM; pApAnubandhaM paruShaM tIkShNamugram |
satAM peyaM yanna pibantyasanto; manyuM mahArAja piba prashAmya
shlokas.67:
rogArditA na phalAnyAdriyante; na vai labhante viShayeShu tattvam |
duHkhopetA rogiNo nityameva; na budhyante dhanabhogAnna saukhyam
shlokas.68:
purA hyukto nAkarostvaM vacho me; dyUte jitAM draupadIM prekShya rAjan |
duryodhanaM vArayetyakShavatyAM; kitavatvaM paNDitA varjayanti
shlokas.69:
na tadbalaM yanmRRidunA virudhyate; mishro dharmastarasA sevitavyaH |
pradhva.nsinI krUrasamAhitA shrI;rmRRiduprauDhA gachChati putrapautrAn
shlokas.70:
dhArtarAShTrAH pANDavAnpAlayantu; pANDoH sutAstava putrA.nshcha pAntu |
ekArimitrAH kuravo hyekamantrA; jIvantu rAjansukhinaH samRRiddhAH
shlokas.71:
meDhIbhUtaH kauravANAM tvamadya; tvayyAdhInaM kurukulamAjamIDha |
pArthAnbAlAnvanavAsaprataptA;ngopAyasva svaM yashastAta rakShan
shlokas.72:
sandhatsva tvaM kauravAnpANDuputrai;rmA te.antaraM ripavaH prArthayantu |
satye sthitAste naradeva sarve; duryodhanaM sthApaya tvaM narendra

shlokas.1:
vidura uvAcha||
saptadashemAnrAjendra manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt |
vaichitravIrya puruShAnAkAshaM muShTibhirghnataH
shlokas.2:
tAnevendrasya hi dhanuranAmyaM namato.abravIt |
atho marIchinaH pAdAnanAmyAnnamatastathA
shlokas.3:
yashchAshiShyaM shAsati yashcha kupyate; yashchAtivelaM bhajate dviShantam |
striyashcha yo.arakShati bhadramastu te; yashchAyAchyaM yAchati yashcha katthate
shlokas.4:
yashchAbhijAtaH prakarotyakAryaM; yashchAbalo balinA nityavairI |
ashraddadhAnAya cha yo bravIti; yashchAkAmyaM kAmayate narendra
shlokas.5:
vadhvA hAsaM shvashuro yashcha manyate; vadhvA vasannuta yo mAnakAmaH |
parakShetre nirvapati yashcha bIjaM; striyaM cha yaH parivadate.ativelam
shlokas.6:
yashchaiva labdhvA na smarAmItyuvAcha; dattvA cha yaH katthati yAchyamAnaH |
yashchAsataH sAntvamupAsatIha; ete.anuyAntyanilaM pAshahastAH
shlokas.7:
yasminyathA vartate yo manuShya;stasmi.nstathA vartitavyaM sa dharmaH |
mAyAchAro mAyayA vartitavyaH; sAdhvAchAraH sAdhunA pratyudeyaH
shlokas.8:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
shatAyuruktaH puruShaH sarvavedeShu vai yadA |
nApnotyatha cha tatsarvamAyuH keneha hetunA
shlokas.9:
vidura uvAcha||
ativAdo.atimAnashcha tathAtyAgo narAdhipa |
krodhashchAtivivitsA cha mitradrohashcha tAni ShaT
shlokas.10:
eta evAsayastIkShNAH kRRintantyAyUMShi dehinAm |
etAni mAnavAnghnanti na mRRityurbhadramastu te
shlokas.11:
vishvastasyaiti yo dArAnyashchApi gurutalpagaH |
vRRiShalIpatirdvijo yashcha pAnapashchaiva bhArata
shlokas.12:
sharaNAgatahA chaiva sarve brahmahaNaiH samAH |
etaiH sametya kartavyaM prAyashchittamiti shrutiH
shlokas.13:
gRRihI vadAnyo.anapaviddhavAkyaH; sheShAnnabhoktApyavihi.nsakashcha |
nAnarthakRRittyaktakaliH kRRitaj~naH; satyo mRRiduH svargamupaiti vidvAn
shlokas.14:
sulabhAH puruShA rAjansatataM priyavAdinaH |
apriyasya tu pathyasya vaktA shrotA cha durlabhaH
shlokas.15:
yo hi dharmaM vyapAshritya hitvA bhartuH priyApriye |
apriyANyAha pathyAni tena rAjA sahAyavAn
shlokas.16:
tyajetkulArthe puruShaM grAmasyArthe kulaM tyajet |
grAmaM janapadasyArthe AtmArthe pRRithivIM tyajet
shlokas.17:
ApadarthaM dhanaM rakSheddArAnrakSheddhanairapi |
AtmAnaM satataM rakSheddArairapi dhanairapi
shlokas.18:
uktaM mayA dyUtakAle.api rAja;nnaivaM yuktaM vachanaM prAtipIya |
tadauShadhaM pathyamivAturasya; na rochate tava vaichitravIrya
shlokas.19:
kAkairimA.nshchitrabarhAnmayUrA;nparAjaiShThAH pANDavAndhArtarAShTraiH |
hitvA siMhAnkroShTukAngUhamAnaH; prApte kAle shochitA tvaM narendra
shlokas.20:
yastAta na krudhyati sarvakAlaM; bhRRityasya bhaktasya hite ratasya |
tasminbhRRityA bhartari vishvasanti; na chainamApatsu parityajanti
shlokas.21:
na bhRRityAnAM vRRittisa.nrodhanena; bAhyaM janaM sa~njighRRikShedapUrvam |
tyajanti hyenamuchitAvaruddhAH; snigdhA hyamAtyAH parihInabhogAH
shlokas.22:
kRRityAni pUrvaM parisa~NkhyAya sarvA;NyAyavyayAvanurUpAM cha vRRittim |
sa~NgRRihNIyAdanurUpAnsahAyA;nsahAyasAdhyAni hi duShkarANi
shlokas.23:
abhiprAyaM yo viditvA tu bhartuH; sarvANi kAryANi karotyatandrIH |
vaktA hitAnAmanurakta AryaH; shaktij~na Atmeva hi so.anukampyaH
shlokas.24:
vAkyaM tu yo nAdriyate.anushiShTaH; pratyAha yashchApi niyujyamAnaH |
praj~nAbhimAnI pratikUlavAdI; tyAjyaH sa tAdRRiktvarayaiva bhRRityaH
shlokas.25:
astabdhamaklIbamadIrghasUtraM; sAnukroshaM shlakShNamahAryamanyaiH |
arogajAtIyamudAravAkyaM; dUtaM vadantyaShTaguNopapannam
shlokas.26:
na vishvAsAjjAtu parasya gehaM; gachChennarashchetayAno vikAle |
na chatvare nishi tiShThennigUDho; na rAjanyAM yoShitaM prArthayIta
shlokas.27:
na nihnavaM satragatasya gachChe;tsa.nsRRiShTamantrasya kusa~Ngatasya |
na cha brUyAnnAshvasAmi tvayIti; sakAraNaM vyapadeshaM tu kuryAt
shlokas.28:
ghRRiNI rAjA pu.nshchalI rAjabhRRityaH; putro bhrAtA vidhavA bAlaputrA |
senAjIvI choddhRRitabhakta eva; vyavahAre vai varjanIyAH syurete
shlokas.29:
guNA dasha snAnashIlaM bhajante; balaM rUpaM svaravarNaprashuddhiH |
sparshashcha gandhashcha vishuddhatA cha; shrIH saukumAryaM pravarAshcha nAryaH
shlokas.30:
guNAshcha ShaNmitabhuktaM bhajante; ArogyamAyushcha sukhaM balaM cha |
anAvilaM chAsya bhavedapatyaM; na chainamAdyUna iti kShipanti
shlokas.31:
akarmashIlaM cha mahAshanaM cha; lokadviShTaM bahumAyaM nRRisha.nsam |
adeshakAlaj~namaniShTaveSha;metAngRRihe na prativAsayIta
shlokas.32:
kadaryamAkroshakamashrutaM cha; varAkasambhUtamamAnyamAninam |
niShThUriNaM kRRitavairaM kRRitaghna;metAnbhRRishArto.api na jAtu yAchet
shlokas.33:
sa~NkliShTakarmANamatipravAdaM; nityAnRRitaM chAdRRiDhabhaktikaM cha |
vikRRiShTarAgaM bahumAninaM chA;pyetAnna seveta narAdhamAnShaT
shlokas.34:
sahAyabandhanA hyarthAH sahAyAshchArthabandhanAH |
anyonyabandhanAvetau vinAnyonyaM na sidhyataH
shlokas.35:
utpAdya putrAnanRRiNA.nshcha kRRitvA; vRRittiM cha tebhyo.anuvidhAya kA~nchit |
sthAne kumArIH pratipAdya sarvA; araNyasa.nstho munivadbubhUShet
shlokas.36:
hitaM yatsarvabhUtAnAmAtmanashcha sukhAvaham |
tatkuryAdIshvaro hyetanmUlaM dharmArthasiddhaye
shlokas.37:
buddhiH prabhAvastejashcha sattvamutthAnameva cha |
vyavasAyashcha yasya syAttasyAvRRittibhayaM kutaH
shlokas.38:
pashya doShAnpANDavairvigrahe tvaM; yatra vyatherannapi devAH sashakrAH |
putrairvairaM nityamudvignavAso; yashaHpraNAsho dviShatAM cha harShaH
shlokas.39:
bhIShmasya kopastava chendrakalpa; droNasya rAj~nashcha yudhiShThirasya |
utsAdayellokamimaM pravRRiddhaH; shveto grahastiryagivApatankhe
shlokas.40:
tava putrashataM chaiva karNaH pa~ncha cha pANDavAH |
pRRithivImanushAseyurakhilAM sAgarAmbarAm
shlokas.41:
dhArtarAShTrA vanaM rAjanvyAghrAH pANDusutA matAH |
mA vanaM Chindhi savyAghraM mA vyAghrAnnInasho vanAt
shlokas.42:
na syAdvanamRRite vyAghrAnvyAghrA na syurRRite vanam |
vanaM hi rakShyate vyAghrairvyAghrAnrakShati kAnanam
shlokas.43:
na tathechChantyakalyANAH pareShAM vedituM guNAn |
yathaiShAM j~nAtumichChanti nairguNyaM pApachetasaH
shlokas.44:
arthasiddhiM parAmichChandharmamevAditashcharet |
na hi dharmAdapaityarthaH svargalokAdivAmRRitam
shlokas.45:
yasyAtmA virataH pApAtkalyANe cha niveshitaH |
tena sarvamidaM buddhaM prakRRitirvikRRitishcha yA
shlokas.46:
yo dharmamarthaM kAmaM cha yathAkAlaM niShevate |
dharmArthakAmasa.nyogaM so.amutreha cha vindati
shlokas.47:
saMniyachChati yo vegamutthitaM krodhaharShayoH |
sa shriyo bhAjanaM rAjanyashchApatsu na muhyati
shlokas.48:
balaM pa~nchavidhaM nityaM puruShANAM nibodha me |
yattu bAhubalaM nAma kaniShThaM balamuchyate
shlokas.49:
amAtyalAbho bhadraM te dvitIyaM balamuchyate |
dhanalAbhastRRitIyaM tu balamAhurjigIShavaH
shlokas.50:
yattvasya sahajaM rAjanpitRRipaitAmahaM balam |
abhijAtabalaM nAma tachchaturthaM balaM smRRitam
shlokas.51:
yena tvetAni sarvANi sa~NgRRihItAni bhArata |
yadbalAnAM balaM shreShThaM tatpraj~nAbalamuchyate
shlokas.52:
mahate yo.apakArAya narasya prabhavennaraH |
tena vairaM samAsajya dUrastho.asmIti nAshvaset
shlokas.53:
