strIShu rAjasu sarpeShu svAdhyAye shatruseviShu |
bhoge chAyuShi vishvAsaM kaH prAj~naH kartumarhati
shlokas.54:
praj~nAshareNAbhihatasya janto;shchikitsakAH santi na chauShadhAni |
na homamantrA na cha ma~NgalAni; nAtharvaNA nApyagadAH susiddhAH
shlokas.55:
sarpashchAgnishcha siMhashcha kulaputrashcha bhArata |
nAvaj~neyA manuShyeNa sarve te hyatitejasaH
shlokas.56:
agnistejo mahalloke gUDhastiShThati dAruShu |
na chopayu~Nkte taddAru yAvanno dIpyate paraiH
shlokas.57:
sa eva khalu dArubhyo yadA nirmathya dIpyate |
tadA tachcha vanaM chAnyannirdahatyAshu tejasA
shlokas.58:
evameva kule jAtAH pAvakopamatejasaH |
kShamAvanto nirAkArAH kAShThe.agniriva sherate
shlokas.59:
latAdharmA tvaM saputraH shAlAH pANDusutA matAH |
na latA vardhate jAtu mahAdrumamanAshritA
shlokas.60:
vanaM rAja.nstvaM saputro.ambikeya; siMhAnvane pANDavA.nstAta viddhi |
siMhairvihInaM hi vanaM vinashye;tsiMhA vinashyeyurRRite vanena

shlokas.1:
vidura uvAcha||
UrdhvaM prANA hyutkrAmanti yUnaH sthavira Ayati |
pratyutthAnAbhivAdAbhyAM punastAnpratipadyate
shlokas.2:
pIThaM dattvA sAdhave.abhyAgatAya; AnIyApaH parinirNijya pAdau |
sukhaM pRRiShTvA prativedyAtmasa.nsthaM; tato dadyAdannamavekShya dhIraH
shlokas.3:
yasyodakaM madhuparkaM cha gAM cha; namantravitpratigRRihNAti gehe |
lobhAdbhayAdarthakArpaNyato vA; tasyAnarthaM jIvitamAhurAryAH
shlokas.4:
chikitsakaH shalyakartAvakIrNI; stenaH krUro madyapo bhrUNahA cha |
senAjIvI shrutivikrAyakashcha; bhRRishaM priyo.apyatithirnodakArhaH
shlokas.5:
avikreyaM lavaNaM pakvamannaM; dadhi kShIraM madhu tailaM ghRRitaM cha |
tilA mA.nsaM mUlaphalAni shAkaM; raktaM vAsaH sarvagandhA guDashcha
shlokas.6:
aroShaNo yaH samaloShTakA~nchanaH; prahINashoko gatasandhivigrahaH |
nindAprasha.nsoparataH priyApriye; charannudAsInavadeSha bhikShukaH
shlokas.7:
nIvAramUle~NgudashAkavRRittiH; susa.nyatAtmAgnikAryeShvachodyaH |
vane vasannatithiShvapramatto; dhurandharaH puNyakRRideSha tApasaH
shlokas.8:
apakRRitvA buddhimato dUrastho.asmIti nAshvaset |
dIrghau buddhimato bAhU yAbhyAM hi.nsati hi.nsitaH
shlokas.9:
na vishvasedavishvaste vishvaste nAtivishvaset |
vishvAsAdbhayamutpannaM mUlAnyapi nikRRintati
shlokas.10:
anIrShyurguptadAraH syAtsa.nvibhAgI priya.nvadaH |
shlakShNo madhuravAkstrINAM na chAsAM vashago bhavet
shlokas.11:
pUjanIyA mahAbhAgAH puNyAshcha gRRihadIptayaH |
striyaH shriyo gRRihasyoktAstasmAdrakShyA visheShataH
shlokas.12:
piturantaHpuraM dadyAnmAturdadyAnmahAnasam |
goShu chAtmasamaM dadyAtsvayameva kRRiShiM vrajet
bhRRityairvaNijyAchAraM cha putraiH seveta brAhmaNAn
shlokas.13:
adbhyo.agnirbrahmataH kShatramashmano lohamutthitam |
teShAM sarvatragaM tejaH svAsu yoniShu shAmyati
shlokas.14:
nityaM santaH kule jAtAH pAvakopamatejasaH |
kShamAvanto nirAkArAH kAShThe.agniriva sherate
shlokas.15:
yasya mantraM na jAnanti bAhyAshchAbhyantarAshcha ye |
sa rAjA sarvatashchakShushchiramaishvaryamashnute
shlokas.16:
kariShyanna prabhASheta kRRitAnyeva cha darshayet |
dharmakAmArthakAryANi tathA mantro na bhidyate
shlokas.17:
giripRRiShThamupAruhya prAsAdaM vA rahogataH |
araNye niHshalAke vA tatra mantro vidhIyate
shlokas.18:
nAsuhRRitparamaM mantraM bhAratArhati veditum |
apaNDito vApi suhRRitpaNDito vApyanAtmavAn
amAtye hyarthalipsA cha mantrarakShaNameva cha
shlokas.19:
kRRitAni sarvakAryANi yasya vA pArShadA viduH |
gUDhamantrasya nRRipatestasya siddhirasa.nshayam
shlokas.20:
aprashastAni karmANi yo mohAdanutiShThati |
sa teShAM viparibhra.nshe bhrashyate jIvitAdapi
shlokas.21:
karmaNAM tu prashastAnAmanuShThAnaM sukhAvaham |
teShAmevAnanuShThAnaM pashchAttApakaraM mahat
shlokas.22:
sthAnavRRiddhikShayaj~nasya ShADguNyaviditAtmanaH |
anavaj~nAtashIlasya svAdhInA pRRithivI nRRipa
shlokas.23:
amoghakrodhaharShasya svayaM kRRityAnvavekShiNaH |
Atmapratyayakoshasya vasudheyaM vasundharA
shlokas.24:
nAmamAtreNa tuShyeta ChatreNa cha mahIpatiH |
bhRRityebhyo visRRijedarthAnnaikaH sarvaharo bhavet
shlokas.25:
brAhmaNo brAhmaNaM veda bhartA veda striyaM tathA |
amAtyaM nRRipatirveda rAjA rAjAnameva cha
shlokas.26:
na shatrura~NkamApanno moktavyo vadhyatAM gataH |
ahatAddhi bhayaM tasmAjjAyate nachirAdiva
shlokas.27:
daivateShu cha yatnena rAjasu brAhmaNeShu cha |
niyantavyaH sadA krodho vRRiddhabAlAtureShu cha
shlokas.28:
nirarthaM kalahaM prAj~no varjayenmUDhasevitam |
kIrtiM cha labhate loke na chAnarthena yujyate
shlokas.29:
prasAdo niShphalo yasya krodhashchApi nirarthakaH |
na taM bhartAramichChanti ShaNDhaM patimiva striyaH
shlokas.30:
na buddhirdhanalAbhAya na jADyamasamRRiddhaye |
lokaparyAyavRRittAntaM prAj~no jAnAti netaraH
shlokas.31:
vidyAshIlavayovRRiddhAnbuddhivRRiddhA.nshcha bhArata |
dhanAbhijanavRRiddhA.nshcha nityaM mUDho.avamanyate
shlokas.32:
anAryavRRittamaprAj~namasUyakamadhArmikam |
anarthAH kShipramAyAnti vAgduShTaM krodhanaM tathA
shlokas.33:
avisa.nvAdanaM dAnaM samayasyAvyatikramaH |
Avartayanti bhUtAni samyakpraNihitA cha vAk
shlokas.34:
avisa.nvAdako dakShaH kRRitaj~no matimAnRRijuH |
api sa~NkShINakosho.api labhate parivAraNam
shlokas.35:
dhRRitiH shamo damaH shauchaM kAruNyaM vAganiShThurA |
mitrANAM chAnabhidrohaH saptaitAH samidhaH shriyaH
shlokas.36:
asa.nvibhAgI duShTAtmA kRRitaghno nirapatrapaH |
tAdRRi~NnarAdhamo loke varjanIyo narAdhipa
shlokas.37:
na sa rAtrau sukhaM shete sasarpa iva veshmani |
yaH kopayati nirdoShaM sadoSho.abhyantaraM janam
shlokas.38:
yeShu duShTeShu doShaH syAdyogakShemasya bhArata |
sadA prasAdanaM teShAM devatAnAmivAcharet
shlokas.39:
ye.arthAH strIShu samAsaktAH prathamotpatiteShu cha |
ye chAnAryasamAsaktAH sarve te sa.nshayaM gatAH
shlokas.40:
yatra strI yatra kitavo yatra bAlo.anushAsti cha |
majjanti te.avashA deshA nadyAmashmaplavA iva
shlokas.41:
prayojaneShu ye saktA na visheSheShu bhArata |
tAnahaM paNDitAnmanye visheShA hi prasa~NginaH
shlokas.42:
yaM prasha.nsanti kitavA yaM prasha.nsanti chAraNAH |
yaM prasha.nsanti bandhakyo na sa jIvati mAnavaH
shlokas.43:
hitvA tAnparameShvAsAnpANDavAnamitaujasaH |
AhitaM bhArataishvaryaM tvayA duryodhane mahat
shlokas.44:
taM drakShyasi paribhraShTaM tasmAttvaM nachirAdiva |
aishvaryamadasaMmUDhaM baliM lokatrayAdiva

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
anIshvaro.ayaM puruSho bhavAbhave; sUtraprotA dArumayIva yoShA |
dhAtrA tu diShTasya vashe kilAyaM; tasmAdvada tvaM shravaNe dhRRito.aham
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
aprAptakAlaM vachanaM bRRihaspatirapi bruvan |
labhate buddhyavaj~nAnamavamAnaM cha bhArata
shlokas.3:
priyo bhavati dAnena priyavAdena chAparaH |
mantraM mUlabalenAnyo yaH priyaH priya eva saH
shlokas.4:
dveShyo na sAdhurbhavati na medhAvI na paNDitaH |
priye shubhAni karmANi dveShye pApAni bhArata
shlokas.5:
na sa kShayo mahArAja yaH kShayo vRRiddhimAvahet |
kShayaH sa tviha mantavyo yaM labdhvA bahu nAshayet
shlokas.6:
samRRiddhA guNataH kechidbhavanti dhanato.apare |
dhanavRRiddhAnguNairhInAndhRRitarAShTra vivarjayet
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sarvaM tvamAyatIyuktaM bhAShase prAj~nasaMmatam |
na chotsahe sutaM tyaktuM yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.8:
vidura uvAcha||
svabhAvaguNasampanno na jAtu vinayAnvitaH |
susUkShmamapi bhUtAnAmupamardaM prayokShyate
shlokas.9:
parApavAdaniratAH paraduHkhodayeShu cha |
parasparavirodhe cha yatante satatotthitAH
shlokas.10:
sadoShaM darshanaM yeShAM sa.nvAse sumahadbhayam |
arthAdAne mahAndoShaH pradAne cha mahadbhayam
shlokas.11:
ye pApA iti vikhyAtAH sa.nvAse parigarhitAH |
yuktAshchAnyairmahAdoShairye narAstAnvivarjayet
shlokas.12:
nivartamAne sauhArde prItirnIche praNashyati |
yA chaiva phalanirvRRittiH sauhRRide chaiva yatsukham
shlokas.13:
yatate chApavAdAya yatnamArabhate kShaye |
alpe.apyapakRRite mohAnna shAntimupagachChati
shlokas.14:
tAdRRishaiH sa~NgataM nIchairnRRisha.nsairakRRitAtmabhiH |
nishAmya nipuNaM buddhyA vidvAndUrAdvivarjayet
shlokas.15:
yo j~nAtimanugRRihNAti daridraM dInamAturam |
sa putrapashubhirvRRiddhiM yashashchAvyayamashnute
shlokas.16:
j~nAtayo vardhanIyAstairya ichChantyAtmanaH shubham |
kulavRRiddhiM cha rAjendra tasmAtsAdhu samAchara
shlokas.17:
shreyasA yokShyase rAjankurvANo j~nAtisatkriyAm |
viguNA hyapi sa.nrakShyA j~nAtayo bharatarShabha
shlokas.18:
kiM punarguNavantaste tvatprasAdAbhikA~NkShiNaH |
prasAdaM kuru dInAnAM pANDavAnAM vishAM pate
shlokas.19:
dIyantAM grAmakAH kechitteShAM vRRittyarthamIshvara |
evaM loke yashaHprApto bhaviShyasi narAdhipa
shlokas.20:
vRRiddhena hi tvayA kAryaM putrANAM tAta rakShaNam |
mayA chApi hitaM vAchyaM viddhi mAM tvaddhitaiShiNam
shlokas.21:
j~nAtibhirvigrahastAta na kartavyo bhavArthinA |
sukhAni saha bhojyAni j~nAtibhirbharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
sambhojanaM sa~NkathanaM samprItishcha parasparam |
j~nAtibhiH saha kAryANi na virodhaH katha~nchana
shlokas.23:
j~nAtayastArayantIha j~nAtayo majjayanti cha |
suvRRittAstArayantIha durvRRittA majjayanti cha
shlokas.24:
suvRRitto bhava rAjendra pANDavAnprati mAnada |
adharShaNIyaH shatrUNAM tairvRRitastvaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.25:
shrImantaM j~nAtimAsAdya yo j~nAtiravasIdati |
digdhahastaM mRRiga iva sa enastasya vindati
shlokas.26:
pashchAdapi narashreShTha tava tApo bhaviShyati |
tAnvA hatAnsutAnvApi shrutvA tadanuchintaya
shlokas.27:
yena khaTvAM samArUDhaH paritapyeta karmaNA |
AdAveva na tatkuryAdadhruve jIvite sati
shlokas.28:
na kashchinnApanayate pumAnanyatra bhArgavAt |
sheShasampratipattistu buddhimatsveva tiShThati
shlokas.29:
duryodhanena yadyetatpApaM teShu purA kRRitam |
tvayA tatkulavRRiddhena pratyAneyaM nareshvara
shlokas.30:
tA.nstvaM pade pratiShThApya loke vigatakalmaShaH |
bhaviShyasi narashreShTha pUjanIyo manIShiNAm
shlokas.31:
suvyAhRRitAni dhIrANAM phalataH pravichintya yaH |
adhyavasyati kAryeShu chiraM yashasi tiShThati
shlokas.32:
avRRittiM vinayo hanti hantyanarthaM parAkramaH |
hanti nityaM kShamA krodhamAchAro hantyalakShaNam
shlokas.33:
parichChadena kShetreNa veshmanA paricharyayA |
parIkSheta kulaM rAjanbhojanAchChAdanena cha
shlokas.34:
yayoshchittena vA chittaM naibhRRitaM naibhRRitena vA |
sameti praj~nayA praj~nA tayormaitrI na jIryate
shlokas.35:
durbuddhimakRRitapraj~naM ChannaM kUpaM tRRiNairiva |
vivarjayIta medhAvI tasminmaitrI praNashyati
shlokas.36:
avalipteShu mUrkheShu raudrasAhasikeShu cha |
tathaivApetadharmeShu na maitrImAcharedbudhaH
shlokas.37:
kRRitaj~naM dhArmikaM satyamakShudraM dRRiDhabhaktikam |
jitendriyaM sthitaM sthityAM mitramatyAgi cheShyate
shlokas.38:
indriyANAmanutsargo mRRityunA na vishiShyate |
atyarthaM punarutsargaH sAdayeddaivatAnyapi
shlokas.39:
mArdavaM sarvabhUtAnAmanasUyA kShamA dhRRitiH |
AyuShyANi budhAH prAhurmitrANAM chAvimAnanA
shlokas.40:
apanItaM sunItena yo.arthaM pratyAninIShate |
matimAsthAya sudRRiDhAM tadakApuruShavratam
shlokas.41:
AyatyAM pratikAraj~nastadAtve dRRiDhanishchayaH |
atIte kAryasheShaj~no naro.arthairna prahIyate
shlokas.42:
karmaNA manasA vAchA yadabhIkShNaM niShevate |
tadevApaharatyenaM tasmAtkalyANamAcharet
shlokas.43:
ma~NgalAlambhanaM yogaH shrutamutthAnamArjavam |
bhUtimetAni kurvanti satAM chAbhIkShNadarshanam
shlokas.44:
anirvedaH shriyo mUlaM duHkhanAshe sukhasya cha |
mahAnbhavatyanirviNNaH sukhaM chAtyantamashnute
shlokas.45:
nAtaH shrImattaraM ki~nchidanyatpathyatamaM tathA |
prabhaviShNoryathA tAta kShamA sarvatra sarvadA
shlokas.46:
kShamedashaktaH sarvasya shaktimAndharmakAraNAt |
arthAnarthau samau yasya tasya nityaM kShamA hitA
shlokas.47:
yatsukhaM sevamAno.api dharmArthAbhyAM na hIyate |
kAmaM tadupaseveta na mUDhavratamAcharet
shlokas.48:
duHkhArteShu pramatteShu nAstikeShvalaseShu cha |
na shrIrvasatyadAnteShu ye chotsAhavivarjitAH
shlokas.49:
Arjavena naraM yuktamArjavAtsavyapatrapam |
ashaktimantaM manyanto dharShayanti kubuddhayaH
shlokas.50:
atyAryamatidAtAramatishUramativratam |
praj~nAbhimAninaM chaiva shrIrbhayAnnopasarpati
shlokas.51:
agnihotraphalA vedAH shIlavRRittaphalaM shrutam |
ratiputraphalA dArA dattabhuktaphalaM dhanam
shlokas.52:
adharmopArjitairarthairyaH karotyaurdhvadehikam |
na sa tasya phalaM pretya bhu~Nkte.arthasya durAgamAt
shlokas.53:
kAntAravanadurgeShu kRRichChrAsvApatsu sambhrame |
udyateShu cha shastreShu nAsti sheShavatAM bhayam
shlokas.54:
utthAnaM sa.nyamo dAkShyamapramAdo dhRRitiH smRRitiH |
samIkShya cha samArambho viddhi mUlaM bhavasya tat
shlokas.55:
tapo balaM tApasAnAM brahma brahmavidAM balam |
hi.nsA balamasAdhUnAM kShamA guNavatAM balam
shlokas.56:
aShTau tAnyavrataghnAni Apo mUlaM phalaM payaH |
havirbrAhmaNakAmyA cha gurorvachanamauShadham
shlokas.57:
na tatparasya sa.ndadhyAtpratikUlaM yadAtmanaH |
sa~NgraheNaiSha dharmaH syAtkAmAdanyaH pravartate
shlokas.58:
akrodhena jayetkrodhamasAdhuM sAdhunA jayet |
jayetkadaryaM dAnena jayetsatyena chAnRRitam
shlokas.59:
strIdhUrtake.alase bhIrau chaNDe puruShamAnini |
chaure kRRitaghne vishvAso na kAryo na cha nAstike
shlokas.60:
abhivAdanashIlasya nityaM vRRiddhopasevinaH |
chatvAri sampravardhante kIrtirAyuryashobalam
shlokas.61:
atikleshena ye.arthAH syurdharmasyAtikrameNa cha |
arervA praNipAtena mA sma teShu manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.62:
avidyaH puruShaH shochyaH shochyaM mithunamaprajam |
nirAhArAH prajAH shochyAH shochyaM rAShTramarAjakam
shlokas.63:
adhvA jarA dehavatAM parvatAnAM jalaM jarA |
asambhogo jarA strINAM vAkShalyaM manaso jarA
shlokas.64:
anAmnAyamalA vedA brAhmaNasyAvrataM malam |
kautUhalamalA sAdhvI vipravAsamalAH striyaH
shlokas.65:
suvarNasya malaM rUpyaM rUpyasyApi malaM trapu |
j~neyaM trapumalaM sIsaM sIsasyApi malaM malam
shlokas.66:
na svapnena jayennidrAM na kAmena striyaM jayet |
nendhanena jayedagniM na pAnena surAM jayet
shlokas.67:
yasya dAnajitaM mitramamitrA yudhi nirjitAH |
annapAnajitA dArAH saphalaM tasya jIvitam
shlokas.68:
sahasriNo.api jIvanti jIvanti shatinastathA |
dhRRitarAShTraM vimu~nchechChAM na katha~nchinna jIvyate
shlokas.69:
yatpRRithivyAM vrIhiyavaM hiraNyaM pashavaH striyaH |
nAlamekasya tatsarvamiti pashyanna muhyati
shlokas.70:
rAjanbhUyo bravImi tvAM putreShu samamAchara |
samatA yadi te rAjansveShu pANDusuteShu cha

shlokas.1:
vidura uvAcha||
yo.abhyarthitaH sadbhirasajjamAnaH; karotyarthaM shaktimahApayitvA |
kShipraM yashastaM samupaiti santamalaM; prasannA hi sukhAya santaH
shlokas.2:
mahAntamapyarthamadharmayuktaM; yaH santyajatyanupAkruShTa eva |
sukhaM sa duHkhAnyavamuchya shete; jIrNAM tvachaM sarpa ivAvamuchya
shlokas.3:
anRRitaM cha samutkarShe rAjagAmi cha paishunam |
guroshchAlIkanirbandhaH samAni brahmahatyayA
shlokas.4:
asUyaikapadaM mRRityurativAdaH shriyo vadhaH |
ashushrUShA tvarA shlAghA vidyAyAH shatravastrayaH
shlokas.5:
sukhArthinaH kuto vidyA nAsti vidyArthinaH sukham |
sukhArthI vA tyajedvidyAM vidyArthI vA sukhaM tyajet
shlokas.6:
nAgnistRRipyati kAShThAnAM nApagAnAM mahodadhiH |
nAntakaH sarvabhUtAnAM na pu.nsAM vAmalochanA
shlokas.7:
AshA dhRRitiM hanti samRRiddhimantakaH; krodhaH shriyaM hanti yashaH kadaryatA |
apAlanaM hanti pashU.nshcha rAja;nnekaH kruddho brAhmaNo hanti rAShTram
shlokas.8:
ajashcha kA.nsyaM cha rathashcha nityaM; madhvAkarShaH shakuniH shrotriyashcha |
vRRiddho j~nAtiravasanno vayasya; etAni te santu gRRihe sadaiva
shlokas.9:
ajokShA chandanaM vINA Adarsho madhusarpiShI |
viShamaudumbaraM sha~NkhaH svarNaM nAbhishcha rochanA
shlokas.10:
gRRihe sthApayitavyAni dhanyAni manurabravIt |
devabrAhmaNapUjArthamatithInAM cha bhArata
shlokas.11:
idaM cha tvAM sarvaparaM bravImi; puNyaM padaM tAta mahAvishiShTam |
na jAtu kAmAnna bhayAnna lobhA;ddharmaM tyajejjIvitasyApi hetoH
shlokas.12:
nityo dharmaH sukhaduHkhe tvanitye; nityo jIvo dhAturasya tvanityaH |
tyaktvAnityaM pratitiShThasva nitye; santuShya tvaM toShaparo hi lAbhaH
shlokas.13:
mahAbalAnpashya mahAnubhAvA;nprashAsya bhUmiM dhanadhAnyapUrNAm |
rAjyAni hitvA vipulA.nshcha bhogA;ngatAnnarendrAnvashamantakasya
shlokas.14:
mRRitaM putraM duHkhapuShTaM manuShyA; utkShipya rAjansvagRRihAnnirharanti |
taM muktakeshAH karuNaM rudanta;shchitAmadhye kAShThamiva kShipanti
shlokas.15:
anyo dhanaM pretagatasya bhu~Nkte; vayA.nsi chAgnishcha sharIradhAtUn |
dvAbhyAmayaM saha gachChatyamutra; puNyena pApena cha veShTyamAnaH
shlokas.16:
utsRRijya vinivartante j~nAtayaH suhRRidaH sutAH |
agnau prAstaM tu puruShaM karmAnveti svaya~NkRRitam
shlokas.17:
asmAllokAdUrdhvamamuShya chAdho; mahattamastiShThati hyandhakAram |
tadvai mahAmohanamindriyANAM; budhyasva mA tvAM pralabheta rAjan
shlokas.18:
idaM vachaH shakShyasi chedyathAva;nnishamya sarvaM pratipattumevam |
yashaH paraM prApsyasi jIvaloke; bhayaM na chAmutra na cheha te.asti
shlokas.19:
AtmA nadI bhArata puNyatIrthA; satyodakA dhRRitikUlA damormiH |
tasyAM snAtaH pUyate puNyakarmA; puNyo hyAtmA nityamambho.ambha eva
shlokas.20:
kAmakrodhagrAhavatIM pa~nchendriyajalAM nadIm |
kRRitvA dhRRitimayIM nAvaM janmadurgANi santara
shlokas.21:
praj~nAvRRiddhaM dharmavRRiddhaM svabandhuM; vidyAvRRiddhaM vayasA chApi vRRiddham |
kAryAkArye pUjayitvA prasAdya; yaH sampRRichChenna sa muhyetkadAchit
shlokas.22:
dhRRityA shishnodaraM rakShetpANipAdaM cha chakShuShA |
chakShuHshrotre cha manasA mano vAchaM cha karmaNA
shlokas.23:
nityodakI nityayaj~nopavItI; nityasvAdhyAyI patitAnnavarjI |
RRitaM bruvangurave karma kurva;nna brAhmaNashchyavate brahmalokAt
shlokas.24:
adhItya vedAnparisa.nstIrya chAgnI;niShTvA yaj~naiH pAlayitvA prajAshcha |
gobrAhmaNArthe shastrapUtAntarAtmA; hataH sa~NgrAme kShatriyaH svargameti
shlokas.25:
vaishyo.adhItya brAhmaNAnkShatriyA.nshcha; dhanaiH kAle sa.nvibhajyAshritA.nshcha |
tretApUtaM dhUmamAghrAya puNyaM; pretya svarge devasukhAni bhu~Nkte
shlokas.26:
brahmakShatraM vaishyavarNaM cha shUdraH; krameNaitAnnyAyataH pUjayAnaH |
tuShTeShveteShvavyatho dagdhapApa;styaktvA dehaM svargasukhAni bhu~Nkte
shlokas.27:
chAturvarNyasyaiSha dharmastavokto; hetuM chAtra bruvato me nibodha |
kShAtrAddharmAddhIyate pANDuputra;staM tvaM rAjanrAjadharme niyu~NkShva
shlokas.28:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
evametadyathA mAM tvamanushAsasi nityadA |
mamApi cha matiH saumya bhavatyevaM yathAttha mAm
shlokas.29:
sA tu buddhiH kRRitApyevaM pANDavAnprati me sadA |
duryodhanaM samAsAdya punarviparivartate
shlokas.30:
na diShTamabhyatikrAntuM shakyaM martyena kenachit |
diShTameva kRRitaM manye pauruShaM tu nirarthakam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
anuktaM yadi te ki~nchidvAchA vidura vidyate |
tanme shushrUShave brUhi vichitrANi hi bhAShase
shlokas.2:
vidura uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTra kumAro vai yaH purANaH sanAtanaH |
sanatsujAtaH provAcha mRRityurnAstIti bhArata
shlokas.3:
sa te guhyAnprakAshA.nshcha sarvAnhRRidayasa.nshrayAn |
pravakShyati mahArAja sarvabuddhimatAM varaH
shlokas.4:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kiM tvaM na veda tadbhUyo yanme brUyAtsanAtanaH |
tvameva vidura brUhi praj~nAsheSho.asti chettava
shlokas.5:
vidura uvAcha||
shUdrayonAvahaM jAto nAto.anyadvaktumutsahe |
kumArasya tu yA buddhirveda tAM shAshvatImaham
shlokas.6:
brAhmIM hi yonimApannaH suguhyamapi yo vadet |
na tena garhyo devAnAM tasmAdetadbravImi te
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bravIhi vidura tvaM me purANaM taM sanAtanam |
kathametena dehena syAdihaiva samAgamaH
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
chintayAmAsa vidurastamRRiShiM sa.nshitavratam |
sa cha tachchintitaM j~nAtvA darshayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.9:
sa chainaM pratijagrAha vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA |
sukhopaviShTaM vishrAntamathainaM viduro.abravIt
shlokas.10:
bhagavansa.nshayaH kashchiddhRRitarAShTrasya mAnase |
yo na shakyo mayA vaktuM tamasmai vaktumarhasi
yaM shrutvAyaM manuShyendraH sukhaduHkhAtigo bhavet
shlokas.11:
lAbhAlAbhau priyadveShyau yathainaM na jarAntakau |
viShaheranbhayAmarShau kShutpipAse madodbhavau
aratishchaiva tandrI cha kAmakrodhau kShayodayau

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAjA dhRRitarAShTro manIShI; sampUjya vAkyaM vidureritaM tat |
sanatsujAtaM rahite mahAtmA; paprachCha buddhiM paramAM bubhUShan
shlokas.2:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sanatsujAta yadIdaM shRRiNomi; mRRityurhi nAstIti tavopadesham |
devAsurA hyAcharanbrahmacharya;mamRRityave tatkatarannu satyam
shlokas.3:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
amRRityuH karmaNA kechinmRRityurnAstIti chApare |
shRRiNu me bruvato rAjanyathaitanmA visha~NkithAH
shlokas.4:
ubhe satye kShatriyAdyapravRRitte; moho mRRityuH saMmato yaH kavInAm |
pramAdaM vai mRRityumahaM bravImi; sadApramAdamamRRitatvaM bravImi
shlokas.5:
pramAdAdvai asurAH parAbhava;nnapramAdAdbrahmabhUtA bhavanti |
na vai mRRityurvyAghra ivAtti jantU;nna hyasya rUpamupalabhyate ha
shlokas.6:
yamaM tveke mRRityumato.anyamAhu;rAtmAvasannamamRRitaM brahmacharyam |
pitRRiloke rAjyamanushAsti devaH; shivaH shivAnAmashivo.ashivAnAm
shlokas.7:
AsyAdeSha niHsarate narANAM; krodhaH pramAdo moharUpashcha mRRityuH |
te mohitAstadvashe vartamAnA; itaH pretAstatra punaH patanti
shlokas.8:
tatastaM devA anu viplavante; ato mRRityurmaraNAkhyAmupaiti |
karmodaye karmaphalAnurAgA;statrAnu yAnti na taranti mRRityum
shlokas.9:
yo.abhidhyAyannutpatiShNUnnihanyA;danAdareNApratibudhyamAnaH |
sa vai mRRityurmRRityurivAtti bhUtvA; evaM vidvAnyo vinihanti kAmAn
shlokas.10:
kAmAnusArI puruShaH kAmAnanu vinashyati |
kAmAnvyudasya dhunute yatki~nchitpuruSho rajaH
shlokas.11:
tamo.aprakAsho bhUtAnAM narako.ayaM pradRRishyate |
gRRihyanta iva dhAvanti gachChantaH shvabhramunmukhAH
shlokas.12:
abhidhyA vai prathamaM hanti chainaM; kAmakrodhau gRRihya chainaM tu pashchAt |
ete bAlAnmRRityave prApayanti; dhIrAstu dhairyeNa taranti mRRityum
shlokas.13:
amanyamAnaH kShatriya ki~nchidanya;nnAdhIyate tArNa ivAsya vyAghraH |
krodhAllobhAnmohamayAntarAtmA; sa vai mRRityustvachCharIre ya eShaH
shlokas.14:
evaM mRRityuM jAyamAnaM viditvA; j~nAne tiShThanna bibhetIha mRRityoH |
vinashyate viShaye tasya mRRityu;rmRRityoryathA viShayaM prApya martyaH
shlokas.15:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ye.asmindharmAnnAcharantIha ke chi;ttathA dharmAnkechidihAcharanti |
dharmaH pApena pratihanyate sma; utAho dharmaH pratihanti pApam
shlokas.16:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
ubhayameva tatropabhujyate phalaM; dharmasyaivetarasya cha |
dharmeNAdharmaM praNudatIha vidvA;ndharmo balIyAniti tasya viddhi
shlokas.17:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yAnimAnAhuH svasya dharmasya lokA;ndvijAtInAM puNyakRRitAM sanAtanAn |
teShAM parikramAnkathayantastato.anyA;nnaitadvidvannaiva kRRitaM cha karma
shlokas.18:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
yeShAM bale na vispardhA bale balavatAmiva |
te brAhmaNA itaH pretya svargaloke prakAshate
shlokas.19:
yatra manyeta bhUyiShThaM prAvRRiShIva tRRiNolapam |
annaM pAnaM cha brAhmaNastajjIvannAnusa~njvaret
shlokas.20:
yatrAkathayamAnasya prayachChatyashivaM bhayam |
atiriktamivAkurvansa shreyAnnetaro janaH
shlokas.21:
yo vAkathayamAnasya AtmAnaM nAnusa~njvaret |
brahmasvaM nopabhu~njedvA tadannaM saMmataM satAm
shlokas.22:
yathA svaM vAntamashnAti shvA vai nityamabhUtaye |
evaM te vAntamashnanti svavIryasyopajIvanAt
shlokas.23:
nityamaj~nAtacharyA me iti manyeta brAhmaNaH |
j~nAtInAM tu vasanmadhye naiva vidyeta ki~nchana
shlokas.24:
ko hyevamantarAtmAnaM brAhmaNo hantumarhati |
tasmAddhi ki~nchitkShatriya brahmAvasati pashyati
shlokas.25:
ashrAntaH syAdanAdAnAtsaMmato nirupadravaH |
shiShTo na shiShTavatsa syAdbrAhmaNo brahmavitkaviH
shlokas.26:
anADhyA mAnuShe vitte ADhyA vedeShu ye dvijAH |
te durdharShA duShprakampyA vidyAttAnbrahmaNastanum
shlokas.27:
sarvAnsviShTakRRito devAnvidyAdya iha kashchana |
na samAno brAhmaNasya yasminprayatate svayam
shlokas.28:
yamaprayatamAnaM tu mAnayanti sa mAnitaH |
na mAnyamAno manyeta nAmAnAdabhisa~njvaret
shlokas.29:
vidvA.nso mAnayantIha iti manyeta mAnitaH |
adharmaviduSho mUDhA lokashAstravishAradAH
na mAnyaM mAnayiShyanti iti manyedamAnitaH
shlokas.30:
na vai mAnaM cha maunaM cha sahitau charataH sadA |
ayaM hi loko mAnasya asau mAnasya tadviduH
shlokas.31:
shrIH sukhasyeha sa.nvAsaH sA chApi paripanthinI |
brAhmI sudurlabhA shrIrhi praj~nAhInena kShatriya
shlokas.32:
dvArANi tasyA hi vadanti santo; bahuprakArANi durAvarANi |
satyArjave hrIrdamashauchavidyAH; ShaNmAnamohapratibAdhanAni

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
RRicho yajUMShyadhIte yaH sAmavedaM cha yo dvijaH |
pApAni kurvanpApena lipyate na sa lipyate
shlokas.2:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
nainaM sAmAnyRRicho vApi na yajUMShi vichakShaNa |
trAyante karmaNaH pApAnna te mithyA bravImyaham
shlokas.3:
na ChandA.nsi vRRijinAttArayanti; mAyAvinaM mAyayA vartamAnam |
nIDaM shakuntA iva jAtapakShA;shChandA.nsyenaM prajahatyantakAle
shlokas.4:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
na chedvedA vedavidaM shaktAstrAtuM vichakShaNa |
atha kasmAtpralApo.ayaM brAhmaNAnAM sanAtanaH
shlokas.5:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
asmi.Nlloke tapastaptaM phalamanyatra dRRishyate |
brAhmaNAnAmime lokA RRiddhe tapasi sa.nyatAH
shlokas.6:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM samRRiddhamapyRRiddhaM tapo bhavati kevalam |
sanatsujAta tadbrUhi yathA vidyAma tadvayam
shlokas.7:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
krodhAdayo dvAdasha yasya doShA;stathA nRRisha.nsAdi ShaDatra rAjan |
dharmAdayo dvAdasha chAtatAnAH; shAstre guNA ye viditA dvijAnAm
shlokas.8:
krodhaH kAmo lobhamohau vivitsA;kRRipAsUyA mAnashokau spRRihA cha |
IrShyA jugupsA cha manuShyadoShA; varjyAH sadA dvAdashaite nareNa
shlokas.9:
ekaikamete rAjendra manuShyAnparyupAsate |
lipsamAno.antaraM teShAM mRRigANAmiva lubdhakaH
shlokas.10:
vikatthanaH spRRihayAlurmanasvI; bibhratkopaM chapalo.arakShaNashcha |
ete prAptAH ShaNnarAnpApadharmA;nprakurvate nota santaH sudurge
shlokas.11:
sambhogasa.nviddviShamedhamAno; dattAnutApI kRRipaNo.abalIyAn |
vargaprasha.nsI vanitAsu dveShTA; ete.apare sapta nRRisha.nsadharmAH
shlokas.12:
dharmashcha satyaM cha damastapashcha; amAtsaryaM hrIstitikShAnasUyA |
yaj~nashcha dAnaM cha dhRRitiH shrutaM cha; mahAvratA dvAdasha brAhmaNasya
shlokas.13:
yastvetebhyaH pravaseddvAdashebhyaH; sarvAmapImAM pRRithivIM prashiShyAt |
tribhirdvAbhyAmekato vA vishiShTo; nAsya svamastIti sa veditavyaH
shlokas.14:
damastyAgo.apramAdashcha eteShvamRRitamAhitam |
tAni satyamukhAnyAhurbrAhmaNA ye manIShiNaH
shlokas.15:
damo.aShTAdashadoShaH syAtpratikUlaM kRRitAkRRite |
anRRitaM chAbhyasUyA cha kAmArthau cha tathA spRRihA
shlokas.16:
krodhaH shokastathA tRRiShNA lobhaH paishunyameva cha |
matsarashcha vivitsA cha paritApastathA ratiH
shlokas.17:
apasmAraH sAtivAdastathA sambhAvanAtmani |
etairvimukto doShairyaH sa damaH sadbhiruchyate
shlokas.18:
shreyA.nstu ShaDvidhastyAgaH priyaM prApya na hRRiShyati |
apriye tu samutpanne vyathAM jAtu na chArchChati
shlokas.19:
iShTAndArA.nshcha putrA.nshcha na chAnyaM yadvacho bhavet |
arhate yAchamAnAya pradeyaM tadvacho bhavet
apyavAchyaM vadatyeva sa tRRitIyo guNaH smRRitaH
shlokas.20:
tyaktairdravyairyo bhavati nopayu~Nkte cha kAmataH |
na cha karmasu taddhInaH shiShyabuddhirnaro yathA
sarvaireva guNairyukto dravyavAnapi yo bhavet
shlokas.21:
apramAdo.aShTadoShaH syAttAndoShAnparivarjayet |
indriyebhyashcha pa~nchabhyo manasashchaiva bhArata
atItAnAgatebhyashcha mukto hyetaiH sukhI bhavet
shlokas.22:
doShairetairvimuktaM tu guNairetaiH samanvitam |
etatsamRRiddhamapyRRiddhaM tapo bhavati kevalam
yanmAM pRRichChasi rAjendra kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi
shlokas.23:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
AkhyAnapa~nchamairvedairbhUyiShThaM kathyate janaH |
tathaivAnye chaturvedAstrivedAshcha tathApare
shlokas.24:
dvivedAshchaikavedAshcha anRRichashcha tathApare |
teShAM tu katamaH sa syAdyamahaM veda brAhmaNam
shlokas.25:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
ekasya vedasyAj~nAnAdvedAste bahavo.abhavan |
satyasyaikasya rAjendra satye kashchidavasthitaH
evaM vedamanutsAdya praj~nAM mahati kurvate
shlokas.26:
dAnamadhyayanaM yaj~no lobhAdetatpravartate |
satyAtprachyavamAnAnAM sa~Nkalpo vitatho bhavet
shlokas.27:
tato yaj~naH pratAyeta satyasyaivAvadhAraNAt |
manasAnyasya bhavati vAchAnyasyota karmaNA
sa~NkalpasiddhaH puruShaH sa~NkalpAnadhitiShThati
shlokas.28:
anaibhRRityena vai tasya dIkShitavratamAcharet |
nAmaitaddhAtunirvRRittaM satyameva satAM param
j~nAnaM vai nAma pratyakShaM parokShaM jAyate tapaH
shlokas.29:
vidyAdbahu paThantaM tu bahupAThIti brAhmaNam |
tasmAtkShatriya mA ma.nsthA jalpitenaiva brAhmaNam
ya eva satyAnnApaiti sa j~neyo brAhmaNastvayA
shlokas.30:
ChandA.nsi nAma kShatriya tAnyatharvA; jagau purastAdRRiShisarga eShaH |
Chandovidaste ya u tAnadhItya; na vedyavedasya vidurna vedyam
shlokas.31:
na vedAnAM veditA kashchidasti; kashchidvedAnbudhyate vApi rAjan |
yo veda vedAnna sa veda vedyaM; satye sthito yastu sa veda vedyam
shlokas.32:
abhijAnAmi brAhmaNamAkhyAtAraM vichakShaNam |
yashChinnavichikitsaH sannAchaShTe sarvasa.nshayAn
shlokas.33:
tasya paryeShaNaM gachChetprAchInaM nota dakShiNam |
nArvAchInaM kutastirya~NnAdishaM tu katha~nchana
shlokas.34:
tUShNImbhUta upAsIta na cheShTenmanasA api |
abhyAvarteta brahmAsya antarAtmani vai shritam
shlokas.35:
maunAddhi sa munirbhavati nAraNyavasanAnmuniH |
akSharaM tattu yo veda sa muniH shreShTha uchyate
shlokas.36:
sarvArthAnAM vyAkaraNAdvaiyAkaraNa uchyate |
pratyakShadarshI lokAnAM sarvadarshI bhavennaraH
shlokas.37:
satye vai brAhmaNastiShThanbrahma pashyati kShatriya |
vedAnAM chAnupUrvyeNa etadvidvanbravImi te

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sanatsujAta yadimAM parArthAM; brAhmIM vAchaM pravadasi vishvarUpAm |
parAM hi kAmeShu sudurlabhAM kathAM; tadbrUhi me vAkyametatkumAra
shlokas.2:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
naitadbrahma tvaramANena labhyaM; yanmAM pRRichChasyabhihRRiShyasyatIva |
avyaktavidyAmabhidhAsye purANIM; buddhyA cha teShAM brahmacharyeNa siddhAm
shlokas.3:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
avyaktavidyAmiti yatsanAtanIM; bravIShi tvaM brahmacharyeNa siddhAm |
anArabhyA vasatIhArya kAle; kathaM brAhmaNyamamRRitatvaM labheta
shlokas.4:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
ye.asmi.Nlloke vijayantIha kAmA;nbrAhmIM sthitimanutitikShamANAH |
ta AtmAnaM nirharantIha dehA;nmu~njAdiShIkAmiva sattvasa.nsthAH
shlokas.5:
sharIrametau kurutaH pitA mAtA cha bhArata |
AchAryashAstA yA jAtiH sA satyA sAjarAmarA
shlokas.6:
AchAryayonimiha ye pravishya; bhUtvA garbhaM brahmacharyaM charanti |
ihaiva te shAstrakArA bhavanti; prahAya dehaM paramaM yAnti yogam
shlokas.7:
ya AvRRiNotyavitathena karNA;vRRitaM kurvannamRRitaM samprayachChan |
taM manyeta pitaraM mAtaraM cha; tasmai na druhyetkRRitamasya jAnan
shlokas.8:
guruM shiShyo nityamabhimanyamAnaH; svAdhyAyamichChechChuchirapramattaH |
mAnaM na kuryAnna dadhIta roSha;meSha prathamo brahmacharyasya pAdaH
shlokas.9:
AchAryasya priyaM kuryAtprANairapi dhanairapi |
karmaNA manasA vAchA dvitIyaH pAda uchyate
shlokas.10:
samA gurau yathA vRRittirgurupatnyAM tathA bhavet |
yathoktakArI priyakRRittRRitIyaH pAda uchyate
shlokas.11:
nAchAryAyehopakRRitvA pravAdaM; prAj~naH kurvIta naitadahaM karomi |
itIva manyeta na bhAShayeta; sa vai chaturtho brahmacharyasya pAdaH
shlokas.12:
evaM vasantaM yadupaplaveddhana;mAchAryAya tadanuprayachChet |
satAM vRRittiM bahuguNAmevameti; guroH putre bhavati cha vRRittireShA
shlokas.13:
evaM vasansarvato vardhatIha; bahUnputrA.Nllabhate cha pratiShThAm |
varShanti chAsmai pradisho dishashcha; vasantyasminbrahmacharye janAshcha
shlokas.14:
etena brahmacharyeNa devA devatvamApnuvan |
RRiShayashcha mahAbhAgA brahmalokaM manIShiNaH
shlokas.15:
gandharvANAmanenaiva rUpamapsarasAmabhUt |
etena brahmacharyeNa sUryo ahnAya jAyate
shlokas.16:
ya AshayetpATayechchApi rAja;nsarvaM sharIraM tapasA tapyamAnaH |
etenAsau bAlyamatyeti vidvA;nmRRityuM tathA rodhayatyantakAle
shlokas.17:
antavantaH kShatriya te jayanti; lokA~njanAH karmaNA nirmitena |
brahmaiva vidvA.nstena abhyeti sarvaM; nAnyaH panthA ayanAya vidyate
shlokas.18:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
AbhAti shuklamiva lohitamiva; atho kRRiShNamathA~njanaM kAdravaM vA |
tadbrAhmaNaH pashyati yo.atra vidvA;nkatha.nrUpaM tadamRRitamakSharaM padam
shlokas.19:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
nAbhAti shuklamiva lohitamiva; atho kRRiShNamAyasamarkavarNam |
na pRRithivyAM tiShThati nAntarikShe; naitatsamudre salilaM bibharti
shlokas.20:
na tArakAsu na cha vidyudAshritaM; na chAbhreShu dRRishyate rUpamasya |
na chApi vAyau na cha devatAsu; na tachchandre dRRishyate nota sUrye
shlokas.21:
naivarkShu tanna yajuHShu nApyatharvasu; na chaiva dRRishyatyamaleShu sAmasu |
rathantare bArhate chApi rAja;nmahAvrate naiva dRRishyeddhruvaM tat
shlokas.22:
apAraNIyaM tamasaH parastA;ttadantako.apyeti vinAshakAle |
aNIyarUpaM kShuradhArayA ta;nmahachcha rUpaM tvapi parvatebhyaH
shlokas.23:
sA pratiShThA tadamRRitaM lokAstadbrahma tadyashaH |
bhUtAni jaj~nire tasmAtpralayaM yAnti tatra cha
shlokas.24:
anAmayaM tanmahadudyataM yasho; vAcho vikArAnkavayo vadanti |
tasmi~njagatsarvamidaM pratiShThitaM; ye tadviduramRRitAste bhavanti

shlokas.1:
sanatsujAta uvAcha||
yattachChukraM mahajjyotirdIpyamAnaM mahadyashaH |
tadvai devA upAsante yasmAdarko virAjate
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.2:
shukrAdbrahma prabhavati brahma shukreNa vardhate |
tachChukraM jyotiShAM madhye.ataptaM tapati tApanam
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.3:
Apo.atha adbhyaH salilasya madhye; ubhau devau shishriyAte.antarikShe |
sa sadhrIchIH sa viShUchIrvasAnA; ubhe bibharti pRRithivIM divaM cha
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.4:
ubhau cha devau pRRithivIM divaM cha; dishashcha shukraM bhuvanaM bibharti |
tasmAddishaH saritashcha sravanti; tasmAtsamudrA vihitA mahAntaH
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.5:
chakre rathasya tiShThantaM dhruvasyAvyayakarmaNaH |
ketumantaM vahantyashvAstaM divyamajaraM divi
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.6:
na sAdRRishye tiShThati rUpamasya; na chakShuShA pashyati kashchidenam |
manIShayAtho manasA hRRidA cha; ya evaM viduramRRitAste bhavanti
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.7:
dvAdashapUgAM saritaM devarakShitam |
madhu IshantastadA sa~ncharanti ghoram
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.8:
tadardhamAsaM pibati sa~nchitya bhramaro madhu |
IshAnaH sarvabhUteShu havirbhUtamakalpayat
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.9:
hiraNyaparNamashvatthamabhipatya apakShakAH |
te tatra pakShiNo bhUtvA prapatanti yathAdisham
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.10:
pUrNAtpUrNAnyuddharanti pUrNAtpUrNAni chakrire |
haranti pUrNAtpUrNAni pUrNamevAvashiShyate
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.11:
tasmAdvai vAyurAyAtastasmi.nshcha prayataH sadA |
tasmAdagnishcha somashcha tasmi.nshcha prANa AtataH
shlokas.12:
sarvameva tato vidyAttattadvaktuM na shaknumaH |
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.13:
apAnaM girati prANaH prANaM girati chandramAH |
Adityo girate chandramAdityaM girate paraH
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.14:
ekaM pAdaM notkShipati salilAddha.nsa uchcharan |
taM chetsatatamRRitvijaM na mRRityurnAmRRitaM bhavet
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.15:
evaM devo mahAtmA sa pAvakaM puruSho giran |
yo vai taM puruShaM veda tasyehAtmA na riShyate
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.16:
yaH sahasraM sahasrANAM pakShAnsantatya sampatet |
madhyame madhya AgachChedapi chetsyAnmanojavaH
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.17:
na darshane tiShThati rUpamasya; pashyanti chainaM suvishuddhasattvAH |
hito manIShI manasAbhipashye;dye taM shrayeyuramRRitAste bhavanti
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.18:
gUhanti sarpA iva gahvarANi; svashikShayA svena vRRittena martyAH |
teShu pramuhyanti janA vimUDhA; yathAdhvAnaM mohayante bhayAya
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.19:
sadA sadAsatkRRitaH syAnna mRRityuramRRitaM kutaH |
satyAnRRite satyasamAnabandhane; satashcha yonirasatashchaika eva
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.20:
na sAdhunA nota asAdhunA vA; samAnametaddRRishyate mAnuSheShu |
samAnametadamRRitasya vidyA;deva.nyukto madhu tadvai parIpset
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.21:
nAsyAtivAdA hRRidayaM tApayanti; nAnadhItaM nAhutamagnihotram |
mano brAhmIM laghutAmAdadhIta; praj~nAnamasya nAma dhIrA labhante
yoginastaM prapashyanti bhagavantaM sanAtanam
shlokas.22:
evaM yaH sarvabhUteShu AtmAnamanupashyati |
anyatrAnyatra yukteShu kiM sa shochettataH param
shlokas.23:
yathodapAne mahati sarvataH samplutodake |
evaM sarveShu vedeShu brAhmaNasya vijAnataH
shlokas.24:
a~NguShThamAtraH puruSho mahAtmA; na dRRishyate.asau hRRidaye niviShTaH |
ajashcharo divArAtramatandritashcha; sa taM matvA kavirAste prasannaH
shlokas.25:
ahamevAsmi vo mAtA pitA putro.asmyahaM punaH |
AtmAhamapi sarvasya yachcha nAsti yadasti cha
shlokas.26:
pitAmaho.asmi sthaviraH pitA putrashcha bhArata |
mamaiva yUyamAtmasthA na me yUyaM na vo.apyaham
shlokas.28:
Atmaiva sthAnaM mama janma chAtmA; vedaprokto.ahamajarapratiShThaH |
aNoraNIyAnsumanAH sarvabhUteShu jAgRRimi |
pitaraM sarvabhUtAnAM puShkare nihitaM viduH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sanatsujAtena vidureNa cha dhImatA |
sArdhaM kathayato rAj~naH sA vyatIyAya sharvarI
shlokas.2:
tasyAM rajanyAM vyuShTAyAM rAjAnaH sarva eva te |
sabhAmAvivishurhRRiShTAH sUtasyopadidRRikShayA
shlokas.3:
shushrUShamANAH pArthAnAM vacho dharmArthasaMhitam |
dhRRitarAShTramukhAH sarve yayU rAjasabhAM shubhAm
shlokas.4:
sudhAvadAtAM vistIrNAM kanakAjirabhUShitAm |
chandraprabhAM suruchirAM siktAM paramavAriNA
shlokas.5:
ruchirairAsanaiH stIrNAM kA~nchanairdAravairapi |
ashmasAramayairdAntaiH svAstIrNaiH sottarachChadaiH
shlokas.6:
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipaH shalyaH kRRitavarmA jayadrathaH |
ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha somadattashcha bAhlikaH
shlokas.7:
vidurashcha mahAprAj~no yuyutsushcha mahArathaH |
sarve cha sahitAH shUrAH pArthivA bharatarShabha
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya vivishustAM sabhAM shubhAm
shlokas.8:
duHshAsanashchitrasenaH shakunishchApi saubalaH |
durmukho duHsahaH karNa ulUko.atha vivi.nshatiH
shlokas.9:
kururAjaM puraskRRitya duryodhanamamarShaNam |
vivishustAM sabhAM rAjansurAH shakrasado yathA
shlokas.10:
AvishadbhistadA rAja~nshUraiH parighabAhubhiH |
shushubhe sA sabhA rAjansiMhairiva girerguhA
shlokas.11:
te pravishya maheShvAsAH sabhAM samitishobhanAH |
AsanAni mahArhANi bhejire sUryavarchasaH
shlokas.12:
AsanastheShu sarveShu teShu rAjasu bhArata |
dvAHstho nivedayAmAsa sUtaputramupasthitam
shlokas.13:
ayaM sa ratha AyAti yo.ayAsItpANDavAnprati |
dUto nastUrNamAyAtaH saindhavaiH sAdhuvAhibhiH
shlokas.14:
upayAya tu sa kShipraM rathAtpraskandya kuNDalI |
pravivesha sabhAM pUrNAM mahIpAlairmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.15:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prApto.asmi pANDavAngatvA tadvijAnIta kauravAH |
yathAvayaH kurUnsarvAnpratinandanti pANDavAH
shlokas.16:
abhivAdayanti vRRiddhA.nshcha vayasyA.nshcha vayasyavat |
yUnashchAbhyavadanpArthAH pratipUjya yathAvayaH
shlokas.17:
yathAhaM dhRRitarAShTreNa shiShTaH pUrvamito gataH |
abruvaM pANDavAngatvA tannibodhata pArthivAH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
pRRichChAmi tvAM sa~njaya rAjamadhye; kimabravIdvAkyamadInasattvaH |
dhana~njayastAta yudhAM praNetA; durAtmanAM jIvitachChinmahAtmA
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duryodhano vAchamimAM shRRiNotu; yadabravIdarjuno yotsyamAnaH |
yudhiShThirasyAnumate mahAtmA; dhana~njayaH shRRiNvataH keshavasya
shlokas.3:
anvatrasto bAhuvIryaM vidAna; upahvare vAsudevasya dhIraH |
avochanmAM yotsyamAnaH kirITI; madhye brUyA dhArtarAShTraM kurUNAm
shlokas.4:
ye vai rAjAnaH pANDavAyodhanAya; samAnItAH shRRiNvatAM chApi teShAm |
yathA samagraM vachanaM mayoktaM; sahAmAtyaM shrAvayethA nRRipaM tam
shlokas.5:
yathA nUnaM devarAjasya devAH; shushrUShante vajrahastasya sarve |
tathAshRRiNvanpANDavAH sRRi~njayAshcha; kirITinA vAchamuktAM samarthAm
shlokas.6:
ityabravIdarjuno yotsyamAno; gANDIvadhanvA lohitapadmanetraH |
na chedrAjyaM mu~nchati dhArtarAShTro; yudhiShThirasyAjamIDhasya rAj~naH
asti nUnaM karma kRRitaM purastA;danirviShTaM pApakaM dhArtarAShTraiH
shlokas.7:
yeShAM yuddhaM bhImasenArjunAbhyAM; tathAshvibhyAM vAsudevena chaiva |
shaineyena dhruvamAttAyudhena; dhRRiShTadyumnenAtha shikhaNDinA cha
yudhiShThireNendrakalpena chaiva; yo.apadhyAnAnnirdahedgAM divaM cha
shlokas.8:
taishchedyuddhaM manyate dhArtarAShTro; nirvRRitto.arthaH sakalaH pANDavAnAm |
mA tatkArShIH pANDavArthAya heto;rupaihi yuddhaM yadi manyase tvam
shlokas.9:
yAM tAM vane duHkhashayyAmuvAsa; pravrAjitaH pANDavo dharmachArI |
AshiShyate duHkhatarAmanarthA;mantyAM shayyAM dhArtarAShTraH parAsuH
shlokas.10:
hriyA j~nAnena tapasA damena; krodhenAtho dharmaguptyA dhanena |
anyAyavRRittaH kurupANDaveyA;nadhyAtiShThaddhArtarAShTro durAtmA
shlokas.11:
mAyopadhaH praNidhAnArjavAbhyAM; tapodamAbhyAM dharmaguptyA balena |
satyaM bruvanprItiyuktyAnRRitena; titikShamANaH klishyamAno.ativelam
shlokas.12:
yadA jyeShThaH pANDavaH sa.nshitAtmA; krodhaM yattaM varShapUgAnsughoram |
avasraShTA kuruShUdvRRittachetA;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.13:
kRRiShNavartmeva jvalitaH samiddho; yathA dahetkakShamagnirnidAghe |
evaM dagdhA dhArtarAShTrasya senAM; yudhiShThiraH krodhadIpto.anuvIkShya
shlokas.14:
yadA draShTA bhImasenaM raNasthaM; gadAhastaM krodhaviShaM vamantam |
durmarShaNaM pANDavaM bhImavegaM; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.15:
mahAsiMho gAva iva pravishya; gadApANirdhArtarAShTrAnupetya |
yadA bhImo bhImarUpo nihantA; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.16:
mahAbhaye vItabhayaH kRRitAstraH; samAgame shatrubalAvamardI |
sakRRidrathena pratiyAdrathaughA;npadAtisa~NghAngadayAbhinighnan
shlokas.17:
sainyAnanekA.nstarasA vimRRidna;nyadA kSheptA dhArtarAShTrasya sainyam |
ChindanvanaM parashuneva shUra;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.18:
tRRiNaprAyaM jvalaneneva dagdhaM; grAmaM yathA dhArtarAShTraH samIkShya |
pakvaM sasyaM vaidyuteneva dagdhaM; parAsiktaM vipulaM svaM balaugham
shlokas.19:
hatapravIraM vimukhaM bhayArtaM; parA~NmukhaM prAyasho.adhRRiShTayodham |
shastrArchiShA bhImasenena dagdhaM; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.20:
upAsa~NgAduddharandakShiNena; paraHshatAnnakulashchitrayodhI |
yadA rathAgryo rathinaH prachetA; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.21:
sukhochito duHkhashayyAM vaneShu; dIrghaM kAlaM nakulo yAmasheta |
AshIviShaH kruddha iva shvasanbhRRishaM; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.22:
tyaktAtmAnaH pArthivAyodhanAya; samAdiShTA dharmarAjena vIrAH |
rathaiH shubhraiH sainyamabhidravanto; dRRiShTvA pashchAttapsyate dhArtarAShTraH
shlokas.23:
shishUnkRRitAstrAnashishuprakAshA;nyadA draShTA kauravaH pa~ncha shUrAn |
tyaktvA prANAnkekayAnAdravanta;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.24:
yadA gatodvAhamakUjanAkShaM; suvarNatAraM rathamAtatAyI |
dAntairyuktaM sahadevo.adhirUDhaH; shirA.nsi rAj~nAM kShepsyate mArgaNaughaiH
shlokas.25:
mahAbhaye sampravRRitte rathasthaM; vivartamAnaM samare kRRitAstram |
sarvAM dishaM sampatantaM samIkShya; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.26:
hrIniShedho nipuNaH satyavAdI; mahAbalaH sarvadharmopapannaH |
gAndhArimArchCha.nstumule kShiprakArI; kSheptA janAnsahadevastarasvI
shlokas.27:
yadA draShTA draupadeyAnmaheShU;~nshUrAnkRRitAstrAnrathayuddhakovidAn |
AshIviShAnghoraviShAnivAyata;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.28:
yadAbhimanyuH paravIraghAtI; sharaiH parAnmegha ivAbhivarShan |
vigAhitA kRRiShNasamaH kRRitAstra;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.29:
yadA draShTA bAlamabAlavIryaM; dviShachchamUM mRRityumivApatantam |
saubhadramindrapratimaM kRRitAstraM; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.30:
prabhadrakAH shIghratarA yuvAno; vishAradAH siMhasamAnavIryAH |
yadA kSheptAro dhArtarAShTrAnsasainyAM;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.31:
vRRiddhau virATadrupadau mahArathau; pRRithakchamUbhyAmabhivartamAnau |
yadA draShTArau dhArtarAShTrAnsasainyAM;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.32:
yadA kRRitAstro drupadaH prachinva;~nshirA.nsi yUnAM samare rathasthaH |
kruddhaH sharaishChetsyati chApamuktai;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.33:
yadA virATaH paravIraghAtI; marmAntare shatruchamUM praveShTA |
matsyaiH sArdhamanRRisha.nsarUpai;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.34:
jyeShThaM mAtsyAnAmanRRisha.nsarUpaM; virATaputraM rathinaM purastAt |
yadA draShTA da.nshitaM pANDavArthe; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.35:
raNe hate kauravANAM pravIre; shikhaNDinA sattame shantanUje |
na jAtu naH shatravo dhArayeyu;rasa.nshayaM satyametadbravImi
shlokas.36:
yadA shikhaNDI rathinaH prachinva;nbhIShmaM rathenAbhiyAtA varUthI |
divyairhayairavamRRidnanrathaughAM;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.37:
yadA draShTA sRRi~njayAnAmanIke; dhRRiShTadyumnaM pramukhe rochamAnam |
astraM yasmai guhyamuvAcha dhImA;ndroNastadA tapsyati dhArtarAShTraH
shlokas.38:
yadA sa senApatiraprameyaH; parAbhavanniShubhirdhArtarAShTrAn |
droNaM raNe shatrusaho.abhiyAtA; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.39:
hrImAnmanIShI balavAnmanasvI; sa lakShmIvAnsomakAnAM prabarhaH |
na jAtu taM shatravo.anye sahera;nyeShAM sa syAdagraNIrvRRiShNisiMhaH
shlokas.40:
brUyAchcha mA pravRRiNIShveti loke; yuddhe.advitIyaM sachivaM rathastham |
shinernaptAraM pravRRiNIma sAtyakiM; mahAbalaM vItabhayaM kRRitAstram
shlokas.41:
yadA shinInAmadhipo mayoktaH; sharaiH parAnmegha iva pravarShan |
prachChAdayiShya~nsharajAlena yodhAM;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.42:
yadA dhRRitiM kurute yotsyamAnaH; sa dIrghabAhurdRRiDhadhanvA mahAtmA |
siMhasyeva gandhamAghrAya gAvaH; sa.nveShTante shatravo.asmAdyathAgneH
shlokas.43:
sa dIrghabAhurdRRiDhadhanvA mahAtmA; bhindyAdgirInsaMharetsarvalokAn |
astre kRRitI nipuNaH kShiprahasto; divi sthitaH sUrya ivAbhibhAti
shlokas.44:
chitraH sUkShmaH sukRRito yAdavasya; astre yogo vRRiShNisiMhasya bhUyAn |
yathAvidhaM yogamAhuH prashastaM; sarvairguNaiH sAtyakistairupetaH
shlokas.45:
hiraNmayaM shvetahayaishchaturbhi;ryadA yuktaM syandanaM mAdhavasya |
draShTA yuddhe sAtyakervai suyodhana;stadA tapsyatyakRRitAtmA sa mandaH
shlokas.46:
yadA rathaM hemamaNiprakAshaM; shvetAshvayuktaM vAnaraketumugram |
draShTA raNe sa.nyataM keshavena; tadA tapsyatyakRRitAtmA sa mandaH
shlokas.47:
yadA maurvyAstalaniShpeShamugraM; mahAshabdaM vajraniShpeShatulyam |
vidhUyamAnasya mahAraNe mayA; gANDIvasya shroShyati mandabuddhiH
shlokas.48:
tadA mUDho dhRRitarAShTrasya putra;staptA yuddhe durmatirduHsahAyaH |
dRRiShTvA sainyaM bANavarShAndhakAraM; prabhajyantaM gokulavadraNAgre
shlokas.49:
balAhakAduchcharantIva vidyu;tsahasraghnI dviShatAM sa~NgameShu |
asthichChido marmabhido vamechCharAM;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.50:
yadA draShTA jyAmukhAdbANasa~NghA;ngANDIvamuktAnpatataH shitAgrAn |
nAgAnhayAnvarmiNashchAdadAnAM;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.51:
yadA mandaH parabANAnvimuktA;nmameShubhirhriyamANAnpratIpam |
tiryagvidvA.nshChidyamAnAnkShuraprai;stadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.52:
yadA vipAThA madbhujavipramuktA; dvijAH phalAnIva mahIruhAgrAt |
prachChettAra uttamA~NgAni yUnAM; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.53:
yadA draShTA patataH syandanebhyo; mahAgajebhyo.ashvagatA.nshcha yodhAn |
sharairhatAnpAtitA.nshchaiva ra~Nge; tadA yuddhaM dhArtarAShTro.anvatapsyat
shlokas.54:
padAtisa~NghAnrathasa~NghAnsamantA;dvyAttAnanaH kAla ivAtateShuH |
praNotsyAmi jvalitairbANavarShaiH; shatrU.nstadA tapsyati mandabuddhiH
shlokas.55:
sarvA dishaH sampatatA rathena; rajodhvastaM gANDivenApakRRittam |
yadA draShTA svabalaM sampramUDhaM; tadA pashchAttapsyati mandabuddhiH
shlokas.56:
kA.ndigbhUtaM ChinnagAtraM visa~nj~naM; duryodhano drakShyati sarvasainyam |
hatAshvavIrAgryanarendranAgaM; pipAsitaM shrAntapatraM bhayArtam
shlokas.57:
ArtasvaraM hanyamAnaM hataM cha; vikIrNakeshAsthikapAlasa~Ngham |
prajApateH karma yathArdhaniShThitaM; tadA dRRiShTvA tapsyate mandabuddhiH
shlokas.58:
yadA rathe gANDivaM vAsudevaM; divyaM sha~NkhaM pA~nchajanyaM hayA.nshcha |
tUNAvakShayyau devadattaM cha mAM cha; draShTA yuddhe dhArtarAShTraH sametAn
shlokas.60:
sahabhrAtA sahaputraH sasainyo; bhraShTaishvaryaH krodhavasho.alpachetAH |
darpasyAnte vihite vepamAnaH; pashchAnmandastapsyati dhArtarAShTraH
shlokas.61:
pUrvAhNe mAM kRRitajapyaM kadA chi;dvipraH provAchodakAnte manoj~nam |
kartavyaM te duShkaraM karma pArtha; yoddhavyaM te shatrubhiH savyasAchin
shlokas.62:
indro vA te harivAnvajrahastaH; purastAdyAtu samare.arInvinighnan |
sugrIvayuktena rathena vA te; pashchAtkRRiShNo rakShatu vAsudevaH
shlokas.63:
vavre chAhaM vajrahastAnmahendrA;dasminyuddhe vAsudevaM sahAyam |
sa me labdho dasyuvadhAya kRRiShNo; manye chaitadvihitaM daivatairme
shlokas.64:
ayudhyamAno manasApi yasya; jayaM kRRiShNaH puruShasyAbhinandet |
dhruvaM sarvAnso.abhyatIyAdamitrA;nsendrAndevAnmAnuShe nAsti chintA
shlokas.65:
sa bAhubhyAM sAgaramuttitIrShe;nmahodadhiM salilasyAprameyam |
tejasvinaM kRRiShNamatyantashUraM; yuddhena yo vAsudevaM jigIShet
shlokas.66:
giriM ya ichCheta talena bhettuM; shilochchayaM shvetamatipramANam |
tasyaiva pANiH sanakho vishIrye;nna chApi ki~nchitsa girestu kuryAt
shlokas.67:
agniM samiddhaM shamayedbhujAbhyAM; chandraM cha sUryaM cha nivArayeta |
hareddevAnAmamRRitaM prasahya; yuddhena yo vAsudevaM jigIShet
shlokas.68:
yo rukmiNImekarathena bhojyA;mutsAdya rAj~nAM viShayaM prasahya |
uvAha bhAryAM yashasA jvalantIM; yasyAM jaj~ne raukmiNeyo mahAtmA
shlokas.69:
ayaM gAndhArA.nstarasA sampramathya; jitvA putrAnnagnajitaH samagrAn |
baddhaM mumocha vinadantaM prasahya; sudarshanIyaM devatAnAM lalAmam
shlokas.70:
ayaM kavATe nijaghAna pANDyaM; tathA kali~NgAndantakUre mamarda |
anena dagdhA varShapUgAnvinAthA; vArANasI nagarI sambabhUva
shlokas.71:
yaM sma yuddhe manyate.anyairajeya;mekalavyaM nAma niShAdarAjam |
vegeneva shailamabhihatya jambhaH; shete sa kRRiShNena hataH parAsuH
shlokas.72:
tathograsenasya sutaM praduShTaM; vRRiShNyandhakAnAM madhyagAM tapantam |
apAtayadbaladevadvitIyo; hatvA dadau chograsenAya rAjyam
shlokas.73:
ayaM saubhaM yodhayAmAsa khasthaM; vibhIShaNaM mAyayA shAlvarAjam |
saubhadvAri pratyagRRihNAchChataghnIM; dorbhyAM ka enaM viShaheta martyaH
shlokas.74:
prAgjyotiShaM nAma babhUva durgaM; puraM ghoramasurANAmasahyam |
mahAbalo narakastatra bhaumo; jahArAdityA maNikuNDale shubhe
shlokas.75:
na taM devAH saha shakreNa sehire; samAgatA AharaNAya bhItAH |
dRRiShTvA cha te vikramaM keshavasya; balaM tathaivAstramavAraNIyam
shlokas.76:
jAnanto.asya prakRRitiM keshavasya; nyayojayandasyuvadhAya kRRiShNam |
sa tatkarma pratishushrAva duShkara;maishvaryavAnsiddhiShu vAsudevaH
shlokas.77:
nirmochane ShaTsahasrANi hatvA; sa~nChidya pAshAnsahasA kShurAntAn |
muraM hatvA vinihatyaugharAkShasaM; nirmochanaM chApi jagAma vIraH
shlokas.78:
tatraiva tenAsya babhUva yuddhaM; mahAbalenAtibalasya viShNoH |
shete sa kRRiShNena hataH parAsu;rvAteneva mathitaH karNikAraH
shlokas.79:
AhRRitya kRRiShNo maNikuNDale te; hatvA cha bhaumaM narakaM muraM cha |
shriyA vRRito yashasA chaiva dhImA;npratyAjagAmApratimaprabhAvaH
shlokas.80:
tasmai varAnadada.nstatra devA; dRRiShTvA bhImaM karma raNe kRRitaM tat |
shramashcha te yudhyamAnasya na syA;dAkAshe vA apsu chaiva kramaH syAt
shlokas.81:
shastrANi gAtre cha na te kramera;nnityeva kRRiShNashcha tataH kRRitArthaH |
eva.nrUpe vAsudeve.aprameye; mahAbale guNasampatsadaiva
shlokas.82:
tamasahyaM viShNumanantavIrya;mAsha.nsate dhArtarAShTro balena |
yadA hyenaM tarkayate durAtmA; tachchApyayaM sahate.asmAnsamIkShya
shlokas.83:
paryAgataM mama kRRiShNasya chaiva; yo manyate kalahaM samprayujya |
shakyaM hartuM pANDavAnAM mamatvaM; tadveditA sa.nyugaM tatra gatvA
shlokas.84:
namaskRRitvA shAntanavAya rAj~ne; droNAyAtho sahaputrAya chaiva |
shAradvatAyApratidvandvine cha; yotsyAmyahaM rAjyamabhIpsamAnaH
shlokas.85:
dharmeNAstraM niyataM tasya manye; yo yotsyate pANDavairdharmachArI |
mithyAglahe nirjitA vai nRRisha.nsaiH; sa.nvatsarAndvAdasha pANDuputrAH
shlokas.86:
avApya kRRichChraM vihitaM hyaraNye; dIrghaM kAlaM chaikamaj~nAtacharyAm |
te hyakasmAjjIvitaM pANDavAnAM; na mRRiShyante dhArtarAShTrAH padasthAH
shlokas.87:
te chedasmAnyudhyamAnA~njayeyu;rdevairapIndrapramukhaiH sahAyaiH |
dharmAdadharmashcharito garIyA;niti dhruvaM nAsti kRRitaM na sAdhu
shlokas.88:
na chedimaM puruShaM karmabaddhaM; na chedasmAnmanyate.asau vishiShTAn |
Asha.nse.ahaM vAsudevadvitIyo; duryodhanaM sAnubandhaM nihantum
shlokas.89:
na chedidaM karma nareShu baddhaM; na vidyate puruShasya svakarma |
idaM cha tachchApi samIkShya nUnaM; parAjayo dhArtarAShTrasya sAdhuH
shlokas.90:
pratyakShaM vaH kuravo yadbravImi; yudhyamAnA dhArtarAShTrA na santi |
anyatra yuddhAtkuravaH parIpsa;nna yudhyatAM sheSha ihAsti kashchit
shlokas.91:
hatvA tvahaM dhArtarAShTrAnsakarNA;nrAjyaM kurUNAmavajetA samagram |
yadvaH kAryaM tatkurudhvaM yathAsva;miShTAndArAnAtmajA.nshchopabhu~Nkta
shlokas.92:
apyevaM no brAhmaNAH santi vRRiddhA; bahushrutAH shIlavantaH kulInAH |
sA.nvatsarA jyotiShi chApi yuktA; nakShatrayogeShu cha nishchayaj~nAH
shlokas.93:
uchchAvachaM daivayuktaM rahasyaM; divyAH prashnA mRRigachakrA muhUrtAH |
kShayaM mahAntaM kurusRRi~njayAnAM; nivedayante pANDavAnAM jayaM cha
shlokas.94:
tathA hi no manyate.ajAtashatruH; sa.nsiddhArtho dviShatAM nigrahAya |
janArdanashchApyaparokShavidyo; na sa.nshayaM pashyati vRRiShNisiMhaH
shlokas.95:
ahaM cha jAnAmi bhaviShyarUpaM; pashyAmi buddhyA svayamapramattaH |
dRRiShTishcha me na vyathate purANI; yudhyamAnA dhArtarAShTrA na santi
shlokas.96:
anAlabdhaM jRRimbhati gANDivaM dhanu;ranAlabdhA kampati me dhanurjyA |
bANAshcha me tUNamukhAdvisRRijya; muhurmuhurgantumushanti chaiva
shlokas.97:
saikyaH koshAnniHsarati prasanno; hitveva jIrNAmuragastvachaM svAm |
dhvaje vAcho raudrarUpA vadanti; kadA ratho yokShyate te kirITin
shlokas.98:
gomAyusa~NghAshcha vadanti rAtrau; rakShA.nsyatho niShpatantyantarikShAt |
mRRigAH shRRigAlAH shitikaNThAshcha kAkA; gRRidhrA baDAshchaiva tarakShavashcha
shlokas.99:
suparNapAtAshcha patanti pashchA;ddRRiShTvA rathaM shvetahayaprayuktam |
ahaM hyekaH pArthivAnsarvayodhA;~nsharAnvarShanmRRityulokaM nayeyam
shlokas.100:
samAdadAnaH pRRithagastramArgA;nyathAgniriddho gahanaM nidAghe |
sthUNAkarNaM pAshupataM cha ghoraM; tathA brahmAstraM yachcha shakro viveda
shlokas.101:
vadhe dhRRito vegavataH pramu~ncha;nnAhaM prajAH ki~nchidivAvashiShye |
shAntiM lapsye paramo hyeSha bhAvaH; sthiro mama brUhi gAvalgaNe tAn
shlokas.102:
nityaM punaH sachivairyairavocha;ddevAnapIndrapramukhAnsahAyAn |
tairmanyate kalahaM samprayujya; sa dhArtarAShTraH pashyata mohamasya
shlokas.103:
vRRiddho bhIShmaH shAntanavaH kRRipashcha; droNaH saputro vidurashcha dhImAn |
ete sarve yadvadante tadastu; AyuShmantaH kuravaH santu sarve

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
samaveteShu sarveShu teShu rAjasu bhArata |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyaM bhIShmaH shAntanavo.abravIt
shlokas.2:
bRRihaspatishchoshanA cha brahmANaM paryupasthitau |
marutashcha sahendreNa vasavashcha sahAshvinau
shlokas.3:
AdityAshchaiva sAdhyAshcha ye cha saptarShayo divi |
vishvAvasushcha gandharvaH shubhAshchApsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.4:
namaskRRitvopajagmuste lokavRRiddhaM pitAmaham |
parivArya cha vishveshaM paryAsata divaukasaH
shlokas.5:
teShAM manashcha tejashchApyAdadAnau divaukasAm |
pUrvadevau vyatikrAntau naranArAyaNAvRRiShI
shlokas.6:
bRRihaspatishcha paprachCha brAhmaNaM kAvimAviti |
bhavantaM nopatiShThete tau naH sha.nsa pitAmaha
shlokas.7:
brahmovAcha||
yAvetau pRRithivIM dyAM cha bhAsayantau tapasvinau |
jvalantau rochamAnau cha vyApyAtItau mahAbalau
shlokas.8:
naranArAyaNAvetau lokAllokaM samAsthitau |
Urjitau svena tapasA mahAsattvaparAkramau
shlokas.9:
etau hi karmaNA lokAnnandayAmAsaturdhruvau |
asurANAmabhAvAya devagandharvapUjitau
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
jagAma shakrastachChrutvA yatra tau tepatustapaH |
sArdhaM devagaNaiH sarvairbRRihaspatipurogamaiH
shlokas.11:
tadA devAsure ghore bhaye jAte divaukasAm |
ayAchata mahAtmAnau naranArAyaNau varam
shlokas.12:
tAvabrUtAM vRRiNIShveti tadA bharatasattama |
athaitAvabravIchChakraH sAhyaM naH kriyatAmiti
shlokas.13:
tatastau shakramabrUtAM kariShyAvo yadichChasi |
tAbhyAM cha sahitaH shakro vijigye daityadAnavAn
shlokas.14:
nara indrasya sa~NgrAme hatvA shatrUnparantapaH |
paulomAnkAlakha~njA.nshcha sahasrANi shatAni cha
shlokas.15:
eSha bhrAnte rathe tiShThanbhallenApaharachChiraH |
jambhasya grasamAnasya yaj~namarjuna Ahave
shlokas.16:
eSha pAre samudrasya hiraNyapuramArujat |
hatvA ShaShTisahasrANi nivAtakavachAnraNe
shlokas.17:
eSha devAnsahendreNa jitvA parapura~njayaH |
atarpayanmahAbAhurarjuno jAtavedasam
nArAyaNastathaivAtra bhUyaso.anyA~njaghAna ha
shlokas.18:
evametau mahAvIryau tau pashyata samAgatau |
vAsudevArjunau vIrau samavetau mahArathau
shlokas.19:
naranArAyaNau devau pUrvadevAviti shrutiH |
ajeyau mAnuShe loke sendrairapi surAsuraiH
shlokas.20:
eSha nArAyaNaH kRRiShNaH phalgunastu naraH smRRitaH |
nArAyaNo narashchaiva sattvamekaM dvidhAkRRitam
shlokas.21:
etau hi karmaNA lokAnashnuvAte.akShayAndhruvAn |
tatra tatraiva jAyete yuddhakAle punaH punaH
shlokas.22:
tasmAtkarmaiva kartavyamiti hovAcha nAradaH |
etaddhi sarvamAchaShTa vRRiShNichakrasya vedavit
shlokas.23:
sha~NkhachakragadAhastaM yadA drakShyasi keshavam |
paryAdadAnaM chAstrANi bhImadhanvAnamarjunam
shlokas.24:
sanAtanau mahAtmAnau kRRiShNAvekarathe sthitau |
duryodhana tadA tAta smartAsi vachanaM mama
shlokas.25:
no chedayamabhAvaH syAtkurUNAM pratyupasthitaH |
arthAchcha tAta dharmAchcha tava buddhirupaplutA
shlokas.26:
na chedgrahIShyase vAkyaM shrotAsi subahUnhatAn |
tavaiva hi mataM sarve kuravaH paryupAsate
shlokas.27:
trayANAmeva cha mataM tattvameko.anumanyase |
rAmeNa chaiva shaptasya karNasya bharatarShabha
shlokas.28:
durjAteH sUtaputrasya shakuneH saubalasya cha |
tathA kShudrasya pApasya bhrAturduHshAsanasya cha
shlokas.29:
karNa uvAcha||
naivamAyuShmatA vAchyaM yanmAmAttha pitAmaha |
kShatradharme sthito hyasmi svadharmAdanapeyivAn
shlokas.30:
kiM chAnyanmayi durvRRittaM yena mAM parigarhase |
na hi me vRRijinaM ki~nchiddhArtarAShTrA viduH kvachit
shlokas.31:
rAj~no hi dhRRitarAShTrasya sarvaM kAryaM priyaM mayA |
tathA duryodhanasyApi sa hi rAjye samAhitaH
shlokas.32:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
karNasya tu vachaH shrutvA bhIShmaH shAntanavaH punaH |
dhRRitarAShTraM mahArAjamAbhAShyedaM vacho.abravIt
shlokas.33:
yadayaM katthate nityaM hantAhaM pANDavAniti |
nAyaM kalApi sampUrNA pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.34:
anayo yo.ayamAgantA putrANAM te durAtmanAm |
tadasya karma jAnIhi sUtaputrasya durmateH
shlokas.35:
enamAshritya putraste mandabuddhiH suyodhanaH |
avamanyata tAnvIrAndevaputrAnari.ndamAn
shlokas.36:
kiM chApyanena tatkarma kRRitaM pUrvaM suduShkaram |
tairyathA pANDavaiH sarvairekaikena kRRitaM purA
shlokas.37:
dRRiShTvA virATanagare bhrAtaraM nihataM priyam |
dhana~njayena vikramya kimanena tadA kRRitam
shlokas.38:
sahitAnhi kurUnsarvAnabhiyAto dhana~njayaH |
pramathya chAchChinadgAvaH kimayaM proShitastadA
shlokas.39:
gandharvairghoShayAtrAyAM hriyate yatsutastava |
kva tadA sUtaputro.abhUdya idAnIM vRRiShAyate
shlokas.40:
nanu tatrApi pArthena bhImena cha mahAtmanA |
yamAbhyAmeva chAgamya gandharvAste parAjitAH
shlokas.41:
etAnyasya mRRiShoktAni bahUni bharatarShabha |
vikatthanasya bhadraM te sadA dharmArthalopinaH
shlokas.42:
bhIShmasya tu vachaH shrutvA bhAradvAjo mahAmanAH |
dhRRitarAShTramuvAchedaM rAjamadhye.abhipUjayan
shlokas.43:
yadAha bharatashreShTho bhIShmastatkriyatAM nRRipa |
na kAmamarthalipsUnAM vachanaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.44:
purA yuddhAtsAdhu manye pANDavaiH saha sa~Ngamam |
yadvAkyamarjunenoktaM sa~njayena niveditam
shlokas.45:
sarvaM tadabhijAnAmi kariShyati cha pANDavaH |
na hyasya triShu lokeShu sadRRisho.asti dhanurdharaH
shlokas.46:
anAdRRitya tu tadvAkyamarthavaddroNabhIShmayoH |
tataH sa sa~njayaM rAjA paryapRRichChata pANDavam
shlokas.47:
tadaiva kuravaH sarve nirAshA jIvite.abhavan |
bhIShmadroNau yadA rAjA na samyaganubhAShate

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kimasau pANDavo rAjA dharmaputro.abhyabhAShata |
shrutvemA bahulAH senAH pratyarthena samAgatAH
shlokas.2:
kimichChatyabhisa.nrambhAdyotsyamAno yudhiShThiraH |
kasya svidbhrAtRRiputrANAM chintAsu mukhamIkShate
shlokas.3:
ke svidenaM vArayanti shAmya yudhyeti vA punaH |
nikRRityA kopitaM mandairdharmaj~naM dharmachAriNam
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAj~no mukhamudIkShante pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha |
yudhiShThirasya bhadraM te sa sarvAnanushAsti cha
shlokas.5:
pRRithagbhUtAH pANDavAnAM pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAH |
AyAntamabhinandanti kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.6:
tamaH sUryamivodyantaM kaunteyaM dIptatejasam |
pA~nchAlAH pratinandanti tejorAshimivodyatam
shlokas.7:
A gopAlAvipAlebhyo nandamAnaM yudhiShThiram |
pA~nchAlAH kekayA matsyAH pratinandanti pANDavam
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNyo rAjaputryashcha vishAM duhitarashcha yAH |
krIDantyo.abhisamAyAnti pArthaM saMnaddhamIkShitum
shlokas.9:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sa~njayAchakShva kenAsmAnpANDavA abhyayu~njata |
dhRRiShTadyumnena senAnyA somakAH kimbalA iva
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
gAvalgaNistu tatpRRiShTaH sabhAyAM kurusa.nsadi |
niHshvasya subhRRishaM dIrghaM muhuH sa~nchintayanniva
tatrAnimittato daivAtsUtaM kashmalamAvishat
shlokas.11:
tadAchachakShe puruShaH sabhAyAM rAjasa.nsadi |
sa~njayo.ayaM mahArAja mUrchChitaH patito bhuvi
vAchaM na sRRijate kA~nchiddhInapraj~no.alpachetanaH
shlokas.12:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
apashyatsa~njayo nUnaM kuntIputrAnmahArathAn |
tairasya puruShavyAghrairbhRRishamudvejitaM manaH
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa~njayashchetanAM labdhvA pratyAshvasyedamabravIt |
dhRRitarAShTraM mahArAja sabhAyAM kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTavAnasmi rAjendra kuntIputrAnmahArathAn |
matsyarAjagRRihAvAsAdavarodhena karshitAn
shRRiNu yairhi mahArAja pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.15:
yo naiva roShAnna bhayAnna kAmAnnArthakAraNAt |
na hetuvAdAddharmAtmA satyaM jahyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.16:
yaH pramANaM mahArAja dharme dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
ajAtashatruNA tena pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.17:
yasya bAhubale tulyaH pRRithivyAM nAsti kashchana |
yo vai sarvAnmahIpAlAnvashe chakre dhanurdharaH
tena vo bhImasenena pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.18:
niHsRRitAnAM jatugRRihAddhiDimbAtpuruShAdakAt |
ya eShAmabhavaddvIpaH kuntIputro vRRikodaraH
shlokas.19:
yAj~nasenImatho yatra sindhurAjo.apakRRiShTavAn |
tatraiShAmabhavaddvIpaH kuntIputro vRRikodaraH
shlokas.20:
yashcha tAnsa~NgatAnsarvAnpANDavAnvAraNAvate |
dahyato mochayAmAsa tena vaste.abhyayu~njata
shlokas.21:
kRRiShNAyAshcharatA prItiM yena krodhavashA hatAH |
pravishya viShamaM ghoraM parvataM gandhamAdanam
shlokas.22:
yasya nAgAyutaM vIryaM bhujayoH sAramarpitam |
tena vo bhImasenena pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.23:
kRRiShNadvitIyo vikramya tuShTyarthaM jAtavedasaH |
ajayadyaH purA vIro yudhyamAnaM pura.ndaram
shlokas.24:
yaH sa sAkShAnmahAdevaM girishaM shUlapANinam |
toShayAmAsa yuddhena devadevamumApatim
shlokas.25:
yashcha sarvAnvashe chakre lokapAlAndhanurdharaH |
tena vo vijayenAjau pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.26:
yaH pratIchIM dishaM chakre vashe mlechChagaNAyutAm |
sa tatra nakulo yoddhA chitrayodhI vyavasthitaH
shlokas.27:
tena vo darshanIyena vIreNAtidhanurbhRRitA |
mAdrIputreNa kauravya pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.28:
yaH kAshIna~NgamagadhAnkali~NgA.nshcha yudhAjayat |
tena vaH sahadevena pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.29:
yasya vIryeNa sadRRishAshchatvAro bhuvi mAnavAH |
ashvatthAmA dhRRiShTaketuH pradyumno rukmireva cha
shlokas.30:
tena vaH sahadevena pANDavA abhyayu~njata |
yavIyasA nRRivIreNa mAdrInandikareNa cha
shlokas.31:
tapashchachAra yA ghoraM kAshikanyA purA satI |
bhIShmasya vadhamichChantI pretyApi bharatarShabha
shlokas.32:
pA~nchAlasya sutA jaj~ne daivAchcha sa punaH pumAn |
strIpu.nsoH puruShavyAghra yaH sa veda guNAguNAn
shlokas.33:
yaH kali~NgAnsamApede pA~nchAlo yuddhadurmadaH |
shikhaNDinA vaH kuravaH kRRitAstreNAbhyayu~njata
shlokas.34:
yAM yakShaH puruShaM chakre bhIShmasya nidhane kila |
maheShvAsena raudreNa pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.35:
maheShvAsA rAjaputrA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha kekayAH |
sumRRiShTakavachAH shUrAstaishcha vaste.abhyayu~njata
shlokas.36:
yo dIrghabAhuH kShiprAstro dhRRitimAnsatyavikramaH |
tena vo vRRiShNivIreNa yuyudhAnena sa~NgaraH
shlokas.37:
ya AsIchCharaNaM kAle pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
raNe tena virATena pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.38:
yaH sa kAshipatI rAjA vArANasyAM mahArathaH |
sa teShAmabhavadyoddhA tena vaste.abhyayu~njata
shlokas.39:
shishubhirdurjayaiH sa~Nkhye draupadeyairmahAtmabhiH |
AshIviShasamasparshaiH pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.40:
yaH kRRiShNasadRRisho vIrye yudhiShThirasamo dame |
tenAbhimanyunA sa~Nkhye pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.41:
yashchaivApratimo vIrye dhRRiShTaketurmahAyashAH |
duHsahaH samare kruddhaH shaishupAlirmahArathaH
tena vashchedirAjena pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.42:
yaH sa.nshrayaH pANDavAnAM devAnAmiva vAsavaH |
tena vo vAsudevena pANDavA abhyayu~njata
shlokas.43:
tathA chedipaterbhrAtA sharabho bharatarShabha |
karakarSheNa sahitastAbhyAM vaste.abhyayu~njata
shlokas.44:
jArAsandhiH sahadevo jayatsenashcha tAvubhau |
drupadashcha mahAtejA balena mahatA vRRitaH
tyaktAtmA pANDavArthAya yotsyamAno vyavasthitaH
shlokas.45:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH prAchyodIchyA mahIkShitaH |
shatasho yAnapAshritya dharmarAjo vyavasthitaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sarva ete mahotsAhA ye tvayA parikIrtitAH |
ekatastveva te sarve sametA bhIma ekataH
shlokas.2:
bhImasenAddhi me bhUyo bhayaM sa~njAyate mahat |
kruddhAdamarShaNAttAta vyAghrAdiva mahAruroH
shlokas.3:
jAgarmi rAtrayaH sarvA dIrghamuShNaM cha niHshvasan |
bhIto vRRikodarAttAta siMhAtpashurivAbalaH
shlokas.4:
na hi tasya mahAbAhoH shakrapratimatejasaH |
sainye.asminpratipashyAmi ya enaM viShahedyudhi
shlokas.5:
amarShaNashcha kaunteyo dRRiDhavairashcha pANDavaH |
anarmahAsI sonmAdastiryakprekShI mahAsvanaH
shlokas.6:
mahAvego mahotsAho mahAbAhurmahAbalaH |
mandAnAM mama putrANAM yuddhenAntaM kariShyati
shlokas.7:
UrugrAhagRRihItAnAM gadAM bibhradvRRikodaraH |
kurUNAmRRiShabho yuddhe daNDapANirivAntakaH
shlokas.8:
shaikyAyasamayIM ghorAM gadAM kA~nchanabhUShitAm |
manasAhaM prapashyAmi brahmadaNDamivodyatam
shlokas.9:
yathA rurUNAM yUtheShu siMho jAtabalashcharet |
mAmakeShu tathA bhImo baleShu vichariShyati
shlokas.10:
sarveShAM mama putrANAM sa ekaH krUravikramaH |
bahvAshI vipratIpashcha bAlye.api rabhasaH sadA
shlokas.11:
udvepate me hRRidayaM yadA duryodhanAdayaH |
bAlye.api tena yudhyanto vAraNeneva marditAH
shlokas.12:
tasya vIryeNa sa~NkliShTA nityameva sutA mama |
sa eva heturbhedasya bhImo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.13:
grasamAnamanIkAni naravAraNavAjinAm |
pashyAmIvAgrato bhImaM krodhamUrChitamAhave
shlokas.14:
astre droNArjunasamaM vAyuvegasamaM jave |
sa~njayAchakShva me shUraM bhImasenamamarShaNam
shlokas.15:
atilAbhaM tu manye.ahaM yattena ripughAtinA |
tadaiva na hatAH sarve mama putrA manasvinA
shlokas.16:
yena bhImabalA yakShA rAkShasAshcha samAhatAH |
kathaM tasya raNe vegaM mAnuShaH prasahiShyati
shlokas.17:
na sa jAtu vashe tasthau mama bAlo.api sa~njaya |
kiM punarmama duShputraiH kliShTaH samprati pANDavaH
shlokas.18:
niShThuraH sa cha naiShThuryAdbhajyedapi na saMnamet |
tiryakprekShI saMhatabhrUH kathaM shAmyedvRRikodaraH
shlokas.19:
bRRihada.nso.apratibalo gaurastAla ivodgataH |
pramANato bhImasenaH prAdeshenAdhiko.arjunAt
shlokas.20:
javena vAjino.atyeti balenAtyeti ku~njarAn |
avyaktajalpI madhvakSho madhyamaH pANDavo balI
shlokas.21:
iti bAlye shrutaH pUrvaM mayA vyAsamukhAtpurA |
rUpato vIryatashchaiva yAthAtathyena pANDavaH
shlokas.22:
Ayasena sa daNDena rathAnnAgAnhayAnnarAn |
haniShyati raNe kruddho bhImaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.23:
amarShI nityasa.nrabdho raudraH krUraparAkramaH |
mama tAta pratIpAni kurvanpUrvaM vimAnitaH
shlokas.24:
niShkIrNAmAyasIM sthUlAM suparvAM kA~nchanIM gadAm |
shataghnIM shatanirhrAdAM kathaM shakShyanti me sutAH
shlokas.25:
apAramaplavAgAdhaM samudraM sharaveginam |
bhImasenamayaM durgaM tAta mandAstitIrShavaH
shlokas.26:
kroshato me na shRRiNvanti bAlAH paNDitamAninaH |
viShamaM nAvabudhyante prapAtaM madhudarshinaH
shlokas.27:
sa.nyugaM ye kariShyanti nararUpeNa vAyunA |
niyataM choditA dhAtrA siMheneva mahAmRRigAH
shlokas.28:
shaikyAM tAta chatuShkiShkuM ShaDasrimamitaujasam |
prahitAM duHkhasa.nsparshAM kathaM shakShyanti me sutAH
shlokas.29:
gadAM bhrAmayatastasya bhindato hastimastakAn |
sRRikkiNI lelihAnasya bAShpamutsRRijato muhuH
shlokas.30:
uddishya pAtAnpatataH kurvato bhairavAnravAn |
pratIpAnpatato mattAnku~njarAnpratigarjataH
shlokas.31:
vigAhya rathamArgeShu varAnuddishya nighnataH |
agneH prajvalitasyeva api muchyeta me prajA
shlokas.32:
vIthIM kurvanmahAbAhurdrAvayanmama vAhinIm |
nRRityanniva gadApANiryugAntaM darshayiShyati
shlokas.33:
prabhinna iva mAta~NgaH prabha~njanpuShpitAndrumAn |
pravekShyati raNe senAM putrANAM me vRRikodaraH
shlokas.34:
kurvanrathAnvipuruShAnvidhvajAnbhagnapuShkarAn |
ArujanpuruShavyAghro rathinaH sAdinastathA
shlokas.35:
ga~NgAvega ivAnUpA.nstIrajAnvividhAndrumAn |
pravekShyati mahAsenAM putrANAM mama sa~njaya
shlokas.36:
vashaM nUnaM gamiShyanti bhImasenabalArditAH |
mama putrAshcha bhRRityAshcha rAjAnashchaiva sa~njaya
shlokas.37:
yena rAjA mahAvIryaH pravishyAntaHpuraM purA |
vAsudevasahAyena jarAsandho nipAtitaH
shlokas.38:
kRRitsneyaM pRRithivI devI jarAsandhena dhImatA |
mAgadhendreNa balinA vashe kRRitvA pratApitA
shlokas.39:
bhIShmapratApAtkuravo nayenAndhakavRRiShNayaH |
te na tasya vashaM jagmuH kevalaM daivameva vA
shlokas.40:
sa gatvA pANDuputreNa tarasA bAhushAlinA |
anAyudhena vIreNa nihataH kiM tato.adhikam
shlokas.41:
dIrghakAlena sa.nsiktaM viShamAshIviSho yathA |
sa mokShyati raNe tejaH putreShu mama sa~njaya
shlokas.42:
mahendra iva vajreNa dAnavAndevasattamaH |
bhImaseno gadApANiH sUdayiShyati me sutAn
shlokas.43:
aviShahyamanAvAryaM tIvravegaparAkramam |
pashyAmIvAtitAmrAkShamApatantaM vRRikodaram
shlokas.44:
agadasyApyadhanuSho virathasya vivarmaNaH |
bAhubhyAM yudhyamAnasya kastiShThedagrataH pumAn
shlokas.45:
bhIShmo droNashcha vipro.ayaM kRRipaH shAradvatastathA |
jAnantyete yathaivAhaM vIryaj~nastasya dhImataH
shlokas.46:
AryavrataM tu jAnantaH sa~NgarAnna bibhitsavaH |
senAmukheShu sthAsyanti mAmakAnAM nararShabhAH
shlokas.47:
balIyaH sarvato diShTaM puruShasya visheShataH |
pashyannapi jayaM teShAM na niyachChAmi yatsutAn
shlokas.48:
te purANaM maheShvAsA mArgamaindraM samAsthitAH |
tyakShyanti tumule prANAnrakShantaH pArthivaM yashaH
shlokas.49:
yathaiShAM mAmakAstAta tathaiShAM pANDavA api |
pautrA bhIShmasya shiShyAshcha droNasya cha kRRipasya cha
shlokas.50:
yattvasmadAshrayaM ki~nchiddattamiShTaM cha sa~njaya |
tasyApachitimAryatvAtkartAraH sthavirAstrayaH
shlokas.51:
AdadAnasya shastraM hi kShatradharmaM parIpsataH |
nidhanaM brAhmaNasyAjau varamevAhuruttamam
shlokas.52:
sa vai shochAmi sarvAnvai ye yuyutsanti pANDavAn |
vikruShTaM vidureNAdau tadetadbhayamAgatam
shlokas.53:
na tu manye vighAtAya j~nAnaM duHkhasya sa~njaya |
bhavatyatibale hyetajj~nAnamapyupaghAtakam
shlokas.54:
RRiShayo hyapi nirmuktAH pashyanto lokasa~NgrahAn |
sukhe bhavanti sukhinastathA duHkhena duHkhitAH
shlokas.55:
kiM punaryo.ahamAsaktastatra tatra sahasradhA |
putreShu rAjyadAreShu pautreShvapi cha bandhuShu
shlokas.56:
sa.nshaye tu mahatyasminkiM nu me kShamamuttamam |
vinAshaM hyeva pashyAmi kurUNAmanuchintayan
shlokas.57:
dyUtapramukhamAbhAti kurUNAM vyasanaM mahat |
mandenaishvaryakAmena lobhAtpApamidaM kRRitam
shlokas.58:
manye paryAyadharmo.ayaM kAlasyAtyantagAminaH |
chakre pradhirivAsakto nAsya shakyaM palAyitum
shlokas.59:
kiM nu kAryaM kathaM kuryAM kva nu gachChAmi sa~njaya |
ete nashyanti kuravo mandAH kAlavashaM gatAH
shlokas.60:
avasho.ahaM purA tAta putrANAM nihate shate |
shroShyAmi ninadaM strINAM kathaM mAM maraNaM spRRishet
shlokas.61:
yathA nidAghe jvalanaH samiddho; dahetkakShaM vAyunA chodyamAnaH |
gadAhastaH pANDavastadvadeva; hantA madIyAnsahito.arjunena

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yasya vai nAnRRitA vAchaH pravRRittA anushushrumaH |
trailokyamapi tasya syAdyoddhA yasya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.2:
tasyaiva cha na pashyAmi yudhi gANDIvadhanvanaH |
anishaM chintayAno.api yaH pratIyAdrathena tam
shlokas.3:
asyataH karNinAlIkAnmArgaNAnhRRidayachChidaH |
pratyetA na samaH kashchidyudhi gANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.4:
droNakarNau pratIyAtAM yadi vIrau nararShabhau |
mAhAtmyAtsa.nshayo loke na tvasti vijayo mama
shlokas.5:
ghRRiNI karNaH pramAdI cha AchAryaH sthaviro guruH |
samartho balavAnpArtho dRRiDhadhanvA jitaklamaH
bhavetsutumulaM yuddhaM sarvasho.apyaparAjayaH
shlokas.6:
sarve hyastravidaH shUrAH sarve prAptA mahadyashaH |
api sarvAmaraishvaryaM tyajeyurna punarjayam
vadhe nUnaM bhavechChAntistayorvA phalgunasya vA
shlokas.7:
na tu jetArjunasyAsti hantA chAsya na vidyate |
manyustasya kathaM shAmyenmandAnprati ya utthitaH
shlokas.8:
anye.apyastrANi jAnanti jIyante cha jayanti cha |
ekAntavijayastveva shrUyate phalgunasya ha
shlokas.9:
trayastri.nshatsamAhUya khANDave.agnimatarpayat |
jigAya cha surAnsarvAnnAsya vedmi parAjayam
shlokas.10:
yasya yantA hRRiShIkeshaH shIlavRRittasamo yudhi |
dhruvastasya jayastAta yathendrasya jayastathA
shlokas.11:
kRRiShNAvekarathe yattAvadhijyaM gANDivaM dhanuH |
yugapattrINi tejA.nsi sametAnyanushushrumaH
shlokas.12:
naiva no.asti dhanustAdRRi~Nna yoddhA na cha sArathiH |
tachcha mandA na jAnanti duryodhanavashAnugAH
shlokas.13:
sheShayedashanirdIpto nipatanmUrdhni sa~njaya |
na tu sheShaM sharAH kuryurastAstAta kirITinA
shlokas.14:
api chAsyannivAbhAti nighnanniva cha phalgunaH |
uddharanniva kAyebhyaH shirA.nsi sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.15:
api bANamayaM tejaH pradIptamiva sarvataH |
gANDIveddhaM dahetAjau putrANAM mama vAhinIm
shlokas.16:
api sA rathaghoSheNa bhayArtA savyasAchinaH |
vitrastA bahulA senA bhAratI pratibhAti me
shlokas.17:
yathA kakShaM dahatyagniH pravRRiddhaH sarvatashcharan |
mahArchiraniloddhUtastadvaddhakShyati mAmakAn
shlokas.18:
yadodvamannishitAnbANasa~NghA;nsthAtAtatAyI samare kirITI |
sRRiShTo.antakaH sarvaharo vidhAtrA; yathA bhavettadvadavAraNIyaH
shlokas.19:
yadA hyabhIkShNaM subahUnprakArA;~nshrotAsmi tAnAvasathe kurUNAm |
teShAM samantAchcha tathA raNAgre; kShayaH kilAyaM bharatAnupaiti

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yathaiva pANDavAH sarve parAkrAntA jigIShavaH |
tathaivAbhisarAsteShAM tyaktAtmAno jaye dhRRitAH
shlokas.2:
tvameva hi parAkrAntAnAchakShIthAH parAnmama |
pA~nchAlAnkekayAnmatsyAnmAgadhAnvatsabhUmipAn
shlokas.3:
yashcha sendrAnimA.NllokAnichChankuryAdvashe balI |
sa shreShTho jagataH kRRiShNaH pANDavAnAM jaye dhRRitaH
shlokas.4:
samastAmarjunAdvidyAM sAtyakiH kShipramAptavAn |
shaineyaH samare sthAtA bIjavatpravapa~nsharAn
shlokas.5:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pA~nchAlyaH krUrakarmA mahArathaH |
mAmakeShu raNaM kartA baleShu paramAstravit
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThirasya cha krodhAdarjunasya cha vikramAt |
yamAbhyAM bhImasenAchcha bhayaM me tAta jAyate
shlokas.7:
amAnuShaM manuShyendrairjAlaM vitatamantarA |
mama senAM haniShyanti tataH kroshAmi sa~njaya
shlokas.8:
darshanIyo manasvI cha lakShmIvAnbrahmavarchasI |
medhAvI sukRRitapraj~no dharmAtmA pANDunandanaH
shlokas.9:
mitrAmAtyaiH susampannaH sampanno yojyayojakaiH |
bhrAtRRibhiH shvashuraiH putrairupapanno mahArathaiH
shlokas.10:
dhRRityA cha puruShavyAghro naibhRRityena cha pANDavaH |
anRRisha.nso vadAnyashcha hrImAnsatyaparAkramaH
shlokas.11:
bahushrutaH kRRitAtmA cha vRRiddhasevI jitendriyaH |
taM sarvaguNasampannaM samiddhamiva pAvakam
shlokas.12:
tapantamiva ko mandaH patiShyati pata~Ngavat |
pANDavAgnimanAvAryaM mumUrShurmUDhachetanaH
shlokas.13:
tanuruchchaH shikhI rAjA shuddhajAmbUnadaprabhaH |
mandAnAM mama putrANAM yuddhenAntaM kariShyati
shlokas.14:
tairayuddhaM sAdhu manye kuravastannibodhata |
yuddhe vinAshaH kRRitsnasya kulasya bhavitA dhruvam
shlokas.15:
eShA me paramA shAntiryayA shAmyati me manaH |
yadi tvayuddhamiShTaM vo vayaM shAntyai yatAmahe
shlokas.16:
na tu naH shikShamANAnAmupekSheta yudhiShThiraH |
jugupsati hyadharmeNa mAmevoddishya kAraNam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evametanmahArAja yathA vadasi bhArata |
yuddhe vinAshaH kShatrasya gANDIvena pradRRishyate
shlokas.2:
idaM tu nAbhijAnAmi tava dhIrasya nityashaH |
yatputravashamAgachCheH sattvaj~naH savyasAchinaH
shlokas.3:
naiSha kAlo mahArAja tava shashvatkRRitAgasaH |
tvayA hyevAditaH pArthA nikRRitA bharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
pitA shreShThaH suhRRidyashcha samyakpraNihitAtmavAn |
AstheyaM hi hitaM tena na drogdhA gururuchyate
shlokas.5:
idaM jitamidaM labdhamiti shrutvA parAjitAn |
dyUtakAle mahArAja smayase sma kumAravat
shlokas.6:
paruShANyuchyamAnAnsma purA pArthAnupekShase |
kRRitsnaM rAjyaM jayantIti prapAtaM nAnupashyasi
shlokas.7:
pitryaM rAjyaM mahArAja kuravaste sajA~NgalAH |
atha vIrairjitAM bhUmimakhilAM pratyapadyathAH
shlokas.8:
bAhuvIryArjitA bhUmistava pArthairniveditA |
mayedaM kRRitamityeva manyase rAjasattama
shlokas.9:
grastAngandharvarAjena majjato hyaplave.ambhasi |
AninAya punaH pArthaH putrA.nste rAjasattama
shlokas.10:
kumAravachcha smayase dyUte vinikRRiteShu yat |
pANDaveShu vanaM rAjanpravrajatsu punaH punaH
shlokas.11:
pravarShataH sharavrAtAnarjunasya shitAnbahUn |
apyarNavA vishuShyeyuH kiM punarmA.nsayonayaH
shlokas.12:
asyatAM phalgunaH shreShTho gANDIvaM dhanuShAM varam |
keshavaH sarvabhUtAnAM chakrANAM cha sudarshanam
shlokas.13:
vAnaro rochamAnashcha ketuH ketumatAM varaH |
evametAni saratho vaha~nshvetahayo raNe
kShapayiShyati no rAjankAlachakramivodyatam
shlokas.14:
tasyAdya vasudhA rAjannikhilA bharatarShabha |
yasya bhImArjunau yodhau sa rAjA rAjasattama
shlokas.15:
tathA bhImahataprAyAM majjantIM tava vAhinIm |
duryodhanamukhA dRRiShTvA kShayaM yAsyanti kauravAH
shlokas.16:
na hi bhImabhayAdbhItA lapsyante vijayaM vibho |
tava putrA mahArAja rAjAnashchAnusAriNaH
shlokas.17:
matsyAstvAmadya nArchanti pA~nchAlAshcha sakekayAH |
shAlveyAH shUrasenAshcha sarve tvAmavajAnate
pArthaM hyete gatAH sarve vIryaj~nAstasya dhImataH
shlokas.18:
anarhAneva tu vadhe dharmayuktAnvikarmaNA |
sarvopAyairniyantavyaH sAnugaH pApapUruShaH
tava putro mahArAja nAtra shochitumarhasi
shlokas.19:
dyUtakAle mayA choktaM vidureNa cha dhImatA |
yadidaM te vilapitaM pANDavAnprati bhArata
anIsheneva rAjendra sarvametannirarthakam

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
na bhetavyaM mahArAja na shochyA bhavatA vayam |
samarthAH sma parAnrAjanvijetuM samare vibho
shlokas.2:
vanaM pravrAjitAnpArthAnyadAyAnmadhusUdanaH |
mahatA balachakreNa pararAShTrAvamardinA
shlokas.3:
kekayA dhRRiShTaketushcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
rAjAnashchAnvayuH pArthAnbahavo.anye.anuyAyinaH
shlokas.4:
indraprasthasya chAdUrAtsamAjagmurmahArathAH |
vyagarhaya.nshcha sa~Ngamya bhavantaM kurubhiH saha
shlokas.5:
te yudhiShThiramAsInamajinaiH prativAsitam |
kRRiShNapradhAnAH saMhatya paryupAsanta bhArata
shlokas.6:
pratyAdAnaM cha rAjyasya kAryamUchurnarAdhipAH |
bhavataH sAnubandhasya samuchChedaM chikIrShavaH
shlokas.7:
shrutvA chaitanmayoktAstu bhIShmadroNakRRipAstadA |
j~nAtikShayabhayAdrAjanbhItena bharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
na te sthAsyanti samaye pANDavA iti me matiH |
samuchChedaM hi naH kRRitsnaM vAsudevashchikIrShati
shlokas.9:
RRite cha viduraM sarve yUyaM vadhyA mahAtmanaH |
dhRRitarAShTrashcha dharmaj~no na vadhyaH kurusattamaH
shlokas.10:
samuchChedaM cha kRRitsnaM naH kRRitvA tAta janArdanaH |
ekarAjyaM kurUNAM sma chikIrShati yudhiShThire
shlokas.11:
tatra kiM prAptakAlaM naH praNipAtaH palAyanam |
prANAnvA samparityajya pratiyudhyAmahe parAn
shlokas.12:
pratiyuddhe tu niyataH syAdasmAkaM parAjayaH |
yudhiShThirasya sarve hi pArthivA vashavartinaH
shlokas.13:
viraktarAShTrAshcha vayaM mitrANi kupitAni naH |
dhikkRRitAH pArthivaiH sarvaiH svajanena cha sarvashaH
shlokas.14:
praNipAte tu doSho.asti bandhUnAM shAshvatIH samAH |
pitaraM tveva shochAmi praj~nAnetraM janeshvaram
matkRRite duHkhamApannaM kleshaM prAptamanantakam
shlokas.15:
kRRitaM hi tava putraishcha pareShAmavarodhanam |
matpriyArthaM puraivaitadviditaM te narottama
shlokas.16:
te rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya sAmAtyasya mahArathAH |
vairaM pratikariShyanti kulochChedena pANDavAH
shlokas.17:
tato droNo.abravIdbhIShmaH kRRipo drauNishcha bhArata |
matvA mAM mahatIM chintAmAsthitaM vyathitendriyam
shlokas.18:
abhidrugdhAH pare chenno na bhetavyaM parantapa |
asamarthAH pare jetumasmAnyudhi janeshvara
shlokas.19:
ekaikashaH samarthAH smo vijetuM sarvapArthivAn |
AgachChantu vineShyAmo darpameShAM shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.20:
puraikena hi bhIShmeNa vijitAH sarvapArthivAH |
mRRite pitaryabhikruddho rathenaikena bhArata
shlokas.21:
jaghAna subahU.nsteShAM sa.nrabdhaH kurusattamaH |
tataste sharaNaM jagmurdevavratamimaM bhayAt
shlokas.22:
sa bhIShmaH susamartho.ayamasmAbhiH sahito raNe |
parAnvijetuM tasmAtte vyetu bhIrbharatarShabha
ityeShAM nishchayo hyAsIttatkAlamamitaujasAm
shlokas.23:
purA pareShAM pRRithivI kRRitsnAsIdvashavartinI |
asmAnpunaramI nAdya samarthA jetumAhave
ChinnapakShAH pare hyadya vIryahInAshcha pANDavAH
shlokas.24:
asmatsa.nsthA cha pRRithivI vartate bharatarShabha |
ekArthAH sukhaduHkheShu mayAnItAshcha pArthivAH
shlokas.25:
apyagniM pravisheyuste samudraM vA parantapa |
madarthe pArthivAH sarve tadviddhi kurusattama
shlokas.26:
unmattamiva chApi tvAM prahasantIha duHkhitam |
vilapantaM bahuvidhaM bhItaM paravikatthane
shlokas.27:
eShAM hyekaikasho rAj~nAM samarthaH pANDavAnprati |
AtmAnaM manyate sarvo vyetu te bhayamAgatam
shlokas.28:
sarvAM samagrAM senAM me vAsavo.api na shaknuyAt |
hantumakShayyarUpeyaM brahmaNApi svayambhuvA
shlokas.29:
