yudhiShThiraH puraM hitvA pa~ncha grAmAnsa yAchati |
bhIto hi mAmakAtsainyAtprabhAvAchchaiva me prabho
shlokas.30:
samarthaM manyase yachcha kuntIputraM vRRikodaram |
tanmithyA na hi me kRRitsnaM prabhAvaM vettha bhArata
shlokas.31:
matsamo hi gadAyuddhe pRRithivyAM nAsti kashchana |
nAsItkashchidatikrAnto bhavitA na cha kashchana
shlokas.32:
yukto duHkhochitashchAhaM vidyApAragatastathA |
tasmAnna bhImAnnAnyebhyo bhayaM me vidyate kvachit
shlokas.33:
duryodhanasamo nAsti gadAyAmiti nishchayaH |
sa~NkarShaNasya bhadraM te yattadainamupAvasam
shlokas.34:
yuddhe sa~NkarShaNasamo balenAbhyadhiko bhuvi |
gadAprahAraM bhImo me na jAtu viShahedyudhi
shlokas.35:
ekaM prahAraM yaM dadyAM bhImAya ruShito nRRipa |
sa evainaM nayedghoraM kShipraM vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.36:
ichCheyaM cha gadAhastaM rAjandraShTuM vRRikodaram |
suchiraM prArthito hyeSha mama nityaM manorathaH
shlokas.37:
gadayA nihato hyAjau mama pArtho vRRikodaraH |
vishIrNagAtraH pRRithivIM parAsuH prapatiShyati
shlokas.38:
gadAprahArAbhihato himavAnapi parvataH |
sakRRinmayA vishIryeta giriH shatasahasradhA
shlokas.39:
sa chApyetadvijAnAti vAsudevArjunau tathA |
duryodhanasamo nAsti gadAyAmiti nishchayaH
shlokas.40:
tatte vRRikodaramayaM bhayaM vyetu mahAhave |
vyapaneShyAmyahaM hyenaM mA rAjanvimanA bhava
shlokas.41:
tasminmayA hate kShipramarjunaM bahavo rathAH |
tulyarUpA vishiShTAshcha kShepsyanti bharatarShabha
shlokas.42:
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipo drauNiH karNo bhUrishravAstathA |
prAgjyotiShAdhipaH shalyaH sindhurAjo jayadrathaH
shlokas.43:
ekaika eShAM shaktastu hantuM bhArata pANDavAn |
samastAstu kShaNenaitAnneShyanti yamasAdanam
shlokas.44:
samagrA pArthivI senA pArthamekaM dhana~njayam |
kasmAdashaktA nirjetumiti heturna vidyate
shlokas.45:
sharavrAtaistu bhIShmeNa shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
droNadrauNikRRipaishchaiva gantA pArtho yamakShayam
shlokas.46:
pitAmaho hi gA~NgeyaH shantanoradhi bhArata |
brahmarShisadRRisho jaj~ne devairapi durutsahaH
pitrA hyuktaH prasannena nAkAmastvaM mariShyasi
shlokas.47:
brahmarSheshcha bharadvAjAddroNyAM droNo vyajAyata |
droNAjjaj~ne mahArAja drauNishcha paramAstravit
shlokas.48:
kRRipashchAchAryamukhyo.ayaM maharShergautamAdapi |
sharastambodbhavaH shrImAnavadhya iti me matiH
shlokas.49:
ayonijaM trayaM hyetatpitA mAtA cha mAtulaH |
ashvatthAmno mahArAja sa cha shUraH sthito mama
shlokas.50:
sarva ete mahArAja devakalpA mahArathAH |
shakrasyApi vyathAM kuryuH sa.nyuge bharatarShabha
shlokas.51:
bhIShmadroNakRRipANAM cha tulyaH karNo mato mama |
anuj~nAtashcha rAmeNa matsamo.asIti bhArata
shlokas.52:
kuNDale ruchire chAstAM karNasya sahaje shubhe |
te shachyarthe mahendreNa yAchitaH sa parantapaH
amoghayA mahArAja shaktyA paramabhImayA
shlokas.53:
tasya shaktyopagUDhasya kasmAjjIveddhana~njayaH |
vijayo me dhruvaM rAjanphalaM pANAvivAhitam
abhivyaktaH pareShAM cha kRRitsno bhuvi parAjayaH
shlokas.54:
ahnA hyekena bhIShmo.ayamayutaM hanti bhArata |
tatsamAshcha maheShvAsA droNadrauNikRRipA api
shlokas.55:
sa.nshaptAni cha vRRindAni kShatriyANAM parantapa |
arjunaM vayamasmAnvA dhana~njaya iti sma ha
shlokas.56:
tA.nshchAlamiti manyante savyasAchivadhe vibho |
pArthivAH sa bhavAnrAjannakasmAdvyathate katham
shlokas.57:
bhImasene cha nihate ko.anyo yudhyeta bhArata |
pareShAM tanmamAchakShva yadi vettha parantapa
shlokas.58:
pa~ncha te bhrAtaraH sarve dhRRiShTadyumno.atha sAtyakiH |
pareShAM sapta ye rAjanyodhAH paramakaM balam
shlokas.59:
asmAkaM tu vishiShTA ye bhIShmadroNakRRipAdayaH |
drauNirvaikartanaH karNaH somadatto.atha bAhlikaH
shlokas.60:
prAgjyotiShAdhipaH shalya Avantyo.atha jayadrathaH |
duHshAsano durmukhashcha duHsahashcha vishAM pate
shlokas.61:
shrutAyushchitrasenashcha purumitro vivi.nshatiH |
shalo bhUrishravAshchobhau vikarNashcha tavAtmajaH
shlokas.62:
akShauhiNyo hi me rAjandashaikA cha samAhRRitAH |
nyUnAH pareShAM saptaiva kasmAnme syAtparAjayaH
shlokas.63:
balaM triguNato hInaM yodhyaM prAha bRRihaspatiH |
parebhyastriguNA cheyaM mama rAjannanIkinI
shlokas.64:
guNahInaM pareShAM cha bahu pashyAmi bhArata |
guNodayaM bahuguNamAtmanashcha vishAM pate
shlokas.65:
etatsarvaM samAj~nAya balAgryaM mama bhArata |
nyUnatAM pANDavAnAM cha na mohaM gantumarhasi
shlokas.66:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA sa~njayaM bhUyaH paryapRRichChata bhArata |
vidhitsuH prAptakAlAni j~nAtvA parapura~njayaH

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
akShauhiNIH sapta labdhvA rAjabhiH saha sa~njaya |
kiM svidichChati kaunteyo yuddhaprepsuryudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
atIva mudito rAjanyuddhaprepsuryudhiShThiraH |
bhImasenArjunau chobhau yamAvapi na bibhyataH
shlokas.3:
rathaM tu divyaM kaunteyaH sarvA vibhrAjayandishaH |
mantraM jij~nAsamAnaH sanbIbhatsuH samayojayat
shlokas.4:
tamapashyAma saMnaddhaM meghaM vidyutprabhaM yathA |
sa mantrAnsamabhidhyAya hRRiShyamANo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.5:
pUrvarUpamidaM pashya vayaM jeShyAma sa~njaya |
bIbhatsurmAM yathovAcha tathAvaimyahamapyuta
shlokas.6:
duryodhana uvAcha||
prasha.nsasyabhinanda.nstAnpArthAnakShaparAjitAn |
arjunasya rathe brUhi kathamashvAH kathaM dhvajaH
shlokas.7:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhauvanaH saha shakreNa bahuchitraM vishAM pate |
rUpANi kalpayAmAsa tvaShTA dhAtrA sahAbhibho
shlokas.8:
dhvaje hi tasminrUpANi chakruste devamAyayA |
mahAdhanAni divyAni mahAnti cha laghUni cha
shlokas.9:
sarvA disho yojanamAtramantaraM; sa tiryagUrdhvaM cha rurodha vai dhvajaH |
na sa.nsajjettarubhiH sa.nvRRito.api; tathA hi mAyA vihitA bhauvanena
shlokas.10:
yathAkAshe shakradhanuH prakAshate; na chaikavarNaM na cha vidma kiM nu tat |
tathA dhvajo vihito bhauvanena; bahvAkAraM dRRishyate rUpamasya
shlokas.11:
yathAgnidhUmo divameti ruddhvA; varNAnbibhrattaijasaM tachCharIram |
tathA dhvajo vihito bhauvanena; na chedbhAro bhavitA nota rodhaH
shlokas.12:
shvetAstasminvAtavegAH sadashvA; divyA yuktAshchitrarathena dattAH |
shataM yattatpUryate nityakAlaM; hataM hataM dattavaraM purastAt
shlokas.13:
tathA rAj~no dantavarNA bRRihanto; rathe yuktA bhAnti tadvIryatulyAH |
RRishyaprakhyA bhImasenasya vAhA; raNe vAyostulyavegA babhUvuH
shlokas.14:
kalmAShA~NgAstittirichitrapRRiShThA; bhrAtrA dattAH prIyatA phalgunena |
bhrAturvIrasya svaistura~NgairvishiShTA; mudA yuktAH sahadevaM vahanti
shlokas.15:
mAdrIputraM nakulaM tvAjamIDhaM; mahendradattA harayo vAjimukhyAH |
samA vAyorbalavantastarasvino; vahanti vIraM vRRitrashatruM yathendram
shlokas.16:
tulyAshchaibhirvayasA vikrameNa; javena chaivApratirUpAH sadashvAH |
saubhadrAdIndraupadeyAnkumArA;nvahantyashvA devadattA bRRihantaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kA.nstatra sa~njayApashyaH pratyarthena samAgatAn |
ye yotsyante pANDavArthe putrasya mama vAhinIm
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
mukhyamandhakavRRiShNInAmapashyaM kRRiShNamAgatam |
chekitAnaM cha tatraiva yuyudhAnaM cha sAtyakim
shlokas.3:
pRRithagakShauhiNIbhyAM tau pANDavAnabhisa.nshritau |
mahArathau samAkhyAtAvubhau puruShamAninau
shlokas.4:
akShauhiNyAtha pA~nchAlyo dashabhistanayairvRRitaH |
satyajitpramukhairvIrairdhRRiShTadyumnapurogamaiH
shlokas.5:
drupado vardhayanmAnaM shikhaNDiparipAlitaH |
upAyAtsarvasainyAnAM pratichChAdya tadA vapuH
shlokas.6:
virATaH saha putrAbhyAM sha~NkhenaivottareNa cha |
sUryadattAdibhirvIrairmadirAshvapurogamaiH
shlokas.7:
sahitaH pRRithivIpAlo bhrAtRRibhistanayaistathA |
akShauhiNyaiva sainyasya vRRitaH pArthaM samAshritaH
shlokas.8:
jArAsandhirmAgadhashcha dhRRiShTaketushcha chedirAT |
pRRithakpRRithaganuprAptau pRRithagakShauhiNIvRRitau
shlokas.9:
kekayA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha sarve lohitakadhvajAH |
akShauhiNIparivRRitAH pANDavAnabhisa.nshritAH
shlokas.10:
etAnetAvatastatra yAnapashyaM samAgatAn |
ye pANDavArthe yotsyanti dhArtarAShTrasya vAhinIm
shlokas.11:
yo veda mAnuShaM vyUhaM daivaM gAndharvamAsuram |
sa tasya senApramukhe dhRRiShTadyumno mahAmanAH
shlokas.12:
bhIShmaH shAntanavo rAjanbhAgaH kL^iptaH shikhaNDinaH |
taM virATo.anu sa.nyAtA saha matsyaiH prahAribhiH
shlokas.13:
jyeShThasya pANDuputrasya bhAgo madrAdhipo balI |
tau tu tatrAbruvankechidviShamau no matAviti
shlokas.14:
duryodhanaH sahasutaH sArdhaM bhrAtRRishatena cha |
prAchyAshcha dAkShiNAtyAshcha bhImasenasya bhAgataH
shlokas.15:
arjunasya tu bhAgena karNo vaikartano mataH |
ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha saindhavashcha jayadrathaH
shlokas.16:
ashakyAshchaiva ye kechitpRRithivyAM shUramAninaH |
sarvA.nstAnarjunaH pArthaH kalpayAmAsa bhAgataH
shlokas.17:
maheShvAsA rAjaputrA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha kekayAH |
kekayAneva bhAgena kRRitvA yotsyanti sa.nyuge
shlokas.18:
teShAmeva kRRito bhAgo mAlavAH shAlvakekayAH |
trigartAnAM cha dvau mukhyau yau tau sa.nshaptakAviti
shlokas.19:
duryodhanasutAH sarve tathA duHshAsanasya cha |
saubhadreNa kRRito bhAgo rAjA chaiva bRRihadbalaH
shlokas.20:
draupadeyA maheShvAsAH suvarNavikRRitadhvajAH |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhA droNamabhiyAsyanti bhArata
shlokas.21:
chekitAnaH somadattaM dvairathe yoddhumichChati |
bhojaM tu kRRitavarmANaM yuyudhAno yuyutsati
shlokas.22:
sahadevastu mAdreyaH shUraH sa~Nkrandano yudhi |
svama.nshaM kalpayAmAsa shyAlaM te subalAtmajam
shlokas.23:
ulUkaM chApi kaitavyaM ye cha sArasvatA gaNAH |
nakulaH kalpayAmAsa bhAgaM mAdravatIsutaH
shlokas.24:
ye chAnye pArthivA rAjanpratyudyAsyanti sa.nyuge |
samAhvAnena tA.nshchApi pANDuputrA akalpayan
shlokas.25:
evameShAmanIkAni pravibhaktAni bhAgashaH |
yatte kAryaM saputrasya kriyatAM tadakAlikam
shlokas.26:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
na santi sarve putrA me mUDhA durdyUtadevinaH |
yeShAM yuddhaM balavatA bhImena raNamUrdhani
shlokas.27:
rAjAnaH pArthivAH sarve prokShitAH kAladharmaNA |
gANDIvAgniM pravekShyanti pata~NgA iva pAvakam
shlokas.28:
vidrutAM vAhinIM manye kRRitavairairmahAtmabhiH |
tAM raNe ke.anuyAsyanti prabhagnAM pANDavairyudhi
shlokas.29:
sarve hyatirathAH shUrAH kIrtimantaH pratApinaH |
sUryapAvakayostulyAstejasA samiti~njayAH
shlokas.30:
yeShAM yudhiShThiro netA goptA cha madhusUdanaH |
yodhau cha pANDavau vIrau savyasAchivRRikodarau
shlokas.31:
nakulaH sahadevashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
sAtyakirdrupadashchaiva dhRRiShTadyumnasya chAtmajaH
shlokas.32:
uttamaujAshcha pA~nchAlyo yudhAmanyushcha durjayaH |
shikhaNDI kShatradevashcha tathA vairATiruttaraH
shlokas.33:
kAshayashchedayashchaiva matsyAH sarve cha sRRi~njayAH |
virATaputro babhrUshcha pA~nchAlAshcha prabhadrakAH
shlokas.34:
yeShAmindro.apyakAmAnAM na haretpRRithivImimAm |
vIrANAM raNadhIrANAM ye bhindyuH parvatAnapi
shlokas.35:
tAnsarvAnguNasampannAnamanuShyapratApinaH |
kroshato mama duShputro yoddhumichChati sa~njaya
shlokas.36:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ubhau sva ekajAtIyau tathobhau bhUmigocharau |
atha kasmAtpANDavAnAmekato manyase jayam
shlokas.37:
pitAmahaM cha droNaM cha kRRipaM karNaM cha durjayam |
jayadrathaM somadattamashvatthAmAnameva cha
shlokas.38:
suchetaso maheShvAsAnindro.api sahito.amaraiH |
ashaktaH samare jetuM kiM punastAta pANDavAH
shlokas.39:
sarvA cha pRRithivI sRRiShTA madarthe tAta pANDavAn |
AryAndhRRitimataH shUrAnagnikalpAnprabAdhitum
shlokas.40:
na mAmakAnpANDavAste samarthAH prativIkShitum |
parAkrAnto hyahaM pANDUnsaputrAnyoddhumAhave
shlokas.41:
matpriyaM pArthivAH sarve ye chikIrShanti bhArata |
te tAnAvArayiShyanti aiNeyAniva tantunA
shlokas.42:
mahatA rathava.nshena sharajAlaishcha mAmakaiH |
abhidrutA bhaviShyanti pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.43:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
unmatta iva me putro vilapatyeSha sa~njaya |
na hi shakto yudhA jetuM dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.44:
jAnAti hi sadA bhIShmaH pANDavAnAM yashasvinAm |
balavattAM saputrANAM dharmaj~nAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.45:
yato nArochayamahaM vigrahaM tairmahAtmabhiH |
kiM tu sa~njaya me brUhi punasteShAM vicheShTitam
shlokas.46:
kastA.nstarasvino bhUyaH sa.ndIpayati pANDavAn |
archiShmato maheShvAsAnhaviShA pAvakAniva
shlokas.47:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dhRRiShTadyumnaH sadaivaitAnsa.ndIpayati bhArata |
yudhyadhvamiti mA bhaiShTa yuddhAdbharatasattamAH
shlokas.48:
ye kechitpArthivAstatra dhArtarAShTreNa sa.nvRRitAH |
yuddhe samAgamiShyanti tumule kavachahrade
shlokas.49:
tAnsarvAnAhave kruddhAnsAnubandhAnsamAgatAn |
ahamekaH samAdAsye timirmatsyAnivaudakAn
shlokas.50:
bhIShmaM droNaM kRRipaM karNaM drauNiM shalyaM suyodhanam |
etA.nshchApi nirotsyAmi veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.51:
tathA bruvANaM dharmAtmA prAha rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
tava dhairyaM cha vIryaM cha pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha
sarve samadhirUDhAH sma sa~NgrAmAnnaH samuddhara
shlokas.52:
jAnAmi tvAM mahAbAho kShatradharme vyavasthitam |
samarthamekaM paryAptaM kauravANAM yuyutsatAm
bhavatA yadvidhAtavyaM tannaH shreyaH parantapa
shlokas.53:
sa~NgrAmAdapayAtAnAM bhagnAnAM sharaNaiShiNAm |
pauruShaM darshaya~nshUro yastiShThedagrataH pumAn
krINIyAttaM sahasreNa nItimannAma tatpadam
shlokas.54:
sa tvaM shUrashcha vIrashcha vikrAntashcha nararShabha |
bhayArtAnAM paritrAtA sa.nyugeShu na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.55:
evaM bruvati kaunteye dharmAtmani yudhiShThire |
dhRRiShTadyumna uvAchedaM mAM vacho gatasAdhvasaH
shlokas.56:
sarvA~njanapadAnsUta yodhA duryodhanasya ye |
sabAhlIkAnkurUnbrUyAH prAtipeyA~nsharadvataH
shlokas.57:
sUtaputraM tathA droNaM sahaputraM jayadratham |
duHshAsanaM vikarNaM cha tathA duryodhanaM nRRipam
shlokas.58:
bhIShmaM chaiva brUhi gatvA tvamAshu; yudhiShThiraM sAdhunaivAbhyupeta |
mA vo vadhIdarjuno devaguptaH; kShipraM yAchadhvaM pANDavaM lokavIram
shlokas.59:
naitAdRRisho hi yodho.asti pRRithivyAmiha kashchana |
yathAvidhaH savyasAchI pANDavaH shastravittamaH
shlokas.60:
devairhi sambhRRito divyo ratho gANDIvadhanvanaH |
na sa jeyo manuShyeNa mA sma kRRidhvaM mano yudhi

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kShatratejA brahmachArI kaumArAdapi pANDavaH |
tena sa.nyugameShyanti mandA vilapato mama
shlokas.2:
duryodhana nivartasva yuddhAdbharatasattama |
na hi yuddhaM prasha.nsanti sarvAvasthamari.ndama
shlokas.3:
alamardhaM pRRithivyAste sahAmAtyasya jIvitum |
prayachCha pANDuputrANAM yathochitamari.ndama
shlokas.4:
etaddhi kuravaH sarve manyante dharmasaMhitam |
yattvaM prashAntimichChethAH pANDuputrairmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.5:
a~NgemAM samavekShasva putra svAmeva vAhinIm |
jAta eva tava srAvastvaM tu mohAnna budhyase
shlokas.6:
na hyahaM yuddhamichChAmi naitadichChati bAhlikaH |
na cha bhIShmo na cha droNo nAshvatthAmA na sa~njayaH
shlokas.7:
na somadatto na shalyo na kRRipo yuddhamichChati |
satyavrataH purumitro jayo bhUrishravAstathA
shlokas.8:
yeShu sampratitiShTheyuH kuravaH pIDitAH paraiH |
te yuddhaM nAbhinandanti tattubhyaM tAta rochatAm
shlokas.9:
na tvaM karoShi kAmena karNaH kArayitA tava |
duHshAsanashcha pApAtmA shakunishchApi saubalaH
shlokas.10:
duryodhana uvAcha||
nAhaM bhavati na droNe nAshvatthAmni na sa~njaye |
na vikarNe na kAmboje na kRRipe na cha bAhlike
shlokas.11:
satyavrate purumitre bhUrishravasi vA punaH |
anyeShu vA tAvakeShu bhAraM kRRitvA samAhvaye
shlokas.12:
ahaM cha tAta karNashcha raNayaj~naM vitatya vai |
yudhiShThiraM pashuM kRRitvA dIkShitau bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
ratho vedI sruvaH khaDgo gadA srukkavachaM sadaH |
chAturhotraM cha dhuryA me sharA darbhA haviryashaH
shlokas.14:
Atmayaj~nena nRRipate iShTvA vaivasvataM raNe |
vijitya svayameShyAvo hatAmitrau shriyA vRRitau
shlokas.15:
ahaM cha tAta karNashcha bhrAtA duHshAsanashcha me |
ete vayaM haniShyAmaH pANDavAnsamare trayaH
shlokas.16:
ahaM hi pANDavAnhatvA prashAstA pRRithivImimAm |
mAM vA hatvA pANDuputrA bhoktAraH pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.17:
tyaktaM me jIvitaM rAjandhanaM rAjyaM cha pArthiva |
na jAtu pANDavaiH sArdhaM vaseyamahamachyuta
shlokas.18:
yAvaddhi sUchyAstIkShNAyA vidhyedagreNa mAriSha |
tAvadapyaparityAjyaM bhUmernaH pANDavAnprati
shlokas.19:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sarvAnvastAta shochAmi tyakto duryodhano mayA |
ye mandamanuyAsyadhvaM yAntaM vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.20:
rurUNAmiva yUtheShu vyAghrAH praharatAM varAH |
varAnvarAnhaniShyanti sametA yudhi pANDavAH
shlokas.21:
pratIpamiva me bhAti yuyudhAnena bhAratI |
vyastA sImantinI trastA pramRRiShTA dIrghabAhunA
shlokas.22:
sampUrNaM pUrayanbhUyo balaM pArthasya mAdhavaH |
shaineyaH samare sthAtA bIjavatpravapa~nsharAn
shlokas.23:
senAmukhe prayuddhAnAM bhImaseno bhaviShyati |
taM sarve sa.nshrayiShyanti prAkAramakutobhayam
shlokas.24:
yadA drakShyasi bhImena ku~njarAnvinipAtitAn |
vishIrNadantAngiryAbhAnbhinnakumbhAnsashoNitAn
shlokas.25:
tAnabhiprekShya sa~NgrAme vishIrNAniva parvatAn |
bhIto bhImasya sa.nsparshAtsmartAsi vachanasya me
shlokas.26:
nirdagdhaM bhImasenena sainyaM hatarathadvipam |
gatimagneriva prekShya smartAsi vachanasya me
shlokas.27:
mahadvo bhayamAgAmi na chechChAmyatha pANDavaiH |
gadayA bhImasenena hatAH shamamupaiShyatha
shlokas.28:
mahAvanamiva ChinnaM yadA drakShyasi pAtitam |
balaM kurUNAM sa~NgrAme tadA smartAsi me vachaH
shlokas.29:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA rAjA tu sa sarvAnpRRithivIpatIn |
anubhAShya mahArAja punaH paprachCha sa~njayam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yadabrUtAM mahAtmAnau vAsudevadhana~njayau |
tanme brUhi mahAprAj~na shushrUShe vachanaM tava
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanyathA dRRiShTau mayA kRRiShNadhana~njayau |
UchatushchApi yadvIrau tatte vakShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.3:
pAdA~NgulIrabhiprekShanprayato.ahaM kRRitA~njaliH |
shuddhAntaM prAvishaM rAjannAkhyAtuM naradevayoH
shlokas.4:
naivAbhimanyurna yamau taM deshamabhiyAnti vai |
yatra kRRiShNau cha kRRiShNA cha satyabhAmA cha bhAminI
shlokas.5:
ubhau madhvAsavakShIbAvubhau chandanarUShitau |
sragviNau varavastrau tau divyAbharaNabhUShitau
shlokas.6:
naikaratnavichitraM tu kA~nchanaM mahadAsanam |
vividhAstaraNAstIrNaM yatrAsAtAmari.ndamau
shlokas.7:
arjunotsa~Ngagau pAdau keshavasyopalakShaye |
arjunasya cha kRRiShNAyAM satyAyAM cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.8:
kA~nchanaM pAdapIThaM tu pArtho me prAdishattadA |
tadahaM pANinA spRRiShTvA tato bhUmAvupAvisham
shlokas.9:
Urdhvarekhatalau pAdau pArthasya shubhalakShaNau |
pAdapIThAdapahRRitau tatrApashyamahaM shubhau
shlokas.10:
shyAmau bRRihantau taruNau shAlaskandhAvivodgatau |
ekAsanagatau dRRiShTvA bhayaM mAM mahadAvishat
shlokas.11:
indraviShNusamAvetau mandAtmA nAvabudhyate |
sa.nshrayAddroNabhIShmAbhyAM karNasya cha vikatthanAt
shlokas.12:
nideshasthAvimau yasya mAnasastasya setsyate |
sa~Nkalpo dharmarAjasya nishchayo me tadAbhavat
shlokas.13:
satkRRitashchAnnapAnAbhyAmAchChanno labdhasatkriyaH |
a~njaliM mUrdhni sandhAya tau sa.ndeshamachodayam
shlokas.14:
dhanurbANochitenaikapANinA shubhalakShaNam |
pAdamAnamayanpArthaH keshavaM samachodayat
shlokas.15:
indraketurivotthAya sarvAbharaNabhUShitaH |
indravIryopamaH kRRiShNaH sa.nviShTo mAbhyabhAShata
shlokas.16:
vAchaM sa vadatAM shreShTho hlAdinIM vachanakShamAm |
trAsanIM dhArtarAShTrANAM mRRidupUrvAM sudAruNAm
shlokas.17:
vAchaM tAM vachanArhasya shikShAkSharasamanvitAm |
ashrauShamahamiShTArthAM pashchAddhRRidayashoShiNIm
shlokas.18:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
sa~njayedaM vacho brUyA dhRRitarAShTraM manIShiNam |
shRRiNvataH kurumukhyasya droNasyApi cha shRRiNvataH
shlokas.19:
yajadhvaM vipulairyaj~nairviprebhyo datta dakShiNAH |
putrairdAraishcha modadhvaM mahadvo bhayamAgatam
shlokas.20:
arthA.nstyajata pAtrebhyaH sutAnprApnuta kAmajAn |
priyaM priyebhyashcharata rAjA hi tvarate jaye
shlokas.21:
RRiNametatpravRRiddhaM me hRRidayAnnApasarpati |
yadgovindeti chukrosha kRRiShNA mAM dUravAsinam
shlokas.22:
tejomayaM durAdharShaM gANDIvaM yasya kArmukam |
maddvitIyena teneha vairaM vaH savyasAchinA
shlokas.23:
maddvitIyaM punaH pArthaM kaH prArthayitumichChati |
yo na kAlaparIto vApyapi sAkShAtpura.ndaraH
shlokas.24:
bAhubhyAmudvahedbhUmiM dahetkruddha imAH prajAH |
pAtayettridivAddevAnyo.arjunaM samare jayet
shlokas.25:
devAsuramanuShyeShu yakShagandharvabhogiShu |
na taM pashyAmyahaM yuddhe pANDavaM yo.abhyayAdraNe
shlokas.26:
yattadvirATanagare shrUyate mahadadbhutam |
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.27:
ekena pANDuputreNa virATanagare yadA |
bhagnAH palAyanta dishaH paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.28:
balaM vIryaM cha tejashcha shIghratA laghuhastatA |
aviShAdashcha dhairyaM cha pArthAnnAnyatra vidyate
shlokas.29:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityabravIddhRRiShIkeshaH pArthamuddharShayangirA |
garjansamayavarShIva gagane pAkashAsanaH
shlokas.30:
keshavasya vachaH shrutvA kirITI shvetavAhanaH |
arjunastanmahadvAkyamabravIllomaharShaNam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa~njayasya vachaH shrutvA praj~nAchakShurnareshvaraH |
tataH sa~NkhyAtumArebhe tadvacho guNadoShataH
shlokas.2:
prasa~NkhyAya cha saukShmyeNa guNadoShAnvichakShaNaH |
yathAvanmatitattvena jayakAmaH sutAnprati
shlokas.3:
balAbale vinishchitya yAthAtathyena buddhimAn |
shaktiM sa~NkhyAtumArebhe tadA vai manujAdhipaH
shlokas.4:
devamAnuShayoH shaktyA tejasA chaiva pANDavAn |
kurU~nshaktyAlpatarayA duryodhanamathAbravIt
shlokas.5:
duryodhaneyaM chintA me shashvannApyupashAmyati |
satyaM hyetadahaM manye pratyakShaM nAnumAnataH
shlokas.6:
AtmajeShu paraM snehaM sarvabhUtAni kurvate |
priyANi chaiShAM kurvanti yathAshakti hitAni cha
shlokas.7:
evamevopakartR^INAM prAyasho lakShayAmahe |
ichChanti bahulaM santaH pratikartuM mahatpriyam
shlokas.8:
agniH sAchivyakartA syAtkhANDave tatkRRitaM smaran |
arjunasyAtibhIme.asminkurupANDusamAgame
shlokas.9:
jAtagRRidhyAbhipannAshcha pANDavAnAmanekashaH |
dharmAdayo bhaviShyanti samAhUtA divaukasaH
shlokas.10:
bhIShmadroNakRRipAdInAM bhayAdashanisaMmitam |
rirakShiShantaH sa.nrambhaM gamiShyantIti me matiH
shlokas.11:
te devasahitAH pArthA na shakyAH prativIkShitum |
mAnuSheNa naravyAghrA vIryavanto.astrapAragAH
shlokas.12:
durAsadaM yasya divyaM gANDIvaM dhanuruttamam |
vAruNau chAkShayau divyau sharapUrNau maheShudhI
shlokas.13:
vAnarashcha dhvajo divyo niHsa~Ngo dhUmavadgatiH |
rathashcha chaturantAyAM yasya nAsti samastviShA
shlokas.14:
mahAmeghanibhashchApi nirghoShaH shrUyate janaiH |
mahAshanisamaH shabdaH shAtravANAM bhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.15:
yaM chAtimAnuShaM vIrye kRRitsno loko vyavasyati |
devAnAmapi jetAraM yaM viduH pArthivA raNe
shlokas.16:
shatAni pa~ncha chaiveShUnudvapanniva dRRishyate |
nimeShAntaramAtreNa mu~nchandUraM cha pAtayan
shlokas.17:
yamAha bhIShmo droNashcha kRRipo drauNistathaiva cha |
madrarAjastathA shalyo madhyasthA ye cha mAnavAH
shlokas.18:
yuddhAyAvasthitaM pArthaM pArthivairatimAnuShaiH |
ashakyaM rathashArdUlaM parAjetumari.ndamam
shlokas.19:
kShipatyekena vegena pa~ncha bANashatAni yaH |
sadRRishaM bAhuvIryeNa kArtavIryasya pANDavam
shlokas.20:
tamarjunaM maheShvAsaM mahendropendrarakShitam |
nighnantamiva pashyAmi vimarde.asminmahAmRRidhe
shlokas.21:
ityevaM chintayankRRitsnamahorAtrANi bhArata |
anidro niHsukhashchAsmi kurUNAM shamachintayA
shlokas.22:
kShayodayo.ayaM sumahAnkurUNAM pratyupasthitaH |
asya chetkalahasyAntaH shamAdanyo na vidyate
shlokas.23:
shamo me rochate nityaM pArthaistAta na vigrahaH |
kurubhyo hi sadA manye pANDavA~nshaktimattarAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pituretadvachaH shrutvA dhArtarAShTro.atyamarShaNaH |
AdhAya vipulaM krodhaM punarevedamabravIt
shlokas.2:
ashakyA devasachivAH pArthAH syuriti yadbhavAn |
manyate tadbhayaM vyetu bhavato rAjasattama
shlokas.3:
akAmadveShasa.nyogAddrohAllobhAchcha bhArata |
upekShayA cha bhAvAnAM devA devatvamApnuvan
shlokas.4:
iti dvaipAyano vyAso nAradashcha mahAtapAH |
jAmadagnyashcha rAmo naH kathAmakathayatpurA
shlokas.5:
naiva mAnuShavaddevAH pravartante kadAchana |
kAmAllobhAdanukroshAddveShAchcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.6:
yadi hyagnishcha vAyushcha dharma indro.ashvinAvapi |
kAmayogAtpravarteranna pArthA duHkhamApnuyuH
shlokas.7:
tasmAnna bhavatA chintA kAryaiShA syAtkadAchana |
daiveShvapekShakA hyete shashvadbhAveShu bhArata
shlokas.8:
atha chetkAmasa.nyogAddveShAllobhAchcha lakShyate |
deveShu devaprAmANyaM naiva tadvikramiShyati
shlokas.9:
mayAbhimantritaH shashvajjAtavedAH prasha.nsati |
didhakShuH sakalA.NllokAnparikShipya samantataH
shlokas.10:
yadvA paramakaM tejo yena yuktA divaukasaH |
mamApyanupamaM bhUyo devebhyo viddhi bhArata
shlokas.11:
pradIryamANAM vasudhAM girINAM shikharANi cha |
lokasya pashyato rAjansthApayAmyabhimantraNAt
shlokas.12:
chetanAchetanasyAsya ja~NgamasthAvarasya cha |
vinAshAya samutpannaM mahAghoraM mahAsvanam
shlokas.13:
ashmavarShaM cha vAyuM cha shamayAmIha nityashaH |
jagataH pashyato.abhIkShNaM bhUtAnAmanukampayA
shlokas.14:
stambhitAsvapsu gachChanti mayA rathapadAtayaH |
devAsurANAM bhAvAnAmahamekaH pravartitA
shlokas.15:
akShauhiNIbhiryAndeshAnyAmi kAryeNa kenachit |
tatrApo me pravartante yatra yatrAbhikAmaye
shlokas.16:
bhayAni viShaye rAjanvyAlAdIni na santi me |
mattaH suptAni bhUtAni na hi.nsanti bhaya~NkarAH
shlokas.17:
nikAmavarShI parjanyo rAjanviShayavAsinAm |
dharmiShThAshcha prajAH sarvA Itayashcha na santi me
shlokas.18:
ashvinAvatha vAyvagnI marudbhiH saha vRRitrahA |
dharmashchaiva mayA dviShTAnnotsahante.abhirakShitum
shlokas.19:
yadi hyete samarthAH syurmaddviShastrAtumojasA |
na sma trayodasha samAH pArthA duHkhamavApnuyuH
shlokas.20:
naiva devA na gandharvA nAsurA na cha rAkShasAH |
shaktAstrAtuM mayA dviShTaM satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.21:
yadabhidhyAmyahaM shashvachChubhaM vA yadi vAshubham |
naitadvipannapUrvaM me mitreShvariShu chobhayoH
shlokas.22:
bhaviShyatIdamiti vA yadbravImi parantapa |
nAnyathA bhUtapUrvaM tatsatyavAgiti mAM viduH
shlokas.23:
lokasAkShikametanme mAhAtmyaM dikShu vishrutam |
AshvAsanArthaM bhavataH proktaM na shlAghayA nRRipa
shlokas.24:
na hyahaM shlAghano rAjanbhUtapUrvaH kadAchana |
asadAcharitaM hyetadyadAtmAnaM prasha.nsati
shlokas.25:
pANDavA.nshchaiva matsyA.nshcha pA~nchAlAnkekayaiH saha |
sAtyakiM vAsudevaM cha shrotAsi vijitAnmayA
shlokas.26:
saritaH sAgaraM prApya yathA nashyanti sarvashaH |
tathaiva te vina~NkShyanti mAmAsAdya sahAnvayAH
shlokas.27:
parA buddhiH paraM tejo vIryaM cha paramaM mayi |
parA vidyA paro yogo mama tebhyo vishiShyate
shlokas.28:
pitAmahashcha droNashcha kRRipaH shalyaH shalastathA |
astreShu yatprajAnanti sarvaM tanmayi vidyate
shlokas.29:
ityuktvA sa~njayaM bhUyaH paryapRRichChata bhArata |
j~nAtvA yuyutsuH kAryANi prAptakAlamari.ndama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA tu pRRichChantamatIva pArthA;nvaichitravIryaM tamachintayitvA |
uvAcha karNo dhRRitarAShTraputraM; praharShayansa.nsadi kauravANAm
shlokas.2:
mithyA pratij~nAya mayA yadastraM; rAmAddhRRitaM brahmapuraM purastAt |
vij~nAya tenAsmi tadaivamukta;stavAntakAle.apratibhAsyatIti
shlokas.3:
mahAparAdhe hyapi saMnatena; maharShiNAhaM guruNA cha shaptaH |
shaktaH pradagdhuM hyapi tigmatejAH; sasAgarAmapyavaniM maharShiH
shlokas.4:
prasAditaM hyasya mayA mano.abhU;chChushrUShayA svena cha pauruSheNa |
tatastadastraM mama sAvasheShaM; tasmAtsamartho.asmi mamaiSha bhAraH
shlokas.5:
nimeShamAtraM tamRRiShiprasAda;mavApya pA~nchAlakarUShamatsyAn |
nihatya pArthA.nshcha saputrapautrA.N;llokAnahaM shastrajitAnprapatsye
shlokas.6:
pitAmahastiShThatu te samIpe; droNashcha sarve cha narendramukhyAH |
yathApradhAnena balena yAtvA; pArthAnhaniShyAmi mamaiSha bhAraH
shlokas.7:
evaM bruvANaM tamuvAcha bhIShmaH; kiM katthase kAlaparItabuddhe |
na karNa jAnAsi yathA pradhAne; hate hatAH syurdhRRitarAShTraputrAH
shlokas.8:
yatkhANDavaM dAhayatA kRRitaM hi; kRRiShNadvitIyena dhana~njayena |
shrutvaiva tatkarma niyantumAtmA; shakyastvayA vai saha bAndhavena
shlokas.9:
yAM chApi shaktiM tridashAdhipaste; dadau mahAtmA bhagavAnmahendraH |
bhasmIkRRitAM tAM patitAM vishIrNAM; chakrAhatAM drakShyasi keshavena
shlokas.10:
yaste sharaH sarpamukho vibhAti; sadAgryamAlyairmahitaH prayatnAt |
sa pANDuputrAbhihataH sharaughaiH; saha tvayA yAsyati karNa nAsham
shlokas.11:
bANasya bhaumasya cha karNa hantA; kirITinaM rakShati vAsudevaH |
yastvAdRRishAnAM cha garIyasAM cha; hantA ripUNAM tumule pragADhe
shlokas.12:
karNa uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM vRRiShNipatiryathokta;stathA cha bhUyashcha tato mahAtmA |
ahaM yaduktaH paruShaM tu kiM chi;tpitAmahastasya phalaM shRRiNotu
shlokas.13:
nyasyAmi shastrANi na jAtu sa~Nkhye; pitAmaho drakShyati mAM sabhAyAm |
tvayi prashAnte tu mama prabhAvaM; drakShyanti sarve bhuvi bhUmipAlAH
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityevamuktvA sa mahAdhanuShmA;nhitvA sabhAM svaM bhavanaM jagAma |
bhIShmastu duryodhanameva rAja;nmadhye kurUNAM prahasannuvAcha
shlokas.15:
satyapratij~naH kila sUtaputra;stathA sa bhAraM viShaheta kasmAt |
vyUhaM prativyUhya shirA.nsi bhittvA; lokakShayaM pashyata bhImasenAt
shlokas.16:
AvantyakAli~NgajayadratheShu; vedidhvaje tiShThati bAhlike cha |
ahaM haniShyAmi sadA pareShAM; sahasrashashchAyutashashcha yodhAn
shlokas.17:
yadaiva rAme bhagavatyanindye; brahma bruvANaH kRRitavA.nstadastram |
tadaiva dharmashcha tapashcha naShTaM; vaikartanasyAdhamapUruShasya
shlokas.18:
athoktavAkye nRRipatau tu bhIShme; nikShipya shastrANi gate cha karNe |
vaichitravIryasya suto.alpabuddhi;rduryodhanaH shAntanavaM babhAShe

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
sadRRishAnAM manuShyeShu sarveShAM tulyajanmanAm |
kathamekAntatasteShAM pArthAnAM manyase jayam
shlokas.2:
sarve sma samajAtIyAH sarve mAnuShayonayaH |
pitAmaha vijAnIShe pArtheShu vijayaM katham
shlokas.3:
nAhaM bhavati na droNe na kRRipe na cha bAhlike |
anyeShu cha narendreShu parAkramya samArabhe
shlokas.4:
ahaM vaikartanaH karNo bhrAtA duHshAsanashcha me |
pANDavAnsamare pa~ncha haniShyAmaH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.5:
tato rAjanmahAyaj~nairvividhairbhUridakShiNaiH |
brAhmaNA.nstarpayiShyAmi gobhirashvairdhanena cha
shlokas.6:
vidura uvAcha||
shakunInAmihArthAya pAshaM bhUmAvayojayat |
kashchichChAkunikastAta pUrveShAmiti shushruma
shlokas.7:
tasmindvau shakunau baddhau yugapatsamapauruShau |
tAvupAdAya taM pAshaM jagmatuH khacharAvubhau
shlokas.8:
tau vihAyasamAkrAntau dRRiShTvA shAkunikastadA |
anvadhAvadanirviNNo yena yena sma gachChataH
shlokas.9:
tathA tamanudhAvantaM mRRigayuM shakunArthinam |
Ashramastho muniH kashchiddadarshAtha kRRitAhnikaH
shlokas.10:
tAvantarikShagau shIghramanuyAntaM mahIcharam |
shlokenAnena kauravya paprachCha sa munistadA
shlokas.11:
vichitramidamAshcharyaM mRRigahanpratibhAti me |
plavamAnau hi khacharau padAtiranudhAvasi
shlokas.12:
shAkunika uvAcha||
pAshamekamubhAvetau sahitau harato mama |
yatra vai vivadiShyete tatra me vashameShyataH
shlokas.13:
vidura uvAcha||
tau vivAdamanuprAptau shakunau mRRityusandhitau |
vigRRihya cha sudurbuddhI pRRithivyAM saMnipetatuH
shlokas.14:
tau yudhyamAnau sa.nrabdhau mRRityupAshavashAnugau |
upasRRityAparij~nAto jagrAha mRRigayustadA
shlokas.15:
evaM ye j~nAtayo.artheShu mitho gachChanti vigraham |
te.amitravashamAyAnti shakunAviva vigrahAt
shlokas.16:
sambhojanaM sa~NkathanaM samprashno.atha samAgamaH |
etAni j~nAtikAryANi na virodhaH kadAchana
shlokas.17:
yasminkAle sumanasaH sarve vRRiddhAnupAsate |
siMhaguptamivAraNyamapradhRRiShyA bhavanti te
shlokas.18:
ye.arthaM santatamAsAdya dInA iva samAsate |
shriyaM te samprayachChanti dviShadbhyo bharatarShabha
shlokas.19:
dhUmAyante vyapetAni jvalanti sahitAni cha |
dhRRitarAShTrolmukAnIva j~nAtayo bharatarShabha
shlokas.20:
idamanyatpravakShyAmi yathA dRRiShTaM girau mayA |
shrutvA tadapi kauravya yathA shreyastathA kuru
shlokas.21:
vayaM kirAtaiH sahitA gachChAmo girimuttaram |
brAhmaNairdevakalpaishcha vidyAjambhakavAtikaiH
shlokas.22:
ku~njabhUtaM giriM sarvamabhito gandhamAdanam |
dIpyamAnauShadhigaNaM siddhagandharvasevitam
shlokas.23:
tatra pashyAmahe sarve madhu pItamamAkShikam |
maruprapAte viShame niviShTaM kumbhasaMmitam
shlokas.24:
AshIviShai rakShyamANaM kuberadayitaM bhRRisham |
yatprAshya puruSho martyo amaratvaM nigachChati
shlokas.25:
achakShurlabhate chakShurvRRiddho bhavati vai yuvA |
iti te kathayanti sma brAhmaNA jambhasAdhakAH
shlokas.26:
tataH kirAtAstaddRRiShTvA prArthayanto mahIpate |
vineshurviShame tasminsasarpe girigahvare
shlokas.27:
tathaiva tava putro.ayaM pRRithivImeka ichChati |
madhu pashyati saMmohAtprapAtaM nAnupashyati
shlokas.28:
duryodhano yoddhumanAH samare savyasAchinA |
na cha pashyAmi tejo.asya vikramaM vA tathAvidham
shlokas.29:
ekena rathamAsthAya pRRithivI yena nirjitA |
pratIkShamANo yo vIraH kShamate vIkShitaM tava
shlokas.30:
drupado matsyarAjashcha sa~Nkruddhashcha dhana~njayaH |
na sheShayeyuH samare vAyuyuktA ivAgnayaH
shlokas.31:
a~Nke kuruShva rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTra yudhiShThiram |
yudhyatorhi dvayoryuddhe naikAntena bhavejjayaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
duryodhana vijAnIhi yattvAM vakShyAmi putraka |
utpathaM manyase mArgamanabhij~na ivAdhvagaH
shlokas.2:
pa~nchAnAM pANDuputrANAM yattejaH pramimIShasi |
pa~nchAnAmiva bhUtAnAM mahatAM sumahAtmanAm
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThiraM hi kaunteyaM paraM dharmamihAsthitam |
parAM gatimasamprekShya na tvaM vettumihArhasi
shlokas.4:
bhImasenaM cha kaunteyaM yasya nAsti samo bale |
raNAntakaM tarkayase mahAvAtamiva drumaH
shlokas.5:
sarvashastrabhRRitAM shreShThaM meruM shikhariNAmiva |
yudhi gANDIvadhanvAnaM ko nu yudhyeta buddhimAn
shlokas.6:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pA~nchAlyaH kamivAdya na shAtayet |
shatrumadhye sharAnmu~nchandevarADashanImiva
shlokas.7:
sAtyakishchApi durdharShaH saMmato.andhakavRRiShNiShu |
dhva.nsayiShyati te senAM pANDaveyahite rataH
shlokas.8:
yaH punaH pratimAnena trI.NllokAnatirichyate |
taM kRRiShNaM puNDarIkAkShaM ko nu yudhyeta buddhimAn
shlokas.9:
ekato hyasya dArAshcha j~nAtayashcha sabAndhavAH |
AtmA cha pRRithivI cheyamekatashcha dhana~njayaH
shlokas.10:
vAsudevo.api durdharSho yatAtmA yatra pANDavaH |
aviShahyaM pRRithivyApi tadbalaM yatra keshavaH
shlokas.11:
tiShTha tAta satAM vAkye suhRRidAmarthavAdinAm |
vRRiddhaM shAntanavaM bhIShmaM titikShasva pitAmaham
shlokas.12:
mAM cha bruvANaM shushrUSha kurUNAmarthavAdinam |
droNaM kRRipaM vikarNaM cha mahArAjaM cha bAhlikam
shlokas.13:
ete hyapi yathaivAhaM mantumarhasi tA.nstathA |
sarve dharmavido hyete tulyasnehAshcha bhArata
shlokas.14:
yattadvirATanagare saha bhrAtRRibhiragrataH |
utsRRijya gAH susantrastaM balaM te samashIryata
shlokas.15:
yachchaiva tasminnagare shrUyate mahadadbhutam |
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.16:
arjunastattathAkArShItkiM punaH sarva eva te |
sabhrAtR^InabhijAnIhi vRRittyA cha pratipAdaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA mahAprAj~no dhRRitarAShTraH suyodhanam |
punareva mahAbhAgaH sa~njayaM paryapRRichChata
shlokas.2:
brUhi sa~njaya yachCheShaM vAsudevAdanantaram |
yadarjuna uvAcha tvAM paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vAsudevavachaH shrutvA kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
uvAcha kAle durdharSho vAsudevasya shRRiNvataH
shlokas.4:
pitAmahaM shAntanavaM dhRRitarAShTraM cha sa~njaya |
droNaM kRRipaM cha karNaM cha mahArAjaM cha bAhlikam
shlokas.5:
drauNiM cha somadattaM cha shakuniM chApi saubalam |
duHshAsanaM shalaM chaiva purumitraM vivi.nshatim
shlokas.6:
vikarNaM chitrasenaM cha jayatsenaM cha pArthivam |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau durmukhaM chApi kauravam
shlokas.7:
saindhavaM duHsahaM chaiva bhUrishravasameva cha |
bhagadattaM cha rAjAnaM jalasandhaM cha pArthivam
shlokas.8:
ye chApyanye pArthivAstatra yoddhuM; samAgatAH kauravANAM priyArtham |
mumUrShavaH pANDavAgnau pradIpte; samAnItA dhArtarAShTreNa sUta
shlokas.9:
yathAnyAyaM kaushalaM vandanaM cha; samAgatA madvachanena vAchyAH |
idaM brUyAH sa~njaya rAjamadhye; suyodhanaM pApakRRitAM pradhAnam
shlokas.10:
amarShaNaM durmatiM rAjaputraM; pApAtmAnaM dhArtarAShTraM sulubdham |
sarvaM mamaitadvachanaM samagraM; sahAmAtyaM sa~njaya shrAvayethAH
shlokas.11:
evaM pratiShThApya dhana~njayo mAM; tato.arthavaddharmavachchApi vAkyam |
provAchedaM vAsudevaM samIkShya; pArtho dhImA.NllohitAntAyatAkShaH
shlokas.12:
yathA shrutaM te vadato mahAtmano; madhupravIrasya vachaH samAhitam |
tathaiva vAchyaM bhavatA hi madvachaH; samAgateShu kShitipeShu sarvashaH
shlokas.13:
sharAgnidhUme rathaneminAdite; dhanuHsruveNAstrabalApahAriNA |
yathA na homaH kriyate mahAmRRidhe; tathA sametya prayatadhvamAdRRitAH
shlokas.14:
na chetprayachChadhvamamitraghAtino; yudhiShThirasyA.nshamabhIpsitaM svakam |
nayAmi vaH svAshvapadAtiku~njarA;ndishaM pitR^INAmashivAM shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.15:
tato.ahamAmantrya chaturbhujaM hariM; dhana~njayaM chaiva namasya satvaraH |
javena samprApta ihAmaradyute; tavAntikaM prApayituM vacho mahat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
duryodhane dhArtarAShTre tadvacho.apratinandati |
tUShNImbhUteShu sarveShu samuttasthurnareshvarAH
shlokas.2:
utthiteShu mahArAja pRRithivyAM sarvarAjasu |
rahite sa~njayaM rAjA paripraShTuM prachakrame
shlokas.3:
Asha.nsamAno vijayaM teShAM putravashAnugaH |
Atmanashcha pareShAM cha pANDavAnAM cha nishchayam
shlokas.4:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
gAvalgaNe brUhi naH sAraphalgu; svasenAyAM yAvadihAsti ki~nchit |
tvaM pANDavAnAM nipuNaM vettha sarvaM; kimeShAM jyAyaH kimu teShAM kanIyaH
shlokas.5:
tvametayoH sAravitsarvadarshI; dharmArthayornipuNo nishchayaj~naH |
sa me pRRiShTaH sa~njaya brUhi sarvaM; yudhyamAnAH katare.asminna santi
shlokas.6:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
na tvAM brUyAM rahite jAtu kiM chi;dasUyA hi tvAM prasaheta rAjan |
Anayasva pitaraM sa.nshitavrataM; gAndhArIM cha mahiShImAjamIDha
shlokas.7:
tau te.asUyAM vinayetAM narendra; dharmaj~nau tau nipuNau nishchayaj~nau |
tayostu tvAM saMnidhau tadvadeyaM; kRRitsnaM mataM vAsudevArjunAbhyAm
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastanmatamAj~nAya sa~njayasyAtmajasya cha |
abhyupetya mahAprAj~naH kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt
shlokas.9:
sampRRichChate dhRRitarAShTrAya sa~njaya; AchakShva sarvaM yAvadeSho.anuyu~Nkte |
sarvaM yAvadvettha tasminyathAva;dyAthAtathyaM vAsudeve.arjune cha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
arjuno vAsudevashcha dhanvinau paramArchitau |
kAmAdanyatra sambhUtau sarvAbhAvAya saMmitau
shlokas.2:
dyAmantaraM samAsthAya yathAyuktaM manasvinaH |
chakraM tadvAsudevasya mAyayA vartate vibho
shlokas.3:
sApahnavaM pANDaveShu pANDavAnAM susaMmatam |
sArAsArabalaM j~nAtvA tatsamAsena me shRRiNu
shlokas.4:
narakaM shambaraM chaiva ka.nsaM chaidyaM cha mAdhavaH |
jitavAnghorasa~NkAshAnkrIDanniva janArdanaH
shlokas.5:
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha dyAM chaiva puruShottamaH |
manasaiva vishiShTAtmA nayatyAtmavashaM vashI
shlokas.6:
bhUyo bhUyo hi yadrAjanpRRichChase pANDavAnprati |
sArAsArabalaM j~nAtuM tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.7:
ekato vA jagatkRRitsnamekato vA janArdanaH |
sArato jagataH kRRitsnAdatirikto janArdanaH
shlokas.8:
bhasma kuryAjjagadidaM manasaiva janArdanaH |
na tu kRRitsnaM jagachChaktaM bhasma kartuM janArdanam
shlokas.9:
yataH satyaM yato dharmo yato hrIrArjavaM yataH |
tato bhavati govindo yataH kRRiShNastato jayaH
shlokas.10:
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha divaM cha puruShottamaH |
vicheShTayati bhUtAtmA krIDanniva janArdanaH
shlokas.11:
sa kRRitvA pANDavAnsatraM lokaM saMmohayanniva |
adharmaniratAnmUDhAndagdhumichChati te sutAn
shlokas.12:
kAlachakraM jagachchakraM yugachakraM cha keshavaH |
Atmayogena bhagavAnparivartayate.anisham
shlokas.13:
kAlasya cha hi mRRityoshcha ja~NgamasthAvarasya cha |
Ishate bhagavAnekaH satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.14:
Ishannapi mahAyogI sarvasya jagato hariH |
karmANyArabhate kartuM kInAsha iva durbalaH
shlokas.15:
tena va~nchayate lokAnmAyAyogena keshavaH |
ye tameva prapadyante na te muhyanti mAnavAH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM tvaM mAdhavaM vettha sarvalokamaheshvaram |
kathamenaM na vedAhaM tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vidyA rAjanna te vidyA mama vidyA na hIyate |
vidyAhInastamodhvasto nAbhijAnAti keshavam
shlokas.3:
vidyayA tAta jAnAmi triyugaM madhusUdanam |
kartAramakRRitaM devaM bhUtAnAM prabhavApyayam
shlokas.4:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
gAvalgaNe.atra kA bhaktiryA te nityA janArdane |
yayA tvamabhijAnAsi triyugaM madhusUdanam
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
mAyAM na seve bhadraM te na vRRithAdharmamAchare |
shuddhabhAvaM gato bhaktyA shAstrAdvedmi janArdanam
shlokas.6:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
duryodhana hRRiShIkeshaM prapadyasva janArdanam |
Apto naH sa~njayastAta sharaNaM gachCha keshavam
shlokas.7:
duryodhana uvAcha||
bhagavAndevakIputro lokaM chennihaniShyati |
pravadannarjune sakhyaM nAhaM gachChe.adya keshavam
shlokas.8:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
avAggAndhAri putrAste gachChatyeSha sudurmatiH |
IrShyurdurAtmA mAnI cha shreyasAM vachanAtigaH
shlokas.9:
gAndhAryuvAcha||
aishvaryakAma duShTAtmanvRRiddhAnAM shAsanAtiga |
aishvaryajIvite hitvA pitaraM mAM cha bAlisha
shlokas.10:
vardhayandurhRRidAM prItiM mAM cha shokena vardhayan |
nihato bhImasenena smartAsi vachanaM pituH
shlokas.11:
vyAsa uvAcha||
dayito.asi rAjankRRiShNasya dhRRitarAShTra nibodha me |
yasya te sa~njayo dUto yastvAM shreyasi yokShyate
shlokas.12:
jAnAtyeSha hRRiShIkeshaM purANaM yachcha vai navam |
shushrUShamANamekAgraM mokShyate mahato bhayAt
shlokas.13:
vaichitravIrya puruShAH krodhaharShatamovRRitAH |
sitA bahuvidhaiH pAshairye na tuShTAH svakairdhanaiH
shlokas.14:
yamasya vashamAyAnti kAmamUDhAH punaH punaH |
andhanetrA yathaivAndhA nIyamAnAH svakarmabhiH
shlokas.15:
eSha ekAyanaH panthA yena yAnti manIShiNaH |
taM dRRiShTvA mRRityumatyeti mahA.nstatra na sajjate
shlokas.16:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
a~Nga sa~njaya me sha.nsa panthAnamakutobhayam |
yena gatvA hRRiShIkeshaM prApnuyAM shAntimuttamAm
shlokas.17:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
nAkRRitAtmA kRRitAtmAnaM jAtu vidyAjjanArdanam |
Atmanastu kriyopAyo nAnyatrendriyanigrahAt
shlokas.18:
indriyANAmudIrNAnAM kAmatyAgo.apramAdataH |
apramAdo.avihi.nsA cha j~nAnayonirasa.nshayam
shlokas.19:
indriyANAM yame yatto bhava rAjannatandritaH |
buddhishcha mA te chyavatu niyachChaitAM yatastataH
shlokas.20:
etajj~nAnaM vidurviprA dhruvamindriyadhAraNam |
etajj~nAnaM cha panthAshcha yena yAnti manIShiNaH
shlokas.21:
aprApyaH keshavo rAjannindriyairajitairnRRibhiH |
AgamAdhigato yogAdvashI tattve prasIdati

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhUyo me puNDarIkAkShaM sa~njayAchakShva pRRichChate |
nAmakarmArthavittAta prApnuyAM puruShottamam
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shrutaM me tasya devasya nAmanirvachanaM shubham |
yAvattatrAbhijAne.ahamaprameyo hi keshavaH
shlokas.3:
vasanAtsarvabhUtAnAM vasutvAddevayonitaH |
vAsudevastato vedyo vRRiShatvAdvRRiShNiruchyate
shlokas.4:
maunAddhyAnAchcha yogAchcha viddhi bhArata mAdhavam |
sarvatattvalayAchchaiva madhuhA madhusUdanaH
shlokas.5:
kRRiShirbhUvAchakaH shabdo Nashcha nirvRRitivAchakaH |
kRRiShNastadbhAvayogAchcha kRRiShNo bhavati shAshvataH
shlokas.6:
puNDarIkaM paraM dhAma nityamakShayamakSharam |
tadbhAvAtpuNDarIkAkSho dasyutrAsAjjanArdanaH
shlokas.7:
yataH sattvaM na chyavate yachcha sattvAnna hIyate |
sattvataH sAtvatastasmAdArShabhAdvRRiShabhekShaNaH
shlokas.8:
na jAyate janitryAM yadajastasmAdanIkajit |
devAnAM svaprakAshatvAddamAddAmodaraM viduH
shlokas.9:
harShAtsaukhyAtsukhaishvaryAddhRRiShIkeshatvamashnute |
bAhubhyAM rodasI bibhranmahAbAhuriti smRRitaH
shlokas.10:
adho na kShIyate jAtu yasmAttasmAdadhokShajaH |
narANAmayanAchchApi tena nArAyaNaH smRRitaH
pUraNAtsadanAchchaiva tato.asau puruShottamaH
shlokas.11:
asatashcha satashchaiva sarvasya prabhavApyayAt |
sarvasya cha sadA j~nAnAtsarvamenaM prachakShate
shlokas.12:
satye pratiShThitaH kRRiShNaH satyamatra pratiShThitam |
satyAtsatyaM cha govindastasmAtsatyo.api nAmataH
shlokas.13:
viShNurvikramaNAdeva jayanAjjiShNuruchyate |
shAshvatatvAdanantashcha govindo vedanAdgavAm
shlokas.14:
atattvaM kurute tattvaM tena mohayate prajAH |
eva.nvidho dharmanityo bhagavAnmunibhiH saha
AgantA hi mahAbAhurAnRRisha.nsyArthamachyutaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
chakShuShmatAM vai spRRihayAmi sa~njaya; drakShyanti ye vAsudevaM samIpe |
vibhrAjamAnaM vapuShA pareNa; prakAshayantaM pradisho dishashcha
shlokas.2:
IrayantaM bhAratIM bhAratAnA;mabhyarchanIyAM sha~NkarIM sRRi~njayAnAm |
bubhUShadbhirgrahaNIyAmanindyAM; parAsUnAmagrahaNIyarUpAm
shlokas.3:
samudyantaM sAtvatamekavIraM; praNetAramRRiShabhaM yAdavAnAm |
nihantAraM kShobhaNaM shAtravANAM; muShNantaM cha dviShatAM vai yashA.nsi
shlokas.4:
draShTAro hi kuravastaM sametA; mahAtmAnaM shatruhaNaM vareNyam |
bruvantaM vAchamanRRisha.nsarUpAM; vRRiShNishreShThaM mohayantaM madIyAn
shlokas.5:
RRiShiM sanAtanatamaM vipashchitaM; vAchaH samudraM kalashaM yatInAm |
ariShTanemiM garuDaM suparNaM; patiM prajAnAM bhuvanasya dhAma
shlokas.6:
sahasrashIrShaM puruShaM purANa;manAdimadhyAntamanantakIrtim |
shukrasya dhAtAramajaM janitraM; paraM parebhyaH sharaNaM prapadye
shlokas.7:
trailokyanirmANakaraM janitraM; devAsurANAmatha nAgarakShasAm |
narAdhipAnAM viduShAM pradhAna;mindrAnujaM taM sharaNaM prapadye

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa~njaye pratiyAte tu dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
abhyabhAShata dAshArhamRRiShabhaM sarvasAtvatAm
shlokas.2:
ayaM sa kAlaH samprApto mitrANAM me janArdana |
na cha tvadanyaM pashyAmi yo na Apatsu tArayet
shlokas.3:
tvAM hi mAdhava sa.nshritya nirbhayA mohadarpitam |
dhArtarAShTraM sahAmAtyaM svama.nshamanuyu~njmahe
shlokas.4:
yathA hi sarvAsvApatsu pAsi vRRiShNInari.ndama |
tathA te pANDavA rakShyAH pAhyasmAnmahato bhayAt
shlokas.5:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
ayamasmi mahAbAho brUhi yatte vivakShitam |
kariShyAmi hi tatsarvaM yattvaM vakShyasi bhArata
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutaM te dhRRitarAShTrasya saputrasya chikIrShitam |
etaddhi sakalaM kRRiShNa sa~njayo mAM yadabravIt
shlokas.7:
tanmataM dhRRitarAShTrasya so.asyAtmA vivRRitAntaraH |
yathoktaM dUta AchaShTe vadhyaH syAdanyathA bruvan
shlokas.8:
apradAnena rAjyasya shAntimasmAsu mArgati |
lubdhaH pApena manasA charannasamamAtmanaH
shlokas.9:
yattaddvAdasha varShANi vane nirvyuShitA vayam |
ChadmanA sharadaM chaikAM dhRRitarAShTrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.10:
sthAtA naH samaye tasmindhRRitarAShTra iti prabho |
nAhAsma samayaM kRRiShNa taddhi no brAhmaNA viduH
shlokas.11:
vRRiddho rAjA dhRRitarAShTraH svadharmaM nAnupashyati |
pashyanvA putragRRiddhitvAnmandasyAnveti shAsanam
shlokas.12:
suyodhanamate tiShThanrAjAsmAsu janArdana |
mithyA charati lubdhaH sa.nshcharanpriyamivAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
ito duHkhataraM kiM nu yatrAhaM mAtaraM tataH |
sa.nvidhAtuM na shaknomi mitrANAM vA janArdana
shlokas.14:
kAshibhishchedipA~nchAlairmatsyaishcha madhusUdana |
bhavatA chaiva nAthena pa~ncha grAmA vRRitA mayA
shlokas.15:
kushasthalaM vRRikasthalamAsandI vAraNAvatam |
avasAnaM cha govinda ki~nchidevAtra pa~nchamam
shlokas.16:
pa~ncha nastAta dIyantAM grAmA vA nagarANi vA |
vasema sahitA yeShu mA cha no bharatA nashan
shlokas.17:
na cha tAnapi duShTAtmA dhArtarAShTro.anumanyate |
svAmyamAtmani matvAsAvato duHkhataraM nu kim
shlokas.18:
kule jAtasya vRRiddhasya paravitteShu gRRidhyataH |
lobhaH praj~nAnamAhanti praj~nA hanti hatA hriyam
shlokas.19:
hrIrhatA bAdhate dharmaM dharmo hanti hataH shriyam |
shrIrhatA puruShaM hanti puruShasyAsvatA vadhaH
shlokas.20:
asvato hi nivartante j~nAtayaH suhRRidartvijaH |
apuShpAdaphalAdvRRikShAdyathA tAta patatriNaH
shlokas.21:
etachcha maraNaM tAta yadasmAtpatitAdiva |
j~nAtayo vinivartante pretasattvAdivAsavaH
shlokas.22:
nAtaH pApIyasIM kA~nchidavasthAM shambaro.abravIt |
yatra naivAdya na prAtarbhojanaM pratidRRishyate
shlokas.23:
dhanamAhuH paraM dharmaM dhane sarvaM pratiShThitam |
jIvanti dhanino loke mRRitA ye tvadhanA narAH
shlokas.24:
ye dhanAdapakarShanti naraM svabalamAshritAH |
te dharmamarthaM kAmaM cha pramathnanti naraM cha tam
shlokas.25:
etAmavasthAM prApyaike maraNaM vavrire janAH |
grAmAyaike vanAyaike nAshAyaike pravavrajuH
shlokas.26:
unmAdameke puShyanti yAntyanye dviShatAM vasham |
dAsyameke nigachChanti pareShAmarthahetunA
shlokas.27:
ApadevAsya maraNAtpuruShasya garIyasI |
shriyo vinAshastaddhyasya nimittaM dharmakAmayoH
shlokas.28:
yadasya dharmyaM maraNaM shAshvataM lokavartma tat |
samantAtsarvabhUtAnAM na tadatyeti kashchana
shlokas.29:
na tathA bAdhyate kRRiShNa prakRRityA nirdhano janaH |
yathA bhadrAM shriyaM prApya tayA hInaH sukhaidhitaH
shlokas.30:
sa tadAtmAparAdhena samprApto vyasanaM mahat |
sendrAngarhayate devAnnAtmAnaM cha katha~nchana
shlokas.31:
na chAsminsarvashAstrANi prataranti nigarhaNAm |
so.abhikrudhyati bhRRityAnAM suhRRidashchAbhyasUyati
shlokas.32:
taM tadA manyurevaiti sa bhUyaH sampramuhyati |
sa mohavashamApannaH krUraM karma niShevate
shlokas.33:
pApakarmAtyayAyaiva sa~NkaraM tena puShyati |
sa~Nkaro narakAyaiva sA kAShThA pApakarmaNAm
shlokas.34:
na chetprabudhyate kRRiShNa narakAyaiva gachChati |
tasya prabodhaH praj~naiva praj~nAchakShurna riShyati
shlokas.35:
praj~nAlAbhe hi puruShaH shAstrANyevAnvavekShate |
shAstranityaH punardharmaM tasya hrIra~Ngamuttamam
shlokas.36:
hrImAnhi pApaM pradveShTi tasya shrIrabhivardhate |
shrImAnsa yAvadbhavati tAvadbhavati pUruShaH
shlokas.37:
dharmanityaH prashAntAtmA kAryayogavahaH sadA |
nAdharme kurute buddhiM na cha pApeShu vartate
shlokas.38:
ahrIko vA vimUDho vA naiva strI na punaH pumAn |
nAsyAdhikAro dharme.asti yathA shUdrastathaiva saH
shlokas.39:
hrImAnavati devA.nshcha pitR^InAtmAnameva cha |
tenAmRRitatvaM vrajati sA kAShThA puNyakarmaNAm
shlokas.40:
tadidaM mayi te dRRiShTaM pratyakShaM madhusUdana |
yathA rAjyAtparibhraShTo vasAmi vasatIrimAH
shlokas.41:
te vayaM na shriyaM hAtumalaM nyAyena kenachit |
atra no yatamAnAnAM vadhashchedapi sAdhu tat
shlokas.42:
tatra naH prathamaH kalpo yadvayaM te cha mAdhava |
prashAntAH samabhUtAshcha shriyaM tAnashnuvImahi
shlokas.43:
tatraiShA paramA kAShThA raudrakarmakShayodayA |
yadvayaM kauravAnhatvA tAni rAShTrANyashImahi
shlokas.44:
ye punaH syurasambaddhA anAryAH kRRiShNa shatravaH |
teShAmapyavadhaH kAryaH kiM punarye syurIdRRishAH
shlokas.45:
j~nAtayashcha hi bhUyiShThAH sahAyA guravashcha naH |
teShAM vadho.atipApIyAnkiM nu yuddhe.asti shobhanam
shlokas.46:
pApaH kShatriyadharmo.ayaM vayaM cha kShatrabAndhavAH |
sa naH svadharmo.adharmo vA vRRittiranyA vigarhitA
shlokas.47:
shUdraH karoti shushrUShAM vaishyA vipaNijIvinaH |
vayaM vadhena jIvAmaH kapAlaM brAhmaNairvRRitam
shlokas.48:
kShatriyaH kShatriyaM hanti matsyo matsyena jIvati |
shvA shvAnaM hanti dAshArha pashya dharmo yathAgataH
shlokas.49:
yuddhe kRRiShNa kalirnityaM prANAH sIdanti sa.nyuge |
balaM tu nItimAtrAya haThe jayaparAjayau
shlokas.50:
nAtmachChandena bhUtAnAM jIvitaM maraNaM tathA |
nApyakAle sukhaM prApyaM duHkhaM vApi yadUttama
shlokas.51:
eko hyapi bahUnhanti ghnantyekaM bahavo.apyuta |
shUraM kApuruSho hanti ayashasvI yashasvinam
shlokas.52:
jayashchaivobhayordRRiShTa ubhayoshcha parAjayaH |
tathaivApachayo dRRiShTo vyapayAne kShayavyayau
shlokas.53:
sarvathA vRRijinaM yuddhaM ko ghnanna pratihanyate |
hatasya cha hRRiShIkesha samau jayaparAjayau
shlokas.54:
parAjayashcha maraNAnmanye naiva vishiShyate |
yasya syAdvijayaH kRRiShNa tasyApyapachayo dhruvam
shlokas.55:
antato dayitaM ghnanti kechidapyapare janAH |
tasyA~Nga balahInasya putrAnbhrAtR^InapashyataH
nirvedo jIvite kRRiShNa sarvatashchopajAyate
shlokas.56:
ye hyeva vIrA hrImanta AryAH karuNavedinaH |
ta eva yuddhe hanyante yavIyAnmuchyate janaH
shlokas.57:
hatvApyanushayo nityaM parAnapi janArdana |
anubandhashcha pApo.atra sheShashchApyavashiShyate
shlokas.58:
sheSho hi balamAsAdya na sheShamavasheShayet |
sarvochChede cha yatate vairasyAntavidhitsayA
shlokas.59:
jayo vairaM prasRRijati duHkhamAste parAjitaH |
sukhaM prashAntaH svapiti hitvA jayaparAjayau
shlokas.60:
jAtavairashcha puruSho duHkhaM svapiti nityadA |
anirvRRitena manasA sasarpa iva veshmani
shlokas.61:
utsAdayati yaH sarvaM yashasA sa viyujyate |
akIrtiM sarvabhUteShu shAshvatIM sa niyachChati
shlokas.62:
na hi vairANi shAmyanti dIrghakAlakRRitAnyapi |
AkhyAtArashcha vidyante pumA.nshchotpadyate kule
shlokas.63:
na chApi vairaM vaireNa keshava vyupashAmyati |
haviShAgniryathA kRRiShNa bhUya evAbhivardhate
shlokas.64:
ato.anyathA nAsti shAntirnityamantaramantataH |
antaraM lipsamAnAnAmayaM doSho nirantaraH
shlokas.65:
pauruSheyo hi balavAnAdhirhRRidayabAdhanaH |
tasya tyAgena vA shAntirnivRRittyA manaso.api vA
shlokas.66:
atha vA mUlaghAtena dviShatAM madhusUdana |
phalanirvRRittiriddhA syAttannRRisha.nsataraM bhavet
shlokas.67:
yA tu tyAgena shAntiH syAttadRRite vadha eva saH |
sa.nshayAchcha samuchChedAddviShatAmAtmanastathA
shlokas.68:
na cha tyaktuM tadichChAmo na chechChAmaH kulakShayam |
atra yA praNipAtena shAntiH saiva garIyasI
shlokas.69:
sarvathA yatamAnAnAmayuddhamabhikA~NkShatAm |
sAntve pratihate yuddhaM prasiddhamaparAkramam
shlokas.70:
pratighAtena sAntvasya dAruNaM sampravartate |
tachChunAmiva gopAde paNDitairupalakShitam
shlokas.71:
lA~NgUlachAlanaM kShveDaH pratirAvo vivartanam |
dantadarshanamArAvastato yuddhaM pravartate
shlokas.72:
tatra yo balavAnkRRiShNa jitvA so.atti tadAmiSham |
evameva manuShyeShu visheSho nAsti kashchana
shlokas.73:
sarvathA tvetaduchitaM durbaleShu balIyasAm |
anAdaro virodhashcha praNipAtI hi durbalaH
shlokas.74:
pitA rAjA cha vRRiddhashcha sarvathA mAnamarhati |
tasmAnmAnyashcha pUjyashcha dhRRitarAShTro janArdana
shlokas.75:
putrasnehastu balavAndhRRitarAShTrasya mAdhava |
sa putravashamApannaH praNipAtaM prahAsyati
shlokas.76:
tatra kiM manyase kRRiShNa prAptakAlamanantaram |
kathamarthAchcha dharmAchcha na hIyemahi mAdhava
shlokas.77:
IdRRishe hyarthakRRichChre.asminkamanyaM madhusUdana |
upasampraShTumarhAmi tvAmRRite puruShottama
shlokas.78:
priyashcha priyakAmashcha gatij~naH sarvakarmaNAm |
ko hi kRRiShNAsti nastvAdRRiksarvanishchayavitsuhRRit
shlokas.79:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha dharmarAjaM janArdanaH |
ubhayoreva vAmarthe yAsyAmi kurusa.nsadam
shlokas.80:
shamaM tatra labheyaM chedyuShmadarthamahApayan |
puNyaM me sumahadrAja.nshcharitaM syAnmahAphalam
shlokas.81:
mochayeyaM mRRityupAshAtsa.nrabdhAnkurusRRi~njayAn |
pANDavAndhArtarAShTrA.nshcha sarvAM cha pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.82:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na mamaitanmataM kRRiShNa yattvaM yAyAH kurUnprati |
suyodhanaH sUktamapi na kariShyati te vachaH
shlokas.83:
sametaM pArthivaM kShatraM suyodhanavashAnugam |
teShAM madhyAvataraNaM tava kRRiShNa na rochaye
shlokas.84:
na hi naH prINayeddravyaM na devatvaM kutaH sukham |
na cha sarvAmaraishvaryaM tava rodhena mAdhava
shlokas.85:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
jAnAmyetAM mahArAja dhArtarAShTrasya pApatAm |
avAchyAstu bhaviShyAmaH sarvaloke mahIkShitAm
shlokas.86:
na chApi mama paryAptAH sahitAH sarvapArthivAH |
kruddhasya pramukhe sthAtuM siMhasyevetare mRRigAH
shlokas.87:
atha chette pravarteranmayi ki~nchidasAmpratam |
nirdaheyaM kurUnsarvAniti me dhIyate matiH
shlokas.88:
na jAtu gamanaM tatra bhavetpArtha nirarthakam |
arthaprAptiH kadAchitsyAdantato vApyavAchyatA
shlokas.89:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yattubhyaM rochate kRRiShNa svasti prApnuhi kauravAn |
kRRitArthaM svastimantaM tvAM drakShyAmi punarAgatam
shlokas.90:
viShvaksena kurUngatvA bhAratA~nshamayeH prabho |
yathA sarve sumanasaH saha syAmaH suchetasaH
shlokas.91:
bhrAtA chAsi sakhA chAsi bIbhatsormama cha priyaH |
sauhRRidenAvisha~Nkyo.asi svasti prApnuhi bhUtaye
shlokas.92:
asmAnvettha parAnvettha vetthArthaM vettha bhAShitam |
yadyadasmaddhitaM kRRiShNa tattadvAchyaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.93:
yadyaddharmeNa sa.nyuktamupapadyeddhitaM vachaH |
tattatkeshava bhAShethAH sAntvaM vA yadi vetarat

shlokas.1:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
sa~njayasya shrutaM vAkyaM bhavatashcha shrutaM mayA |
sarvaM jAnAmyabhiprAyaM teShAM cha bhavatashcha yaH
shlokas.2:
tava dharmAshritA buddhisteShAM vairAshritA matiH |
yadayuddhena labhyeta tatte bahumataM bhavet
shlokas.3:
na cha tannaiShThikaM karma kShatriyasya vishAM pate |
AhurAshramiNaH sarve yadbhaikShaM kShatriyashcharet
shlokas.4:
jayo vadho vA sa~NgrAme dhAtrA diShTaH sanAtanaH |
svadharmaH kShatriyasyaiSha kArpaNyaM na prashasyate
shlokas.5:
na hi kArpaNyamAsthAya shakyA vRRittiryudhiShThira |
vikramasva mahAbAho jahi shatrUnari.ndama
shlokas.6:
atigRRiddhAH kRRitasnehA dIrghakAlaM sahoShitAH |
kRRitamitrAH kRRitabalA dhArtarAShTrAH parantapa
shlokas.7:
na paryAyo.asti yatsAmyaM tvayi kuryurvishAM pate |
balavattAM hi manyante bhIShmadroNakRRipAdibhiH
shlokas.8:
yAvachcha mArdavenaitAnrAjannupachariShyasi |
tAvadete hariShyanti tava rAjyamari.ndama
shlokas.9:
nAnukroshAnna kArpaNyAnna cha dharmArthakAraNAt |
alaM kartuM dhArtarAShTrAstava kAmamari.ndama
shlokas.10:
etadeva nimittaM te pANDavAstu yathA tvayi |
nAnvatapyanta kaupInaM tAvatkRRitvApi duShkaram
shlokas.11:
pitAmahasya droNasya vidurasya cha dhImataH |
pashyatAM kurumukhyAnAM sarveShAmeva tattvataH
shlokas.12:
dAnashIlaM mRRiduM dAntaM dharmakAmamanuvratam |
yattvAmupadhinA rAjandyUtenAva~nchayattadA
na chApatrapate pApo nRRisha.nsastena karmaNA
shlokas.13:
tathAshIlasamAchAre rAjanmA praNayaM kRRithAH |
vadhyAste sarvalokasya kiM punastava bhArata
shlokas.14:
vAgbhistvapratirUpAbhiratudatsakanIyasam |
shlAghamAnaH prahRRiShTaH sanbhAShate bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.15:
etAvatpANDavAnAM hi nAsti ki~nchidiha svakam |
nAmadheyaM cha gotraM cha tadapyeShAM na shiShyate
shlokas.16:
kAlena mahatA chaiShAM bhaviShyati parAbhavaH |
prakRRitiM te bhajiShyanti naShTaprakRRitayo janAH
shlokas.17:
etAshchAnyAshcha paruShA vAchaH sa samudIrayan |
shlAghate j~nAtimadhye sma tvayi pravrajite vanam
shlokas.18:
ye tatrAsansamAnItAste dRRiShTvA tvAmanAgasam |
ashrukaNThA rudantashcha sabhAyAmAsate tadA
shlokas.19:
na chainamabhyananda.nste rAjAno brAhmaNaiH saha |
sarve duryodhanaM tatra nindanti sma sabhAsadaH
shlokas.20:
kulInasya cha yA nindA vadhashchAmitrakarshana |
mahAguNo vadho rAjanna tu nindA kujIvikA
shlokas.21:
tadaiva nihato rAjanyadaiva nirapatrapaH |
ninditashcha mahArAja pRRithivyAM sarvarAjasu
shlokas.22:
IShatkAryo vadhastasya yasya chAritramIdRRisham |
praskambhanapratistabdhashChinnamUla iva drumaH
shlokas.23:
vadhyaH sarpa ivAnAryaH sarvalokasya durmatiH |
jahyenaM tvamamitraghna mA rAjanvichikitsithAH
shlokas.24:
sarvathA tvatkShamaM chaitadrochate cha mamAnagha |
yattvaM pitari bhIShme cha praNipAtaM samAchareH
shlokas.25:
ahaM tu sarvalokasya gatvA ChetsyAmi sa.nshayam |
yeShAmasti dvidhAbhAvo rAjanduryodhanaM prati
shlokas.26:
madhye rAj~nAmahaM tatra prAtipauruShikAnguNAn |
tava sa~NkIrtayiShyAmi ye cha tasya vyatikramAH
shlokas.27:
bruvatastatra me vAkyaM dharmArthasahitaM hitam |
nishamya pArthivAH sarve nAnAjanapadeshvarAH
shlokas.28:
tvayi sampratipatsyante dharmAtmA satyavAgiti |
tasmi.nshchAdhigamiShyanti yathA lobhAdavartata
shlokas.29:
garhayiShyAmi chaivainaM paurajAnapadeShvapi |
vRRiddhabAlAnupAdAya chAturvarNyasamAgame
shlokas.30:
shamaM chedyAchamAnastvaM na dharmaM tatra lapsyase |
kurUnvigarhayiShyanti dhRRitarAShTraM cha pArthivAH
shlokas.31:
tasmi.Nllokaparityakte kiM kAryamavashiShyate |
hate duryodhane rAjanyadanyatkriyatAmiti
shlokas.32:
yAtvA chAhaM kurUnsarvAnyuShmadarthamahApayan |
yatiShye prashamaM kartuM lakShayiShye cha cheShTitam
shlokas.33:
kauravANAM pravRRittiM cha gatvA yuddhAdhikArikAm |
nishAmya vinivartiShye jayAya tava bhArata
shlokas.34:
sarvathA yuddhamevAhamAsha.nsAmi paraiH saha |
nimittAni hi sarvANi tathA prAdurbhavanti me
shlokas.35:
mRRigAH shakuntAshcha vadanti ghoraM; hastyashvamukhyeShu nishAmukheShu |
ghorANi rUpANi tathaiva chAgni;rvarNAnbahUnpuShyati ghorarUpAn
manuShyalokakShapaNo.atha ghoro; no chedanuprApta ihAntakaH syAt
shlokas.36:
shastrANi patraM kavachAnrathA.nshcha; nAgAndhvajA.nshcha pratipAdayitvA |
yodhAshcha sarve kRRitanishramAste; bhavantu hastyashvaratheShu yattAH
sA~NgrAmikaM te yadupArjanIyaM; sarvaM samagraM kuru tannarendra
shlokas.37:
duryodhano na hyalamadya dAtuM; jIva.nstavaitannRRipate katha~nchit |
yatte purastAdabhavatsamRRiddhaM; dyUte hRRitaM pANDavamukhya rAjyam

shlokas.1:
bhImasena uvAcha||
yathA yathaiva shAntiH syAtkurUNAM madhusUdana |
tathA tathaiva bhAShethA mA sma yuddhena bhIShayeH
shlokas.2:
amarShI nityasa.nrabdhaH shreyodveShI mahAmanAH |
nograM duryodhano vAchyaH sAmnaivainaM samAchareH
shlokas.3:
prakRRityA pApasattvashcha tulyachetAshcha dasyubhiH |
aishvaryamadamattashcha kRRitavairashcha pANDavaiH
shlokas.4:
adIrghadarshI niShThUrI kSheptA krUraparAkramaH |
dIrghamanyuraneyashcha pApAtmA nikRRitipriyaH
shlokas.5:
mriyetApi na bhajyeta naiva jahyAtsvakaM matam |
tAdRRishena shamaM kRRiShNa manye paramaduShkaram
shlokas.6:
suhRRidAmapyavAchInastyaktadharmaH priyAnRRitaH |
pratihantyeva suhRRidAM vAchashchaiva manA.nsi cha
shlokas.7:
sa manyuvashamApannaH svabhAvaM duShTamAsthitaH |
svabhAvAtpApamanveti tRRiNaistunna ivoragaH
shlokas.8:
duryodhano hi yatsenaH sarvathA viditastava |
yachChIlo yatsvabhAvashcha yadbalo yatparAkramaH
shlokas.9:
purA prasannAH kuravaH sahaputrAstathA vayam |
indrajyeShThA ivAbhUma modamAnAH sabAndhavAH
shlokas.10:
duryodhanasya krodhena bhAratA madhusUdana |
dhakShyante shishirApAye vanAnIva hutAshanaiH
shlokas.11:
aShTAdasheme rAjAnaH prakhyAtA madhusUdana |
ye samuchchichChidurj~nAtInsuhRRidashcha sabAndhavAn
shlokas.12:
asurANAM samRRiddhAnAM jvalatAmiva tejasA |
paryAyakAle dharmasya prApte balirajAyata
shlokas.13:
haihayAnAmudAvarto nIpAnAM janamejayaH |
bahulastAlaja~NghAnAM kRRimINAmuddhato vasuH
shlokas.14:
ajabinduH suvIrANAM surAShTrANAM kusharddhikaH |
arkajashcha balIhAnAM chInAnAM dhautamUlakaH
shlokas.15:
hayagrIvo videhAnAM varaprashcha mahaujasAm |
bAhuH sundaravegAnAM dIptAkShANAM purUravAH
shlokas.16:
sahajashchedimatsyAnAM prachetAnAM bRRihadbalaH |
dhAraNashchendravatsAnAM mukuTAnAM vigAhanaH
shlokas.17:
shamashcha nandivegAnAmityete kulapA.nsanAH |
yugAnte kRRiShNa sambhUtAH kuleShu puruShAdhamAH
shlokas.18:
apyayaM naH kurUNAM syAdyugAnte kAlasambhRRitaH |
duryodhanaH kulA~NgAro jaghanyaH pApapUruShaH
shlokas.19:
tasmAnmRRidu shanairenaM brUyA dharmArthasaMhitam |
kAmAnubandhabahulaM nogramugraparAkramam
shlokas.20:
api duryodhanaM kRRiShNa sarve vayamadhashcharAH |
nIchairbhUtvAnuyAsyAmo mA sma no bharatA nashan
shlokas.21:
apyudAsInavRRittiH syAdyathA naH kurubhiH saha |
vAsudeva tathA kAryaM na kurUnanayaH spRRishet
shlokas.22:
vAchyaH pitAmaho vRRiddho ye cha kRRiShNa sabhAsadaH |
bhrAtR^INAmastu saubhrAtraM dhArtarAShTraH prashAmyatAm
shlokas.23:
ahametadbravImyevaM rAjA chaiva prasha.nsati |
arjuno naiva yuddhArthI bhUyasI hi dayArjune

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA mahAbAhuH keshavaH prahasanniva |
abhUtapUrvaM bhImasya mArdavopagataM vachaH
shlokas.2:
gireriva laghutvaM tachChItatvamiva pAvake |
matvA rAmAnujaH shauriH shAr~NgadhanvA vRRikodaram
shlokas.3:
santejaya.nstadA vAgbhirmAtarishveva pAvakam |
uvAcha bhImamAsInaM kRRipayAbhipariplutam
shlokas.4:
tvamanyadA bhImasena yuddhameva prasha.nsasi |
vadhAbhinandinaH krUrAndhArtarAShTrAnmimardiShuH
shlokas.5:
na cha svapiShi jAgarShi nyubjaH sheShe parantapa |
ghorAmashAntAM rushatIM sadA vAchaM prabhAShase
shlokas.6:
niHshvasannagnivarNena santaptaH svena manyunA |
aprashAntamanA bhIma sadhUma iva pAvakaH
shlokas.7:
ekAnte niShTana~nsheShe bhArArta iva durbalaH |
api tvAM kechidunmattaM manyante.atadvido janAH
shlokas.8:
Arujya vRRikShAnnirmUlAngajaH paribhujanniva |
nighnanpadbhiH kShitiM bhIma niShTananparidhAvasi
shlokas.9:
nAsmi~njane.abhiramase rahaH kShiyasi pANDava |
nAnyaM nishi divA vApi kadAchidabhinandasi
shlokas.10:
akasmAtsmayamAnashcha rahasyAsse rudanniva |
jAnvormUrdhAnamAdhAya chiramAsse pramIlitaH
shlokas.11:
bhrukuTiM cha punaH kurvannoShThau cha vilihanniva |
abhIkShNaM dRRishyase bhIma sarvaM tanmanyukAritam
shlokas.12:
yathA purastAtsavitA dRRishyate shukramuchcharan |
yathA cha pashchAnnirmukto dhruvaM paryeti rashmivAn
shlokas.13:
tathA satyaM bravImyetannAsti tasya vyatikramaH |
hantAhaM gadayAbhyetya duryodhanamamarShaNam
shlokas.14:
iti sma madhye bhrAtR^INAM satyenAlabhase gadAm |
tasya te prashame buddhirdhIyate.adya parantapa
shlokas.15:
aho yuddhapratIpAni yuddhakAla upasthite |
pashyasIvApratIpAni kiM tvAM bhIrbhIma vindati
shlokas.16:
aho pArtha nimittAni viparItAni pashyasi |
svapnAnte jAgarAnte cha tasmAtprashamamichChasi
shlokas.17:
aho nAsha.nsase ki~nchitpu.nstvaM klIba ivAtmani |
kashmalenAbhipanno.asi tena te vikRRitaM manaH
shlokas.18:
udvepate te hRRidayaM manaste praviShIdati |
UrustambhagRRihIto.asi tasmAtprashamamichChasi
shlokas.19:
anityaM kila martyasya chittaM pArtha chalAchalam |
vAtavegaprachalitA aShThIlA shAlmaleriva
shlokas.20:
tavaiShA vikRRitA buddhirgavAM vAgiva mAnuShI |
manA.nsi pANDuputrANAM majjayatyaplavAniva
shlokas.21:
idaM me mahadAshcharyaM parvatasyeva sarpaNam |
yadIdRRishaM prabhAShethA bhImasenAsamaM vachaH
shlokas.22:
sa dRRiShTvA svAni karmANi kule janma cha bhArata |
uttiShThasva viShAdaM mA kRRithA vIra sthiro bhava
shlokas.23:
na chaitadanurUpaM te yatte glAnirari.ndama |
yadojasA na labhate kShatriyo na tadashnute

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathokto vAsudevena nityamanyuramarShaNaH |
sadashvavatsamAdhAvadbabhAShe tadanantaram
shlokas.2:
anyathA mAM chikIrShantamanyathA manyase.achyuta |
praNItabhAvamatyantaM yudhi satyaparAkramam
shlokas.3:
vettha dAshArha sattvaM me dIrghakAlaM sahoShitaH |
uta vA mAM na jAnAsi plavanhrada ivAlpavaH
tasmAdapratirUpAbhirvAgbhirmAM tvaM samarChasi
shlokas.4:
kathaM hi bhImasenaM mAM jAnankashchana mAdhava |
brUyAdapratirUpANi yathA mAM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.5:
tasmAdidaM pravakShyAmi vachanaM vRRiShNinandana |
AtmanaH pauruShaM chaiva balaM cha na samaM paraiH
shlokas.6:
sarvathA nAryakarmaitatprasha.nsA svayamAtmanaH |
ativAdApaviddhastu vakShyAmi balamAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
pashyeme rodasI kRRiShNa yayorAsannimAH prajAH |
achale chApyanante cha pratiShThe sarvamAtarau
shlokas.8:
yadIme sahasA kruddhe sameyAtAM shile iva |
ahamete nigRRihNIyAM bAhubhyAM sacharAchare
shlokas.9:
pashyaitadantaraM bAhvormahAparighayoriva |
ya etatprApya muchyeta na taM pashyAmi pUruSham
shlokas.10:
himavA.nshcha samudrashcha vajrI cha balabhitsvayam |
mayAbhipannaM trAyeranbalamAsthAya na trayaH
shlokas.11:
yudhyeyaM kShatriyAnsarvAnpANDaveShvAtatAyinaH |
adhaH pAdatalenaitAnadhiShThAsyAmi bhUtale
shlokas.12:
na hi tvaM nAbhijAnAsi mama vikramamachyuta |
yathA mayA vinirjitya rAjAno vashagAH kRRitAH
shlokas.13:
atha chenmAM na jAnAsi sUryasyevodyataH prabhAm |
vigADhe yudhi sambAdhe vetsyase mAM janArdana
shlokas.14:
kiM mAtyavAkShIH paruShairvraNaM sUchyA ivAnagha |
yathAmati bravImyetadviddhi mAmadhikaM tataH
shlokas.15:
draShTAsi yudhi sambAdhe pravRRitte vaishase.ahani |
mayA praNunnAnmAta~NgAnrathinaH sAdinastathA
shlokas.16:
tathA narAnabhikruddhaM nighnantaM kShatriyarShabhAn |
draShTA mAM tvaM cha lokashcha vikarShantaM varAnvarAn
shlokas.17:
na me sIdanti majjAno na mamodvepate manaH |
sarvalokAdabhikruddhAnna bhayaM vidyate mama
shlokas.18:
kiM tu sauhRRidamevaitatkRRipayA madhusUdana |
sarvA.nstitikShe sa~NkleshAnmA sma no bharatA nashan

shlokas.1:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
bhAvaM jij~nAsamAno.ahaM praNayAdidamabruvam |
na chAkShepAnna pANDityAnna krodhAnna vivakShayA
shlokas.2:
vedAhaM tava mAhAtmyamuta te veda yadbalam |
uta te veda karmANi na tvAM paribhavAmyaham
shlokas.3:
yathA chAtmani kalyANaM sambhAvayasi pANDava |
sahasraguNamapyetattvayi sambhAvayAmyaham
shlokas.4:
yAdRRishe cha kule janma sarvarAjAbhipUjite |
bandhubhishcha suhRRidbhishcha bhIma tvamasi tAdRRishaH
shlokas.5:
jij~nAsanto hi dharmasya sa.ndigdhasya vRRikodara |
paryAyaM na vyavasyanti daivamAnuShayorjanAH
shlokas.6:
sa eva heturbhUtvA hi puruShasyArthasiddhiShu |
vinAshe.api sa evAsya sa.ndigdhaM karma pauruSham
shlokas.7:
anyathA paridRRiShTAni kavibhirdoShadarshibhiH |
anyathA parivartante vegA iva nabhasvataH
shlokas.8:
sumantritaM sunItaM cha nyAyatashchopapAditam |
kRRitaM mAnuShyakaM karma daivenApi virudhyate
shlokas.9:
daivamapyakRRitaM karma pauruSheNa vihanyate |
shItamuShNaM tathA varShaM kShutpipAse cha bhArata
shlokas.10:
yadanyaddiShTabhAvasya puruShasya svaya~NkRRitam |
tasmAdanavarodhashcha vidyate tatra lakShaNam
shlokas.11:
lokasya nAnyato vRRittiH pANDavAnyatra karmaNaH |
evambuddhiH pravarteta phalaM syAdubhayAnvayAt
shlokas.12:
ya evaM kRRitabuddhiH sankarmasveva pravartate |
nAsiddhau vyathate tasya na siddhau harShamashnute
shlokas.13:
tatreyamarthamAtrA me bhImasena vivakShitA |
naikAntasiddhirmantavyA kurubhiH saha sa.nyuge
shlokas.14:
nAtipraNItarashmiH syAttathA bhavati paryaye |
viShAdamarChedglAniM vA etadarthaM bravImi te
shlokas.15:
shvobhUte dhRRitarAShTrasya samIpaM prApya pANDava |
yatiShye prashamaM kartuM yuShmadarthamahApayan
shlokas.16:
shamaM chette kariShyanti tato.anantaM yasho mama |
bhavatAM cha kRRitaH kAmasteShAM cha shreya uttamam
shlokas.17:
te chedabhinivekShyanti nAbhyupaiShyanti me vachaH |
kuravo yuddhamevAtra raudraM karma bhaviShyati
shlokas.18:
asminyuddhe bhImasena tvayi bhAraH samAhitaH |
dhUrarjunena dhAryA syAdvoDhavya itaro janaH
shlokas.19:
ahaM hi yantA bIbhatsorbhavitA sa.nyuge sati |
dhana~njayasyaiSha kAmo na hi yuddhaM na kAmaye
shlokas.20:
tasmAdAsha~NkamAno.ahaM vRRikodara matiM tava |
tudannaklIbayA vAchA tejaste samadIpayam

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
uktaM yudhiShThireNaiva yAvadvAchyaM janArdana |
tava vAkyaM tu me shrutvA pratibhAti parantapa
shlokas.2:
naiva prashamamatra tvaM manyase sukaraM prabho |
lobhAdvA dhRRitarAShTrasya dainyAdvA samupasthitAt
shlokas.3:
aphalaM manyase chApi puruShasya parAkramam |
na chAntareNa karmANi pauruSheNa phalodayaH
shlokas.4:
tadidaM bhAShitaM vAkyaM tathA cha na tathaiva cha |
na chaitadevaM draShTavyamasAdhyamiti ki~nchana
shlokas.5:
kiM chaitanmanyase kRRichChramasmAkaM pApamAditaH |
kurvanti teShAM karmANi yeShAM nAsti phalodayaH
shlokas.6:
sampAdyamAnaM samyakcha syAtkarma saphalaM prabho |
sa tathA kRRiShNa vartasva yathA sharma bhavetparaiH
shlokas.7:
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha bhavAnparamakaH suhRRit |
surANAmasurANAM cha yathA vIra prajApatiH
shlokas.8:
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha pratipatsva nirAmayam |
asmaddhitamanuShThAtuM na manye tava duShkaram
shlokas.9:
evaM chetkAryatAmeti kAryaM tava janArdana |
gamanAdevameva tvaM kariShyasi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
chikIrShitamathAnyatte tasminvIra durAtmani |
bhaviShyati tathA sarvaM yathA tava chikIrShitam
shlokas.11:
sharma taiH saha vA no.astu tava vA yachchikIrShitam |
vichAryamANo yaH kAmastava kRRiShNa sa no guruH
shlokas.12:
na sa nArhati duShTAtmA vadhaM sasutabAndhavaH |
yena dharmasute dRRiShTvA na sA shrIrupamarShitA
shlokas.13:
yachchApyapashyatopAyaM dharmiShThaM madhusUdana |
upAyena nRRisha.nsena hRRitA durdyUtadevinA
shlokas.14:
kathaM hi puruSho jAtaH kShatriyeShu dhanurdharaH |
samAhUto nivarteta prANatyAge.apyupasthite
shlokas.15:
adharmeNa jitAndRRiShTvA vane pravrajitA.nstathA |
vadhyatAM mama vArShNeya nirgato.asau suyodhanaH
shlokas.16:
na chaitadadbhutaM kRRiShNa mitrArthe yachchikIrShasi |
kriyA kathaM nu mukhyA syAnmRRidunA vetareNa vA
shlokas.17:
atha vA manyase jyAyAnvadhasteShAmanantaram |
tadeva kriyatAmAshu na vichAryamatastvayA
shlokas.18:
jAnAsi hi yathA tena draupadI pApabuddhinA |
parikliShTA sabhAmadhye tachcha tasyApi marShitam
shlokas.19:
sa nAma samyagvarteta pANDaveShviti mAdhava |
na me sa~njAyate buddhirbIjamuptamivoShare
shlokas.20:
tasmAdyanmanyase yuktaM pANDavAnAM cha yaddhitam |
tadAshu kuru vArShNeya yannaH kAryamanantaram

shlokas.1:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi pANDava |
sarvaM tvidaM samAyattaM bIbhatso karmaNordvayoH
shlokas.2:
kShetraM hi rasavachChuddhaM karShakeNopapAditam |
RRite varShaM na kaunteya jAtu nirvartayetphalam
shlokas.3:
tatra vai pauruShaM brUyurAsekaM yatnakAritam |
tatra chApi dhruvaM pashyechChoShaNaM daivakAritam
shlokas.4:
tadidaM nishchitaM buddhyA pUrvairapi mahAtmabhiH |
daive cha mAnuShe chaiva sa.nyuktaM lokakAraNam
shlokas.5:
ahaM hi tatkariShyAmi paraM puruShakArataH |
daivaM tu na mayA shakyaM karma kartuM katha~nchana
shlokas.6:
sa hi dharmaM cha satyaM cha tyaktvA charati durmatiH |
na hi santapyate tena tathArUpeNa karmaNA
shlokas.7:
tAM chApi buddhiM pApiShThAM vardhayantyasya mantriNaH |
shakuniH sUtaputrashcha bhrAtA duHshAsanastathA
shlokas.8:
sa hi tyAgena rAjyasya na shamaM samupeShyati |
antareNa vadhAtpArtha sAnubandhaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.9:
na chApi praNipAtena tyaktumichChati dharmarAT |
yAchyamAnastu rAjyaM sa na pradAsyati durmatiH
shlokas.10:
na tu manye sa tadvAchyo yadyudhiShThirashAsanam |
uktaM prayojanaM tatra dharmarAjena bhArata
shlokas.11:
tathA pApastu tatsarvaM na kariShyati kauravaH |
tasmi.nshchAkriyamANe.asau lokavadhyo bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
mama chApi sa vadhyo vai jagatashchApi bhArata |
yena kaumArake yUyaM sarve viprakRRitAstathA
shlokas.13:
vipraluptaM cha vo rAjyaM nRRisha.nsena durAtmanA |
na chopashAmyate pApaH shriyaM dRRiShTvA yudhiShThire
shlokas.14:
asakRRichchApyahaM tena tvatkRRite pArtha bheditaH |
na mayA tadgRRihItaM cha pApaM tasya chikIrShitam
shlokas.15:
jAnAsi hi mahAbAho tvamapyasya paraM matam |
priyaM chikIrShamANaM cha dharmarAjasya mAmapi
shlokas.16:
sa jAna.nstasya chAtmAnaM mama chaiva paraM matam |
ajAnanniva chAkasmAdarjunAdyAbhisha~Nkase
shlokas.17:
yachchApi paramaM divyaM tachchApyavagataM tvayA |
vidhAnavihitaM pArtha kathaM sharma bhavetparaiH
shlokas.18:
yattu vAchA mayA shakyaM karmaNA chApi pANDava |
kariShye tadahaM pArtha na tvAsha.nse shamaM paraiH
shlokas.19:
kathaM goharaNe brUyAdichCha~nsharma tathAvidham |
yAchyamAno.api bhIShmeNa sa.nvatsaragate.adhvani
shlokas.20:
tadaiva te parAbhUtA yadA sa~NkalpitAstvayA |
lavashaH kShaNashashchApi na cha tuShTaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.21:
sarvathA tu mayA kAryaM dharmarAjasya shAsanam |
vibhAvyaM tasya bhUyashcha karma pApaM durAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
nakula uvAcha||
uktaM bahuvidhaM vAkyaM dharmarAjena mAdhava |
dharmaj~nena vadAnyena dharmayuktaM cha tattvataH
shlokas.2:
matamAj~nAya rAj~nashcha bhImasenena mAdhava |
sa.nshamo bAhuvIryaM cha khyApitaM mAdhavAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
tathaiva phalgunenApi yaduktaM tattvayA shrutam |
Atmanashcha mataM vIra kathitaM bhavatAsakRRit
shlokas.4:
sarvametadatikramya shrutvA paramataM bhavAn |
yatprAptakAlaM manyethAstatkuryAH puruShottama
shlokas.5:
tasmi.nstasminnimitte hi mataM bhavati keshava |
prAptakAlaM manuShyeNa svayaM kAryamari.ndama
shlokas.6:
anyathA chintito hyarthaH punarbhavati so.anyathA |
anityamatayo loke narAH puruShasattama
shlokas.7:
anyathA buddhayo hyAsannasmAsu vanavAsiShu |
adRRishyeShvanyathA kRRiShNa dRRishyeShu punaranyathA
shlokas.8:
asmAkamapi vArShNeya vane vicharatAM tadA |
na tathA praNayo rAjye yathA samprati vartate
shlokas.9:
nivRRittavanavAsAnnaH shrutvA vIra samAgatAH |
akShauhiNyo hi saptemAstvatprasAdAjjanArdana
shlokas.10:
imAnhi puruShavyAghrAnachintyabalapauruShAn |
AttashastrAnraNe dRRiShTvA na vyathediha kaH pumAn
shlokas.11:
sa bhavAnkurumadhye taM sAntvapUrvaM bhayAnvitam |
brUyAdvAkyaM yathA mando na vyatheta suyodhanaH
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThiraM bhImasenaM bIbhatsuM chAparAjitam |
sahadevaM cha mAM chaiva tvAM cha rAmaM cha keshava
shlokas.13:
sAtyakiM cha mahAvIryaM virATaM cha sahAtmajam |
drupadaM cha sahAmAtyaM dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam
shlokas.14:
kAshirAjaM cha vikrAntaM dhRRiShTaketuM cha chedipam |
mA.nsashoNitabhRRinmartyaH pratiyudhyeta ko yudhi
shlokas.15:
sa bhavAngamanAdeva sAdhayiShyatyasa.nshayam |
iShTamarthaM mahAbAho dharmarAjasya kevalam
shlokas.16:
vidurashchaiva bhIShmashcha droNashcha sahabAhlikaH |
shreyaH samarthA vij~nAtumuchyamAnaM tvayAnagha
shlokas.17:
te chainamanuneShyanti dhRRitarAShTraM janAdhipam |
taM cha pApasamAchAraM sahAmAtyaM suyodhanam
shlokas.18:
shrotA chArthasya vidurastvaM cha vaktA janArdana |
kamivArthaM vivartantaM sthApayetAM na vartmani

shlokas.1:
sahadeva uvAcha||
yadetatkathitaM rAj~nA dharma eSha sanAtanaH |
yathA tu yuddhameva syAttathA kAryamari.ndama
shlokas.2:
yadi prashamamichCheyuH kuravaH pANDavaiH saha |
tathApi yuddhaM dAshArha yojayethAH sahaiva taiH
shlokas.3:
kathaM nu dRRiShTvA pA~nchAlIM tathA kliShTAM sabhAgatAm |
avadhena prashAmyeta mama manyuH suyodhane
shlokas.4:
yadi bhImArjunau kRRiShNa dharmarAjashcha dhArmikaH |
dharmamutsRRijya tenAhaM yoddhumichChAmi sa.nyuge
shlokas.5:
sAtyakiruvAcha||
satyamAha mahAbAho sahadevo mahAmatiH |
duryodhanavadhe shAntistasya kopasya me bhavet
shlokas.6:
jAnAsi hi yathA dRRiShTvA chIrAjinadharAnvane |
tavApi manyurudbhUto duHkhitAnprekShya pANDavAn
shlokas.7:
tasmAnmAdrIsutaH shUro yadAha puruSharShabhaH |
vachanaM sarvayodhAnAM tanmataM puruShottama
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM vadati vAkyaM tu yuyudhAne mahAmatau |
subhImaH siMhanAdo.abhUdyodhAnAM tatra sarvashaH
shlokas.9:
sarve hi sarvato vIrAstadvachaH pratyapUjayan |
sAdhu sAdhviti shaineyaM harShayanto yuyutsavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
rAj~nastu vachanaM shrutvA dharmArthasahitaM hitam |
kRRiShNA dAshArhamAsInamabravIchChokakarShitA
shlokas.2:
sutA drupadarAjasya svasitAyatamUrdhajA |
sampUjya sahadevaM cha sAtyakiM cha mahAratham
shlokas.3:
bhImasenaM cha sa.nshAntaM dRRiShTvA paramadurmanAH |
ashrupUrNekShaNA vAkyamuvAchedaM manasvinI
shlokas.4:
viditaM te mahAbAho dharmaj~na madhusUdana |
yathA nikRRitimAsthAya bhra.nshitAH pANDavAH sukhAt
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTrasya putreNa sAmAtyena janArdana |
yathA cha sa~njayo rAj~nA mantraM rahasi shrAvitaH
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThireNa dAshArha tachchApi viditaM tava |
yathoktaH sa~njayashchaiva tachcha sarvaM shrutaM tvayA
shlokas.7:
pa~ncha nastAta dIyantAM grAmA iti mahAdyute |
kushasthalaM vRRikasthalamAsandI vAraNAvatam
shlokas.8:
avasAnaM mahAbAho ki~nchideva tu pa~nchamam |
iti duryodhano vAchyaH suhRRidashchAsya keshava
shlokas.9:
tachchApi nAkarodvAkyaM shrutvA kRRiShNa suyodhanaH |
yudhiShThirasya dAshArha hrImataH sandhimichChataH
shlokas.10:
apradAnena rAjyasya yadi kRRiShNa suyodhanaH |
sandhimichChenna kartavyastatra gatvA katha~nchana
shlokas.11:
shakShyanti hi mahAbAho pANDavAH sRRi~njayaiH saha |
dhArtarAShTrabalaM ghoraM kruddhaM pratisamAsitum
shlokas.12:
na hi sAmnA na dAnena shakyo.arthasteShu kashchana |
tasmAtteShu na kartavyA kRRipA te madhusUdana
shlokas.13:
sAmnA dAnena vA kRRiShNa ye na shAmyanti shatravaH |
moktavyasteShu daNDaH syAjjIvitaM parirakShatA
shlokas.14:
tasmAtteShu mahAdaNDaH kSheptavyaH kShipramachyuta |
tvayA chaiva mahAbAho pANDavaiH saha sRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.15:
etatsamarthaM pArthAnAM tava chaiva yashaskaram |
kriyamANaM bhavetkRRiShNa kShatrasya cha sukhAvaham
shlokas.16:
kShatriyeNa hi hantavyaH kShatriyo lobhamAsthitaH |
akShatriyo vA dAshArha svadharmamanutiShThatA
shlokas.17:
anyatra brAhmaNAttAta sarvapApeShvavasthitAt |
gururhi sarvavarNAnAM brAhmaNaH prasRRitAgrabhuk
shlokas.18:
yathAvadhye bhaveddoSho vadhyamAne janArdana |
sa vadhyasyAvadhe dRRiShTa iti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.19:
yathA tvAM na spRRishedeSha doShaH kRRiShNa tathA kuru |
pANDavaiH saha dAshArha sRRi~njayaishcha sasainikaiH
shlokas.20:
punaruktaM cha vakShyAmi vishrambheNa janArdana |
kA nu sImantinI mAdRRikpRRithivyAmasti keshava
shlokas.21:
sutA drupadarAjasya vedimadhyAtsamutthitA |
dhRRiShTadyumnasya bhaginI tava kRRiShNa priyA sakhI
shlokas.22:
AjamIDhakulaM prAptA snuShA pANDormahAtmanaH |
mahiShI pANDuputrANAM pa~nchendrasamavarchasAm
shlokas.23:
sutA me pa~nchabhirvIraiH pa~ncha jAtA mahArathAH |
abhimanyuryathA kRRiShNa tathA te tava dharmataH
shlokas.24:
sAhaM keshagrahaM prAptA parikliShTA sabhAM gatA |
pashyatAM pANDuputrANAM tvayi jIvati keshava
shlokas.25:
jIvatsu kauraveyeShu pA~nchAleShvatha vRRiShNiShu |
dAsIbhUtAsmi pApAnAM sabhAmadhye vyavasthitA
shlokas.26:
nirAmarSheShvacheShTeShu prekShamANeShu pANDuShu |
trAhi mAmiti govinda manasA kA~NkShito.asi me
shlokas.27:
yatra mAM bhagavAnrAjA shvashuro vAkyamabravIt |
varaM vRRiNIShva pA~nchAli varArhAsi matAsi me
shlokas.28:
adAsAH pANDavAH santu sarathAH sAyudhA iti |
mayokte yatra nirmuktA vanavAsAya keshava
shlokas.29:
eva.nvidhAnAM duHkhAnAmabhij~no.asi janArdana |
trAhi mAM puNDarIkAkSha sabhartRRij~nAtibAndhavAm
shlokas.30:
nanvahaM kRRiShNa bhIShmasya dhRRitarAShTrasya chobhayoH |
snuShA bhavAmi dharmeNa sAhaM dAsIkRRitAbhavam
shlokas.31:
dhigbalaM bhImasenasya dhikpArthasya dhanuShmatAm |
yatra duryodhanaH kRRiShNa muhUrtamapi jIvati
shlokas.32:
yadi te.ahamanugrAhyA yadi te.asti kRRipA mayi |
dhArtarAShTreShu vai kopaH sarvaH kRRiShNa vidhIyatAm
shlokas.33:
ityuktvA mRRidusaMhAraM vRRijinAgraM sudarshanam |
sunIlamasitApA~NgI puNyagandhAdhivAsitam
shlokas.34:
sarvalakShaNasampannaM mahAbhujagavarchasam |
keshapakShaM varArohA gRRihya savyena pANinA
shlokas.35:
padmAkShI puNDarIkAkShamupetya gajagAminI |
ashrupUrNekShaNA kRRiShNA kRRiShNaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.36:
ayaM te puNDarIkAkSha duHshAsanakaroddhRRitaH |
smartavyaH sarvakAleShu pareShAM sandhimichChatA
shlokas.37:
yadi bhImArjunau kRRiShNa kRRipaNau sandhikAmukau |
pitA me yotsyate vRRiddhaH saha putrairmahArathaiH
shlokas.38:
pa~ncha chaiva mahAvIryAH putrA me madhusUdana |
abhimanyuM puraskRRitya yotsyanti kurubhiH saha
shlokas.39:
duHshAsanabhujaM shyAmaM sa~nChinnaM pA.nsuguNThitam |
yadyahaM taM na pashyAmi kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.40:
trayodasha hi varShANi pratIkShantyA gatAni me |
nidhAya hRRidaye manyuM pradIptamiva pAvakam
shlokas.41:
vidIryate me hRRidayaM bhImavAkShalyapIDitam |
yo.ayamadya mahAbAhurdharmaM samanupashyati
shlokas.42:
ityuktvA bAShpasannena kaNThenAyatalochanA |
ruroda kRRiShNA sotkampaM sasvaraM bAShpagadgadam
shlokas.43:
stanau pInAyatashroNI sahitAvabhivarShatI |
dravIbhUtamivAtyuShNamutsRRijadvAri netrajam
shlokas.44:
tAmuvAcha mahAbAhuH keshavaH parisAntvayan |
achirAddrakShyase kRRiShNe rudatIrbharatastriyaH
shlokas.45:
evaM tA bhIru rotsyanti nihataj~nAtibAndhavAH |
hatamitrA hatabalA yeShAM kruddhAsi bhAmini
shlokas.46:
ahaM cha tatkariShyAmi bhImArjunayamaiH saha |
yudhiShThiraniyogena daivAchcha vidhinirmitAt
shlokas.47:
dhArtarAShTrAH kAlapakvA na chechChRRiNvanti me vachaH |
sheShyante nihatA bhUmau shvashRRigAlAdanIkRRitAH
