shlokas.48:
chaleddhi himavA~nshailo medinI shatadhA bhavet |
dyauH patechcha sanakShatrA na me moghaM vacho bhavet
shlokas.49:
satyaM te pratijAnAmi kRRiShNe bAShpo nigRRihyatAm |
hatAmitrA~nshriyA yuktAnachirAddrakShyase patIn

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
kurUNAmadya sarveShAM bhavAnsuhRRidanuttamaH |
sambandhI dayito nityamubhayoH pakShayorapi
shlokas.2:
pANDavairdhArtarAShTrANAM pratipAdyamanAmayam |
samarthaH prashamaM chaiShAM kartuM tvamasi keshava
shlokas.3:
tvamitaH puNDarIkAkSha suyodhanamamarShaNam |
shAntyarthaM bhArataM brUyA yattadvAchyamamitrahan
shlokas.4:
tvayA dharmArthayuktaM cheduktaM shivamanAmayam |
hitaM nAdAsyate bAlo diShTasya vashameShyati
shlokas.5:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
dharmyamasmaddhitaM chaiva kurUNAM yadanAmayam |
eSha yAsyAmi rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTramabhIpsayA
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vyapete tamasi sUrye vimala udgate |
maitre muhUrte samprApte mRRidvarchiShi divAkare
shlokas.7:
kaumude mAsi revatyAM sharadante himAgame |
sphItasasyasukhe kAle kalyaH sattvavatAM varaH
shlokas.8:
ma~NgalyAH puNyanirghoShA vAchaH shRRiNva.nshcha sUnRRitAH |
brAhmaNAnAM pratItAnAmRRiShINAmiva vAsavaH
shlokas.9:
kRRitvA paurvAhNikaM kRRityaM snAtaH shuchirala~NkRRitaH |
upatasthe vivasvantaM pAvakaM cha janArdanaH
shlokas.10:
RRiShabhaM pRRiShTha Alabhya brAhmaNAnabhivAdya cha |
agniM pradakShiNaM kRRitvA pashyankalyANamagrataH
shlokas.11:
tatpratij~nAya vachanaM pANDavasya janArdanaH |
shinernaptAramAsInamabhyabhAShata sAtyakim
shlokas.12:
ratha AropyatAM sha~NkhashchakraM cha gadayA saha |
upAsa~NgAshcha shaktyashcha sarvapraharaNAni cha
shlokas.13:
duryodhano hi duShTAtmA karNashcha sahasaubalaH |
na cha shatruravaj~neyaH prAkRRito.api balIyasA
shlokas.14:
tatastanmatamAj~nAya keshavasya puraHsarAH |
prasasruryojayiShyanto rathaM chakragadAbhRRitaH
shlokas.15:
taM dIptamiva kAlAgnimAkAshagamivAdhvagam |
chandrasUryaprakAshAbhyAM chakrAbhyAM samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.16:
ardhachandraishcha chandraishcha matsyaiH samRRigapakShibhiH |
puShpaishcha vividhaishchitraM maNiratnaishcha sarvashaH
shlokas.17:
taruNAdityasa~NkAshaM bRRihantaM chArudarshanam |
maNihemavichitrA~NgaM sudhvajaM supatAkinam
shlokas.18:
sUpaskaramanAdhRRiShyaM vaiyAghraparivAraNam |
yashoghnaM pratyamitrANAM yadUnAM nandivardhanam
shlokas.19:
vAjibhiH sainyasugrIvameghapuShpabalAhakaiH |
snAtaiH sampAdayAM chakruH sampannaiH sarvasampadA
shlokas.20:
mahimAnaM tu kRRiShNasya bhUya evAbhivardhayan |
sughoShaH patagendreNa dhvajena yuyuje rathaH
shlokas.21:
taM merushikharaprakhyaM meghadundubhinisvanam |
Aruroha rathaM shaurirvimAnamiva puNyakRRit
shlokas.22:
tataH sAtyakimAropya prayayau puruShottamaH |
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha rathaghoSheNa nAdayan
shlokas.23:
vyapoDhAbhraghanaH kAlaH kShaNena samapadyata |
shivashchAnuvavau vAyuH prashAntamabhavadrajaH
shlokas.24:
pradakShiNAnulomAshcha ma~NgalyA mRRigapakShiNaH |
prayANe vAsudevasya babhUvuranuyAyinaH
shlokas.25:
ma~NgalyArthapadaiH shabdairanvavartanta sarvashaH |
sArasAH shatapatrAshcha ha.nsAshcha madhusUdanam
shlokas.26:
mantrAhutimahAhomairhUyamAnashcha pAvakaH |
pradakShiNashikho bhUtvA vidhUmaH samapadyata
shlokas.27:
vasiShTho vAmadevashcha bhUridyumno gayaH krathaH |
shukranAradavAlmIkA marutaH kushiko bhRRiguH
shlokas.28:
brahmadevarShayashchaiva kRRiShNaM yadusukhAvaham |
pradakShiNamavartanta sahitA vAsavAnujam
shlokas.29:
evametairmahAbhAgairmaharShigaNasAdhubhiH |
pUjitaH prayayau kRRiShNaH kurUNAM sadanaM prati
shlokas.30:
taM prayAntamanuprAyAtkuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
bhImasenArjunau chobhau mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.31:
chekitAnashcha vikrAnto dhRRiShTaketushcha chedipaH |
drupadaH kAshirAjashcha shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH
shlokas.32:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH saputrashcha virATaH kekayaiH saha |
sa.nsAdhanArthaM prayayuH kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabham
shlokas.33:
tato.anuvrajya govindaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
rAj~nAM sakAshe dyutimAnuvAchedaM vachastadA
shlokas.34:
yo naiva kAmAnna bhayAnna lobhAnnArthakAraNAt |
anyAyamanuvarteta sthirabuddhiralolupaH
shlokas.35:
dharmaj~no dhRRitimAnprAj~naH sarvabhUteShu keshavaH |
IshvaraH sarvabhUtAnAM devadevaH pratApavAn
shlokas.36:
taM sarvaguNasampannaM shrIvatsakRRitalakShaNam |
sampariShvajya kaunteyaH sa.ndeShTumupachakrame
shlokas.37:
yA sA bAlyAtprabhRRityasmAnparyavardhayatAbalA |
upavAsatapaHshIlA sadA svastyayane ratA
shlokas.38:
devatAtithipUjAsu gurushushrUShaNe ratA |
vatsalA priyaputrA cha priyAsmAkaM janArdana
shlokas.39:
suyodhanabhayAdyA no.atrAyatAmitrakarshana |
mahato mRRityusambAdhAduttarannaurivArNavAt
shlokas.40:
asmatkRRite cha satataM yayA duHkhAni mAdhava |
anubhUtAnyaduHkhArhA tAM sma pRRichCheranAmayam
shlokas.41:
bhRRishamAshvAsayeshchainAM putrashokapariplutAm |
abhivAdya svajethAshcha pANDavAnparikIrtayan
shlokas.42:
UDhAtprabhRRiti duHkhAni shvashurANAmari.ndama |
nikArAnatadarhA cha pashyantI duHkhamashnute
shlokas.43:
api jAtu sa kAlaH syAtkRRiShNa duHkhaviparyayaH |
yadahaM mAtaraM kliShTAM sukhe dadhyAmari.ndama
shlokas.44:
pravrajanto.anvadhAvatsA kRRipaNA putragRRiddhinI |
rudatImapahAyainAmupagachChAma yadvanam
shlokas.45:
na nUnaM mriyate duHkhaiH sA chejjIvati keshava |
tathA putrAdhibhirgADhamArtA hyAnartasatkRRitA
shlokas.46:
abhivAdyA tu sA kRRiShNa tvayA madvachanAdvibho |
dhRRitarAShTrashcha kauravyo rAjAnashcha vayo.adhikAH
shlokas.47:
bhIShmaM droNaM kRRipaM chaiva mahArAjaM cha bAhlikam |
drauNiM cha somadattaM cha sarvA.nshcha bharatAnpRRithak
shlokas.48:
viduraM cha mahAprAj~naM kurUNAM mantradhAriNam |
agAdhabuddhiM dharmaj~naM svajethA madhusUdana
shlokas.49:
ityuktvA keshavaM tatra rAjamadhye yudhiShThiraH |
anuj~nAto nivavRRite kRRiShNaM kRRitvA pradakShiNam
shlokas.50:
vrajanneva tu bIbhatsuH sakhAyaM puruSharShabham |
abravItparavIraghnaM dAshArhamaparAjitam
shlokas.51:
yadasmAkaM vibho vRRittaM purA vai mantranishchaye |
ardharAjyasya govinda viditaM sarvarAjasu
shlokas.52:
tachcheddadyAdasa~Ngena satkRRityAnavamanya cha |
priyaM me syAnmahAbAho muchyeranmahato bhayAt
shlokas.53:
atashchedanyathA kartA dhArtarAShTro.anupAyavit |
antaM nUnaM kariShyAmi kShatriyANAM janArdana
shlokas.54:
evamukte pANDavena paryahRRiShyadvRRikodaraH |
muhurmuhuH krodhavashAtprAvepata cha pANDavaH
shlokas.55:
vepamAnashcha kaunteyaH prAkroshanmahato ravAn |
dhana~njayavachaH shrutvA harShotsiktamanA bhRRisham
shlokas.56:
tasya taM ninadaM shrutvA samprAvepanta dhanvinaH |
vAhanAni cha sarvANi shakRRinmUtraM prasusruvuH
shlokas.57:
ityuktvA keshavaM tatra tathA choktvA vinishchayam |
anuj~nAto nivavRRite pariShvajya janArdanam
shlokas.58:
teShu rAjasu sarveShu nivRRitteShu janArdanaH |
tUrNamabhyapataddhRRiShTaH sainyasugrIvavAhanaH
shlokas.59:
te hayA vAsudevasya dArukeNa prachoditAH |
panthAnamAchemuriva grasamAnA ivAmbaram
shlokas.60:
athApashyanmahAbAhurRRiShInadhvani keshavaH |
brAhmyA shriyA dIpyamAnAnsthitAnubhayataH pathi
shlokas.62:
kachchillokeShu kushalaM kachchiddharmaH svanuShThitaH |
brAhmaNAnAM trayo varNAH kachchittiShThanti shAsane
shlokas.63:
tebhyaH prayujya tAM pUjAM provAcha madhusUdanaH |
bhagavantaH kva sa.nsiddhAH kA vIthI bhavatAmiha
shlokas.64:
kiM vA bhagavatAM kAryamahaM kiM karavANi vaH |
kenArthenopasamprAptA bhagavanto mahItalam
shlokas.65:
tamabravIjjAmadagnya upetya madhusUdanam |
pariShvajya cha govindaM purA sucharite sakhA
shlokas.66:
devarShayaH puNyakRRito brAhmaNAshcha bahushrutAH |
rAjarShayashcha dAshArha mAnayantastapasvinaH
shlokas.67:
devAsurasya draShTAraH purANasya mahAdyute |
sametaM pArthivaM kShatraM didRRikShantashcha sarvataH
shlokas.68:
sabhAsadashcha rAjAnastvAM cha satyaM janArdana |
etanmahatprekShaNIyaM draShTuM gachChAma keshava
shlokas.69:
dharmArthasahitA vAchaH shrotumichChAma mAdhava |
tvayochyamAnAH kuruShu rAjamadhye parantapa
shlokas.70:
bhIShmadroNAdayashchaiva vidurashcha mahAmatiH |
tvaM cha yAdavashArdUla sabhAyAM vai sameShyatha
shlokas.71:
tava vAkyAni divyAni tatra teShAM cha mAdhava |
shrotumichChAma govinda satyAni cha shubhAni cha
shlokas.72:
ApRRiShTo.asi mahAbAho punardrakShyAmahe vayam |
yAhyavighnena vai vIra drakShyAmastvAM sabhAgatam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prayAntaM devakIputraM paravIrarujo dasha |
mahArathA mahAbAhumanvayuH shastrapANayaH
shlokas.2:
padAtInAM sahasraM cha sAdinAM cha parantapa |
bhojyaM cha vipulaM rAjanpreShyAshcha shatasho.apare
shlokas.3:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM prayAto dAshArho mahAtmA madhusUdanaH |
kAni vA vrajatastasya nimittAni mahaujasaH
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya prayANe yAnyAsannadbhutAni mahAtmanaH |
tAni me shRRiNu divyAni daivAnyautpAtikAni cha
shlokas.5:
anabhre.ashaninirghoShaH savidyutsamajAyata |
anvageva cha parjanyaH prAvarShadvighane bhRRisham
shlokas.6:
pratyagUhurmahAnadyaH prA~NmukhAH sindhusattamAH |
viparItA dishaH sarvA na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.7:
prAjvalannagnayo rAjanpRRithivI samakampata |
udapAnAshcha kumbhAshcha prAsi~ncha~nshatasho jalam
shlokas.8:
tamaHsa.nvRRitamapyAsItsarvaM jagadidaM tadA |
na disho nAdisho rAjanpraj~nAyante sma reNunA
shlokas.9:
prAdurAsInmahA~nshabdaH khe sharIraM na dRRishyate |
sarveShu rAjandesheShu tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.10:
prAmathnAddhAstinapuraM vAto dakShiNapashchimaH |
ArujangaNasho vRRikShAnparuSho bhImanisvanaH
shlokas.11:
yatra yatra tu vArShNeyo vartate pathi bhArata |
tatra tatra sukho vAyuH sarvaM chAsItpradakShiNam
shlokas.12:
vavarSha puShpavarShaM cha kamalAni cha bhUrishaH |
samashcha panthA nirduHkho vyapetakushakaNTakaH
shlokas.13:
sa gachChanbrAhmaNai rAja.nstatra tatra mahAbhujaH |
archyate madhuparkaishcha sumanobhirvasupradaH
shlokas.14:
taM kiranti mahAtmAnaM vanyaiH puShpaiH sugandhibhiH |
striyaH pathi samAgamya sarvabhUtahite ratam
shlokas.15:
sa shAlibhavanaM ramyaM sarvasasyasamAchitam |
sukhaM paramadharmiShThamatyagAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
pashyanbahupashUngrAmAnramyAnhRRidayatoShaNAn |
purANi cha vyatikrAmanrAShTrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.17:
nityahRRiShTAH sumanaso bhAratairabhirakShitAH |
nodvignAH parachakrANAmanayAnAmakovidAH
shlokas.18:
upaplavyAdathAyAntaM janAH puranivAsinaH |
pathyatiShThanta sahitA viShvaksenadidRRikShayA
shlokas.19:
te tu sarve sunAmAnamagnimiddhamiva prabhum |
archayAmAsurarchyaM taM deshAtithimupasthitam
shlokas.20:
vRRikasthalaM samAsAdya keshavaH paravIrahA |
prakIrNarashmAvAditye vimale lohitAyati
shlokas.21:
avatIrya rathAttUrNaM kRRitvA shauchaM yathAvidhi |
rathamochanamAdishya sandhyAmupavivesha ha
shlokas.22:
dAruko.api hayAnmuktvA paricharya cha shAstrataH |
mumocha sarvaM varmANi muktvA chainAnavAsRRijat
shlokas.23:
abhyatItya tu tatsarvamuvAcha madhusUdanaH |
yudhiShThirasya kAryArthamiha vatsyAmahe kShapAm
shlokas.24:
tasya tanmatamAj~nAya chakrurAvasathaM narAH |
kShaNena chAnnapAnAni guNavanti samArjayan
shlokas.25:
tasmingrAme pradhAnAstu ya AsanbrAhmaNA nRRipa |
AryAH kulInA hrImanto brAhmIM vRRittimanuShThitAH
shlokas.26:
te.abhigamya mahAtmAnaM hRRiShIkeshamari.ndamam |
pUjAM chakruryathAnyAyamAshIrma~Ngalasa.nyutAm
shlokas.27:
te pUjayitvA dAshArhaM sarvalokeShu pUjitam |
nyavedayanta veshmAni ratnavanti mahAtmane
shlokas.28:
tAnprabhuH kRRitamityuktvA satkRRitya cha yathArhataH |
abhyetya teShAM veshmAni punarAyAtsahaiva taiH
shlokas.29:
sumRRiShTaM bhojayitvA cha brAhmaNA.nstatra keshavaH |
bhuktvA cha saha taiH sarvairavasattAM kShapAM sukham

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA dUtaiH samAj~nAya AyAntaM madhusUdanam |
dhRRitarAShTro.abravIdbhIShmamarchayitvA mahAbhujam
shlokas.2:
droNaM cha sa~njayaM chaiva viduraM cha mahAmatim |
duryodhanaM cha sAmAtyaM hRRiShTaromAbravIdidam
shlokas.3:
adbhutaM mahadAshcharyaM shrUyate kurunandana |
striyo bAlAshcha vRRiddhAshcha kathayanti gRRihe gRRihe
shlokas.4:
satkRRityAchakShate chAnye tathaivAnye samAgatAH |
pRRithagvAdAshcha vartante chatvareShu sabhAsu cha
shlokas.5:
upayAsyati dAshArhaH pANDavArthe parAkramI |
sa no mAnyashcha pUjyashcha sarvathA madhusUdanaH
shlokas.6:
tasminhi yAtrA lokasya bhUtAnAmIshvaro hi saH |
tasmindhRRitishcha vIryaM cha praj~nA chaujashcha mAdhave
shlokas.7:
sa mAnyatAM narashreShThaH sa hi dharmaH sanAtanaH |
pUjito hi sukhAya syAdasukhaH syAdapUjitaH
shlokas.8:
sa chettuShyati dAshArha upachArairari.ndamaH |
kRRitsnAnsarvAnabhiprAyAnprApsyAmaH sarvarAjasu
shlokas.9:
tasya pUjArthamadyaiva sa.nvidhatsva parantapa |
sabhAH pathi vidhIyantAM sarvakAmasamAhitAH
shlokas.10:
yathA prItirmahAbAho tvayi jAyeta tasya vai |
tathA kuruShva gAndhAre kathaM vA bhIShma manyase
shlokas.11:
tato bhIShmAdayaH sarve dhRRitarAShTraM janAdhipam |
UchuH paramamityevaM pUjayanto.asya tadvachaH
shlokas.12:
teShAmanumataM j~nAtvA rAjA duryodhanastadA |
sabhAvAstUni ramyANi pradeShTumupachakrame
shlokas.13:
tato desheShu desheShu ramaNIyeShu bhAgashaH |
sarvaratnasamAkIrNAH sabhAshchakruranekashaH
shlokas.14:
AsanAni vichitrANi yuktAni vividhairguNaiH |
striyo gandhAnala~NkArAnsUkShmANi vasanAni cha
shlokas.15:
guNavantyannapAnAni bhojyAni vividhAni cha |
mAlyAni cha sugandhIni tAni rAjA dadau tataH
shlokas.16:
visheShatashcha vAsArthaM sabhAM grAme vRRikasthale |
vidadhe kauravo rAjA bahuratnAM manoramAm
shlokas.17:
etadvidhAya vai sarvaM devArhamatimAnuSham |
Achakhyau dhRRitarAShTrAya rAjA duryodhanastadA
shlokas.18:
tAH sabhAH keshavaH sarvA ratnAni vividhAni cha |
asamIkShyaiva dAshArha upAyAtkurusadma tat

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
upaplavyAdiha kShattarupayAto janArdanaH |
vRRikasthale nivasati sa cha prAtariheShyati
shlokas.2:
AhukAnAmadhipatiH purogaH sarvasAtvatAm |
mahAmanA mahAvIryo mahAmAtro janArdanaH
shlokas.3:
sphItasya vRRiShNiva.nshasya bhartA goptA cha mAdhavaH |
trayANAmapi lokAnAM bhagavAnprapitAmahaH
shlokas.4:
vRRiShNyandhakAH sumanaso yasya praj~nAmupAsate |
AdityA vasavo rudrA yathA buddhiM bRRihaspateH
shlokas.5:
tasmai pUjAM prayokShyAmi dAshArhAya mahAtmane |
pratyakShaM tava dharmaj~na tanme kathayataH shRRiNu
shlokas.6:
ekavarNaiH sukRRiShNA~NgairbAhlijAtairhayottamaiH |
chaturyuktAnrathA.nstasmai raukmAndAsyAmi ShoDasha
shlokas.7:
nityaprabhinnAnmAta~NgAnIShAdantAnprahAriNaH |
aShTAnucharamekaikamaShTau dAsyAmi keshave
shlokas.8:
dAsInAmaprajAtAnAM shubhAnAM rukmavarchasAm |
shatamasmai pradAsyAmi dAsAnAmapi tAvataH
shlokas.9:
AvikaM bahu susparshaM pArvatIyairupAhRRitam |
tadapyasmai pradAsyAmi sahasrANi dashAShTa cha
shlokas.10:
ajinAnAM sahasrANi chInadeshodbhavAni cha |
tAnyapyasmai pradAsyAmi yAvadarhati keshavaH
shlokas.11:
divA rAtrau cha bhAtyeSha sutejA vimalo maNiH |
tamapyasmai pradAsyAmi tamapyarhati keshavaH
shlokas.12:
ekenApi patatyahnA yojanAni chaturdasha |
yAnamashvatarIyuktaM dAsye tasmai tadapyaham
shlokas.13:
yAvanti vAhanAnyasya yAvantaH puruShAshcha te |
tato.aShTaguNamapyasmai bhojyaM dAsyAmyahaM sadA
shlokas.14:
mama putrAshcha pautrAshcha sarve duryodhanAdRRite |
pratyudyAsyanti dAshArhaM rathairmRRiShTairala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.15:
svala~NkRRitAshcha kalyANyaH pAdaireva sahasrashaH |
vAramukhyA mahAbhAgaM pratyudyAsyanti keshavam
shlokas.16:
nagarAdapi yAH kAshchidgamiShyanti janArdanam |
draShTuM kanyAshcha kalyANyastAshcha yAsyantyanAvRRitAH
shlokas.17:
sastrIpuruShabAlaM hi nagaraM madhusUdanam |
udIkShate mahAtmAnaM bhAnumantamiva prajAH
shlokas.18:
mahAdhvajapatAkAshcha kriyantAM sarvatodisham |
jalAvasikto virajAH panthAstasyeti chAnvashAt
shlokas.19:
duHshAsanasya cha gRRihaM duryodhanagRRihAdvaram |
tadasya kriyatAM kShipraM susaMmRRiShTamala~NkRRitam
shlokas.20:
etaddhi ruchirAkAraiH prAsAdairupashobhitam |
shivaM cha ramaNIyaM cha sarvartu sumahAdhanam
shlokas.21:
sarvamasmingRRihe ratnaM mama duryodhanasya cha |
yadyadarhetsa vArShNeyastattaddeyamasa.nshayam

shlokas.1:
vidura uvAcha||
rAjanbahumatashchAsi trailokyasyApi sattamaH |
sambhAvitashcha lokasya saMmatashchAsi bhArata
shlokas.2:
yattvameva~Ngate brUyAH pashchime vayasi sthitaH |
shAstrAdvA supratarkAdvA susthiraH sthaviro hyasi
shlokas.3:
lekhAshmanIva bhAH sUrye mahormiriva sAgare |
dharmastvayi mahAnrAjanniti vyavasitAH prajAH
shlokas.4:
sadaiva bhAvito loko guNaughaistava pArthiva |
guNAnAM rakShaNe nityaM prayatasva sabAndhavaH
shlokas.5:
ArjavaM pratipadyasva mA bAlyAdbahudhA nashIH |
rAjyaM putrA.nshcha pautrA.nshcha suhRRidashchApi supriyAn
shlokas.6:
yattvaM ditsasi kRRiShNAya rAjannatithaye bahu |
etadanyachcha dAshArhaH pRRithivImapi chArhati
shlokas.7:
na tu tvaM dharmamuddishya tasya vA priyakAraNAt |
etadichChasi kRRiShNAya satyenAtmAnamAlabhe
shlokas.8:
mAyaiShAtattvamevaitachChadmaitadbhUridakShiNa |
jAnAmi te mataM rAjangUDhaM bAhyena karmaNA
shlokas.9:
pa~ncha pa~nchaiva lipsanti grAmakAnpANDavA nRRipa |
na cha ditsasi tebhyastA.nstachChamaM kaH kariShyati
shlokas.10:
arthena tu mahAbAhuM vArShNeyaM tvaM jihIrShasi |
anenaivAbhyupAyena pANDavebhyo bibhitsasi
shlokas.11:
na cha vittena shakyo.asau nodyamena na garhayA |
anyo dhana~njayAtkartumetattattvaM bravImi te
shlokas.12:
veda kRRiShNasya mAhAtmyaM vedAsya dRRiDhabhaktitAm |
atyAjyamasya jAnAmi prANaistulyaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.13:
anyatkumbhAdapAM pUrNAdanyatpAdAvasechanAt |
anyatkushalasamprashnAnnaiShiShyati janArdanaH
shlokas.14:
yattvasya priyamAtithyaM mAnArhasya mahAtmanaH |
tadasmai kriyatAM rAjanmAnArho hi janArdanaH
shlokas.15:
Asha.nsamAnaH kalyANaM kurUnabhyeti keshavaH |
yenaiva rAjannarthena tadevAsmA upAkuru
shlokas.16:
shamamichChati dAshArhastava duryodhanasya cha |
pANDavAnAM cha rAjendra tadasya vachanaM kuru
shlokas.17:
pitAsi rAjanputrAste vRRiddhastvaM shishavaH pare |
vartasva pitRRivatteShu vartante te hi putravat

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
yadAha viduraH kRRiShNe sarvaM tatsatyamuchyate |
anurakto hyasaMhAryaH pArthAnprati janArdanaH
shlokas.2:
yattu satkArasa.nyuktaM deyaM vasu janArdane |
anekarUpaM rAjendra na taddeyaM kadAchana
shlokas.3:
deshaH kAlastathAyukto na hi nArhati keshavaH |
ma.nsyatyadhokShajo rAjanbhayAdarchati mAmiti
shlokas.4:
avamAnashcha yatra syAtkShatriyasya vishAM pate |
na tatkuryAdbudhaH kAryamiti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.5:
sa hi pUjyatamo devaH kRRiShNaH kamalalochanaH |
trayANAmapi lokAnAM viditaM mama sarvathA
shlokas.6:
na tu tasminpradeyaM syAttathA kAryagatiH prabho |
vigrahaH samupArabdho na hi shAmyatyavigrahAt
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA bhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH |
vaichitravIryaM rAjAnamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.8:
satkRRito.asatkRRito vApi na krudhyeta janArdanaH |
nAlamanyamavaj~nAtumavaj~nAto.api keshavaH
shlokas.9:
yattu kAryaM mahAbAho manasA kAryatAM gatam |
sarvopAyairna tachChakyaM kenachitkartumanyathA
shlokas.10:
sa yadbrUyAnmahAbAhustatkAryamavisha~NkayA |
vAsudevena tIrthena kShipraM sa.nshAmya pANDavaiH
shlokas.11:
dharmyamarthyaM sa dharmAtmA dhruvaM vaktA janArdanaH |
tasminvAchyAH priyA vAcho bhavatA bAndhavaiH saha
shlokas.12:
duryodhana uvAcha||
na paryAyo.asti yadrAja~nshriyaM niShkevalAmaham |
taiH sahemAmupAshnIyAM jIva~njIvaiH pitAmaha
shlokas.13:
idaM tu sumahatkAryaM shRRiNu me yatsamarthitam |
parAyaNaM pANDavAnAM niya.nsyAmi janArdanam
shlokas.14:
tasminbaddhe bhaviShyanti vRRiShNayaH pRRithivI tathA |
pANDavAshcha vidheyA me sa cha prAtariheShyati
shlokas.15:
atropAyaM yathA samya~Nna budhyeta janArdanaH |
na chApAyo bhavetkashchittadbhavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA ghoraM kRRiShNAbhisaMhitam |
dhRRitarAShTraH sahAmAtyo vyathito vimanAbhavat
shlokas.17:
tato duryodhanamidaM dhRRitarAShTro.abravIdvachaH |
maivaM vochaH prajApAla naiSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.18:
dUtashcha hi hRRiShIkeshaH sambandhI cha priyashcha naH |
apApaH kauraveyeShu kathaM bandhanamarhati
shlokas.19:
bhIShma uvAcha||
parIto dhRRitarAShTrAyaM tava putraH sumandadhIH |
vRRiNotyanarthaM na tvarthaM yAchyamAnaH suhRRidgaNaiH
shlokas.20:
imamutpathi vartantaM pApaM pApAnubandhinam |
vAkyAni suhRRidAM hitvA tvamapyasyAnuvartase
shlokas.21:
kRRiShNamakliShTakarmANamAsAdyAyaM sudurmatiH |
tava putraH sahAmAtyaH kShaNena na bhaviShyati
shlokas.22:
pApasyAsya nRRisha.nsasya tyaktadharmasya durmateH |
notsahe.anarthasa.nyuktAM vAchaM shrotuM katha~nchana
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA bharatashreShTho vRRiddhaH paramamanyumAn |
utthAya tasmAtprAtiShThadbhIShmaH satyaparAkramaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prAtarutthAya kRRiShNastu kRRitavAnsarvamAhnikam |
brAhmaNairabhyanuj~nAtaH prayayau nagaraM prati
shlokas.2:
taM prayAntaM mahAbAhumanuj~nApya tato nRRipa |
paryavartanta te sarve vRRikasthalanivAsinaH
shlokas.3:
dhArtarAShTrAstamAyAntaM pratyujjagmuH svala~NkRRitAH |
duryodhanamRRite sarve bhIShmadroNakRRipAdayaH
shlokas.4:
paurAshcha bahulA rAjanhRRiShIkeshaM didRRikShavaH |
yAnairbahuvidhairanye padbhireva tathApare
shlokas.5:
sa vai pathi samAgamya bhIShmeNAkliShTakarmaNA |
droNena dhArtarAShTraishcha tairvRRito nagaraM yayau
shlokas.6:
kRRiShNasaMmAnanArthaM cha nagaraM samala~NkRRitam |
babhUvU rAjamArgAshcha bahuratnasamAchitAH
shlokas.7:
na sma kashchidgRRihe rAja.nstadAsIdbharatarShabha |
na strI na vRRiddho na shishurvAsudevadidRRikShayA
shlokas.8:
rAjamArge narA na sma sambhavantyavaniM gatAH |
tathA hi sumahadrAjanhRRiShIkeshapraveshane
shlokas.9:
AvRRitAni varastrIbhirgRRihANi sumahAntyapi |
prachalantIva bhAreNa dRRishyante sma mahItale
shlokas.10:
tathA cha gatimantaste vAsudevasya vAjinaH |
pranaShTagatayo.abhUvanrAjamArge narairvRRite
shlokas.11:
sa gRRihaM dhRRitarAShTrasya prAvishachChatrukarshanaH |
pANDuraM puNDarIkAkShaH prAsAdairupashobhitam
shlokas.12:
tisraH kakShyA vyatikramya keshavo rAjaveshmanaH |
vaichitravIryaM rAjAnamabhyagachChadari.ndamaH
shlokas.13:
abhyAgachChati dAshArhe praj~nAchakShurnareshvaraH |
sahaiva droNabhIShmAbhyAmudatiShThanmahAyashAH
shlokas.14:
kRRipashcha somadattashcha mahArAjashcha bAhlikaH |
Asanebhyo.achalansarve pUjayanto janArdanam
shlokas.15:
tato rAjAnamAsAdya dhRRitarAShTraM yashasvinam |
sa bhIShmaM pUjayAmAsa vArShNeyo vAgbhira~njasA
shlokas.16:
teShu dharmAnupUrvIM tAM prayujya madhusUdanaH |
yathAvayaH samIyAya rAjabhistatra mAdhavaH
shlokas.17:
atha droNaM saputraM sa bAhlIkaM cha yashasvinam |
kRRipaM cha somadattaM cha samIyAya janArdanaH
shlokas.18:
tatrAsIdUrjitaM mRRiShTaM kA~nchanaM mahadAsanam |
shAsanAddhRRitarAShTrasya tatropAvishadachyutaH
shlokas.19:
atha gAM madhuparkaM chApyudakaM cha janArdane |
upajahruryathAnyAyaM dhRRitarAShTrapurohitAH
shlokas.20:
kRRitAtithyastu govindaH sarvAnparihasankurUn |
Aste sambandhakaM kurvankurubhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.21:
so.archito dhRRitarAShTreNa pUjitashcha mahAyashAH |
rAjAnaM samanuj~nApya nirAkrAmadari.ndamaH
shlokas.22:
taiH sametya yathAnyAyaM kurubhiH kurusa.nsadi |
vidurAvasathaM ramyamupAtiShThata mAdhavaH
shlokas.23:
viduraH sarvakalyANairabhigamya janArdanam |
archayAmAsa dAshArhaM sarvakAmairupasthitam
shlokas.24:
kRRitAtithyaM tu govindaM viduraH sarvadharmavit |
kushalaM pANDuputrANAmapRRichChanmadhusUdanam
shlokas.25:
prIyamANasya suhRRido viduSho buddhisattamaH |
dharmanityasya cha tadA gatadoShasya dhImataH
shlokas.26:
tasya sarvaM savistAraM pANDavAnAM vicheShTitam |
kShatturAchaShTa dAshArhaH sarvapratyakShadarshivAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athopagamya viduramaparAhNe janArdanaH |
pitRRiShvasAraM govindaH so.abhyagachChadari.ndamaH
shlokas.2:
sA dRRiShTvA kRRiShNamAyAntaM prasannAdityavarchasam |
kaNThe gRRihItvA prAkroshatpRRithA pArthAnanusmaran
shlokas.3:
teShAM sattvavatAM madhye govindaM sahachAriNam |
chirasya dRRiShTvA vArShNeyaM bAShpamAhArayatpRRithA
shlokas.4:
sAbravItkRRiShNamAsInaM kRRitAtithyaM yudhAM patim |
bAShpagadgadapUrNena mukhena parishuShyatA
shlokas.5:
ye te bAlyAtprabhRRityeva gurushushrUShaNe ratAH |
parasparasya suhRRidaH saMmatAH samachetasaH
shlokas.6:
nikRRityA bhra.nshitA rAjyAjjanArhA nirjanaM gatAH |
vinItakrodhaharShAshcha brahmaNyAH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.7:
tyaktvA priyasukhe pArthA rudantImapahAya mAm |
ahArShushcha vanaM yAntaH samUlaM hRRidayaM mama
shlokas.8:
atadarhA mahAtmAnaH kathaM keshava pANDavAH |
UShurmahAvane tAta siMhavyAghragajAkule
shlokas.9:
bAlA vihInAH pitrA te mayA satatalAlitAH |
apashyantaH svapitarau kathamUShurmahAvane
shlokas.10:
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShairmRRida~NgairvaiNavairapi |
pANDavAH samabodhyanta bAlyAtprabhRRiti keshava
shlokas.11:
ye sma vAraNashabdena hayAnAM heShitena cha |
rathanemininAdaishcha vyabodhyanta sadA gRRihe
shlokas.12:
sha~NkhabherIninAdena veNuvINAnunAdinA |
puNyAhaghoShamishreNa pUjyamAnA dvijAtibhiH
shlokas.13:
vastrai ratnairala~NkAraiH pUjayanto dvijanmanaH |
gIrbhirma~NgalayuktAbhirbrAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.14:
architairarchanArhaishcha stuvadbhirabhinanditAH |
prAsAdAgreShvabodhyanta rA~NkavAjinashAyinaH
shlokas.15:
te nUnaM ninadaM shrutvA shvApadAnAM mahAvane |
na smopayAnti nidrAM vai atadarhA janArdana
shlokas.16:
bherImRRida~NganinadaiH sha~NkhavaiNavanisvanaiH |
strINAM gItaninAdaishcha madhurairmadhusUdana
shlokas.17:
bandimAgadhasUtaishcha stuvadbhirbodhitAH katham |
mahAvane vyabodhyanta shvApadAnAM rutena te
shlokas.18:
hrImAnsatyadhRRitirdAnto bhUtAnAmanukampitA |
kAmadveShau vashe kRRitvA satAM vartmAnuvartate
shlokas.19:
ambarIShasya mAndhAturyayAternahuShasya cha |
bharatasya dilIpasya shiberaushInarasya cha
shlokas.20:
rAjarShINAM purANAnAM dhuraM dhatte durudvahAm |
shIlavRRittopasampanno dharmaj~naH satyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.21:
rAjA sarvaguNopetastrailokyasyApi yo bhavet |
ajAtashatrurdharmAtmA shuddhajAmbUnadaprabhaH
shlokas.22:
shreShThaH kuruShu sarveShu dharmataH shrutavRRittataH |
priyadarshano dIrghabhujaH kathaM kRRiShNa yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.23:
yaH sa nAgAyutaprANo vAtaraMhA vRRikodaraH |
amarShI pANDavo nityaM priyo bhrAtuH priya~NkaraH
shlokas.24:
kIchakasya cha saj~nAteryo hantA madhusUdana |
shUraH krodhavashAnAM cha hiDimbasya bakasya cha
shlokas.25:
parAkrame shakrasamo vAyuvegasamo jave |
maheshvarasamaH krodhe bhImaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.26:
krodhaM balamamarShaM cha yo nidhAya parantapaH |
jitAtmA pANDavo.amarShI bhrAtustiShThati shAsane
shlokas.27:
tejorAshiM mahAtmAnaM balaughamamitaujasam |
bhImaM pradarshanenApi bhImasenaM janArdana
taM mamAchakShva vArShNeya kathamadya vRRikodaraH
shlokas.28:
Aste parighabAhuH sa madhyamaH pANDavo.achyuta |
arjunenArjuno yaH sa kRRiShNa bAhusahasriNA
dvibAhuH spardhate nityamatItenApi keshava
shlokas.29:
kShipatyekena vegena pa~ncha bANashatAni yaH |
iShvastre sadRRisho rAj~naH kArtavIryasya pANDavaH
shlokas.30:
tejasAdityasadRRisho maharShipratimo dame |
kShamayA pRRithivItulyo mahendrasamavikramaH
shlokas.31:
AdhirAjyaM mahaddIptaM prathitaM madhusUdana |
AhRRitaM yena vIryeNa kurUNAM sarvarAjasu
shlokas.32:
yasya bAhubalaM ghoraM kauravAH paryupAsate |
sa sarvarathinAM shreShThaH pANDavaH satyavikramaH
shlokas.33:
yo.apAshrayaH pANDavAnAM devAnAmiva vAsavaH |
sa te bhrAtA sakhA chaiva kathamadya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.34:
dayAvAnsarvabhUteShu hrIniShedho mahAstravit |
mRRidushcha sukumArashcha dhArmikashcha priyashcha me
shlokas.35:
sahadevo maheShvAsaH shUraH samitishobhanaH |
bhrAtR^INAM kRRiShNa shushrUShurdharmArthakushalo yuvA
shlokas.36:
sadaiva sahadevasya bhrAtaro madhusUdana |
vRRittaM kalyANavRRittasya pUjayanti mahAtmanaH
shlokas.37:
jyeShThApachAyinaM vIraM sahadevaM yudhAM patim |
shushrUShuM mama vArShNeya mAdrIputraM prachakShva me
shlokas.38:
sukumAro yuvA shUro darshanIyashcha pANDavaH |
bhrAtR^INAM kRRiShNa sarveShAM priyaH prANo bahishcharaH
shlokas.39:
chitrayodhI cha nakulo maheShvAso mahAbalaH |
kachchitsa kushalI kRRiShNa vatso mama sukhaidhitaH
shlokas.40:
sukhochitamaduHkhArhaM sukumAraM mahAratham |
api jAtu mahAbAho pashyeyaM nakulaM punaH
shlokas.41:
pakShmasampAtaje kAle nakulena vinAkRRitA |
na labhAmi sukhaM vIra sAdya jIvAmi pashya mAm
shlokas.42:
sarvaiH putraiH priyatamA draupadI me janArdana |
kulInA shIlasampannA sarvaiH samuditA guNaiH
shlokas.43:
putralokAtpatilokAnvRRiNvAnA satyavAdinI |
priyAnputrAnparityajya pANDavAnanvapadyata
shlokas.44:
mahAbhijanasampannA sarvakAmaiH supUjitA |
IshvarI sarvakalyANI draupadI kathamachyuta
shlokas.45:
patibhiH pa~nchabhiH shUrairagnikalpaiH prahAribhiH |
upapannA maheShvAsairdraupadI duHkhabhAginI
shlokas.46:
chaturdashamimaM varShaM yannApashyamari.ndama |
putrAdhibhiH paridyUnAM draupadIM satyavAdinIm
shlokas.47:
na nUnaM karmabhiH puNyairashnute puruShaH sukham |
draupadI chettathAvRRittA nAshnute sukhamavyayam
shlokas.48:
na priyo mama kRRiShNAya bIbhatsurna yudhiShThiraH |
bhImaseno yamau vApi yadapashyaM sabhAgatAm
shlokas.49:
na me duHkhataraM ki~nchidbhUtapUrvaM tato.adhikam |
yaddraupadIM nivAtasthAM shvashurANAM samIpagAm
shlokas.50:
AnAyitAmanAryeNa krodhalobhAnuvartinA |
sarve praikShanta kurava ekavastrAM sabhAgatAm
shlokas.51:
tatraiva dhRRitarAShTrashcha mahArAjashcha bAhlikaH |
kRRipashcha somadattashcha nirviNNAH kuravastathA
shlokas.52:
tasyAM sa.nsadi sarvasyAM kShattAraM pUjayAmyaham |
vRRittena hi bhavatyAryo na dhanena na vidyayA
shlokas.53:
tasya kRRiShNa mahAbuddhergambhIrasya mahAtmanaH |
kShattuH shIlamala~NkAro lokAnviShTabhya tiShThati
shlokas.54:
sA shokArtA cha hRRiShTA cha dRRiShTvA govindamAgatam |
nAnAvidhAni duHkhAni sarvANyevAnvakIrtayat
shlokas.55:
pUrvairAcharitaM yattatkurAjabhirari.ndama |
akShadyUtaM mRRigavadhaH kachchideShAM sukhAvaham
shlokas.56:
tanmAM dahati yatkRRiShNA sabhAyAM kurusaMnidhau |
dhArtarAShTraiH parikliShTA yathA nakushalaM tathA
shlokas.57:
nirvAsanaM cha nagarAtpravrajyA cha parantapa |
nAnAvidhAnAM duHkhAnAmAvAso.asmi janArdana
aj~nAtacharyA bAlAnAmavarodhashcha keshava
shlokas.58:
na sma kleshatamaM me syAtputraiH saha parantapa |
duryodhanena nikRRitA varShamadya chaturdasham
shlokas.59:
duHkhAdapi sukhaM na syAdyadi puNyaphalakShayaH |
na me visheSho jAtvAsIddhArtarAShTreShu pANDavaiH
shlokas.60:
tena satyena kRRiShNa tvAM hatAmitraM shriyA vRRitam |
asmAdvimuktaM sa~NgrAmAtpashyeyaM pANDavaiH saha
naiva shakyAH parAjetuM sattvaM hyeShAM tathAgatam
shlokas.61:
pitaraM tveva garheyaM nAtmAnaM na suyodhanam |
yenAhaM kuntibhojAya dhanaM dhUrtairivArpitA
shlokas.62:
bAlAM mAmAryakastubhyaM krIDantIM kanduhastakAm |
adadAtkuntibhojAya sakhA sakhye mahAtmane
shlokas.63:
sAhaM pitrA cha nikRRitA shvashuraishcha parantapa |
atyantaduHkhitA kRRiShNa kiM jIvitaphalaM mama
shlokas.64:
yanmA vAgabravInnaktaM sUtake savyasAchinaH |
putraste pRRithivIM jetA yashashchAsya divaM spRRishet
shlokas.65:
hatvA kurUngrAmajanye rAjyaM prApya dhana~njayaH |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha kaunteyastrInmedhAnAhariShyati
shlokas.66:
nAhaM tAmabhyasUyAmi namo dharmAya vedhase |
kRRiShNAya mahate nityaM dharmo dhArayati prajAH
shlokas.67:
dharmashchedasti vArShNeya tathA satyaM bhaviShyati |
tvaM chApi tattathA kRRiShNa sarvaM sampAdayiShyasi
shlokas.68:
na mAM mAdhava vaidhavyaM nArthanAsho na vairitA |
tathA shokAya bhavati yathA putrairvinAbhavaH
shlokas.69:
yAhaM gANDIvadhanvAnaM sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
dhana~njayaM na pashyAmi kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.70:
idaM chaturdashaM varShaM yannApashyaM yudhiShThiram |
dhana~njayaM cha govinda yamau taM cha vRRikodaram
shlokas.71:
jIvanAshaM pranaShTAnAM shrAddhaM kurvanti mAnavAH |
arthataste mama mRRitAsteShAM chAhaM janArdana
shlokas.72:
brUyA mAdhava rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
bhUyA.nste hIyate dharmo mA putraka vRRithA kRRithAH
shlokas.73:
parAshrayA vAsudeva yA jIvAmi dhigastu mAm |
vRRitteH kRRipaNalabdhAyA apratiShThaiva jyAyasI
shlokas.74:
atho dhana~njayaM brUyA nityodyuktaM vRRikodaram |
yadarthaM kShatriyA sUte tasya kAlo.ayamAgataH
shlokas.75:
asmi.nshchedAgate kAle kAlo vo.atikramiShyati |
lokasambhAvitAH santaH sunRRisha.nsaM kariShyatha
shlokas.76:
nRRisha.nsena cha vo yuktA.nstyajeyaM shAshvatIH samAH |
kAle hi samanuprApte tyaktavyamapi jIvitam
shlokas.77:
mAdrIputrau cha vaktavyau kShatradharmaratau sadA |
vikrameNArjitAnbhogAnvRRiNItaM jIvitAdapi
shlokas.78:
vikramAdhigatA hyarthAH kShatradharmeNa jIvataH |
mano manuShyasya sadA prINanti puruShottama
shlokas.79:
gatvA brUhi mahAbAho sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
arjunaM pANDavaM vIraM draupadyAH padavIM chara
shlokas.80:
viditau hi tavAtyantaM kruddhAviva yathAntakau |
bhImArjunau nayetAM hi devAnapi parAM gatim
shlokas.81:
tayoshchaitadavaj~nAnaM yatsA kRRiShNA sabhAM gatA |
duHshAsanashcha karNashcha paruShANyabhyabhAShatAm
shlokas.82:
duryodhano bhImasenamabhyagachChanmanasvinam |
pashyatAM kurumukhyAnAM tasya drakShyati yatphalam
shlokas.83:
na hi vairaM samAsAdya prashAmyati vRRikodaraH |
suchirAdapi bhImasya na hi vairaM prashAmyati
yAvadantaM na nayati shAtravA~nshatrukarshanaH
shlokas.84:
na duHkhaM rAjyaharaNaM na cha dyUte parAjayaH |
pravrAjanaM cha putrANAM na me tadduHkhakAraNam
shlokas.85:
yattu sA bRRihatI shyAmA ekavastrA sabhAM gatA |
ashRRiNotparuShA vAchastato duHkhataraM nu kim
shlokas.86:
strIdharmiNI varArohA kShatradharmaratA sadA |
nAdhyagachChattathA nAthaM kRRiShNA nAthavatI satI
shlokas.87:
yasyA mama saputrAyAstvaM nAtho madhusUdana |
rAmashcha balinAM shreShThaH pradyumnashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.88:
sAhameva.nvidhaM duHkhaM sahe.adya puruShottama |
bhIme jIvati durdharShe vijaye chApalAyini
shlokas.89:
tata AshvAsayAmAsa putrAdhibhirabhiplutAm |
pitRRiShvasAraM shochantIM shauriH pArthasakhaH pRRithAm
shlokas.90:
kA nu sImantinI tvAdRRiglokeShvasti pitRRiShvasaH |
shUrasya rAj~no duhitA AjamIDhakulaM gatA
shlokas.91:
mahAkulInA bhavatI hradAddhradamivAgatA |
IshvarI sarvakalyANI bhartrA paramapUjitA
shlokas.92:
vIrasUrvIrapatnI cha sarvaiH samuditA guNaiH |
sukhaduHkhe mahAprAj~ne tvAdRRishI soDhumarhati
shlokas.93:
nidrAtandrI krodhaharShau kShutpipAse himAtapau |
etAni pArthA nirjitya nityaM vIrAH sukhe ratAH
shlokas.94:
tyaktagrAmyasukhAH pArthA nityaM vIrasukhapriyAH |
na te svalpena tuShyeyurmahotsAhA mahAbalAH
shlokas.95:
antaM dhIrA niShevante madhyaM grAmyasukhapriyAH |
uttamA.nshcha parikleshAnbhogA.nshchAtIva mAnuShAn
shlokas.96:
anteShu remire dhIrA na te madhyeShu remire |
antaprAptiM sukhAmAhurduHkhamantaramantayoH
shlokas.97:
abhivAdayanti bhavatIM pANDavAH saha kRRiShNayA |
AtmAnaM cha kushalinaM nivedyAhuranAmayam
shlokas.98:
arogAnsarvasiddhArthAnkShipraM drakShyasi pANDavAn |
IshvarAnsarvalokasya hatAmitrA~nshriyA vRRitAn
shlokas.99:
evamAshvAsitA kuntI pratyuvAcha janArdanam |
putrAdhibhirabhidhvastA nigRRihyAbuddhijaM tamaH
shlokas.100:
yadyatteShAM mahAbAho pathyaM syAnmadhusUdana |
yathA yathA tvaM manyethAH kuryAH kRRiShNa tathA tathA
shlokas.101:
avilopena dharmasya anikRRityA parantapa |
prabhAvaj~nAsmi te kRRiShNa satyasyAbhijanasya cha
shlokas.102:
vyavasthAyAM cha mitreShu buddhivikramayostathA |
tvameva naH kule dharmastvaM satyaM tvaM tapo mahat
shlokas.103:
tvaM trAtA tvaM mahadbrahma tvayi sarvaM pratiShThitam |
yathaivAttha tathaivaitattvayi satyaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.104:
tAmAmantrya cha govindaH kRRitvA chAbhipradakShiNam |
prAtiShThata mahAbAhurduryodhanagRRihAnprati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pRRithAmAmantrya govindaH kRRitvA chApi pradakShiNam |
duryodhanagRRihaM shaurirabhyagachChadari.ndamaH
shlokas.2:
lakShmyA paramayA yuktaM pura.ndaragRRihopamam |
tasya kakShyA vyatikramya tisro dvAHsthairavAritaH
shlokas.3:
tato.abhraghanasa~NkAshaM girikUTamivochChritam |
shriyA jvalantaM prAsAdamAruroha mahAyashAH
shlokas.4:
tatra rAjasahasraishcha kurubhishchAbhisa.nvRRitam |
dhArtarAShTraM mahAbAhuM dadarshAsInamAsane
shlokas.5:
duHshAsanaM cha karNaM cha shakuniM chApi saubalam |
duryodhanasamIpe tAnAsanasthAndadarsha saH
shlokas.6:
abhyAgachChati dAshArhe dhArtarAShTro mahAyashAH |
udatiShThatsahAmAtyaH pUjayanmadhusUdanam
shlokas.7:
sametya dhArtarAShTreNa sahAmAtyena keshavaH |
rAjabhistatra vArShNeyaH samAgachChadyathAvayaH
shlokas.8:
tatra jAmbUnadamayaM parya~NkaM supariShkRRitam |
vividhAstaraNAstIrNamabhyupAvishadachyutaH
shlokas.9:
tasmingAM madhuparkaM cha upahRRitya janArdane |
nivedayAmAsa tadA gRRihAnrAjyaM cha kauravaH
shlokas.10:
tatra govindamAsInaM prasannAdityavarchasam |
upAsAM chakrire sarve kuravo rAjabhiH saha
shlokas.11:
tato duryodhano rAjA vArShNeyaM jayatAM varam |
nyamantrayadbhojanena nAbhyanandachcha keshavaH
shlokas.12:
tato duryodhanaH kRRiShNamabravIdrAjasa.nsadi |
mRRidupUrvaM shaThodarkaM karNamAbhAShya kauravaH
shlokas.13:
kasmAdannAni pAnAni vAsA.nsi shayanAni cha |
tvadarthamupanItAni nAgrahIstvaM janArdana
shlokas.14:
ubhayoshchAdadaH sAhyamubhayoshcha hite rataH |
sambandhI dayitashchAsi dhRRitarAShTrasya mAdhava
shlokas.15:
tvaM hi govinda dharmArthau vettha tattvena sarvashaH |
tatra kAraNamichChAmi shrotuM chakragadAdhara
shlokas.16:
sa evamukto govindaH pratyuvAcha mahAmanAH |
oghameghasvanaH kAle pragRRihya vipulaM bhujam
shlokas.17:
anambUkRRitamagrastamanirastamasa~Nkulam |
rAjIvanetro rAjAnaM hetumadvAkyamuttamam
shlokas.18:
kRRitArthA bhu~njate dUtAH pUjAM gRRihNanti chaiva hi |
kRRitArthaM mAM sahAmAtyastvamarchiShyasi bhArata
shlokas.19:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha dhArtarAShTro janArdanam |
na yuktaM bhavatAsmAsu pratipattumasAmpratam
shlokas.20:
kRRitArthaM chAkRRitArthaM cha tvAM vayaM madhusUdana |
yatAmahe pUjayituM govinda na cha shaknumaH
shlokas.21:
na cha tatkAraNaM vidmo yasminno madhusUdana |
pUjAM kRRitAM prIyamANairnAma.nsthAH puruShottama
shlokas.22:
vairaM no nAsti bhavatA govinda na cha vigrahaH |
sa bhavAnprasamIkShyaitannedRRishaM vaktumarhati
shlokas.23:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha dhArtarAShTraM janArdanaH |
abhivIkShya sahAmAtyaM dAshArhaH prahasanniva
shlokas.24:
nAhaM kAmAnna sa.nrambhAnna dveShAnnArthakAraNAt |
na hetuvAdAllobhAdvA dharmaM jahyAM katha~nchana
shlokas.25:
samprItibhojyAnyannAni ApadbhojyAni vA punaH |
na cha samprIyase rAjanna chApyApadgatA vayam
shlokas.26:
akasmAddviShase rAja~njanmaprabhRRiti pANDavAn |
priyAnuvartino bhrAtR^InsarvaiH samuditAnguNaiH
shlokas.27:
akasmAchchaiva pArthAnAM dveShaNaM nopapadyate |
dharme sthitAH pANDaveyAH kastAnkiM vaktumarhati
shlokas.28:
yastAndveShTi sa mAM dveShTi yastAnanu sa mAmanu |
aikAtmyaM mAM gataM viddhi pANDavairdharmachAribhiH
shlokas.29:
kAmakrodhAnuvartI hi yo mohAdvirurutsate |
guNavantaM cha yo dveShTi tamAhuH puruShAdhamam
shlokas.30:
yaH kalyANaguNA~nj~nAtInmohAllobhAddidRRikShate |
so.ajitAtmAjitakrodho na chiraM tiShThati shriyam
shlokas.31:
atha yo guNasampannAnhRRidayasyApriyAnapi |
priyeNa kurute vashyA.nshchiraM yashasi tiShThati
shlokas.32:
sarvametadabhoktavyamannaM duShTAbhisaMhitam |
kShatturekasya bhoktavyamiti me dhIyate matiH
shlokas.33:
evamuktvA mahAbAhurduryodhanamamarShaNam |
nishchakrAma tataH shubhrAddhArtarAShTraniveshanAt
shlokas.34:
niryAya cha mahAbAhurvAsudevo mahAmanAH |
niveshAya yayau veshma vidurasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.35:
tamabhyagachChaddroNashcha kRRipo bhIShmo.atha bAhlikaH |
kuravashcha mahAbAhuM vidurasya gRRihe sthitam
shlokas.36:
te.abhigamyAbruva.nstatra kuravo madhusUdanam |
nivedayAmo vArShNeya saratnA.nste gRRihAnvayam
shlokas.37:
tAnuvAcha mahAtejAH kauravAnmadhusUdanaH |
sarve bhavanto gachChantu sarvA me.apachitiH kRRitA
shlokas.38:
yAteShu kuruShu kShattA dAshArhamaparAjitam |
abhyarchayAmAsa tadA sarvakAmaiH prayatnavAn
shlokas.39:
tataH kShattAnnapAnAni shuchIni guNavanti cha |
upAharadanekAni keshavAya mahAtmane
shlokas.40:
tairtarpayitvA prathamaM brAhmaNAnmadhusUdanaH |
vedavidbhyo dadau kRRiShNaH paramadraviNAnyapi
shlokas.41:
tato.anuyAyibhiH sArdhaM marudbhiriva vAsavaH |
vidurAnnAni bubhuje shuchIni guNavanti cha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM bhuktavantamAshvastaM nishAyAM viduro.abravIt |
nedaM samyagvyavasitaM keshavAgamanaM tava
shlokas.2:
arthadharmAtigo mUDhaH sa.nrambhI cha janArdana |
mAnaghno mAnakAmashcha vRRiddhAnAM shAsanAtigaH
shlokas.3:
dharmashAstrAtigo mando durAtmA pragrahaM gataH |
aneyaH shreyasAM pApo dhArtarAShTro janArdana
shlokas.4:
kAmAtmA prAj~namAnI cha mitradhruksarvasha~NkitaH |
akartA chAkRRitaj~nashcha tyaktadharmaH priyAnRRitaH
shlokas.5:
etaishchAnyaishcha bahubhirdoShaireSha samanvitaH |
tvayochyamAnaH shreyo.api sa.nrambhAnna grahIShyati
shlokas.6:
senAsamudayaM dRRiShTvA pArthivaM madhusUdana |
kRRitArthaM manyate bAla AtmAnamavichakShaNaH
shlokas.7:
ekaH karNaH parA~njetuM samartha iti nishchitam |
dhArtarAShTrasya durbuddheH sa shamaM nopayAsyati
shlokas.8:
bhIShme droNe kRRipe karNe droNaputre jayadrathe |
bhUyasIM vartate vRRittiM na shame kurute manaH
shlokas.9:
nishchitaM dhArtarAShTrANAM sakarNAnAM janArdana |
bhIShmadroNakRRipAnpArthA na shaktAH prativIkShitum
shlokas.10:
sa.nvichcha dhArtarAShTrANAM sarveShAmeva keshava |
shame prayatamAnasya tava saubhrAtrakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.11:
na pANDavAnAmasmAbhiH pratideyaM yathochitam |
iti vyavasitAsteShu vachanaM syAnnirarthakam
shlokas.12:
yatra sUktaM duruktaM cha samaM syAnmadhusUdana |
na tatra pralapetprAj~no badhireShviva gAyanaH
shlokas.13:
avijAnatsu mUDheShu nirmaryAdeShu mAdhava |
na tvaM vAkyaM bruvanyuktashchANDAleShu dvijo yathA
shlokas.14:
so.ayaM balastho mUDhashcha na kariShyati te vachaH |
tasminnirarthakaM vAkyamuktaM sampatsyate tava
shlokas.15:
teShAM samupaviShTAnAM sarveShAM pApachetasAm |
tava madhyAvataraNaM mama kRRiShNa na rochate
shlokas.16:
durbuddhInAmashiShTAnAM bahUnAM pApachetasAm |
pratIpaM vachanaM madhye tava kRRiShNa na rochate
shlokas.17:
anupAsitavRRiddhatvAchChriyA mohAchcha darpitaH |
vayodarpAdamarShAchcha na te shreyo grahIShyati
shlokas.18:
balaM balavadapyasya yadi vakShyasi mAdhava |
tvayyasya mahatI sha~NkA na kariShyati te vachaH
shlokas.19:
nedamadya yudhA shakyamindreNApi sahAmaraiH |
iti vyavasitAH sarve dhArtarAShTrA janArdana
shlokas.20:
teShvevamupapanneShu kAmakrodhAnuvartiShu |
samarthamapi te vAkyamasamarthaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.21:
madhye tiShThanhastyanIkasya mando; rathAshvayuktasya balasya mUDhaH |
duryodhano manyate vItamanyuH; kRRitsnA mayeyaM pRRithivI jiteti
shlokas.22:
Asha.nsate dhRRitarAShTrasya putro; mahArAjyamasapatnaM pRRithivyAm |
tasmi~nshamaH kevalo nopalabhyo; baddhaM santamAgataM manyate.artham
shlokas.23:
paryasteyaM pRRithivI kAlapakvA; duryodhanArthe pANDavAnyoddhukAmAH |
samAgatAH sarvayodhAH pRRithivyAM; rAjAnashcha kShitipAlaiH sametAH
shlokas.24:
sarve chaite kRRitavairAH purastA;ttvayA rAjAno hRRitasArAshcha kRRiShNa |
tavodvegAtsa.nshritA dhArtarAShTrA;nsusaMhatAH saha karNena vIrAH
shlokas.25:
tyaktAtmAnaH saha duryodhanena; sRRiShTA yoddhuM pANDavAnsarvayodhAH |
teShAM madhye pravishethA yadi tvaM; na tanmataM mama dAshArha vIra
shlokas.26:
teShAM samupaviShTAnAM bahUnAM duShTachetasAm |
kathaM madhyaM prapadyethAH shatrUNAM shatrukarshana
shlokas.27:
sarvathA tvaM mahAbAho devairapi durutsahaH |
prabhAvaM pauruShaM buddhiM jAnAmi tava shatruhan
shlokas.28:
yA me prItiH pANDaveShu bhUyaH sA tvayi mAdhava |
premNA cha bahumAnAchcha sauhRRidAchcha bravImyaham

shlokas.1:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
yathA brUyAnmahAprAj~no yathA brUyAdvichakShaNaH |
yathA vAchyastvadvidhena suhRRidA madvidhaH suhRRit
shlokas.2:
dharmArthayuktaM tathyaM cha yathA tvayyupapadyate |
tathA vachanamukto.asmi tvayaitatpitRRimAtRRivat
shlokas.3:
satyaM prAptaM cha yuktaM chApyevameva yathAttha mAm |
shRRiNuShvAgamane hetuM vidurAvahito bhava
shlokas.4:
daurAtmyaM dhArtarAShTrasya kShatriyANAM cha vairitAm |
sarvametadahaM jAnankShattaH prApto.adya kauravAn
shlokas.5:
paryastAM pRRithivIM sarvAM sAshvAM sarathaku~njarAm |
yo mochayenmRRityupAshAtprApnuyAddharmamuttamam
shlokas.6:
dharmakAryaM yata~nshaktyA na chechChaknoti mAnavaH |
prApto bhavati tatpuNyamatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
manasA chintayanpApaM karmaNA nAbhirochayan |
na prApnoti phalaM tasya evaM dharmavido viduH
shlokas.8:
so.ahaM yatiShye prashamaM kShattaH kartumamAyayA |
kurUNAM sRRi~njayAnAM cha sa~NgrAme vinashiShyatAm
shlokas.9:
seyamApanmahAghorA kuruShveva samutthitA |
karNaduryodhanakRRitA sarve hyete tadanvayAH
shlokas.10:
vyasanaiH klishyamAnaM hi yo mitraM nAbhipadyate |
anunIya yathAshakti taM nRRisha.nsaM vidurbudhAH
shlokas.11:
A keshagrahaNAnmitramakAryAtsaMnivartayan |
avAchyaH kasyachidbhavati kRRitayatno yathAbalam
shlokas.12:
tatsamarthaM shubhaM vAkyaM dharmArthasahitaM hitam |
dhArtarAShTraH sahAmAtyo grahItuM vidurArhati
shlokas.13:
hitaM hi dhArtarAShTrANAM pANDavAnAM tathaiva cha |
pRRithivyAM kShatriyANAM cha yatiShye.ahamamAyayA
shlokas.14:
hite prayatamAnaM mAM sha~Nkedduryodhano yadi |
hRRidayasya cha me prItirAnRRiNyaM cha bhaviShyati
shlokas.15:
j~nAtInAM hi mitho bhede yanmitraM nAbhipadyate |
sarvayatnena madhyasthaM na tanmitraM vidurbudhAH
shlokas.16:
na mAM brUyuradharmaj~nA mUDhA asuhRRidastathA |
shakto nAvArayatkRRiShNaH sa.nrabdhAnkurupANDavAn
shlokas.17:
ubhayoH sAdhayannarthamahamAgata ityuta |
tatra yatnamahaM kRRitvA gachCheyaM nRRiShvavAchyatAm
shlokas.18:
mama dharmArthayuktaM hi shrutvA vAkyamanAmayam |
na chedAdAsyate bAlo diShTasya vashameShyati
shlokas.19:
ahApayanpANDavArthaM yathAva;chChamaM kurUNAM yadi chAchareyam |
puNyaM cha me syAchcharitaM mahArthaM; muchyera.nshcha kuravo mRRityupAshAt
shlokas.20:
api vAchaM bhAShamANasya kAvyAM; dharmArAmAmarthavatImahi.nsrAm |
avekSherandhArtarAShTrAH samarthAM; mAM cha prAptaM kuravaH pUjayeyuH
shlokas.21:
na chApi mama paryAptAH sahitAH sarvapArthivAH |
kruddhasya pramukhe sthAtuM siMhasyevetare mRRigAH
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityevamuktvA vachanaM vRRiShNInAmRRiShabhastadA |
shayane sukhasa.nsparshe shishye yadusukhAvahaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA kathayatoreva tayorbuddhimatostadA |
shivA nakShatrasampannA sA vyatIyAya sharvarI
shlokas.2:
dharmArthakAmayuktAshcha vichitrArthapadAkSharAH |
shRRiNvato vividhA vAcho vidurasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
kathAbhiranurUpAbhiH kRRiShNasyAmitatejasaH |
akAmasyeva kRRiShNasya sA vyatIyAya sharvarI
shlokas.4:
tatastu svarasampannA bahavaH sUtamAgadhAH |
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShaiH keshavaM pratyabodhayan
shlokas.5:
tata utthAya dAshArha RRiShabhaH sarvasAtvatAm |
sarvamAvashyakaM chakre prAtaHkAryaM janArdanaH
shlokas.6:
kRRitodakAryajapyaH sa hutAgniH samala~NkRRitaH |
tata AdityamudyantamupAtiShThata mAdhavaH
shlokas.7:
atha duryodhanaH kRRiShNaM shakunishchApi saubalaH |
sandhyAM tiShThantamabhyetya dAshArhamaparAjitam
shlokas.8:
AchakShetAM tu kRRiShNasya dhRRitarAShTraM sabhAgatam |
kurU.nshcha bhIShmapramukhAnrAj~naH sarvA.nshcha pArthivAn
shlokas.9:
tvAmarthayante govinda divi shakramivAmarAH |
tAvabhyanandadgovindaH sAmnA paramavalgunA
shlokas.10:
tato vimala Aditye brAhmaNebhyo janArdanaH |
dadau hiraNyaM vAsA.nsi gAshchAshvA.nshcha parantapaH
shlokas.11:
visRRiShTavantaM ratnAni dAshArhamaparAjitam |
tiShThantamupasa~Ngamya vavande sArathistadA
shlokas.12:
tamupasthitamAj~nAya rathaM divyaM mahAmanAH |
mahAbhraghananirghoShaM sarvaratnavibhUShitam
shlokas.13:
agniM pradakShiNaM kRRitvA brAhmaNA.nshcha janArdanaH |
kaustubhaM maNimAmuchya shriyA paramayA jvalan
shlokas.14:
kurubhiH sa.nvRRitaH kRRiShNo vRRiShNibhishchAbhirakShitaH |
AtiShThata rathaM shauriH sarvayAdavanandanaH
shlokas.15:
anvAruroha dAshArhaM viduraH sarvadharmavit |
sarvaprANabhRRitAM shreShThaM sarvadharmabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.16:
tato duryodhanaH kRRiShNaM shakunishchApi saubalaH |
dvitIyena rathenainamanvayAtAM parantapam
shlokas.17:
sAtyakiH kRRitavarmA cha vRRiShNInAM cha mahArathAH |
pRRiShThato.anuyayuH kRRiShNaM rathairashvairgajairapi
shlokas.18:
teShAM hemapariShkArA yuktAH paramavAjibhiH |
gachChatAM ghoShiNashchitrAshchAru babhrAjire rathAH
shlokas.19:
saMmRRiShTasa.nsiktarajaH pratipede mahApatham |
rAjarShicharitaM kAle kRRiShNo dhImA~nshriyA jvalan
shlokas.20:
tataH prayAte dAshArhe prAvAdyantaikapuShkarAH |
sha~NkhAshcha dadhmire tatra vAdyAnyanyAni yAni cha
shlokas.21:
pravIrAH sarvalokasya yuvAnaH siMhavikramAH |
parivArya rathaM shaureragachChanta parantapAH
shlokas.22:
tato.anye bahusAhasrA vichitrAdbhutavAsasaH |
asiprAsAyudhadharAH kRRiShNasyAsanpuraHsarAH
shlokas.23:
gajAH paraHshatAstatra varAshchAshvAH sahasrashaH |
prayAntamanvayurvIraM dAshArhamaparAjitam
shlokas.24:
puraM kurUNAM sa.nvRRittaM draShTukAmaM janArdanam |
savRRiddhabAlaM sastrIkaM rathyAgatamari.ndamam
shlokas.25:
vedikApAshritAbhishcha samAkrAntAnyanekashaH |
prachalantIva bhAreNa yoShidbhirbhavanAnyuta
shlokas.26:
sampUjyamAnaH kurubhiH sa.nshRRiNvanvividhAH kathAH |
yathArhaM pratisatkurvanprekShamANaH shanairyayau
shlokas.27:
tataH sabhAM samAsAdya keshavasyAnuyAyinaH |
sasha~NkhairveNunirghoShairdishaH sarvA vyanAdayan
shlokas.28:
tataH sA samitiH sarvA rAj~nAmamitatejasAm |
samprAkampata harSheNa kRRiShNAgamanakA~NkShayA
shlokas.29:
tato.abhyAshagate kRRiShNe samahRRiShyannarAdhipAH |
shrutvA taM rathanirghoShaM parjanyaninadopamam
shlokas.30:
AsAdya tu sabhAdvAramRRiShabhaH sarvasAtvatAm |
avatIrya rathAchChauriH kailAsashikharopamAt
shlokas.31:
nagameghapratIkAshAM jvalantImiva tejasA |
mahendrasadanaprakhyAM pravivesha sabhAM tataH
shlokas.32:
pANau gRRihItvA viduraM sAtyakiM cha mahAyashAH |
jyotIMShyAdityavadrAjankurUnprachChAdaya~nshriyA
shlokas.33:
agrato vAsudevasya karNaduryodhanAvubhau |
vRRiShNayaH kRRitavarmA cha AsankRRiShNasya pRRiShThataH
shlokas.34:
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya bhIShmadroNAdayastataH |
Asanebhyo.achalansarve pUjayanto janArdanam
shlokas.35:
abhyAgachChati dAshArhe praj~nAchakShurmahAmanAH |
sahaiva bhIShmadroNAbhyAmudatiShThanmahAyashAH
shlokas.36:
uttiShThati mahArAje dhRRitarAShTre janeshvare |
tAni rAjasahasrANi samuttasthuH samantataH
shlokas.37:
AsanaM sarvatobhadraM jAmbUnadapariShkRRitam |
kRRiShNArthe kalpitaM tatra dhRRitarAShTrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.38:
smayamAnastu rAjAnaM bhIShmadroNau cha mAdhavaH |
abhyabhAShata dharmAtmA rAj~nashchAnyAnyathAvayaH
shlokas.39:
tatra keshavamAnarchuH samyagabhyAgataM sabhAm |
rAjAnaH pArthivAH sarve kuravashcha janArdanam
shlokas.40:
tatra tiShThansa dAshArho rAjamadhye parantapaH |
apashyadantarikShasthAnRRiShInparapura~njayaH
shlokas.41:
tatastAnabhisamprekShya nAradapramukhAnRRiShIn |
abhyabhAShata dAshArho bhIShmaM shAntanavaM shanaiH
shlokas.42:
pArthivIM samitiM draShTumRRiShayo.abhyAgatA nRRipa |
nimantryantAmAsanaishcha satkAreNa cha bhUyasA
shlokas.43:
naiteShvanupaviShTeShu shakyaM kenachidAsitum |
pUjA prayujyatAmAshu munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.44:
RRiShI~nshAntanavo dRRiShTvA sabhAdvAramupasthitAn |
tvaramANastato bhRRityAnAsanAnItyachodayat
shlokas.45:
AsanAnyatha mRRiShTAni mahAnti vipulAni cha |
maNikA~nchanachitrANi samAjahrustatastataH
shlokas.46:
teShu tatropaviShTeShu gRRihItArgheShu bhArata |
niShasAdAsane kRRiShNo rAjAnashcha yathAsanam
shlokas.47:
duHshAsanaH sAtyakaye dadAvAsanamuttamam |
vivi.nshatirdadau pIThaM kA~nchanaM kRRitavarmaNe
shlokas.48:
avidUre.atha kRRiShNasya karNaduryodhanAvubhau |
ekAsane mahAtmAnau niShIdaturamarShaNau
shlokas.49:
gAndhArarAjaH shakunirgAndhArairabhirakShitaH |
niShasAdAsane rAjA sahaputro vishAM pate
shlokas.50:
viduro maNipIThe tu shuklaspardhyAjinottare |
sa.nspRRishannAsanaM shaurermahAmatirupAvishat
shlokas.51:
chirasya dRRiShTvA dAshArhaM rAjAnaH sarvapArthivAH |
amRRitasyeva nAtRRipyanprekShamANA janArdanam
shlokas.52:
atasIpuShpasa~NkAshaH pItavAsA janArdanaH |
vyabhrAjata sabhAmadhye hemnIvopahito maNiH
shlokas.53:
tatastUShNIM sarvamAsIdgovindagatamAnasam |
na tatra kashchitki~nchiddhi vyAjahAra pumAnkvachit

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
teShvAsIneShu sarveShu tUShNImbhUteShu rAjasu |
vAkyamabhyAdade kRRiShNaH sudaMShTro dundubhisvanaH
shlokas.2:
jImUta iva gharmAnte sarvAM sa.nshrAvayansabhAm |
dhRRitarAShTramabhiprekShya samabhAShata mAdhavaH
shlokas.3:
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha shamaH syAditi bhArata |
aprayatnena vIrANAmetadyatitumAgataH
shlokas.4:
rAjannAnyatpravaktavyaM tava niHshreyasaM vachaH |
viditaM hyeva te sarvaM veditavyamari.ndama
shlokas.5:
idamadya kulaM shreShThaM sarvarAjasu pArthiva |
shrutavRRittopasampannaM sarvaiH samuditaM guNaiH
shlokas.6:
kRRipAnukampA kAruNyamAnRRisha.nsyaM cha bhArata |
tathArjavaM kShamA satyaM kuruShvetadvishiShyate
shlokas.7:
tasminneva.nvidhe rAjankule mahati tiShThati |
tvannimittaM visheSheNa neha yuktamasAmpratam
shlokas.8:
tvaM hi vArayitA shreShThaH kurUNAM kurusattama |
mithyA pracharatAM tAta bAhyeShvAbhyantareShu cha
shlokas.9:
te putrAstava kauravya duryodhanapurogamAH |
dharmArthau pRRiShThataH kRRitvA pracharanti nRRisha.nsavat
shlokas.10:
ashiShTA gatamaryAdA lobhena hRRitachetasaH |
sveShu bandhuShu mukhyeShu tadvettha bharatarShabha
shlokas.11:
seyamApanmahAghorA kuruShveva samutthitA |
upekShyamANA kauravya pRRithivIM ghAtayiShyati
shlokas.12:
shakyA cheyaM shamayituM tvaM chedichChasi bhArata |
na duShkaro hyatra shamo mato me bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
tvayyadhInaH shamo rAjanmayi chaiva vishAM pate |
putrAnsthApaya kauravya sthApayiShyAmyahaM parAn
shlokas.14:
Aj~nA tava hi rAjendra kAryA putraiH sahAnvayaiH |
hitaM balavadapyeShAM tiShThatAM tava shAsane
shlokas.15:
tava chaiva hitaM rAjanpANDavAnAmatho hitam |
shame prayatamAnasya mama shAsanakA~NkShiNAm
shlokas.16:
svayaM niShkalamAlakShya sa.nvidhatsva vishAM pate |
sahabhUtAstu bharatAstavaiva syurjaneshvara
shlokas.17:
dharmArthayostiShTha rAjanpANDavairabhirakShitaH |
na hi shakyAstathAbhUtA yatnAdapi narAdhipa
shlokas.18:
na hi tvAM pANDavairjetuM rakShyamANaM mahAtmabhiH |
indro.api devaiH sahitaH prasaheta kuto nRRipAH
shlokas.19:
yatra bhIShmashcha droNashcha kRRipaH karNo vivi.nshatiH |
ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha somadatto.atha bAhlikaH
shlokas.20:
saindhavashcha kali~Ngashcha kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH |
yudhiShThiro bhImasenaH savyasAchI yamau tathA
shlokas.21:
sAtyakishcha mahAtejA yuyutsushcha mahArathaH |
ko nu tAnviparItAtmA yudhyeta bharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
lokasyeshvaratAM bhUyaH shatrubhishchApradhRRiShyatAm |
prApsyasi tvamamitraghna sahitaH kurupANDavaiH
shlokas.23:
tasya te pRRithivIpAlAstvatsamAH pRRithivIpate |
shreyA.nsashchaiva rAjAnaH sandhAsyante parantapa
shlokas.24:
sa tvaM putraishcha pautraishcha bhrAtRRibhiH pitRRibhistathA |
suhRRidbhiH sarvato guptaH sukhaM shakShyasi jIvitum
shlokas.25:
etAneva purodhAya satkRRitya cha yathA purA |
akhilAM bhokShyase sarvAM pRRithivIM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.26:
etairhi sahitaH sarvaiH pANDavaiH svaishcha bhArata |
anyAnvijeShyase shatrUneSha svArthastavAkhilaH
shlokas.27:
tairevopArjitAM bhUmiM bhokShyase cha parantapa |
yadi sampatsyase putraiH sahAmAtyairnarAdhipa
shlokas.28:
sa.nyuge vai mahArAja dRRishyate sumahAnkShayaH |
kShaye chobhayato rAjankaM dharmamanupashyasi
shlokas.29:
pANDavairnihataiH sa~Nkhye putrairvApi mahAbalaiH |
yadvindethAH sukhaM rAja.nstadbrUhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.30:
shUrAshcha hi kRRitAstrAshcha sarve yuddhAbhikA~NkShiNaH |
pANDavAstAvakAshchaiva tAnrakSha mahato bhayAt
shlokas.31:
na pashyema kurUnsarvAnpANDavA.nshchaiva sa.nyuge |
kShINAnubhayataH shUrAnrathebhyo rathibhirhatAn
shlokas.32:
samavetAH pRRithivyAM hi rAjAno rAjasattama |
amarShavashamApannA nAshayeyurimAH prajAH
shlokas.33:
trAhi rAjannimaM lokaM na nashyeyurimAH prajAH |
tvayi prakRRitimApanne sheShaM syAtkurunandana
shlokas.34:
shuklA vadAnyA hrImanta AryAH puNyAbhijAtayaH |
anyonyasachivA rAja.nstAnpAhi mahato bhayAt
shlokas.35:
shiveneme bhUmipAlAH samAgamya parasparam |
saha bhuktvA cha pItvA cha pratiyAntu yathAgRRiham
shlokas.36:
suvAsasaH sragviNashcha satkRRitya bharatarShabha |
amarShA.nshcha nirAkRRitya vairANi cha parantapa
shlokas.37:
hArdaM yatpANDaveShvAsItprApte.asminnAyuShaH kShaye |
tadeva te bhavatvadya shashvachcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.38:
bAlA vihInAH pitrA te tvayaiva parivardhitAH |
tAnpAlaya yathAnyAyaM putrA.nshcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.39:
bhavataiva hi rakShyAste vyasaneShu visheShataH |
mA te dharmastathaivArtho nashyeta bharatarShabha
shlokas.40:
AhustvAM pANDavA rAjannabhivAdya prasAdya cha |
bhavataH shAsanAdduHkhamanubhUtaM sahAnugaiH
shlokas.41:
dvAdashemAni varShANi vane nirvyuShitAni naH |
trayodashaM tathAj~nAtaiH sajane parivatsaram
shlokas.42:
sthAtA naH samaye tasminpiteti kRRitanishchayAH |
nAhAsma samayaM tAta tachcha no brAhmaNA viduH
shlokas.43:
tasminnaH samaye tiShTha sthitAnAM bharatarShabha |
nityaM sa~NkleshitA rAjansvarAjyA.nshaM labhemahi
shlokas.44:
tvaM dharmamarthaM yu~njAnaH samya~NnastrAtumarhasi |
gurutvaM bhavati prekShya bahUnkleshA.nstitikShmahe
shlokas.45:
sa bhavAnmAtRRipitRRivadasmAsu pratipadyatAm |
gurorgarIyasI vRRittiryA cha shiShyasya bhArata
shlokas.46:
pitrA sthApayitavyA hi vayamutpathamAsthitAH |
sa.nsthApaya pathiShvasmA.nstiShTha rAjansvavartmani
shlokas.47:
AhushchemAM pariShadaM putrAste bharatarShabha |
dharmaj~neShu sabhAsatsu neha yuktamasAmpratam
shlokas.48:
yatra dharmo hyadharmeNa satyaM yatrAnRRitena cha |
hanyate prekShamANAnAM hatAstatra sabhAsadaH
shlokas.49:
viddho dharmo hyadharmeNa sabhAM yatra prapadyate |
na chAsya shalyaM kRRintanti viddhAstatra sabhAsadaH
dharma etAnArujati yathA nadyanukUlajAn
shlokas.50:
ye dharmamanupashyantastUShNIM dhyAyanta Asate |
te satyamAhurdharmaM cha nyAyyaM cha bharatarShabha
shlokas.51:
shakyaM kimanyadvaktuM te dAnAdanyajjaneshvara |
bruvantu vA mahIpAlAH sabhAyAM ye samAsate
dharmArthau sampradhAryaiva yadi satyaM bravImyaham
shlokas.52:
pramu~nchemAnmRRityupAshAtkShatriyAnkShatriyarShabha |
prashAmya bharatashreShTha mA manyuvashamanvagAH
shlokas.53:
pitryaM tebhyaH pradAyA.nshaM pANDavebhyo yathochitam |
tataH saputraH siddhArtho bhu~NkShva bhogAnparantapa
shlokas.54:
ajAtashatruM jAnIShe sthitaM dharme satAM sadA |
saputre tvayi vRRittiM cha vartate yAM narAdhipa
shlokas.55:
dAhitashcha nirastashcha tvAmevopAshritaH punaH |
indraprasthaM tvayaivAsau saputreNa vivAsitaH
shlokas.56:
sa tatra nivasansarvAnvashamAnIya pArthivAn |
tvanmukhAnakarodrAjanna cha tvAmatyavartata
shlokas.57:
tasyaivaM vartamAnasya saubalena jihIrShatA |
rAShTrANi dhanadhAnyaM cha prayuktaH paramopadhiH
shlokas.58:
sa tAmavasthAM samprApya kRRiShNAM prekShya sabhAgatAm |
kShatradharmAdameyAtmA nAkampata yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.59:
ahaM tu tava teShAM cha shreya ichChAmi bhArata |
dharmAdarthAtsukhAchchaiva mA rAjannInashaH prajAH
shlokas.60:
anarthamarthaM manvAnA arthaM vAnarthamAtmanaH |
lobhe.atiprasRRitAnputrAnnigRRihNIShva vishAM pate
shlokas.61:
sthitAH shushrUShituM pArthAH sthitA yoddhumari.ndamAH |
yatte pathyatamaM rAja.nstasmi.nstiShTha parantapa
shlokas.62:
tadvAkyaM pArthivAH sarve hRRidayaiH samapUjayan |
na tatra kashchidvaktuM hi vAchaM prAkrAmadagrataH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminnabhihite vAkye keshavena mahAtmanA |
stimitA hRRiShTaromANa Asansarve sabhAsadaH
shlokas.2:
kaH sviduttarametasmAdvaktumutsahate pumAn |
iti sarve manobhiste chintayanti sma pArthivAH
shlokas.3:
tathA teShu cha sarveShu tUShNImbhUteShu rAjasu |
jAmadagnya idaM vAkyamabravItkurusa.nsadi
shlokas.4:
imAmekopamAM rAja~nshRRiNu satyAmasha~NkitaH |
tAM shrutvA shreya Adatsva yadi sAdhviti manyase
shlokas.5:
rAjA dambhodbhavo nAma sArvabhaumaH purAbhavat |
akhilAM bubhuje sarvAM pRRithivImiti naH shrutam
shlokas.6:
sa sma nityaM nishApAye prAtarutthAya vIryavAn |
brAhmaNAnkShatriyA.nshchaiva pRRichChannAste mahArathaH
shlokas.7:
asti kashchidvishiShTo vA madvidho vA bhavedyudhi |
shUdro vaishyaH kShatriyo vA brAhmaNo vApi shastrabhRRit
shlokas.8:
iti bruvannanvacharatsa rAjA pRRithivImimAm |
darpeNa mahatA mattaH ka~nchidanyamachintayan
shlokas.9:
taM sma vaidyA akRRipaNA brAhmaNAH sarvato.abhayAH |
pratyaShedhanta rAjAnaM shlAghamAnaM punaH punaH
shlokas.10:
pratiShidhyamAno.apyasakRRitpRRichChatyeva sa vai dvijAn |
abhimAnI shriyA mattastamUchurbrAhmaNAstadA
shlokas.11:
tapasvino mahAtmAno vedavratasamanvitAH |
udIryamANaM rAjAnaM krodhadIptA dvijAtayaH
shlokas.12:
anekajananaM sakhyaM yayoH puruShasiMhayoH |
tayostvaM na samo rAjanbhavitAsi kadAchana
shlokas.13:
evamuktaH sa rAjA tu punaH paprachCha tAndvijAn |
kva tau vIrau kvajanmAnau ki~NkarmANau cha kau cha tau
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNA UchuH||
naro nArAyaNashchaiva tApasAviti naH shrutam |
AyAtau mAnuShe loke tAbhyAM yudhyasva pArthiva
shlokas.15:
shrUyate tau mahAtmAnau naranArAyaNAvubhau |
tapo ghoramanirdeshyaM tapyete gandhamAdane
shlokas.16:
rAma uvAcha||
sa rAjA mahatIM senAM yojayitvA ShaDa~NginIm |
amRRiShyamANaH samprAyAdyatra tAvaparAjitau
shlokas.17:
sa gatvA viShamaM ghoraM parvataM gandhamAdanam |
mRRigayANo.anvagachChattau tApasAvaparAjitau
shlokas.18:
tau dRRiShTvA kShutpipAsAbhyAM kRRishau dhamanisantatau |
shItavAtAtapaishchaiva karshitau puruShottamau
abhigamyopasa~NgRRihya paryapRRichChadanAmayam
shlokas.19:
tamarchitvA mUlaphalairAsanenodakena cha |
nyamantrayetAM rAjAnaM kiM kAryaM kriyatAmiti
shlokas.20:
dambhodbhava uvAcha||
bAhubhyAM me jitA bhUmirnihatAH sarvashatravaH |
bhavadbhyAM yuddhamAkA~NkShannupayAto.asmi parvatam
AtithyaM dIyatAmetatkA~NkShitaM me chiraM prati
shlokas.21:
naranArAyaNAvUchatuH||
apetakrodhalobho.ayamAshramo rAjasattama |
na hyasminnAshrame yuddhaM kutaH shastraM kuto.anRRijuH
anyatra yuddhamAkA~NkShva bahavaH kShatriyAH kShitau
shlokas.22:
rAma uvAcha||
uchyamAnastathApi sma bhUya evAbhyabhAShata |
punaH punaH kShamyamANaH sAntvyamAnashcha bhArata
dambhodbhavo yuddhamichChannAhvayatyeva tApasau
shlokas.23:
tato narastviShIkANAM muShTimAdAya kaurava |
abravIdehi yudhyasva yuddhakAmuka kShatriya
shlokas.24:
sarvashastrANi chAdatsva yojayasva cha vAhinIm |
ahaM hi te vineShyAmi yuddhashraddhAmitaH param
shlokas.25:
dambhodbhava uvAcha||
yadyetadastramasmAsu yuktaM tApasa manyase |
etenApi tvayA yotsye yuddhArthI hyahamAgataH
shlokas.26:
rAma uvAcha||
ityuktvA sharavarSheNa sarvataH samavAkirat |
dambhodbhavastApasaM taM jighA.nsuH sahasainikaH
shlokas.27:
tasya tAnasyato ghorAniShUnparatanuchChidaH |
kadarthIkRRitya sa muniriShIkAbhirapAnudat
shlokas.28:
tato.asmai prAsRRijadghoramaiShIkamaparAjitaH |
astramapratisandheyaM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.29:
teShAmakShINi karNA.nshcha nastakA.nshchaiva mAyayA |
nimittavedhI sa muniriShIkAbhiH samarpayat
shlokas.30:
sa dRRiShTvA shvetamAkAshamiShIkAbhiH samAchitam |
pAdayornyapatadrAjA svasti me.astviti chAbravIt
shlokas.31:
tamabravInnaro rAja~nsharaNyaH sharaNaiShiNAm |
brahmaNyo bhava dharmAtmA mA cha smaivaM punaH kRRithAH
shlokas.32:
mA cha darpasamAviShTaH kShepsIH kA.nshchitkadAchana |
alpIyA.nsaM vishiShTaM vA tatte rAjanparaM hitam
shlokas.33:
kRRitapraj~no vItalobho niraha~NkAra AtmavAn |
dAntaH kShAnto mRRiduH kShemaH prajAH pAlaya pArthiva
shlokas.34:
anuj~nAtaH svasti gachCha maivaM bhUyaH samAchareH |
kushalaM brAhmaNAnpRRichCherAvayorvachanAdbhRRisham
shlokas.35:
tato rAjA tayoH pAdAvabhivAdya mahAtmanoH |
pratyAjagAma svapuraM dharmaM chaivAchinodbhRRisham
shlokas.36:
sumahachchApi tatkarma yannareNa kRRitaM purA |
tato guNaiH subahubhiH shreShTho nArAyaNo.abhavat
shlokas.37:
tasmAdyAvaddhanuHshreShThe gANDIve.astraM na yujyate |
tAvattvaM mAnamutsRRijya gachCha rAjandhana~njayam
shlokas.38:
kAkudIkaM shukaM nAkamakShisantarjanaM tathA |
santAnaM nartanaM ghoramAsyamodakamaShTamam
shlokas.39:
etairviddhAH sarva eva maraNaM yAnti mAnavAH |
unmattAshcha vicheShTante naShTasa~nj~nA vichetasaH
shlokas.40:
svapante cha plavante cha Chardayanti cha mAnavAH |
mUtrayante cha satataM rudanti cha hasanti cha
shlokas.41:
asa~NkhyeyA guNAH pArthe tadvishiShTo janArdanaH |
tvameva bhUyo jAnAsi kuntIputraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.42:
naranArAyaNau yau tau tAvevArjunakeshavau |
vijAnIhi mahArAja pravIrau puruSharShabhau
shlokas.43:
yadyetadevaM jAnAsi na cha mAmatisha~Nkase |
AryAM matiM samAsthAya shAmya bhArata pANDavaiH
shlokas.44:
atha chenmanyase shreyo na me bhedo bhavediti |
prashAmya bharatashreShTha mA cha yuddhe manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.45:
bhavatAM cha kurushreShTha kulaM bahumataM bhuvi |
tattathaivAstu bhadraM te svArthamevAnuchintaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
jAmadagnyavachaH shrutvA kaNvo.api bhagavAnRRiShiH |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyamabravItkurusa.nsadi
shlokas.2:
akShayashchAvyayashchaiva brahmA lokapitAmahaH |
tathaiva bhagavantau tau naranArAyaNAvRRiShI
shlokas.3:
AdityAnAM hi sarveShAM viShNurekaH sanAtanaH |
ajayyashchAvyayashchaiva shAshvataH prabhurIshvaraH
shlokas.4:
nimittamaraNAstvanye chandrasUryau mahI jalam |
vAyuragnistathAkAshaM grahAstArAgaNAstathA
shlokas.5:
te cha kShayAnte jagato hitvA lokatrayaM sadA |
kShayaM gachChanti vai sarve sRRijyante cha punaH punaH
shlokas.6:
muhUrtamaraNAstvanye mAnuShA mRRigapakShiNaH |
tiryagyonyashcha ye chAnye jIvalokacharAH smRRitAH
shlokas.7:
bhUyiShThena tu rAjAnaH shriyaM bhuktvAyuShaH kShaye |
maraNaM pratigachChanti bhoktuM sukRRitaduShkRRitam
shlokas.8:
sa bhavAndharmaputreNa shamaM kartumihArhati |
pANDavAH kuravashchaiva pAlayantu vasundharAm
shlokas.9:
balavAnahamityeva na mantavyaM suyodhana |
balavanto hi balibhirdRRishyante puruSharShabha
shlokas.10:
na balaM balinAM madhye balaM bhavati kaurava |
balavanto hi te sarve pANDavA devavikramAH
shlokas.11:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
mAtalerdAtukAmasya kanyAM mRRigayato varam
shlokas.12:
matastrailokyarAjasya mAtalirnAma sArathiH |
tasyaikaiva kule kanyA rUpato lokavishrutA
shlokas.13:
guNakeshIti vikhyAtA nAmnA sA devarUpiNI |
shriyA cha vapuShA chaiva striyo.anyAH sAtirichyate
shlokas.14:
tasyAH pradAnasamayaM mAtaliH saha bhAryayA |
j~nAtvA vimamRRishe rAja.nstatparaH parichintayan
shlokas.15:
dhikkhalvalaghushIlAnAmuchChritAnAM yashasvinAm |
narANAmRRiddhasattvAnAM kule kanyAprarohaNam
shlokas.16:
mAtuH kulaM pitRRikulaM yatra chaiva pradIyate |
kulatrayaM sa.nshayitaM kurute kanyakA satAm
shlokas.17:
devamAnuShalokau dvau mAnasenaiva chakShuShA |
avagAhyaiva vichitau na cha me rochate varaH
shlokas.18:
na devAnnaiva ditijAnna gandharvAnna mAnuShAn |
arochayaM varakRRite tathaiva bahulAnRRiShIn
shlokas.19:
bhAryayA tu sa saMmantrya saha rAtrau sudharmayA |
mAtalirnAgalokAya chakAra gamane matim
shlokas.20:
na me devamanuShyeShu guNakeshyAH samo varaH |
rUpato dRRishyate kashchinnAgeShu bhavitA dhruvam
shlokas.21:
ityAmantrya sudharmAM sa kRRitvA chAbhipradakShiNam |
kanyAM shirasyupAghrAya pravivesha mahItalam

shlokas.1:
kaNva uvAcha||
mAtalistu vrajanmArge nAradena maharShiNA |
varuNaM gachChatA draShTuM samAgachChadyadRRichChayA
shlokas.2:
nArado.athAbravIdenaM kva bhavAngantumudyataH |
svena vA sUta kAryeNa shAsanAdvA shatakratoH
shlokas.3:
mAtalirnAradenaivaM sampRRiShTaH pathi gachChatA |
yathAvatsarvamAchaShTa svakAryaM varuNaM prati
shlokas.4:
tamuvAchAtha sa munirgachChAvaH sahitAviti |
salileshadidRRikShArthamahamapyudyato divaH
shlokas.5:
ahaM te sarvamAkhyAsye darshayanvasudhAtalam |
dRRiShTvA tatra varaM ka~nchidrochayiShyAva mAtale
shlokas.6:
avagAhya tato bhUmimubhau mAtalinAradau |
dadRRishAte mahAtmAnau lokapAlamapAM patim
shlokas.7:
tatra devarShisadRRishIM pUjAM prApa sa nAradaH |
mahendrasadRRishIM chaiva mAtaliH pratyapadyata
shlokas.8:
tAvubhau prItamanasau kAryavattAM nivedya ha |
varuNenAbhyanuj~nAtau nAgalokaM vicheratuH
shlokas.9:
nAradaH sarvabhUtAnAmantarbhUminivAsinAm |
jAna.nshchakAra vyAkhyAnaM yantuH sarvamasheShataH
shlokas.10:
nArada uvAcha||
dRRiShTaste varuNastAta putrapautrasamAvRRitaH |
pashyodakapateH sthAnaM sarvatobhadramRRiddhimat
shlokas.11:
eSha putro mahAprAj~no varuNasyeha gopateH |
eSha taM shIlavRRittena shauchena cha vishiShyate
shlokas.12:
eSho.asya putro.abhimataH puShkaraH puShkarekShaNaH |
rUpavAndarshanIyashcha somaputryA vRRitaH patiH
shlokas.13:
jyotsnAkAlIti yAmAhurdvitIyAM rUpataH shriyam |
Adityasyaiva goH putro jyeShThaH putraH kRRitaH smRRitaH
shlokas.14:
bhavanaM pashya vAruNyA yadetatsarvakA~nchanam |
yAM prApya suratAM prAptAH surAH surapateH sakhe
shlokas.15:
etAni hRRitarAjyAnAM daiteyAnAM sma mAtale |
dIpyamAnAni dRRishyante sarvapraharaNAnyuta
shlokas.16:
akShayANi kilaitAni vivartante sma mAtale |
anubhAvaprayuktAni surairavajitAni ha
shlokas.17:
atra rAkShasajAtyashcha bhUtajAtyashcha mAtale |
divyapraharaNAshchAsanpUrvadaivatanirmitAH
shlokas.18:
agnireSha mahArchiShmA~njAgarti varuNahrade |
vaiShNavaM chakramAviddhaM vidhUmena haviShmatA
shlokas.19:
eSha gANDImayashchApo lokasaMhArasambhRRitaH |
rakShyate daivatairnityaM yatastadgANDivaM dhanuH
shlokas.20:
eSha kRRitye samutpanne tattaddhArayate balam |
sahasrashatasa~Nkhyena prANena satataM dhruvam
shlokas.21:
ashAsyAnapi shAstyeSha rakShobandhuShu rAjasu |
sRRiShTaH prathamajo daNDo brahmaNA brahmavAdinA
shlokas.22:
etachChatraM narendrANAM mahachChakreNa bhAShitam |
putrAH salilarAjasya dhArayanti mahodayam
shlokas.23:
etatsalilarAjasya ChatraM ChatragRRihe sthitam |
sarvataH salilaM shItaM jImUta iva varShati
shlokas.24:
etachChatrAtparibhraShTaM salilaM somanirmalam |
tamasA mUrChitaM yAti yena nArChati darshanam
shlokas.25:
bahUnyadbhutarUpANi draShTavyAnIha mAtale |
tava kAryoparodhastu tasmAdgachChAva mAchiram

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
etattu nAgalokasya nAbhisthAne sthitaM puram |
pAtAlamiti vikhyAtaM daityadAnavasevitam
shlokas.2:
idamadbhiH samaM prAptA ye kechiddhruvaja~NgamAH |
pravishanto mahAnAdaM nadanti bhayapIDitAH
shlokas.3:
atrAsuro.agniH satataM dIpyate vAribhojanaH |
vyApAreNa dhRRitAtmAnaM nibaddhaM samabudhyata
shlokas.4:
atrAmRRitaM suraiH pItvA nihitaM nihatAribhiH |
ataH somasya hAnishcha vRRiddhishchaiva pradRRishyate
shlokas.5:
atra divyaM hayashiraH kAle parvaNi parvaNi |
uttiShThati suvarNAbhaM vArbhirApUraya~njagat
shlokas.6:
yasmAdatra samagrAstAH patanti jalamUrtayaH |
tasmAtpAtAlamityetatkhyAyate puramuttamam
shlokas.7:
airAvato.asmAtsalilaM gRRihItvA jagato hitaH |
megheShvAmu~nchate shItaM yanmahendraH pravarShati
shlokas.8:
atra nAnAvidhAkArAstimayo naikarUpiNaH |
apsu somaprabhAM pItvA vasanti jalachAriNaH
shlokas.9:
atra sUryA.nshubhirbhinnAH pAtAlatalamAshritAH |
mRRitA divasataH sUta punarjIvanti te nishi
shlokas.10:
udaye nityashashchAtra chandramA rashmibhirvRRitaH |
amRRitaM spRRishya sa.nsparshAtsa~njIvayati dehinaH
shlokas.11:
atra te.adharmaniratA baddhAH kAlena pIDitAH |
daiteyA nivasanti sma vAsavena hRRitashriyaH
shlokas.12:
atra bhUtapatirnAma sarvabhUtamaheshvaraH |
bhUtaye sarvabhUtAnAmacharattapa uttamam
shlokas.13:
atra govratino viprAH svAdhyAyAmnAyakarshitAH |
tyaktaprANA jitasvargA nivasanti maharShayaH
shlokas.14:
yatratatrashayo nityaM yenakenachidAshitaH |
yenakenachidAchChannaH sa govrata ihochyate
shlokas.15:
airAvato nAgarAjo vAmanaH kumudo.a~njanaH |
prasUtAH supratIkasya va.nshe vAraNasattamAH
shlokas.16:
pashya yadyatra te kashchidrochate guNato varaH |
varayiShyAva taM gatvA yatnamAsthAya mAtale
shlokas.17:
aNDametajjale nyastaM dIpyamAnamiva shriyA |
A prajAnAM nisargAdvai nodbhidyati na sarpati
shlokas.18:
nAsya jAtiM nisargaM vA kathyamAnaM shRRiNomi vai |
pitaraM mAtaraM vApi nAsya jAnAti kashchana
shlokas.19:
ataH kila mahAnagnirantakAle samutthitaH |
dhakShyate mAtale sarvaM trailokyaM sacharAcharam
shlokas.20:
kaNva uvAcha||
mAtalistvabravIchChrutvA nAradasyAtha bhAShitam |
na me.atra rochate kashchidanyato vraja mAchiram

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
hiraNyapuramityetatkhyAtaM puravaraM mahat |
daityAnAM dAnavAnAM cha mAyAshatavichAriNAm
shlokas.2:
analpena prayatnena nirmitaM vishvakarmaNA |
mayena manasA sRRiShTaM pAtAlatalamAshritam
shlokas.3:
atra mAyAsahasrANi vikurvANA mahaujasaH |
dAnavA nivasanti sma shUrA dattavarAH purA
shlokas.4:
naite shakreNa nAnyena varuNena yamena vA |
shakyante vashamAnetuM tathaiva dhanadena cha
shlokas.5:
asurAH kAlakha~njAshcha tathA viShNupadodbhavAH |
nairRRitA yAtudhAnAshcha brahmavedodbhavAshcha ye
shlokas.6:
daMShTriNo bhImarUpAshcha nivasantyAtmarakShiNaH |
mAyAvIryopasampannA nivasantyAtmarakShiNaH
shlokas.7:
nivAtakavachA nAma dAnavA yuddhadurmadAH |
jAnAsi cha yathA shakro naitA~nshaknoti bAdhitum
shlokas.8:
bahusho mAtale tvaM cha tava putrashcha gomukhaH |
nirbhagno devarAjashcha sahaputraH shachIpatiH
shlokas.9:
pashya veshmAni raukmANi mAtale rAjatAni cha |
karmaNA vidhiyuktena yuktAnyupagatAni cha
shlokas.10:
vaiDUryaharitAnIva pravAlaruchirANi cha |
arkasphaTikashubhrANi vajrasArojjvalAni cha
shlokas.11:
pArthivAnIva chAbhAnti punarnagamayAni cha |
shailAnIva cha dRRishyante tArakANIva chApyuta
shlokas.12:
sUryarUpANi chAbhAnti dIptAgnisadRRishAni cha |
maNijAlavichitrANi prA.nshUni nibiDAni cha
shlokas.13:
naitAni shakyaM nirdeShTuM rUpato dravyatastathA |
guNatashchaiva siddhAni pramANaguNavanti cha
shlokas.14:
AkrIDAnpashya daityAnAM tathaiva shayanAnyuta |
ratnavanti mahArhANi bhAjanAnyAsanAni cha
shlokas.15:
jaladAbhA.nstathA shailA.nstoyaprasravaNAnvitAn |
kAmapuShpaphalA.nshchaiva pAdapAnkAmachAriNaH
shlokas.16:
mAtale kashchidatrApi ruchitaste varo bhavet |
atha vAnyAM dishaM bhUmergachChAva yadi manyase
shlokas.17:
kaNva uvAcha||
mAtalistvabravIdenaM bhAShamANaM tathAvidham |
devarShe naiva me kAryaM vipriyaM tridivaukasAm
shlokas.18:
nityAnuShaktavairA hi bhrAtaro devadAnavAH |
aripakSheNa sambandhaM rochayiShyAmyahaM katham
shlokas.19:
anyatra sAdhu gachChAvo draShTuM nArhAmi dAnavAn |
jAnAmi tu tathAtmAnaM ditsAtmakamalaM yathA

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
ayaM lokaH suparNAnAM pakShiNAM pannagAshinAm |
vikrame gamane bhAre naiShAmasti parishramaH
shlokas.2:
vainateyasutaiH sUta ShaDbhistatamidaM kulam |
sumukhena sunAmnA cha sunetreNa suvarchasA
shlokas.3:
surUpapakShirAjena subalena cha mAtale |
vardhitAni prasUtyA vai vinatAkulakartRRibhiH
shlokas.4:
pakShirAjAbhijAtyAnAM sahasrANi shatAni cha |
kashyapasya tato va.nshe jAtairbhUtivivardhanaiH
shlokas.5:
sarve hyete shriyA yuktAH sarve shrIvatsalakShaNAH |
sarve shriyamabhIpsanto dhArayanti balAnyuta
shlokas.6:
karmaNA kShatriyAshchaite nirghRRiNA bhogibhojinaH |
j~nAtisa~NkShayakartRRitvAdbrAhmaNyaM na labhanti vai
shlokas.7:
nAmAni chaiShAM vakShyAmi yathA prAdhAnyataH shRRiNu |
mAtale shlAghyametaddhi kulaM viShNuparigraham
shlokas.8:
daivataM viShNureteShAM viShNureva parAyaNam |
hRRidi chaiShAM sadA viShNurviShNureva gatiH sadA
shlokas.9:
suvarNachUDo nAgAshI dAruNashchaNDatuNDakaH |
analashchAnilashchaiva vishAlAkSho.atha kuNDalI
shlokas.10:
kAshyapirdhvajaviShkambho vainateyo.atha vAmanaH |
vAtavego dishAchakShurnimeSho nimiShastathA
shlokas.11:
trivAraH saptavArashcha vAlmIkirdvIpakastathA |
daityadvIpaH sariddvIpaH sArasaH padmakesaraH
shlokas.12:
sumukhaH sukhaketushcha chitrabarhastathAnaghaH |
meghakRRitkumudo dakShaH sarpAntaH somabhojanaH
shlokas.13:
gurubhAraH kapotashcha sUryanetrashchirAntakaH |
viShNudhanvA kumArashcha paribarho haristathA
shlokas.14:
susvaro madhuparkashcha hemavarNastathaiva cha |
malayo mAtarishvA cha nishAkaradivAkarau
shlokas.15:
ete pradeshamAtreNa mayoktA garuDAtmajAH |
prAdhAnyato.atha yashasA kIrtitAH prANatashcha te
shlokas.16:
yadyatra na ruchiH kAchidehi gachChAva mAtale |
taM nayiShyAmi deshaM tvAM ruchiM yatropalapsyase

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
idaM rasAtalaM nAma saptamaM pRRithivItalam |
yatrAste surabhirmAtA gavAmamRRitasambhavA
shlokas.2:
kSharantI satataM kShIraM pRRithivIsArasambhavam |
ShaNNAM rasAnAM sAreNa rasamekamanuttamam
shlokas.3:
amRRitenAbhitRRiptasya sAramudgirataH purA |
pitAmahasya vadanAdudatiShThadaninditA
shlokas.4:
yasyAH kShIrasya dhArAyA nipatantyA mahItale |
hradaH kRRitaH kShIranidhiH pavitraM paramuttamam
shlokas.5:
puShpitasyeva phenasya paryantamanuveShTitam |
pibanto nivasantyatra phenapA munisattamAH
shlokas.6:
phenapA nAma nAmnA te phenAhArAshcha mAtale |
ugre tapasi vartante yeShAM bibhyati devatAH
shlokas.7:
asyAshchatasro dhenvo.anyA dikShu sarvAsu mAtale |
nivasanti dishApAlyo dhArayantyo dishaH smRRitAH
shlokas.8:
pUrvAM dishaM dhArayate surUpA nAma saurabhI |
dakShiNAM ha.nsakA nAma dhArayatyaparAM disham
shlokas.9:
pashchimA vAruNI dikcha dhAryate vai subhadrayA |
mahAnubhAvayA nityaM mAtale vishvarUpayA
shlokas.10:
sarvakAmadughA nAma dhenurdhArayate disham |
uttarAM mAtale dharmyAM tathailavilasa~nj~nitAm
shlokas.11:
AsAM tu payasA mishraM payo nirmathya sAgare |
manthAnaM mandaraM kRRitvA devairasurasaMhitaiH
shlokas.12:
uddhRRitA vAruNI lakShmIramRRitaM chApi mAtale |
uchchaiHshravAshchAshvarAjo maNiratnaM cha kaustubham
shlokas.13:
sudhAhAreShu cha sudhAM svadhAbhojiShu cha svadhAm |
amRRitaM chAmRRitAsheShu surabhiH kSharate payaH
shlokas.14:
atra gAthA purA gItA rasAtalanivAsibhiH |
paurANI shrUyate loke gIyate yA manIShibhiH
shlokas.15:
na nAgaloke na svarge na vimAne triviShTape |
parivAsaH sukhastAdRRigrasAtalatale yathA

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
iyaM bhogavatI nAma purI vAsukipAlitA |
yAdRRishI devarAjasya purIvaryAmarAvatI
shlokas.2:
eSha sheShaH sthito nAgo yeneyaM dhAryate sadA |
tapasA lokamukhyena prabhAvamahatA mahI
shlokas.3:
shvetochchayanibhAkAro nAnAvidhavibhUShaNaH |
sahasraM dhArayanmUrdhnAM jvAlAjihvo mahAbalaH
shlokas.4:
iha nAnAvidhAkArA nAnAvidhavibhUShaNAH |
surasAyAH sutA nAgA nivasanti gatavyathAH
shlokas.5:
maNisvastikachakrA~NkAH kamaNDalukalakShaNAH |
sahasrasa~NkhyA balinaH sarve raudrAH svabhAvataH
shlokas.6:
sahasrashirasaH kechitkechitpa~nchashatAnanAH |
shatashIrShAstathA kechitkechittrishiraso.api cha
shlokas.7:
dvipa~nchashirasaH kechitkechitsaptamukhAstathA |
mahAbhogA mahAkAyAH parvatAbhogabhoginaH
shlokas.8:
bahUnIha sahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
nAgAnAmekava.nshAnAM yathAshreShThA.nstu me shRRiNu
shlokas.9:
vAsukistakShakashchaiva karkoTakadhana~njayau |
kAlIyo nahuShashchaiva kambalAshvatarAvubhau
shlokas.10:
bAhyakuNDo maNirnAgastathaivApUraNaH khagaH |
vAmanashchailapatrashcha kukuraH kukuNastathA
shlokas.11:
Aryako nandakashchaiva tathA kalashapotakau |
kailAsakaH pi~njarako nAgashchairAvatastathA
shlokas.12:
sumanomukho dadhimukhaH sha~Nkho nandopanandakau |
AptaH koTanakashchaiva shikhI niShThUrikastathA
shlokas.13:
tittirirhastibhadrashcha kumudo mAlyapiNDakaH |
dvau padmau puNDarIkashcha puShpo mudgaraparNakaH
shlokas.14:
karavIraH pITharakaH sa.nvRRitto vRRitta eva cha |
piNDAro bilvapatrashcha mUShikAdaH shirIShakaH
shlokas.15:
dilIpaH sha~NkhashIrShashcha jyotiShko.athAparAjitaH |
kauravyo dhRRitarAShTrashcha kumAraH kushakastathA
shlokas.16:
virajA dhAraNashchaiva subAhurmukharo jayaH |
badhirAndhau vikuNDashcha virasaH surasastathA
shlokas.17:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH kashyapasyAtmajAH smRRitAH |
mAtale pashya yadyatra kashchitte rochate varaH
shlokas.18:
kaNva uvAcha||
mAtalistvekamavyagraH satataM saMnirIkShya vai |
paprachCha nAradaM tatra prItimAniva chAbhavat
shlokas.19:
sthito ya eSha purataH kauravyasyAryakasya cha |
dyutimAndarshanIyashcha kasyaiSha kulanandanaH
shlokas.20:
kaH pitA jananI chAsya katamasyaiSha bhoginaH |
va.nshasya kasyaiSha mahAnketubhUta iva sthitaH
shlokas.21:
praNidhAnena dhairyeNa rUpeNa vayasA cha me |
manaH praviShTo devarShe guNakeshyAH patirvaraH
shlokas.22:
mAtaliM prItimanasaM dRRiShTvA sumukhadarshanAt |
nivedayAmAsa tadA mAhAtmyaM janma karma cha
shlokas.23:
airAvatakule jAtaH sumukho nAma nAgarAT |
Aryakasya mataH pautro dauhitro vAmanasya cha
shlokas.24:
etasya hi pitA nAgashchikuro nAma mAtale |
nachirAdvainateyena pa~nchatvamupapAditaH
shlokas.25:
tato.abravItprItamanA mAtalirnAradaM vachaH |
eSha me ruchitastAta jAmAtA bhujagottamaH
shlokas.26:
kriyatAmatra yatno hi prItimAnasmyanena vai |
asya nAgapaterdAtuM priyAM duhitaraM mune

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
sUto.ayaM mAtalirnAma shakrasya dayitaH suhRRit |
shuchiH shIlaguNopetastejasvI vIryavAnbalI
shlokas.2:
shakrasyAyaM sakhA chaiva mantrI sArathireva cha |
alpAntaraprabhAvashcha vAsavena raNe raNe
shlokas.3:
ayaM harisahasreNa yuktaM jaitraM rathottamam |
devAsureShu yuddheShu manasaiva niyachChati
shlokas.4:
anena vijitAnashvairdorbhyAM jayati vAsavaH |
anena prahRRite pUrvaM balabhitpraharatyuta
shlokas.5:
asya kanyA varArohA rUpeNAsadRRishI bhuvi |
sattvashIlaguNopetA guNakeshIti vishrutA
shlokas.6:
tasyAsya yatnAchcharatastrailokyamamaradyute |
sumukho bhavataH pautro rochate duhituH patiH
shlokas.7:
yadi te rochate saumya bhujagottama mAchiram |
kriyatAmAryaka kShipraM buddhiH kanyApratigrahe
shlokas.8:
yathA viShNukule lakShmIryathA svAhA vibhAvasoH |
kule tava tathaivAstu guNakeshI sumadhyamA
shlokas.9:
pautrasyArthe bhavA.nstasmAdguNakeshIM pratIchChatu |
sadRRishIM pratirUpasya vAsavasya shachImiva
shlokas.10:
pitRRihInamapi hyenaM guNato varayAmahe |
bahumAnAchcha bhavatastathaivairAvatasya cha
sumukhasya guNaishchaiva shIlashauchadamAdibhiH
shlokas.11:
abhigamya svayaM kanyAmayaM dAtuM samudyataH |
mAtalestasya saMmAnaM kartumarho bhavAnapi
shlokas.12:
kaNva uvAcha||
sa tu dInaH prahRRiShTashcha prAha nAradamAryakaH |
vriyamANe tathA pautre putre cha nidhanaM gate
shlokas.13:
na me naitadbahumataM devarShe vachanaM tava |
sakhA shakrasya sa.nyuktaH kasyAyaM nepsito bhavet
shlokas.14:
kAraNasya tu daurbalyAchchintayAmi mahAmune |
asya dehakarastAta mama putro mahAdyute
bhakShito vainateyena duHkhArtAstena vai vayam
shlokas.15:
punareva cha tenoktaM vainateyena gachChatA |
mAsenAnyena sumukhaM bhakShayiShya iti prabho
shlokas.16:
dhruvaM tathA tadbhavitA jAnImastasya nishchayam |
tena harShaH pranaShTo me suparNavachanena vai
shlokas.17:
mAtalistvabravIdenaM buddhiratra kRRitA mayA |
jAmAtRRibhAvena vRRitaH sumukhastava putrajaH
shlokas.18:
so.ayaM mayA cha sahito nAradena cha pannagaH |
trilokeshaM surapatiM gatvA pashyatu vAsavam
shlokas.19:
sheSheNaivAsya kAryeNa praj~nAsyAmyahamAyuShaH |
suparNasya vighAte cha prayatiShyAmi sattama
shlokas.20:
sumukhashcha mayA sArdhaM deveshamabhigachChatu |
kAryasa.nsAdhanArthAya svasti te.astu bhuja~Ngama
shlokas.21:
tataste sumukhaM gRRihya sarva eva mahaujasaH |
dadRRishuH shakramAsInaM devarAjaM mahAdyutim
shlokas.22:
