sa~NgatyA tatra bhagavAnviShNurAsIchchaturbhujaH |
tatastatsarvamAchakhyau nArado mAtaliM prati
shlokas.23:
tataH pura.ndaraM viShNuruvAcha bhuvaneshvaram |
amRRitaM dIyatAmasmai kriyatAmamaraiH samaH
shlokas.24:
mAtalirnAradashchaiva sumukhashchaiva vAsava |
labhantAM bhavataH kAmAtkAmametaM yathepsitam
shlokas.25:
pura.ndaro.atha sa~nchintya vainateyaparAkramam |
viShNumevAbravIdenaM bhavAneva dadAtviti
shlokas.26:
viShNuruvAcha||
Ishastvamasi lokAnAM charANAmacharAshcha ye |
tvayA dattamadattaM kaH kartumutsahate vibho
shlokas.27:
kaNva uvAcha||
prAdAchChakrastatastasmai pannagAyAyuruttamam |
na tvenamamRRitaprAshaM chakAra balavRRitrahA
shlokas.28:
labdhvA varaM tu sumukhaH sumukhaH sambabhUva ha |
kRRitadAro yathAkAmaM jagAma cha gRRihAnprati
shlokas.29:
nAradastvAryakashchaiva kRRitakAryau mudA yutau |
pratijagmaturabhyarchya devarAjaM mahAdyutim

shlokas.1:
kaNva uvAcha||
garuDastattu shushrAva yathAvRRittaM mahAbalaH |
AyuHpradAnaM shakreNa kRRitaM nAgasya bhArata
shlokas.2:
pakShavAtena mahatA ruddhvA tribhuvanaM khagaH |
suparNaH paramakruddho vAsavaM samupAdravat
shlokas.3:
garuDa uvAcha||
bhagavankimavaj~nAnAtkShudhAM prati bhaye mama |
kAmakAravaraM dattvA punashchalitavAnasi
shlokas.4:
nisargAtsarvabhUtAnAM sarvabhUteshvareNa me |
AhAro vihito dhAtrA kimarthaM vAryate tvayA
shlokas.5:
vRRitashchaiSha mahAnAgaH sthApitaH samayashcha me |
anena cha mayA deva bhartavyaH prasavo mahAn
shlokas.6:
etasmi.nstvanyathAbhUte nAnyaM hi.nsitumutsahe |
krIDase kAmakAreNa devarAja yathechChakam
shlokas.7:
so.ahaM prANAnvimokShyAmi tathA parijano mama |
ye cha bhRRityA mama gRRihe prItimAnbhava vAsava
shlokas.8:
etachchaivAhamarhAmi bhUyashcha balavRRitrahan |
trailokyasyeshvaro yo.ahaM parabhRRityatvamAgataH
shlokas.9:
tvayi tiShThati devesha na viShNuH kAraNaM mama |
trailokyarAja rAjyaM hi tvayi vAsava shAshvatam
shlokas.10:
mamApi dakShasya sutA jananI kashyapaH pitA |
ahamapyutsahe lokAnsamastAnvoDhuma~njasA
shlokas.11:
asahyaM sarvabhUtAnAM mamApi vipulaM balam |
mayApi sumahatkarma kRRitaM daiteyavigrahe
shlokas.12:
shrutashrIH shrutasenashcha vivasvAnrochanAmukhaH |
prasabhaH kAlakAkShashcha mayApi ditijA hatAH
shlokas.13:
yattu dhvajasthAnagato yatnAtparicharAmyaham |
vahAmi chaivAnujaM te tena mAmavamanyase
shlokas.14:
ko.anyo bhArasaho hyasti ko.anyo.asti balavattaraH |
mayA yo.ahaM vishiShTaH sanvahAmImaM sabAndhavam
shlokas.15:
avaj~nAya tu yatte.ahaM bhojanAdvyaparopitaH |
tena me gauravaM naShTaM tvattashchAsmAchcha vAsava
shlokas.16:
adityAM ya ime jAtA balavikramashAlinaH |
tvameShAM kila sarveShAM visheShAdbalavattaraH
shlokas.17:
so.ahaM pakShaikadeshena vahAmi tvAM gataklamaH |
vimRRisha tvaM shanaistAta ko nvatra balavAniti
shlokas.18:
kaNva uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA khagasyodarkadAruNam |
akShobhyaM kShobhaya.nstArkShyamuvAcha rathachakrabhRRit
shlokas.19:
garutmanmanyase.a.atmAnaM balavantaM sudurbalam |
alamasmatsamakShaM te stotumAtmAnamaNDaja
shlokas.20:
trailokyamapi me kRRitsnamashaktaM dehadhAraNe |
ahamevAtmanAtmAnaM vahAmi tvAM cha dhAraye
shlokas.21:
imaM tAvanmamaikaM tvaM bAhuM savyetaraM vaha |
yadyenaM dhArayasyekaM saphalaM te vikatthitam
shlokas.22:
tataH sa bhagavA.nstasya skandhe bAhuM samAsajat |
nipapAta sa bhArArto vihvalo naShTachetanaH
shlokas.23:
yAvAnhi bhAraH kRRitsnAyAH pRRithivyAH parvataiH saha |
ekasyA dehashAkhAyAstAvadbhAramamanyata
shlokas.24:
na tvenaM pIDayAmAsa balena balavattaraH |
tato hi jIvitaM tasya na vyanInashadachyutaH
shlokas.25:
vipakShaH srastakAyashcha vichetA vihvalaH khagaH |
mumocha patrANi tadA gurubhAraprapIDitaH
shlokas.26:
sa viShNuM shirasA pakShI praNamya vinatAsutaH |
vichetA vihvalo dInaH ki~nchidvachanamabravIt
shlokas.27:
bhagava.NllokasArasya sadRRishena vapuShmatA |
bhujena svairamuktena niShpiShTo.asmi mahItale
shlokas.28:
kShantumarhasi me deva vihvalasyAlpachetasaH |
baladAhavidagdhasya pakShiNo dhvajavAsinaH
shlokas.29:
na vij~nAtaM balaM deva mayA te paramaM vibho |
tena manyAmyahaM vIryamAtmano.asadRRishaM paraiH
shlokas.30:
tatashchakre sa bhagavAnprasAdaM vai garutmataH |
maivaM bhUya iti snehAttadA chainamuvAcha ha
shlokas.31:
tathA tvamapi gAndhAre yAvatpANDusutAnraNe |
nAsAdayasi tAnvIrA.nstAvajjIvasi putraka
shlokas.32:
bhImaH praharatAM shreShTho vAyuputro mahAbalaH |
dhana~njayashchendrasuto na hanyAtAM tu kaM raNe
shlokas.33:
viShNurvAyushcha shakrashcha dharmastau chAshvinAvubhau |
ete devAstvayA kena hetunA shakyamIkShitum
shlokas.34:
tadalaM te virodhena shamaM gachCha nRRipAtmaja |
vAsudevena tIrthena kulaM rakShitumarhasi
shlokas.35:
pratyakSho hyasya sarvasya nArado.ayaM mahAtapAH |
mAhAtmyaM yattadA viShNoryo.ayaM chakragadAdharaH
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
duryodhanastu tachChrutvA niHshvasanbhRRikuTImukhaH |
rAdheyamabhisamprekShya jahAsa svanavattadA
shlokas.37:
kadarthIkRRitya tadvAkyamRRiSheH kaNvasya durmatiH |
UruM gajakarAkAraM tADayannidamabravIt
shlokas.38:
yathaiveshvarasRRiShTo.asmi yadbhAvi yA cha me gatiH |
tathA maharShe vartAmi kiM pralApaH kariShyati

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
anarthe jAtanirbandhaM parArthe lobhamohitam |
anAryakeShvabhirataM maraNe kRRitanishchayam
shlokas.2:
j~nAtInAM duHkhakartAraM bandhUnAM shokavardhanam |
suhRRidAM kleshadAtAraM dviShatAM harShavardhanam
shlokas.3:
kathaM nainaM vimArgasthaM vArayantIha bAndhavAH |
sauhRRidAdvA suhRRitsnigdho bhagavAnvA pitAmahaH
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
uktaM bhagavatA vAkyamuktaM bhIShmeNa yatkShamam |
uktaM bahuvidhaM chaiva nAradenApi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.5:
nArada uvAcha||
durlabho vai suhRRichChrotA durlabhashcha hitaH suhRRit |
tiShThate hi suhRRidyatra na bandhustatra tiShThati
shlokas.6:
shrotavyamapi pashyAmi suhRRidAM kurunandana |
na kartavyashcha nirbandho nirbandho hi sudAruNaH
shlokas.7:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yathA nirbandhataH prApto gAlavena parAjayaH
shlokas.8:
vishvAmitraM tapasyantaM dharmo jij~nAsayA purA |
abhyagachChatsvayaM bhUtvA vasiShTho bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.9:
saptarShINAmanyatamaM veShamAsthAya bhArata |
bubhukShuH kShudhito rAjannAshramaM kaushikasya ha
shlokas.10:
vishvAmitro.atha sambhrAntaH shrapayAmAsa vai charum |
paramAnnasya yatnena na cha sa pratyapAlayat
shlokas.11:
annaM tena yadA bhuktamanyairdattaM tapasvibhiH |
atha gRRihyAnnamatyuShNaM vishvAmitro.abhyupAgamat
shlokas.12:
bhuktaM me tiShTha tAvattvamityuktvA bhagavAnyayau |
vishvAmitrastato rAjansthita eva mahAdyutiH
shlokas.13:
bhaktaM pragRRihya mUrdhnA tadbAhubhyAM pArshvato.agamat |
sthitaH sthANurivAbhyAshe nishcheShTo mArutAshanaH
shlokas.14:
tasya shushrUShaNe yatnamakarodgAlavo muniH |
gauravAdbahumAnAchcha hArdena priyakAmyayA
shlokas.15:
atha varShashate pUrNe dharmaH punarupAgamat |
vAsiShThaM veShamAsthAya kaushikaM bhojanepsayA
shlokas.16:
sa dRRiShTvA shirasA bhaktaM dhriyamANaM maharShiNA |
tiShThatA vAyubhakSheNa vishvAmitreNa dhImatA
shlokas.17:
pratigRRihya tato dharmastathaivoShNaM tathA navam |
bhuktvA prIto.asmi viprarShe tamuktvA sa munirgataH
shlokas.18:
kShatrabhAvAdapagato brAhmaNatvamupAgataH |
dharmasya vachanAtprIto vishvAmitrastadAbhavat
shlokas.19:
vishvAmitrastu shiShyasya gAlavasya tapasvinaH |
shushrUShayA cha bhaktyA cha prItimAnityuvAcha tam
anuj~nAto mayA vatsa yatheShTaM gachCha gAlava
shlokas.20:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM gAlavo munisattamam |
prIto madhurayA vAchA vishvAmitraM mahAdyutim
shlokas.21:
dakShiNAM kAM prayachChAmi bhavate gurukarmaNi |
dakShiNAbhirupetaM hi karma sidhyati mAnavam
shlokas.22:
dakShiNAnAM hi sRRiShTAnAmapavargeNa bhujyate |
svarge kratuphalaM sadbhirdakShiNA shAntiruchyate
kimAharAmi gurvarthaM bravItu bhagavAniti
shlokas.23:
jAnamAnastu bhagavA~njitaH shushrUShaNena cha |
vishvAmitrastamasakRRidgachCha gachChetyachodayat
shlokas.24:
asakRRidgachCha gachCheti vishvAmitreNa bhAShitaH |
kiM dadAnIti bahusho gAlavaH pratyabhAShata
shlokas.25:
nirbandhatastu bahusho gAlavasya tapasvinaH |
ki~nchidAgatasa.nrambho vishvAmitro.abravIdidam
shlokas.26:
ekataHshyAmakarNAnAM shatAnyaShTau dadasva me |
hayAnAM chandrashubhrANAM gachCha gAlava mAchiram

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
evamuktastadA tena vishvAmitreNa dhImatA |
nAste na shete nAhAraM kurute gAlavastadA
shlokas.2:
tvagasthibhUto hariNashchintAshokaparAyaNaH |
shochamAno.atimAtraM sa dahyamAnashcha manyunA
shlokas.3:
kutaH puShTAni mitrANi kuto.arthAH sa~nchayaH kutaH |
hayAnAM chandrashubhrANAM shatAnyaShTau kuto mama
shlokas.4:
kuto me bhojanashraddhA sukhashraddhA kutashcha me |
shraddhA me jIvitasyApi ChinnA kiM jIvitena me
shlokas.5:
ahaM pAraM samudrasya pRRithivyA vA paraM parAt |
gatvAtmAnaM vimu~nchAmi kiM phalaM jIvitena me
shlokas.6:
adhanasyAkRRitArthasya tyaktasya vividhaiH phalaiH |
RRiNaM dhArayamANasya kutaH sukhamanIhayA
shlokas.7:
suhRRidAM hi dhanaM bhuktvA kRRitvA praNayamIpsitam |
pratikartumashaktasya jIvitAnmaraNaM varam
shlokas.8:
pratishrutya kariShyeti kartavyaM tadakurvataH |
mithyAvachanadagdhasya iShTApUrtaM praNashyati
shlokas.9:
na rUpamanRRitasyAsti nAnRRitasyAsti santatiH |
nAnRRitasyAdhipatyaM cha kuta eva gatiH shubhA
shlokas.10:
kutaH kRRitaghnasya yashaH kutaH sthAnaM kutaH sukham |
ashraddheyaH kRRitaghno hi kRRitaghne nAsti niShkRRitiH
shlokas.11:
na jIvatyadhanaH pApaH kutaH pApasya tantraNam |
pApo dhruvamavApnoti vinAshaM nAshayankRRitam
shlokas.12:
so.ahaM pApaH kRRitaghnashcha kRRipaNashchAnRRito.api cha |
guroryaH kRRitakAryaH sa.nstatkaromi na bhAShitam
so.ahaM prANAnvimokShyAmi kRRitvA yatnamanuttamam
shlokas.13:
arthanA na mayA kAchitkRRitapUrvA divaukasAm |
mAnayanti cha mAM sarve tridashA yaj~nasa.nstare
shlokas.14:
ahaM tu vibudhashreShThaM devaM tribhuvaneshvaram |
viShNuM gachChAmyahaM kRRiShNaM gatiM gatimatAM varam
shlokas.15:
bhogA yasmAtpratiShThante vyApya sarvAnsurAsurAn |
prayato draShTumichChAmi mahAyoginamavyayam
shlokas.16:
evamukte sakhA tasya garuDo vinatAtmajaH |
darshayAmAsa taM prAha saMhRRiShTaH priyakAmyayA
shlokas.17:
suhRRidbhavAnmama mataH suhRRidAM cha mataH suhRRit |
IpsitenAbhilASheNa yoktavyo vibhave sati
shlokas.18:
vibhavashchAsti me vipra vAsavAvarajo dvija |
pUrvamuktastvadarthaM cha kRRitaH kAmashcha tena me
shlokas.19:
sa bhavAnetu gachChAva nayiShye tvAM yathAsukham |
deshaM pAraM pRRithivyA vA gachCha gAlava mAchiram

shlokas.1:
suparNa uvAcha||
anushiShTo.asmi devena gAlavAj~nAtayoninA |
brUhi kAmanusa.nyAmi draShTuM prathamato disham
shlokas.2:
pUrvAM vA dakShiNAM vAhamatha vA pashchimAM disham |
uttarAM vA dvijashreShTha kuto gachChAmi gAlava
shlokas.3:
yasyAmudayate pUrvaM sarvalokaprabhAvanaH |
savitA yatra sandhyAyAM sAdhyAnAM vartate tapaH
shlokas.4:
yasyAM pUrvaM matirjAtA yayA vyAptamidaM jagat |
chakShuShI yatra dharmasya yatra chaiSha pratiShThitaH
shlokas.5:
hutaM yatomukhairhavyaM sarpate sarvatodisham |
etaddvAraM dvijashreShTha divasasya tathAdhvanaH
shlokas.6:
yatra pUrvaM prasUtA vai dAkShAyaNyaH prajAH striyaH |
yasyAM dishi pravRRiddhAshcha kashyapasyAtmasambhavAH
shlokas.7:
yatomUlA surANAM shrIryatra shakro.abhyaShichyata |
surarAjyena viprarShe devaishchAtra tapashchitam
shlokas.8:
etasmAtkAraNAdbrahmanpUrvetyeShA diguchyate |
yasmAtpUrvatare kAle pUrvameShAvRRitA suraiH
shlokas.9:
ata eva cha pUrveShAM pUrvAmAshAmavekShatAm |
pUrvakAryANi kAryANi daivAni sukhamIpsatA
shlokas.10:
atra vedA~njagau pUrvaM bhagavA.NllokabhAvanaH |
atraivoktA savitrAsItsAvitrI brahmavAdiShu
shlokas.11:
atra dattAni sUryeNa yajUMShi dvijasattama |
atra labdhavaraiH somaH suraiH kratuShu pIyate
shlokas.12:
atra tRRiptA hutavahAH svAM yonimupabhu~njate |
atra pAtAlamAshritya varuNaH shriyamApa cha
shlokas.13:
atra pUrvaM vasiShThasya paurANasya dvijarShabha |
sUtishchaiva pratiShThA cha nidhanaM cha prakAshate
shlokas.14:
o~NkArasyAtra jAyante sUtayo dashatIrdasha |
pibanti munayo yatra havirdhAne sma somapAH
shlokas.15:
prokShitA yatra bahavo varAhAdyA mRRigA vane |
shakreNa yatra bhAgArthe daivateShu prakalpitAH
shlokas.16:
atrAhitAH kRRitaghnAshcha mAnuShAshchAsurAshcha ye |
udaya.nstAnhi sarvAnvai krodhAddhanti vibhAvasuH
shlokas.17:
etaddvAraM trilokasya svargasya cha sukhasya cha |
eSha pUrvo dishAbhAgo vishAvainaM yadIchChasi
shlokas.18:
priyaM kAryaM hi me tasya yasyAsmi vachane sthitaH |
brUhi gAlava yAsyAmi shRRiNu chApyaparAM disham

shlokas.1:
suparNa uvAcha||
iyaM vivasvatA pUrvaM shrautena vidhinA kila |
gurave dakShiNA dattA dakShiNetyuchyate.atha dik
shlokas.2:
atra lokatrayasyAsya pitRRipakShaH pratiShThitaH |
atroShmapAnAM devAnAM nivAsaH shrUyate dvija
shlokas.3:
atra vishve sadA devAH pitRRibhiH sArdhamAsate |
ijyamAnAH sma lokeShu samprAptAstulyabhAgatAm
shlokas.4:
etaddvitIyaM dharmasya dvAramAchakShate dvija |
truTisho lavashashchAtra gaNyate kAlanishchayaH
shlokas.5:
atra devarShayo nityaM pitRRilokarShayastathA |
tathA rAjarShayaH sarve nivasanti gatavyathAH
shlokas.6:
atra dharmashcha satyaM cha karma chAtra nishAmyate |
gatireShA dvijashreShTha karmaNAtmAvasAdinaH
shlokas.7:
eShA diksA dvijashreShTha yAM sarvaH pratipadyate |
vRRitA tvanavabodhena sukhaM tena na gamyate
shlokas.8:
nairRRitAnAM sahasrANi bahUnyatra dvijarShabha |
sRRiShTAni pratikUlAni draShTavyAnyakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.9:
atra mandaraku~njeShu viprarShisadaneShu cha |
gandharvA gAnti gAthA vai chittabuddhiharA dvija
shlokas.10:
atra sAmAni gAthAbhiH shrutvA gItAni raivataH |
gatadAro gatAmAtyo gatarAjyo vanaM gataH
shlokas.11:
atra sAvarNinA chaiva yavakrItAtmajena cha |
maryAdA sthApitA brahmanyAM sUryo nAtivartate
shlokas.12:
atra rAkShasarAjena paulastyena mahAtmanA |
rAvaNena tapashchIrtvA surebhyo.amaratA vRRitA
shlokas.13:
atra vRRittena vRRitro.api shakrashatrutvamIyivAn |
atra sarvAsavaH prAptAH punargachChanti pa~nchadhA
shlokas.14:
atra duShkRRitakarmANo narAH pachyanti gAlava |
atra vaitaraNI nAma nadI vitaraNairvRRitA
atra gatvA sukhasyAntaM duHkhasyAntaM prapadyate
shlokas.15:
atrAvRRitto dinakaraH kSharate surasaM payaH |
kAShThAM chAsAdya dhAniShThAM himamutsRRijate punaH
shlokas.16:
atrAhaM gAlava purA kShudhArtaH parichintayan |
labdhavAnyudhyamAnau dvau bRRihantau gajakachChapau
shlokas.17:
atra shakradhanurnAma sUryAjjAto mahAnRRiShiH |
viduryaM kapilaM devaM yenAttAH sagarAtmajAH
shlokas.18:
atra siddhAH shivA nAma brAhmaNA vedapAragAH |
adhItya sakhilAnvedAnAlabhante yamakShayam
shlokas.19:
atra bhogavatI nAma purI vAsukipAlitA |
takShakeNa cha nAgena tathaivairAvatena cha
shlokas.20:
atra niryANakAleShu tamaH samprApyate mahat |
abhedyaM bhAskareNApi svayaM vA kRRiShNavartmanA
shlokas.21:
eSha tasyApi te mArgaH paritApasya gAlava |
brUhi me yadi gantavyaM pratIchIM shRRiNu vA mama

shlokas.1:
suparNa uvAcha||
iyaM digdayitA rAj~no varuNasya tu gopateH |
sadA salilarAjasya pratiShThA chAdireva cha
shlokas.2:
atra pashchAdahaH sUryo visarjayati bhAH svayam |
pashchimetyabhivikhyAtA digiyaM dvijasattama
shlokas.3:
yAdasAmatra rAjyena salilasya cha guptaye |
kashyapo bhagavAndevo varuNaM smAbhyaShechayat
shlokas.4:
atra pItvA samastAnvai varuNasya rasA.nstu ShaT |
jAyate taruNaH somaH shuklasyAdau tamisrahA
shlokas.5:
atra pashchAtkRRitA daityA vAyunA sa.nyatAstadA |
niHshvasanto mahAnAgairarditAH suShupurdvija
shlokas.6:
atra sUryaM praNayinaM pratigRRihNAti parvataH |
asto nAma yataH sandhyA pashchimA pratisarpati
shlokas.7:
ato rAtrishcha nidrA cha nirgatA divasakShaye |
jAyate jIvalokasya hartumardhamivAyuShaH
shlokas.8:
atra devIM ditiM suptAmAtmaprasavadhAriNIm |
vigarbhAmakarochChakro yatra jAto marudgaNaH
shlokas.9:
atra mUlaM himavato mandaraM yAti shAshvatam |
api varShasahasreNa na chAsyAnto.adhigamyate
shlokas.10:
atra kA~nchanashailasya kA~nchanAmbuvahasya cha |
udadhestIramAsAdya surabhiH kSharate payaH
shlokas.11:
atra madhye samudrasya kabandhaH pratidRRishyate |
svarbhAnoH sUryakalpasya somasUryau jighA.nsataH
shlokas.12:
suvarNashiraso.apyatra hariromNaH pragAyataH |
adRRishyasyAprameyasya shrUyate vipulo dhvaniH
shlokas.13:
atra dhvajavatI nAma kumArI harimedhasaH |
AkAshe tiShTha tiShTheti tasthau sUryasya shAsanAt
shlokas.14:
atra vAyustathA vahnirApaH khaM chaiva gAlava |
AhnikaM chaiva naishaM cha duHkhasparshaM vimu~nchati
ataH prabhRRiti sUryasya tiryagAvartate gatiH
shlokas.15:
atra jyotIMShi sarvANi vishantyAdityamaNDalam |
aShTAvi.nshatirAtraM cha cha~Nkramya saha bhAnunA
niShpatanti punaH sUryAtsomasa.nyogayogataH
shlokas.16:
atra nityaM sravantInAM prabhavaH sAgarodayaH |
atra lokatrayasyApastiShThanti varuNAshrayAH
shlokas.17:
atra pannagarAjasyApyanantasya niveshanam |
anAdinidhanasyAtra viShNoH sthAnamanuttamam
shlokas.18:
atrAnalasakhasyApi pavanasya niveshanam |
maharSheH kashyapasyAtra mArIchasya niveshanam
shlokas.19:
eSha te pashchimo mArgo digdvAreNa prakIrtitaH |
brUhi gAlava gachChAvo buddhiH kA dvijasattama

shlokas.1:
suparNa uvAcha||
yasmAduttAryate pApAdyasmAnniHshreyaso.ashnute |
tasmAduttAraNaphalAduttaretyuchyate budhaiH
shlokas.2:
uttarasya hiraNyasya parivApasya gAlava |
mArgaH pashchimapUrvAbhyAM digbhyAM vai madhyamaH smRRitaH
shlokas.3:
asyAM dishi variShThAyAmuttarAyAM dvijarShabha |
nAsaumyo nAvidheyAtmA nAdharmyo vasate janaH
shlokas.4:
atra nArAyaNaH kRRiShNo jiShNushchaiva narottamaH |
badaryAmAshramapade tathA brahmA cha shAshvataH
shlokas.5:
atra vai himavatpRRiShThe nityamAste maheshvaraH |
atra rAjyena viprANAM chandramAshchAbhyaShichyata
shlokas.6:
atra ga~NgAM mahAdevaH patantIM gaganAchchyutAm |
pratigRRihya dadau loke mAnuShe brahmavittama
shlokas.7:
atra devyA tapastaptaM maheshvaraparIpsayA |
atra kAmashcha roShashcha shailashchomA cha sambabhuH
shlokas.8:
atra rAkShasayakShANAM gandharvANAM cha gAlava |
Adhipatyena kailAse dhanado.apyabhiShechitaH
shlokas.9:
atra chaitrarathaM ramyamatra vaikhAnasAshramaH |
atra mandAkinI chaiva mandarashcha dvijarShabha
shlokas.10:
atra saugandhikavanaM nairRRitairabhirakShyate |
shADvalaM kadalIskandhamatra santAnakA nagAH
shlokas.11:
atra sa.nyamanityAnAM siddhAnAM svairachAriNAm |
vimAnAnyanurUpANi kAmabhogyAni gAlava
shlokas.12:
atra te RRiShayaH sapta devI chArundhatI tathA |
atra tiShThati vai svAtiratrAsyA udayaH smRRitaH
shlokas.13:
atra yaj~naM samAruhya dhruvaM sthAtA pitAmahaH |
jyotIMShi chandrasUryau cha parivartanti nityashaH
shlokas.14:
atra gAyantikAdvAraM rakShanti dvijasattamAH |
dhAmA nAma mahAtmAno munayaH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.15:
na teShAM j~nAyate sUtirnAkRRitirna tapashchitam |
parivartasahasrANi kAmabhogyAni gAlava
shlokas.16:
yathA yathA pravishati tasmAtparataraM naraH |
tathA tathA dvijashreShTha pravilIyati gAlava
shlokas.17:
na tatkenachidanyena gatapUrvaM dvijarShabha |
RRite nArAyaNaM devaM naraM vA jiShNumavyayam
shlokas.18:
atra kailAsamityuktaM sthAnamailavilasya tat |
atra vidyutprabhA nAma jaj~nire.apsaraso dasha
shlokas.19:
atra viShNupadaM nAma kramatA viShNunA kRRitam |
trilokavikrame brahmannuttarAM dishamAshritam
shlokas.20:
atra rAj~nA maruttena yaj~neneShTaM dvijottama |
ushIrabIje viprarShe yatra jAmbUnadaM saraH
shlokas.21:
jImUtasyAtra viprarSherupatasthe mahAtmanaH |
sAkShAddhaimavataH puNyo vimalaH kamalAkaraH
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNeShu cha yatkRRitsnaM svantaM kRRitvA dhanaM mahat |
vavre vanaM maharShiH sa jaimUtaM tadvanaM tataH
shlokas.23:
atra nityaM dishApAlAH sAyaM prAtardvijarShabha |
kasya kAryaM kimiti vai parikroshanti gAlava
shlokas.24:
evameShA dvijashreShTha guNairanyairdiguttarA |
uttareti parikhyAtA sarvakarmasu chottarA
shlokas.25:
etA vistarashastAta tava sa~NkIrtitA dishaH |
chatasraH kramayogena kAmAshAM gantumichChasi
shlokas.26:
udyato.ahaM dvijashreShTha tava darshayituM dishaH |
pRRithivIM chAkhilAM brahma.nstasmAdAroha mAM dvija

shlokas.1:
gAlava uvAcha||
garutmanbhujagendrAre suparNa vinatAtmaja |
naya mAM tArkShya pUrveNa yatra dharmasya chakShuShI
shlokas.2:
pUrvametAM dishaM gachCha yA pUrvaM parikIrtitA |
daivatAnAM hi sAMnidhyamatra kIrtitavAnasi
shlokas.3:
atra satyaM cha dharmashcha tvayA samyakprakIrtitaH |
ichCheyaM tu samAgantuM samastairdaivatairaham
bhUyashcha tAnsurAndraShTumichCheyamaruNAnuja
shlokas.4:
nArada uvAcha||
tamAha vinatAsUnurArohasveti vai dvijam |
ArurohAtha sa munirgaruDaM gAlavastadA
shlokas.5:
gAlava uvAcha||
kramamANasya te rUpaM dRRishyate pannagAshana |
bhAskarasyeva pUrvAhNe sahasrA.nshorvivasvataH
shlokas.6:
pakShavAtapraNunnAnAM vRRikShANAmanugAminAm |
prasthitAnAmiva samaM pashyAmIha gatiM khaga
shlokas.7:
sasAgaravanAmurvIM sashailavanakAnanAm |
AkarShanniva chAbhAsi pakShavAtena khechara
shlokas.8:
samInanAganakraM cha khamivAropyate jalam |
vAyunA chaiva mahatA pakShavAtena chAnisham
shlokas.9:
tulyarUpAnanAnmatsyA.nstimimatsyA.nstimi~NgilAn |
nAgA.nshcha naravaktrA.nshcha pashyAmyunmathitAniva
shlokas.10:
mahArNavasya cha ravaiH shrotre me badhirIkRRite |
na shRRiNomi na pashyAmi nAtmano vedmi kAraNam
shlokas.11:
shanaiH sAdhu bhavAnyAtu brahmahatyAmanusmaran |
na dRRishyate ravistAta na disho na cha khaM khaga
shlokas.12:
tama eva tu pashyAmi sharIraM te na lakShaye |
maNIva jAtyau pashyAmi chakShuShI te.ahamaNDaja
shlokas.13:
sharIre tu na pashyAmi tava chaivAtmanashcha ha |
pade pade tu pashyAmi salilAdagnimutthitam
shlokas.14:
sa me nirvApya sahasA chakShuShI shAmyate punaH |
tannivarta mahAnkAlo gachChato vinatAtmaja
shlokas.15:
na me prayojanaM ki~nchidgamane pannagAshana |
saMnivarta mahAvega na vegaM viShahAmi te
shlokas.16:
gurave sa.nshrutAnIha shatAnyaShTau hi vAjinAm |
ekataHshyAmakarNAnAM shubhrANAM chandravarchasAm
shlokas.17:
teShAM chaivApavargAya mArgaM pashyAmi nANDaja |
tato.ayaM jIvitatyAge dRRiShTo mArgo mayAtmanaH
shlokas.18:
naiva me.asti dhanaM ki~nchinna dhanenAnvitaH suhRRit |
na chArthenApi mahatA shakyametadvyapohitum
shlokas.19:
nArada uvAcha||
evaM bahu cha dInaM cha bruvANaM gAlavaM tadA |
pratyuvAcha vrajanneva prahasanvinatAtmajaH
shlokas.20:
nAtipraj~no.asi viprarShe yo.a.atmAnaM tyaktumichChasi |
na chApi kRRitrimaH kAlaH kAlo hi parameshvaraH
shlokas.21:
kimahaM pUrvameveha bhavatA nAbhichoditaH |
upAyo.atra mahAnasti yenaitadupapadyate
shlokas.22:
tadeSha RRiShabho nAma parvataH sAgarorasi |
atra vishramya bhuktvA cha nivartiShyAva gAlava

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
RRiShabhasya tataH shRRi~Nge nipatya dvijapakShiNau |
shANDilIM brAhmaNIM tatra dadRRishAte taponvitAm
shlokas.2:
abhivAdya suparNastu gAlavashchAbhipUjya tAm |
tayA cha svAgatenoktau viShTare saMniShIdatuH
shlokas.3:
siddhamannaM tayA kShipraM balimantropabRRiMhitam |
bhuktvA tRRiptAvubhau bhUmau suptau tAvannamohitau
shlokas.4:
muhUrtAtpratibuddhastu suparNo gamanepsayA |
atha bhraShTatanUjA~NgamAtmAnaM dadRRishe khagaH
shlokas.5:
mA.nsapiNDopamo.abhUtsa mukhapAdAnvitaH khagaH |
gAlavastaM tathA dRRiShTvA viShaNNaH paryapRRichChata
shlokas.6:
kimidaM bhavatA prAptamihAgamanajaM phalam |
vAso.ayamiha kAlaM tu kiyantaM nau bhaviShyati
shlokas.7:
kiM nu te manasA dhyAtamashubhaM dharmadUShaNam |
na hyayaM bhavataH svalpo vyabhichAro bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
suparNo.athAbravIdvipraM pradhyAtaM vai mayA dvija |
imAM siddhAmito netuM tatra yatra prajApatiH
shlokas.9:
yatra devo mahAdevo yatra viShNuH sanAtanaH |
yatra dharmashcha yaj~nashcha tatreyaM nivasediti
shlokas.10:
so.ahaM bhagavatIM yAche praNataH priyakAmyayA |
mayaitannAma pradhyAtaM manasA shochatA kila
shlokas.11:
tadevaM bahumAnAtte mayehAnIpsitaM kRRitam |
sukRRitaM duShkRRitaM vA tvaM mAhAtmyAtkShantumarhasi
shlokas.12:
sA tau tadAbravIttuShTA patagendradvijarShabhau |
na bhetavyaM suparNo.asi suparNa tyaja sambhramam
shlokas.13:
ninditAsmi tvayA vatsa na cha nindAM kShamAmyaham |
lokebhyaH sa paribhrashyedyo mAM nindeta pApakRRit
shlokas.14:
hInayAlakShaNaiH sarvaistathAninditayA mayA |
AchAraM pratigRRihNantyA siddhiH prApteyamuttamA
shlokas.15:
AchArAllabhate dharmamAchArAllabhate dhanam |
AchArAchChriyamApnoti AchAro hantyalakShaNam
shlokas.16:
tadAyuShmankhagapate yatheShTaM gamyatAmitaH |
na cha te garhaNIyApi garhitavyAH striyaH kvachit
shlokas.17:
bhavitAsi yathApUrvaM balavIryasamanvitaH |
babhUvatustatastasya pakShau draviNavattarau
shlokas.18:
anuj~nAtashcha shANDilyA yathAgatamupAgamat |
naiva chAsAdayAmAsa tathArUpA.nstura~NgamAn
shlokas.19:
vishvAmitro.atha taM dRRiShTvA gAlavaM chAdhvani sthitam |
uvAcha vadatAM shreShTho vainateyasya saMnidhau
shlokas.20:
yastvayA svayamevArthaH pratij~nAto mama dvija |
tasya kAlo.apavargasya yathA vA manyate bhavAn
shlokas.21:
pratIkShiShyAmyahaM kAlametAvantaM tathA param |
yathA sa.nsidhyate vipra sa mArgastu nishamyatAm
shlokas.22:
suparNo.athAbravIddInaM gAlavaM bhRRishaduHkhitam |
pratyakShaM khalvidAnIM me vishvAmitro yaduktavAn
shlokas.23:
tadAgachCha dvijashreShTha mantrayiShyAva gAlava |
nAdattvA gurave shakyaM kRRitsnamarthaM tvayAsitum

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
athAha gAlavaM dInaM suparNaH patatAM varaH |
nirmitaM vahninA bhUmau vAyunA vaidhitaM tathA
yasmAddhiraNmayaM sarvaM hiraNyaM tena chochyate
shlokas.2:
dhatte dhArayate chedametasmAtkAraNAddhanam |
tadetattriShu lokeShu dhanaM tiShThati shAshvatam
shlokas.3:
nityaM proShThapadAbhyAM cha shukre dhanapatau tathA |
manuShyebhyaH samAdatte shukrashchittArjitaM dhanam
shlokas.4:
ajaikapAdahirbudhnyai rakShyate dhanadena cha |
evaM na shakyate labdhumalabdhavyaM dvijarShabha
shlokas.5:
RRite cha dhanamashvAnAM nAvAptirvidyate tava |
arthaM yAchAtra rAjAnaM ka~nchidrAjarShiva.nshajam
apIDya rAjA paurAnhi yo nau kuryAtkRRitArthinau
shlokas.6:
asti somAnvavAye me jAtaH kashchinnRRipaH sakhA |
abhigachChAvahe taM vai tasyAsti vibhavo bhuvi
shlokas.7:
yayAtirnAma rAjarShirnAhuShaH satyavikramaH |
sa dAsyati mayA chokto bhavatA chArthitaH svayam
shlokas.8:
vibhavashchAsya sumahAnAsIddhanapateriva |
evaM sa tu dhanaM vidvAndAnenaiva vyashodhayat
shlokas.9:
tathA tau kathayantau cha chintayantau cha yatkShamam |
pratiShThAne narapatiM yayAtiM pratyupasthitau
shlokas.10:
pratigRRihya cha satkAramarghAdiM bhojanaM varam |
pRRiShTashchAgamane hetumuvAcha vinatAsutaH
shlokas.11:
ayaM me nAhuSha sakhA gAlavastapaso nidhiH |
vishvAmitrasya shiShyo.abhUdvarShANyayutasho nRRipa
shlokas.12:
so.ayaM tenAbhyanuj~nAta upakArepsayA dvijaH |
tamAha bhagavAnkAM te dadAni gurudakShiNAm
shlokas.13:
asakRRittena choktena ki~nchidAgatamanyunA |
ayamuktaH prayachCheti jAnatA vibhavaM laghu
shlokas.14:
ekataHshyAmakarNAnAM shubhrANAM shuddhajanmanAm |
aShTau shatAni me dehi hayAnAM chandravarchasAm
shlokas.15:
gurvartho dIyatAmeSha yadi gAlava manyase |
ityevamAha sakrodho vishvAmitrastapodhanaH
shlokas.16:
so.ayaM shokena mahatA tapyamAno dvijarShabhaH |
ashaktaH pratikartuM tadbhavantaM sharaNaM gataH
shlokas.17:
pratigRRihya naravyAghra tvatto bhikShAM gatavyathaH |
kRRitvApavargaM gurave chariShyati mahattapaH
shlokas.18:
tapasaH sa.nvibhAgena bhavantamapi yokShyate |
svena rAjarShitapasA pUrNaM tvAM pUrayiShyati
shlokas.19:
yAvanti romANi haye bhavanti hi nareshvara |
tAvato vAjidA lokAnprApnuvanti mahIpate
shlokas.20:
pAtraM pratigrahasyAyaM dAtuM pAtraM tathA bhavAn |
sha~Nkhe kShIramivAsaktaM bhavatvetattathopamam

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
evamuktaH suparNena tathyaM vachanamuttamam |
vimRRishyAvahito rAjA nishchitya cha punaH punaH
shlokas.2:
yaShTA kratusahasrANAM dAtA dAnapatiH prabhuH |
yayAtirvatsakAshIsha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.3:
dRRiShTvA priyasakhaM tArkShyaM gAlavaM cha dvijarShabham |
nidarshanaM cha tapaso bhikShAM shlAghyAM cha kIrtitAm
shlokas.4:
atItya cha nRRipAnanyAnAdityakulasambhavAn |
matsakAshamanuprAptAvetau buddhimavekShya cha
shlokas.5:
adya me saphalaM janma tAritaM chAdya me kulam |
adyAyaM tArito desho mama tArkShya tvayAnagha
shlokas.6:
vaktumichChAmi tu sakhe yathA jAnAsi mAM purA |
na tathA vittavAnasmi kShINaM vittaM hi me sakhe
shlokas.7:
na cha shakto.asmi te kartuM moghamAgamanaM khaga |
na chAshAmasya viprarShervitathAM kartumutsahe
shlokas.8:
tattu dAsyAmi yatkAryamidaM sampAdayiShyati |
abhigamya hatAsho hi nivRRitto dahate kulam
shlokas.9:
nAtaH paraM vainateya ki~nchitpApiShThamuchyate |
yathAshAnAshanaM loke dehi nAstIti vA vachaH
shlokas.10:
hatAsho hyakRRitArthaH sanhataH sambhAvito naraH |
hinasti tasya putrA.nshcha pautrA.nshchAkurvato.arthinAm
shlokas.11:
tasmAchchaturNAM va.nshAnAM sthApayitrI sutA mama |
iyaM surasutaprakhyA sarvadharmopachAyinI
shlokas.12:
sadA devamanuShyANAmasurANAM cha gAlava |
kA~NkShitA rUpato bAlA sutA me pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.13:
asyAH shulkaM pradAsyanti nRRipA rAjyamapi dhruvam |
kiM punaH shyAmakarNAnAM hayAnAM dve chatuHshate
shlokas.14:
sa bhavAnpratigRRihNAtu mamemAM mAdhavIM sutAm |
ahaM dauhitravAnsyAM vai vara eSha mama prabho
shlokas.15:
pratigRRihya cha tAM kanyAM gAlavaH saha pakShiNA |
punardrakShyAva ityuktvA pratasthe saha kanyayA
shlokas.16:
upalabdhamidaM dvAramashvAnAmiti chANDajaH |
uktvA gAlavamApRRichChya jagAma bhavanaM svakam
shlokas.17:
gate patagarAje tu gAlavaH saha kanyayA |
chintayAnaH kShamaM dAne rAj~nAM vai shulkato.agamat
shlokas.18:
so.agachChanmanasekShvAkuM haryashvaM rAjasattamam |
ayodhyAyAM mahAvIryaM chatura~NgabalAnvitam
shlokas.19:
koshadhAnyabalopetaM priyapauraM dvijapriyam |
prajAbhikAmaM shAmyantaM kurvANaM tapa uttamam
shlokas.20:
tamupAgamya vipraH sa haryashvaM gAlavo.abravIt |
kanyeyaM mama rAjendra prasavaiH kulavardhinI
shlokas.21:
iyaM shulkena bhAryArthe haryashva pratigRRihyatAm |
shulkaM te kIrtayiShyAmi tachChrutvA sampradhAryatAm

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
haryashvastvabravIdrAjA vichintya bahudhA tataH |
dIrghamuShNaM cha niHshvasya prajAhetornRRipottamaH
shlokas.2:
unnateShUnnatA ShaTsu sUkShmA sUkShmeShu saptasu |
gambhIrA triShu gambhIreShviyaM raktA cha pa~nchasu
shlokas.3:
bahudevAsurAlokA bahugandharvadarshanA |
bahulakShaNasampannA bahuprasavadhAriNI
shlokas.4:
samartheyaM janayituM chakravartinamAtmajam |
brUhi shulkaM dvijashreShTha samIkShya vibhavaM mama
shlokas.5:
gAlava uvAcha||
ekataHshyAmakarNAnAM shatAnyaShTau dadasva me |
hayAnAM chandrashubhrANAM deshajAnAM vapuShmatAm
shlokas.6:
tatastava bhavitrIyaM putrANAM jananI shubhA |
araNIva hutAshAnAM yonirAyatalochanA
shlokas.7:
nArada uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vacho rAjA haryashvaH kAmamohitaH |
uvAcha gAlavaM dIno rAjarShirRRiShisattamam
shlokas.8:
dve me shate saMnihite hayAnAM yadvidhAstava |
eShTavyAH shatashastvanye charanti mama vAjinaH
shlokas.9:
so.ahamekamapatyaM vai janayiShyAmi gAlava |
asyAmetaM bhavAnkAmaM sampAdayatu me varam
shlokas.10:
etachChrutvA tu sA kanyA gAlavaM vAkyamabravIt |
mama datto varaH kashchitkenachidbrahmavAdinA
shlokas.11:
prasUtyante prasUtyante kanyaiva tvaM bhaviShyasi |
sa tvaM dadasva mAM rAj~ne pratigRRihya hayottamAn
shlokas.12:
nRRipebhyo hi chaturbhyaste pUrNAnyaShTau shatAni vai |
bhaviShyanti tathA putrA mama chatvAra eva cha
shlokas.13:
kriyatAM mama saMhAro gurvarthaM dvijasattama |
eShA tAvanmama praj~nA yathA vA manyase dvija
shlokas.14:
evamuktastu sa muniH kanyayA gAlavastadA |
haryashvaM pRRithivIpAlamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.15:
iyaM kanyA narashreShTha haryashva pratigRRihyatAm |
chaturbhAgena shulkasya janayasvaikamAtmajam
shlokas.16:
pratigRRihya sa tAM kanyAM gAlavaM pratinandya cha |
samaye deshakAle cha labdhavAnsutamIpsitam
shlokas.17:
tato vasumanA nAma vasubhyo vasumattaraH |
vasuprakhyo narapatiH sa babhUva vasupradaH
shlokas.18:
atha kAle punardhImAngAlavaH pratyupasthitaH |
upasa~Ngamya chovAcha haryashvaM prItimAnasam
shlokas.19:
jAto nRRipa sutaste.ayaM bAlabhAskarasaMnibhaH |
kAlo gantuM narashreShTha bhikShArthamaparaM nRRipam
shlokas.20:
haryashvaH satyavachane sthitaH sthitvA cha pauruShe |
durlabhatvAddhayAnAM cha pradadau mAdhavIM punaH
shlokas.21:
mAdhavI cha punardIptAM parityajya nRRipashriyam |
kumArI kAmato bhUtvA gAlavaM pRRiShThato.anvagAt
shlokas.22:
tvayyeva tAvattiShThantu hayA ityuktavAndvijaH |
prayayau kanyayA sArdhaM divodAsaM prajeshvaram

shlokas.1:
gAlava uvAcha||
mahAvIryo mahIpAlaH kAshInAmIshvaraH prabhuH |
divodAsa iti khyAto bhaimasenirnarAdhipaH
shlokas.2:
tatra gachChAvahe bhadre shanairAgachCha mA shuchaH |
dhArmikaH sa.nyame yuktaH satyashchaiva janeshvaraH
shlokas.3:
nArada uvAcha||
tamupAgamya sa munirnyAyatastena satkRRitaH |
gAlavaH prasavasyArthe taM nRRipaM pratyachodayat
shlokas.4:
divodAsa uvAcha||
shrutametanmayA pUrvaM kimuktvA vistaraM dvija |
kA~NkShito hi mayaiSho.arthaH shrutvaitaddvijasattama
shlokas.5:
etachcha me bahumataM yadutsRRijya narAdhipAn |
mAmevamupayAto.asi bhAvi chaitadasa.nshayam
shlokas.6:
sa eva vibhavo.asmAkamashvAnAmapi gAlava |
ahamapyekamevAsyAM janayiShyAmi pArthivam
shlokas.7:
nArada uvAcha||
tathetyuktvA dvijashreShThaH prAdAtkanyAM mahIpateH |
vidhipUrvaM cha tAM rAjA kanyAM pratigRRihItavAn
shlokas.8:
reme sa tasyAM rAjarShiH prabhAvatyAM yathA raviH |
svAhAyAM cha yathA vahniryathA shachyAM sa vAsavaH
shlokas.9:
yathA chandrashcha rohiNyAM yathA dhUmorNayA yamaH |
varuNashcha yathA gauryAM yathA charddhyAM dhaneshvaraH
shlokas.10:
yathA nArAyaNo lakShmyAM jAhnavyAM cha yathodadhiH |
yathA rudrashcha rudrANyAM yathA vedyAM pitAmahaH
shlokas.11:
adRRishyantyAM cha vAsiShTho vasiShThashchAkShamAlayA |
chyavanashcha sukanyAyAM pulastyaH sandhyayA yathA
shlokas.12:
agastyashchApi vaidarbhyAM sAvitryAM satyavAnyathA |
yathA bhRRiguH pulomAyAmadityAM kashyapo yathA
shlokas.13:
reNukAyAM yathArchIko haimavatyAM cha kaushikaH |
bRRihaspatishcha tArAyAM shukrashcha shataparvayA
shlokas.14:
yathA bhUmyAM bhUmipatirurvashyAM cha purUravAH |
RRichIkaH satyavatyAM cha sarasvatyAM yathA manuH
shlokas.15:
tathA tu ramamANasya divodAsasya bhUpateH |
mAdhavI janayAmAsa putramekaM pratardanam
shlokas.16:
athAjagAma bhagavAndivodAsaM sa gAlavaH |
samaye samanuprApte vachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.17:
niryAtayatu me kanyAM bhavA.nstiShThantu vAjinaH |
yAvadanyatra gachChAmi shulkArthaM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.18:
divodAso.atha dharmAtmA samaye gAlavasya tAm |
kanyAM niryAtayAmAsa sthitaH satye mahIpatiH

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
tathaiva sA shriyaM tyaktvA kanyA bhUtvA yashasvinI |
mAdhavI gAlavaM vipramanvayAtsatyasa~NgarA
shlokas.2:
gAlavo vimRRishanneva svakAryagatamAnasaH |
jagAma bhojanagaraM draShTumaushInaraM nRRipam
shlokas.3:
tamuvAchAtha gatvA sa nRRipatiM satyavikramam |
iyaM kanyA sutau dvau te janayiShyati pArthivau
shlokas.4:
asyAM bhavAnavAptArtho bhavitA pretya cheha cha |
somArkapratisa~NkAshau janayitvA sutau nRRipa
shlokas.5:
shulkaM tu sarvadharmaj~na hayAnAM chandravarchasAm |
ekataHshyAmakarNAnAM deyaM mahyaM chatuHshatam
shlokas.6:
gurvartho.ayaM samArambho na hayaiH kRRityamasti me |
yadi shakyaM mahArAja kriyatAM mA vichAryatAm
shlokas.7:
anapatyo.asi rAjarShe putrau janaya pArthiva |
pitR^Inputraplavena tvamAtmAnaM chaiva tAraya
shlokas.8:
na putraphalabhoktA hi rAjarShe pAtyate divaH |
na yAti narakaM ghoraM yatra gachChantyanAtmajAH
shlokas.9:
etachchAnyachcha vividhaM shrutvA gAlavabhAShitam |
ushInaraH prativacho dadau tasya narAdhipaH
shlokas.10:
shrutavAnasmi te vAkyaM yathA vadasi gAlava |
vidhistu balavAnbrahmanpravaNaM hi mano mama
shlokas.11:
shate dve tu mamAshvAnAmIdRRishAnAM dvijottama |
itareShAM sahasrANi subahUni charanti me
shlokas.12:
ahamapyekamevAsyAM janayiShyAmi gAlava |
putraM dvija gataM mArgaM gamiShyAmi parairaham
shlokas.13:
mUlyenApi samaM kuryAM tavAhaM dvijasattama |
paurajAnapadArthaM tu mamArtho nAtmabhogataH
shlokas.14:
kAmato hi dhanaM rAjA pArakyaM yaH prayachChati |
na sa dharmeNa dharmAtmanyujyate yashasA na cha
shlokas.15:
so.ahaM pratigrahIShyAmi dadAtvetAM bhavAnmama |
kumArIM devagarbhAbhAmekaputrabhavAya me
shlokas.16:
tathA tu bahukalyANamuktavantaM narAdhipam |
ushInaraM dvijashreShTho gAlavaH pratyapUjayat
shlokas.17:
ushInaraM pratigrAhya gAlavaH prayayau vanam |
reme sa tAM samAsAdya kRRitapuNya iva shriyam
shlokas.18:
kandareShu cha shailAnAM nadInAM nirjhareShu cha |
udyAneShu vichitreShu vaneShUpavaneShu cha
shlokas.19:
harmyeShu ramaNIyeShu prAsAdashikhareShu cha |
vAtAyanavimAneShu tathA garbhagRRiheShu cha
shlokas.20:
tato.asya samaye jaj~ne putro bAlaraviprabhaH |
shibirnAmnAbhivikhyAto yaH sa pArthivasattamaH
shlokas.21:
upasthAya sa taM vipro gAlavaH pratigRRihya cha |
kanyAM prayAtastAM rAjandRRiShTavAnvinatAtmajam

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
gAlavaM vainateyo.atha prahasannidamabravIt |
diShTyA kRRitArthaM pashyAmi bhavantamiha vai dvija
shlokas.2:
gAlavastu vachaH shrutvA vainateyena bhAShitam |
chaturbhAgAvashiShTaM tadAchakhyau kAryamasya hi
shlokas.3:
suparNastvabravIdenaM gAlavaM patatAM varaH |
prayatnaste na kartavyo naiSha sampatsyate tava
shlokas.4:
purA hi kanyakubje vai gAdheH satyavatIM sutAm |
bhAryArthe.avarayatkanyAmRRichIkastena bhAShitaH
shlokas.5:
ekataHshyAmakarNAnAM hayAnAM chandravarchasAm |
bhagavandIyatAM mahyaM sahasramiti gAlava
shlokas.6:
RRichIkastu tathetyuktvA varuNasyAlayaM gataH |
ashvatIrthe hayA.NllabdhvA dattavAnpArthivAya vai
shlokas.7:
iShTvA te puNDarIkeNa dattA rAj~nA dvijAtiShu |
tebhyo dve dve shate krItvA prAptAste pArthivaistadA
shlokas.8:
aparANyapi chatvAri shatAni dvijasattama |
nIyamAnAni santAre hRRitAnyAsanvitastayA
evaM na shakyamaprApyaM prAptuM gAlava karhichit
shlokas.9:
imAmashvashatAbhyAM vai dvAbhyAM tasmai nivedaya |
vishvAmitrAya dharmAtmanShaDbhirashvashataiH saha
tato.asi gatasaMmohaH kRRitakRRityo dvijarShabha
shlokas.10:
gAlavastaM tathetyuktvA suparNasahitastataH |
AdAyAshvA.nshcha kanyAM cha vishvAmitramupAgamat
shlokas.11:
gAlava uvAcha||
ashvAnAM kA~NkShitArthAnAM ShaDimAni shatAni vai |
shatadvayena kanyeyaM bhavatA pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.12:
asyAM rAjarShibhiH putrA jAtA vai dhArmikAstrayaH |
chaturthaM janayatvekaM bhavAnapi narottama
shlokas.13:
pUrNAnyevaM shatAnyaShTau turagANAM bhavantu te |
bhavato hyanRRiNo bhUtvA tapaH kuryAM yathAsukham
shlokas.14:
nArada uvAcha||
vishvAmitrastu taM dRRiShTvA gAlavaM saha pakShiNA |
kanyAM cha tAM varArohAmidamityabravIdvachaH
shlokas.15:
kimiyaM pUrvameveha na dattA mama gAlava |
putrA mamaiva chatvAro bhaveyuH kulabhAvanAH
shlokas.16:
pratigRRihNAmi te kanyAmekaputraphalAya vai |
ashvAshchAshramamAsAdya tiShThantu mama sarvashaH
shlokas.17:
sa tayA ramamANo.atha vishvAmitro mahAdyutiH |
AtmajaM janayAmAsa mAdhavIputramaShTakam
shlokas.18:
jAtamAtraM sutaM taM cha vishvAmitro mahAdyutiH |
sa.nyojyArthaistathA dharmairashvaistaiH samayojayat
shlokas.19:
athAShTakaH puraM prAyAttadA somapuraprabham |
niryAtya kanyAM shiShyAya kaushiko.api vanaM yayau
shlokas.20:
gAlavo.api suparNena saha niryAtya dakShiNAm |
manasAbhipratItena kanyAmidamuvAcha ha
shlokas.21:
jAto dAnapatiH putrastvayA shUrastathAparaH |
satyadharmaratashchAnyo yajvA chApi tathAparaH
shlokas.22:
tadAgachCha varArohe tAritaste pitA sutaiH |
chatvArashchaiva rAjAnastathAhaM cha sumadhyame
shlokas.23:
gAlavastvabhyanuj~nAya suparNaM pannagAshanam |
piturniryAtya tAM kanyAM prayayau vanameva ha

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
sa tu rAjA punastasyAH kartukAmaH svaya.nvaram |
upagamyAshramapadaM ga~NgAyamunasa~Ngame
shlokas.2:
gRRihItamAlyadAmAM tAM rathamAropya mAdhavIm |
pUruryadushcha bhaginImAshrame paryadhAvatAm
shlokas.3:
nAgayakShamanuShyANAM patatrimRRigapakShiNAm |
shailadrumavanaukAnAmAsIttatra samAgamaH
shlokas.4:
nAnApuruShadeshAnAmIshvaraishcha samAkulam |
RRiShibhirbrahmakalpaishcha samantAdAvRRitaM vanam
shlokas.5:
nirdishyamAneShu tu sA vareShu varavarNinI |
varAnutkramya sarvA.nstAnvanaM vRRitavatI varam
shlokas.6:
avatIrya rathAtkanyA namaskRRitvA cha bandhuShu |
upagamya vanaM puNyaM tapastepe yayAtijA
shlokas.7:
upavAsaishcha vividhairdIkShAbhirniyamaistathA |
Atmano laghutAM kRRitvA babhUva mRRigachAriNI
shlokas.8:
vaiDUryA~NkurakalpAni mRRidUni haritAni cha |
charantI shaShpamukhyAni tiktAni madhurANi cha
shlokas.9:
sravantInAM cha puNyAnAM surasAni shuchIni cha |
pibantI vArimukhyAni shItAni vimalAni cha
shlokas.10:
vaneShu mRRigarAjeShu siMhaviproShiteShu cha |
dAvAgnivipramukteShu shUnyeShu gahaneShu cha
shlokas.11:
charantI hariNaiH sArdhaM mRRigIva vanachAriNI |
chachAra vipulaM dharmaM brahmacharyeNa sa.nvRRitA
shlokas.12:
yayAtirapi pUrveShAM rAj~nAM vRRittamanuShThitaH |
bahuvarShasahasrAyurayujatkAladharmaNA
shlokas.13:
pUruryadushcha dvau va.nshau vardhamAnau narottamau |
tAbhyAM pratiShThito loke paraloke cha nAhuShaH
shlokas.14:
mahIyate narapatiryayAtiH svargamAsthitaH |
maharShikalpo nRRipatiH svargAgryaphalabhugvibhuH
shlokas.15:
bahuvarShasahasrAkhye kAle bahuguNe gate |
rAjarShiShu niShaNNeShu mahIyaHsu maharShiShu
shlokas.16:
avamene narAnsarvAndevAnRRiShigaNA.nstathA |
yayAtirmUDhavij~nAno vismayAviShTachetanaH
shlokas.17:
tatastaM bubudhe devaH shakro balaniShUdanaH |
te cha rAjarShayaH sarve dhigdhigityevamabruvan
shlokas.18:
vichArashcha samutpanno nirIkShya nahuShAtmajam |
ko nvayaM kasya vA rAj~naH kathaM vA svargamAgataH
shlokas.19:
karmaNA kena siddho.ayaM kva vAnena tapashchitam |
kathaM vA j~nAyate svarge kena vA j~nAyate.apyuta
shlokas.20:
evaM vichArayantaste rAjAnaH svargavAsinaH |
dRRiShTvA paprachChuranyonyaM yayAtiM nRRipatiM prati
shlokas.21:
vimAnapAlAH shatashaH svargadvArAbhirakShiNaH |
pRRiShTA AsanapAlAshcha na jAnImetyathAbruvan
shlokas.22:
sarve te hyAvRRitaj~nAnA nAbhyajAnanta taM nRRipam |
sa muhUrtAdatha nRRipo hataujA abhavattadA

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
atha prachalitaH sthAnAdAsanAchcha parichyutaH |
kampitenaiva manasA dharShitaH shokavahninA
shlokas.2:
mlAnasragbhraShTavij~nAnaH prabhraShTamukuTA~NgadaH |
vighUrNansrastasarvA~NgaH prabhraShTAbharaNAmbaraH
shlokas.3:
adRRishyamAnastAnpashyannapashya.nshcha punaH punaH |
shUnyaH shUnyena manasA prapatiShyanmahItalam
shlokas.4:
kiM mayA manasA dhyAtamashubhaM dharmadUShaNam |
yenAhaM chalitaH sthAnAditi rAjA vyachintayat
shlokas.5:
te tu tatraiva rAjAnaH siddhAshchApsarasastathA |
apashyanta nirAlambaM yayAtiM taM parichyutam
shlokas.6:
athaitya puruShaH kashchitkShINapuNyanipAtakaH |
yayAtimabravIdrAjandevarAjasya shAsanAt
shlokas.7:
atIva madamattastvaM na ka~nchinnAvamanyase |
mAnena bhraShTaH svargaste nArhastvaM pArthivAtmaja
na cha praj~nAyase gachCha patasveti tamabravIt
shlokas.8:
pateyaM satsviti vachastriruktvA nahuShAtmajaH |
patiShya.nshchintayAmAsa gatiM gatimatAM varaH
shlokas.9:
etasminneva kAle tu naimiShe pArthivarShabhAn |
chaturo.apashyata nRRipasteShAM madhye papAta saH
shlokas.10:
pratardano vasumanAH shibiraushInaro.aShTakaH |
vAjapeyena yaj~nena tarpayanti sureshvaram
shlokas.11:
teShAmadhvarajaM dhUmaM svargadvAramupasthitam |
yayAtirupajighranvai nipapAta mahIM prati
shlokas.12:
bhUmau svarge cha sambaddhAM nadIM dhUmamayIM nRRipaH |
sa ga~NgAmiva gachChantImAlambya jagatIpatiH
shlokas.13:
shrImatsvavabhRRithAgryeShu chaturShu pratibandhuShu |
madhye nipatito rAjA lokapAlopameShu cha
shlokas.14:
chaturShu hutakalpeShu rAjasiMhamahAgniShu |
papAta madhye rAjarShiryayAtiH puNyasa~NkShaye
shlokas.15:
tamAhuH pArthivAH sarve pratimAnamiva shriyaH |
ko bhavAnkasya vA bandhurdeshasya nagarasya vA
shlokas.16:
yakSho vApyatha vA devo gandharvo rAkShaso.api vA |
na hi mAnuSharUpo.asi ko vArthaH kA~NkShitastvayA
shlokas.17:
yayAtiruvAcha||
yayAtirasmi rAjarShiH kShINapuNyashchyuto divaH |
pateyaM satsviti dhyAyanbhavatsu patitastataH
shlokas.18:
rAjAna UchuH||
satyametadbhavatu te kA~NkShitaM puruSharShabha |
sarveShAM naH kratuphalaM dharmashcha pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.19:
yayAtiruvAcha||
nAhaM pratigrahadhano brAhmaNaH kShatriyo hyaham |
na cha me pravaNA buddhiH parapuNyavinAshane
shlokas.20:
nArada uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu mRRigacharyAkramAgatAm |
mAdhavIM prekShya rAjAnaste.abhivAdyedamabruvan
shlokas.21:
kimAgamanakRRityaM te kiM kurvaH shAsanaM tava |
Aj~nApyA hi vayaM sarve tava putrAstapodhane
shlokas.22:
teShAM tadbhAShitaM shrutvA mAdhavI parayA mudA |
pitaraM samupAgachChadyayAtiM sA vavanda cha
shlokas.23:
dRRiShTvA mUrdhnA natAnputrA.nstApasI vAkyamabravIt |
dauhitrAstava rAjendra mama putrA na te parAH
ime tvAM tArayiShyanti diShTametatpurAtanam
shlokas.24:
ahaM te duhitA rAjanmAdhavI mRRigachAriNI |
mayApyupachito dharmastato.ardhaM pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.25:
yasmAdrAjannarAH sarve apatyaphalabhAginaH |
tasmAdichChanti dauhitrAnyathA tvaM vasudhAdhipa
shlokas.26:
tataste pArthivAH sarve shirasA jananIM tadA |
abhivAdya namaskRRitya mAtAmahamathAbruvan
shlokas.27:
uchchairanupamaiH snigdhaiH svarairApUrya medinIm |
mAtAmahaM nRRipatayastArayanto divashchyutam
shlokas.28:
atha tasmAdupagato gAlavo.apyAha pArthivam |
tapaso me.aShTabhAgena svargamArohatAM bhavAn

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
pratyabhij~nAtamAtro.atha sadbhistairnarapu~NgavaH |
yayAtirdivyasa.nsthAno babhUva vigatajvaraH
shlokas.2:
divyamAlyAmbaradharo divyAbharaNabhUShitaH |
divyagandhaguNopeto na pRRithvImaspRRishatpadA
shlokas.3:
tato vasumanAH pUrvamuchchairuchchArayanvachaH |
khyAto dAnapatirloke vyAjahAra nRRipaM tadA
shlokas.4:
prAptavAnasmi yalloke sarvavarNeShvagarhayA |
tadapyatha cha dAsyAmi tena sa.nyujyatAM bhavAn
shlokas.5:
yatphalaM dAnashIlasya kShamAshIlasya yatphalam |
yachcha me phalamAdhAne tena sa.nyujyatAM bhavAn
shlokas.6:
tataH pratardano.apyAha vAkyaM kShatriyapu~NgavaH |
yathA dharmaratirnityaM nityaM yuddhaparAyaNaH
shlokas.7:
prAptavAnasmi yalloke kShatradharmodbhavaM yashaH |
vIrashabdaphalaM chaiva tena sa.nyujyatAM bhavAn
shlokas.8:
shibiraushInaro dhImAnuvAcha madhurAM giram |
yathA bAleShu nArIShu vaihAryeShu tathaiva cha
shlokas.9:
sa~NgareShu nipAteShu tathApadvyasaneShu cha |
anRRitaM noktapUrvaM me tena satyena khaM vraja
shlokas.10:
yathA prANA.nshcha rAjyaM cha rAjankarma sukhAni cha |
tyajeyaM na punaH satyaM tena satyena khaM vraja
shlokas.11:
yathA satyena me dharmo yathA satyena pAvakaH |
prItaH shakrashcha satyena tena satyena khaM vraja
shlokas.12:
aShTakastvatha rAjarShiH kaushiko mAdhavIsutaH |
anekashatayajvAnaM vachanaM prAha dharmavit
shlokas.13:
shatashaH puNDarIkA me gosavAshcha chitAH prabho |
kratavo vAjapeyAshcha teShAM phalamavApnuhi
shlokas.14:
na me ratnAni na dhanaM na tathAnye parichChadAH |
kratuShvanupayuktAni tena satyena khaM vraja
shlokas.15:
yathA yathA hi jalpanti dauhitrAstaM narAdhipam |
tathA tathA vasumatIM tyaktvA rAjA divaM yayau
shlokas.16:
evaM sarve samastAste rAjAnaH sukRRitaistadA |
yayAtiM svargato bhraShTaM tArayAmAsura~njasA
shlokas.17:
dauhitrAH svena dharmeNa yaj~nadAnakRRitena vai |
chaturShu rAjava.nsheShu sambhUtAH kulavardhanAH
mAtAmahaM mahAprAj~naM divamAropayanti te
shlokas.18:
rAjAna UchuH||
rAjadharmaguNopetAH sarvadharmaguNAnvitAH |
dauhitrAste vayaM rAjandivamAroha pArthivaH

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
sadbhirAropitaH svargaM pArthivairbhUridakShiNaiH |
abhyanuj~nAya dauhitrAnyayAtirdivamAsthitaH
shlokas.2:
abhivRRiShTashcha varSheNa nAnApuShpasugandhinA |
pariShvaktashcha puNyena vAyunA puNyagandhinA
shlokas.3:
achalaM sthAnamAruhya dauhitraphalanirjitam |
karmabhiH svairupachito jajvAla parayA shriyA
shlokas.4:
upagItopanRRittashcha gandharvApsarasAM gaNaiH |
prItyA pratigRRihItashcha svarge dundubhinisvanaiH
shlokas.5:
abhiShTutashcha vividhairdevarAjarShichAraNaiH |
architashchottamArgheNa daivatairabhinanditaH
shlokas.6:
prAptaH svargaphalaM chaiva tamuvAcha pitAmahaH |
nirvRRitaM shAntamanasaM vachobhistarpayanniva
shlokas.7:
chatuShpAdastvayA dharmashchito lokyena karmaNA |
akShayastava loko.ayaM kIrtishchaivAkShayA divi
punastavAdya rAjarShe sukRRiteneha karmaNA
shlokas.8:
AvRRitaM tamasA chetaH sarveShAM svargavAsinAm |
yena tvAM nAbhijAnanti tato.aj~nAtvAsi pAtitaH
shlokas.9:
prItyaiva chAsi dauhitraistAritastvamihAgataH |
sthAnaM cha pratipanno.asi karmaNA svena nirjitam
achalaM shAshvataM puNyamuttamaM dhruvamavyayam
shlokas.10:
yayAtiruvAcha||
bhagavansa.nshayo me.asti kashchittaM Chettumarhasi |
na hyanyamahamarhAmi praShTuM lokapitAmaha
shlokas.11:
bahuvarShasahasrAntaM prajApAlanavardhitam |
anekakratudAnaughairarjitaM me mahatphalam
shlokas.12:
kathaM tadalpakAlena kShINaM yenAsmi pAtitaH |
bhagavanvettha lokA.nshcha shAshvatAnmama nirjitAn
shlokas.13:
pitAmaha uvAcha||
bahuvarShasahasrAntaM prajApAlanavardhitam |
anekakratudAnaughairyattvayopArjitaM phalam
shlokas.14:
tadanenaiva doSheNa kShINaM yenAsi pAtitaH |
abhimAnena rAjendra dhikkRRitaH svargavAsibhiH
shlokas.15:
nAyaM mAnena rAjarShe na balena na hi.nsayA |
na shAThyena na mAyAbhirloko bhavati shAshvataH
shlokas.16:
nAvamAnyAstvayA rAjannavarotkRRiShTamadhyamAH |
na hi mAnapradagdhAnAM kashchidasti samaH kvachit
shlokas.17:
patanArohaNamidaM kathayiShyanti ye narAH |
viShamANyapi te prAptAstariShyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.18:
nArada uvAcha||
eSha doSho.abhimAnena purA prApto yayAtinA |
nirbandhatashchAtimAtraM gAlavena mahIpate
shlokas.19:
shrotavyaM hitakAmAnAM suhRRidAM bhUtimichChatAm |
na kartavyo hi nirbandho nirbandho hi kShayodayaH
shlokas.20:
tasmAttvamapi gAndhAre mAnaM krodhaM cha varjaya |
sandhatsva pANDavairvIra sa.nrambhaM tyaja pArthiva
shlokas.21:
dadAti yatpArthiva yatkaroti; yadvA tapastapyati yajjuhoti |
na tasya nAsho.asti na chApakarSho; nAnyastadashnAti sa eva kartA
shlokas.22:
idaM mahAkhyAnamanuttamaM mataM; bahushrutAnAM gataroSharAgiNAm |
samIkShya loke bahudhA pradhAvitA; trivargadRRiShTiH pRRithivImupAshnute

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhagavannevamevaitadyathA vadasi nArada |
ichChAmi chAhamapyevaM na tvIsho bhagavannaham
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvA tataH kRRiShNamabhyabhAShata bhArata |
svargyaM lokyaM cha mAmAttha dharmyaM nyAyyaM cha keshava
shlokas.3:
na tvahaM svavashastAta kriyamANaM na me priyam |
a~Nga duryodhanaM kRRiShNa mandaM shAstrAtigaM mama
shlokas.4:
anunetuM mahAbAho yatasva puruShottama |
suhRRitkAryaM tu sumahatkRRitaM te syAjjanArdana
shlokas.5:
tato.abhyAvRRitya vArShNeyo duryodhanamamarShaNam |
abravInmadhurAM vAchaM sarvadharmArthatattvavit
shlokas.6:
duryodhana nibodhedaM madvAkyaM kurusattama |
samarthaM te visheSheNa sAnubandhasya bhArata
shlokas.7:
mahAprAj~na kule jAtaH sAdhvetatkartumarhasi |
shrutavRRittopasampannaH sarvaiH samudito guNaiH
shlokas.8:
dauShkuleyA durAtmAno nRRisha.nsA nirapatrapAH |
ta etadIdRRishaM kuryuryathA tvaM tAta manyase
shlokas.9:
dharmArthayuktA loke.asminpravRRittirlakShyate satAm |
asatAM viparItA tu lakShyate bharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
viparItA tviyaM vRRittirasakRRillakShyate tvayi |
adharmashchAnubandho.atra ghoraH prANaharo mahAn
shlokas.11:
anekashastvannimittamayashasyaM cha bhArata |
tamanarthaM pariharannAtmashreyaH kariShyasi
shlokas.12:
bhrAtR^INAmatha bhRRityAnAM mitrANAM cha parantapa |
adharmyAdayashasyAchcha karmaNastvaM pramokShyase
shlokas.13:
prAj~naiH shUrairmahotsAhairAtmavadbhirbahushrutaiH |
sandhatsva puruShavyAghra pANDavairbharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
taddhitaM cha priyaM chaiva dhRRitarAShTrasya dhImataH |
pitAmahasya droNasya vidurasya mahAmateH
shlokas.15:
kRRipasya somadattasya bAhlIkasya cha dhImataH |
ashvatthAmno vikarNasya sa~njayasya vishAM pate
shlokas.16:
j~nAtInAM chaiva bhUyiShThaM mitrANAM cha parantapa |
shame sharma bhavettAta sarvasya jagatastathA
shlokas.17:
hrImAnasi kule jAtaH shrutavAnanRRisha.nsavAn |
tiShTha tAta pituH shAstre mAtushcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.18:
etachChreyo hi manyante pitA yachChAsti bhArata |
uttamApadgataH sarvaH pituH smarati shAsanam
shlokas.19:
rochate te pitustAta pANDavaiH saha sa~NgamaH |
sAmAtyasya kurushreShTha tattubhyaM tAta rochatAm
shlokas.20:
shrutvA yaH suhRRidAM shAstraM martyo na pratipadyate |
vipAkAnte dahatyenaM kimpAkamiva bhakShitam
shlokas.21:
yastu niHshreyasaM vAkyaM mohAnna pratipadyate |
sa dIrghasUtro hInArthaH pashchAttApena yujyate
shlokas.22:
yastu niHshreyasaM shrutvA prAptamevAbhipadyate |
Atmano matamutsRRijya sa loke sukhamedhate
shlokas.23:
yo.arthakAmasya vachanaM prAtikUlyAnna mRRiShyate |
shRRiNoti pratikUlAni dviShatAM vashameti saH
shlokas.24:
satAM matamatikramya yo.asatAM vartate mate |
shochante vyasane tasya suhRRido nachirAdiva
shlokas.25:
mukhyAnamAtyAnutsRRijya yo nihInAnniShevate |
sa ghorAmApadaM prApya nottAramadhigachChati
shlokas.26:
yo.asatsevI vRRithAchAro na shrotA suhRRidAM sadA |
parAnvRRiNIte svAndveShTi taM gauH shapati bhArata
shlokas.27:
sa tvaM virudhya tairvIrairanyebhyastrANamichChasi |
ashiShTebhyo.asamarthebhyo mUDhebhyo bharatarShabha
shlokas.28:
ko hi shakrasamA~nj~nAtInatikramya mahArathAn |
anyebhyastrANamAsha.nsettvadanyo bhuvi mAnavaH
shlokas.29:
janmaprabhRRiti kaunteyA nityaM vinikRRitAstvayA |
na cha te jAtu kupyanti dharmAtmAno hi pANDavAH
shlokas.30:
mithyApracharitAstAta janmaprabhRRiti pANDavAH |
tvayi samya~NmahAbAho pratipannA yashasvinaH
shlokas.31:
tvayApi pratipattavyaM tathaiva bharatarShabha |
sveShu bandhuShu mukhyeShu mA manyuvashamanvagAH
shlokas.32:
trivargayuktA prAj~nAnAmArambhA bharatarShabha |
dharmArthAvanurudhyante trivargAsambhave narAH
shlokas.33:
pRRithaktu viniviShTAnAM dharmaM dhIro.anurudhyate |
madhyamo.arthaM kaliM bAlaH kAmamevAnurudhyate
shlokas.34:
indriyaiH prasRRito lobhAddharmaM viprajahAti yaH |
kAmArthAvanupAyena lipsamAno vinashyati
shlokas.35:
kAmArthau lipsamAnastu dharmamevAditashcharet |
na hi dharmAdapaityarthaH kAmo vApi kadAchana
shlokas.36:
upAyaM dharmamevAhustrivargasya vishAM pate |
lipsamAno hi tenAshu kakShe.agniriva vardhate
shlokas.37:
sa tvaM tAtAnupAyena lipsase bharatarShabha |
AdhirAjyaM mahaddIptaM prathitaM sarvarAjasu
shlokas.38:
AtmAnaM takShati hyeSha vanaM parashunA yathA |
yaH samyagvartamAneShu mithyA rAjanpravartate
shlokas.39:
na tasya hi matiM ChindyAdyasya nechChetparAbhavam |
avichChinnasya dhIrasya kalyANe dhIyate matiH
shlokas.40:
tyaktAtmAnaM na bAdheta triShu lokeShu bhArata |
apyanyaM prAkRRitaM ki~nchitkimu tAnpANDavarShabhAn
shlokas.41:
amarShavashamApanno na ki~nchidbudhyate naraH |
Chidyate hyAtataM sarvaM pramANaM pashya bhArata
shlokas.42:
shreyaste durjanAttAta pANDavaiH saha sa~NgamaH |
tairhi samprIyamANastvaM sarvAnkAmAnavApsyasi
shlokas.43:
pANDavairnirjitAM bhUmiM bhu~njAno rAjasattama |
pANDavAnpRRiShThataH kRRitvA trANamAsha.nsase.anyataH
shlokas.44:
duHshAsane durviShahe karNe chApi sasaubale |
eteShvaishvaryamAdhAya bhUtimichChasi bhArata
shlokas.45:
na chaite tava paryAptA j~nAne dharmArthayostathA |
vikrame chApyaparyAptAH pANDavAnprati bhArata
shlokas.46:
na hIme sarvarAjAnaH paryAptAH sahitAstvayA |
kruddhasya bhImasenasya prekShituM mukhamAhave
shlokas.47:
idaM saMnihitaM tAta samagraM pArthivaM balam |
ayaM bhIShmastathA droNaH karNashchAyaM tathA kRRipaH
shlokas.48:
bhUrishravAH saumadattirashvatthAmA jayadrathaH |
ashaktAH sarva evaite pratiyoddhuM dhana~njayam
shlokas.49:
ajeyo hyarjunaH kruddhaH sarvairapi surAsuraiH |
mAnuShairapi gandharvairmA yuddhe cheta AdhithAH
shlokas.50:
dRRishyatAM vA pumAnkashchitsamagre pArthive bale |
yo.arjunaM samare prApya svastimAnAvrajedgRRihAn
shlokas.51:
kiM te janakShayeNeha kRRitena bharatarShabha |
yasmi~njite jitaM te syAtpumAnekaH sa dRRishyatAm
shlokas.52:
yaH sa devAnsagandharvAnsayakShAsurapannagAn |
ajayatkhANDavaprasthe kastaM yudhyeta mAnavaH
shlokas.53:
tathA virATanagare shrUyate mahadadbhutam |
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.54:
tamajeyamanAdhRRiShyaM vijetuM jiShNumachyutam |
Asha.nsasIha samare vIramarjunamUrjitam
shlokas.55:
maddvitIyaM punaH pArthaM kaH prArthayitumarhati |
yuddhe pratIpamAyAntamapi sAkShAtpura.ndaraH
shlokas.56:
bAhubhyAmuddharedbhUmiM dahetkruddha imAH prajAH |
pAtayettridivAddevAnyo.arjunaM samare jayet
shlokas.57:
pashya putrA.nstathA bhrAtR^I~nj~nAtInsambandhinastathA |
tvatkRRite na vinashyeyurete bharatasattama
shlokas.58:
astu sheShaM kauravANAM mA parAbhUdidaM kulam |
kulaghna iti nochyethA naShTakIrtirnarAdhipa
shlokas.59:
tvAmeva sthApayiShyanti yauvarAjye mahArathAH |
mahArAjye cha pitaraM dhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram
shlokas.60:
mA tAta shriyamAyAntImavama.nsthAH samudyatAm |
ardhaM pradAya pArthebhyo mahatIM shriyamApsyasi
shlokas.61:
pANDavaiH sa.nshamaM kRRitvA kRRitvA cha suhRRidAM vachaH |
samprIyamANo mitraishcha chiraM bhadrANyavApsyasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shAntanavo bhIShmo duryodhanamamarShaNam |
keshavasya vachaH shrutvA provAcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
kRRiShNena vAkyamukto.asi suhRRidAM shamamichChatA |
anupashyasva tattAta mA manyuvashamanvagAH
shlokas.3:
akRRitvA vachanaM tAta keshavasya mahAtmanaH |
shreyo na jAtu na sukhaM na kalyANamavApsyasi
shlokas.4:
dharmyamarthaM mahAbAhurAha tvAM tAta keshavaH |
tamarthamabhipadyasva mA rAjannInashaH prajAH
shlokas.5:
imAM shriyaM prajvalitAM bhAratIM sarvarAjasu |
jIvato dhRRitarAShTrasya daurAtmyAdbhra.nshayiShyasi
shlokas.6:
AtmAnaM cha sahAmAtyaM saputrapashubAndhavam |
sahamitramasadbuddhyA jIvitAdbhra.nshayiShyasi
shlokas.7:
atikrAmankeshavasya tathyaM vachanamarthavat |
pitushcha bharatashreShTha vidurasya cha dhImataH
shlokas.8:
mA kulaghno.antapuruSho durmatiH kApathaM gamaH |
pitaraM mAtaraM chaiva vRRiddhau shokAya mA dadaH
shlokas.9:
atha droNo.abravIttatra duryodhanamidaM vachaH |
amarShavashamApannaM niHshvasantaM punaH punaH
shlokas.10:
dharmArthayuktaM vachanamAha tvAM tAta keshavaH |
tathA bhIShmaH shAntanavastajjuShasva narAdhipa
shlokas.11:
prAj~nau medhAvinau dAntAvarthakAmau bahushrutau |
AhatustvAM hitaM vAkyaM tadAdatsva parantapa
shlokas.12:
anutiShTha mahAprAj~na kRRiShNabhIShmau yadUchatuH |
mA vacho laghubuddhInAM samAsthAstvaM parantapa
shlokas.13:
ye tvAM protsAhayantyete naite kRRityAya karhichit |
vairaM pareShAM grIvAyAM pratimokShyanti sa.nyuge
shlokas.14:
mA kurU~njIghanaH sarvAnputrAnbhrAtR^I.nstathaiva cha |
vAsudevArjunau yatra viddhyajeyaM balaM hi tat
shlokas.15:
etachchaiva mataM satyaM suhRRidoH kRRiShNabhIShmayoH |
yadi nAdAsyase tAta pashchAttapsyasi bhArata
shlokas.16:
yathoktaM jAmadagnyena bhUyAneva tato.arjunaH |
kRRiShNo hi devakIputro devairapi durutsahaH
shlokas.17:
kiM te sukhapriyeNeha proktena bharatarShabha |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yathechChasi tathA kuru
na hi tvAmutsahe vaktuM bhUyo bharatasattama
shlokas.18:
tasminvAkyAntare vAkyaM kShattApi viduro.abravIt |
duryodhanamabhiprekShya dhArtarAShTramamarShaNam
shlokas.19:
duryodhana na shochAmi tvAmahaM bharatarShabha |
imau tu vRRiddhau shochAmi gAndhArIM pitaraM cha te
shlokas.20:
yAvanAthau chariShyete tvayA nAthena durhRRidA |
hatamitrau hatAmAtyau lUnapakShAviva dvijau
shlokas.21:
bhikShukau vichariShyete shochantau pRRithivImimAm |
kulaghnamIdRRishaM pApaM janayitvA kupUruSham
shlokas.22:
atha duryodhanaM rAjA dhRRitarAShTro.abhyabhAShata |
AsInaM bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM rAjabhiH parivAritam
shlokas.23:
duryodhana nibodhedaM shauriNoktaM mahAtmanA |
Adatsva shivamatyantaM yogakShemavadavyayam
shlokas.24:
anena hi sahAyena kRRiShNenAkliShTakarmaNA |
iShTAnsarvAnabhiprAyAnprApsyAmaH sarvarAjasu
shlokas.25:
susaMhitaH keshavena gachCha tAta yudhiShThiram |
chara svastyayanaM kRRitsnaM bhAratAnAmanAmayam
shlokas.26:
vAsudevena tIrthena tAta gachChasva sa~Ngamam |
kAlaprAptamidaM manye mA tvaM duryodhanAtigAH
shlokas.27:
shamaM chedyAchamAnaM tvaM pratyAkhyAsyasi keshavam |
tvadarthamabhijalpantaM na tavAstyaparAbhavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dhRRitarAShTravachaH shrutvA bhIShmadroNau samarthya tau |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyamUchatuH shAsanAtigam
shlokas.2:
yAvatkRRiShNAvasaMnaddhau yAvattiShThati gANDivam |
yAvaddhaumyo na senAgnau juhotIha dviShadbalam
shlokas.3:
yAvanna prekShate kruddhaH senAM tava yudhiShThiraH |
hrIniShedho maheShvAsastAvachChAmyatu vaishasam
shlokas.4:
yAvanna dRRiShyate pArthaH sveShvanIkeShvavasthitaH |
bhImaseno maheShvAsastAvachChAmyatu vaishasam
shlokas.5:
yAvanna charate mArgAnpRRitanAmabhiharShayan |
yAvanna shAtayatyAjau shirA.nsi gajayodhinAm
shlokas.6:
gadayA vIraghAtinyA phalAnIva vanaspateH |
kAlena paripakvAni tAvachChAmyatu vaishasam
shlokas.7:
nakulaH sahadevashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
virATashcha shikhaNDI cha shaishupAlishcha da.nshitAH
shlokas.8:
yAvanna pravishantyete nakrA iva mahArNavam |
kRRitAstrAH kShipramasyantastAvachChAmyatu vaishasam
shlokas.9:
yAvanna sukumAreShu sharIreShu mahIkShitAm |
gArdhrapatrAH patantyugrAstAvachChAmyatu vaishasam
shlokas.10:
chandanAgarudigdheShu hAraniShkadhareShu cha |
noraHsu yAvadyodhAnAM maheShvAsairmaheShavaH
shlokas.11:
kRRitAstraiH kShipramasyadbhirdUrapAtibhirAyasAH |
abhilakShyairnipAtyante tAvachChAmyatu vaishasam
shlokas.12:
abhivAdayamAnaM tvAM shirasA rAjaku~njaraH |
pANibhyAM pratigRRihNAtu dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.13:
dhvajA~NkushapatAkA~NkaM dakShiNaM te sudakShiNaH |
skandhe nikShipatAM bAhuM shAntaye bharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
ratnauShadhisametena ratnA~Ngulitalena cha |
upaviShTasya pRRiShThaM te pANinA parimArjatu
shlokas.15:
shAlaskandho mahAbAhustvAM svajAno vRRikodaraH |
sAmnAbhivadatAM chApi shAntaye bharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
arjunena yamAbhyAM cha tribhistairabhivAditaH |
mUrdhni tAnsamupAghrAya premNAbhivada pArthiva
shlokas.17:
dRRiShTvA tvAM pANDavairvIrairbhrAtRRibhiH saha sa~Ngatam |
yAvadAnandajAshrUNi pramu~nchantu narAdhipAH
shlokas.18:
ghuShyatAM rAjadhAnIShu sarvasampanmahIkShitAm |
pRRithivI bhrAtRRibhAvena bhujyatAM vijvaro bhava

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA duryodhano vAkyamapriyaM kurusa.nsadi |
pratyuvAcha mahAbAhuM vAsudevaM yashasvinam
shlokas.2:
prasamIkShya bhavAnetadvaktumarhati keshava |
mAmeva hi visheSheNa vibhAShya parigarhase
shlokas.3:
bhaktivAdena pArthAnAmakasmAnmadhusUdana |
bhavAngarhayate nityaM kiM samIkShya balAbalam
shlokas.4:
bhavAnkShattA cha rAjA cha AchAryo vA pitAmahaH |
mAmeva parigarhante nAnyaM ka~nchana pArthivam
shlokas.5:
na chAhaM lakShaye ka~nchidvyabhichAramihAtmanaH |
atha sarve bhavanto mAM vidviShanti sarAjakAH
shlokas.6:
na chAhaM ka~nchidatyarthamaparAdhamari.ndama |
vichintayanprapashyAmi susUkShmamapi keshava
shlokas.7:
priyAbhyupagate dyUte pANDavA madhusUdana |
jitAH shakuninA rAjyaM tatra kiM mama duShkRRitam
shlokas.8:
yatpunardraviNaM ki~nchittatrAjIyanta pANDavAH |
tebhya evAbhyanuj~nAtaM tattadA madhusUdana
shlokas.9:
aparAdho na chAsmAkaM yatte hyakShaparAjitAH |
ajeyA jayatAM shreShTha pArthAH pravrAjitA vanam
shlokas.10:
kena chApyapavAdena virudhyante.aribhiH saha |
ashaktAH pANDavAH kRRiShNa prahRRiShTAH pratyamitravat
shlokas.11:
kimasmAbhiH kRRitaM teShAM kasminvA punarAgasi |
dhArtarAShTrA~njighA.nsanti pANDavAH sRRi~njayaiH saha
shlokas.12:
na chApi vayamugreNa karmaNA vachanena vA |
vitrastAH praNamAmeha bhayAdapi shatakratoH
shlokas.13:
na cha taM kRRiShNa pashyAmi kShatradharmamanuShThitam |
utsaheta yudhA jetuM yo naH shatrunibarhaNa
shlokas.14:
na hi bhIShmakRRipadroNAH sagaNA madhusUdana |
devairapi yudhA jetuM shakyAH kimuta pANDavaiH
shlokas.15:
svadharmamanutiShThanto yadi mAdhava sa.nyuge |
shastreNa nidhanaM kAle prApsyAmaH svargameva tat
shlokas.16:
mukhyashchaivaiSha no dharmaH kShatriyANAM janArdana |
yachChayImahi sa~NgrAme sharatalpagatA vayam
shlokas.17:
te vayaM vIrashayanaM prApsyAmo yadi sa.nyuge |
apraNamyaiva shatrUNAM na nastapsyati mAdhava
shlokas.18:
kashcha jAtu kule jAtaH kShatradharmeNa vartayan |
bhayAdvRRittiM samIkShyaivaM praNamediha kasyachit
shlokas.19:
udyachChedeva na namedudyamo hyeva pauruSham |
apyaparvaNi bhajyeta na namediha kasyachit
shlokas.20:
iti mAta~NgavachanaM parIpsanti hitepsavaH |
dharmAya chaiva praNamedbrAhmaNebhyashcha madvidhaH
shlokas.21:
achintayanka~nchidanyaM yAvajjIvaM tathAcharet |
eSha dharmaH kShatriyANAM matametachcha me sadA
shlokas.22:
rAjyA.nshashchAbhyanuj~nAto yo me pitrA purAbhavat |
na sa labhyaH punarjAtu mayi jIvati keshava
shlokas.23:
yAvachcha rAjA dhriyate dhRRitarAShTro janArdana |
nyastashastrA vayaM te vApyupajIvAma mAdhava
shlokas.24:
yadyadeyaM purA dattaM rAjyaM paravato mama |
aj~nAnAdvA bhayAdvApi mayi bAle janArdana
shlokas.25:
na tadadya punarlabhyaM pANDavairvRRiShNinandana |
dhriyamANe mahAbAho mayi samprati keshava
shlokas.26:
yAvaddhi sUchyAstIkShNAyA vidhyedagreNa mAdhava |
tAvadapyaparityAjyaM bhUmernaH pANDavAnprati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prahasya dAshArhaH krodhaparyAkulekShaNaH |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyamabravItkurusa.nsadi
shlokas.2:
lapsyase vIrashayanaM kAmametadavApsyasi |
sthiro bhava sahAmAtyo vimardo bhavitA mahAn
shlokas.3:
yachchaivaM manyase mUDha na me kashchidvyatikramaH |
pANDaveShviti tatsarvaM nibodhata narAdhipAH
shlokas.4:
shriyA santapyamAnena pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
tvayA durmantritaM dyUtaM saubalena cha bhArata
shlokas.5:
kathaM cha j~nAtayastAta shreyA.nsaH sAdhusaMmatAH |
tathAnyAyyamupasthAtuM jihmenAjihmachAriNaH
shlokas.6:
akShadyUtaM mahAprAj~na satAmaratinAshanam |
asatAM tatra jAyante bhedAshcha vyasanAni cha
shlokas.7:
tadidaM vyasanaM ghoraM tvayA dyUtamukhaM kRRitam |
asamIkShya sadAchAraiH sArdhaM pApAnubandhanaiH
shlokas.8:
kashchAnyo j~nAtibhAryAM vai viprakartuM tathArhati |
AnIya cha sabhAM vaktuM yathoktA draupadI tvayA
shlokas.9:
kulInA shIlasampannA prANebhyo.api garIyasI |
mahiShI pANDuputrANAM tathA vinikRRitA tvayA
shlokas.10:
jAnanti kuravaH sarve yathoktAH kurusa.nsadi |
duHshAsanena kaunteyAH pravrajantaH parantapAH
shlokas.11:
samyagvRRitteShvalubdheShu satataM dharmachAriShu |
sveShu bandhuShu kaH sAdhushcharedevamasAmpratam
shlokas.12:
nRRisha.nsAnAmanAryANAM paruShANAM cha bhAShaNam |
karNaduHshAsanAbhyAM cha tvayA cha bahushaH kRRitam
shlokas.13:
saha mAtrA pradagdhuM tAnbAlakAnvAraNAvate |
AsthitaH paramaM yatnaM na samRRiddhaM cha tattava
shlokas.14:
UShushcha suchiraM kAlaM prachChannAH pANDavAstadA |
mAtrA sahaikachakrAyAM brAhmaNasya niveshane
shlokas.15:
viSheNa sarpabandhaishcha yatitAH pANDavAstvayA |
sarvopAyairvinAshAya na samRRiddhaM cha tattava
shlokas.16:
evambuddhiH pANDaveShu mithyAvRRittiH sadA bhavAn |
kathaM te nAparAdho.asti pANDaveShu mahAtmasu
shlokas.17:
kRRitvA bahUnyakAryANi pANDaveShu nRRisha.nsavat |
mithyAvRRittiranAryaH sannadya vipratipadyase
shlokas.18:
mAtApitRRibhyAM bhIShmeNa droNena vidureNa cha |
shAmyeti muhurukto.asi na cha shAmyasi pArthiva
shlokas.19:
shame hi sumahAnarthastava pArthasya chobhayoH |
na cha rochayase rAjankimanyadbuddhilAghavAt
shlokas.20:
na sharma prApsyase rAjannutkramya suhRRidAM vachaH |
adharmyamayashasyaM cha kriyate pArthiva tvayA
shlokas.21:
evaM bruvati dAshArhe duryodhanamamarShaNam |
duHshAsana idaM vAkyamabravItkurusa.nsadi
shlokas.22:
na chetsandhAsyase rAjansvena kAmena pANDavaiH |
baddhvA kila tvAM dAsyanti kuntIputrAya kauravAH
shlokas.23:
vaikartanaM tvAM cha mAM cha trInetAnmanujarShabha |
pANDavebhyaH pradAsyanti bhIShmo droNaH pitA cha te
shlokas.24:
bhrAturetadvachaH shrutvA dhArtarAShTraH suyodhanaH |
kruddhaH prAtiShThatotthAya mahAnAga iva shvasan
shlokas.25:
viduraM dhRRitarAShTraM cha mahArAjaM cha bAhlikam |
kRRipaM cha somadattaM cha bhIShmaM droNaM janArdanam
shlokas.26:
sarvAnetAnanAdRRitya durmatirnirapatrapaH |
ashiShTavadamaryAdo mAnI mAnyAvamAnitA
shlokas.27:
taM prasthitamabhiprekShya bhrAtaro manujarShabham |
anujagmuH sahAmAtyA rAjAnashchApi sarvashaH
shlokas.28:
sabhAyAmutthitaM kruddhaM prasthitaM bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
duryodhanamabhiprekShya bhIShmaH shAntanavo.abravIt
shlokas.29:
dharmArthAvabhisantyajya sa.nrambhaM yo.anumanyate |
hasanti vyasane tasya durhRRido nachirAdiva
shlokas.30:
durAtmA rAjaputro.ayaM dhArtarAShTro.anupAyavit |
mithyAbhimAnI rAjyasya krodhalobhavashAnugaH
shlokas.31:
kAlapakvamidaM manye sarvakShatraM janArdana |
sarve hyanusRRitA mohAtpArthivAH saha mantribhiH
shlokas.32:
bhIShmasyAtha vachaH shrutvA dAshArhaH puShkarekShaNaH |
bhIShmadroNamukhAnsarvAnabhyabhAShata vIryavAn
shlokas.33:
sarveShAM kuruvRRiddhAnAM mahAnayamatikramaH |
prasahya mandamaishvarye na niyachChata yannRRipam
shlokas.34:
tatra kAryamahaM manye prAptakAlamari.ndamAH |
kriyamANe bhavechChreyastatsarvaM shRRiNutAnaghAH
shlokas.35:
pratyakShametadbhavatAM yadvakShyAmi hitaM vachaH |
bhavatAmAnukUlyena yadi rocheta bhAratAH
shlokas.36:
bhojarAjasya vRRiddhasya durAchAro hyanAtmavAn |
jIvataH pituraishvaryaM hRRitvA manyuvashaM gataH
shlokas.37:
ugrasenasutaH ka.nsaH parityaktaH sa bAndhavaiH |
j~nAtInAM hitakAmena mayA shasto mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.38:
AhukaH punarasmAbhirj~nAtibhishchApi satkRRitaH |
ugrasenaH kRRito rAjA bhojarAjanyavardhanaH
shlokas.39:
ka.nsamekaM parityajya kulArthe sarvayAdavAH |
sambhUya sukhamedhante bhAratAndhakavRRiShNayaH
shlokas.40:
api chApyavadadrAjanparameShThI prajApatiH |
vyUDhe devAsure yuddhe.abhyudyateShvAyudheShu cha
shlokas.41:
dvaidhIbhUteShu lokeShu vinashyatsu cha bhArata |
abravItsRRiShTimAndevo bhagavA.NllokabhAvanaH
shlokas.42:
parAbhaviShyantyasurA daiteyA dAnavaiH saha |
AdityA vasavo rudrA bhaviShyanti divaukasaH
shlokas.43:
devAsuramanuShyAshcha gandharvoragarAkShasAH |
asminyuddhe susa.nyattA haniShyanti parasparam
shlokas.44:
iti matvAbravIddharmaM parameShThI prajApatiH |
varuNAya prayachChaitAnbaddhvA daiteyadAnavAn
shlokas.45:
evamuktastato dharmo niyogAtparameShThinaH |
varuNAya dadau sarvAnbaddhvA daiteyadAnavAn
shlokas.46:
tAnbaddhvA dharmapAshaishcha svaishcha pAshairjaleshvaraH |
varuNaH sAgare yatto nityaM rakShati dAnavAn
shlokas.47:
tathA duryodhanaM karNaM shakuniM chApi saubalam |
baddhvA duHshAsanaM chApi pANDavebhyaH prayachChata
shlokas.48:
tyajetkulArthe puruShaM grAmasyArthe kulaM tyajet |
grAmaM janapadasyArthe AtmArthe pRRithivIM tyajet
shlokas.49:
rAjanduryodhanaM baddhvA tataH sa.nshAmya pANDavaiH |
tvatkRRite na vinashyeyuH kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kRRiShNasya vachanaM shrutvA dhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
viduraM sarvadharmaj~naM tvaramANo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
gachCha tAta mahAprAj~nAM gAndhArIM dIrghadarshinIm |
Anayeha tayA sArdhamanuneShyAmi durmatim
shlokas.3:
yadi sApi durAtmAnaM shamayedduShTachetasam |
api kRRiShNAya suhRRidastiShThema vachane vayam
shlokas.4:
api lobhAbhibhUtasya panthAnamanudarshayet |
durbuddherduHsahAyasya samarthaM bruvatI vachaH
shlokas.5:
api no vyasanaM ghoraM duryodhanakRRitaM mahat |
shamayechchirarAtrAya yogakShemavadavyayam
shlokas.6:
rAj~nastu vachanaM shrutvA viduro dIrghadarshinIm |
AnayAmAsa gAndhArIM dhRRitarAShTrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
eSha gAndhAri putraste durAtmA shAsanAtigaH |
aishvaryalobhAdaishvaryaM jIvitaM cha prahAsyati
shlokas.8:
ashiShTavadamaryAdaH pApaiH saha durAtmabhiH |
sabhAyA nirgato mUDho vyatikramya suhRRidvachaH
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sA bharturvachanaM shrutvA rAjaputrI yashasvinI |
anvichChantI mahachChreyo gAndhArI vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.10:
Anayeha sutaM kShipraM rAjyakAmukamAturam |
na hi rAjyamashiShTena shakyaM dharmArthalopinA
shlokas.11:
tvaM hyevAtra bhRRishaM garhyo dhRRitarAShTra sutapriyaH |
yo jAnanpApatAmasya tatpraj~nAmanuvartase
shlokas.12:
sa eSha kAmamanyubhyAM pralabdho mohamAsthitaH |
ashakyo.adya tvayA rAjanvinivartayituM balAt
shlokas.13:
rAjyapradAne mUDhasya bAlishasya durAtmanaH |
duHsahAyasya lubdhasya dhRRitarAShTro.ashnute phalam
shlokas.14:
kathaM hi svajane bhedamupekSheta mahAmatiH |
bhinnaM hi svajanena tvAM prasahiShyanti shatravaH
shlokas.15:
yA hi shakyA mahArAja sAmnA dAnena vA punaH |
nistartumApadaH sveShu daNDaM kastatra pAtayet
shlokas.16:
shAsanAddhRRitarAShTrasya duryodhanamamarShaNam |
mAtushcha vachanAtkShattA sabhAM prAveshayatpunaH
shlokas.17:
sa mAturvachanAkA~NkShI pravivesha sabhAM punaH |
abhitAmrekShaNaH krodhAnniHshvasanniva pannagaH
shlokas.18:
taM praviShTamabhiprekShya putramutpathamAsthitam |
vigarhamANA gAndhArI samarthaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.19:
duryodhana nibodhedaM vachanaM mama putraka |
hitaM te sAnubandhasya tathAyatyAM sukhodayam
shlokas.20:
bhIShmasya tu pitushchaiva mama chApachitiH kRRitA |
bhaveddroNamukhAnAM cha suhRRidAM shAmyatA tvayA
shlokas.21:
na hi rAjyaM mahAprAj~na svena kAmena shakyate |
avAptuM rakShituM vApi bhoktuM vA bharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
na hyavashyendriyo rAjyamashnIyAddIrghamantaram |
vijitAtmA tu medhAvI sa rAjyamabhipAlayet
shlokas.23:
kAmakrodhau hi puruShamarthebhyo vyapakarShataH |
tau tu shatrU vinirjitya rAjA vijayate mahIm
shlokas.24:
lokeshvaraprabhutvaM hi mahadetaddurAtmabhiH |
rAjyaM nAmepsitaM sthAnaM na shakyamabhirakShitum
shlokas.25:
indriyANi mahatprepsurniyachChedarthadharmayoH |
indriyairniyatairbuddhirvardhate.agnirivendhanaiH
shlokas.26:
avidhyeyAni hImAni vyApAdayitumapyalam |
avidheyA ivAdAntA hayAH pathi kusArathim
shlokas.27:
avijitya ya AtmAnamamAtyAnvijigIShate |
ajitAtmAjitAmAtyaH so.avashaH parihIyate
shlokas.28:
AtmAnameva prathamaM desharUpeNa yo jayet |
tato.amAtyAnamitrA.nshcha na moghaM vijigIShate
shlokas.29:
vashyendriyaM jitAmAtyaM dhRRitadaNDaM vikAriShu |
parIkShyakAriNaM dhIramatyantaM shrIrniShevate
shlokas.30:
kShudrAkSheNeva jAlena jhaShAvapihitAvubhau |
kAmakrodhau sharIrasthau praj~nAnaM tau vilumpataH
shlokas.31:
yAbhyAM hi devAH svaryAtuH svargasyApidadhurmukham |
bibhyato.anuparAgasya kAmakrodhau sma vardhitau
shlokas.32:
kAmaM krodhaM cha lobhaM cha dambhaM darpaM cha bhUmipaH |
samyagvijetuM yo veda sa mahImabhijAyate
shlokas.33:
satataM nigrahe yukta indriyANAM bhavennRRipaH |
IpsannarthaM cha dharmaM cha dviShatAM cha parAbhavam
shlokas.34:
kAmAbhibhUtaH krodhAdvA yo mithyA pratipadyate |
sveShu chAnyeShu vA tasya na sahAyA bhavantyuta
shlokas.35:
ekIbhUtairmahAprAj~naiH shUrairarinibarhaNaiH |
pANDavaiH pRRithivIM tAta bhokShyase sahitaH sukhI
shlokas.36:
yathA bhIShmaH shAntanavo droNashchApi mahArathaH |
AhatustAta tatsatyamajeyau kRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.37:
prapadyasva mahAbAhuM kRRiShNamakliShTakAriNam |
prasanno hi sukhAya syAdubhayoreva keshavaH
shlokas.38:
suhRRidAmarthakAmAnAM yo na tiShThati shAsane |
prAj~nAnAM kRRitavidyAnAM sa naraH shatrunandanaH
shlokas.39:
na yuddhe tAta kalyANaM na dharmArthau kutaH sukham |
na chApi vijayo nityaM mA yuddhe cheta AdhithAH
shlokas.40:
bhIShmeNa hi mahAprAj~na pitrA te bAhlikena cha |
dattoM.ashaH pANDuputrANAM bhedAdbhItairari.ndama
shlokas.41:
tasya chaitatpradAnasya phalamadyAnupashyasi |
yadbhu~NkShe pRRithivIM sarvAM shUrairnihatakaNTakAm
shlokas.42:
prayachCha pANDuputrANAM yathochitamari.ndama |
yadIchChasi sahAmAtyo bhoktumardhaM mahIkShitAm
shlokas.43:
alamardhaM pRRithivyAste sahAmAtyasya jIvanam |
suhRRidAM vachane tiShThanyashaH prApsyasi bhArata
shlokas.44:
shrImadbhirAtmavadbhirhi buddhimadbhirjitendriyaiH |
pANDavairvigrahastAta bhra.nshayenmahataH sukhAt
shlokas.45:
nigRRihya suhRRidAM manyuM shAdhi rAjyaM yathochitam |
svama.nshaM pANDuputrebhyaH pradAya bharatarShabha
shlokas.46:
alamahnA nikAro.ayaM trayodasha samAH kRRitaH |
shamayainaM mahAprAj~na kAmakrodhasamedhitam
shlokas.47:
na chaiSha shaktaH pArthAnAM yastvadarthamabhIpsati |
sUtaputro dRRiDhakrodho bhrAtA duHshAsanashcha te
shlokas.48:
bhIShme droNe kRRipe karNe bhImasene dhana~njaye |
dhRRiShTadyumne cha sa~Nkruddhe na syuH sarvAH prajA dhruvam
shlokas.49:
amarShavashamApanno mA kurU.nstAta jIghanaH |
sarvA hi pRRithivI spRRiShTA tvatpANDavakRRite vadham
shlokas.50:
yachcha tvaM manyase mUDha bhIShmadroNakRRipAdayaH |
yotsyante sarvashaktyeti naitadadyopapadyate
shlokas.51:
samaM hi rAjyaM prItishcha sthAnaM cha vijitAtmanAm |
pANDaveShvatha yuShmAsu dharmastvabhyadhikastataH
shlokas.52:
rAjapiNDabhayAdete yadi hAsyanti jIvitam |
na hi shakShyanti rAjAnaM yudhiShThiramudIkShitum
shlokas.53:
na lobhAdarthasampattirnarANAmiha dRRishyate |
tadalaM tAta lobhena prashAmya bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tattu vAkyamanAdRRitya so.arthavanmAtRRibhAShitam |
punaH pratasthe sa.nrambhAtsakAshamakRRitAtmanAm
shlokas.2:
tataH sabhAyA nirgamya mantrayAmAsa kauravaH |
saubalena matAkSheNa rAj~nA shakuninA saha
shlokas.3:
duryodhanasya karNasya shakuneH saubalasya cha |
duHshAsanachaturthAnAmidamAsIdvicheShTitam
shlokas.4:
purAyamasmAngRRihNAti kShiprakArI janArdanaH |
sahito dhRRitarAShTreNa rAj~nA shAntanavena cha
shlokas.5:
vayameva hRRiShIkeshaM nigRRihNIma balAdiva |
prasahya puruShavyAghramindro vairochaniM yathA
shlokas.6:
shrutvA gRRihItaM vArShNeyaM pANDavA hatachetasaH |
nirutsAhA bhaviShyanti bhagnadaMShTrA ivoragAH
shlokas.7:
ayaM hyeShAM mahAbAhuH sarveShAM sharma varma cha |
asmingRRihIte varade RRiShabhe sarvasAtvatAm
nirudyamA bhaviShyanti pANDavAH somakaiH saha
shlokas.8:
tasmAdvayamihaivainaM keshavaM kShiprakAriNam |
kroshato dhRRitarAShTrasya baddhvA yotsyAmahe ripUn
shlokas.9:
teShAM pApamabhiprAyaM pApAnAM duShTachetasAm |
i~Ngitaj~naH kaviH kShipramanvabudhyata sAtyakiH
shlokas.10:
tadarthamabhiniShkramya hArdikyena sahAsthitaH |
abravItkRRitavarmANaM kShipraM yojaya vAhinIm
shlokas.11:
vyUDhAnIkaH sabhAdvAramupatiShThasva da.nshitaH |
yAvadAkhyAmyahaM chaitatkRRiShNAyAkliShTakarmaNe
shlokas.12:
sa pravishya sabhAM vIraH siMho giriguhAmiva |
AchaShTa tamabhiprAyaM keshavAya mahAtmane
shlokas.13:
dhRRitarAShTraM tatashchaiva viduraM chAnvabhAShata |
teShAmetamabhiprAyamAchachakShe smayanniva
shlokas.14:
dharmAdapetamarthAchcha karma sAdhuvigarhitam |
mandAH kartumihechChanti na chAvApyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.15:
purA vikurvate mUDhAH pApAtmAnaH samAgatAH |
dharShitAH kAmamanyubhyAM krodhalobhavashAnugAH
shlokas.16:
imaM hi puNDarIkAkShaM jighRRikShantyalpachetasaH |
paTenAgniM prajvalitaM yathA bAlA yathA jaDAH
shlokas.17:
sAtyakestadvachaH shrutvA viduro dIrghadarshivAn |
dhRRitarAShTraM mahAbAhumabravItkurusa.nsadi
shlokas.18:
rAjanparItakAlAste putrAH sarve parantapa |
ayashasyamashakyaM cha karma kartuM samudyatAH
shlokas.19:
imaM hi puNDarIkAkShamabhibhUya prasahya cha |
nigrahItuM kilechChanti sahitA vAsavAnujam
shlokas.20:
imaM puruShashArdUlamapradhRRiShyaM durAsadam |
AsAdya na bhaviShyanti pata~NgA iva pAvakam
shlokas.21:
ayamichChanhi tAnsarvAnyatamAnA~njanArdanaH |
siMho mRRigAniva kruddho gamayedyamasAdanam
shlokas.22:
na tvayaM ninditaM karma kuryAtkRRiShNaH katha~nchana |
na cha dharmAdapakrAmedachyutaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.23:
vidureNaivamukte tu keshavo vAkyamabravIt |
dhRRitarAShTramabhiprekShya suhRRidAM shRRiNvatAM mithaH
shlokas.24:
rAjannete yadi kruddhA mAM nigRRihNIyurojasA |
ete vA mAmahaM vainAnanujAnIhi pArthiva
shlokas.25:
etAnhi sarvAnsa.nrabdhAnniyantumahamutsahe |
na tvahaM ninditaM karma kuryAM pApaM katha~nchana
shlokas.26:
pANDavArthe hi lubhyantaH svArthAddhAsyanti te sutAH |
ete chedevamichChanti kRRitakAryo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.27:
adyaiva hyahametA.nshcha ye chaitAnanu bhArata |
nigRRihya rAjanpArthebhyo dadyAM kiM duShkRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.28:
idaM tu na pravarteyaM ninditaM karma bhArata |
saMnidhau te mahArAja krodhajaM pApabuddhijam
shlokas.29:
eSha duryodhano rAjanyathechChati tathAstu tat |
ahaM tu sarvAnsamayAnanujAnAmi bhArata
shlokas.30:
etachChrutvA tu viduraM dhRRitarAShTro.abhyabhAShata |
kShipramAnaya taM pApaM rAjyalubdhaM suyodhanam
shlokas.31:
sahamitraM sahAmAtyaM sasodaryaM sahAnugam |
shaknuyAM yadi panthAnamavatArayituM punaH
shlokas.32:
tato duryodhanaM kShattA punaH prAveshayatsabhAm |
akAmaM bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM rAjabhiH parivAritam
shlokas.33:
atha duryodhanaM rAjA dhRRitarAShTro.abhyabhAShata |
karNaduHshAsanAbhyAM cha rAjabhishchAbhisa.nvRRitam
shlokas.34:
nRRisha.nsa pApabhUyiShTha kShudrakarmasahAyavAn |
pApaiH sahAyaiH saMhatya pApaM karma chikIrShasi
shlokas.35:
ashakyamayashasyaM cha sadbhishchApi vigarhitam |
yathA tvAdRRishako mUDho vyavasyetkulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.36:
tvamimaM puNDarIkAkShamapradhRRiShyaM durAsadam |
pApaiH sahAyaiH saMhatya nigrahItuM kilechChasi
shlokas.37:
yo na shakyo balAtkartuM devairapi savAsavaiH |
taM tvaM prArthayase manda bAlashchandramasaM yathA
shlokas.38:
devairmanuShyairgandharvairasurairuragaishcha yaH |
na soDhuM samare shakyastaM na budhyasi keshavam
shlokas.39:
durgrahaH pANinA vAyurduHsparshaH pANinA shashI |
durdharA pRRithivI mUrdhnA durgrahaH keshavo balAt
shlokas.40:
ityukte dhRRitarAShTreNa kShattApi viduro.abravIt |
duryodhanamabhiprekShya dhArtarAShTramamarShaNam
shlokas.41:
saubhadvAre vAnarendro dvivido nAma nAmataH |
shilAvarSheNa mahatA ChAdayAmAsa keshavam
shlokas.42:
grahItukAmo vikramya sarvayatnena mAdhavam |
grahItuM nAshakattatra taM tvaM prArthayase balAt
shlokas.43:
nirmochane ShaTsahasrAH pAshairbaddhvA mahAsurAH |
grahItuM nAshaka.nshchainaM taM tvaM prArthayase balAt
shlokas.44:
prAgjyotiShagataM shauriM narakaH saha dAnavaiH |
grahItuM nAshakattatra taM tvaM prArthayase balAt
shlokas.45:
anena hi hatA bAlye pUtanA shishunA tathA |
govardhano dhAritashcha gavArthe bharatarShabha
shlokas.46:
ariShTo dhenukashchaiva chANUrashcha mahAbalaH |
ashvarAjashcha nihataH ka.nsashchAriShTamAcharan
shlokas.47:
jarAsandhashcha vakrashcha shishupAlashcha vIryavAn |
bANashcha nihataH sa~Nkhye rAjAnashcha niShUditAH
shlokas.48:
varuNo nirjito rAjA pAvakashchAmitaujasA |
pArijAtaM cha haratA jitaH sAkShAchChachIpatiH
shlokas.49:
ekArNave shayAnena hatau tau madhukaiTabhau |
janmAntaramupAgamya hayagrIvastathA hataH
shlokas.50:
ayaM kartA na kriyate kAraNaM chApi pauruShe |
yadyadichChedayaM shauristattatkuryAdayatnataH
shlokas.51:
taM na budhyasi govindaM ghoravikramamachyutam |
AshIviShamiva kruddhaM tejorAshimanirjitam
shlokas.52:
pradharShayanmahAbAhuM kRRiShNamakliShTakAriNam |
pata~Ngo.agnimivAsAdya sAmAtyo na bhaviShyasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vidureNaivamukte tu keshavaH shatrupUgahA |
duryodhanaM dhArtarAShTramabhyabhAShata vIryavAn
shlokas.2:
eko.ahamiti yanmohAnmanyase mAM suyodhana |
paribhUya cha durbuddhe grahItuM mAM chikIrShasi
shlokas.3:
ihaiva pANDavAH sarve tathaivAndhakavRRiShNayaH |
ihAdityAshcha rudrAshcha vasavashcha maharShibhiH
shlokas.4:
