evamuktvA jahAsochchaiH keshavaH paravIrahA |
tasya sa.nsmayataH shaurervidyudrUpA mahAtmanaH
a~NguShThamAtrAstridashA mumuchuH pAvakArchiShaH
shlokas.5:
tasya brahmA lalATastho rudro vakShasi chAbhavat |
lokapAlA bhujeShvAsannagnirAsyAdajAyata
shlokas.6:
AdityAshchaiva sAdhyAshcha vasavo.athAshvinAvapi |
marutashcha sahendreNa vishvedevAstathaiva cha
babhUvushchaiva rUpANi yakShagandharvarakShasAm
shlokas.7:
prAdurAstAM tathA dorbhyAM sa~NkarShaNadhana~njayau |
dakShiNe.athArjuno dhanvI halI rAmashcha savyataH
shlokas.8:
bhImo yudhiShThirashchaiva mAdrIputrau cha pRRiShThataH |
andhakA vRRiShNayashchaiva pradyumnapramukhAstataH
shlokas.9:
agre babhUvuH kRRiShNasya samudyatamahAyudhAH |
sha~NkhachakragadAshaktishAr~NgalA~NgalanandakAH
shlokas.10:
adRRishyantodyatAnyeva sarvapraharaNAni cha |
nAnAbAhuShu kRRiShNasya dIpyamAnAni sarvashaH
shlokas.11:
netrAbhyAM nastatashchaiva shrotrAbhyAM cha samantataH |
prAdurAsanmahAraudrAH sadhUmAH pAvakArchiShaH
romakUpeShu cha tathA sUryasyeva marIchayaH
shlokas.12:
taM dRRiShTvA ghoramAtmAnaM keshavasya mahAtmanaH |
nyamIlayanta netrANi rAjAnastrastachetasaH
shlokas.13:
RRite droNaM cha bhIShmaM cha viduraM cha mahAmatim |
sa~njayaM cha mahAbhAgamRRiShI.nshchaiva tapodhanAn
prAdAtteShAM sa bhagavAndivyaM chakShurjanArdanaH
shlokas.14:
taddRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyaM mAdhavasya sabhAtale |
devadundubhayo neduH puShpavarShaM papAta cha
shlokas.15:
chachAla cha mahI kRRitsnA sAgarashchApi chukShubhe |
vismayaM paramaM jagmuH pArthivA bharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
tataH sa puruShavyAghraH sa~njahAra vapuH svakam |
tAM divyAmadbhutAM chitrAmRRiddhimattAmari.ndamaH
shlokas.17:
tataH sAtyakimAdAya pANau hArdikyameva cha |
RRiShibhistairanuj~nAto niryayau madhusUdanaH
shlokas.18:
RRiShayo.antarhitA jagmustataste nAradAdayaH |
tasminkolAhale vRRitte tadadbhutamabhUttadA
shlokas.19:
taM prasthitamabhiprekShya kauravAH saha rAjabhiH |
anujagmurnaravyAghraM devA iva shatakratum
shlokas.20:
achintayannameyAtmA sarvaM tadrAjamaNDalam |
nishchakrAma tataH shauriH sadhUma iva pAvakaH
shlokas.21:
tato rathena shubhreNa mahatA ki~NkiNIkinA |
hemajAlavichitreNa laghunA meghanAdinA
shlokas.22:
sUpaskareNa shubhreNa vaiyAghreNa varUthinA |
sainyasugrIvayuktena pratyadRRishyata dArukaH
shlokas.23:
tathaiva rathamAsthAya kRRitavarmA mahArathaH |
vRRiShNInAM saMmato vIro hArdikyaH pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.24:
upasthitarathaM shauriM prayAsyantamari.ndamam |
dhRRitarAShTro mahArAjaH punarevAbhyabhAShata
shlokas.25:
yAvadbalaM me putreShu pashyasyetajjanArdana |
pratyakShaM te na te ki~nchitparokShaM shatrukarshana
shlokas.26:
kurUNAM shamamichChantaM yatamAnaM cha keshava |
viditvaitAmavasthAM me nAtisha~Nkitumarhasi
shlokas.27:
na me pApo.astyabhiprAyaH pANDavAnprati keshava |
j~nAtameva hi te vAkyaM yanmayoktaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.28:
jAnanti kuravaH sarve rAjAnashchaiva pArthivAH |
shame prayatamAnaM mAM sarvayatnena mAdhava
shlokas.29:
tato.abravInmahAbAhurdhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram |
droNaM pitAmahaM bhIShmaM kShattAraM bAhlikaM kRRipam
shlokas.30:
pratyakShametadbhavatAM yadvRRittaM kurusa.nsadi |
yathA chAshiShTavanmando roShAdasakRRidutthitaH
shlokas.31:
vadatyanIshamAtmAnaM dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
ApRRichChe bhavataH sarvAngamiShyAmi yudhiShThiram
shlokas.32:
Amantrya prasthitaM shauriM rathasthaM puruSharShabham |
anujagmurmaheShvAsAH pravIrA bharatarShabhAH
shlokas.33:
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipaH kShattA dhRRitarAShTro.atha bAhlikaH |
ashvatthAmA vikarNashcha yuyutsushcha mahArathaH
shlokas.34:
tato rathena shubhreNa mahatA ki~NkiNIkinA |
kurUNAM pashyatAM prAyAtpRRithAM draShTuM pitRRiShvasAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pravishyAtha gRRihaM tasyAshcharaNAvabhivAdya cha |
Achakhyau tatsamAsena yadvRRittaM kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.2:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
uktaM bahuvidhaM vAkyaM grahaNIyaM sahetukam |
RRiShibhishcha mayA chaiva na chAsau tadgRRihItavAn
shlokas.3:
kAlapakvamidaM sarvaM duryodhanavashAnugam |
ApRRichChe bhavatIM shIghraM prayAsye pANDavAnprati
shlokas.4:
kiM vAchyAH pANDaveyAste bhavatyA vachanAnmayA |
tadbrUhi tvaM mahAprAj~ne shushrUShe vachanaM tava
shlokas.5:
kuntyuvAcha||
brUyAH keshava rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
bhUyA.nste hIyate dharmo mA putraka vRRithA kRRithAH
shlokas.6:
shrotriyasyeva te rAjanmandakasyAvipashchitaH |
anuvAkahatA buddhirdharmamevaikamIkShate
shlokas.7:
a~NgAvekShasva dharmaM tvaM yathA sRRiShTaH svayambhuvA |
urastaH kShatriyaH sRRiShTo bAhuvIryopajIvitA
krUrAya karmaNe nityaM prajAnAM paripAlane
shlokas.8:
shRRiNu chAtropamAmekAM yA vRRiddhebhyaH shrutA mayA |
muchukundasya rAjarSheradadAtpRRithivImimAm
purA vaishravaNaH prIto na chAsau tAM gRRihItavAn
shlokas.9:
bAhuvIryArjitaM rAjyamashnIyAmiti kAmaye |
tato vaishravaNaH prIto vismitaH samapadyata
shlokas.10:
muchukundastato rAjA so.anvashAsadvasundharAm |
bAhuvIryArjitAM samyakkShatradharmamanuvrataH
shlokas.11:
yaM hi dharmaM charantIha prajA rAj~nA surakShitAH |
chaturthaM tasya dharmasya rAjA bhArata vindati
shlokas.12:
rAjA charati cheddharmaM devatvAyaiva kalpate |
sa chedadharmaM charati narakAyaiva gachChati
shlokas.13:
daNDanItiH svadharmeNa chAturvarNyaM niyachChati |
prayuktA svAminA samyagadharmebhyashcha yachChati
shlokas.14:
daNDanItyAM yadA rAjA samyakkArtsnyena vartate |
tadA kRRitayugaM nAma kAlaH shreShThaH pravartate
shlokas.15:
kAlo vA kAraNaM rAj~no rAjA vA kAlakAraNam |
iti te sa.nshayo mA bhUdrAjA kAlasya kAraNam
shlokas.16:
rAjA kRRitayugasraShTA tretAyA dvAparasya cha |
yugasya cha chaturthasya rAjA bhavati kAraNam
shlokas.17:
kRRitasya kAraNAdrAjA svargamatyantamashnute |
tretAyAH kAraNAdrAjA svargaM nAtyantamashnute
pravartanAddvAparasya yathAbhAgamupAshnute
shlokas.18:
tato vasati duShkarmA narake shAshvatIH samAH |
rAjadoSheNa hi jagatspRRishyate jagataH sa cha
shlokas.19:
rAjadharmAnavekShasva pitRRipaitAmahochitAn |
naitadrAjarShivRRittaM hi yatra tvaM sthAtumichChasi
shlokas.20:
na hi vaiklavyasa.nsRRiShTa AnRRisha.nsye vyavasthitaH |
prajApAlanasambhUtaM ki~nchitprApa phalaM nRRipaH
shlokas.21:
na hyetAmAshiShaM pANDurna chAhaM na pitAmahaH |
prayuktavantaH pUrvaM te yayA charasi medhayA
shlokas.22:
yaj~no dAnaM tapaH shauryaM prajAsantAnameva cha |
mAhAtmyaM balamojashcha nityamAsha.nsitaM mayA
shlokas.23:
nityaM svAhA svadhA nityaM dadurmAnuShadevatAH |
dIrghamAyurdhanaM putrAnsamyagArAdhitAH shubhAH
shlokas.24:
putreShvAshAsate nityaM pitaro daivatAni cha |
dAnamadhyayanaM yaj~naM prajAnAM paripAlanam
shlokas.25:
etaddharmamadharmaM vA janmanaivAbhyajAyathAH |
te stha vaidyAH kule jAtA avRRittyA tAta pIDitAH
shlokas.26:
yattu dAnapatiM shUraM kShudhitAH pRRithivIcharAH |
prApya tRRiptAH pratiShThante dharmaH ko.abhyadhikastataH
shlokas.27:
dAnenAnyaM balenAnyaM tathA sUnRRitayAparam |
sarvataH pratigRRihNIyAdrAjyaM prApyeha dhArmikaH
shlokas.28:
brAhmaNaH pracharedbhaikShaM kShatriyaH paripAlayet |
vaishyo dhanArjanaM kuryAchChUdraH paricharechcha tAn
shlokas.29:
bhaikShaM vipratiShiddhaM te kRRiShirnaivopapadyate |
kShatriyo.asi kShatAttrAtA bAhuvIryopajIvitA
shlokas.30:
pitryama.nshaM mahAbAho nimagnaM punaruddhara |
sAmnA dAnena bhedena daNDenAtha nayena cha
shlokas.31:
ito duHkhataraM kiM nu yadahaM hInabAndhavA |
parapiNDamudIkShAmi tvAM sUtvAmitranandana
shlokas.32:
yudhyasva rAjadharmeNa mA nimajjIH pitAmahAn |
mA gamaH kShINapuNyastvaM sAnujaH pApikAM gatim

shlokas.1:
kuntyuvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vidurAyAshcha sa.nvAdaM putrasya cha parantapa
shlokas.2:
atra shreyashcha bhUyashcha yathA sA vaktumarhati |
yashasvinI manyumatI kule jAtA vibhAvarI
shlokas.3:
kShatradharmaratA dhanyA vidurA dIrghadarshinI |
vishrutA rAjasa.nsatsu shrutavAkyA bahushrutA
shlokas.4:
vidurA nAma vai satyA jagarhe putramaurasam |
nirjitaM sindhurAjena shayAnaM dInachetasam
anandanamadharmaj~naM dviShatAM harShavardhanam
shlokas.5:
na mayA tvaM na pitrAsi jAtaH kvAbhyAgato hyasi |
nirmanyurupashAkhIyaH puruShaH klIbasAdhanaH
shlokas.6:
yAvajjIvaM nirAsho.asi kalyANAya dhuraM vaha |
mAtmAnamavamanyasva mainamalpena bIbharaH
manaH kRRitvA sukalyANaM mA bhaistvaM pratisa.nstabha
shlokas.7:
uttiShTha he kApuruSha mA sheShvaivaM parAjitaH |
amitrAnnandayansarvAnnirmAno bandhushokadaH
shlokas.8:
supUrA vai kunadikA supUro mUShikA~njaliH |
susantoShaH kApuruShaH svalpakenApi tuShyati
shlokas.9:
apyarerArujandaMShTrAmAshveva nidhanaM vraja |
api vA sa.nshayaM prApya jIvite.api parAkrama
shlokas.10:
apyareH shyenavachChidraM pashyestvaM viparikraman |
vinadanvAtha vA tUShNIM vyomni vAparisha~NkitaH
shlokas.11:
tvamevaM pretavachCheShe kasmAdvajrahato yathA |
uttiShTha he kApuruSha mA sheShvaivaM parAjitaH
shlokas.12:
mAstaM gamastvaM kRRipaNo vishrUyasva svakarmaNA |
mA madhye mA jaghanye tvaM mAdho bhUstiShTha chorjitaH
shlokas.13:
alAtaM tindukasyeva muhUrtamapi vijvala |
mA tuShAgnirivAnarchiH kAkara~NkhA jijIviShuH
muhUrtaM jvalitaM shreyo na tu dhUmAyitaM chiram
shlokas.14:
mA ha sma kasyachidgehe janI rAj~naH kharImRRiduH |
kRRitvA mAnuShyakaM karma sRRitvAjiM yAvaduttamam
dharmasyAnRRiNyamApnoti na chAtmAnaM vigarhate
shlokas.15:
alabdhvA yadi vA labdhvA nAnushochanti paNDitAH |
AnantaryaM chArabhate na prANAnAM dhanAyate
shlokas.16:
udbhAvayasva vIryaM vA tAM vA gachCha dhruvAM gatim |
dharmaM putrAgrataH kRRitvA kiMnimittaM hi jIvasi
shlokas.17:
iShTApUrtaM hi te klIba kIrtishcha sakalA hatA |
vichChinnaM bhogamUlaM te kiMnimittaM hi jIvasi
shlokas.18:
shatrurnimajjatA grAhyo ja~NghAyAM prapatiShyatA |
viparichChinnamUlo.api na viShIdetkatha~nchana
udyamya dhuramutkarShedAjAneyakRRitaM smaran
shlokas.19:
kuru sattvaM cha mAnaM cha viddhi pauruShamAtmanaH |
udbhAvaya kulaM magnaM tvatkRRite svayameva hi
shlokas.20:
yasya vRRittaM na jalpanti mAnavA mahadadbhutam |
rAshivardhanamAtraM sa naiva strI na punaH pumAn
shlokas.21:
dAne tapasi shaurye cha yasya na prathitaM yashaH |
vidyAyAmarthalAbhe vA mAturuchchAra eva saH
shlokas.22:
shrutena tapasA vApi shriyA vA vikrameNa vA |
janAnyo.abhibhavatyanyAnkarmaNA hi sa vai pumAn
shlokas.23:
na tveva jAlmIM kApAlIM vRRittimeShitumarhasi |
nRRisha.nsyAmayashasyAM cha duHkhAM kApuruShochitAm
shlokas.24:
yamenamabhinandeyuramitrAH puruShaM kRRisham |
lokasya samavaj~nAtaM nihInAshanavAsasam
shlokas.25:
aholAbhakaraM dInamalpajIvanamalpakam |
nedRRishaM bandhumAsAdya bAndhavaH sukhamedhate
shlokas.26:
avRRittyaiva vipatsyAmo vayaM rAShTrAtpravAsitAH |
sarvakAmarasairhInAH sthAnabhraShTA aki~nchanAH
shlokas.27:
avarNakAriNaM satsu kulava.nshasya nAshanam |
kaliM putrapravAdena sa~njaya tvAmajIjanam
shlokas.28:
niramarShaM nirutsAhaM nirvIryamarinandanam |
mA sma sImantinI kAchijjanayetputramIdRRisham
shlokas.29:
mA dhUmAya jvalAtyantamAkramya jahi shAtravAn |
jvala mUrdhanyamitrANAM muhUrtamapi vA kShaNam
shlokas.30:
etAvAneva puruSho yadamarShI yadakShamI |
kShamAvAnniramarShashcha naiva strI na punaH pumAn
shlokas.31:
santoSho vai shriyaM hanti tathAnukrosha eva cha |
anutthAnabhaye chobhe nirIho nAshnute mahat
shlokas.32:
ebhyo nikRRitipApebhyaH pramu~nchAtmAnamAtmanA |
AyasaM hRRidayaM kRRitvA mRRigayasva punaH svakam
shlokas.33:
puraM viShahate yasmAttasmAtpuruSha uchyate |
tamAhurvyarthanAmAnaM strIvadya iha jIvati
shlokas.34:
shUrasyorjitasattvasya siMhavikrAntagAminaH |
diShTabhAvaM gatasyApi vighase modate prajA
shlokas.35:
ya AtmanaH priyasukhe hitvA mRRigayate shriyam |
amAtyAnAmatho harShamAdadhAtyachireNa saH
shlokas.36:
putra uvAcha||
kiM nu te mAmapashyantyAH pRRithivyA api sarvayA |
kimAbharaNakRRityaM te kiM bhogairjIvitena vA
shlokas.37:
mAtovAcha||
kimadyakAnAM ye lokA dviShantastAnavApnuyuH |
ye tvAdRRitAtmanAM lokAH suhRRidastAnvrajantu naH
shlokas.38:
bhRRityairvihIyamAnAnAM parapiNDopajIvinAm |
kRRipaNAnAmasattvAnAM mA vRRittimanuvartithAH
shlokas.39:
anu tvAM tAta jIvantu brAhmaNAH suhRRidastathA |
parjanyamiva bhUtAni devA iva shatakratum
shlokas.40:
yamAjIvanti puruShaM sarvabhUtAni sa~njaya |
pakvaM drumamivAsAdya tasya jIvitamarthavat
shlokas.41:
yasya shUrasya vikrAntairedhante bAndhavAH sukham |
tridashA iva shakrasya sAdhu tasyeha jIvitam
shlokas.42:
svabAhubalamAshritya yo.abhyujjIvati mAnavaH |
sa loke labhate kIrtiM paratra cha shubhAM gatim

shlokas.1:
vidurovAcha||
athaitasyAmavasthAyAM pauruShaM hAtumichChasi |
nihInasevitaM mArgaM gamiShyasyachirAdiva
shlokas.2:
yo hi tejo yathAshakti na darshayati vikramAt |
kShatriyo jIvitAkA~NkShI stena ityeva taM viduH
shlokas.3:
arthavantyupapannAni vAkyAni guNavanti cha |
naiva samprApnuvanti tvAM mumUrShumiva bheShajam
shlokas.4:
santi vai sindhurAjasya santuShTA bahavo janAH |
daurbalyAdAsate mUDhA vyasanaughapratIkShiNaH
shlokas.5:
sahAyopachayaM kRRitvA vyavasAyya tatastataH |
anuduShyeyurapare pashyantastava pauruSham
shlokas.6:
taiH kRRitvA saha sa~NghAtaM giridurgAlayA.nshchara |
kAle vyasanamAkA~NkShannaivAyamajarAmaraH
shlokas.7:
sa~njayo nAmatashcha tvaM na cha pashyAmi tattvayi |
anvarthanAmA bhava me putra mA vyarthanAmakaH
shlokas.8:
samyagdRRiShTirmahAprAj~no bAlaM tvAM brAhmaNo.abravIt |
ayaM prApya mahatkRRichChraM punarvRRiddhiM gamiShyati
shlokas.9:
tasya smarantI vachanamAsha.nse vijayaM tava |
tasmAttAta bravImi tvAM vakShyAmi cha punaH punaH
shlokas.10:
yasya hyarthAbhinirvRRittau bhavantyApyAyitAH pare |
tasyArthasiddhirniyatA nayeShvarthAnusAriNaH
shlokas.11:
samRRiddhirasamRRiddhirvA pUrveShAM mama sa~njaya |
evaM vidvAnyuddhamanA bhava mA pratyupAhara
shlokas.12:
nAtaH pApIyasIM kA~nchidavasthAM shambaro.abravIt |
yatra naivAdya na prAtarbhojanaM pratidRRishyate
shlokas.13:
patiputravadhAdetatparamaM duHkhamabravIt |
dAridryamiti yatproktaM paryAyamaraNaM hi tat
shlokas.14:
ahaM mahAkule jAtA hradAddhradamivAgatA |
IshvarI sarvakalyANairbhartrA paramapUjitA
shlokas.15:
mahArhamAlyAbharaNAM sumRRiShTAmbaravAsasam |
purA dRRiShTvA suhRRidvargo mAmapashyatsudurgatAm
shlokas.16:
yadA mAM chaiva bhAryAM cha draShTAsi bhRRishadurbale |
na tadA jIvitenArtho bhavitA tava sa~njaya
shlokas.17:
dAsakarmakarAnbhRRityAnAchAryartvikpurohitAn |
avRRittyAsmAnprajahato dRRiShTvA kiM jIvitena te
shlokas.18:
yadi kRRityaM na pashyAmi tavAdyeha yathA purA |
shlAghanIyaM yashasyaM cha kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.19:
neti chedbrAhmaNAnbrUyAM dIryate hRRidayaM mama |
na hyahaM na cha me bhartA neti brAhmaNamuktavAn
shlokas.20:
vayamAshrayaNIyAH sma nAshritAraH parasya cha |
sAnyAnAshritya jIvantI parityakShyAmi jIvitam
shlokas.21:
apAre bhava naH pAramaplave bhava naH plavaH |
kuruShva sthAnamasthAne mRRitAnsa~njIvayasva naH
shlokas.22:
sarve te shatravaH sahyA na chejjIvitumichChasi |
atha chedIdRRishIM vRRittiM klIbAmabhyupapadyase
shlokas.23:
nirviNNAtmA hatamanA mu~nchaitAM pApajIvikAm |
ekashatruvadhenaiva shUro gachChati vishrutim
shlokas.24:
indro vRRitravadhenaiva mahendraH samapadyata |
mAhendraM cha grahaM lebhe lokAnAM cheshvaro.abhavat
shlokas.25:
nAma vishrAvya vA sa~Nkhye shatrUnAhUya da.nshitAn |
senAgraM vApi vidrAvya hatvA vA puruShaM varam
shlokas.26:
yadaiva labhate vIraH suyuddhena mahadyashaH |
tadaiva pravyathante.asya shatravo vinamanti cha
shlokas.27:
tyaktvAtmAnaM raNe dakShaM shUraM kApuruShA janAH |
avashAH pUrayanti sma sarvakAmasamRRiddhibhiH
shlokas.28:
rAjyaM vApyugravibhra.nshaM sa.nshayo jIvitasya vA |
pralabdhasya hi shatrorvai sheShaM kurvanti sAdhavaH
shlokas.29:
svargadvAropamaM rAjyamatha vApyamRRitopamam |
ruddhamekAyane matvA patolmuka ivAriShu
shlokas.30:
jahi shatrUnraNe rAjansvadharmamanupAlaya |
mA tvA pashyetsukRRipaNaM shatruH shrImAnkadAchana
shlokas.31:
asmadIyaishcha shochadbhirnadadbhishcha parairvRRitam |
api tvAM nAnupashyeyaM dInA dInamavasthitam
shlokas.32:
uShya sauvIrakanyAbhiH shlAghasvArthairyathA purA |
mA cha saindhavakanyAnAmavasanno vashaM gamaH
shlokas.33:
yuvA rUpeNa sampanno vidyayAbhijanena cha |
yastvAdRRisho vikurvIta yashasvI lokavishrutaH
voDhavye dhuryanaDuvanmanye maraNameva tat
shlokas.34:
yadi tvAmanupashyAmi parasya priyavAdinam |
pRRiShThato.anuvrajantaM vA kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.35:
nAsmi~njAtu kule jAto gachChedyo.anyasya pRRiShThataH |
na tvaM parasyAnudhuraM tAta jIvitumarhasi
shlokas.36:
ahaM hi kShatrahRRidayaM veda yatparishAshvatam |
pUrvaiH pUrvataraiH proktaM paraiH paratarairapi
shlokas.37:
yo vai kashchidihAjAtaH kShatriyaH kShatradharmavit |
bhayAdvRRittisamIkSho vA na namediha kasyachit
shlokas.38:
udyachChedeva na namedudyamo hyeva pauruSham |
apyaparvaNi bhajyeta na namediha kasyachit
shlokas.39:
mAta~Ngo matta iva cha parIyAtsumahAmanAH |
brAhmaNebhyo namennityaM dharmAyaiva cha sa~njaya
shlokas.40:
niyachChannitarAnvarNAnvinighnansarvaduShkRRitaH |
sasahAyo.asahAyo vA yAvajjIvaM tathA bhavet

shlokas.1:
putra uvAcha||
kRRiShNAyasasyeva cha te saMhatya hRRidayaM kRRitam |
mama mAtastvakaruNe vairapraj~ne hyamarShaNe
shlokas.2:
aho kShatrasamAchAro yatra mAmaparaM yathA |
IdRRishaM vachanaM brUyAdbhavatI putramekajam
shlokas.3:
kiM nu te mAmapashyantyAH pRRithivyA api sarvayA |
kimAbharaNakRRityaM te kiM bhogairjIvitena vA
shlokas.4:
mAtovAcha||
sarvArambhA hi viduShAM tAta dharmArthakAraNAt |
tAnevAbhisamIkShyAhaM sa~njaya tvAmachUchudam
shlokas.5:
sa samIkShyakramopeto mukhyaH kAlo.ayamAgataH |
asmi.nshchedAgate kAle kAryaM na pratipadyase
asambhAvitarUpastvaM sunRRisha.nsaM kariShyasi
shlokas.6:
taM tvAmayashasA spRRiShTaM na brUyAM yadi sa~njaya |
kharIvAtsalyamAhustanniHsAmarthyamahetukam
shlokas.7:
sadbhirvigarhitaM mArgaM tyaja mUrkhaniShevitam |
avidyA vai mahatyasti yAmimAM sa.nshritAH prajAH
shlokas.8:
tava syAdyadi sadvRRittaM tena me tvaM priyo bhaveH |
dharmArthaguNayuktena netareNa katha~nchana
daivamAnuShayuktena sadbhirAcharitena cha
shlokas.9:
yo hyevamavinItena ramate putranaptRRiNA |
anutthAnavatA chApi moghaM tasya prajAphalam
shlokas.10:
akurvanto hi karmANi kurvanto ninditAni cha |
sukhaM naiveha nAmutra labhante puruShAdhamAH
shlokas.11:
yuddhAya kShatriyaH sRRiShTaH sa~njayeha jayAya cha |
krUrAya karmaNe nityaM prajAnAM paripAlane
jayanvA vadhyamAno vA prApnotIndrasalokatAm
shlokas.12:
na shakrabhavane puNye divi tadvidyate sukham |
yadamitrAnvashe kRRitvA kShatriyaH sukhamashnute
shlokas.13:
manyunA dahyamAnena puruSheNa manasvinA |
nikRRiteneha bahushaH shatrUnpratijigIShayA
shlokas.14:
AtmAnaM vA parityajya shatrUnvA vinipAtya vai |
ato.anyena prakAreNa shAntirasya kuto bhavet
shlokas.15:
iha prAj~no hi puruShaH svalpamapriyamichChati |
yasya svalpaM priyaM loke dhruvaM tasyAlpamapriyam
shlokas.16:
priyAbhAvAchcha puruSho naiva prApnoti shobhanam |
dhruvaM chAbhAvamabhyeti gatvA ga~Ngeva sAgaram
shlokas.17:
putra uvAcha||
neyaM matistvayA vAchyA mAtaH putre visheShataH |
kAruNyamevAtra pashya bhUtveha jaDamUkavat
shlokas.18:
mAtovAcha||
ato me bhUyasI nandiryadevamanupashyasi |
chodyaM mAM chodayasyetadbhRRishaM vai chodayAmi te
shlokas.19:
atha tvAM pUjayiShyAmi hatvA vai sarvasaindhavAn |
ahaM pashyAmi vijayaM kRRitsnaM bhAvinameva te
shlokas.20:
putra uvAcha||
akoshasyAsahAyasya kutaH svidvijayo mama |
ityavasthAM viditvemAmAtmanAtmani dAruNAm
rAjyAdbhAvo nivRRitto me tridivAdiva duShkRRiteH
shlokas.21:
IdRRishaM bhavatI ka~nchidupAyamanupashyati |
tanme pariNatapraj~ne samyakprabrUhi pRRichChate
kariShyAmi hi tatsarvaM yathAvadanushAsanam
shlokas.22:
mAtovAcha||
putrAtmA nAvamantavyaH pUrvAbhirasamRRiddhibhiH |
abhUtvA hi bhavantyarthA bhUtvA nashyanti chApare
shlokas.23:
amarSheNaiva chApyarthA nArabdhavyAH subAlishaiH |
sarveShAM karmaNAM tAta phale nityamanityatA
shlokas.24:
anityamiti jAnanto na bhavanti bhavanti cha |
atha ye naiva kurvanti naiva jAtu bhavanti te
shlokas.25:
aikaguNyamanIhAyAmabhAvaH karmaNAM phalam |
atha dvaiguNyamIhAyAM phalaM bhavati vA na vA
shlokas.26:
yasya prAgeva viditA sarvArthAnAmanityatA |
nudedvRRiddhisamRRiddhI sa pratikUle nRRipAtmaja
shlokas.27:
utthAtavyaM jAgRRitavyaM yoktavyaM bhUtikarmasu |
bhaviShyatItyeva manaH kRRitvA satatamavyathaiH
ma~NgalAni puraskRRitya brAhmaNaishcheshvaraiH saha
shlokas.28:
prAj~nasya nRRipaterAshu vRRiddhirbhavati putraka |
abhivartati lakShmIstaM prAchImiva divAkaraH
shlokas.29:
nidarshanAnyupAyA.nshcha bahUnyuddharShaNAni cha |
anudarshitarUpo.asi pashyAmi kuru pauruSham
puruShArthamabhipretaM samAhartumihArhasi
shlokas.30:
kruddhA.NllubdhAnparikShINAnavakShiptAnvimAnitAn |
spardhinashchaiva ye kechittAnyukta upadhAraya
shlokas.31:
etena tvaM prakAreNa mahato bhetsyase gaNAn |
mahAvega ivoddhUto mAtarishvA balAhakAn
shlokas.32:
teShAmagrapradAyI syAH kalyotthAyI priya.nvadaH |
te tvAM priyaM kariShyanti puro dhAsyanti cha dhruvam
shlokas.33:
yadaiva shatrurjAnIyAtsapatnaM tyaktajIvitam |
tadaivAsmAdudvijate sarpAdveshmagatAdiva
shlokas.34:
taM viditvA parAkrAntaM vashe na kurute yadi |
nirvAdairnirvadedenamantatastadbhaviShyati
shlokas.35:
nirvAdAdAspadaM labdhvA dhanavRRiddhirbhaviShyati |
dhanavantaM hi mitrANi bhajante chAshrayanti cha
shlokas.36:
skhalitArthaM punastAta santyajantyapi bAndhavAH |
apyasminnAshrayante cha jugupsanti cha tAdRRisham
shlokas.37:
shatruM kRRitvA yaH sahAyaM vishvAsamupagachChati |
ataH sambhAvyamevaitadyadrAjyaM prApnuyAditi

shlokas.1:
mAtovAcha||
naiva rAj~nA daraH kAryo jAtu kasyA~nchidApadi |
atha chedapi dIrNaH syAnnaiva varteta dIrNavat
shlokas.2:
dIrNaM hi dRRiShTvA rAjAnaM sarvamevAnudIryate |
rAShTraM balamamAtyAshcha pRRithakkurvanti te matim
shlokas.3:
shatrUneke prapadyante prajahatyapare punaH |
anveke prajihIrShanti ye purastAdvimAnitAH
shlokas.4:
ya evAtyantasuhRRidasta enaM paryupAsate |
ashaktayaH svastikAmA baddhavatsA iDA iva
shochantamanushochanti pratItAniva bAndhavAn
shlokas.5:
api te pUjitAH pUrvamapi te suhRRido matAH |
ye rAShTramabhimanyante rAj~no vyasanamIyuShaH
mA dIdarastvaM suhRRido mA tvAM dIrNaM prahAsiShuH
shlokas.6:
prabhAvaM pauruShaM buddhiM jij~nAsantyA mayA tava |
ullapantyA samAshvAsaM balavAniva durbalam
shlokas.7:
yadyetatsa.nvijAnAsi yadi samyagbravImyaham |
kRRitvAsaumyamivAtmAnaM jayAyottiShTha sa~njaya
shlokas.8:
asti naH koshanichayo mahAnaviditastava |
tamahaM veda nAnyastamupasampAdayAmi te
shlokas.9:
santi naikashatA bhUyaH suhRRidastava sa~njaya |
sukhaduHkhasahA vIra shatArhA anivartinaH
shlokas.10:
tAdRRishA hi sahAyA vai puruShasya bubhUShataH |
IShadujjihataH ki~nchitsachivAH shatrukarshanAH
shlokas.11:
putra uvAcha||
kasya tvIdRRishakaM vAkyaM shrutvApi svalpachetasaH |
tamo na vyapahanyeta suchitrArthapadAkSharam
shlokas.12:
udake dhUriyaM dhAryA sartavyaM pravaNe mayA |
yasya me bhavatI netrI bhaviShyadbhUtadarshinI
shlokas.13:
ahaM hi vachanaM tvattaH shushrUShuraparAparam |
ki~nchitki~nchitprativada.nstUShNImAsaM muhurmuhuH
shlokas.14:
atRRipyannamRRitasyeva kRRichChrAllabdhasya bAndhavAt |
udyachChAmyeSha shatrUNAM niyamAya jayAya cha
shlokas.15:
kuntyuvAcha||
sadashva iva sa kShiptaH praNunno vAkyasAyakaiH |
tachchakAra tathA sarvaM yathAvadanushAsanam
shlokas.16:
idamuddharShaNaM bhImaM tejovardhanamuttamam |
rAjAnaM shrAvayenmantrI sIdantaM shatrupIDitam
shlokas.17:
jayo nAmetihAso.ayaM shrotavyo vijigIShuNA |
mahIM vijayate kShipraM shrutvA shatrU.nshcha mardati
shlokas.18:
idaM pu.nsavanaM chaiva vIrAjananameva cha |
abhIkShNaM garbhiNI shrutvA dhruvaM vIraM prajAyate
shlokas.19:
vidyAshUraM tapaHshUraM damashUraM tapasvinam |
brAhmyA shriyA dIpyamAnaM sAdhuvAdena saMmatam
shlokas.20:
archiShmantaM balopetaM mahAbhAgaM mahAratham |
dhRRiShTavantamanAdhRRiShyaM jetAramaparAjitam
shlokas.21:
niyantAramasAdhUnAM goptAraM dharmachAriNAm |
tadarthaM kShatriyA sUte vIraM satyaparAkramam

shlokas.1:
kuntyuvAcha||
arjunaM keshava brUyAstvayi jAte sma sUtake |
upopaviShTA nArIbhirAshrame parivAritA
shlokas.2:
athAntarikShe vAgAsIddivyarUpA manoramA |
sahasrAkShasamaH kunti bhaviShyatyeSha te sutaH
shlokas.3:
eSha jeShyati sa~NgrAme kurUnsarvAnsamAgatAn |
bhImasenadvitIyashcha lokamudvartayiShyati
shlokas.4:
putraste pRRithivIM jetA yashashchAsya divaspRRisham |
hatvA kurUngrAmajanye vAsudevasahAyavAn
shlokas.5:
pitryama.nshaM pranaShTaM cha punarapyuddhariShyati |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH shrImA.nstrInmedhAnAhariShyati
shlokas.6:
taM satyasandhaM bIbhatsuM savyasAchinamachyuta |
yathAhamevaM jAnAmi balavantaM durAsadam
tathA tadastu dAshArha yathA vAgabhyabhAShata
shlokas.7:
dharmashchedasti vArShNeya tathA satyaM bhaviShyati |
tvaM chApi tattathA kRRiShNa sarvaM sampAdayiShyasi
shlokas.8:
nAhaM tadabhyasUyAmi yathA vAgabhyabhAShata |
namo dharmAya mahate dharmo dhArayati prajAH
shlokas.9:
etaddhana~njayo vAchyo nityodyukto vRRikodaraH |
yadarthaM kShatriyA sUte tasya kAlo.ayamAgataH
na hi vairaM samAsAdya sIdanti puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.10:
viditA te sadA buddhirbhImasya na sa shAmyati |
yAvadantaM na kurute shatrUNAM shatrukarshanaH
shlokas.11:
sarvadharmavisheShaj~nAM snuShAM pANDormahAtmanaH |
brUyA mAdhava kalyANIM kRRiShNAM kRRiShNa yashasvinIm
shlokas.12:
yuktametanmahAbhAge kule jAte yashasvini |
yanme putreShu sarveShu yathAvattvamavartithAH
shlokas.13:
mAdrIputrau cha vaktavyau kShatradharmaratAvubhau |
vikrameNArjitAnbhogAnvRRiNItaM jIvitAdapi
shlokas.14:
vikramAdhigatA hyarthAH kShatradharmeNa jIvataH |
mano manuShyasya sadA prINanti puruShottama
shlokas.15:
yachcha vaH prekShamANAnAM sarvadharmopachAyinI |
pA~nchAlI paruShANyuktA ko nu tatkShantumarhati
shlokas.16:
na rAjyaharaNaM duHkhaM dyUte chApi parAjayaH |
pravrAjanaM sutAnAM vA na me tadduHkhakAraNam
shlokas.17:
yattu sA bRRihatI shyAmA sabhAyAM rudatI tadA |
ashrauShItparuShA vAchastanme duHkhataraM matam
shlokas.18:
strIdharmiNI varArohA kShatradharmaratA sadA |
nAdhyagachChattadA nAthaM kRRiShNA nAthavatI satI
shlokas.19:
taM vai brUhi mahAbAho sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
arjunaM puruShavyAghraM draupadyAH padavIM chara
shlokas.20:
viditau hi tavAtyantaM kruddhAviva yamAntakau |
bhImArjunau nayetAM hi devAnapi parAM gatim
shlokas.21:
tayoshchaitadavaj~nAnaM yatsA kRRiShNA sabhAgatA |
duHshAsanashcha yadbhImaM kaTukAnyabhyabhAShata
pashyatAM kuruvIrANAM tachcha sa.nsmArayeH punaH
shlokas.22:
pANDavAnkushalaM pRRichCheH saputrAnkRRiShNayA saha |
mAM cha kushalinIM brUyAsteShu bhUyo janArdana
ariShTaM gachCha panthAnaM putrAnme paripAlaya
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
abhivAdyAtha tAM kRRiShNaH kRRitvA chAbhipradakShiNam |
nishchakrAma mahAbAhuH siMhakhelagatistataH
shlokas.24:
tato visarjayAmAsa bhIShmAdInkurupu~NgavAn |
Aropya cha rathe karNaM prAyAtsAtyakinA saha
shlokas.25:
tataH prayAte dAshArhe kuravaH sa~NgatA mithaH |
jajalpurmahadAshcharyaM keshave paramAdbhutam
shlokas.26:
pramUDhA pRRithivI sarvA mRRityupAshasitA kRRitA |
duryodhanasya bAlishyAnnaitadastIti chAbruvan
shlokas.27:
tato niryAya nagarAtprayayau puruShottamaH |
mantrayAmAsa cha tadA karNena suchiraM saha
shlokas.28:
visarjayitvA rAdheyaM sarvayAdavanandanaH |
tato javena mahatA tUrNamashvAnachodayat
shlokas.29:
te pibanta ivAkAshaM dArukeNa prachoditAH |
hayA jagmurmahAvegA manomArutaraMhasaH
shlokas.30:
te vyatItya tamadhvAnaM kShipraM shyenA ivAshugAH |
uchchaiH sUryamupaplavyaM shAr~NgadhanvAnamAvahan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kuntyAstu vachanaM shrutvA bhIShmadroNau mahArathau |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyamUchatuH shAsanAtigam
shlokas.2:
shrutaM te puruShavyAghra kuntyAH kRRiShNasya saMnidhau |
vAkyamarthavadavyagramuktaM dharmyamanuttamam
shlokas.3:
tatkariShyanti kaunteyA vAsudevasya saMmatam |
na hi te jAtu shAmyerannRRite rAjyena kaurava
shlokas.4:
kleshitA hi tvayA pArthA dharmapAshasitAstadA |
sabhAyAM draupadI chaiva taishcha tanmarShitaM tava
shlokas.5:
kRRitAstraM hyarjunaM prApya bhImaM cha kRRitanishramam |
gANDIvaM cheShudhI chaiva rathaM cha dhvajameva cha
sahAyaM vAsudevaM cha na kSha.nsyati yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.6:
pratyakShaM te mahAbAho yathA pArthena dhImatA |
virATanagare pUrvaM sarve sma yudhi nirjitAH
shlokas.7:
dAnavAnghorakarmANo nivAtakavachAnyudhi |
raudramastraM samAdhAya dagdhavAnastravahninA
shlokas.8:
karNaprabhRRitayashcheme tvaM chApi kavachI rathI |
mokShitA ghoShayAtrAyAM paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.9:
prashAmya bharatashreShTha bhrAtRRibhiH saha pANDavaiH |
rakShemAM pRRithivIM sarvAM mRRityordaMShTrAntaraM gatAm
shlokas.10:
jyeShTho bhrAtA dharmashIlo vatsalaH shlakShNavAkShuchiH |
taM gachCha puruShavyAghraM vyapanIyeha kilbiSham
shlokas.11:
dRRiShTashchettvaM pANDavena vyapanItasharAsanaH |
prasannabhrukuTiH shrImAnkRRitA shAntiH kulasya naH
shlokas.12:
tamabhyetya sahAmAtyaH pariShvajya nRRipAtmajam |
abhivAdaya rAjAnaM yathApUrvamari.ndama
shlokas.13:
abhivAdayamAnaM tvAM pANibhyAM bhImapUrvajaH |
pratigRRihNAtu sauhArdAtkuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.14:
siMhaskandhorubAhustvAM vRRittAyatamahAbhujaH |
pariShvajatu bAhubhyAM bhImaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.15:
siMhagrIvo guDAkeshastatastvAM puShkarekShaNaH |
abhivAdayatAM pArthaH kuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.16:
Ashvineyau naravyAghrau rUpeNApratimau bhuvi |
tau cha tvAM guruvatpremNA pUjayA pratyudIyatAm
shlokas.17:
mu~nchantvAnandajAshrUNi dAshArhapramukhA nRRipAH |
sa~NgachCha bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM mAnaM santyajya pArthiva
shlokas.18:
prashAdhi pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM tatastaM bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
samAli~Ngya cha harSheNa nRRipA yAntu parasparam
shlokas.19:
alaM yuddhena rAjendra suhRRidAM shRRiNu kAraNam |
dhruvaM vinAsho yuddhe hi kShatriyANAM pradRRishyate
shlokas.20:
jyotIMShi pratikUlAni dAruNA mRRigapakShiNaH |
utpAtA vividhA vIra dRRishyante kShatranAshanAH
shlokas.21:
visheShata ihAsmAkaM nimittAni vinAshane |
ulkAbhirhi pradIptAbhirvadhyate pRRitanA tava
shlokas.22:
vAhanAnyaprahRRiShTAni rudantIva vishAM pate |
gRRidhrAste paryupAsante sainyAni cha samantataH
shlokas.23:
nagaraM na yathApUrvaM tathA rAjaniveshanam |
shivAshchAshivanirghoShA dIptAM sevanti vai disham
shlokas.24:
kuru vAkyaM piturmAturasmAkaM cha hitaiShiNAm |
tvayyAyatto mahAbAho shamo vyAyAma eva cha
shlokas.25:
na chetkariShyasi vachaH suhRRidAmarikarshana |
tapsyase vAhinIM dRRiShTvA pArthabANaprapIDitAm
shlokas.26:
bhImasya cha mahAnAdaM nadataH shuShmiNo raNe |
shrutvA smartAsi me vAkyaM gANDIvasya cha nisvanam
yadyetadapasavyaM te bhaviShyati vacho mama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu vimanAstiryagdRRiShTiradhomukhaH |
saMhatya cha bhruvormadhyaM na ki~nchidvyAjahAra ha
shlokas.2:
taM vai vimanasaM dRRiShTvA samprekShyAnyonyamantikAt |
punarevottaraM vAkyamuktavantau nararShabhau
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shushrUShumanasUyaM cha brahmaNyaM satyasa~Ngaram |
pratiyotsyAmahe pArthamato duHkhataraM nu kim
shlokas.4:
droNa uvAcha||
ashvatthAmni yathA putre bhUyo mama dhana~njaye |
bahumAnaH paro rAjansaMnatishcha kapidhvaje
shlokas.5:
taM chetputrAtpriyataraM pratiyotsye dhana~njayam |
kShatradharmamanuShThAya dhigastu kShatrajIvikAm
shlokas.6:
yasya loke samo nAsti kashchidanyo dhanurdharaH |
matprasAdAtsa bIbhatsuH shreyAnanyairdhanurdharaiH
shlokas.7:
mitradhrugduShTabhAvashcha nAstiko.athAnRRijuH shaThaH |
na satsu labhate pUjAM yaj~ne mUrkha ivAgataH
shlokas.8:
vAryamANo.api pApebhyaH pApAtmA pApamichChati |
chodyamAno.api pApena shubhAtmA shubhamichChati
shlokas.9:
mithyopacharitA hyete vartamAnA hyanu priye |
ahitatvAya kalpante doShA bharatasattama
shlokas.10:
tvamuktaH kuruvRRiddhena mayA cha vidureNa cha |
vAsudevena cha tathA shreyo naivAbhipadyase
shlokas.11:
asti me balamityeva sahasA tvaM titIrShasi |
sagrAhanakramakaraM ga~NgAvegamivoShNage
shlokas.12:
vAsa eva yathA hi tvaM prAvRRiNvAno.adya manyase |
srajaM tyaktAmiva prApya lobhAdyaudhiShThirIM shriyam
shlokas.13:
draupadIsahitaM pArthaM sAyudhairbhrAtRRibhirvRRitam |
vanasthamapi rAjyasthaH pANDavaM ko.atijIvati
shlokas.14:
nideshe yasya rAjAnaH sarve tiShThanti ki~NkarAH |
tamailavilamAsAdya dharmarAjo vyarAjata
shlokas.15:
kuberasadanaM prApya tato ratnAnyavApya cha |
sphItamAkramya te rAShTraM rAjyamichChanti pANDavAH
shlokas.16:
dattaM hutamadhItaM cha brAhmaNAstarpitA dhanaiH |
AvayorgatamAyushcha kRRitakRRityau cha viddhi nau
shlokas.17:
tvaM tu hitvA sukhaM rAjyaM mitrANi cha dhanAni cha |
vigrahaM pANDavaiH kRRitvA mahadvyasanamApsyasi
shlokas.18:
draupadI yasya chAshAste vijayaM satyavAdinI |
tapoghoravratA devI na tvaM jeShyasi pANDavam
shlokas.19:
mantrI janArdano yasya bhrAtA yasya dhana~njayaH |
sarvashastrabhRRitAM shreShThaM kathaM jeShyasi pANDavam
shlokas.20:
sahAyA brAhmaNA yasya dhRRitimanto jitendriyAH |
tamugratapasaM vIraM kathaM jeShyasi pANDavam
shlokas.21:
punaruktaM cha vakShyAmi yatkAryaM bhUtimichChatA |
suhRRidA majjamAneShu suhRRitsu vyasanArNave
shlokas.22:
alaM yuddhena tairvIraiH shAmya tvaM kuruvRRiddhaye |
mA gamaH sasutAmAtyaH sabalashcha parAbhavam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
rAjaputraiH parivRRitastathAmAtyaishcha sa~njaya |
upAropya rathe karNaM niryAto madhusUdanaH
shlokas.2:
kimabravIdrathopasthe rAdheyaM paravIrahA |
kAni sAntvAni govindaH sUtaputre prayuktavAn
shlokas.3:
oghameghasvanaH kAle yatkRRiShNaH karNamabravIt |
mRRidu vA yadi vA tIkShNaM tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
AnupUrvyeNa vAkyAni shlakShNAni cha mRRidUni cha |
priyANi dharmayuktAni satyAni cha hitAni cha
shlokas.5:
hRRidayagrahaNIyAni rAdheyaM madhusUdanaH |
yAnyabravIdameyAtmA tAni me shRRiNu bhArata
shlokas.6:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
upAsitAste rAdheya brAhmaNA vedapAragAH |
tattvArthaM paripRRiShTAshcha niyatenAnasUyayA
shlokas.7:
tvameva karNa jAnAsi vedavAdAnsanAtanAn |
tvaM hyeva dharmashAstreShu sUkShmeShu pariniShThitaH
shlokas.8:
kAnInashcha sahoDhashcha kanyAyAM yashcha jAyate |
voDhAraM pitaraM tasya prAhuH shAstravido janAH
shlokas.9:
so.asi karNa tathA jAtaH pANDoH putro.asi dharmataH |
nigrahAddharmashAstrANAmehi rAjA bhaviShyasi
shlokas.10:
pitRRipakShe hi te pArthA mAtRRipakShe cha vRRiShNayaH |
dvau pakShAvabhijAnIhi tvametau puruSharShabha
shlokas.11:
mayA sArdhamito yAtamadya tvAM tAta pANDavAH |
abhijAnantu kaunteyaM pUrvajAtaM yudhiShThirAt
shlokas.12:
pAdau tava grahIShyanti bhrAtaraH pa~ncha pANDavAH |
draupadeyAstathA pa~ncha saubhadrashchAparAjitaH
shlokas.13:
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha pANDavArthe samAgatAH |
pAdau tava grahIShyanti sarve chAndhakavRRiShNayaH
shlokas.14:
hiraNmayA.nshcha te kumbhAnrAjatAnpArthivA.nstathA |
oShadhyaH sarvabIjAni sarvaratnAni vIrudhaH
shlokas.15:
rAjanyA rAjakanyAshchApyAnayantvabhiShechanam |
ShaShThe cha tvAM tathA kAle draupadyupagamiShyati
shlokas.16:
adya tvAmabhiShi~nchantu chAturvaidyA dvijAtayaH |
purohitaH pANDavAnAM vyAghracharmaNyavasthitam
shlokas.17:
tathaiva bhrAtaraH pa~ncha pANDavAH puruSharShabhAH |
draupadeyAstathA pa~ncha pA~nchAlAshchedayastathA
shlokas.18:
ahaM cha tvAbhiShekShyAmi rAjAnaM pRRithivIpatim |
yuvarAjo.astu te rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.19:
gRRihItvA vyajanaM shvetaM dharmAtmA sa.nshitavrataH |
upAnvArohatu rathaM kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.20:
ChatraM cha te mahachChvetaM bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
abhiShiktasya kaunteya kaunteyo dhArayiShyati
shlokas.21:
ki~NkiNIshatanirghoShaM vaiyAghraparivAraNam |
rathaM shvetahayairyuktamarjuno vAhayiShyati
shlokas.22:
abhimanyushcha te nityaM pratyAsanno bhaviShyati |
nakulaH sahadevashcha draupadeyAshcha pa~ncha ye
shlokas.23:
pA~nchAlAstvAnuyAsyanti shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH |
ahaM cha tvAnuyAsyAmi sarve chAndhakavRRiShNayaH
dAshArhAH parivArAste dAshArNAshcha vishAM pate
shlokas.24:
bhu~NkShva rAjyaM mahAbAho bhrAtRRibhiH saha pANDavaiH |
japairhomaishcha sa.nyukto ma~Ngalaishcha pRRithagvidhaiH
shlokas.25:
purogamAshcha te santu draviDAH saha kuntalaiH |
AndhrAstAlacharAshchaiva chUchupA veNupAstathA
shlokas.26:
stuvantu tvAdya bahushaH stutibhiH sUtamAgadhAH |
vijayaM vasuSheNasya ghoShayantu cha pANDavAH
shlokas.27:
sa tvaM parivRRitaH pArthairnakShatrairiva chandramAH |
prashAdhi rAjyaM kaunteya kuntIM cha pratinandaya
shlokas.28:
mitrANi te prahRRiShyantu vyathantu ripavastathA |
saubhrAtraM chaiva te.adyAstu bhrAtRRibhiH saha pANDavaiH

shlokas.1:
karNa uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM sauhRRidAnme praNayAchchAttha keshava |
sakhyena chaiva vArShNeya shreyaskAmatayaiva cha
shlokas.2:
sarvaM chaivAbhijAnAmi pANDoH putro.asmi dharmataH |
nigrahAddharmashAstrANAM yathA tvaM kRRiShNa manyase
shlokas.3:
kanyA garbhaM samAdhatta bhAskarAnmAM janArdana |
AdityavachanAchchaiva jAtaM mAM sA vyasarjayat
shlokas.4:
so.asmi kRRiShNa tathA jAtaH pANDoH putro.asmi dharmataH |
kuntyA tvahamapAkIrNo yathA na kushalaM tathA
shlokas.5:
sUto hi mAmadhiratho dRRiShTvaiva anayadgRRihAn |
rAdhAyAshchaiva mAM prAdAtsauhArdAnmadhusUdana
shlokas.6:
matsnehAchchaiva rAdhAyAH sadyaH kShIramavAtarat |
sA me mUtraM purIShaM cha pratijagrAha mAdhava
shlokas.7:
tasyAH piNDavyapanayaM kuryAdasmadvidhaH katham |
dharmaviddharmashAstrANAM shravaNe satataM rataH
shlokas.8:
tathA mAmabhijAnAti sUtashchAdhirathaH sutam |
pitaraM chAbhijAnAmi tamahaM sauhRRidAtsadA
shlokas.9:
sa hi me jAtakarmAdi kArayAmAsa mAdhava |
shAstradRRiShTena vidhinA putraprItyA janArdana
shlokas.10:
nAma me vasuSheNeti kArayAmAsa vai dvijaiH |
bhAryAshchoDhA mama prApte yauvane tena keshava
shlokas.11:
tAsu putrAshcha pautrAshcha mama jAtA janArdana |
tAsu me hRRidayaM kRRiShNa sa~njAtaM kAmabandhanam
shlokas.12:
na pRRithivyA sakalayA na suvarNasya rAshibhiH |
harShAdbhayAdvA govinda anRRitaM vaktumutsahe
shlokas.13:
dhRRitarAShTrakule kRRiShNa duryodhanasamAshrayAt |
mayA trayodasha samA bhuktaM rAjyamakaNTakam
shlokas.14:
iShTaM cha bahubhiryaj~naiH saha sUtairmayAsakRRit |
AvAhAshcha vivAhAshcha saha sUtaiH kRRitA mayA
shlokas.15:
mAM cha kRRiShNa samAshritya kRRitaH shastrasamudyamaH |
duryodhanena vArShNeya vigrahashchApi pANDavaiH
shlokas.16:
tasmAdraNe dvairathe mAM pratyudyAtAramachyuta |
vRRitavAnparamaM hRRiShTaH pratIpaM savyasAchinaH
shlokas.17:
vadhAdbandhAdbhayAdvApi lobhAdvApi janArdana |
anRRitaM notsahe kartuM dhArtarAShTrasya dhImataH
shlokas.18:
yadi hyadya na gachCheyaM dvairathaM savyasAchinA |
akIrtiH syAddhRRiShIkesha mama pArthasya chobhayoH
shlokas.19:
asa.nshayaM hitArthAya brUyAstvaM madhusUdana |
sarvaM cha pANDavAH kuryustvadvashitvAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.20:
mantrasya niyamaM kuryAstvamatra puruShottama |
etadatra hitaM manye sarvayAdavanandana
shlokas.21:
yadi jAnAti mAM rAjA dharmAtmA sa.nshitavrataH |
kuntyAH prathamajaM putraM na sa rAjyaM grahIShyati
shlokas.22:
prApya chApi mahadrAjyaM tadahaM madhusUdana |
sphItaM duryodhanAyaiva sampradadyAmari.ndama
shlokas.23:
sa eva rAjA dharmAtmA shAshvato.astu yudhiShThiraH |
netA yasya hRRiShIkesho yoddhA yasya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.24:
pRRithivI tasya rAShTraM cha yasya bhImo mahArathaH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha draupadeyAshcha mAdhava
shlokas.25:
uttamaujA yudhAmanyuH satyadharmA cha somakiH |
chaidyashcha chekitAnashcha shikhaNDI chAparAjitaH
shlokas.26:
indragopakavarNAshcha kekayA bhrAtarastathA |
indrAyudhasavarNashcha kuntibhojo mahArathaH
shlokas.27:
mAtulo bhImasenasya senajichcha mahArathaH |
sha~NkhaH putro virATasya nidhistvaM cha janArdana
shlokas.28:
mahAnayaM kRRiShNa kRRitaH kShatrasya samudAnayaH |
rAjyaM prAptamidaM dIptaM prathitaM sarvarAjasu
shlokas.29:
dhArtarAShTrasya vArShNeya shastrayaj~no bhaviShyati |
asya yaj~nasya vettA tvaM bhaviShyasi janArdana
AdhvaryavaM cha te kRRiShNa kratAvasminbhaviShyati
shlokas.30:
hotA chaivAtra bIbhatsuH saMnaddhaH sa kapidhvajaH |
gANDIvaM sruktathAjyaM cha vIryaM pu.nsAM bhaviShyati
shlokas.31:
aindraM pAshupataM brAhmaM sthUNAkarNaM cha mAdhava |
mantrAstatra bhaviShyanti prayuktAH savyasAchinA
shlokas.32:
anuyAtashcha pitaramadhiko vA parAkrame |
grAvastotraM sa saubhadraH samyaktatra kariShyati
shlokas.33:
udgAtAtra punarbhImaH prastotA sumahAbalaH |
vinadansa naravyAghro nAgAnIkAntakRRidraNe
shlokas.34:
sa chaiva tatra dharmAtmA shashvadrAjA yudhiShThiraH |
japairhomaishcha sa.nyukto brahmatvaM kArayiShyati
shlokas.35:
sha~NkhashabdAH samurajA bheryashcha madhusUdana |
utkRRiShTasiMhanAdAshcha subrahmaNyo bhaviShyati
shlokas.36:
nakulaH sahadevashcha mAdrIputrau yashasvinau |
shAmitraM tau mahAvIryau samyaktatra kariShyataH
shlokas.37:
kalmAShadaNDA govinda vimalA rathashaktayaH |
yUpAH samupakalpantAmasminyaj~ne janArdana
shlokas.38:
karNinAlIkanArAchA vatsadantopabRRiMhaNAH |
tomarAH somakalashAH pavitrANi dhanUMShi cha
shlokas.39:
asayo.atra kapAlAni puroDAshAH shirA.nsi cha |
havistu rudhiraM kRRiShNa asminyaj~ne bhaviShyati
shlokas.40:
idhmAH paridhayashchaiva shaktyo.atha vimalA gadAH |
sadasyA droNashiShyAshcha kRRipasya cha sharadvataH
shlokas.41:
iShavo.atra paristomA muktA gANDIvadhanvanA |
mahArathaprayuktAshcha droNadrauNiprachoditAH
shlokas.42:
prAtiprasthAnikaM karma sAtyakiH sa kariShyati |
dIkShito dhArtarAShTro.atra patnI chAsya mahAchamUH
shlokas.43:
ghaTotkacho.atra shAmitraM kariShyati mahAbalaH |
atirAtre mahAbAho vitate yaj~nakarmaNi
shlokas.44:
dakShiNA tvasya yaj~nasya dhRRiShTadyumnaH pratApavAn |
vaitAne karmaNi tate jAto yaH kRRiShNa pAvakAt
shlokas.45:
yadabruvamahaM kRRiShNa kaTukAni sma pANDavAn |
priyArthaM dhArtarAShTrasya tena tapye.adya karmaNA
shlokas.46:
yadA drakShyasi mAM kRRiShNa nihataM savyasAchinA |
punashchitistadA chAsya yaj~nasyAtha bhaviShyati
shlokas.47:
duHshAsanasya rudhiraM yadA pAsyati pANDavaH |
AnardaM nardataH samyaktadA sutyaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.48:
yadA droNaM cha bhIShmaM cha pA~nchAlyau pAtayiShyataH |
tadA yaj~nAvasAnaM tadbhaviShyati janArdana
shlokas.49:
duryodhanaM yadA hantA bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
tadA samApsyate yaj~no dhArtarAShTrasya mAdhava
shlokas.50:
snuShAshcha prasnuShAshchaiva dhRRitarAShTrasya sa~NgatAH |
hateshvarA hatasutA hatanAthAshcha keshava
shlokas.51:
gAndhAryA saha rodantyaH shvagRRidhrakurarAkule |
sa yaj~ne.asminnavabhRRitho bhaviShyati janArdana
shlokas.52:
vidyAvRRiddhA vayovRRiddhAH kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabha |
vRRithAmRRityuM na kurvIra.nstvatkRRite madhusUdana
shlokas.53:
shastreNa nidhanaM gachChetsamRRiddhaM kShatramaNDalam |
kurukShetre puNyatame trailokyasyApi keshava
shlokas.54:
tadatra puNDarIkAkSha vidhatsva yadabhIpsitam |
yathA kArtsnyena vArShNeya kShatraM svargamavApnuyAt
shlokas.55:
yAvatsthAsyanti girayaH saritashcha janArdana |
tAvatkIrtibhavaH shabdaH shAshvato.ayaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.56:
brAhmaNAH kathayiShyanti mahAbhAratamAhavam |
samAgameShu vArShNeya kShatriyANAM yashodharam
shlokas.57:
samupAnaya kaunteyaM yuddhAya mama keshava |
mantrasa.nvaraNaM kurvannityameva parantapa

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
karNasya vachanaM shrutvA keshavaH paravIrahA |
uvAcha prahasanvAkyaM smitapUrvamidaM tadA
shlokas.2:
api tvAM na tapetkarNa rAjyalAbhopapAdanA |
mayA dattAM hi pRRithivIM na prashAsitumichChasi
shlokas.3:
dhruvo jayaH pANDavAnAmitIdaM; na sa.nshayaH kashchana vidyate.atra |
jayadhvajo dRRishyate pANDavasya; samuchChrito vAnararAja ugraH
shlokas.4:
divyA mAyA vihitA bhauvanena; samuchChritA indraketuprakAshA |
divyAni bhUtAni bhayAvahAni; dRRishyanti chaivAtra bhayAnakAni
shlokas.5:
na sajjate shailavanaspatibhya; UrdhvaM tiryagyojanamAtrarUpaH |
shrImAndhvajaH karNa dhana~njayasya; samuchChritaH pAvakatulyarUpaH
shlokas.6:
yadA drakShyasi sa~NgrAme shvetAshvaM kRRiShNasArathim |
aindramastraM vikurvANamubhe chaivAgnimArute
shlokas.7:
gANDIvasya cha nirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
na tadA bhavitA tretA na kRRitaM dvAparaM na cha
shlokas.8:
yadA drakShyasi sa~NgrAme kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
japahomasamAyuktaM svAM rakShantaM mahAchamUm
shlokas.9:
Adityamiva durdharShaM tapantaM shatruvAhinIm |
na tadA bhavitA tretA na kRRitaM dvAparaM na cha
shlokas.10:
yadA drakShyasi sa~NgrAme bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
duHshAsanasya rudhiraM pItvA nRRityantamAhave
shlokas.11:
prabhinnamiva mAta~NgaM pratidviradaghAtinam |
na tadA bhavitA tretA na kRRitaM dvAparaM na cha
shlokas.12:
yadA drakShyasi sa~NgrAme mAdrIputrau mahArathau |
vAhinIM dhArtarAShTrANAM kShobhayantau gajAviva
shlokas.13:
vigADhe shastrasampAte paravIrarathArujau |
na tadA bhavitA tretA na kRRitaM dvAparaM na cha
shlokas.14:
yadA drakShyasi sa~NgrAme droNaM shAntanavaM kRRipam |
suyodhanaM cha rAjAnaM saindhavaM cha jayadratham
shlokas.15:
yuddhAyApatatastUrNaM vAritAnsavyasAchinA |
na tadA bhavitA tretA na kRRitaM dvAparaM na cha
shlokas.16:
brUyAH karNa ito gatvA droNaM shAntanavaM kRRipam |
saumyo.ayaM vartate mAsaH suprApayavasendhanaH
shlokas.17:
pakvauShadhivanasphItaH phalavAnalpamakShikaH |
niShpa~Nko rasavattoyo nAtyuShNashishiraH sukhaH
shlokas.18:
saptamAchchApi divasAdamAvAsyA bhaviShyati |
sa~NgrAmaM yojayettatra tAM hyAhuH shakradevatAm
shlokas.19:
tathA rAj~no vadeH sarvAnye yuddhAyAbhyupAgatAH |
yadvo manIShitaM tadvai sarvaM sampAdayAmi vaH
shlokas.20:
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha duryodhanavashAnugAH |
prApya shastreNa nidhanaM prApsyanti gatimuttamAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
keshavasya tu tadvAkyaM karNaH shrutvA hitaM shubham |
abravIdabhisampUjya kRRiShNaM madhuniShUdanam
jAnanmAM kiM mahAbAho saMmohayitumichChasi
shlokas.2:
yo.ayaM pRRithivyAH kArtsnyena vinAshaH samupasthitaH |
nimittaM tatra shakunirahaM duHshAsanastathA
duryodhanashcha nRRipatirdhRRitarAShTrasuto.abhavat
shlokas.3:
asa.nshayamidaM kRRiShNa mahadyuddhamupasthitam |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha ghoraM rudhirakardamam
shlokas.4:
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha duryodhanavashAnugAH |
raNe shastrAgninA dagdhAH prApsyanti yamasAdanam
shlokas.5:
svapnA hi bahavo ghorA dRRishyante madhusUdana |
nimittAni cha ghorANi tathotpAtAH sudAruNAH
shlokas.6:
parAjayaM dhArtarAShTre vijayaM cha yudhiShThire |
sha.nsanta iva vArShNeya vividhA lomaharShaNAH
shlokas.7:
prAjApatyaM hi nakShatraM grahastIkShNo mahAdyutiH |
shanaishcharaH pIDayati pIDayanprANino.adhikam
shlokas.8:
kRRitvA chA~NgArako vakraM jyeShThAyAM madhusUdana |
anurAdhAM prArthayate maitraM sa.nshamayanniva
shlokas.9:
nUnaM mahadbhayaM kRRiShNa kurUNAM samupasthitam |
visheSheNa hi vArShNeya chitrAM pIDayate grahaH
shlokas.10:
somasya lakShma vyAvRRittaM rAhurarkamupeShyati |
divashcholkAH patantyetAH sanirghAtAH sakampanAH
shlokas.11:
niShTananti cha mAta~NgA mu~nchantyashrUNi vAjinaH |
pAnIyaM yavasaM chApi nAbhinandanti mAdhava
shlokas.12:
prAdurbhUteShu chaiteShu bhayamAhurupasthitam |
nimitteShu mahAbAho dAruNaM prANinAshanam
shlokas.13:
alpe bhukte purIShaM cha prabhUtamiha dRRishyate |
vAjinAM vAraNAnAM cha manuShyANAM cha keshava
shlokas.14:
dhArtarAShTrasya sainyeShu sarveShu madhusUdana |
parAbhavasya talli~Ngamiti prAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.15:
prahRRiShTaM vAhanaM kRRiShNa pANDavAnAM prachakShate |
pradakShiNA mRRigAshchaiva tatteShAM jayalakShaNam
shlokas.16:
apasavyA mRRigAH sarve dhArtarAShTrasya keshava |
vAchashchApyasharIriNyastatparAbhavalakShaNam
shlokas.17:
mayUrAH puShpashakunA ha.nsAH sArasachAtakAH |
jIvaM jIvakasa~NghAshchApyanugachChanti pANDavAn
shlokas.18:
gRRidhrAH kAkA baDAH shyenA yAtudhAnAH shalAvRRikAH |
makShikANAM cha sa~NghAtA anugachChanti kauravAn
shlokas.19:
dhArtarAShTrasya sainyeShu bherINAM nAsti nisvanaH |
anAhatAH pANDavAnAM nadanti paTahAH kila
shlokas.20:
udapAnAshcha nardanti yathA govRRiShabhAstathA |
dhArtarAShTrasya sainyeShu tatparAbhavalakShaNam
shlokas.21:
mA.nsashoNitavarShaM cha vRRiShTaM devena mAdhava |
tathA gandharvanagaraM bhAnumantamupasthitam
saprAkAraM saparikhaM savapraM chArutoraNam
shlokas.22:
kRRiShNashcha parighastatra bhAnumAvRRitya tiShThati |
udayAstamaye sandhye vedayAno mahadbhayam
ekA sRRigvAshate ghoraM tatparAbhavalakShaNam
shlokas.23:
kRRiShNagrIvAshcha shakunA lambamAnA bhayAnakAH |
sandhyAmabhimukhA yAnti tatparAbhavalakShaNam
shlokas.24:
brAhmaNAnprathamaM dveShTi gurU.nshcha madhusUdana |
bhRRityAnbhaktimatashchApi tatparAbhavalakShaNam
shlokas.25:
pUrvA diglohitAkArA shastravarNA cha dakShiNA |
AmapAtrapratIkAshA pashchimA madhusUdana
shlokas.26:
pradIptAshcha dishaH sarvA dhArtarAShTrasya mAdhava |
mahadbhayaM vedayanti tasminnutpAtalakShaNe
shlokas.27:
sahasrapAdaM prAsAdaM svapnAnte sma yudhiShThiraH |
adhirohanmayA dRRiShTaH saha bhrAtRRibhirachyuta
shlokas.28:
shvetoShNIShAshcha dRRishyante sarve te shuklavAsasaH |
AsanAni cha shubhrANi sarveShAmupalakShaye
shlokas.29:
tava chApi mayA kRRiShNa svapnAnte rudhirAvilA |
AntreNa pRRithivI dRRiShTA parikShiptA janArdana
shlokas.30:
asthisa~nchayamArUDhashchAmitaujA yudhiShThiraH |
suvarNapAtryAM saMhRRiShTo bhuktavAnghRRitapAyasam
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThiro mayA dRRiShTo grasamAno vasundharAm |
tvayA dattAmimAM vyaktaM bhokShyate sa vasundharAm
shlokas.32:
uchchaM parvatamArUDho bhImakarmA vRRikodaraH |
gadApANirnaravyAghro vIkShanniva mahImimAm
shlokas.33:
kShapayiShyati naH sarvAnsa suvyaktaM mahAraNe |
viditaM me hRRiShIkesha yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.34:
pANDuraM gajamArUDho gANDIvI sa dhana~njayaH |
tvayA sArdhaM hRRiShIkesha shriyA paramayA jvalan
shlokas.35:
yUyaM sarvAnvadhiShyadhvaM tatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH |
pArthivAnsamare kRRiShNa duryodhanapurogamAn
shlokas.36:
nakulaH sahadevashcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
shuddhakeyUrakaNThatrAH shuklamAlyAmbarAvRRitAH
shlokas.37:
adhirUDhA naravyAghrA naravAhanamuttamam |
traya ete mahAmAtrAH pANDurachChatravAsasaH
shlokas.38:
shvetoShNIShAshcha dRRishyante traya eva janArdana |
dhArtarAShTrasya sainyeShu tAnvijAnIhi keshava
shlokas.39:
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva kRRitavarmA cha sAtvataH |
raktoShNIShAshcha dRRishyante sarve mAdhava pArthivAH
shlokas.40:
uShTrayuktaM samArUDhau bhIShmadroNau janArdana |
mayA sArdhaM mahAbAho dhArtarAShTreNa chAbhibho
shlokas.41:
agastyashAstAM cha dishaM prayAtAH sma janArdana |
achireNaiva kAlena prApsyAmo yamasAdanam
shlokas.42:
ahaM chAnye cha rAjAno yachcha tatkShatramaNDalam |
gANDIvAgniM pravekShyAma iti me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.43:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
upasthitavinAsheyaM nUnamadya vasundharA |
tathA hi me vachaH karNa nopaiti hRRidayaM tava
shlokas.44:
sarveShAM tAta bhUtAnAM vinAshe samupasthite |
anayo nayasa~NkAsho hRRidayAnnApasarpati
shlokas.45:
karNa uvAcha||
api tvA kRRiShNa pashyAma jIvanto.asmAnmahAraNAt |
samuttIrNA mahAbAho vIrakShayavinAshanAt
shlokas.46:
atha vA sa~NgamaH kRRiShNa svarge no bhavitA dhruvam |
tatredAnIM sameShyAmaH punaH sArdhaM tvayAnagha
shlokas.47:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityuktvA mAdhavaM karNaH pariShvajya cha pIDitam |
visarjitaH keshavena rathopasthAdavAtarat
shlokas.48:
tataH svarathamAsthAya jAmbUnadavibhUShitam |
sahAsmAbhirnivavRRite rAdheyo dInamAnasaH
shlokas.49:
tataH shIghrataraM prAyAtkeshavaH sahasAtyakiH |
punaruchchArayanvANIM yAhi yAhIti sArathim

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
asiddhAnunaye kRRiShNe kurubhyaH pANDavAngate |
abhigamya pRRithAM kShattA shanaiH shochannivAbravIt
shlokas.2:
jAnAsi me jIvaputre bhAvaM nityamanugrahe |
kroshato na cha gRRihNIte vachanaM me suyodhanaH
shlokas.3:
upapanno hyasau rAjA chedipA~nchAlakekayaiH |
bhImArjunAbhyAM kRRiShNena yuyudhAnayamairapi
shlokas.4:
upaplavye niviShTo.api dharmameva yudhiShThiraH |
kA~NkShate j~nAtisauhArdAdbalavAndurbalo yathA
shlokas.5:
rAjA tu dhRRitarAShTro.ayaM vayovRRiddho na shAmyati |
mattaH putramadenaiva vidharme pathi vartate
shlokas.6:
jayadrathasya karNasya tathA duHshAsanasya cha |
saubalasya cha durbuddhyA mithobhedaH pravartate
shlokas.7:
adharmeNa hi dharmiShThaM hRRitaM vai rAjyamIdRRisham |
yeShAM teShAmayaM dharmaH sAnubandho bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
hriyamANe balAddharme kurubhiH ko na sa~njvaret |
asAmnA keshave yAte samudyokShyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.9:
tataH kurUNAmanayo bhavitA vIranAshanaH |
chintayanna labhe nidrAmahaHsu cha nishAsu cha
shlokas.10:
shrutvA tu kuntI tadvAkyamarthakAmena bhAShitam |
aniShTanantI duHkhArtA manasA vimamarsha ha
shlokas.11:
dhigastvarthaM yatkRRite.ayaM mahA~nj~nAtivadhe kShayaH |
vartsyate suhRRidAM hyeShAM yuddhe.asminvai parAbhavaH
shlokas.12:
pANDavAshchedipA~nchAlA yAdavAshcha samAgatAH |
bhAratairyadi yotsyanti kiM nu duHkhamataH param
shlokas.13:
pashye doShaM dhruvaM yuddhe tathA yuddhe parAbhavam |
adhanasya mRRitaM shreyo na hi j~nAtikShaye jayaH
shlokas.14:
pitAmahaH shAntanava AchAryashcha yudhAM patiH |
karNashcha dhArtarAShTrArthaM vardhayanti bhayaM mama
shlokas.15:
nAchAryaH kAmavA~nshiShyairdroNo yudhyeta jAtu chit |
pANDaveShu kathaM hArdaM kuryAnna cha pitAmahaH
shlokas.16:
ayaM tveko vRRithAdRRiShTirdhArtarAShTrasya durmateH |
mohAnuvartI satataM pApo dveShTi cha pANDavAn
shlokas.17:
mahatyanarthe nirbandhI balavA.nshcha visheShataH |
karNaH sadA pANDavAnAM tanme dahati sAmpratam
shlokas.18:
Asha.nse tvadya karNasya mano.ahaM pANDavAnprati |
prasAdayitumAsAdya darshayantI yathAtatham
shlokas.19:
toShito bhagavAnyatra durvAsA me varaM dadau |
AhvAnaM devasa.nyuktaM vasantyAH pitRRiveshmani
shlokas.20:
sAhamantaHpure rAj~naH kuntibhojapuraskRRitA |
chintayantI bahuvidhaM hRRidayena vidUyatA
shlokas.21:
balAbalaM cha mantrANAM brAhmaNasya cha vAgbalam |
strIbhAvAdbAlabhAvAchcha chintayantI punaH punaH
shlokas.22:
dhAtryA vishrabdhayA guptA sakhIjanavRRitA tadA |
doShaM pariharantI cha pitushchAritrarakShiNI
shlokas.23:
kathaM nu sukRRitaM me syAnnAparAdhavatI katham |
bhaveyamiti sa~nchintya brAhmaNaM taM namasya cha
shlokas.24:
kautUhalAttu taM labdhvA bAlishyAdAcharaM tadA |
kanyA satI devamarkamAsAdayamahaM tataH
shlokas.25:
yo.asau kAnInagarbho me putravatparivartitaH |
kasmAnna kuryAdvachanaM pathyaM bhrAtRRihitaM tathA
shlokas.26:
iti kuntI vinishchitya kAryaM nishchitamuttamam |
kAryArthamabhiniryAya yayau bhAgIrathIM prati
shlokas.27:
Atmajasya tatastasya ghRRiNinaH satyasa~NginaH |
ga~NgAtIre pRRithAshRRiNvadupAdhyayananisvanam
shlokas.28:
prA~NmukhasyordhvabAhoH sA paryatiShThata pRRiShThataH |
japyAvasAnaM kAryArthaM pratIkShantI tapasvinI
shlokas.29:
atiShThatsUryatApArtA karNasyottaravAsasi |
kauravyapatnI vArShNeyI padmamAleva shuShyatI
shlokas.30:
A pRRiShThatApAjjaptvA sa parivRRitya yatavrataH |
dRRiShTvA kuntImupAtiShThadabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH
yathAnyAyaM mahAtejA mAnI dharmabhRRitAM varaH

shlokas.1:
karNa uvAcha||
rAdheyo.ahamAdhirathiH karNastvAmabhivAdaye |
prAptA kimarthaM bhavatI brUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.2:
kuntyuvAcha||
kaunteyastvaM na rAdheyo na tavAdhirathaH pitA |
nAsi sUtakule jAtaH karNa tadviddhi me vachaH
shlokas.3:
kAnInastvaM mayA jAtaH pUrvajaH kukShiNA dhRRitaH |
kuntibhojasya bhavane pArthastvamasi putraka
shlokas.4:
prakAshakarmA tapano yo.ayaM devo virochanaH |
ajIjanattvAM mayyeSha karNa shastrabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.5:
kuNDalI baddhakavacho devagarbhaH shriyA vRRitaH |
jAtastvamasi durdharSha mayA putra piturgRRihe
shlokas.6:
sa tvaM bhrAtR^InasambuddhvA mohAdyadupasevase |
dhArtarAShTrAnna tadyuktaM tvayi putra visheShataH
shlokas.7:
etaddharmaphalaM putra narANAM dharmanishchaye |
yattuShyantyasya pitaro mAtA chApyekadarshinI
shlokas.8:
arjunenArjitAM pUrvaM hRRitAM lobhAdasAdhubhiH |
AchChidya dhArtarAShTrebhyo bhu~NkShva yaudhiShThirIM shriyam
shlokas.9:
adya pashyantu kuravaH karNArjunasamAgamam |
saubhrAtreNa tadAlakShya saMnamantAmasAdhavaH
shlokas.10:
karNArjunau vai bhavatAM yathA rAmajanArdanau |
asAdhyaM kiM nu loke syAdyuvayoH sahitAtmanoH
shlokas.11:
karNa shobhiShyase nUnaM pa~nchabhirbhrAtRRibhirvRRitaH |
vedaiH parivRRito brahmA yathA vedA~Ngapa~nchamaiH
shlokas.12:
upapanno guNaiH shreShTho jyeShThaH shreShTheShu bandhuShu |
sUtaputreti mA shabdaH pArthastvamasi vIryavAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sUryAnnishcharitAM karNaH shushrAva bhAratIm |
duratyayAM praNayinIM pitRRivadbhAskareritAm
shlokas.2:
satyamAha pRRithA vAkyaM karNa mAtRRivachaH kuru |
shreyaste syAnnaravyAghra sarvamAcharatastathA
shlokas.3:
evamuktasya mAtrA cha svayaM pitrA cha bhAnunA |
chachAla naiva karNasya matiH satyadhRRitestadA
shlokas.4:
karNa uvAcha||
na te na shraddadhe vAkyaM kShatriye bhAShitaM tvayA |
dharmadvAraM mamaitatsyAnniyogakaraNaM tava
shlokas.5:
akaronmayi yatpApaM bhavatI sumahAtyayam |
avakIrNo.asmi te tena tadyashaHkIrtinAshanam
shlokas.6:
ahaM cha kShatriyo jAto na prAptaH kShatrasatkriyAm |
tvatkRRite kiM nu pApIyaH shatruH kuryAnmamAhitam
shlokas.7:
kriyAkAle tvanukroshamakRRitvA tvamimaM mama |
hInasa.nskArasamayamadya mAM samachUchudaH
shlokas.8:
na vai mama hitaM pUrvaM mAtRRivachcheShTitaM tvayA |
sA mAM sambodhayasyadya kevalAtmahitaiShiNI
shlokas.9:
kRRiShNena sahitAtko vai na vyatheta dhana~njayAt |
ko.adya bhItaM na mAM vidyAtpArthAnAM samitiM gatam
shlokas.10:
abhrAtA viditaH pUrvaM yuddhakAle prakAshitaH |
pANDavAnyadi gachChAmi kiM mAM kShatraM vadiShyati
shlokas.11:
sarvakAmaiH sa.nvibhaktaH pUjitashcha sadA bhRRisham |
ahaM vai dhArtarAShTrANAM kuryAM tadaphalaM katham
shlokas.12:
upanahya parairvairaM ye mAM nityamupAsate |
namaskurvanti cha sadA vasavo vAsavaM yathA
shlokas.13:
mama prANena ye shatrU~nshaktAH pratisamAsitum |
manyante.adya kathaM teShAmahaM bhindyAM manoratham
shlokas.14:
mayA plavena sa~NgrAmaM titIrShanti duratyayam |
apAre pArakAmA ye tyajeyaM tAnahaM katham
shlokas.15:
ayaM hi kAlaH samprApto dhArtarAShTropajIvinAm |
nirveShTavyaM mayA tatra prANAnaparirakShatA
shlokas.16:
kRRitArthAH subhRRitA ye hi kRRityakAla upasthite |
anavekShya kRRitaM pApA vikurvantyanavasthitAH
shlokas.17:
rAjakilbiShiNAM teShAM bhartRRipiNDApahAriNAm |
naivAyaM na paro loko vidyate pApakarmaNAm
shlokas.18:
dhRRitarAShTrasya putrANAmarthe yotsyAmi te sutaiH |
balaM cha shaktiM chAsthAya na vai tvayyanRRitaM vade
shlokas.19:
AnRRisha.nsyamatho vRRittaM rakShansatpuruShochitam |
ato.arthakaramapyetanna karomyadya te vachaH
shlokas.20:
na tu te.ayaM samArambho mayi mogho bhaviShyati |
vadhyAnviShahyAnsa~NgrAme na haniShyAmi te sutAn
yudhiShThiraM cha bhImaM cha yamau chaivArjunAdRRite
shlokas.21:
arjunena samaM yuddhaM mama yaudhiShThire bale |
arjunaM hi nihatyAjau samprAptaM syAtphalaM mayA
yashasA chApi yujyeyaM nihataH savyasAchinA
shlokas.22:
na te jAtu nashiShyanti putrAH pa~ncha yashasvini |
nirarjunAH sakarNA vA sArjunA vA hate mayi
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
iti karNavachaH shrutvA kuntI duHkhAtpravepatI |
uvAcha putramAshliShya karNaM dhairyAdakampitam
shlokas.24:
evaM vai bhAvyametena kShayaM yAsyanti kauravAH |
yathA tvaM bhAShase karNa daivaM tu balavattaram
shlokas.25:
tvayA chaturNAM bhrAtR^INAmabhayaM shatrukarshana |
dattaM tatpratijAnIhi sa~Ngarapratimochanam
shlokas.26:
anAmayaM svasti cheti pRRithAtho karNamabravIt |
tAM karNo.abhyavadatprItastatastau jagmatuH pRRithak

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
Agamya hAstinapurAdupaplavyamari.ndamaH |
pANDavAnAM yathAvRRittaM keshavaH sarvamuktavAn
shlokas.2:
sambhAShya suchiraM kAlaM mantrayitvA punaH punaH |
svamevAvasathaM shaurirvishrAmArthaM jagAma ha
shlokas.3:
visRRijya sarvAnnRRipatInvirATapramukhA.nstadA |
pANDavA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha bhAnAvasta~Ngate sati
shlokas.4:
sandhyAmupAsya dhyAyantastameva gatamAnasAH |
AnAyya kRRiShNaM dAshArhaM punarmantramamantrayan
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tvayA nAgapuraM gatvA sabhAyAM dhRRitarAShTrajaH |
kimuktaH puNDarIkAkSha tannaH sha.nsitumarhasi
shlokas.6:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
mayA nAgapuraM gatvA sabhAyAM dhRRitarAShTrajaH |
tathyaM pathyaM hitaM chokto na cha gRRihNAti durmatiH
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tasminnutpathamApanne kuruvRRiddhaH pitAmahaH |
kimuktavAnhRRiShIkesha duryodhanamamarShaNam
AchAryo vA mahAbAho bhAradvAjaH kimabravIt
shlokas.8:
pitA yavIyAnasmAkaM kShattA dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
putrashokAbhisantaptaH kimAha dhRRitarAShTrajam
shlokas.9:
kiM cha sarve nRRipatayaH sabhAyAM ye samAsate |
uktavanto yathAtattvaM tadbrUhi tvaM janArdana
shlokas.10:
uktavAnhi bhavAnsarvaM vachanaM kurumukhyayoH |
kAmalobhAbhibhUtasya mandasya prAj~namAninaH
shlokas.11:
apriyaM hRRidaye mahyaM tanna tiShThati keshava |
teShAM vAkyAni govinda shrotumichChAmyahaM vibho
shlokas.12:
yathA cha nAbhipadyeta kAlastAta tathA kuru |
bhavAnhi no gatiH kRRiShNa bhavAnnAtho bhavAnguruH
shlokas.13:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanyathA vAkyamukto rAjA suyodhanaH |
madhye kurUNAM rAjendra sabhAyAM tannibodha me
shlokas.14:
mayA vai shrAvite vAkye jahAsa dhRRitarAShTrajaH |
atha bhIShmaH susa~Nkruddha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.15:
duryodhana nibodhedaM kulArthe yadbravImi te |
tachChrutvA rAjashArdUla svakulasya hitaM kuru
shlokas.16:
mama tAta pitA rAja~nshantanurlokavishrutaH |
tasyAhameka evAsaM putraH putravatAM varaH
shlokas.17:
tasya buddhiH samutpannA dvitIyaH syAtkathaM sutaH |
ekaputramaputraM vai pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.18:
na chochChedaM kulaM yAyAdvistIryeta kathaM yashaH |
tasyAhamIpsitaM buddhvA kAlIM mAtaramAvaham
shlokas.19:
pratij~nAM duShkarAM kRRitvA piturarthe kulasya cha |
arAjA chordhvaretAshcha yathA suviditaM tava
pratIto nivasAmyeSha pratij~nAmanupAlayan
shlokas.20:
tasyAM jaj~ne mahAbAhuH shrImAnkurukulodvahaH |
vichitravIryo dharmAtmA kanIyAnmama pArthivaH
shlokas.21:
svaryAte.ahaM pitari taM svarAjye saMnyaveshayam |
vichitravIryaM rAjAnaM bhRRityo bhUtvA hyadhashcharaH
shlokas.22:
tasyAhaM sadRRishAndArAnrAjendra samudAvaham |
jitvA pArthivasa~NghAtamapi te bahushaH shrutam
shlokas.23:
tato rAmeNa samare dvandvayuddhamupAgamam |
sa hi rAmabhayAdebhirnAgarairvipravAsitaH
dAreShvatiprasaktashcha yakShmANaM samapadyata
shlokas.24:
yadA tvarAjake rAShTre na vavarSha sureshvaraH |
tadAbhyadhAvanmAmeva prajAH kShudbhayapIDitAH
shlokas.25:
prajA UchuH||
upakShINAH prajAH sarvA rAjA bhava bhavAya naH |
Itayo nuda bhadraM te shantanoH kulavardhana
shlokas.26:
pIDyante te prajAH sarvA vyAdhibhirbhRRishadAruNaiH |
alpAvashiShTA gA~Ngeya tAH paritrAtumarhasi
shlokas.27:
vyAdhInpraNudya vIra tvaM prajA dharmeNa pAlaya |
tvayi jIvati mA rAShTraM vinAshamupagachChatu
shlokas.28:
bhIShma uvAcha||
prajAnAM kroshatInAM vai naivAkShubhyata me manaH |
pratij~nAM rakShamANasya sadvRRittaM smaratastathA
shlokas.29:
tataH paurA mahArAja mAtA kAlI cha me shubhA |
bhRRityAH purohitAchAryA brAhmaNAshcha bahushrutAH
mAmUchurbhRRishasantaptA bhava rAjeti santatam
shlokas.30:
pratIparakShitaM rAShTraM tvAM prApya vinashiShyati |
sa tvamasmaddhitArthaM vai rAjA bhava mahAmate
shlokas.31:
ityuktaH prA~njalirbhUtvA duHkhito bhRRishamAturaH |
tebhyo nyavedayaM putra pratij~nAM pitRRigauravAt
UrdhvaretA hyarAjA cha kulasyArthe punaH punaH
shlokas.32:
tato.ahaM prA~njalirbhUtvA mAtaraM samprasAdayam |
nAmba shantanunA jAtaH kauravaM va.nshamudvahan
pratij~nAM vitathAM kuryAmiti rAjanpunaH punaH
shlokas.33:
visheShatastvadarthaM cha dhuri mA mAM niyojaya |
ahaM preShyashcha dAsashcha tavAmba sutavatsale
shlokas.34:
evaM tAmanunIyAhaM mAtaraM janameva cha |
ayAchaM bhrAtRRidAreShu tadA vyAsaM mahAmunim
shlokas.35:
saha mAtrA mahArAja prasAdya tamRRiShiM tadA |
apatyArthamayAchaM vai prasAdaM kRRitavA.nshcha saH
trInsa putrAnajanayattadA bharatasattama
shlokas.36:
andhaH karaNahIneti na vai rAjA pitA tava |
rAjA tu pANDurabhavanmahAtmA lokavishrutaH
shlokas.37:
sa rAjA tasya te putrAH piturdAyAdyahAriNaH |
mA tAta kalahaM kArShI rAjyasyArdhaM pradIyatAm
shlokas.38:
mayi jIvati rAjyaM kaH samprashAsetpumAniha |
mAvama.nsthA vacho mahyaM shamamichChAmi vaH sadA
shlokas.39:
na visheSho.asti me putra tvayi teShu cha pArthiva |
matametatpitustubhyaM gAndhAryA vidurasya cha
shlokas.40:
shrotavyaM yadi vRRiddhAnAM mAtisha~NkIrvacho mama |
nAshayiShyasi mA sarvamAtmAnaM pRRithivIM tathA

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
bhIShmeNokte tato droNo duryodhanamabhAShata |
madhye nRRipANAM bhadraM te vachanaM vachanakShamaH
shlokas.2:
prAtIpaH shantanustAta kulasyArthe yathotthitaH |
tathA devavrato bhIShmaH kulasyArthe sthito.abhavat
shlokas.3:
tataH pANDurnarapatiH satyasandho jitendriyaH |
rAjA kurUNAM dharmAtmA suvrataH susamAhitaH
shlokas.4:
jyeShThAya rAjyamadadAddhRRitarAShTrAya dhImate |
yavIyasastathA kShattuH kuruva.nshavivardhanaH
shlokas.5:
tataH siMhAsane rAjansthApayitvainamachyutam |
vanaM jagAma kauravyo bhAryAbhyAM sahito.anagha
shlokas.6:
nIchaiH sthitvA tu vidura upAste sma vinItavat |
preShyavatpuruShavyAghro vAlavyajanamutkShipan
shlokas.7:
tataH sarvAH prajAstAta dhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram |
anvapadyanta vidhivadyathA pANDuM narAdhipam
shlokas.8:
visRRijya dhRRitarAShTrAya rAjyaM sa vidurAya cha |
chachAra pRRithivIM pANDuH sarvAM parapura~njayaH
shlokas.9:
koshasa~njanane dAne bhRRityAnAM chAnvavekShaNe |
bharaNe chaiva sarvasya viduraH satyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.10:
sandhivigrahasa.nyukto rAj~naH sa.nvAhanakriyAH |
avaikShata mahAtejA bhIShmaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.11:
siMhAsanastho nRRipatirdhRRitarAShTro mahAbalaH |
anvAsyamAnaH satataM vidureNa mahAtmanA
shlokas.12:
kathaM tasya kule jAtaH kulabhedaM vyavasyasi |
sambhUya bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM bhu~NkShva bhogA~njanAdhipa
shlokas.13:
bravImyahaM na kArpaNyAnnArthahetoH katha~nchana |
bhIShmeNa dattamashnAmi na tvayA rAjasattama
shlokas.14:
nAhaM tvatto.abhikA~NkShiShye vRRittyupAyaM janAdhipa |
yato bhIShmastato droNo yadbhIShmastvAha tatkuru
shlokas.15:
dIyatAM pANDuputrebhyo rAjyArdhamarikarshana |
samamAchAryakaM tAta tava teShAM cha me sadA
shlokas.16:
ashvatthAmA yathA mahyaM tathA shvetahayo mama |
bahunA kiM pralApena yato dharmastato jayaH
shlokas.17:
evamukte mahArAja droNenAmitatejasA |
vyAjahAra tato vAkyaM viduraH satyasa~NgaraH
piturvadanamanvIkShya parivRRitya cha dharmavit
shlokas.18:
devavrata nibodhedaM vachanaM mama bhAShataH |
pranaShTaH kauravo va.nshastvayAyaM punaruddhRRitaH
shlokas.19:
tanme vilapamAnasya vachanaM samupekShase |
ko.ayaM duryodhano nAma kule.asminkulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.20:
yasya lobhAbhibhUtasya matiM samanuvartase |
anAryasyAkRRitaj~nasya lobhopahatachetasaH
atikrAmati yaH shAstraM piturdharmArthadarshinaH
shlokas.21:
ete nashyanti kuravo duryodhanakRRitena vai |
yathA te na praNashyeyurmahArAja tathA kuru
shlokas.22:
mAM chaiva dhRRitarAShTraM cha pUrvameva mahAdyute |
chitrakAra ivAlekhyaM kRRitvA mA sma vinAshaya
prajApatiH prajAH sRRiShTvA yathA saMharate tathA
shlokas.23:
nopekShasva mahAbAho pashyamAnaH kulakShayam |
atha te.adya matirnaShTA vinAshe pratyupasthite
vanaM gachCha mayA sArdhaM dhRRitarAShTreNa chaiva ha
shlokas.24:
baddhvA vA nikRRitipraj~naM dhArtarAShTraM sudurmatim |
sAdhvidaM rAjyamadyAstu pANDavairabhirakShitam
shlokas.25:
prasIda rAjashArdUla vinAsho dRRishyate mahAn |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha rAj~nAM chAmitatejasAm
shlokas.26:
virarAmaivamuktvA tu viduro dInamAnasaH |
pradhyAyamAnaH sa tadA niHshvasa.nshcha punaH punaH
shlokas.27:
tato.atha rAj~naH subalasya putrI; dharmArthayuktaM kulanAshabhItA |
duryodhanaM pApamatiM nRRisha.nsaM; rAj~nAM samakShaM sutamAha kopAt
shlokas.28:
ye pArthivA rAjasabhAM praviShTA; brahmarShayo ye cha sabhAsado.anye |
shRRiNvantu vakShyAmi tavAparAdhaM; pApasya sAmAtyaparichChadasya
shlokas.29:
rAjyaM kurUNAmanupUrvabhogyaM; kramAgato naH kuladharma eShaH |
tvaM pApabuddhe.atinRRisha.nsakarma;nrAjyaM kurUNAmanayAdviha.nsi
shlokas.30:
rAjye sthito dhRRitarAShTro manIShI; tasyAnujo viduro dIrghadarshI |
etAvatikramya kathaM nRRipatvaM; duryodhana prArthayase.adya mohAt
shlokas.31:
rAjA cha kShattA cha mahAnubhAvau; bhIShme sthite paravantau bhavetAm |
ayaM tu dharmaj~natayA mahAtmA; na rAjyakAmo nRRivaro nadIjaH
shlokas.32:
rAjyaM tu pANDoridamapradhRRiShyaM; tasyAdya putrAH prabhavanti nAnye |
rAjyaM tadetannikhilaM pANDavAnAM; paitAmahaM putrapautrAnugAmi
shlokas.33:
yadvai brUte kurumukhyo mahAtmA; devavrataH satyasandho manIShI |
sarvaM tadasmAbhirahatya dharmaM; grAhyaM svadharmaM paripAlayadbhiH
shlokas.34:
anuj~nayA chAtha mahAvratasya; brUyAnnRRipo yadvidurastathaiva |
kAryaM bhavettatsuhRRidbhirniyujya; dharmaM puraskRRitya sudIrghakAlam
shlokas.35:
nyAyAgataM rAjyamidaM kurUNAM; yudhiShThiraH shAstu vai dharmaputraH |
prachodito dhRRitarAShTreNa rAj~nA; puraskRRitaH shAntanavena chaiva

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
evamukte tu gAndhAryA dhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
duryodhanamuvAchedaM nRRipamadhye janAdhipa
shlokas.2:
duryodhana nibodhedaM yattvAM vakShyAmi putraka |
tathA tatkuru bhadraM te yadyasti pitRRigauravam
shlokas.3:
somaH prajApatiH pUrvaM kurUNAM va.nshavardhanaH |
somAdbabhUva ShaShTho vai yayAtirnahuShAtmajaH
shlokas.4:
tasya putrA babhUvushcha pa~ncha rAjarShisattamAH |
teShAM yadurmahAtejA jyeShThaH samabhavatprabhuH
shlokas.5:
pUruryavIyA.nshcha tato yo.asmAkaM va.nshavardhanaH |
sharmiShThAyAH samprasUto duhiturvRRiShaparvaNaH
shlokas.6:
yadushcha bharatashreShTha devayAnyAH suto.abhavat |
dauhitrastAta shukrasya kAvyasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.7:
yAdavAnAM kulakaro balavAnvIryasaMmataH |
avamene sa tu kShatraM darpapUrNaH sumandadhIH
shlokas.8:
na chAtiShThatpituH shAstre baladarpavimohitaH |
avamene cha pitaraM bhrAtR^I.nshchApyaparAjitaH
shlokas.9:
pRRithivyAM chaturantAyAM yadurevAbhavadbalI |
vashe kRRitvA sa nRRipatInavasannAgasAhvaye
shlokas.10:
taM pitA paramakruddho yayAtirnahuShAtmajaH |
shashApa putraM gAndhAre rAjyAchcha vyaparopayat
shlokas.11:
ya chainamanvavartanta bhrAtaro baladarpitam |
shashApa tAnapi kruddho yayAtistanayAnatha
shlokas.12:
yavIyA.nsaM tataH pUruM putraM svavashavartinam |
rAjye niveshayAmAsa vidheyaM nRRipasattamaH
shlokas.13:
evaM jyeShTho.apyathotsikto na rAjyamabhijAyate |
yavIyA.nso.abhijAyante rAjyaM vRRiddhopasevayA
shlokas.14:
tathaiva sarvadharmaj~naH piturmama pitAmahaH |
pratIpaH pRRithivIpAlastriShu lokeShu vishrutaH
shlokas.15:
tasya pArthivasiMhasya rAjyaM dharmeNa shAsataH |
trayaH prajaj~nire putrA devakalpA yashasvinaH
shlokas.16:
devApirabhavajjyeShTho bAhlIkastadanantaram |
tRRitIyaH shantanustAta dhRRitimAnme pitAmahaH
shlokas.17:
devApistu mahAtejAstvagdoShI rAjasattamaH |
dhArmikaH satyavAdI cha pituH shushrUShaNe rataH
shlokas.18:
paurajAnapadAnAM cha saMmataH sAdhusatkRRitaH |
sarveShAM bAlavRRiddhAnAM devApirhRRidaya~NgamaH
shlokas.19:
prAj~nashcha satyasandhashcha sarvabhUtahite rataH |
vartamAnaH pituH shAstre brAhmaNAnAM tathaiva cha
shlokas.20:
bAhlIkasya priyo bhrAtA shantanoshcha mahAtmanaH |
saubhrAtraM cha paraM teShAM sahitAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.21:
atha kAlasya paryAye vRRiddho nRRipatisattamaH |
sambhArAnabhiShekArthaM kArayAmAsa shAstrataH
ma~NgalAni cha sarvANi kArayAmAsa chAbhibhUH
shlokas.22:
taM brAhmaNAshcha vRRiddhAshcha paurajAnapadaiH saha |
sarve nivArayAmAsurdevAperabhiShechanam
shlokas.23:
sa tachChrutvA tu nRRipatirabhiShekanivAraNam |
ashrukaNTho.abhavadrAjA paryashochata chAtmajam
shlokas.24:
evaM vadAnyo dharmaj~naH satyasandhashcha so.abhavat |
priyaH prajAnAmapi sa.nstvagdoSheNa pradUShitaH
shlokas.25:
hInA~NgaM pRRithivIpAlaM nAbhinandanti devatAH |
iti kRRitvA nRRipashreShThaM pratyaShedhandvijarShabhAH
shlokas.26:
tataH pravyathitAtmAsau putrashokasamanvitaH |
mamAra taM mRRitaM dRRiShTvA devApiH sa.nshrito vanam
shlokas.27:
bAhlIko mAtulakule tyaktvA rAjyaM vyavasthitaH |
pitRRibhrAtR^Inparityajya prAptavAnpuramRRiddhimat
shlokas.28:
bAhlIkena tvanuj~nAtaH shantanurlokavishrutaH |
pitaryuparate rAjanrAjA rAjyamakArayat
shlokas.29:
tathaivAhaM matimatA parichintyeha pANDunA |
jyeShThaH prabhra.nshito rAjyAddhInA~Nga iti bhArata
shlokas.30:
pANDustu rAjyaM samprAptaH kanIyAnapi sannRRipaH |
vinAshe tasya putrANAmidaM rAjyamari.ndama
mayyabhAgini rAjyAya kathaM tvaM rAjyamichChasi
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThiro rAjaputro mahAtmA; nyAyAgataM rAjyamidaM cha tasya |
sa kauravasyAsya janasya bhartA; prashAsitA chaiva mahAnubhAvaH
shlokas.32:
sa satyasandhaH satatApramattaH; shAstre sthito bandhujanasya sAdhuH |
priyaH prajAnAM suhRRidAnukampI; jitendriyaH sAdhujanasya bhartA
shlokas.33:
kShamA titikShA dama ArjavaM cha; satyavratatvaM shrutamapramAdaH |
bhUtAnukampA hyanushAsanaM cha; yudhiShThire rAjaguNAH samastAH
shlokas.34:
arAjaputrastvamanAryavRRitto; lubdhastathA bandhuShu pApabuddhiH |
kramAgataM rAjyamidaM pareShAM; hartuM kathaM shakShyasi durvinItaH
shlokas.35:
prayachCha rAjyArdhamapetamohaH; savAhanaM tvaM saparichChadaM cha |
tato.avasheShaM tava jIvitasya; sahAnujasyaiva bhavennarendra

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
evamukte tu bhIShmeNa droNena vidureNa cha |
gAndhAryA dhRRitarAShTreNa na cha mando.anvabudhyata
shlokas.2:
avadhUyotthitaH kruddho roShAtsa.nraktalochanaH |
anvadravanta taM pashchAdrAjAnastyaktajIvitAH
shlokas.3:
aj~nApayachcha rAj~nastAnpArthivAnduShTachetasaH |
prayAdhvaM vai kurukShetraM puShyo.adyeti punaH punaH
shlokas.4:
tataste pRRithivIpAlAH prayayuH sahasainikAH |
bhIShmaM senApatiM kRRitvA saMhRRiShTAH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.5:
akShauhiNyo dashaikA cha pArthivAnAM samAgatAH |
tAsAM pramukhato bhIShmastAlaketurvyarochata
yadatra yuktaM prAptaM cha tadvidhatsva vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
uktaM bhIShmeNa yadvAkyaM droNena vidureNa cha |
gAndhAryA dhRRitarAShTreNa samakShaM mama bhArata
etatte kathitaM rAjanyadvRRittaM kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.7:
sAma Adau prayuktaM me rAjansaubhrAtramichChatA |
abhedAtkuruva.nshasya prajAnAM cha vivRRiddhaye
shlokas.8:
punarbhedashcha me yukto yadA sAma na gRRihyate |
karmAnukIrtanaM chaiva devamAnuShasaMhitam
shlokas.9:
yadA nAdriyate vAkyaM sAmapUrvaM suyodhanaH |
tadA mayA samAnIya bheditAH sarvapArthivAH
shlokas.10:
adbhutAni cha ghorANi dAruNAni cha bhArata |
amAnuShANi karmANi darshitAni cha me vibho
shlokas.11:
bhartsayitvA tu rAj~nastA.nstRRiNIkRRitya suyodhanam |
rAdheyaM bhIShayitvA cha saubalaM cha punaH punaH
shlokas.12:
nyUnatAM dhArtarAShTrANAM nindAM chaiva punaH punaH |
bhedayitvA nRRipAnsarvAnvAgbhirmantreNa chAsakRRit
shlokas.13:
punaH sAmAbhisa.nyuktaM sampradAnamathAbruvam |
abhedAtkuruva.nshasya kAryayogAttathaiva cha
shlokas.14:
te bAlA dhRRitarAShTrasya bhIShmasya vidurasya cha |
tiShTheyuH pANDavAH sarve hitvA mAnamadhashcharAH
shlokas.15:
prayachChantu cha te rAjyamanIshAste bhavantu cha |
yathAha rAjA gA~Ngeyo vidurashcha tathAstu tat
shlokas.16:
sarvaM bhavatu te rAjyaM pa~ncha grAmAnvisarjaya |
avashyaM bharaNIyA hi pituste rAjasattama
shlokas.17:
evamuktastu duShTAtmA naiva bhAvaM vyamu~nchata |
daNDaM chaturthaM pashyAmi teShu pApeShu nAnyathA
shlokas.18:
niryAtAshcha vinAshAya kurukShetraM narAdhipAH |
etatte kathitaM sarvaM yadvRRittaM kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.19:
na te rAjyaM prayachChanti vinA yuddhena pANDava |
vinAshahetavaH sarve pratyupasthitamRRityavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
janArdanavachaH shrutvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtR^InuvAcha dharmAtmA samakShaM keshavasya ha
shlokas.2:
shrutaM bhavadbhiryadvRRittaM sabhAyAM kurusa.nsadi |
keshavasyApi yadvAkyaM tatsarvamavadhAritam
shlokas.3:
tasmAtsenAvibhAgaM me kurudhvaM narasattamAH |
akShauhiNyastu saptaitAH sametA vijayAya vai
shlokas.4:
tAsAM me patayaH sapta vikhyAtAstAnnibodhata |
drupadashcha virATashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau
shlokas.5:
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha bhImasenashcha vIryavAn |
ete senApraNetAro vIrAH sarve tanutyajaH
shlokas.6:
sarve vedavidaH shUrAH sarve sucharitavratAH |
hrImanto nItimantashcha sarve yuddhavishAradAH
iShvastrakushalAshchaiva tathA sarvAstrayodhinaH
shlokas.7:
saptAnAmapi yo netA senAnAM pravibhAgavit |
yaH saheta raNe bhIShmaM sharArchiHpAvakopamam
shlokas.8:
tvaM tAvatsahadevAtra prabrUhi kurunandana |
svamataM puruShavyAghra ko naH senApatiH kShamaH
shlokas.9:
sahadeva uvAcha||
sa.nyukta ekaduHkhashcha vIryavA.nshcha mahIpatiH |
yaM samAshritya dharmaj~naM svama.nshamanuyu~njmahe
shlokas.10:
matsyo virATo balavAnkRRitAstro yuddhadurmadaH |
prasahiShyati sa~NgrAme bhIShmaM tA.nshcha mahArathAn
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathokte sahadevena vAkye vAkyavishAradaH |
nakulo.anantaraM tasmAdidaM vachanamAdade
shlokas.12:
vayasA shAstrato dhairyAtkulenAbhijanena cha |
hrImAnkulAnvitaH shrImAnsarvashAstravishAradaH
shlokas.13:
veda chAstraM bharadvAjAddurdharShaH satyasa~NgaraH |
yo nityaM spardhate droNaM bhIShmaM chaiva mahAbalam
shlokas.14:
shlAghyaH pArthivasa~Nghasya pramukhe vAhinIpatiH |
putrapautraiH parivRRitaH shatashAkha iva drumaH
shlokas.15:
yastatApa tapo ghoraM sadAraH pRRithivIpatiH |
roShAddroNavinAshAya vIraH samitishobhanaH
shlokas.16:
pitevAsmAnsamAdhatte yaH sadA pArthivarShabhaH |
shvashuro drupado.asmAkaM senAmagre prakarShatu
shlokas.17:
sa droNabhIShmAvAyAntau sahediti matirmama |
sa hi divyAstravidrAjA sakhA chA~Ngiraso nRRipaH
shlokas.18:
mAdrIsutAbhyAmukte tu svamate kurunandanaH |
vAsavirvAsavasamaH savyasAchyabravIdvachaH
shlokas.19:
yo.ayaM tapaHprabhAvena RRiShisantoShaNena cha |
divyaH puruSha utpanno jvAlAvarNo mahAbalaH
shlokas.20:
dhanuShmAnkavachI khaDgI rathamAruhya da.nshitaH |
divyairhayavarairyuktamagnikuNDAtsamutthitaH
shlokas.21:
garjanniva mahAmegho rathaghoSheNa vIryavAn |
siMhasaMhanano vIraH siMhavikrAntavikramaH
shlokas.22:
siMhorasko mahAbAhuH siMhavakShA mahAbalaH |
siMhapragarjano vIraH siMhaskandho mahAdyutiH
shlokas.23:
subhrUH sudaMShTraH suhanuH subAhuH sumukho.akRRishaH |
sujatruH suvishAlAkShaH supAdaH supratiShThitaH
shlokas.24:
abhedyaH sarvashastrANAM prabhinna iva vAraNaH |
jaj~ne droNavinAshAya satyavAdI jitendriyaH
shlokas.25:
dhRRiShTadyumnamahaM manye sahedbhIShmasya sAyakAn |
vajrAshanisamasparshAndIptAsyAnuragAniva
shlokas.26:
yamadUtasamAnvege nipAte pAvakopamAn |
rAmeNAjau viShahitAnvajraniShpeShadAruNAn
shlokas.27:
puruShaM taM na pashyAmi yaH saheta mahAvratam |
dhRRiShTadyumnamRRite rAjanniti me dhIyate matiH
shlokas.28:
kShiprahastashchitrayodhI mataH senApatirmama |
abhedyakavachaH shrImAnmAta~Nga iva yUthapaH
shlokas.29:
bhIma uvAcha||
vadhArthaM yaH samutpannaH shikhaNDI drupadAtmajaH |
vadanti siddhA rAjendra RRiShayashcha samAgatAH
shlokas.30:
yasya sa~NgrAmamadhyeShu divyamastraM vikurvataH |
rUpaM drakShyanti puruShA rAmasyeva mahAtmanaH
shlokas.31:
na taM yuddheShu pashyAmi yo vibhindyAchChikhaNDinam |
shastreNa samare rAjansaMnaddhaM syandane sthitam
shlokas.32:
dvairathe viShahennAnyo bhIShmaM rAjanmahAvratam |
shikhaNDinamRRite vIraM sa me senApatirmataH
shlokas.33:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sarvasya jagatastAta sArAsAraM balAbalam |
sarvaM jAnAti dharmAtmA gatameShyachcha keshavaH
shlokas.34:
yamAha kRRiShNo dAshArhaH so.astu no vAhinIpatiH |
kRRitAstro hyakRRitAstro vA vRRiddho vA yadi vA yuvA
shlokas.35:
eSha no vijaye mUlameSha tAta viparyaye |
atra prANAshcha rAjyaM cha bhAvAbhAvau sukhAsukhe
shlokas.36:
eSha dhAtA vidhAtA cha siddhiratra pratiShThitA |
yamAha kRRiShNo dAshArhaH sa naH senApatiH kShamaH
bravItu vadatAM shreShTho nishA samativartate
shlokas.37:
tataH senApatiM kRRitvA kRRiShNasya vashavartinam |
rAtrisheShe vyatikrAnte prayAsyAmo raNAjiram
adhivAsitashastrAshcha kRRitakautukama~NgalAH
shlokas.38:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA dharmarAjasya dhImataH |
abravItpuNDarIkAkSho dhana~njayamavekShya ha
shlokas.39:
mamApyete mahArAja bhavadbhirya udAhRRitAH |
netArastava senAyAH shUrA vikrAntayodhinaH
sarva ete samarthA hi tava shatrUnpramarditum
shlokas.40:
indrasyApi bhayaM hyete janayeyurmahAhave |
kiM punardhArtarAShTrANAM lubdhAnAM pApachetasAm
shlokas.41:
mayApi hi mahAbAho tvatpriyArthamari.ndama |
kRRito yatno mahA.nstatra shamaH syAditi bhArata
dharmasya gatamAnRRiNyaM na sma vAchyA vivakShatAm
shlokas.42:
kRRitArthaM manyate bAlaH so.a.atmAnamavichakShaNaH |
dhArtarAShTro balasthaM cha manyate.a.atmAnamAturaH
shlokas.43:
yujyatAM vAhinI sAdhu vadhasAdhyA hi te matAH |
na dhArtarAShTrAH shakShyanti sthAtuM dRRiShTvA dhana~njayam
shlokas.44:
bhImasenaM cha sa~NkruddhaM yamau chApi yamopamau |
yuyudhAnadvitIyaM cha dhRRiShTadyumnamamarShaNam
shlokas.45:
abhimanyuM draupadeyAnvirATadrupadAvapi |
akShauhiNIpatI.nshchAnyAnnarendrAndRRiDhavikramAn
shlokas.46:
sAravadbalamasmAkaM duShpradharShaM durAsadam |
dhArtarAShTrabalaM sa~Nkhye vadhiShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.47:
evamukte tu kRRiShNena samprahRRiShyannarottamAH |
teShAM prahRRiShTamanasAM nAdaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.48:
yoga ityatha sainyAnAM tvaratAM sampradhAvatAm |
hayavAraNashabdashcha nemighoShashcha sarvashaH
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShastumulaH sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.49:
prayAsyatAM pANDavAnAM sasainyAnAM samantataH |
ga~Ngeva pUrNA durdharShA samadRRishyata vAhinI
shlokas.50:
agrAnIke bhImaseno mAdrIputrau cha da.nshitau |
saubhadro draupadeyAshcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
prabhadrakAshcha pA~nchAlA bhImasenamukhA yayuH
shlokas.51:
tataH shabdaH samabhavatsamudrasyeva parvaNi |
hRRiShTAnAM samprayAtAnAM ghoSho divamivAspRRishat
shlokas.52:
prahRRiShTA da.nshitA yodhAH parAnIkavidAraNAH |
teShAM madhye yayau rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.53:
shakaTApaNaveshAshcha yAnayugyaM cha sarvashaH |
koshayantrAyudhaM chaiva ye cha vaidyAshchikitsakAH
shlokas.54:
phalgu yachcha balaM ki~nchittathaiva kRRishadurbalam |
tatsa~NgRRihya yayau rAjA ye chApi parichArakAH
shlokas.55:
upaplavye tu pA~nchAlI draupadI satyavAdinI |
saha strIbhirnivavRRite dAsIdAsasamAvRRitA
shlokas.56:
kRRitvA mUlapratIkArAngulmaiH sthAvaraja~NgamaiH |
skandhAvAreNa mahatA prayayuH pANDunandanAH
shlokas.57:
dadato gAM hiraNyaM cha brAhmaNairabhisa.nvRRitAH |
stUyamAnA yayU rAjanrathairmaNivibhUShitaiH
shlokas.58:
kekayA dhRRiShTaketushcha putraH kAshyasya chAbhibhUH |
shreNimAnvasudAnashcha shikhaNDI chAparAjitaH
shlokas.59:
hRRiShTAstuShTAH kavachinaH sashastrAH samala~NkRRitAH |
rAjAnamanvayuH sarve parivArya yudhiShThiram
shlokas.60:
jaghanArdhe virATashcha yaj~nasenashcha somakiH |
sudharmA kuntibhojashcha dhRRiShTadyumnasya chAtmajAH
shlokas.61:
rathAyutAni chatvAri hayAH pa~nchaguNAstataH |
pattisainyaM dashaguNaM sAdinAmayutAni ShaT
shlokas.62:
anAdhRRiShTishchekitAnashchedirAjo.atha sAtyakiH |
parivArya yayuH sarve vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.63:
AsAdya tu kurukShetraM vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH |
pANDavAH samadRRishyanta nardanto vRRiShabhA iva
shlokas.64:
te.avagAhya kurukShetraM sha~NkhAndadhmurari.ndamAH |
tathaiva dadhmatuH sha~Nkhau vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.65:
pA~nchajanyasya nirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
