nishamya sarvasainyAni samahRRiShyanta sarvashaH
shlokas.66:
sha~Nkhadundubhisa.nsRRiShTaH siMhanAdastarasvinAm |
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha sAgarA.nshchAnvanAdayat
shlokas.67:
tato deshe same snigdhe prabhUtayavasendhane |
niveshayAmAsa tadA senAM rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.68:
parihRRitya shmashAnAni devatAyatanAni cha |
AshramA.nshcha maharShINAM tIrthAnyAyatanAni cha
shlokas.69:
madhurAnUShare deshe shive puNye mahIpatiH |
niveshaM kArayAmAsa kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.70:
tatashcha punarutthAya sukhI vishrAntavAhanaH |
prayayau pRRithivIpAlairvRRitaH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.71:
vidrAvya shatasho gulmAndhArtarAShTrasya sainikAn |
paryakrAmatsamantAchcha pArthena saha keshavaH
shlokas.72:
shibiraM mApayAmAsa dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
sAtyakishcha rathodAro yuyudhAnaH pratApavAn
shlokas.73:
AsAdya saritaM puNyAM kurukShetre hiraNvatIm |
sUpatIrthAM shuchijalAM sharkarApa~NkavarjitAm
shlokas.74:
khAnayAmAsa parikhAM keshavastatra bhArata |
guptyarthamapi chAdishya balaM tatra nyaveshayat
shlokas.75:
vidhiryaH shibirasyAsItpANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
tadvidhAni narendrANAM kArayAmAsa keshavaH
shlokas.76:
prabhUtajalakAShThAni durAdharShatarANi cha |
bhakShyabhojyopapannAni shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.77:
shibirANi mahArhANi rAj~nAM tatra pRRithakpRRithak |
vimAnAnIva rAjendra niviShTAni mahItale
shlokas.78:
tatrAsa~nshilpinaH prAj~nAH shatasho dattavetanAH |
sarvopakaraNairyuktA vaidyAshcha suvishAradAH
shlokas.79:
jyAdhanurvarmashastrANAM tathaiva madhusarpiShoH |
sasarja rasapA.nsUnAM rAshayaH parvatopamAH
shlokas.80:
bahUdakaM suyavasaM tuShA~NgArasamanvitam |
shibire shibire rAjA sa~nchakAra yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.81:
mahAyantrANi nArAchAstomararShTiparashvadhAH |
dhanUMShi kavachAdIni hRRidyabhUvannRRiNAM tadA
shlokas.82:
gajAH ka~NkaTasaMnAhA lohavarmottarachChadAH |
adRRishya.nstatra giryAbhAH sahasrashatayodhinaH
shlokas.83:
niviShTAnpANDavA.nstatra j~nAtvA mitrANi bhArata |
abhisasruryathoddeshaM sabalAH sahavAhanAH
shlokas.84:
charitabrahmacharyAste somapA bhUridakShiNAH |
jayAya pANDuputrANAM samAjagmurmahIkShitaH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
yudhiShThiraM sahAnIkamupayAntaM yuyutsayA |
saMniviShTaM kurukShetre vAsudevena pAlitam
shlokas.2:
virATadrupadAbhyAM cha saputrAbhyAM samanvitam |
kekayairvRRiShNibhishchaiva pArthivaiH shatasho vRRitam
shlokas.3:
mahendramiva chAdityairabhiguptaM mahArathaiH |
shrutvA duryodhano rAjA kiM kAryaM pratyapadyata
shlokas.4:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa tapodhana |
sambhrame tumule tasminyadAsItkurujA~Ngale
shlokas.5:
vyathayeyurhi devAnAM senAmapi samAgame |
pANDavA vAsudevashcha virATadrupadau tathA
shlokas.6:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pA~nchAlyaH shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH |
yuyudhAnashcha vikrAnto devairapi durAsadaH
shlokas.7:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa tapodhana |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha yadyadAsIdvicheShTitam
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pratiyAte tu dAshArhe rAjA duryodhanastadA |
karNaM duHshAsanaM chaiva shakuniM chAbravIdidam
shlokas.9:
akRRitenaiva kAryeNa gataH pArthAnadhokShajaH |
sa enAnmanyunAviShTo dhruvaM vakShyatyasa.nshayam
shlokas.10:
iShTo hi vAsudevasya pANDavairmama vigrahaH |
bhImasenArjunau chaiva dAshArhasya mate sthitau
shlokas.11:
ajAtashatrurapyadya bhImArjunavashAnugaH |
nikRRitashcha mayA pUrvaM saha sarvaiH sahodaraiH
shlokas.12:
virATadrupadau chaiva kRRitavairau mayA saha |
tau cha senApraNetArau vAsudevavashAnugau
shlokas.13:
bhavitA vigrahaH so.ayaM tumulo lomaharShaNaH |
tasmAtsA~NgrAmikaM sarvaM kArayadhvamatandritAH
shlokas.14:
shibirANi kurukShetre kriyantAM vasudhAdhipAH |
suparyAptAvakAshAni durAdeyAni shatrubhiH
shlokas.15:
AsannajalakAShThAni shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
achChedyAhAramArgANi ratnochchayachitAni cha
vividhAyudhapUrNAni patAkAdhvajavanti cha
shlokas.16:
samAshcha teShAM panthAnaH kriyantAM nagarAdbahiH |
prayANaM ghuShyatAmadya shvobhUta iti mAchiram
shlokas.17:
te tatheti pratij~nAya shvobhUte chakrire tathA |
hRRiShTarUpA mahAtmAno vinAshAya mahIkShitAm
shlokas.18:
tataste pArthivAH sarve tachChrutvA rAjashAsanam |
Asanebhyo mahArhebhya udatiShThannamarShitAH
shlokas.19:
bAhUnparighasa~NkAshAnsa.nspRRishantaH shanaiH shanaiH |
kA~nchanA~NgadadIptA.nshcha chandanAgarubhUShitAn
shlokas.20:
uShNIShANi niyachChantaH puNDarIkanibhaiH karaiH |
antarIyottarIyANi bhUShaNAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.21:
te rathAnrathinaH shreShThA hayA.nshcha hayakovidAH |
sajjayanti sma nAgA.nshcha nAgashikShAsu niShThitAH
shlokas.22:
atha varmANi chitrANi kA~nchanAni bahUni cha |
vividhAni cha shastrANi chakruH sajjAni sarvashaH
shlokas.23:
padAtayashcha puruShAH shastrANi vividhAni cha |
upajahruH sharIreShu hemachitrANyanekashaH
shlokas.24:
tadutsava ivodagraM samprahRRiShTanarAvRRitam |
nagaraM dhArtarAShTrasya bhAratAsItsamAkulam
shlokas.25:
janaughasalilAvarto rathanAgAshvamInavAn |
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShaH koshasa~nchayaratnavAn
shlokas.26:
chitrAbharaNavarmormiH shastranirmalaphenavAn |
prAsAdamAlAdrivRRito rathyApaNamahAhradaH
shlokas.27:
yodhachandrodayodbhUtaH kururAjamahArNavaH |
adRRishyata tadA rAja.nshchandrodaya ivArNavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vAsudevasya tadvAkyamanusmRRitya yudhiShThiraH |
punaH paprachCha vArShNeyaM kathaM mando.abravIdidam
shlokas.2:
asminnabhyAgate kAle kiM cha naH kShamamachyuta |
kathaM cha vartamAnA vai svadharmAnna chyavemahi
shlokas.3:
duryodhanasya karNasya shakuneH saubalasya cha |
vAsudeva mataj~no.asi mama sabhrAtRRikasya cha
shlokas.4:
vidurasyApi te vAkyaM shrutaM bhIShmasya chobhayoH |
kuntyAshcha vipulapraj~na praj~nA kArtsnyena te shrutA
shlokas.5:
sarvametadatikramya vichArya cha punaH punaH |
yannaH kShamaM mahAbAho tadbravIhyavichArayan
shlokas.6:
shrutvaitaddharmarAjasya dharmArthasahitaM vachaH |
meghadundubhinirghoShaH kRRiShNo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.7:
uktavAnasmi yadvAkyaM dharmArthasahitaM hitam |
na tu tannikRRitipraj~ne kauravye pratitiShThati
shlokas.8:
na cha bhIShmasya durmedhAH shRRiNoti vidurasya vA |
mama vA bhAShitaM ki~nchitsarvamevAtivartate
shlokas.9:
na sa kAmayate dharmaM na sa kAmayate yashaH |
jitaM sa manyate sarvaM durAtmA karNamAshritaH
shlokas.10:
bandhamAj~nApayAmAsa mama chApi suyodhanaH |
na cha taM labdhavAnkAmaM durAtmA shAsanAtigaH
shlokas.11:
na cha bhIShmo na cha droNo yuktaM tatrAhaturvachaH |
sarve tamanuvartante RRite viduramachyuta
shlokas.12:
shakuniH saubalashchaiva karNaduHshAsanAvapi |
tvayyayuktAnyabhAShanta mUDhA mUDhamamarShaNam
shlokas.13:
kiM cha tena mayoktena yAnyabhAShanta kauravAH |
sa~NkShepeNa durAtmAsau na yuktaM tvayi vartate
shlokas.14:
na pArthiveShu sarveShu ya ime tava sainikAH |
yatpApaM yanna kalyANaM sarvaM tasminpratiShThitam
shlokas.15:
na chApi vayamatyarthaM parityAgena karhichit |
kauravaiH shamamichChAmastatra yuddhamanantaram
shlokas.16:
tachChrutvA pArthivAH sarve vAsudevasya bhAShitam |
abruvanto mukhaM rAj~naH samudaikShanta bhArata
shlokas.17:
yudhiShThirastvabhiprAyamupalabhya mahIkShitAm |
yogamAj~nApayAmAsa bhImArjunayamaiH saha
shlokas.18:
tataH kilakilAbhUtamanIkaM pANDavasya ha |
Aj~nApite tadA yoge samahRRiShyanta sainikAH
shlokas.19:
avadhyAnAM vadhaM pashyandharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
niShTananbhImasenaM cha vijayaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.20:
yadarthaM vanavAsashcha prAptaM duHkhaM cha yanmayA |
so.ayamasmAnupaityeva paro.anarthaH prayatnataH
shlokas.21:
yasminyatnaH kRRito.asmAbhiH sa no hInaH prayatnataH |
akRRite tu prayatne.asmAnupAvRRittaH kalirmahAn
shlokas.22:
kathaM hyavadhyaiH sa~NgrAmaH kAryaH saha bhaviShyati |
kathaM hatvA gurUnvRRiddhAnvijayo no bhaviShyati
shlokas.23:
tachChrutvA dharmarAjasya savyasAchI parantapaH |
yaduktaM vAsudevena shrAvayAmAsa tadvachaH
shlokas.24:
uktavAndevakIputraH kuntyAshcha vidurasya cha |
vachanaM tattvayA rAjannikhilenAvadhAritam
shlokas.25:
na cha tau vakShyato.adharmamiti me naiShThikI matiH |
na chApi yuktaM kaunteya nivartitumayudhyataH
shlokas.26:
tachChrutvA vAsudevo.api savyasAchivachastadA |
smayamAno.abravItpArthamevametaditi bruvan
shlokas.27:
tataste dhRRitasa~NkalpA yuddhAya sahasainikAH |
pANDaveyA mahArAja tAM rAtriM sukhamAvasan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vyuShitAyAM rajanyAM tu rAjA duryodhanastataH |
vyabhajattAnyanIkAni dasha chaikaM cha bhArata
shlokas.2:
narahastirathAshvAnAM sAraM madhyaM cha phalgu cha |
sarveShveteShvanIkeShu sa.ndidesha mahIpatiH
shlokas.3:
sAnukarShAH satUNIrAH savarUthAH satomarAH |
sopAsa~NgAH sashaktIkAH saniSha~NgAH sapothikAH
shlokas.4:
sadhvajAH sapatAkAshcha sasharAsanatomarAH |
rajjubhishcha vichitrAbhiH sapAshAH saparistarAH
shlokas.5:
sakachagrahavikShepAH satailaguDavAlukAH |
sAshIviShaghaTAH sarve sasarjarasapA.nsavaH
shlokas.6:
saghaNTAphalakAH sarve vAsIvRRikShAdanAnvitAH |
vyAghracharmaparIvArA vRRitAshcha dvIpicharmabhiH
shlokas.7:
savastayaH sashRRi~NgAshcha saprAsavividhAyudhAH |
sakuThArAH sakuddAlAH satailakShaumasarpiShaH
shlokas.8:
chitrAnIkAH suvapuSho jvalitA iva pAvakAH |
tathA kavachinaH shUrAH shastreShu kRRitanishramAH
shlokas.9:
kulInA hayayonij~nAH sArathye viniveshitAH |
baddhAriShTA baddhakakShyA baddhadhvajapatAkinaH
shlokas.10:
chaturyujo rathAH sarve sarve shastrasamAyutAH |
saMhRRiShTavAhanAH sarve sarve shatasharAsanAH
shlokas.11:
dhuryayorhayayorekastathAnyau pArShNisArathI |
tau chApi rathinAM shreShThau rathI cha hayavittathA
shlokas.12:
nagarANIva guptAni durAdeyAni shatrubhiH |
AsanrathasahasrANi hemamAlIni sarvashaH
shlokas.13:
yathA rathAstathA nAgA baddhakakShyAH svala~NkRRitAH |
babhUvuH sapta puruShA ratnavanta ivAdrayaH
shlokas.14:
dvAva~Nkushadharau teShu dvAvuttamadhanurdharau |
dvau varAsidharau rAjannekaH shaktipatAkadhRRik
shlokas.15:
gajairmattaiH samAkIrNaM savarmAyudhakoshakaiH |
tadbabhUva balaM rAjankauravyasya sahasrashaH
shlokas.16:
vichitrakavachAmuktaiH sapatAkaiH svala~NkRRitaiH |
sAdibhishchopasampannA Asannayutasho hayAH
shlokas.17:
susa~NgrAhAH susantoShA hemabhANDaparichChadAH |
anekashatasAhasrAste cha sAdivashe sthitAH
shlokas.18:
nAnArUpavikArAshcha nAnAkavachashastriNaH |
padAtino narAstatra babhUvurhemamAlinaH
shlokas.19:
rathasyAsandasha gajA gajasya dasha vAjinaH |
narA dasha hayasyAsanpAdarakShAH samantataH
shlokas.20:
rathasya nAgAH pa~nchAshannAgasyAsa~nshataM hayAH |
hayasya puruShAH sapta bhinnasandhAnakAriNaH
shlokas.21:
senA pa~nchashataM nAgA rathAstAvanta eva cha |
dashasenA cha pRRitanA pRRitanA dashavAhinI
shlokas.22:
vAhinI pRRitanA senA dhvajinI sAdinI chamUH |
akShauhiNIti paryAyairniruktAtha varUthinI
evaM vyUDhAnyanIkAni kauraveyeNa dhImatA
shlokas.23:
akShauhiNyo dashaikA cha sa~NkhyAtAH sapta chaiva ha |
akShauhiNyastu saptaiva pANDavAnAmabhUdbalam
akShauhiNyo dashaikA cha kauravANAmabhUdbalam
shlokas.24:
narANAM pa~nchapa~nchAshadeShA pattirvidhIyate |
senAmukhaM cha tisrastA gulma ityabhisa~nj~nitaH
shlokas.25:
dasha gulmA gaNastvAsIdgaNAstvayutasho.abhavan |
duryodhanasya senAsu yotsyamAnAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.26:
tatra duryodhano rAjA shUrAnbuddhimato narAn |
prasamIkShya mahAbAhushchakre senApatI.nstadA
shlokas.27:
pRRithagakShauhiNInAM cha praNetR^InnarasattamAn |
vidhipUrvaM samAnIya pArthivAnabhyaShechayat
shlokas.28:
kRRipaM droNaM cha shalyaM cha saindhavaM cha mahAratham |
sudakShiNaM cha kAmbojaM kRRitavarmANameva cha
shlokas.29:
droNaputraM cha karNaM cha bhUrishravasameva cha |
shakuniM saubalaM chaiva bAhlIkaM cha mahAratham
shlokas.30:
divase divase teShAM prativelaM cha bhArata |
chakre sa vividhAH sa~nj~nAH pratyakShaM cha punaH punaH
shlokas.31:
tathA viniyatAH sarve ye cha teShAM padAnugAH |
babhUvuH sainikA rAjanrAj~naH priyachikIrShavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH shAntanavaM bhIShmaM prA~njalirdhRRitarAShTrajaH |
saha sarvairmahIpAlairidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
RRite senApraNetAraM pRRitanA sumahatyapi |
dIryate yuddhamAsAdya pipIlikapuTaM yathA
shlokas.3:
na hi jAtu dvayorbuddhiH samA bhavati karhichit |
shauryaM cha nAma netR^INAM spardhate cha parasparam
shlokas.4:
shrUyate cha mahAprAj~na haihayAnamitaujasaH |
abhyayurbrAhmaNAH sarve samuchChritakushadhvajAH
shlokas.5:
tAnanvayustadA vaishyAH shUdrAshchaiva pitAmaha |
ekatastu trayo varNA ekataH kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.6:
te sma yuddheShvabhajyanta trayo varNAH punaH punaH |
kShatriyAstu jayantyeva bahulaM chaikato balam
shlokas.7:
tataste kShatriyAneva paprachChurdvijasattamAH |
tebhyaH shasha.nsurdharmaj~nA yAthAtathyaM pitAmaha
shlokas.8:
vayamekasya shRRiNumo mahAbuddhimato raNe |
bhavantastu pRRithaksarve svabuddhivashavartinaH
shlokas.9:
tataste brAhmaNAshchakrurekaM senApatiM dvijam |
nayeShu kushalaM shUramajayankShatriyA.nstataH
shlokas.10:
evaM ye kushalaM shUraM hite sthitamakalmaSham |
senApatiM prakurvanti te jayanti raNe ripUn
shlokas.11:
bhavAnushanasA tulyo hitaiShI cha sadA mama |
asaMhAryaH sthito dharme sa naH senApatirbhava
shlokas.12:
rashmIvatAmivAdityo vIrudhAmiva chandramAH |
kubera iva yakShANAM marutAmiva vAsavaH
shlokas.13:
parvatAnAM yathA meruH suparNaH patatAmiva |
kumAra iva bhUtAnAM vasUnAmiva havyavAT
shlokas.14:
bhavatA hi vayaM guptAH shakreNeva divaukasaH |
anAdhRRiShyA bhaviShyAmastridashAnAmapi dhruvam
shlokas.15:
prayAtu no bhavAnagre devAnAmiva pAvakiH |
vayaM tvAmanuyAsyAmaH saurabheyA ivarShabham
shlokas.16:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi bhArata |
yathaiva hi bhavanto me tathaiva mama pANDavAH
shlokas.17:
api chaiva maya shreyo vAchyaM teShAM narAdhipa |
yoddhavyaM tu tavArthAya yathA sa samayaH kRRitaH
shlokas.18:
na tu pashyAmi yoddhAramAtmanaH sadRRishaM bhuvi |
RRite tasmAnnaravyAghrAtkuntIputrAddhana~njayAt
shlokas.19:
sa hi veda mahAbAhurdivyAnyastrANi sarvashaH |
na tu mAM vivRRito yuddhe jAtu yudhyeta pANDavaH
shlokas.20:
ahaM sa cha kShaNenaiva nirmanuShyamidaM jagat |
kuryAM shastrabalenaiva sasurAsurarAkShasam
shlokas.21:
na tvevotsAdanIyA me pANDoH putrA narAdhipa |
tasmAdyodhAnhaniShyAmi prayogeNAyutaM sadA
shlokas.22:
evameShAM kariShyAmi nidhanaM kurunandana |
na chette mAM haniShyanti pUrvameva samAgame
shlokas.23:
senApatistvahaM rAjansamayenApareNa te |
bhaviShyAmi yathAkAmaM tanme shrotumihArhasi
shlokas.24:
karNo vA yudhyatAM pUrvamahaM vA pRRithivIpate |
spardhate hi sadAtyarthaM sUtaputro mayA raNe
shlokas.25:
karNa uvAcha||
nAhaM jIvati gA~Ngeye yotsye rAjankatha~nchana |
hate bhIShme tu yotsyAmi saha gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH senApatiM chakre vidhivadbhUridakShiNam |
dhRRitarAShTrAtmajo bhIShmaM so.abhiShikto vyarochata
shlokas.27:
tato bherIshcha sha~NkhA.nshcha shatashashchaiva puShkarAn |
vAdayAmAsuravyagrAH puruShA rAjashAsanAt
shlokas.28:
siMhanAdAshcha vividhA vAhanAnAM cha nisvanAH |
prAdurAsannanabhre cha varShaM rudhirakardamam
shlokas.29:
nirghAtAH pRRithivIkampA gajabRRiMhitanisvanAH |
Asa.nshcha sarvayodhAnAM pAtayanto manA.nsyuta
shlokas.30:
vAchashchApyasharIriNyo divashcholkAH prapedire |
shivAshcha bhayavedinyo nedurdIptasvarA bhRRisham
shlokas.31:
senApatye yadA rAjA gA~NgeyamabhiShiktavAn |
tadaitAnyugrarUpANi abhava~nshatasho nRRipa
shlokas.32:
tataH senApatiM kRRitvA bhIShmaM parabalArdanam |
vAchayitvA dvijashreShThAnniShkairgobhishcha bhUrishaH
shlokas.33:
vardhamAno jayAshIrbhirniryayau sainikairvRRitaH |
ApageyaM puraskRRitya bhrAtRRibhiH sahitastadA
skandhAvAreNa mahatA kurukShetraM jagAma ha
shlokas.34:
parikramya kurukShetraM karNena saha kauravaH |
shibiraM mApayAmAsa same deshe narAdhipaH
shlokas.35:
madhurAnUShare deshe prabhUtayavasendhane |
yathaiva hAstinapuraM tadvachChibiramAbabhau

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
ApageyaM mahAtmAnaM bhIShmaM shastrabhRRitAM varam |
pitAmahaM bhAratAnAM dhvajaM sarvamahIkShitAm
shlokas.2:
bRRihaspatisamaM buddhyA kShamayA pRRithivIsamam |
samudramiva gAmbhIrye himavantamiva sthiram
shlokas.3:
prajApatimivaudArye tejasA bhAskaropamam |
mahendramiva shatrUNAM dhva.nsanaM sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.4:
raNayaj~ne pratibhaye svAbhIle lomaharShaNe |
dIkShitaM chirarAtrAya shrutvA rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.5:
kimabravInmahAbAhuH sarvadharmavishAradaH |
bhImasenArjunau vApi kRRiShNo vA pratyapadyata
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ApaddharmArthakushalo mahAbuddhiryudhiShThiraH |
sarvAnbhrAtR^InsamAnIya vAsudevaM cha sAtvatam
uvAcha vadatAM shreShThaH sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH
shlokas.7:
paryAkrAmata sainyAni yattAstiShThata da.nshitAH |
pitAmahena vo yuddhaM pUrvameva bhaviShyati
tasmAtsaptasu senAsu praNetR^Inmama pashyata
shlokas.8:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
yathArhati bhavAnvaktumasminkAla upasthite |
tathedamarthavadvAkyamuktaM te bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
rochate me mahAbAho kriyatAM yadanantaram |
nAyakAstava senAyAmabhiShichyantu sapta vai
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato drupadamAnAyya virATaM shinipu~Ngavam |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pA~nchAlyaM dhRRiShTaketuM cha pArthivam
shikhaNDinaM cha pA~nchAlyaM sahadevaM cha mAgadham
shlokas.11:
etAnsapta maheShvAsAnvIrAnyuddhAbhinandinaH |
senApraNetR^InvidhivadabhyaShi~nchadyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
sarvasenApatiM chAtra dhRRiShTadyumnamupAdishat |
droNAntahetorutpanno ya iddhA~njAtavedasaH
shlokas.13:
sarveShAmeva teShAM tu samastAnAM mahAtmanAm |
senApatipatiM chakre guDAkeshaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.14:
arjunasyApi netA cha sa.nyantA chaiva vAjinAm |
sa~NkarShaNAnujaH shrImAnmahAbuddhirjanArdanaH
shlokas.15:
taddRRiShTvopasthitaM yuddhaM samAsannaM mahAtyayam |
prAvishadbhavanaM rAj~naH pANDavasya halAyudhaH
shlokas.16:
sahAkrUraprabhRRitibhirgadasAmbolmukAdibhiH |
raukmiNeyAhukasutaishchArudeShNapurogamaiH
shlokas.17:
vRRiShNimukhyairabhigatairvyAghrairiva balotkaTaiH |
abhigupto mahAbAhurmarudbhiriva vAsavaH
shlokas.18:
nIlakausheyavasanaH kailAsashikharopamaH |
siMhakhelagatiH shrImAnmadaraktAntalochanaH
shlokas.19:
taM dRRiShTvA dharmarAjashcha keshavashcha mahAdyutiH |
udatiShThattadA pArtho bhImakarmA vRRikodaraH
shlokas.20:
gANDIvadhanvA ye chAnye rAjAnastatra kechana |
pUjayAM chakrurabhyetya te sma sarve halAyudham
shlokas.21:
tatastaM pANDavo rAjA kare pasparsha pANinA |
vAsudevapurogAstu sarva evAbhyavAdayan
shlokas.22:
virATadrupadau vRRiddhAvabhivAdya halAyudhaH |
yudhiShThireNa sahita upAvishadari.ndamaH
shlokas.23:
tatasteShUpaviShTeShu pArthiveShu samantataH |
vAsudevamabhiprekShya rauhiNeyo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.24:
bhavitAyaM mahAraudro dAruNaH puruShakShayaH |
diShTametaddhruvaM manye na shakyamativartitum
shlokas.25:
asmAdyuddhAtsamuttIrNAnapi vaH sasuhRRijjanAn |
arogAnakShatairdehaiH pashyeyamiti me matiH
shlokas.26:
sametaM pArthivaM kShatraM kAlapakvamasa.nshayam |
vimardaH sumahAnbhAvI mA.nsashoNitakardamaH
shlokas.27:
ukto mayA vAsudevaH punaH punarupahvare |
sambandhiShu samAM vRRittiM vartasva madhusUdana
shlokas.28:
pANDavA hi yathAsmAkaM tathA duryodhano nRRipaH |
tasyApi kriyatAM yuktyA saparyeti punaH punaH
shlokas.29:
tachcha me nAkarodvAkyaM tvadarthe madhusUdanaH |
niviShTaH sarvabhAvena dhana~njayamavekShya cha
shlokas.30:
dhruvo jayaH pANDavAnAmiti me nishchitA matiH |
tathA hyabhinivesho.ayaM vAsudevasya bhArata
shlokas.31:
na chAhamutsahe kRRiShNamRRite lokamudIkShitum |
tato.ahamanuvartAmi keshavasya chikIrShitam
shlokas.32:
ubhau shiShyau hi me vIrau gadAyuddhavishAradau |
tulyasneho.asmyato bhIme tathA duryodhane nRRipe
shlokas.33:
tasmAdyAsyAmi tIrthAni sarasvatyA niShevitum |
na hi shakShyAmi kauravyAnnashyamAnAnupekShitum
shlokas.34:
evamuktvA mahAbAhuranuj~nAtashcha pANDavaiH |
tIrthayAtrAM yayau rAmo nivartya madhusUdanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu bhIShmakasya mahAtmanaH |
hiraNyalomno nRRipateH sAkShAdindrasakhasya vai
shlokas.2:
AhRRitInAmadhipaterbhojasyAtiyashasvinaH |
dAkShiNAtyapateH putro dikShu rukmIti vishrutaH
shlokas.3:
yaH kimpuruShasiMhasya gandhamAdanavAsinaH |
shiShyaH kRRitsnaM dhanurvedaM chatuShpAdamavAptavAn
shlokas.4:
yo mAhendraM dhanurlebhe tulyaM gANDIvatejasA |
shAr~NgeNa cha mahAbAhuH saMmitaM divyamakShayam
shlokas.5:
trINyevaitAni divyAni dhanUMShi divichAriNAm |
vAruNaM gANDivaM tatra mAhendraM vijayaM dhanuH
shlokas.6:
shAr~NgaM tu vaiShNavaM prAhurdivyaM tejomayaM dhanuH |
dhArayAmAsa yatkRRiShNaH parasenAbhayAvaham
shlokas.7:
gANDIvaM pAvakAllebhe khANDave pAkashAsaniH |
drumAdrukmI mahAtejA vijayaM pratyapadyata
shlokas.8:
sa~nChidya mauravAnpAshAnnihatya muramojasA |
nirjitya narakaM bhaumamAhRRitya maNikuNDale
shlokas.9:
ShoDasha strIsahasrANi ratnAni vividhAni cha |
pratipede hRRiShIkeshaH shAr~NgaM cha dhanuruttamam
shlokas.10:
rukmI tu vijayaM labdhvA dhanurmeghasamasvanam |
vibhIShayanniva jagatpANDavAnabhyavartata
shlokas.11:
nAmRRiShyata purA yo.asau svabAhubaladarpitaH |
rukmiNyA haraNaM vIro vAsudevena dhImatA
shlokas.12:
kRRitvA pratij~nAM nAhatvA nivartiShyAmi keshavam |
tato.anvadhAvadvArShNeyaM sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.13:
senayA chatura~NgiNyA mahatyA dUrapAtayA |
vichitrAyudhavarmiNyA ga~Ngayeva pravRRiddhayA
shlokas.14:
sa samAsAdya vArShNeyaM yogAnAmIshvaraM prabhum |
vya.nsito vrIDito rAjannAjagAma sa kuNDinam
shlokas.15:
yatraiva kRRiShNena raNe nirjitaH paravIrahA |
tatra bhojakaTaM nAma chakre nagaramuttamam
shlokas.16:
sainyena mahatA tena prabhUtagajavAjinA |
puraM tadbhuvi vikhyAtaM nAmnA bhojakaTaM nRRipa
shlokas.17:
sa bhojarAjaH sainyena mahatA parivAritaH |
akShauhiNyA mahAvIryaH pANDavAnsamupAgamat
shlokas.18:
tataH sa kavachI khaDgI sharI dhanvI talI rathI |
dhvajenAdityavarNena pravivesha mahAchamUm
shlokas.19:
viditaH pANDaveyAnAM vAsudevapriyepsayA |
yudhiShThirastu taM rAjA pratyudgamyAbhyapUjayat
shlokas.20:
sa pUjitaH pANDusutairyathAnyAyaM susatkRRitaH |
pratipUjya cha tAnsarvAnvishrAntaH sahasainikaH
uvAcha madhye vIrANAM kuntIputraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.21:
sahAyo.asmi sthito yuddhe yadi bhIto.asi pANDava |
kariShyAmi raNe sAhyamasahyaM tava shatrubhiH
shlokas.22:
na hi me vikrame tulyaH pumAnastIha kashchana |
nihatya samare shatrU.nstava dAsyAmi phalguna
shlokas.23:
ityukto dharmarAjasya keshavasya cha saMnidhau |
shRRiNvatAM pArthivendrANAmanyeShAM chaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.24:
vAsudevamabhiprekShya dharmarAjaM cha pANDavam |
uvAcha dhImAnkaunteyaH prahasya sakhipUrvakam
shlokas.25:
yudhyamAnasya me vIra gandharvaiH sumahAbalaiH |
sahAyo ghoShayAtrAyAM kastadAsItsakhA mama
shlokas.26:
tathA pratibhaye tasmindevadAnavasa~Nkule |
khANDave yudhyamAnasya kaH sahAyastadAbhavat
shlokas.27:
nivAtakavachairyuddhe kAlakeyaishcha dAnavaiH |
tatra me yudhyamAnasya kaH sahAyastadAbhavat
shlokas.28:
tathA virATanagare kurubhiH saha sa~Ngare |
yudhyato bahubhistAta kaH sahAyo.abhavanmama
shlokas.29:
upajIvya raNe rudraM shakraM vaishravaNaM yamam |
varuNaM pAvakaM chaiva kRRipaM droNaM cha mAdhavam
shlokas.30:
dhArayangANDivaM divyaM dhanustejomayaM dRRiDham |
akShayyasharasa.nyukto divyAstraparibRRiMhitaH
shlokas.31:
kauravANAM kule jAtaH pANDoH putro visheShataH |
droNaM vyapadisha~nshiShyo vAsudevasahAyavAn
shlokas.32:
kathamasmadvidho brUyAdbhIto.asmItyayashaskaram |
vachanaM narashArdUla vajrAyudhamapi svayam
shlokas.33:
nAsmi bhIto mahAbAho sahAyArthashcha nAsti me |
yathAkAmaM yathAyogaM gachCha vAnyatra tiShTha vA
shlokas.34:
vinivartya tato rukmI senAM sAgarasaMnibhAm |
duryodhanamupAgachChattathaiva bharatarShabha
shlokas.35:
tathaiva chAbhigamyainamuvAcha sa narAdhipaH |
pratyAkhyAtashcha tenApi sa tadA shUramAninA
shlokas.36:
dvAveva tu mahArAja tasmAdyuddhAdvyapeyatuH |
rauhiNeyashcha vArShNeyo rukmI cha vasudhAdhipaH
shlokas.37:
gate rAme tIrthayAtrAM bhIShmakasya sute tathA |
upAvishanpANDaveyA mantrAya punareva hi
shlokas.38:
samitirdharmarAjasya sA pArthivasamAkulA |
shushubhe tArakAchitrA dyaushchandreNeva bhArata

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
tathA vyUDheShvanIkeShu kurukShetre dvijarShabha |
kimakurvanta kuravaH kAlenAbhiprachoditAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA vyUDheShvanIkeShu yatteShu bharatarShabha |
dhRRitarAShTro mahArAja sa~njayaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
ehi sa~njaya me sarvamAchakShvAnavasheShataH |
senAniveshe yadvRRittaM kurupANDavasenayoH
shlokas.4:
diShTameva paraM manye pauruShaM chApyanarthakam |
yadahaM jAnamAno.api yuddhadoShAnkShayodayAn
shlokas.5:
tathApi nikRRitipraj~naM putraM durdyUtadevinam |
na shaknomi niyantuM vA kartuM vA hitamAtmanaH
shlokas.6:
bhavatyeva hi me sUta buddhirdoShAnudarshinI |
duryodhanaM samAsAdya punaH sA parivartate
shlokas.7:
evaM gate vai yadbhAvi tadbhaviShyati sa~njaya |
kShatradharmaH kila raNe tanutyAgo.abhipUjitaH
shlokas.8:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tvadyukto.ayamanuprashno mahArAja yathArhasi |
na tu duryodhane doShamimamAsaktumarhasi
shRRiNuShvAnavasheSheNa vadato mama pArthiva
shlokas.9:
ya Atmano dushcharitAdashubhaM prApnuyAnnaraH |
enasA na sa daivaM vA kAlaM vA gantumarhati
shlokas.10:
mahArAja manuShyeShu nindyaM yaH sarvamAcharet |
sa vadhyaH sarvalokasya ninditAni samAcharan
shlokas.11:
nikArA manujashreShTha pANDavaistvatpratIkShayA |
anubhUtAH sahAmAtyairnikRRitairadhidevane
shlokas.12:
hayAnAM cha gajAnAM cha rAj~nAM chAmitatejasAm |
vaishasaM samare vRRittaM yattanme shRRiNu sarvashaH
shlokas.13:
sthiro bhUtvA mahArAja sarvalokakShayodayam |
yathAbhUtaM mahAyuddhe shrutvA mA vimanA bhava
shlokas.14:
na hyeva kartA puruShaH karmaNoH shubhapApayoH |
asvatantro hi puruShaH kAryate dAruyantravat
shlokas.15:
kechidIshvaranirdiShTAH kechideva yadRRichChayA |
pUrvakarmabhirapyanye traidhametadvikRRiShyate

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hiraNvatyAM niviShTeShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
duryodhano mahArAja karNena saha bhArata
shlokas.2:
saubalena cha rAjendra tathA duHshAsanena cha |
AhUyopahvare rAjannulUkamidamabravIt
shlokas.3:
ulUka gachCha kaitavya pANDavAnsahasomakAn |
gatvA mama vacho brUhi vAsudevasya shRRiNvataH
shlokas.4:
idaM tatsamanuprAptaM varShapUgAbhichintitam |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha yuddhaM lokabhaya~Nkaram
shlokas.5:
yadetatkatthanAvAkyaM sa~njayo mahadabravIt |
madhye kurUNAM kaunteya tasya kAlo.ayamAgataH
yathA vaH sampratij~nAtaM tatsarvaM kriyatAmiti
shlokas.6:
amarShaM rAjyaharaNaM vanavAsaM cha pANDava |
draupadyAshcha parikleshaM sa.nsmaranpuruSho bhava
shlokas.7:
yadarthaM kShatriyA sUte garbhaM tadidamAgatam |
balaM vIryaM cha shauryaM cha paraM chApyastralAghavam
pauruShaM darshayanyuddhe kopasya kuru niShkRRitim
shlokas.8:
parikliShTasya dInasya dIrghakAloShitasya cha |
na sphuTeddhRRidayaM kasya aishvaryAdbhra.nshitasya cha
shlokas.9:
kule jAtasya shUrasya paravitteShu gRRidhyataH |
AchChinnaM rAjyamAkramya kopaM kasya na dIpayet
shlokas.10:
yattaduktaM mahadvAkyaM karmaNA tadvibhAvyatAm |
akarmaNA katthitena santaH kupuruShaM viduH
shlokas.11:
amitrANAM vashe sthAnaM rAjyasya cha punarbhavaH |
dvAvarthau yudhyamAnasya tasmAtkuruta pauruSham
shlokas.12:
asmAnvA tvaM parAjitya prashAdhi pRRithivImimAm |
atha vA nihato.asmAbhirvIralokaM gamiShyasi
shlokas.13:
rAShTrAtpravrAjanaM kleshaM vanavAsaM cha pANDava |
kRRiShNAyAshcha parikleshaM sa.nsmaranpuruSho bhava
shlokas.14:
apriyANAM cha vachane pravrajatsu punaH punaH |
amarShaM darshayAdya tvamamarSho hyeva pauruSham
shlokas.15:
krodho balaM tathA vIryaM j~nAnayogo.astralAghavam |
iha te pArtha dRRishyantAM sa~NgrAme puruSho bhava
shlokas.16:
taM cha tUbarakaM mUDhaM bahvAshinamavidyakam |
ulUka madvacho brUyA asakRRidbhImasenakam
shlokas.17:
ashaktenaiva yachChaptaM sabhAmadhye vRRikodara |
duHshAsanasya rudhiraM pIyatAM yadi shakyate
shlokas.18:
lohAbhihAro nirvRRittaH kurukShetramakardamam |
puShTAste.ashvA bhRRitA yodhAH shvo yudhyasva sakeshavaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
senAniveshaM samprApya kaitavyaH pANDavasya ha |
samAgataH pANDaveyairyudhiShThiramabhAShata
shlokas.2:
abhij~no dUtavAkyAnAM yathoktaM bruvato mama |
duryodhanasamAdeshaM shrutvA na kroddhumarhasi
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ulUka na bhayaM te.asti brUhi tvaM vigatajvaraH |
yanmataM dhArtarAShTrasya lubdhasyAdIrghadarshinaH
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato dyutimatAM madhye pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
sRRi~njayAnAM cha sarveShAM kRRiShNasya cha yashasvinaH
shlokas.5:
drupadasya saputrasya virATasya cha saMnidhau |
bhUmipAnAM cha sarveShAM madhye vAkyaM jagAda ha
shlokas.6:
idaM tvAmabravIdrAjA dhArtarAShTro mahAmanAH |
shRRiNvatAM kuruvIrANAM tannibodha narAdhipa
shlokas.7:
parAjito.asi dyUtena kRRiShNA chAnAyitA sabhAm |
shakyo.amarSho manuShyeNa kartuM puruShamAninA
shlokas.8:
dvAdashaiva tu varShANi vane dhiShNyAdvivAsitAH |
sa.nvatsaraM virATasya dAsyamAsthAya choShitAH
shlokas.9:
amarShaM rAjyaharaNaM vanavAsaM cha pANDava |
draupadyAshcha parikleshaM sa.nsmaranpuruSho bhava
shlokas.10:
ashaktena cha yachChaptaM bhImasenena pANDava |
duHshAsanasya rudhiraM pIyatAM yadi shakyate
shlokas.11:
lohAbhihAro nirvRRittaH kurukShetramakardamam |
samaH panthA bhRRitA yodhAH shvo yudhyasva sakeshavaH
shlokas.12:
asamAgamya bhIShmeNa sa.nyuge kiM vikatthase |
ArurukShuryathA mandaH parvataM gandhamAdanam
shlokas.13:
droNaM cha yudhyatAM shreShThaM shachIpatisamaM yudhi |
ajitvA sa.nyuge pArtha rAjyaM kathamihechChasi
shlokas.14:
brAhme dhanuShi chAchAryaM vedayorantaraM dvayoH |
yudhi dhuryamavikShobhyamanIkadharamachyutam
shlokas.15:
droNaM mohAdyudhA pArtha yajjigIShasi tanmRRiShA |
na hi shushruma vAtena merumunmathitaM girim
shlokas.16:
anilo vA vahenmeruM dyaurvApi nipatenmahIm |
yugaM vA parivarteta yadyevaM syAdyathAttha mAm
shlokas.17:
ko hyAbhyAM jIvitAkA~NkShI prApyAstramarimardanam |
gajo vAjI naro vApi punaH svasti gRRihAnvrajet
shlokas.18:
kathamAbhyAmabhidhyAtaH sa.nsRRiShTo dAruNena vA |
raNe jIvanvimuchyeta padA bhUmimupaspRRishan
shlokas.19:
kiM darduraH kUpashayo yathemAM; na budhyase rAjachamUM sametAm |
durAdharShAM devachamUprakAshAM; guptAM narendraistridashairiva dyAm
shlokas.20:
prAchyaiH pratIchyairatha dAkShiNAtyai;rudIchyakAmbojashakaiH khashaishcha |
shAlvaiH samatsyaiH kurumadhyadeshai;rmlechChaiH pulindairdraviDAndhrakA~nchyaiH
shlokas.21:
nAnAjanaughaM yudhi sampravRRiddhaM; gA~NgaM yathA vegamavAraNIyam |
mAM cha sthitaM nAgabalasya madhye; yuyutsase manda kimalpabuddhe
shlokas.22:
ityevamuktvA rAjAnaM dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram |
abhyAvRRitya punarjiShNumulUkaH pratyabhAShata
shlokas.23:
akatthamAno yudhyasva katthase.arjuna kiM bahu |
paryAyAtsiddhiretasya naitatsidhyati katthanAt
shlokas.24:
yadIdaM katthanAtsidhyetkarma loke dhana~njaya |
sarve bhaveyuH siddhArthA bahu kattheta durgataH
shlokas.25:
jAnAmi te vAsudevaM sahAyaM; jAnAmi te gANDivaM tAlamAtram |
jAnAmyetattvAdRRisho nAsti yoddhA; rAjyaM cha te jAnamAno harAmi
shlokas.26:
na tu paryAyadharmeNa siddhiM prApnoti bhUyasIm |
manasaiva hi bhUtAni dhAtA prakurute vashe
shlokas.27:
trayodasha samA bhuktaM rAjyaM vilapatastava |
bhUyashchaiva prashAsiShye nihatya tvAM sabAndhavam
shlokas.28:
kva tadA gANDivaM te.abhUdyattvaM dAsapaNe jitaH |
kva tadA bhImasenasya balamAsIchcha phalguna
shlokas.29:
sagadAdbhImasenAchcha pArthAchchaiva sagANDivAt |
na vai mokShastadA vo.abhUdvinA kRRiShNAmaninditAm
shlokas.30:
sA vo dAsyaM samApannAnmokShayAmAsa bhAminI |
amAnuShyasamAyuktAndAsyakarmaNyavasthitAn
shlokas.31:
avochaM yatShaNDhatilAnahaM vastathyameva tat |
dhRRitA hi veNI pArthena virATanagare tadA
shlokas.32:
sUdakarmaNi cha shrAntaM virATasya mahAnase |
bhImasenena kaunteya yachcha tanmama pauruSham
shlokas.33:
evameva sadA daNDaM kShatriyAH kShatriye dadhuH |
shreNyAM kakShyAM cha veNyAM cha sa.nyuge yaH palAyate
shlokas.34:
na bhayAdvAsudevasya na chApi tava phalguna |
rAjyaM pratipradAsyAmi yudhyasva sahakeshavaH
shlokas.35:
na mAyA hIndrajAlaM vA kuhakA vA vibhIShaNI |
Attashastrasya me yuddhe vahanti pratigarjanAH
shlokas.36:
vAsudevasahasraM vA phalgunAnAM shatAni vA |
AsAdya mAmamogheShuM draviShyanti disho dasha
shlokas.37:
sa.nyugaM gachCha bhIShmeNa bhindhi tvaM shirasA girim |
prataremaM mahAgAdhaM bAhubhyAM puruShodadhim
shlokas.38:
shAradvatamahImAnaM vivi.nshatijhaShAkulam |
bRRihadbalasamuchchAlaM saumadattitimi~Ngilam
shlokas.39:
duHshAsanaughaM shalashalyamatsyaM; suSheNachitrAyudhanAganakram |
jayadrathAdriM purumitragAdhaM; durmarShaNodaM shakuniprapAtam
shlokas.40:
shastraughamakShayyamatipravRRiddhaM; yadAvagAhya shramanaShTachetAH |
bhaviShyasi tvaM hatasarvabAndhava;stadA manaste paritApameShyati
shlokas.41:
tadA manaste tridivAdivAshuche;rnivartatAM pArtha mahIprashAsanAt |
rAjyaM prashAstuM hi sudurlabhaM tvayA; bubhUShatA svarga ivAtapasvinA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ulUkastvarjunaM bhUyo yathoktaM vAkyamabravIt |
AshIviShamiva kruddhaM tudanvAkyashalAkayA
shlokas.2:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA ruShitAH pANDavA bhRRisham |
prAgeva bhRRishasa~NkruddhAH kaitavyena pradharShitAH
shlokas.3:
nAsaneShvavatiShThanta bAhU.nshchaiva vichikShipuH |
AshIviShA iva kruddhA vIkShAM chakruH parasparam
shlokas.4:
avAkShirA bhImasenaH samudaikShata keshavam |
netrAbhyAM lohitAntAbhyAmAshIviSha iva shvasan
shlokas.5:
ArtaM vAtAtmajaM dRRiShTvA krodhenAbhihataM bhRRisham |
utsmayanniva dAshArhaH kaitavyaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.6:
prayAhi shIghraM kaitavya brUyAshchaiva suyodhanam |
shrutaM vAkyaM gRRihIto.artho mataM yatte tathAstu tat
shlokas.7:
madvachashchApi bhUyaste vaktavyaH sa suyodhanaH |
shva idAnIM pradRRishyethAH puruSho bhava durmate
shlokas.8:
manyase yachcha mUDha tvaM na yotsyati janArdanaH |
sArathyena vRRitaH pArthairiti tvaM na bibheShi cha
shlokas.9:
jaghanyakAlamapyetadbhavedyatsarvapArthivAn |
nirdaheyamahaM krodhAttRRiNAnIva hutAshanaH
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThiraniyogAttu phalgunasya mahAtmanaH |
kariShye yudhyamAnasya sArathyaM viditAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
yadyutpatasi lokA.nstrInyadyAvishasi bhUtalam |
tatra tatrArjunarathaM prabhAte drakShyase.agrataH
shlokas.12:
yachchApi bhImasenasya manyase moghagarjitam |
duHshAsanasya rudhiraM pItamityavadhAryatAm
shlokas.13:
na tvAM samIkShate pArtho nApi rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
na bhImaseno na yamau pratikUlaprabhAShiNam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duryodhanasya tadvAkyaM nishamya bharatarShabhaH |
netrAbhyAmatitAmrAbhyAM kaitavyaM samudaikShata
shlokas.2:
sa keshavamabhiprekShya guDAkesho mahAyashAH |
abhyabhAShata kaitavyaM pragRRihya vipulaM bhujam
shlokas.3:
svavIryaM yaH samAshritya samAhvayati vai parAn |
abhItaH pUraya~nshaktiM sa vai puruSha uchyate
shlokas.4:
paravIryaM samAshritya yaH samAhvayate parAn |
kShatrabandhurashaktatvAlloke sa puruShAdhamaH
shlokas.5:
sa tvaM pareShAM vIryeNa manyase vIryamAtmanaH |
svayaM kApuruSho mUDhaH parA.nshcha kSheptumichChasi
shlokas.6:
yastvaM vRRiddhaM sarvarAj~nAM hitabuddhiM jitendriyam |
maraNAya mahAbuddhiM dIkShayitvA vikatthase
shlokas.7:
bhAvaste vidito.asmAbhirdurbuddhe kulapA.nsana |
na haniShyanti ga~NgeyaM pANDavA ghRRiNayeti cha
shlokas.8:
yasya vIryaM samAshritya dhArtarAShTra vikatthase |
hantAsmi prathamaM bhIShmaM miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.9:
kaitavya gatvA bharatAnsametya; suyodhanaM dhArtarAShTraM bravIhi |
tathetyAha arjunaH savyasAchI; nishAvyapAye bhavitA vimardaH
shlokas.10:
yadvo.abravIdvAkyamadInasattvo; madhye kurUNAM harShayansatyasandhaH |
ahaM hantA pANDavAnAmanIkaM; shAlveyakA.nshcheti mamaiSha bhAraH
shlokas.11:
hanyAmahaM droNamRRite hi lokaM; na te bhayaM vidyate pANDavebhyaH |
tato hi te labdhatamaM cha rAjyaM; kShayaM gatAH pANDavAshcheti bhAvaH
shlokas.12:
sa darpapUrNo na samIkShase tva;manarthamAtmanyapi vartamAnam |
tasmAdahaM te prathamaM samUhe; hantA samakShaM kuruvRRiddhameva
shlokas.13:
sUryodaye yuktasenaH pratIkShya; dhvajI rathI rakSha cha satyasandham |
ahaM hi vaH pashyatAM dvIpamenaM; rathAdbhIShmaM pAtayitAsmi bANaiH
shlokas.14:
shvobhUte katthanAvAkyaM vij~nAsyati suyodhanaH |
arditaM sharajAlena mayA dRRiShTvA pitAmaham
shlokas.15:
yaduktashcha sabhAmadhye puruSho hrasvadarshanaH |
kruddhena bhImasenena bhrAtA duHshAsanastava
shlokas.16:
adharmaj~no nityavairI pApabuddhirnRRisha.nsakRRit |
satyAM pratij~nAM nachirAdrakShyase tAM suyodhana
shlokas.17:
abhimAnasya darpasya krodhapAruShyayostathA |
naiShThuryasyAvalepasya AtmasambhAvanasya cha
shlokas.18:
nRRisha.nsatAyAstaikShNyasya dharmavidveShaNasya cha |
adharmasyAtivAdasya vRRiddhAtikramaNasya cha
shlokas.19:
darshanasya cha vakrasya kRRitsnasyApanayasya cha |
drakShyasi tvaM phalaM tIvramachireNa suyodhana
shlokas.20:
vAsudevadvitIye hi mayi kruddhe narAdhipa |
AshA te jIvite mUDha rAjye vA kena hetunA
shlokas.21:
shAnte bhIShme tathA droNe sUtaputre cha pAtite |
nirAsho jIvite rAjye putreShu cha bhaviShyasi
shlokas.22:
bhrAtR^INAM nidhanaM dRRiShTvA putrANAM cha suyodhana |
bhImasenena nihato duShkRRitAni smariShyasi
shlokas.23:
na dvitIyAM pratij~nAM hi pratij~nAsyati keshavaH |
satyaM bravImyahaM hyetatsarvaM satyaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.24:
ityuktaH kaitavo rAja.nstadvAkyamupadhArya cha |
anuj~nAto nivavRRite punareva yathAgatam
shlokas.25:
upAvRRitya tu pANDubhyaH kaitavyo dhRRitarAShTrajam |
gatvA yathoktaM tatsarvamuvAcha kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.26:
keshavArjunayorvAkyaM nishamya bharatarShabhaH |
duHshAsanaM cha karNaM cha shakuniM chAbhyabhAShata
shlokas.27:
Aj~nApayata rAj~nashcha balaM mitrabalaM tathA |
yathA prAgudayAtsarvA yuktA tiShThatyanIkinI
shlokas.28:
tataH karNasamAdiShTA dUtAH pratvaritA rathaiH |
uShTravAmIbhirapyanye sadashvaishcha mahAjavaiH
shlokas.29:
tUrNaM pariyayuH senAM kRRitsnAM karNasya shAsanAt |
Aj~nApayanto rAj~nastAnyogaH prAgudayAditi

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ulUkasya vachaH shrutvA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
senAM niryApayAmAsa dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAm
shlokas.2:
padAtinIM nAgavatIM rathinImashvavRRindinIm |
chaturvidhabalAM bhImAmakampyAM pRRithivImiva
shlokas.3:
bhImasenAdibhirguptAM sArjunaishcha mahArathaiH |
dhRRiShTadyumnavashAM durgAM sAgarastimitopamAm
shlokas.4:
tasyAstvagre maheShvAsaH pA~nchAlyo yuddhadurmadaH |
droNaprepsuranIkAni dhRRiShTadyumnaH prakarShati
shlokas.5:
yathAbalaM yathotsAhaM rathinaH samupAdishat |
arjunaM sUtaputrAya bhImaM duryodhanAya cha
shlokas.6:
ashvatthAmne cha nakulaM shaibyaM cha kRRitavarmaNe |
saindhavAya cha vArShNeyaM yuyudhAnamupAdishat
shlokas.7:
shikhaNDinaM cha bhIShmAya pramukhe samakalpayat |
sahadevaM shakunaye chekitAnaM shalAya cha
shlokas.8:
dhRRiShTaketuM cha shalyAya gautamAyottamaujasam |
draupadeyA.nshcha pa~nchabhyastrigartebhyaH samAdishat
shlokas.9:
vRRiShasenAya saubhadraM sheShANAM cha mahIkShitAm |
samarthaM taM hi mene vai pArthAdabhyadhikaM raNe
shlokas.10:
evaM vibhajya yodhA.nstAnpRRithakcha saha chaiva ha |
jvAlAvarNo maheShvAso droNama.nshamakalpayat
shlokas.11:
dhRRiShTadyumno maheShvAsaH senApatipatistataH |
vidhivadvyUhya medhAvI yuddhAya dhRRitamAnasaH
shlokas.12:
yathAdiShTAnyanIkAni pANDavAnAmayojayat |
jayAya pANDuputrANAM yattastasthau raNAjire

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
pratij~nAte phalgunena vadhe bhIShmasya sa~njaya |
kimakurvanta me mandAH putrA duryodhanAdayaH
shlokas.2:
hatameva hi pashyAmi gA~NgeyaM pitaraM raNe |
vAsudevasahAyena pArthena dRRiDhadhanvanA
shlokas.3:
sa chAparimitapraj~nastachChrutvA pArthabhAShitam |
kimuktavAnmaheShvAso bhIShmaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.4:
senApatyaM cha samprApya kauravANAM dhurandharaH |
kimacheShTata gA~Ngeyo mahAbuddhiparAkramaH
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastatsa~njayastasmai sarvameva nyavedayat |
yathoktaM kuruvRRiddhena bhIShmeNAmitatejasA
shlokas.6:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
senApatyamanuprApya bhIShmaH shAntanavo nRRipa |
duryodhanamuvAchedaM vachanaM harShayanniva
shlokas.7:
namaskRRitvA kumArAya senAnye shaktipANaye |
ahaM senApatiste.adya bhaviShyAmi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.8:
senAkarmaNyabhij~no.asmi vyUheShu vividheShu cha |
karma kArayituM chaiva bhRRitAnapyabhRRitA.nstathA
shlokas.9:
yAtrAyAneShu yuddheShu labdhaprashamaneShu cha |
bhRRishaM veda mahArAja yathA veda bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.10:
vyUhAnapi mahArambhAndaivagAndharvamAnuShAn |
tairahaM mohayiShyAmi pANDavAnvyetu te jvaraH
shlokas.11:
so.ahaM yotsyAmi tattvena pAlaya.nstava vAhinIm |
yathAvachChAstrato rAjanvyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.12:
duryodhana uvAcha||
na vidyate me gA~Ngeya bhayaM devAsureShvapi |
samasteShu mahAbAho satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.13:
kiM punastvayi durdharShe senApatye vyavasthite |
droNe cha puruShavyAghre sthite yuddhAbhinandini
shlokas.14:
bhavadbhyAM puruShAgryAbhyAM sthitAbhyAM vijayo mama |
na durlabhaM kurushreShTha devarAjyamapi dhruvam
shlokas.15:
rathasa~NkhyAM tu kArtsnyena pareShAmAtmanastathA |
tathaivAtirathAnAM cha vettumichChAmi kaurava
shlokas.16:
pitAmaho hi kushalaH pareShAmAtmanastathA |
shrotumichChAmyahaM sarvaiH sahaibhirvasudhAdhipaiH
shlokas.17:
bhIShma uvAcha||
gAndhAre shRRiNu rAjendra rathasa~NkhyAM svake bale |
ye rathAH pRRithivIpAla tathaivAtirathAshcha ye
shlokas.18:
bahUnIha sahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
rathAnAM tava senAyAM yathAmukhyaM tu me shRRiNu
shlokas.19:
bhavAnagre rathodAraH saha sarvaiH sahodaraiH |
duHshAsanaprabhRRitibhirbhrAtRRibhiH shatasaMmitaiH
shlokas.20:
sarve kRRitapraharaNAshChedyabhedyavishAradAH |
rathopasthe gajaskandhe gadAyuddhe.asicharmaNi
shlokas.21:
sa.nyantAraH prahartAraH kRRitAstrA bhArasAdhanAH |
iShvastre droNashiShyAshcha kRRipasya cha sharadvataH
shlokas.22:
ete haniShyanti raNe pA~nchAlAnyuddhadurmadAn |
kRRitakilbiShAH pANDaveyairdhArtarAShTrA manasvinaH
shlokas.23:
tato.ahaM bharatashreShTha sarvasenApatistava |
shatrUnvidhva.nsayiShyAmi kadarthIkRRitya pANDavAn
na tvAtmano guNAnvaktumarhAmi vidito.asmi te
shlokas.24:
kRRitavarmA tvatiratho bhojaH praharatAM varaH |
arthasiddhiM tava raNe kariShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.25:
astravidbhiranAdhRRiShyo dUrapAtI dRRiDhAyudhaH |
haniShyati ripU.nstubhyaM mahendro dAnavAniva
shlokas.26:
madrarAjo maheShvAsaH shalyo me.atiratho mataH |
spardhate vAsudevena yo vai nityaM raNe raNe
shlokas.27:
bhAgineyAnnijA.nstyaktvA shalyaste rathasattamaH |
eSha yotsyati sa~NgrAme kRRiShNaM chakragadAdharam
shlokas.28:
sAgarormisamairvegaiH plAvayanniva shAtravAn |
bhUrishravAH kRRitAstrashcha tava chApi hitaH suhRRit
shlokas.29:
saumadattirmaheShvAso rathayUthapayUthapaH |
balakShayamamitrANAM sumahAntaM kariShyati
shlokas.30:
sindhurAjo mahArAja mato me dviguNo rathaH |
yotsyate samare rAjanvikrAnto rathasattamaH
shlokas.31:
draupadIharaNe pUrvaM parikliShTaH sa pANDavaiH |
sa.nsmara.nstaM parikleshaM yotsyate paravIrahA
shlokas.32:
etena hi tadA rAja.nstapa AsthAya dAruNam |
sudurlabho varo labdhaH pANDavAnyoddhumAhave
shlokas.33:
sa eSha rathashArdUlastadvairaM sa.nsmaranraNe |
yotsyate pANDavA.nstAta prANA.nstyaktvA sudustyajAn

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sudakShiNastu kAmbojo ratha ekaguNo mataH |
tavArthasiddhimAkA~NkShanyotsyate samare paraiH
shlokas.2:
etasya rathasiMhasya tavArthe rAjasattama |
parAkramaM yathendrasya drakShyanti kuravo yudhi
shlokas.3:
etasya rathava.nsho hi tigmavegaprahAriNAm |
kAmbojAnAM mahArAja shalabhAnAmivAyatiH
shlokas.4:
nIlo mAhiShmatIvAsI nIlavarmadharastava |
rathava.nshena shatrUNAM kadanaM vai kariShyati
shlokas.5:
kRRitavairaH purA chaiva sahadevena pArthivaH |
yotsyate satataM rAja.nstavArthe kurusattama
shlokas.6:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau sametau rathasattamau |
kRRitinau samare tAta dRRiDhavIryaparAkramau
shlokas.7:
etau tau puruShavyAghrau ripusainyaM pradhakShyataH |
gadAprAsAsinArAchaistomaraishcha bhujachyutaiH
shlokas.8:
yuddhAbhikAmau samare krIDantAviva yUthapau |
yUthamadhye mahArAja vicharantau kRRitAntavat
shlokas.9:
trigartA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha rathodArA matA mama |
kRRitavairAshcha pArthena virATanagare tadA
shlokas.10:
makarA iva rAjendra samuddhatatara~NgiNIm |
ga~NgAM vikShobhayiShyanti pArthAnAM yudhi vAhinIm
shlokas.11:
te rathAH pa~ncha rAjendra yeShAM satyaratho mukham |
ete yotsyanti samare sa.nsmarantaH purA kRRitam
shlokas.12:
vyalIkaM pANDaveyena bhImasenAnujena ha |
disho vijayatA rAja~nshvetavAhena bhArata
shlokas.13:
te haniShyanti pArthAnAM samAsAdya mahArathAn |
varAnvarAnmaheShvAsAnkShatriyANAM dhurandharAH
shlokas.14:
lakShmaNastava putrastu tathA duHshAsanasya cha |
ubhau tau puruShavyAghrau sa~NgrAmeShvanivartinau
shlokas.15:
taruNau sukumArau cha rAjaputrau tarasvinau |
yuddhAnAM cha visheShaj~nau praNetArau cha sarvashaH
shlokas.16:
rathau tau rathashArdUla matau me rathasattamau |
kShatradharmaratau vIrau mahatkarma kariShyataH
shlokas.17:
daNDadhAro mahArAja ratha eko nararShabhaH |
yotsyate samaraM prApya svena sainyena pAlitaH
shlokas.18:
bRRihadbalastathA rAjA kausalyo rathasattamaH |
ratho mama matastAta dRRiDhavegaparAkramaH
shlokas.19:
eSha yotsyati sa~NgrAme svAM chamUM sampraharShayan |
ugrAyudho maheShvAso dhArtarAShTrahite rataH
shlokas.20:
kRRipaH shAradvato rAjanrathayUthapayUthapaH |
priyAnprANAnparityajya pradhakShyati ripU.nstava
shlokas.21:
gautamasya maharSherya AchAryasya sharadvataH |
kArttikeya ivAjeyaH sharastambAtsuto.abhavat
shlokas.22:
eSha senAM bahuvidhAM vividhAyudhakArmukAm |
agnivatsamare tAta chariShyati vimardayan

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shakunirmAtulaste.asau ratha eko narAdhipa |
prasajya pANDavairvairaM yotsyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.2:
etasya sainyA durdharShAH samare.apratiyAyinaH |
vikRRitAyudhabhUyiShThA vAyuvegasamA jave
shlokas.3:
droNaputro maheShvAsaH sarveShAmati dhanvinAm |
samare chitrayodhI cha dRRiDhAstrashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.4:
etasya hi mahArAja yathA gANDIvadhanvanaH |
sharAsanAdvinirmuktAH sa.nsaktA yAnti sAyakAH
shlokas.5:
naiSha shakyo mayA vIraH sa~NkhyAtuM rathasattamaH |
nirdahedapi lokA.nstrInichChanneSha mahAyashAH
shlokas.6:
krodhastejashcha tapasA sambhRRito.a.ashramavAsinA |
droNenAnugRRihItashcha divyairastrairudAradhIH
shlokas.7:
doShastvasya mahAneko yenaiSha bharatarShabha |
na me ratho nAtiratho mataH pArthivasattama
shlokas.8:
jIvitaM priyamatyarthamAyuShkAmaH sadA dvijaH |
na hyasya sadRRishaH kashchidubhayoH senayorapi
shlokas.9:
hanyAdekarathenaiva devAnAmapi vAhinIm |
vapuShmA.nstalaghoSheNa sphoTayedapi parvatAn
shlokas.10:
asa~NkhyeyaguNo vIraH prahartA dAruNadyutiH |
daNDapANirivAsahyaH kAlavatprachariShyati
shlokas.11:
yugAntAgnisamaH krodhe siMhagrIvo mahAmatiH |
eSha bhArata yuddhasya pRRiShThaM sa.nshamayiShyati
shlokas.12:
pitA tvasya mahAtejA vRRiddho.api yuvabhirvaraH |
raNe karma mahatkartA tatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
astravegAniloddhUtaH senAkakShendhanotthitaH |
pANDuputrasya sainyAni pradhakShyati jaye dhRRitaH
shlokas.14:
rathayUthapayUthAnAM yUthapaH sa nararShabhaH |
bhAradvAjAtmajaH kartA karma tIvraM hitAya vaH
shlokas.15:
sarvamUrdhAbhiShiktAnAmAchAryaH sthaviro guruH |
gachChedantaM sRRi~njayAnAM priyastvasya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.16:
naiSha jAtu maheShvAsaH pArthamakliShTakAriNam |
hanyAdAchAryakaM dIptaM sa.nsmRRitya guNanirjitam
shlokas.17:
shlAghatyeSha sadA vIraH pArthasya guNavistaraiH |
putrAdabhyadhikaM chaiva bhAradvAjo.anupashyati
shlokas.18:
hanyAdekarathenaiva devagandharvadAnavAn |
ekIbhUtAnapi raNe divyairastraiH pratApavAn
shlokas.19:
pauravo rAjashArdUlastava rAjanmahArathaH |
mato mama ratho vIra paravIrarathArujaH
shlokas.20:
svena sainyena sahitaH pratapa~nshatruvAhinIm |
pradhakShyati sa pA~nchAlAnkakShaM kRRiShNagatiryathA
shlokas.21:
satyavrato rathavaro rAjaputro mahArathaH |
tava rAjanripubale kAlavatprachariShyati
shlokas.22:
etasya yodhA rAjendra vichitrakavachAyudhAH |
vichariShyanti sa~NgrAme nighnantaH shAtravA.nstava
shlokas.23:
vRRiShaseno rathAgryaste karNaputro mahArathaH |
pradhakShyati ripUNAM te balAni balinAM varaH
shlokas.24:
jalasandho mahAtejA rAjanrathavarastava |
tyakShyate samare prANAnmAgadhaH paravIrahA
shlokas.25:
eSha yotsyati sa~NgrAme gajaskandhavishAradaH |
rathena vA mahAbAhuH kShapaya~nshatruvAhinIm
shlokas.26:
ratha eSha mahArAja mato mama nararShabhaH |
tvadarthe tyakShyati prANAnsaha sainyo mahAraNe
shlokas.27:
eSha vikrAntayodhI cha chitrayodhI cha sa~Ngare |
vItabhIshchApi te rAja~nshAtravaiH saha yotsyate
shlokas.28:
bAhlIko.atirathashchaiva samare chAnivartitA |
mama rAjanmato yuddhe shUro vaivasvatopamaH
shlokas.29:
na hyeSha samaraM prApya nivarteta katha~nchana |
yathA satatago rAjannAbhihatya parAnraNe
shlokas.30:
senApatirmahArAja satyavA.nste mahArathaH |
raNeShvadbhutakarmA cha rathaH pararathArujaH
shlokas.31:
etasya samaraM dRRiShTvA na vyathAsti katha~nchana |
utsmayannabhyupaityeSha parAnrathapathe sthitAn
shlokas.32:
eSha chAriShu vikrAntaH karma satpuruShochitam |
kartA vimarde sumahattvadarthe puruShottamaH
shlokas.33:
alAyudho rAkShasendraH krUrakarmA mahAbalaH |
haniShyati parAnrAjanpUrvavairamanusmaran
shlokas.34:
eSha rAkShasasainyAnAM sarveShAM rathasattamaH |
mAyAvI dRRiDhavairashcha samare vichariShyati
shlokas.35:
prAgjyotiShAdhipo vIro bhagadattaH pratApavAn |
gajA~NkushadharashreShTho rathe chaiva vishAradaH
shlokas.36:
etena yuddhamabhavatpurA gANDIvadhanvanaH |
divasAnsubahUnrAjannubhayorjayagRRiddhinoH
shlokas.37:
tataH sakhAyaM gAndhAre mAnayanpAkashAsanam |
akarotsa.nvidaM tena pANDavena mahAtmanA
shlokas.38:
eSha yotsyati sa~NgrAme gajaskandhavishAradaH |
airAvatagato rAjA devAnAmiva vAsavaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
achalo vRRiShakashchaiva bhrAtarau sahitAvubhau |
rathau tava durAdharShau shatrUnvidhva.nsayiShyataH
shlokas.2:
balavantau naravyAghrau dRRiDhakrodhau prahAriNau |
gAndhAramukhyau taruNau darshanIyau mahAbalau
shlokas.3:
sakhA te dayito nityaM ya eSha raNakarkashaH |
protsAhayati rAja.nstvAM vigrahe pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.4:
paruShaH katthano nIchaH karNo vaikartanastava |
mantrI netA cha bandhushcha mAnI chAtyantamuchChritaH
shlokas.5:
eSha naiva rathaH pUrNo nApyevAtiratho nRRipa |
viyuktaH kavachenaiSha sahajena vichetanaH
kuNDalAbhyAM cha divyAbhyAM viyuktaH satataM ghRRiNI
shlokas.6:
abhishApAchcha rAmasya brAhmaNasya cha bhAShaNAt |
karaNAnAM viyogAchcha tena me.ardharatho mataH
naiSha phalgunamAsAdya punarjIvanvimokShyate
shlokas.7:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato.abravInmahAbAhurdroNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
evametadyathAttha tvaM na mithyAstIti ki~nchana
shlokas.8:
raNe raNe.atimAnI cha vimukhashchaiva dRRishyate |
ghRRiNI karNaH pramAdI cha tena me.ardharatho mataH
shlokas.9:
etachChrutvA tu rAdheyaH krodhAdutphullalochanaH |
uvAcha bhIShmaM rAjendra tudanvAgbhiH pratodavat
shlokas.10:
pitAmaha yatheShTaM mAM vAkSharairupakRRintasi |
anAgasaM sadA dveShAdevameva pade pade
marShayAmi cha tatsarvaM duryodhanakRRitena vai
shlokas.11:
tvaM tu mAM manyase.ashaktaM yathA kApuruShaM tathA |
bhavAnardharatho mahyaM mato nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.12:
sarvasya jagatashchaiva gA~Ngeya na mRRiShA vade |
kurUNAmahito nityaM na cha rAjAvabudhyate
shlokas.13:
ko hi nAma samAneShu rAjasUdAttakarmasu |
tejovadhamimaM kuryAdvibhedayiShurAhave
yathA tvaM guNanirdeshAdaparAdhaM chikIrShasi
shlokas.14:
na hAyanairna palitairna vittairna cha bandhubhiH |
mahArathatvaM sa~NkhyAtuM shakyaM kShatrasya kaurava
shlokas.15:
balajyeShThaM smRRitaM kShatraM mantrajyeShThA dvijAtayaH |
dhanajyeShThAH smRRitA vaishyAH shUdrAstu vayasAdhikAH
shlokas.16:
yathechChakaM svaya~NgrAhAdrathAnatirathA.nstathA |
kAmadveShasamAyukto mohAtprakurute bhavAn
shlokas.17:
duryodhana mahAbAho sAdhu samyagavekShyatAm |
tyajyatAM duShTabhAvo.ayaM bhIShmaH kilbiShakRRittava
shlokas.18:
bhinnA hi senA nRRipate duHsandheyA bhavatyuta |
maulApi puruShavyAghra kimu nAnA samutthitA
shlokas.19:
eShAM dvaidhaM samutpannaM yodhAnAM yudhi bhArata |
tejovadho naH kriyate pratyakSheNa visheShataH
shlokas.20:
rathAnAM kva cha vij~nAnaM kva cha bhIShmo.alpachetanaH |
ahamAvArayiShyAmi pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.21:
AsAdya mAmamogheShuM gamiShyanti disho dasha |
pANDavAH sahapa~nchAlAH shArdUlaM vRRiShabhA iva
shlokas.22:
kva cha yuddhavimardo vA mantrAH suvyAhRRitAni vA |
kva cha bhIShmo gatavayA mandAtmA kAlamohitaH
shlokas.23:
spardhate hi sadA nityaM sarveNa jagatA saha |
na chAnyaM puruShaM ka~nchinmanyate moghadarshanaH
shlokas.24:
shrotavyaM khalu vRRiddhAnAmiti shAstranidarshanam |
na tvevApyativRRiddhAnAM punarbAlA hi te matAH
shlokas.25:
ahameko haniShyAmi pANDavAnnAtra sa.nshayaH |
suyuddhe rAjashArdUla yasho bhIShmaM gamiShyati
shlokas.26:
kRRitaH senApatistveSha tvayA bhIShmo narAdhipa |
senApatiM guNo gantA na tu yodhAnkatha~nchana
shlokas.27:
nAhaM jIvati gA~Ngeye yotsye rAjankatha~nchana |
hate tu bhIShme yodhAsmi sarvaireva mahArathaiH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
samudyato.ayaM bhAro me sumahAnsAgaropamaH |
dhArtarAShTrasya sa~NgrAme varShapUgAbhichintitaH
shlokas.2:
tasminnabhyAgate kAle pratapte lomaharShaNe |
mithobhedo na me kAryastena jIvasi sUtaja
shlokas.3:
na hyahaM nAdya vikramya sthaviro.api shishostava |
yuddhashraddhAM raNe ChindyAM jIvitasya cha sUtaja
shlokas.4:
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa mahAstrANi pramu~nchatA |
na me vyathAbhavatkAchittvaM tu me kiM kariShyasi
shlokas.5:
kAmaM naitatprasha.nsanti santo.a.atmabalasa.nstavam |
vakShyAmi tu tvAM santapto nihIna kulapA.nsana
shlokas.6:
sametaM pArthivaM kShatraM kAshirAj~naH svaya.nvare |
nirjityaikarathenaiva yatkanyAstarasA hRRitAH
shlokas.7:
IdRRishAnAM sahasrANi vishiShTAnAmatho punaH |
mayaikena nirastAni sasainyAni raNAjire
shlokas.8:
tvAM prApya vairapuruShaM kurUNAmanayo mahAn |
upasthito vinAshAya yatasva puruSho bhava
shlokas.9:
yudhyasva pArthaM samare yena vispardhase saha |
drakShyAmi tvAM vinirmuktamasmAdyuddhAtsudurmate
shlokas.10:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tamuvAcha tato rAjA dhArtarAShTro mahAmanAH |
mAmavekShasva gA~Ngeya kAryaM hi mahadudyatam
shlokas.11:
chintyatAmidamevAgre mama niHshreyasaM param |
ubhAvapi bhavantau me mahatkarma kariShyataH
shlokas.12:
bhUyashcha shrotumichChAmi pareShAM rathasattamAn |
ye chaivAtirathAstatra tathaiva rathayUthapAH
shlokas.13:
balAbalamamitrANAM shrotumichChAmi kaurava |
prabhAtAyAM rajanyAM vai idaM yuddhaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ete rathAste sa~NkhyAtAstathaivAtirathA nRRipa |
ya chApyardharathA rAjanpANDavAnAmataH shRRiNu
shlokas.15:
yadi kautUhalaM te.adya pANDavAnAM bale nRRipa |
rathasa~NkhyAM mahAbAho sahaibhirvasudhAdhipaiH
shlokas.16:
svayaM rAjA rathodAraH pANDavaH kuntinandanaH |
agnivatsamare tAta chariShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.17:
bhImasenastu rAjendra ratho.aShTaguNasaMmitaH |
nAgAyutabalo mAnI tejasA na sa mAnuShaH
shlokas.18:
mAdrIputrau tu rathinau dvAveva puruSharShabhau |
ashvinAviva rUpeNa tejasA cha samanvitau
shlokas.19:
ete chamUmukhagatAH smarantaH kleshamAtmanaH |
rudravatprachariShyanti tatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.20:
sarva eva mahAtmAnaH shAlaskandhA ivodgatAH |
prAdeshenAdhikAH pumbhiranyaiste cha pramANataH
shlokas.21:
siMhasaMhananAH sarve pANDuputrA mahAbalAH |
charitabrahmacharyAshcha sarve chAtitapasvinaH
shlokas.22:
hrImantaH puruShavyAghrA vyAghrA iva balotkaTAH |
jave prahAre saMmarde sarva evAtimAnuShAH
sarve jitamahIpAlA digjaye bharatarShabha
shlokas.23:
na chaiShAM puruShAH kechidAyudhAni gadAH sharAn |
viShahanti sadA kartumadhijyAnyapi kaurava
udyantuM vA gadAM gurvIM sharAnvApi prakarShitum
shlokas.24:
jave lakShyasya haraNe bhojye pA.nsuvikarShaNe |
bAlairapi bhavantastaiH sarva eva visheShitAH
shlokas.25:
te te sainyaM samAsAdya vyAghrA iva balotkaTAH |
vidhva.nsayiShyanti raNe mA sma taiH saha sa~NgamaH
shlokas.26:
ekaikashaste sa~NgrAme hanyuH sarvAnmahIkShitaH |
pratyakShaM tava rAjendra rAjasUye yathAbhavat
shlokas.27:
draupadyAshcha parikleshaM dyUte cha paruShA giraH |
te sa.nsmarantaH sa~NgrAme vichariShyanti kAlavat
shlokas.28:
lohitAkSho guDAkesho nArAyaNasahAyavAn |
ubhayoH senayorvIra ratho nAstIha tAdRRishaH
shlokas.29:
na hi deveShu vA pUrvaM dAnaveShUrageShu vA |
rAkShaseShvatha yakSheShu nareShu kuta eva tu
shlokas.30:
bhUto.atha vA bhaviShyo vA rathaH kashchinmayA shrutaH |
samAyukto mahArAja yathA pArthasya dhImataH
shlokas.31:
vAsudevashcha sa.nyantA yoddhA chaiva dhana~njayaH |
gANDIvaM cha dhanurdivyaM te chAshvA vAtaraMhasaH
shlokas.32:
abhedyaM kavachaM divyamakShayyau cha maheShudhI |
astragrAmashcha mAhendro raudraH kaubera eva cha
shlokas.33:
yAmyashcha vAruNashchaiva gadAshchograpradarshanAH |
vajrAdIni cha mukhyAni nAnApraharaNAni vai
shlokas.34:
dAnavAnAM sahasrANi hiraNyapuravAsinAm |
hatAnyekarathenAjau kastasya sadRRisho rathaH
shlokas.35:
eSha hanyAddhi sa.nrambhI balavAnsatyavikramaH |
tava senAM mahAbAhuH svAM chaiva paripAlayan
shlokas.36:
ahaM chainaM pratyudiyAmAchAryo vA dhana~njayam |
na tRRitIyo.asti rAjendra senayorubhayorapi
ya enaM sharavarShANi varShantamudiyAdrathI
shlokas.37:
jImUta iva gharmAnte mahAvAtasamIritaH |
samAyuktastu kaunteyo vAsudevasahAyavAn
taruNashcha kRRitI chaiva jIrNAvAvAmubhAvapi
shlokas.38:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu bhIShmasya rAj~nAM dadhva.nsire tadA |
kA~nchanA~NgadinaH pInA bhujAshchandanarUShitAH
shlokas.39:
manobhiH saha sAvegaiH sa.nsmRRitya cha purAtanam |
sAmarthyaM pANDaveyAnAM yathApratyakShadarshanAt

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
draupadeyA mahArAja sarve pa~ncha mahArathAH |
vairATiruttarashchaiva ratho mama mahAnmataH
shlokas.2:
abhimanyurmahArAja rathayUthapayUthapaH |
samaH pArthena samare vAsudevena vA bhavet
shlokas.3:
laghvastrashchitrayodhI cha manasvI dRRiDhavikramaH |
sa.nsmaranvai parikleshaM svapiturvikramiShyati
shlokas.4:
sAtyakirmAdhavaH shUro rathayUthapayUthapaH |
eSha vRRiShNipravIrANAmamarShI jitasAdhvasaH
shlokas.5:
uttamaujAstathA rAjanratho mama mahAnmataH |
yudhAmanyushcha vikrAnto rathodAro nararShabhaH
shlokas.6:
eteShAM bahusAhasrA rathA nAgA hayAstathA |
yotsyante te tanuM tyaktvA kuntIputrapriyepsayA
shlokas.7:
pANDavaiH saha rAjendra tava senAsu bhArata |
agnimArutavadrAjannAhvayantaH parasparam
shlokas.8:
ajeyau samare vRRiddhau virATadrupadAvubhau |
mahArathau mahAvIryau matau me puruSharShabhau
shlokas.9:
vayovRRiddhAvapi tu tau kShatradharmaparAyaNau |
yatiShyete paraM shaktyA sthitau vIragate pathi
shlokas.10:
sambandhakena rAjendra tau tu vIryabalAnvayAt |
AryavRRittau maheShvAsau snehapAshasitAvubhau
shlokas.11:
kAraNaM prApya tu narAH sarva eva mahAbhujAH |
shUrA vA kAtarA vApi bhavanti narapu~Ngava
shlokas.12:
ekAyanagatAvetau pArthena dRRiDhabhaktikau |
tyaktvA prANAnparaM shaktyA ghaTitArau narAdhipa
shlokas.13:
pRRithagakShauhiNIbhyAM tAvubhau sa.nyati dAruNau |
sambandhibhAvaM rakShantau mahatkarma kariShyataH
shlokas.14:
lokavIrau maheShvAsau tyaktAtmAnau cha bhArata |
pratyayaM parirakShantau mahatkarma kariShyataH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
pA~nchAlarAjasya suto rAjanparapura~njayaH |
shikhaNDI rathamukhyo me mataH pArthasya bhArata
shlokas.2:
eSha yotsyati sa~NgrAme nAshayanpUrvasa.nsthitim |
paraM yasho viprathaya.nstava senAsu bhArata
shlokas.3:
etasya bahulAH senAH pA~nchAlAshcha prabhadrakAH |
tenAsau rathava.nshena mahatkarma kariShyati
shlokas.4:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha senAnIH sarvasenAsu bhArata |
mato me.atiratho rAjandroNashiShyo mahArathaH
shlokas.5:
eSha yotsyati sa~NgrAme sUdayanvai parAnraNe |
bhagavAniva sa~NkruddhaH pinAkI yugasa~NkShaye
shlokas.6:
etasya tadrathAnIkaM kathayanti raNapriyAH |
bahutvAtsAgaraprakhyaM devAnAmiva sa.nyuge
shlokas.7:
kShatradharmA tu rAjendra mato me.ardharatho nRRipa |
dhRRiShTadyumnasya tanayo bAlyAnnAtikRRitashramaH
shlokas.8:
shishupAlasuto vIrashchedirAjo mahArathaH |
dhRRiShTaketurmaheShvAsaH sambandhI pANDavasya ha
shlokas.9:
eSha chedipatiH shUraH saha putreNa bhArata |
mahArathenAsukaraM mahatkarma kariShyati
shlokas.10:
kShatradharmarato mahyaM mataH parapura~njayaH |
kShatradevastu rAjendra pANDaveShu rathottamaH
jayantashchAmitaujAshcha satyajichcha mahArathaH
shlokas.11:
mahArathA mahAtmAnaH sarve pA~nchAlasattamAH |
yotsyante samare tAta sa.nrabdhA iva ku~njarAH
shlokas.12:
ajo bhojashcha vikrAntau pANDaveShu mahArathau |
pANDavAnAM sahAyArthe paraM shaktyA yatiShyataH
shIghrAstrau chitrayoddhArau kRRitinau dRRiDhavikramau
shlokas.13:
kekayAH pa~ncha rAjendra bhrAtaro yuddhadurmadAH |
sarva ete rathodArAH sarve lohitakadhvajAH
shlokas.14:
kAshikaH sukumArashcha nIlo yashchAparo nRRipaH |
sUryadattashcha sha~Nkhashcha madirAshvashcha nAmataH
shlokas.15:
sarva ete rathodArAH sarve chAhavalakShaNAH |
sarvAstraviduShaH sarve mahAtmAno matA mama
shlokas.16:
vArdhakShemirmahArAja ratho mama mahAnmataH |
chitrAyudhashcha nRRipatirmato me rathasattamaH
sa hi sa~NgrAmashobhI cha bhaktashchApi kirITinaH
shlokas.17:
chekitAnaH satyadhRRitiH pANDavAnAM mahArathau |
dvAvimau puruShavyAghrau rathodArau matau mama
shlokas.18:
vyAghradattashcha rAjendra chandrasenashcha bhArata |
matau mama rathodArau pANDavAnAM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.19:
senAbindushcha rAjendra krodhahantA cha nAmataH |
yaH samo vAsudevena bhImasenena chAbhibhUH
sa yotsyatIha vikramya samare tava sainikaiH
shlokas.20:
mAM droNaM cha kRRipaM chaiva yathA saMmanyate bhavAn |
tathA sa samarashlAghI mantavyo rathasattamaH
shlokas.21:
kAshyaH paramashIghrAstraH shlAghanIyo rathottamaH |
ratha ekaguNo mahyaM mataH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.22:
ayaM cha yudhi vikrAnto mantavyo.aShTaguNo rathaH |
satyajitsamarashlAghI drupadasyAtmajo yuvA
shlokas.23:
gataH so.atirathatvaM hi dhRRiShTadyumnena saMmitaH |
pANDavAnAM yashaskAmaH paraM karma kariShyati
shlokas.24:
anuraktashcha shUrashcha ratho.ayamaparo mahAn |
pANDyarAjo mahAvIryaH pANDavAnAM dhurandharaH
shlokas.25:
dRRiDhadhanvA maheShvAsaH pANDavAnAM rathottamaH |
shreNimAnkauravashreShTha vasudAnashcha pArthivaH
ubhAvetAvatirathau matau mama parantapa

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rochamAno mahArAja pANDavAnAM mahArathaH |
yotsyate.amaravatsa~Nkhye parasainyeShu bhArata
shlokas.2:
purujitkuntibhojashcha maheShvAso mahAbalaH |
mAtulo bhImasenasya sa cha me.atiratho mataH
shlokas.3:
eSha vIro maheShvAsaH kRRitI cha nipuNashcha ha |
chitrayodhI cha shaktashcha mato me rathapu~NgavaH
shlokas.4:
sa yotsyati hi vikramya maghavAniva dAnavaiH |
yodhAshchAsya parikhyAtAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH
shlokas.5:
bhAgineyakRRite vIraH sa kariShyati sa~Ngare |
sumahatkarma pANDUnAM sthitaH priyahite nRRipaH
shlokas.6:
bhaimasenirmahArAja haiDimbo rAkShaseshvaraH |
mato me bahumAyAvI rathayUthapayUthapaH
shlokas.7:
yotsyate samare tAta mAyAbhiH samarapriyaH |
ye chAsya rAkShasAH shUrAH sachivA vashavartinaH
shlokas.8:
ete chAnye cha bahavo nAnAjanapadeshvarAH |
sametAH pANDavasyArthe vAsudevapurogamAH
shlokas.9:
ete prAdhAnyato rAjanpANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
rathAshchAtirathAshchaiva ye chApyardharathA matAH
shlokas.10:
neShyanti samare senAM bhImAM yaudhiShThirIM nRRipa |
mahendreNeva vIreNa pAlyamAnAM kirITinA
shlokas.11:
tairahaM samare vIra tvAmAyadbhirjayaiShibhiH |
yotsyAmi jayamAkA~NkShannatha vA nidhanaM raNe
shlokas.12:
pArthaM cha vAsudevaM cha chakragANDIvadhAriNau |
sandhyAgatAvivArkendU sameShye puruShottamau
shlokas.13:
ye chaiva te rathodArAH pANDuputrasya sainikAH |
sahasainyAnahaM tA.nshcha pratIyAM raNamUrdhani
shlokas.14:
ete rathAshchAtirathAshcha tubhyaM; yathApradhAnaM nRRipa kIrtitA mayA |
tathA rAjannardharathAshcha ke chi;ttathaiva teShAmapi kauravendra
shlokas.15:
arjunaM vAsudevaM cha ye chAnye tatra pArthivAH |
sarvAnAvArayiShyAmi yAvaddrakShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.16:
pA~nchAlyaM tu mahAbAho nAhaM hanyAM shikhaNDinam |
udyateShumabhiprekShya pratiyudhyantamAhave
shlokas.17:
lokastadveda yadahaM pituH priyachikIrShayA |
prAptaM rAjyaM parityajya brahmacharye dhRRitavrataH
shlokas.18:
chitrA~NgadaM kauravANAmahaM rAjye.abhyaShechayam |
vichitravIryaM cha shishuM yauvarAjye.abhyaShechayam
shlokas.19:
devavratatvaM vikhyApya pRRithivyAM sarvarAjasu |
naiva hanyAM striyaM jAtu na strIpUrvaM katha~nchana
shlokas.20:
sa hi strIpUrvako rAja~nshikhaNDI yadi te shrutaH |
kanyA bhUtvA pumA~njAto na yotsye tena bhArata
shlokas.21:
sarvA.nstvanyAnhaniShyAmi pArthivAnbharatarShabha |
yAnsameShyAmi samare na tu kuntIsutAnnRRipa

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
kimarthaM bharatashreShTha na hanyAstvaM shikhaNDinam |
udyateShumatho dRRiShTvA samareShvAtatAyinam
shlokas.2:
pUrvamuktvA mahAbAho pANDavAnsaha somakaiH |
vadhiShyAmIti gA~Ngeya tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu duryodhana kathAM sahaibhirvasudhAdhipaiH |
yadarthaM yudhi samprekShya nAhaM hanyAM shikhaNDinam
shlokas.4:
mahArAjo mama pitA shantanurbharatarShabhaH |
diShTAntaM prApa dharmAtmA samaye puruSharShabha
shlokas.5:
tato.ahaM bharatashreShTha pratij~nAM paripAlayan |
chitrA~NgadaM bhrAtaraM vai mahArAjye.abhyaShechayam
shlokas.6:
tasmi.nshcha nidhanaM prApte satyavatyA mate sthitaH |
vichitravIryaM rAjAnamabhyaShi~nchaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.7:
mayAbhiShikto rAjendra yavIyAnapi dharmataH |
vichitravIryo dharmAtmA mAmeva samudaikShata
shlokas.8:
tasya dArakriyAM tAta chikIrShurahamapyuta |
anurUpAdiva kulAditi chintya mano dadhe
shlokas.9:
tathAshrauShaM mahAbAho tisraH kanyAH svaya.nvare |
rUpeNApratimAH sarvAH kAshirAjasutAstadA
ambA chaivAmbikA chaiva tathaivAmbAlikAparA
shlokas.10:
rAjAnashcha samAhUtAH pRRithivyAM bharatarShabha |
ambA jyeShThAbhavattAsAmambikA tvatha madhyamA
ambAlikA cha rAjendra rAjakanyA yavIyasI
shlokas.11:
so.ahamekarathenaiva gataH kAshipateH purIm |
apashyaM tA mahAbAho tisraH kanyAH svala~NkRRitAH
rAj~nashchaiva samAvRRittAnpArthivAnpRRithivIpate
shlokas.12:
tato.ahaM tAnnRRipAnsarvAnAhUya samare sthitAn |
rathamAropayAM chakre kanyAstA bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
vIryashulkAshcha tA j~nAtvA samAropya rathaM tadA |
avochaM pArthivAnsarvAnahaM tatra samAgatAn
bhIShmaH shAntanavaH kanyA haratIti punaH punaH
shlokas.14:
te yatadhvaM paraM shaktyA sarve mokShAya pArthivAH |
prasahya hi nayAmyeSha miShatAM vo narAdhipAH
shlokas.15:
tataste pRRithivIpAlAH samutpeturudAyudhAH |
yogo yoga iti kruddhAH sArathI.nshchApyachodayan
shlokas.16:
te rathairmeghasa~NkAshairgajaishcha gajayodhinaH |
pRRiShThyaishchAshvairmahIpAlAH samutpeturudAyudhAH
shlokas.17:
tataste mAM mahIpAlAH sarva eva vishAM pate |
rathavrAtena mahatA sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.18:
tAnahaM sharavarSheNa mahatA pratyavArayam |
sarvAnnRRipA.nshchApyajayaM devarADiva dAnavAn
shlokas.19:
teShAmApatatAM chitrAndhvajAnhemapariShkRRitAn |
ekaikena hi bANena bhUmau pAtitavAnaham
shlokas.20:
hayA.nshchaiShAM gajA.nshchaiva sArathI.nshchApyahaM raNe |
apAtayaM sharairdIptaiH prahasanpuruSharShabha
shlokas.21:
te nivRRittAshcha bhagnAshcha dRRiShTvA tallAghavaM mama |
athAhaM hAstinapuramAyAM jitvA mahIkShitaH
shlokas.22:
ato.ahaM tAshcha kanyA vai bhrAturarthAya bhArata |
tachcha karma mahAbAho satyavatyai nyavedayam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato.ahaM bharatashreShTha mAtaraM vIramAtaram |
abhigamyopasa~NgRRihya dAsheyImidamabruvam
shlokas.2:
imAH kAshipateH kanyA mayA nirjitya pArthivAn |
vichitravIryasya kRRite vIryashulkA upArjitAH
shlokas.3:
tato mUrdhanyupAghrAya paryashrunayanA nRRipa |
Aha satyavatI hRRiShTA diShTyA putra jitaM tvayA
shlokas.4:
satyavatyAstvanumate vivAhe samupasthite |
uvAcha vAkyaM savrIDA jyeShThA kAshipateH sutA
shlokas.5:
bhIShma tvamasi dharmaj~naH sarvashAstravishAradaH |
shrutvA cha dharmyaM vachanaM mahyaM kartumihArhasi
shlokas.6:
mayA shAlvapatiH pUrvaM manasAbhivRRito varaH |
tena chAsmi vRRitA pUrvaM rahasyavidite pituH
shlokas.7:
kathaM mAmanyakAmAM tvaM rAja~nshAstramadhItya vai |
vAsayethA gRRihe bhIShma kauravaH sanvisheShataH
shlokas.8:
etadbuddhyA vinishchitya manasA bharatarShabha |
yatkShamaM te mahAbAho tadihArabdhumarhasi
shlokas.9:
sa mAM pratIkShate vyaktaM shAlvarAjo vishAM pate |
kRRipAM kuru mahAbAho mayi dharmabhRRitAM vara
tvaM hi satyavrato vIra pRRithivyAmiti naH shrutam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato.ahaM samanuj~nApya kAlIM satyavatIM tadA |
mantriNashcha dvijA.nshchaiva tathaiva cha purohitAn
samanuj~nAsiShaM kanyAM jyeShThAmambAM narAdhipa
shlokas.2:
anuj~nAtA yayau sA tu kanyA shAlvapateH puram |
vRRiddhairdvijAtibhirguptA dhAtryA chAnugatA tadA
atItya cha tamadhvAnamAsasAda narAdhipam
shlokas.3:
sA tamAsAdya rAjAnaM shAlvaM vachanamabravIt |
AgatAhaM mahAbAho tvAmuddishya mahAdyute
shlokas.4:
tAmabravIchChAlvapatiH smayanniva vishAM pate |
tvayAnyapUrvayA nAhaM bhAryArthI varavarNini
shlokas.5:
gachCha bhadre punastatra sakAshaM bhAratasya vai |
nAhamichChAmi bhIShmeNa gRRihItAM tvAM prasahya vai
shlokas.6:
tvaM hi nirjitya bhIShmeNa nItA prItimatI tadA |
parAmRRishya mahAyuddhe nirjitya pRRithivIpatIn
nAhaM tvayyanyapUrvAyAM bhAryArthI varavarNini
shlokas.7:
kathamasmadvidho rAjA parapUrvAM praveshayet |
nArIM viditavij~nAnaH pareShAM dharmamAdishan
yatheShTaM gamyatAM bhadre mA te kAlo.atyagAdayam
shlokas.8:
ambA tamabravIdrAjannana~NgasharapIDitA |
maivaM vada mahIpAla naitadevaM katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
nAsmi prItimatI nItA bhIShmeNAmitrakarshana |
balAnnItAsmi rudatI vidrAvya pRRithivIpatIn
shlokas.10:
bhajasva mAM shAlvapate bhaktAM bAlAmanAgasam |
bhaktAnAM hi parityAgo na dharmeShu prashasyate
shlokas.11:
sAhamAmantrya gA~NgeyaM samareShvanivartinam |
anuj~nAtA cha tenaiva tavaiva gRRihamAgatA
shlokas.12:
na sa bhIShmo mahAbAhurmAmichChati vishAM pate |
bhrAtRRihetoH samArambho bhIShmasyeti shrutaM mayA
shlokas.13:
bhaginyau mama ye nIte ambikAmbAlike nRRipa |
prAdAdvichitravIryAya gA~Ngeyo hi yavIyase
shlokas.14:
yathA shAlvapate nAnyaM naraM dhyAmi katha~nchana |
tvAmRRite puruShavyAghra tathA mUrdhAnamAlabhe
shlokas.15:
na chAnyapUrvA rAjendra tvAmahaM samupasthitA |
satyaM bravImi shAlvaitatsatyenAtmAnamAlabhe
shlokas.16:
bhajasva mAM vishAlAkSha svayaM kanyAmupasthitAm |
ananyapUrvAM rAjendra tvatprasAdAbhikA~NkShiNIm
shlokas.17:
tAmevaM bhAShamANAM tu shAlvaH kAshipateH sutAm |
atyajadbharatashreShTha tvachaM jIrNAmivoragaH
shlokas.18:
evaM bahuvidhairvAkyairyAchyamAnastayAnagha |
nAshraddadhachChAlvapatiH kanyAyA bharatarShabha
shlokas.19:
tataH sA manyunAviShTA jyeShThA kAshipateH sutA |
abravItsAshrunayanA bAShpavihvalayA girA
shlokas.20:
tvayA tyaktA gamiShyAmi yatra yatra vishAM pate |
tatra me santu gatayaH santaH satyaM yathAbruvam
shlokas.21:
evaM sambhAShamANAM tu nRRisha.nsaH shAlvarATtadA |
paryatyajata kauravya karuNaM paridevatIm
shlokas.22:
gachCha gachCheti tAM shAlvaH punaH punarabhAShata |
bibhemi bhIShmAtsushroNi tvaM cha bhIShmaparigrahaH
shlokas.23:
evamuktA tu sA tena shAlvenAdIrghadarshinA |
nishchakrAma purAddInA rudatI kurarI yathA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sA niShkramantI nagarAchchintayAmAsa bhArata |
pRRithivyAM nAsti yuvatirviShamasthatarA mayA
bAndhavairviprahInAsmi shAlvena cha nirAkRRitA
shlokas.2:
na cha shakyaM punargantuM mayA vAraNasAhvayam |
anuj~nAtAsmi bhIShmeNa shAlvamuddishya kAraNam
shlokas.3:
kiM nu garhAmyathAtmAnamatha bhIShmaM durAsadam |
Aho svitpitaraM mUDhaM yo me.akArShItsvaya.nvaram
shlokas.4:
mamAyaM svakRRito doSho yAhaM bhIShmarathAttadA |
pravRRitte vaishase yuddhe shAlvArthaM nApataM purA
tasyeyaM phalanirvRRittiryadApannAsmi mUDhavat
shlokas.5:
dhigbhIShmaM dhikcha me mandaM pitaraM mUDhachetasam |
yenAhaM vIryashulkena paNyastrIvatpraveritA
shlokas.6:
dhi~NmAM dhikShAlvarAjAnaM dhigdhAtAramathApi cha |
yeShAM durnItabhAvena prAptAsmyApadamuttamAm
shlokas.7:
sarvathA bhAgadheyAni svAni prApnoti mAnavaH |
anayasyAsya tu mukhaM bhIShmaH shAntanavo mama
shlokas.8:
sA bhIShme pratikartavyamahaM pashyAmi sAmpratam |
tapasA vA yudhA vApi duHkhahetuH sa me mataH
ko nu bhIShmaM yudhA jetumutsaheta mahIpatiH
shlokas.9:
evaM sA parinishchitya jagAma nagarAdbahiH |
AshramaM puNyashIlAnAM tApasAnAM mahAtmanAm
tatastAmavasadrAtriM tApasaiH parivAritA
shlokas.10:
Achakhyau cha yathA vRRittaM sarvamAtmani bhArata |
vistareNa mahAbAho nikhilena shuchismitA
haraNaM cha visargaM cha shAlvena cha visarjanam
shlokas.11:
tatastatra mahAnAsIdbrAhmaNaH sa.nshitavrataH |
shaikhAvatyastapovRRiddhaH shAstre chAraNyake guruH
shlokas.12:
ArtAM tAmAha sa muniH shaikhAvatyo mahAtapAH |
niHshvasantIM satIM bAlAM duHkhashokaparAyaNAm
shlokas.13:
evaM gate kiM nu bhadre shakyaM kartuM tapasvibhiH |
AshramasthairmahAbhAgaistaponityairmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.14:
sA tvenamabravIdrAjankriyatAM madanugrahaH |
pravrAjitumihechChAmi tapastapsyAmi dushcharam
shlokas.15:
mayaivaitAni karmANi pUrvadeheShu mUDhayA |
kRRitAni nUnaM pApAni teShAmetatphalaM dhruvam
shlokas.16:
notsaheyaM punargantuM svajanaM prati tApasAH |
pratyAkhyAtA nirAnandA shAlvena cha nirAkRRitA
shlokas.17:
upadiShTamihechChAmi tApasyaM vItakalmaShAH |
yuShmAbhirdevasa~NkAshAH kRRipA bhavatu vo mayi
shlokas.18:
sa tAmAshvAsayatkanyAM dRRiShTAntAgamahetubhiH |
sAntvayAmAsa kAryaM cha pratijaj~ne dvijaiH saha

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataste tApasAH sarve kAryavanto.abhava.nstadA |
tAM kanyAM chintayanto vai kiM kAryamiti dharmiNaH
shlokas.2:
kechidAhuH piturveshma nIyatAmiti tApasAH |
kechidasmadupAlambhe matiM chakrurdvijottamAH
shlokas.3:
kechichChAlvapatiM gatvA niyojyamiti menire |
neti kechidvyavasyanti pratyAkhyAtA hi tena sA
shlokas.4:
evaM gate kiM nu shakyaM bhadre kartuM manIShibhiH |
punarUchushcha te sarve tApasAH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.5:
alaM pravrajiteneha bhadre shRRiNu hitaM vachaH |
ito gachChasva bhadraM te pitureva niveshanam
shlokas.6:
pratipatsyati rAjA sa pitA te yadanantaram |
tatra vatsyasi kalyANi sukhaM sarvaguNAnvitA
na cha te.anyA gatirnyAyyA bhavedbhadre yathA pitA
shlokas.7:
patirvApi gatirnAryAH pitA vA varavarNini |
gatiH patiH samasthAyA viShame tu pitA gatiH
shlokas.8:
pravrajyA hi suduHkheyaM sukumAryA visheShataH |
rAjaputryAH prakRRityA cha kumAryAstava bhAmini
shlokas.9:
bhadre doShA hi vidyante bahavo varavarNini |
Ashrame vai vasantyAste na bhaveyuH piturgRRihe
shlokas.10:
tatastu te.abruvanvAkyaM brAhmaNAstAM tapasvinIm |
tvAmihaikAkinIM dRRiShTvA nirjane gahane vane
prArthayiShyanti rAjendrAstasmAnmaivaM manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.11:
ambovAcha||
na shakyaM kAshinagarIM punargantuM piturgRRihAn |
avaj~nAtA bhaviShyAmi bAndhavAnAM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.12:
uShitA hyanyathA bAlye piturveshmani tApasAH |
nAhaM gamiShye bhadraM vastatra yatra pitA mama
tapastaptumabhIpsAmi tApasaiH paripAlitA
shlokas.13:
yathA pare.api me loke na syAdevaM mahAtyayaH |
daurbhAgyaM brAhmaNashreShThAstasmAttapsyAmyahaM tapaH
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityevaM teShu vipreShu chintayatsu tathA tathA |
rAjarShistadvanaM prAptastapasvI hotravAhanaH
shlokas.15:
tataste tApasAH sarve pUjayanti sma taM nRRipam |
pUjAbhiH svAgatAdyAbhirAsanenodakena cha
shlokas.16:
tasyopaviShTasya tato vishrAntasyopashRRiNvataH |
punareva kathAM chakruH kanyAM prati vanaukasaH
shlokas.17:
ambAyAstAM kathAM shrutvA kAshirAj~nashcha bhArata |
sa vepamAna utthAya mAturasyAH pitA tadA
tAM kanyAma~NkamAropya paryAshvAsayata prabho
shlokas.18:
sa tAmapRRichChatkArtsnyena vyasanotpattimAditaH |
sA cha tasmai yathAvRRittaM vistareNa nyavedayat
shlokas.19:
tataH sa rAjarShirabhUdduHkhashokasamanvitaH |
kAryaM cha pratipede tanmanasA sumahAtapAH
shlokas.20:
abravIdvepamAnashcha kanyAmArtAM suduHkhitaH |
mA gAH pitRRigRRihaM bhadre mAtuste janako hyaham
shlokas.21:
duHkhaM ChetsyAmi te.ahaM vai mayi vartasva putrike |
paryAptaM te manaH putri yadevaM parishuShyasi
shlokas.22:
gachCha madvachanAdrAmaM jAmadagnyaM tapasvinam |
rAmastava mahadduHkhaM shokaM chApanayiShyati
haniShyati raNe bhIShmaM na kariShyati chedvachaH
shlokas.23:
taM gachCha bhArgavashreShThaM kAlAgnisamatejasam |
pratiShThApayitA sa tvAM same pathi mahAtapAH
shlokas.24:
tatastu sasvaraM bAShpamutsRRijantI punaH punaH |
abravItpitaraM mAtuH sA tadA hotravAhanam
shlokas.25:
abhivAdayitvA shirasA gamiShye tava shAsanAt |
api nAmAdya pashyeyamAryaM taM lokavishrutam
shlokas.26:
kathaM cha tIvraM duHkhaM me haniShyati sa bhArgavaH |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotumatha yAsyAmi tatra vai

shlokas.1:
hotravAhana uvAcha||
rAmaM drakShyasi vatse tvaM jAmadagnyaM mahAvane |
ugre tapasi vartantaM satyasandhaM mahAbalam
shlokas.2:
mahendre vai girishreShThe rAmaM nityamupAsate |
RRiShayo vedaviduSho gandharvApsarasastathA
shlokas.3:
tatra gachChasva bhadraM te brUyAshchainaM vacho mama |
abhivAdya pUrvaM shirasA tapovRRiddhaM dRRiDhavratam
shlokas.4:
brUyAshchainaM punarbhadre yatte kAryaM manIShitam |
mayi sa~NkIrtite rAmaH sarvaM tatte kariShyati
shlokas.5:
mama rAmaH sakhA vatse prItiyuktaH suhRRichcha me |
jamadagnisuto vIraH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.6:
evaM bruvati kanyAM tu pArthive hotravAhane |
akRRitavraNaH prAdurAsIdrAmasyAnucharaH priyaH
shlokas.7:
tataste munayaH sarve samuttasthuH sahasrashaH |
sa cha rAjA vayovRRiddhaH sRRi~njayo hotravAhanaH
shlokas.8:
tataH pRRiShTvA yathAnyAyamanyonyaM te vanaukasaH |
sahitA bharatashreShTha niSheduH parivArya tam
shlokas.9:
tataste kathayAmAsuH kathAstAstA manoramAH |
kAntA divyAshcha rAjendra prItiharShamudA yutAH
shlokas.10:
tataH kathAnte rAjarShirmahAtmA hotravAhanaH |
rAmaM shreShThaM maharShINAmapRRichChadakRRitavraNam
shlokas.11:
kva samprati mahAbAho jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn |
akRRitavraNa shakyo vai draShTuM vedavidAM varaH
shlokas.12:
akRRitavraNa uvAcha||
bhavantameva satataM rAmaH kIrtayati prabho |
sRRi~njayo me priyasakho rAjarShiriti pArthiva
shlokas.13:
iha rAmaH prabhAte shvo bhaviteti matirmama |
draShTAsyenamihAyAntaM tava darshanakA~NkShayA
shlokas.14:
iyaM cha kanyA rAjarShe kimarthaM vanamAgatA |
kasya cheyaM tava cha kA bhavatIchChAmi veditum
shlokas.15:
hotravAhana uvAcha||
dauhitrIyaM mama vibho kAshirAjasutA shubhA |
jyeShThA svaya.nvare tasthau bhaginIbhyAM sahAnagha
shlokas.16:
iyamambeti vikhyAtA jyeShThA kAshipateH sutA |
ambikAmbAlike tvanye yavIyasyau tapodhana
shlokas.17:
sametaM pArthivaM kShatraM kAshipuryAM tato.abhavat |
kanyAnimittaM brahmarShe tatrAsIdutsavo mahAn
shlokas.18:
tataH kila mahAvIryo bhIShmaH shAntanavo nRRipAn |
avAkShipya mahAtejAstisraH kanyA jahAra tAH
shlokas.19:
nirjitya pRRithivIpAlAnatha bhIShmo gajAhvayam |
AjagAma vishuddhAtmA kanyAbhiH saha bhArata
shlokas.20:
satyavatyai nivedyAtha vivAhArthamanantaram |
bhrAturvichitravIryasya samAj~nApayata prabhuH
shlokas.21:
tato vaivAhikaM dRRiShTvA kanyeyaM samupArjitam |
abravIttatra gA~NgeyaM mantrimadhye dvijarShabha
shlokas.22:
mayA shAlvapatirvIra manasAbhivRRitaH patiH |
na mAmarhasi dharmaj~na parachittAM pradApitum
shlokas.23:
tachChrutvA vachanaM bhIShmaH saMmantrya saha mantribhiH |
nishchitya visasarjemAM satyavatyA mate sthitaH
shlokas.24:
anuj~nAtA tu bhIShmeNa shAlvaM saubhapatiM tataH |
kanyeyaM muditA vipra kAle vachanamabravIt
shlokas.25:
visarjitAsmi bhIShmeNa dharmaM mAM pratipAdaya |
manasAbhivRRitaH pUrvaM mayA tvaM pArthivarShabha
shlokas.26:
pratyAchakhyau cha shAlvo.api chAritrasyAbhisha~NkitaH |
seyaM tapovanaM prAptA tApasye.abhiratA bhRRisham
shlokas.27:
mayA cha pratyabhij~nAtA va.nshasya parikIrtanAt |
asya duHkhasya chotpattiM bhIShmameveha manyate
shlokas.28:
ambovAcha||
bhagavannevamevaitadyathAha pRRithivIpatiH |
sharIrakartA mAturme sRRi~njayo hotravAhanaH
shlokas.29:
na hyutsahe svanagaraM pratiyAtuM tapodhana |
avamAnabhayAchchaiva vrIDayA cha mahAmune
shlokas.30:
yattu mAM bhagavAnrAmo vakShyati dvijasattama |
tanme kAryatamaM kAryamiti me bhagavanmatiH

shlokas.1:
akRRitavraNa uvAcha||
duHkhadvayamidaM bhadre katarasya chikIrShasi |
pratikartavyamabale tattvaM vatse bravIhi me
shlokas.2:
yadi saubhapatirbhadre niyoktavyo mate tava |
niyokShyati mahAtmA taM rAmastvaddhitakAmyayA
shlokas.3:
athApageyaM bhIShmaM taM rAmeNechChasi dhImatA |
raNe vinirjitaM draShTuM kuryAttadapi bhArgavaH
shlokas.4:
sRRi~njayasya vachaH shrutvA tava chaiva shuchismite |
yadatrAnantaraM kAryaM tadadyaiva vichintyatAm
shlokas.5:
ambovAcha||
apanItAsmi bhIShmeNa bhagavannavijAnatA |
na hi jAnAti me bhIShmo brahma~nshAlvagataM manaH
shlokas.6:
etadvichArya manasA bhavAneva vinishchayam |
vichinotu yathAnyAyaM vidhAnaM kriyatAM tathA
shlokas.7:
bhIShme vA kurushArdUle shAlvarAje.atha vA punaH |
ubhayoreva vA brahmanyadyuktaM tatsamAchara
shlokas.8:
niveditaM mayA hyetadduHkhamUlaM yathAtatham |
vidhAnaM tatra bhagavankartumarhasi yuktitaH
shlokas.9:
akRRitavraNa uvAcha||
upapannamidaM bhadre yadevaM varavarNini |
dharmaM prati vacho brUyAH shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.10:
yadi tvAmApageyo vai na nayedgajasAhvayam |
shAlvastvAM shirasA bhIru gRRihNIyAdrAmachoditaH
shlokas.11:
tena tvaM nirjitA bhadre yasmAnnItAsi bhAmini |
sa.nshayaH shAlvarAjasya tena tvayi sumadhyame
shlokas.12:
bhIShmaH puruShamAnI cha jitakAshI tathaiva cha |
tasmAtpratikriyA yuktA bhIShme kArayituM tvayA
shlokas.13:
ambovAcha||
mamApyeSha mahAnbrahmanhRRidi kAmo.abhivartate |
ghAtayeyaM yadi raNe bhIShmamityeva nityadA
shlokas.14:
bhIShmaM vA shAlvarAjaM vA yaM vA doSheNa gachChasi |
prashAdhi taM mahAbAho yatkRRite.ahaM suduHkhitA
shlokas.15:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM kathayatAmeva teShAM sa divaso gataH |
rAtrishcha bharatashreShTha sukhashItoShNamArutA
shlokas.16:
tato rAmaH prAdurAsItprajvalanniva tejasA |
shiShyaiH parivRRito rAja~njaTAchIradharo muniH
shlokas.17:
dhanuShpANiradInAtmA khaDgaM bibhratparashvadhI |
virajA rAjashArdUla so.abhyayAtsRRi~njayaM nRRipam
shlokas.18:
tatastaM tApasA dRRiShTvA sa cha rAjA mahAtapAH |
tasthuH prA~njalayaH sarve sA cha kanyA tapasvinI
shlokas.19:
pUjayAmAsuravyagrA madhuparkeNa bhArgavam |
architashcha yathAyogaM niShasAda sahaiva taiH
shlokas.20:
tataH pUrvavyatItAni kathayete sma tAvubhau |
sRRi~njayashcha sa rAjarShirjAmadagnyashcha bhArata
shlokas.21:
tataH kathAnte rAjarShirbhRRigushreShThaM mahAbalam |
uvAcha madhuraM kAle rAmaM vachanamarthavat
shlokas.22:
rAmeyaM mama dauhitrI kAshirAjasutA prabho |
asyAH shRRiNu yathAtattvaM kAryaM kAryavishArada
shlokas.23:
paramaM kathyatAM cheti tAM rAmaH pratyabhAShata |
tataH sAbhyagamadrAmaM jvalantamiva pAvakam
shlokas.24:
sA chAbhivAdya charaNau rAmasya shirasA shubhA |
spRRiShTvA padmadalAbhAbhyAM pANibhyAmagrataH sthitA
shlokas.25:
ruroda sA shokavatI bAShpavyAkulalochanA |
prapede sharaNaM chaiva sharaNyaM bhRRigunandanam
shlokas.26:
rAma uvAcha||
yathAsi sRRi~njayasyAsya tathA mama nRRipAtmaje |
