brUhi yatte manoduHkhaM kariShye vachanaM tava
shlokas.27:
ambovAcha||
bhagava~nsharaNaM tvAdya prapannAsmi mahAvrata |
shokapa~NkArNavAdghorAduddharasva cha mAM vibho
shlokas.28:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tasyAshcha dRRiShTvA rUpaM cha vayashchAbhinavaM punaH |
saukumAryaM paraM chaiva rAmashchintAparo.abhavat
shlokas.29:
kimiyaM vakShyatItyevaM vimRRishanbhRRigusattamaH |
iti dadhyau chiraM rAmaH kRRipayAbhipariplutaH
shlokas.30:
kathyatAmiti sA bhUyo rAmeNoktA shuchismitA |
sarvameva yathAtattvaM kathayAmAsa bhArgave
shlokas.31:
tachChrutvA jAmadagnyastu rAjaputryA vachastadA |
uvAcha tAM varArohAM nishchityArthavinishchayam
shlokas.32:
preShayiShyAmi bhIShmAya kurushreShThAya bhAmini |
kariShyati vacho dharmyaM shrutvA me sa narAdhipaH
shlokas.33:
na chetkariShyati vacho mayoktaM jAhnavIsutaH |
dhakShyAmyenaM raNe bhadre sAmAtyaM shastratejasA
shlokas.34:
atha vA te matistatra rAjaputri nivartate |
tAvachChAlvapatiM vIraM yojayAmyatra karmaNi
shlokas.35:
ambovAcha||
visarjitAsmi bhIShmeNa shrutvaiva bhRRigunandana |
shAlvarAjagataM cheto mama pUrvaM manIShitam
shlokas.36:
saubharAjamupetyAhamabruvaM durvachaM vachaH |
na cha mAM pratyagRRihNAtsa chAritraparisha~NkitaH
shlokas.37:
etatsarvaM vinishchitya svabuddhyA bhRRigunandana |
yadatraupayikaM kAryaM tachchintayitumarhasi
shlokas.38:
mamAtra vyasanasyAsya bhIShmo mUlaM mahAvrataH |
yenAhaM vashamAnItA samutkShipya balAttadA
shlokas.39:
bhIShmaM jahi mahAbAho yatkRRite duHkhamIdRRisham |
prAptAhaM bhRRigushArdUla charAmyapriyamuttamam
shlokas.40:
sa hi lubdhashcha mAnI cha jitakAshI cha bhArgava |
tasmAtpratikriyA kartuM yuktA tasmai tvayAnagha
shlokas.41:
eSha me hriyamANAyA bhAratena tadA vibho |
abhavaddhRRidi sa~Nkalpo ghAtayeyaM mahAvratam
shlokas.42:
tasmAtkAmaM mamAdyemaM rAma sa.nvartayAnagha |
jahi bhIShmaM mahAbAho yathA vRRitraM pura.ndaraH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktastadA rAmo jahi bhIShmamiti prabho |
uvAcha rudatIM kanyAM chodayantIM punaH punaH
shlokas.2:
kAshye kAmaM na gRRihNAmi shastraM vai varavarNini |
RRite brahmavidAM hetoH kimanyatkaravANi te
shlokas.3:
vAchA bhIShmashcha shAlvashcha mama rAj~ni vashAnugau |
bhaviShyato.anavadyA~Ngi tatkariShyAmi mA shuchaH
shlokas.4:
na tu shastraM grahIShyAmi katha~nchidapi bhAmini |
RRite niyogAdviprANAmeSha me samayaH kRRitaH
shlokas.5:
ambovAcha||
mama duHkhaM bhagavatA vyapaneyaM yatastataH |
tattu bhIShmaprasUtaM me taM jahIshvara mAchiram
shlokas.6:
rAma uvAcha||
kAshikanye punarbrUhi bhIShmaste charaNAvubhau |
shirasA vandanArho.api grahIShyati girA mama
shlokas.7:
ambovAcha||
jahi bhIShmaM raNe rAma mama chedichChasi priyam |
pratishrutaM cha yadi tatsatyaM kartumihArhasi
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tayoH sa.nvadatorevaM rAjanrAmAmbayostadA |
akRRitavraNo jAmadagnyamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.9:
sharaNAgatAM mahAbAho kanyAM na tyaktumarhasi |
jahi bhIShmaM raNe rAma garjantamasuraM yathA
shlokas.10:
yadi bhIShmastvayAhUto raNe rAma mahAmune |
nirjito.asmIti vA brUyAtkuryAdvA vachanaM tava
shlokas.11:
kRRitamasyA bhavetkAryaM kanyAyA bhRRigunandana |
vAkyaM satyaM cha te vIra bhaviShyati kRRitaM vibho
shlokas.12:
iyaM chApi pratij~nA te tadA rAma mahAmune |
jitvA vai kShatriyAnsarvAnbrAhmaNeShu pratishrutam
shlokas.13:
brAhmaNaH kShatriyo vaishyaH shUdrashchaiva raNe yadi |
brahmadviDbhavitA taM vai haniShyAmIti bhArgava
shlokas.14:
sharaNaM hi prapannAnAM bhItAnAM jIvitArthinAm |
na shakShyAmi parityAgaM kartuM jIvankatha~nchana
shlokas.15:
yashcha kShatraM raNe kRRitsnaM vijeShyati samAgatam |
dRRiptAtmAnamahaM taM cha haniShyAmIti bhArgava
shlokas.16:
sa evaM vijayI rAma bhIShmaH kurukulodvahaH |
tena yudhyasva sa~NgrAme sametya bhRRigunandana
shlokas.17:
rAma uvAcha||
smarAmyahaM pUrvakRRitAM pratij~nAmRRiShisattama |
tathaiva cha kariShyAmi yathA sAmnaiva lapsyate
shlokas.18:
kAryametanmahadbrahmankAshikanyAmanogatam |
gamiShyAmi svayaM tatra kanyAmAdAya yatra saH
shlokas.19:
yadi bhIShmo raNashlAghI na kariShyati me vachaH |
haniShyAmyenamudriktamiti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.20:
na hi bANA mayotsRRiShTAH sajjantIha sharIriNAm |
kAyeShu viditaM tubhyaM purA kShatriyasa~Ngare
shlokas.21:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA tato rAmaH saha tairbrahmavAdibhiH |
prayANAya matiM kRRitvA samuttasthau mahAmanAH
shlokas.22:
tataste tAmuShitvA tu rajanIM tatra tApasAH |
hutAgnayo japtajapyAH pratasthurmajjighA.nsayA
shlokas.23:
abhyagachChattato rAmaH saha tairbrAhmaNarShabhaiH |
kurukShetraM mahArAja kanyayA saha bhArata
shlokas.24:
nyavishanta tataH sarve parigRRihya sarasvatIm |
tApasAste mahAtmAno bhRRigushreShThapuraskRRitAH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastRRitIye divase same deshe vyavasthitaH |
preShayAmAsa me rAjanprApto.asmIti mahAvrataH
shlokas.2:
tamAgatamahaM shrutvA viShayAntaM mahAbalam |
abhyagachChaM javenAshu prItyA tejonidhiM prabhum
shlokas.3:
gAM puraskRRitya rAjendra brAhmaNaiH parivAritaH |
RRitvigbhirdevakalpaishcha tathaiva cha purohitaiH
shlokas.4:
sa mAmabhigataM dRRiShTvA jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn |
pratijagrAha tAM pUjAM vachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.5:
bhIShma kAM buddhimAsthAya kAshirAjasutA tvayA |
akAmeyamihAnItA punashchaiva visarjitA
shlokas.6:
vibhra.nshitA tvayA hIyaM dharmAvApteH parAvarAt |
parAmRRiShTAM tvayA hImAM ko hi gantumihArhati
shlokas.7:
pratyAkhyAtA hi shAlvena tvayA nIteti bhArata |
tasmAdimAM manniyogAtpratigRRihNIShva bhArata
shlokas.8:
svadharmaM puruShavyAghra rAjaputrI labhatviyam |
na yuktamavamAno.ayaM kartuM rAj~nA tvayAnagha
shlokas.9:
tatastaM nAtimanasaM samudIkShyAhamabruvam |
nAhamenAM punardadyAM bhrAtre brahmankatha~nchana
shlokas.10:
shAlvasyAhamiti prAha purA mAmiha bhArgava |
mayA chaivAbhyanuj~nAtA gatA saubhapuraM prati
shlokas.11:
na bhayAnnApyanukroshAnna lobhAnnArthakAmyayA |
kShatradharmamahaM jahyAmiti me vratamAhitam
shlokas.12:
atha mAmabravIdrAmaH krodhaparyAkulekShaNaH |
na kariShyasi chedetadvAkyaM me kurupu~Ngava
shlokas.13:
haniShyAmi sahAmAtyaM tvAmadyeti punaH punaH |
sa.nrambhAdabravIdrAmaH krodhaparyAkulekShaNaH
shlokas.14:
tamahaM gIrbhiriShTAbhiH punaH punarari.ndamam |
ayAchaM bhRRigushArdUlaM na chaiva prashashAma saH
shlokas.15:
tamahaM praNamya shirasA bhUyo brAhmaNasattamam |
abruvaM kAraNaM kiM tadyattvaM yoddhumihechChasi
shlokas.16:
iShvastraM mama bAlasya bhavataiva chaturvidham |
upadiShTaM mahAbAho shiShyo.asmi tava bhArgava
shlokas.17:
tato mAmabravIdrAmaH krodhasa.nraktalochanaH |
jAnIShe mAM guruM bhIShma na chemAM pratigRRihNase
sutAM kAshyasya kauravya matpriyArthaM mahIpate
shlokas.18:
na hi te vidyate shAntiranyathA kurunandana |
gRRihANemAM mahAbAho rakShasva kulamAtmanaH
tvayA vibhra.nshitA hIyaM bhartAraM nAbhigachChati
shlokas.19:
tathA bruvantaM tamahaM rAmaM parapura~njayam |
naitadevaM punarbhAvi brahmarShe kiM shrameNa te
shlokas.20:
gurutvaM tvayi samprekShya jAmadagnya purAtanam |
prasAdaye tvAM bhagava.nstyaktaiShA hi purA mayA
shlokas.21:
ko jAtu parabhAvAM hi nArIM vyAlImiva sthitAm |
vAsayeta gRRihe jAnanstrINAM doShAnmahAtyayAn
shlokas.22:
na bhayAdvAsavasyApi dharmaM jahyAM mahAdyute |
prasIda mA vA yadvA te kAryaM tatkuru mAchiram
shlokas.23:
ayaM chApi vishuddhAtmanpurANe shrUyate vibho |
maruttena mahAbuddhe gItaH shloko mahAtmanA
shlokas.24:
gurorapyavaliptasya kAryAkAryamajAnataH |
utpathapratipannasya kAryaM bhavati shAsanam
shlokas.25:
sa tvaM gururiti premNA mayA saMmAnito bhRRisham |
guruvRRittaM na jAnIShe tasmAdyotsyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.26:
guruM na hanyAM samare brAhmaNaM cha visheShataH |
visheShatastapovRRiddhamevaM kShAntaM mayA tava
shlokas.27:
udyateShumatho dRRiShTvA brAhmaNaM kShatrabandhuvat |
yo hanyAtsamare kruddho yudhyantamapalAyinam
brahmahatyA na tasya syAditi dharmeShu nishchayaH
shlokas.28:
kShatriyANAM sthito dharme kShatriyo.asmi tapodhana |
yo yathA vartate yasmi.nstathA tasminpravartayan
nAdharmaM samavApnoti naraH shreyashcha vindati
shlokas.29:
arthe vA yadi vA dharme samartho deshakAlavit |
anarthasa.nshayApannaH shreyAnniHsa.nshayena cha
shlokas.30:
yasmAtsa.nshayite.arthe.asminyathAnyAyaM pravartase |
tasmAdyotsyAmi sahitastvayA rAma mahAhave
pashya me bAhuvIryaM cha vikramaM chAtimAnuSham
shlokas.31:
evaM gate.api tu mayA yachChakyaM bhRRigunandana |
tatkariShye kurukShetre yotsye vipra tvayA saha
dva.ndve rAma yatheShTaM te sajjo bhava mahAmune
shlokas.32:
tatra tvaM nihato rAma mayA sharashatAchitaH |
lapsyase nirjitA.NllokA~nshastrapUto mahAraNe
shlokas.33:
sa gachCha vinivartasva kurukShetraM raNapriya |
tatraiShyAmi mahAbAho yuddhAya tvAM tapodhana
shlokas.34:
api yatra tvayA rAma kRRitaM shauchaM purA pituH |
tatrAhamapi hatvA tvAM shauchaM kartAsmi bhArgava
shlokas.35:
tatra gachChasva rAma tvaM tvaritaM yuddhadurmada |
vyapaneShyAmi te darpaM paurANaM brAhmaNabruva
shlokas.36:
yachchApi katthase rAma bahushaH pariShatsu vai |
nirjitAH kShatriyA loke mayaikeneti tachChRRiNu
shlokas.37:
na tadA jAyate bhIShmo madvidhaH kShatriyo.api vA |
yaste yuddhamayaM darpaM kAmaM cha vyapanAshayet
shlokas.38:
so.ahaM jAto mahAbAho bhIShmaH parapura~njayaH |
vyapaneShyAmi te darpaM yuddhe rAma na sa.nshayaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato mAmabravIdrAmaH prahasanniva bhArata |
diShTyA bhIShma mayA sArdhaM yoddhumichChasi sa~Ngare
shlokas.2:
ayaM gachChAmi kauravya kurukShetraM tvayA saha |
bhAShitaM tatkariShyAmi tatrAgachCheH parantapa
shlokas.3:
tatra tvAM nihataM mAtA mayA sharashatAchitam |
jAhnavI pashyatAM bhIShma gRRidhraka~NkabaDAshanam
shlokas.4:
kRRipaNaM tvAmabhiprekShya siddhachAraNasevitA |
mayA vinihataM devI rodatAmadya pArthiva
shlokas.5:
atadarhA mahAbhAgA bhagIrathasutA nadI |
yA tvAmajIjananmandaM yuddhakAmukamAturam
shlokas.6:
ehi gachCha mayA bhIShma yuddhamadyaiva vartatAm |
gRRihANa sarvaM kauravya rathAdi bharatarShabha
shlokas.7:
iti bruvANaM tamahaM rAmaM parapura~njayam |
praNamya shirasA rAjannevamastvityathAbruvam
shlokas.8:
evamuktvA yayau rAmaH kurukShetraM yuyutsayA |
pravishya nagaraM chAhaM satyavatyai nyavedayam
shlokas.9:
tataH kRRitasvastyayano mAtrA pratyabhinanditaH |
dvijAtInvAchya puNyAhaM svasti chaiva mahAdyute
shlokas.10:
rathamAsthAya ruchiraM rAjataM pANDurairhayaiH |
sUpaskaraM svadhiShThAnaM vaiyAghraparivAraNam
shlokas.11:
upapannaM mahAshastraiH sarvopakaraNAnvitam |
tatkulInena vIreNa hayashAstravidA nRRipa
shlokas.12:
yuktaM sUtena shiShTena bahusho dRRiShTakarmaNA |
da.nshitaH pANDureNAhaM kavachena vapuShmatA
shlokas.13:
pANDuraM kArmukaM gRRihya prAyAM bharatasattama |
pANDureNAtapatreNa dhriyamANena mUrdhani
shlokas.14:
pANDuraishchAmaraishchApi vIjyamAno narAdhipa |
shuklavAsAH sitoShNIShaH sarvashuklavibhUShaNaH
shlokas.15:
stUyamAno jayAshIrbhirniShkramya gajasAhvayAt |
kurukShetraM raNakShetramupAyAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.16:
te hayAshchoditAstena sUtena paramAhave |
avahanmAM bhRRishaM rAjanmanomArutaraMhasaH
shlokas.17:
gatvAhaM tatkurukShetraM sa cha rAmaH pratApavAn |
yuddhAya sahasA rAjanparAkrAntau parasparam
shlokas.18:
tataH sa.ndarshane.atiShThaM rAmasyAtitapasvinaH |
pragRRihya sha~NkhapravaraM tataH prAdhamamuttamam
shlokas.19:
tatastatra dvijA rAja.nstApasAshcha vanaukasaH |
apashyanta raNaM divyaM devAH sarShigaNAstadA
shlokas.20:
tato divyAni mAlyAni prAdurAsanmuhurmuhuH |
vAditrANi cha divyAni meghavRRindAni chaiva ha
shlokas.21:
tataste tApasAH sarve bhArgavasyAnuyAyinaH |
prekShakAH samapadyanta parivArya raNAjiram
shlokas.22:
tato mAmabravIddevI sarvabhUtahitaiShiNI |
mAtA svarUpiNI rAjankimidaM te chikIrShitam
shlokas.23:
gatvAhaM jAmadagnyaM taM prayAchiShye kurUdvaha |
bhIShmeNa saha mA yotsIH shiShyeNeti punaH punaH
shlokas.24:
mA maivaM putra nirbandhaM kuru vipreNa pArthiva |
jAmadagnyena samare yoddhumityavabhartsayat
shlokas.25:
kiM na vai kShatriyaharo haratulyaparAkramaH |
viditaH putra rAmaste yatastvaM yoddhumichChasi
shlokas.26:
tato.ahamabruvaM devImabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH |
sarvaM tadbharatashreShTha yathAvRRittaM svaya.nvare
shlokas.27:
yathA cha rAmo rAjendra mayA pUrvaM prasAditaH |
kAshirAjasutAyAshcha yathA kAmaH purAtanaH
shlokas.28:
tataH sA rAmamabhyetya jananI me mahAnadI |
madarthaM tamRRiShiM devI kShamayAmAsa bhArgavam
bhIShmeNa saha mA yotsIH shiShyeNeti vacho.abravIt
shlokas.29:
sa cha tAmAha yAchantIM bhIShmameva nivartaya |
na hi me kurute kAmamityahaM tamupAgamam
shlokas.30:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato ga~NgA sutasnehAdbhIShmaM punarupAgamat |
na chAsyAH so.akarodvAkyaM krodhaparyAkulekShaNaH
shlokas.31:
athAdRRishyata dharmAtmA bhRRigushreShTho mahAtapAH |
AhvayAmAsa cha punaryuddhAya dvijasattamaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tamahaM smayanniva raNe pratyabhAShaM vyavasthitam |
bhUmiShThaM notsahe yoddhuM bhavantaM rathamAsthitaH
shlokas.2:
Aroha syandanaM vIra kavachaM cha mahAbhuja |
badhAna samare rAma yadi yoddhuM mayechChasi
shlokas.3:
tato mAmabravIdrAmaH smayamAno raNAjire |
ratho me medinI bhIShma vAhA vedAH sadashvavat
shlokas.4:
sUto me mAtarishvA vai kavachaM vedamAtaraH |
susa.nvIto raNe tAbhiryotsye.ahaM kurunandana
shlokas.5:
evaM bruvANo gAndhAre rAmo mAM satyavikramaH |
sharavrAtena mahatA sarvataH paryavArayat
shlokas.6:
tato.apashyaM jAmadagnyaM rathe divye vyavasthitam |
sarvAyudhadhare shrImatyadbhutopamadarshane
shlokas.7:
manasA vihite puNye vistIrNe nagaropame |
divyAshvayuji saMnaddhe kA~nchanena vibhUShite
shlokas.8:
dhvajena cha mahAbAho somAla~NkRRitalakShmaNA |
dhanurdharo baddhatUNo baddhagodhA~NgulitravAn
shlokas.9:
sArathyaM kRRitavA.nstatra yuyutsorakRRitavraNaH |
sakhA vedavidatyantaM dayito bhArgavasya ha
shlokas.10:
AhvayAnaH sa mAM yuddhe mano harShayatIva me |
punaH punarabhikroshannabhiyAhIti bhArgavaH
shlokas.11:
tamAdityamivodyantamanAdhRRiShyaM mahAbalam |
kShatriyAntakaraM rAmamekamekaH samAsadam
shlokas.12:
tato.ahaM bANapAteShu triShu vAhAnnigRRihya vai |
avatIrya dhanurnyasya padAtirRRiShisattamam
shlokas.13:
abhyagachChaM tadA rAmamarchiShyandvijasattamam |
abhivAdya chainaM vidhivadabruvaM vAkyamuttamam
shlokas.14:
yotsye tvayA raNe rAma vishiShTenAdhikena cha |
guruNA dharmashIlena jayamAshAssva me vibho
shlokas.15:
rAma uvAcha||
evametatkurushreShTha kartavyaM bhUtimichChatA |
dharmo hyeSha mahAbAho vishiShTaiH saha yudhyatAm
shlokas.16:
shapeyaM tvAM na chedevamAgachChethA vishAM pate |
yudhyasva tvaM raNe yatto dhairyamAlambya kaurava
shlokas.17:
na tu te jayamAshAse tvAM hi jetumahaM sthitaH |
gachCha yudhyasva dharmeNa prIto.asmi charitena te
shlokas.18:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato.ahaM taM namaskRRitya rathamAruhya satvaraH |
prAdhmApayaM raNe sha~NkhaM punarhemavibhUShitam
shlokas.19:
tato yuddhaM samabhavanmama tasya cha bhArata |
divasAnsubahUnrAjanparasparajigIShayA
shlokas.20:
sa me tasminraNe pUrvaM prAharatka~NkapatribhiH |
ShaShTyA shataishcha navabhiH sharANAmagnivarchasAm
shlokas.21:
chatvArastena me vAhAH sUtashchaiva vishAM pate |
pratiruddhAstathaivAhaM samare da.nshitaH sthitaH
shlokas.22:
namaskRRitya cha devebhyo brAhmaNebhyashcha bhArata |
tamahaM smayanniva raNe pratyabhAShaM vyavasthitam
shlokas.23:
AchAryatA mAnitA me nirmaryAde hyapi tvayi |
bhUyastu shRRiNu me brahmansampadaM dharmasa~Ngrahe
shlokas.24:
ye te vedAH sharIrasthA brAhmaNyaM yachcha te mahat |
tapashcha sumahattaptaM na tebhyaH praharAmyaham
shlokas.25:
prahare kShatradharmasya yaM tvaM rAma samAsthitaH |
brAhmaNaH kShatriyatvaM hi yAti shastrasamudyamAt
shlokas.26:
pashya me dhanuSho vIryaM pashya bAhvorbalaM cha me |
eSha te kArmukaM vIra dvidhA kurmi sasAyakam
shlokas.27:
tasyAhaM nishitaM bhallaM prAhiNvaM bharatarShabha |
tenAsya dhanuShaH koTishChinnA bhUmimathAgamat
shlokas.28:
nava chApi pRRiShatkAnAM shatAni nataparvaNAm |
prAhiNvaM ka~NkapatrANAM jAmadagnyarathaM prati
shlokas.29:
kAye viShaktAstu tadA vAyunAbhisamIritAH |
cheluH kSharanto rudhiraM nAgA iva cha te sharAH
shlokas.30:
kShatajokShitasarvA~NgaH kSharansa rudhiraM vraNaiH |
babhau rAmastadA rAjanmerurdhAtUnivotsRRijan
shlokas.31:
hemantAnte.ashoka iva raktastabakamaNDitaH |
babhau rAmastadA rAjankvachitki.nshukasaMnibhaH
shlokas.32:
tato.anyaddhanurAdAya rAmaH krodhasamanvitaH |
hemapu~NkhAnsunishitA~nsharA.nstAnhi vavarSha saH
shlokas.33:
te samAsAdya mAM raudrA bahudhA marmabhedinaH |
akampayanmahAvegAH sarpAnalaviShopamAH
shlokas.34:
tato.ahaM samavaShTabhya punarAtmAnamAhave |
shatasa~NkhyaiH sharaiH kruddhastadA rAmamavAkiram
shlokas.35:
sa tairagnyarkasa~NkAshaiH sharairAshIviShopamaiH |
shitairabhyardito rAmo mandachetA ivAbhavat
shlokas.36:
tato.ahaM kRRipayAviShTo vinindyAtmAnamAtmanA |
dhigdhigityabruvaM yuddhaM kShatraM cha bharatarShabha
shlokas.37:
asakRRichchAbruvaM rAja~nshokavegapariplutaH |
aho bata kRRitaM pApaM mayedaM kShatrakarmaNA
shlokas.38:
gururdvijAtirdharmAtmA yadevaM pIDitaH sharaiH |
tato na prAharaM bhUyo jAmadagnyAya bhArata
shlokas.39:
athAvatApya pRRithivIM pUShA divasasa~NkShaye |
jagAmAstaM sahasrA.nshustato yuddhamupAramat

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
Atmanastu tataH sUto hayAnAM cha vishAM pate |
mama chApanayAmAsa shalyAnkushalasaMmataH
shlokas.2:
snAtopavRRittaisturagairlabdhatoyairavihvalaiH |
prabhAta udite sUrye tato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.3:
dRRiShTvA mAM tUrNamAyAntaM da.nshitaM syandane sthitam |
akarodrathamatyarthaM rAmaH sajjaM pratApavAn
shlokas.4:
tato.ahaM rAmamAyAntaM dRRiShTvA samarakA~NkShiNam |
dhanuHshreShThaM samutsRRijya sahasAvataraM rathAt
shlokas.5:
abhivAdya tathaivAhaM rathamAruhya bhArata |
yuyutsurjAmadagnyasya pramukhe vItabhIH sthitaH
shlokas.6:
tato mAM sharavarSheNa mahatA samavAkirat |
ahaM cha sharavarSheNa varShantaM samavAkiram
shlokas.7:
sa~Nkruddho jAmadagnyastu punareva patatriNaH |
preShayAmAsa me rAjandIptAsyAnuragAniva
shlokas.8:
tAnahaM nishitairbhallaiH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH |
achChidaM sahasA rAjannantarikShe punaH punaH
shlokas.9:
tatastvastrANi divyAni jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn |
mayi prachodayAmAsa tAnyahaM pratyaShedhayam
shlokas.10:
astraireva mahAbAho chikIrShannadhikAM kriyAm |
tato divi mahAnnAdaH prAdurAsItsamantataH
shlokas.11:
tato.ahamastraM vAyavyaM jAmadagnye prayuktavAn |
pratyAjaghne cha tadrAmo guhyakAstreNa bhArata
shlokas.12:
tato.astramahamAgneyamanumantrya prayuktavAn |
vAruNenaiva rAmastadvArayAmAsa me vibhuH
shlokas.13:
evamastrANi divyAni rAmasyAhamavArayam |
rAmashcha mama tejasvI divyAstravidari.ndamaH
shlokas.14:
tato mAM savyato rAjanrAmaH kurvandvijottamaH |
urasyavidhyatsa~Nkruddho jAmadagnyo mahAbalaH
shlokas.15:
tato.ahaM bharatashreShTha saMnyaShIdaM rathottame |
atha mAM kashmalAviShTaM sUtastUrNamapAvahat
gorutaM bharatashreShTha rAmabANaprapIDitam
shlokas.16:
tato mAmapayAtaM vai bhRRishaM viddhamachetasam |
rAmasyAnucharA hRRiShTAH sarve dRRiShTvA prachukrushuH
akRRitavraNaprabhRRitayaH kAshikanyA cha bhArata
shlokas.17:
tatastu labdhasa~nj~no.ahaM j~nAtvA sUtamathAbruvam |
yAhi sUta yato rAmaH sajjo.ahaM gatavedanaH
shlokas.18:
tato mAmavahatsUto hayaiH paramashobhitaiH |
nRRityadbhiriva kauravya mArutapratimairgatau
shlokas.19:
tato.ahaM rAmamAsAdya bANajAlena kaurava |
avAkiraM susa.nrabdhaH sa.nrabdhaM vijigIShayA
shlokas.20:
tAnApatata evAsau rAmo bANAnajihmagAn |
bANairevAchChinattUrNamekaikaM tribhirAhave
shlokas.21:
tataste mRRiditAH sarve mama bANAH susa.nshitAH |
rAmabANairdvidhA ChinnAH shatasho.atha mahAhave
shlokas.22:
tataH punaH sharaM dIptaM suprabhaM kAlasaMmitam |
asRRijaM jAmadagnyAya rAmAyAhaM jighA.nsayA
shlokas.23:
tena tvabhihato gADhaM bANachChedavashaM gataH |
mumoha sahasA rAmo bhUmau cha nipapAta ha
shlokas.24:
tato hAhAkRRitaM sarvaM rAme bhUtalamAshrite |
jagadbhArata sa.nvignaM yathArkapatane.abhavat
shlokas.25:
tata enaM susa.nvignAH sarva evAbhidudruvuH |
tapodhanAste sahasA kAshyA cha bhRRigunandanam
shlokas.26:
ta enaM sampariShvajya shanairAshvAsaya.nstadA |
pANibhirjalashItaishcha jayAshIrbhishcha kaurava
shlokas.27:
tataH sa vihvalo vAkyaM rAma utthAya mAbravIt |
tiShTha bhIShma hato.asIti bANaM sandhAya kArmuke
shlokas.28:
sa mukto nyapatattUrNaM pArshve savye mahAhave |
yenAhaM bhRRishasa.nvigno vyAghUrNita iva drumaH
shlokas.29:
hatvA hayA.nstato rAja~nshIghrAstreNa mahAhave |
avAkiranmAM vishrabdho bANaistairlomavAhibhiH
shlokas.30:
tato.ahamapi shIghrAstraM samare.aprativAraNam |
avAsRRijaM mahAbAho te.antarAdhiShThitAH sharAH
rAmasya mama chaivAshu vyomAvRRitya samantataH
shlokas.31:
na sma sUryaH pratapati sharajAlasamAvRRitaH |
mAtarishvAntare tasminmegharuddha ivAnadat
shlokas.32:
tato vAyoH prakampAchcha sUryasya cha marIchibhiH |
abhitApAtsvabhAvAchcha pAvakaH samajAyata
shlokas.33:
te sharAH svasamutthena pradIptAshchitrabhAnunA |
bhUmau sarve tadA rAjanbhasmabhUtAH prapedire
shlokas.34:
tadA shatasahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
ayutAnyatha kharvANi nikharvANi cha kaurava
rAmaH sharANAM sa~Nkruddho mayi tUrNamapAtayat
shlokas.35:
tato.ahaM tAnapi raNe sharairAshIviShopamaiH |
sa~nChidya bhUmau nRRipate.apAtayaM pannagAniva
shlokas.36:
evaM tadabhavadyuddhaM tadA bharatasattama |
sandhyAkAle vyatIte tu vyapAyAtsa cha me guruH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
samAgatasya rAmeNa punarevAtidAruNam |
anyedyustumulaM yuddhaM tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.2:
tato divyAstravichChUro divyAnyastrANyanekashaH |
ayojayata dharmAtmA divase divase vibhuH
shlokas.3:
tAnyahaM tatpratIghAtairastrairastrANi bhArata |
vyadhamaM tumule yuddhe prANA.nstyaktvA sudustyajAn
shlokas.4:
astrairastreShu bahudhA hateShvatha cha bhArgavaH |
akrudhyata mahAtejAstyaktaprANaH sa sa.nyuge
shlokas.5:
tataH shaktiM prAhiNodghorarUpA;mastrai ruddho jAmadagnyo mahAtmA |
kAlotsRRiShTAM prajvalitAmivolkAM; sa.ndIptAgrAM tejasAvRRitya lokAn
shlokas.6:
tato.ahaM tAmiShubhirdIpyamAnaiH; samAyAntImantakAlArkadIptAm |
ChittvA tridhA pAtayAmAsa bhUmau; tato vavau pavanaH puNyagandhiH
shlokas.7:
tasyAM ChinnAyAM krodhadIpto.atha rAmaH; shaktIrghorAH prAhiNoddvAdashAnyAH |
tAsAM rUpaM bhArata nota shakyaM; tejasvitvAllAghavAchchaiva vaktum
shlokas.8:
kiM tvevAhaM vihvalaH sampradRRishya; digbhyaH sarvAstA maholkA ivAgneH |
nAnArUpAstejasogreNa dIptA; yathAdityA dvAdasha lokasa~NkShaye
shlokas.9:
tato jAlaM bANamayaM vivRRitya; sa.ndRRishya bhittvA sharajAlena rAjan |
dvAdasheShUnprAhiNavaM raNe.ahaM; tataH shaktIrvyadhamaM ghorarUpAH
shlokas.10:
tato.aparA jAmadagnyo mahAtmA; shaktIrghorAH prAkShipaddhemadaNDAH |
vichitritAH kA~nchanapaTTanaddhA; yathA maholkA jvalitAstathA tAH
shlokas.11:
tAshchApyugrAshcharmaNA vArayitvA; khaDgenAjau pAtitA me narendra |
bANairdivyairjAmadagnyasya sa~Nkhye; divyA.nshchAshvAnabhyavarShaM sasUtAn
shlokas.12:
nirmuktAnAM pannagAnAM sarUpA; dRRiShTvA shaktIrhemachitrA nikRRittAH |
prAdushchakre divyamastraM mahAtmA; krodhAviShTo haihayeshapramAthI
shlokas.13:
tataH shreNyaH shalabhAnAmivogrAH; samApeturvishikhAnAM pradIptAH |
samAchinochchApi bhRRishaM sharIraM; hayAnsUtaM sarathaM chaiva mahyam
shlokas.14:
rathaH sharairme nichitaH sarvato.abhU;ttathA hayAH sArathishchaiva rAjan |
yugaM ratheShA cha tathaiva chakre; tathaivAkShaH sharakRRitto.atha bhagnaH
shlokas.15:
tatastasminbANavarShe vyatIte; sharaugheNa pratyavarShaM guruM tam |
sa vikShato mArgaNairbrahmarAshi;rdehAdajasraM mumuche bhUri raktam
shlokas.16:
yathA rAmo bANajAlAbhitapta;stathaivAhaM subhRRishaM gADhaviddhaH |
tato yuddhaM vyaramachchAparAhNe; bhAnAvastaM prArthayAne mahIdhram

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH prabhAte rAjendra sUrye vimala udgate |
bhArgavasya mayA sArdhaM punaryuddhamavartata
shlokas.2:
tato bhrAnte rathe tiShThanrAmaH praharatAM varaH |
vavarSha sharavarShANi mayi shakra ivAchale
shlokas.3:
tena sUto mama suhRRichCharavarSheNa tADitaH |
nipapAta rathopasthe mano mama viShAdayan
shlokas.4:
tataH sUtaH sa me.atyarthaM kashmalaM prAvishanmahat |
pRRithivyAM cha sharAghAtAnnipapAta mumoha cha
shlokas.5:
tataH sUto.ajahAtprANAnrAmabANaprapIDitaH |
muhUrtAdiva rAjendra mAM cha bhIrAvishattadA
shlokas.6:
tataH sUte hate rAjankShipatastasya me sharAn |
pramattamanaso rAmaH prAhiNonmRRityusaMmitAn
shlokas.7:
tataH sUtavyasaninaM viplutaM mAM sa bhArgavaH |
shareNAbhyahanadgADhaM vikRRiShya balavaddhanuH
shlokas.8:
sa me jatrvantare rAjannipatya rudhirAshanaH |
mayaiva saha rAjendra jagAma vasudhAtalam
shlokas.9:
matvA tu nihataM rAmastato mAM bharatarShabha |
meghavadvyanadachchochchairjahRRiShe cha punaH punaH
shlokas.10:
tathA tu patite rAjanmayi rAmo mudA yutaH |
udakroshanmahAnAdaM saha tairanuyAyibhiH
shlokas.11:
mama tatrAbhavanye tu kauravAH pArshvataH sthitAH |
AgatA ye cha yuddhaM tajjanAstatra didRRikShavaH
ArtiM paramikAM jagmuste tadA mayi pAtite
shlokas.12:
tato.apashyaM pAtito rAjasiMha; dvijAnaShTau sUryahutAshanAbhAn |
te mAM samantAtparivArya tasthuH; svabAhubhiH parigRRihyAjimadhye
shlokas.13:
rakShyamANashcha tairviprairnAhaM bhUmimupAspRRisham |
antarikShe sthito hyasmi tairviprairbAndhavairiva
svapannivAntarikShe cha jalabindubhirukShitaH
shlokas.14:
tataste brAhmaNA rAjannabruvanparigRRihya mAm |
mA bhairiti samaM sarve svasti te.astviti chAsakRRit
shlokas.15:
tatasteShAmahaM vAgbhistarpitaH sahasotthitaH |
mAtaraM saritAM shreShThAmapashyaM rathamAsthitAm
shlokas.16:
hayAshcha me sa~NgRRihItAstayA vai; mahAnadyA sa.nyati kauravendra |
pAdau jananyAH pratipUjya chAhaM; tathArShTiSheNaM rathamabhyaroham
shlokas.17:
rarakSha sA mama rathaM hayA.nshchopaskarANi cha |
tAmahaM prA~njalirbhUtvA punareva vyasarjayam
shlokas.18:
tato.ahaM svayamudyamya hayA.nstAnvAtaraMhasaH |
ayudhyaM jAmadagnyena nivRRitte.ahani bhArata
shlokas.19:
tato.ahaM bharatashreShTha vegavantaM mahAbalam |
amu~nchaM samare bANaM rAmAya hRRidayachChidam
shlokas.20:
tato jagAma vasudhAM bANavegaprapIDitaH |
jAnubhyAM dhanurutsRRijya rAmo mohavashaM gataH
shlokas.21:
tatastasminnipatite rAme bhUrisahasrade |
AvavrurjaladA vyoma kSharanto rudhiraM bahu
shlokas.22:
ulkAshcha shatashaH petuH sanirghAtAH sakampanAH |
arkaM cha sahasA dIptaM svarbhAnurabhisa.nvRRiNot
shlokas.23:
vavushcha vAtAH paruShAshchalitA cha vasundharA |
gRRidhrA baDAshcha ka~NkAshcha paripeturmudA yutAH
shlokas.24:
dIptAyAM dishi gomAyurdAruNaM muhurunnadat |
anAhatA dundubhayo vinedurbhRRishanisvanAH
shlokas.25:
etadautpAtikaM ghoramAsIdbharatasattama |
visa~nj~nakalpe dharaNIM gate rAme mahAtmani
shlokas.26:
tato ravirmandamarIchimaNDalo; jagAmAstaM pA.nsupu~njAvagADhaH |
nishA vyagAhatsukhashItamArutA; tato yuddhaM pratyavahArayAvaH
shlokas.27:
evaM rAjannavahAro babhUva; tataH punarvimale.abhUtsughoram |
kAlyaM kAlyaM vi.nshatiM vai dinAni; tathaiva chAnyAni dinAni trINi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato.ahaM nishi rAjendra praNamya shirasA tadA |
brAhmaNAnAM pitR^INAM cha devatAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.2:
nakta~ncharANAM bhUtAnAM rajanyAshcha vishAM pate |
shayanaM prApya rahite manasA samachintayam
shlokas.3:
jAmadagnyena me yuddhamidaM paramadAruNam |
ahAni subahUnyadya vartate sumahAtyayam
shlokas.4:
na cha rAmaM mahAvIryaM shaknomi raNamUrdhani |
vijetuM samare vipraM jAmadagnyaM mahAbalam
shlokas.5:
yadi shakyo mayA jetuM jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn |
daivatAni prasannAni darshayantu nishAM mama
shlokas.6:
tato.ahaM nishi rAjendra prasuptaH sharavikShataH |
dakShiNenaiva pArshvena prabhAtasamaye iva
shlokas.7:
tato.ahaM vipramukhyaistairyairasmi patito rathAt |
utthApito dhRRitashchaiva mA bhairiti cha sAntvitaH
shlokas.8:
ta eva mAM mahArAja svapnadarshanametya vai |
parivAryAbruvanvAkyaM tannibodha kurUdvaha
shlokas.9:
uttiShTha mA bhairgA~Ngeya bhayaM te nAsti ki~nchana |
rakShAmahe naravyAghra svasharIraM hi no bhavAn
shlokas.10:
na tvAM rAmo raNe jetA jAmadagnyaH katha~nchana |
tvameva samare rAmaM vijetA bharatarShabha
shlokas.11:
idamastraM sudayitaM pratyabhij~nAsyate bhavAn |
viditaM hi tavApyetatpUrvasmindehadhAraNe
shlokas.12:
prAjApatyaM vishvakRRitaM prasvApaM nAma bhArata |
na hIdaM veda rAmo.api pRRithivyAM vA pumAnkvachit
shlokas.13:
tatsmarasva mahAbAho bhRRishaM sa.nyojayasva cha |
na cha rAmaH kShayaM gantA tenAstreNa narAdhipa
shlokas.14:
enasA cha na yogaM tvaM prApsyase jAtu mAnada |
svapsyate jAmadagnyo.asau tvadbANabalapIDitaH
shlokas.15:
tato jitvA tvamevainaM punarutthApayiShyasi |
astreNa dayitenAjau bhIShma sambodhanena vai
shlokas.16:
evaM kuruShva kauravya prabhAte rathamAsthitaH |
prasuptaM vA mRRitaM vApi tulyaM manyAmahe vayam
shlokas.17:
na cha rAmeNa martavyaM kadAchidapi pArthiva |
tataH samutpannamidaM prasvApaM yujyatAmiti
shlokas.18:
ityuktvAntarhitA rAjansarva eva dvijottamAH |
aShTau sadRRisharUpAste sarve bhAsvaramUrtayaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato rAtryAM vyatItAyAM pratibuddho.asmi bhArata |
taM cha sa~nchintya vai svapnamavApaM harShamuttamam
shlokas.2:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM mama tasya cha bhArata |
tumulaM sarvabhUtAnAM lomaharShaNamadbhutam
shlokas.3:
tato bANamayaM varShaM vavarSha mayi bhArgavaH |
nyavArayamahaM taM cha sharajAlena bhArata
shlokas.4:
tataH paramasa~NkruddhaH punareva mahAtapAH |
hyastanenaiva kopena shaktiM vai prAhiNonmayi
shlokas.5:
indrAshanisamasparshAM yamadaNDopamaprabhAm |
jvalantImagnivatsa~Nkhye lelihAnAM samantataH
shlokas.6:
tato bharatashArdUla dhiShNyamAkAshagaM yathA |
sA mAmabhyahanattUrNama.nsadeshe cha bhArata
shlokas.7:
athAsRRi~Nme.asravadghoraM girergairikadhAtuvat |
rAmeNa sumahAbAho kShatasya kShatajekShaNa
shlokas.8:
tato.ahaM jAmadagnyAya bhRRishaM krodhasamanvitaH |
preShayaM mRRityusa~NkAshaM bANaM sarpaviShopamam
shlokas.9:
sa tenAbhihato vIro lalATe dvijasattamaH |
ashobhata mahArAja sashRRi~Nga iva parvataH
shlokas.10:
sa sa.nrabdhaH samAvRRitya bANaM kAlAntakopamam |
sa.ndadhe balavatkRRiShya ghoraM shatrunibarhaNam
shlokas.11:
sa vakShasi papAtograH sharo vyAla iva shvasan |
mahIM rAja.nstatashchAhamagachChaM rudhirAvilaH
shlokas.12:
avApya tu punaH sa~nj~nAM jAmadagnyAya dhImate |
prAhiNvaM vimalAM shaktiM jvalantImashanImiva
shlokas.13:
sA tasya dvijamukhyasya nipapAta bhujAntare |
vihvalashchAbhavadrAjanvepathushchainamAvishat
shlokas.14:
tata enaM pariShvajya sakhA vipro mahAtapAH |
akRRitavraNaH shubhairvAkyairAshvAsayadanekadhA
shlokas.15:
samAshvastastadA rAmaH krodhAmarShasamanvitaH |
prAdushchakre tadA brAhmaM paramAstraM mahAvrataH
shlokas.16:
tatastatpratighAtArthaM brAhmamevAstramuttamam |
mayA prayuktaM jajvAla yugAntamiva darshayat
shlokas.17:
tayorbrahmAstrayorAsIdantarA vai samAgamaH |
asamprApyaiva rAmaM cha mAM cha bhAratasattama
shlokas.18:
tato vyomni prAdurabhUtteja eva hi kevalam |
bhUtAni chaiva sarvANi jagmurArtiM vishAM pate
shlokas.19:
RRiShayashcha sagandharvA devatAshchaiva bhArata |
santApaM paramaM jagmurastratejobhipIDitAH
shlokas.20:
tatashchachAla pRRithivI saparvatavanadrumA |
santaptAni cha bhUtAni viShAdaM jagmuruttamam
shlokas.21:
prajajvAla nabho rAjandhUmAyante disho dasha |
na sthAtumantarikShe cha shekurAkAshagAstadA
shlokas.22:
tato hAhAkRRite loke sadevAsurarAkShase |
idamantaramityeva yoktukAmo.asmi bhArata
shlokas.23:
prasvApamastraM dayitaM vachanAdbrahmavAdinAm |
chintitaM cha tadastraM me manasi pratyabhAttadA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato halahalAshabdo divi rAjanmahAnabhUt |
prasvApaM bhIShma mA srAkShIriti kauravanandana
shlokas.2:
ayu~njameva chaivAhaM tadastraM bhRRigunandane |
prasvApaM mAM prayu~njAnaM nArado vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
ete viyati kauravya divi devagaNAH sthitAH |
te tvAM nivArayantyadya prasvApaM mA prayojaya
shlokas.4:
rAmastapasvI brahmaNyo brAhmaNashcha gurushcha te |
tasyAvamAnaM kauravya mA sma kArShIH katha~nchana
shlokas.5:
tato.apashyaM diviShThAnvai tAnaShTau brahmavAdinaH |
te mAM smayanto rAjendra shanakairidamabruvan
shlokas.6:
yathAha bharatashreShTha nAradastattathA kuru |
etaddhi paramaM shreyo lokAnAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.7:
tatashcha pratisaMhRRitya tadastraM svApanaM mRRidhe |
brahmAstraM dIpayAM chakre tasminyudhi yathAvidhi
shlokas.8:
tato rAmo ruShito rAjaputra; dRRiShTvA tadastraM vinivartitaM vai |
jito.asmi bhIShmeNa sumandabuddhi;rityeva vAkyaM sahasA vyamu~nchat
shlokas.9:
tato.apashyatpitaraM jAmadagnyaH; pitustathA pitaraM tasya chAnyam |
ta evainaM samparivArya tasthu;rUchushchainaM sAntvapUrvaM tadAnIm
shlokas.10:
mA smaivaM sAhasaM vatsa punaH kArShIH katha~nchana |
bhIShmeNa sa.nyugaM gantuM kShatriyeNa visheShataH
shlokas.11:
kShatriyasya tu dharmo.ayaM yadyuddhaM bhRRigunandana |
svAdhyAyo vratacharyA cha brAhmaNAnAM paraM dhanam
shlokas.12:
idaM nimitte kasmi.nshchidasmAbhirupamantritam |
shastradhAraNamatyugraM tachcha kAryaM kRRitaM tvayA
shlokas.13:
vatsa paryAptametAvadbhIShmeNa saha sa.nyuge |
vimardaste mahAbAho vyapayAhi raNAditaH
shlokas.14:
paryAptametadbhadraM te tava kArmukadhAraNam |
visarjayaitaddurdharSha tapastapyasva bhArgava
shlokas.15:
eSha bhIShmaH shAntanavo devaiH sarvairnivAritaH |
nivartasva raNAdasmAditi chaiva prachoditaH
shlokas.16:
rAmeNa saha mA yotsIrguruNeti punaH punaH |
na hi rAmo raNe jetuM tvayA nyAyyaH kurUdvaha
mAnaM kuruShva gA~Ngeya brAhmaNasya raNAjire
shlokas.17:
vayaM tu guravastubhyaM tatastvAM vArayAmahe |
bhIShmo vasUnAmanyatamo diShTyA jIvasi putraka
shlokas.18:
gA~NgeyaH shantanoH putro vasureSha mahAyashAH |
kathaM tvayA raNe jetuM rAma shakyo nivarta vai
shlokas.19:
arjunaH pANDavashreShThaH pura.ndarasuto balI |
naraH prajApatirvIraH pUrvadevaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.20:
savyasAchIti vikhyAtastriShu lokeShu vIryavAn |
bhIShmamRRityuryathAkAlaM vihito vai svayambhuvA
shlokas.21:
evamuktaH sa pitRRibhiH pitR^InrAmo.abravIdidam |
nAhaM yudhi nivarteyamiti me vratamAhitam
shlokas.22:
na nivartitapUrvaM cha kadAchidraNamUrdhani |
nivartyatAmApageyaH kAmaM yuddhAtpitAmahAH
na tvahaM vinivartiShye yuddhAdasmAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.23:
tataste munayo rAjannRRichIkapramukhAstadA |
nAradenaiva sahitAH samAgamyedamabruvan
shlokas.24:
nivartasva raNAttAta mAnayasva dvijottamAn |
netyavochamahaM tA.nshcha kShatradharmavyapekShayA
shlokas.25:
mama vratamidaM loke nAhaM yuddhAtkatha~nchana |
vimukho vinivarteyaM pRRiShThato.abhyAhataH sharaiH
shlokas.26:
nAhaM lobhAnna kArpaNyAnna bhayAnnArthakAraNAt |
tyajeyaM shAshvataM dharmamiti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.27:
tataste munayaH sarve nAradapramukhA nRRipa |
bhAgIrathI cha me mAtA raNamadhyaM prapedire
shlokas.28:
tathaivAttasharo dhanvI tathaiva dRRiDhanishchayaH |
sthito.ahamAhave yoddhuM tataste rAmamabruvan
sametya sahitA bhUyaH samare bhRRigunandanam
shlokas.29:
nAvanItaM hi hRRidayaM viprANAM shAmya bhArgava |
rAma rAma nivartasva yuddhAdasmAddvijottama
avadhyo hi tvayA bhIShmastvaM cha bhIShmasya bhArgava
shlokas.30:
evaM bruvantaste sarve pratirudhya raNAjiram |
nyAsayAM chakrire shastraM pitaro bhRRigunandanam
shlokas.31:
tato.ahaM punarevAtha tAnaShTau brahmavAdinaH |
adrAkShaM dIpyamAnAnvai grahAnaShTAvivoditAn
shlokas.32:
te mAM sapraNayaM vAkyamabruvansamare sthitam |
praihi rAmaM mahAbAho guruM lokahitaM kuru
shlokas.33:
dRRiShTvA nivartitaM rAmaM suhRRidvAkyena tena vai |
lokAnAM cha hitaM kurvannahamapyAdade vachaH
shlokas.34:
tato.ahaM rAmamAsAdya vavande bhRRishavikShataH |
rAmashchAbhyutsmayanpremNA mAmuvAcha mahAtapAH
shlokas.35:
tvatsamo nAsti loke.asminkShatriyaH pRRithivIcharaH |
gamyatAM bhIShma yuddhe.asmi.nstoShito.ahaM bhRRishaM tvayA
shlokas.36:
mama chaiva samakShaM tAM kanyAmAhUya bhArgavaH |
uvAcha dInayA vAchA madhye teShAM tapasvinAm

shlokas.1:
rAma uvAcha||
pratyakShametallokAnAM sarveShAmeva bhAmini |
yathA mayA paraM shaktyA kRRitaM vai pauruShaM mahat
shlokas.2:
na chaiva yudhi shaknomi bhIShmaM shastrabhRRitAM varam |
visheShayitumatyarthamuttamAstrANi darshayan
shlokas.3:
eShA me paramA shaktiretanme paramaM balam |
yatheShTaM gamyatAM bhadre kimanyadvA karomi te
shlokas.4:
bhIShmameva prapadyasva na te.anyA vidyate gatiH |
nirjito hyasmi bhIShmeNa mahAstrANi pramu~nchatA
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA tato rAmo viniHshvasya mahAmanAH |
tUShNImAsIttadA kanyA provAcha bhRRigunandanam
shlokas.6:
bhagavannevamevaitadyathAha bhagavA.nstathA |
ajeyo yudhi bhIShmo.ayamapi devairudAradhIH
shlokas.7:
yathAshakti yathotsAhaM mama kAryaM kRRitaM tvayA |
anidhAya raNe vIryamastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.8:
na chaiSha shakyate yuddhe visheShayitumantataH |
na chAhamenaM yAsyAmi punarbhIShmaM katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
gamiShyAmi tu tatrAhaM yatra bhIShmaM tapodhana |
samare pAtayiShyAmi svayameva bhRRigUdvaha
shlokas.10:
evamuktvA yayau kanyA roShavyAkulalochanA |
tapase dhRRitasa~NkalpA mama chintayatI vadham
shlokas.11:
tato mahendraM saha tairmunibhirbhRRigusattamaH |
yathAgataM yayau rAmo mAmupAmantrya bhArata
shlokas.12:
tato.ahaM rathamAruhya stUyamAno dvijAtibhiH |
pravishya nagaraM mAtre satyavatyai nyavedayam
yathAvRRittaM mahArAja sA cha mAM pratyanandata
shlokas.13:
puruShA.nshchAdishaM prAj~nAnkanyAvRRittAntakarmaNi |
divase divase hyasyA gatajalpitacheShTitam
pratyAhara.nshcha me yuktAH sthitAH priyahite mama
shlokas.14:
yadaiva hi vanaM prAyAtkanyA sA tapase dhRRitA |
tadaiva vyathito dIno gatachetA ivAbhavam
shlokas.15:
na hi mAM kShatriyaH kashchidvIryeNa vijayedyudhi |
RRite brahmavidastAta tapasA sa.nshitavratAt
shlokas.16:
api chaitanmayA rAjannArade.api niveditam |
vyAse chaiva bhayAtkAryaM tau chobhau mAmavochatAm
shlokas.17:
na viShAdastvayA kAryo bhIShma kAshisutAM prati |
daivaM puruShakAreNa ko nivartitumutsahet
shlokas.18:
sA tu kanyA mahArAja pravishyAshramamaNDalam |
yamunAtIramAshritya tapastepe.atimAnuSham
shlokas.19:
nirAhArA kRRishA rUkShA jaTilA malapa~NkinI |
ShaNmAsAnvAyubhakShA cha sthANubhUtA tapodhanA
shlokas.20:
yamunAtIramAsAdya sa.nvatsaramathAparam |
udavAsaM nirAhArA pArayAmAsa bhAminI
shlokas.21:
shIrNaparNena chaikena pArayAmAsa chAparam |
sa.nvatsaraM tIvrakopA pAdA~NguShThAgradhiShThitA
shlokas.22:
evaM dvAdasha varShANi tApayAmAsa rodasI |
nivartyamAnApi tu sA j~nAtibhirnaiva shakyate
shlokas.23:
tato.agamadvatsabhUmiM siddhachAraNasevitAm |
AshramaM puNyashIlAnAM tApasAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.24:
tatra puNyeShu desheShu sAplutA~NgI divAnisham |
vyacharatkAshikanyA sA yathAkAmavichAriNI
shlokas.25:
nandAshrame mahArAja tatolUkAshrame shubhe |
chyavanasyAshrame chaiva brahmaNaH sthAna eva cha
shlokas.26:
prayAge devayajane devAraNyeShu chaiva ha |
bhogavatyAM tathA rAjankaushikasyAshrame tathA
shlokas.27:
mANDavyasyAshrame rAjandilIpasyAshrame tathA |
rAmahrade cha kauravya pailagArgyasya chAshrame
shlokas.28:
eteShu tIrtheShu tadA kAshikanyA vishAM pate |
AplAvayata gAtrANi tIvramAsthAya vai tapaH
shlokas.29:
tAmabravItkauraveya mama mAtA jalotthitA |
kimarthaM klishyase bhadre tathyametadbravIhi me
shlokas.30:
sainAmathAbravIdrAjankRRitA~njaliraninditA |
bhIShmo rAmeNa samare na jitashchArulochane
shlokas.31:
ko.anyastamutsahejjetumudyateShuM mahIpatim |
sAhaM bhIShmavinAshAya tapastapsye sudAruNam
shlokas.32:
charAmi pRRithivIM devi yathA hanyAmahaM nRRipam |
etadvrataphalaM dehe parasminsyAdyathA hi me
shlokas.33:
tato.abravItsAgaragA jihmaM charasi bhAmini |
naiSha kAmo.anavadyA~Ngi shakyaH prAptuM tvayAbale
shlokas.34:
yadi bhIShmavinAshAya kAshye charasi vai vratam |
vratasthA cha sharIraM tvaM yadi nAma vimokShyasi
nadI bhaviShyasi shubhe kuTilA vArShikodakA
shlokas.35:
dustIrthA chAnabhij~neyA vArShikI nAShTamAsikI |
bhImagrAhavatI ghorA sarvabhUtabhaya~NkarI
shlokas.36:
evamuktvA tato rAjankAshikanyAM nyavartata |
mAtA mama mahAbhAgA smayamAneva bhAminI
shlokas.37:
kadAchidaShTame mAsi kadAchiddashame tathA |
na prAshnItodakamapi punaH sA varavarNinI
shlokas.38:
sA vatsabhUmiM kauravya tIrthalobhAttatastataH |
patitA paridhAvantI punaH kAshipateH sutA
shlokas.39:
sA nadI vatsabhUmyAM tu prathitAmbeti bhArata |
vArShikI grAhabahulA dustIrthA kuTilA tathA
shlokas.40:
sA kanyA tapasA tena bhAgArdhena vyajAyata |
nadI cha rAjanvatseShu kanyA chaivAbhavattadA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataste tApasAH sarve tapase dhRRitanishchayAm |
dRRiShTvA nyavartaya.nstAta kiM kAryamiti chAbruvan
shlokas.2:
tAnuvAcha tataH kanyA tapovRRiddhAnRRiShI.nstadA |
nirAkRRitAsmi bhIShmeNa bhra.nshitA patidharmataH
shlokas.3:
vadhArthaM tasya dIkShA me na lokArthaM tapodhanAH |
nihatya bhIShmaM gachCheyaM shAntimityeva nishchayaH
shlokas.4:
yatkRRite duHkhavasatimimAM prAptAsmi shAshvatIm |
patilokAdvihInA cha naiva strI na pumAniha
shlokas.5:
nAhatvA yudhi gA~NgeyaM nivarteyaM tapodhanAH |
eSha me hRRidi sa~Nkalpo yadarthamidamudyatam
shlokas.6:
strIbhAve parinirviNNA pu.nstvArthe kRRitanishchayA |
bhIShme pratichikIrShAmi nAsmi vAryeti vai punaH
shlokas.7:
tAM devo darshayAmAsa shUlapANirumApatiH |
madhye teShAM maharShINAM svena rUpeNa bhAminIm
shlokas.8:
ChandyamAnA vareNAtha sA vavre matparAjayam |
vadhiShyasIti tAM devaH pratyuvAcha manasvinIm
shlokas.9:
tataH sA punarevAtha kanyA rudramuvAcha ha |
upapadyetkathaM deva striyo mama jayo yudhi
strIbhAvena cha me gADhaM manaH shAntamumApate
shlokas.10:
pratishrutashcha bhUtesha tvayA bhIShmaparAjayaH |
yathA sa satyo bhavati tathA kuru vRRiShadhvaja
yathA hanyAM samAgamya bhIShmaM shAntanavaM yudhi
shlokas.11:
tAmuvAcha mahAdevaH kanyAM kila vRRiShadhvajaH |
na me vAganRRitaM bhadre prAha satyaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
vadhiShyasi raNe bhIShmaM puruShatvaM cha lapsyase |
smariShyasi cha tatsarvaM dehamanyaM gatA satI
shlokas.13:
drupadasya kule jAtA bhaviShyasi mahArathaH |
shIghrAstrashchitrayodhI cha bhaviShyasi susaMmataH
shlokas.14:
yathoktameva kalyANi sarvametadbhaviShyati |
bhaviShyasi pumAnpashchAtkasmAchchitkAlaparyayAt
shlokas.15:
evamuktvA mahAtejAH kapardI vRRiShabhadhvajaH |
pashyatAmeva viprANAM tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.16:
tataH sA pashyatAM teShAM maharShINAmaninditA |
samAhRRitya vanAttasmAtkAShThAni varavarNinI
shlokas.17:
chitAM kRRitvA sumahatIM pradAya cha hutAshanam |
pradIpte.agnau mahArAja roShadIptena chetasA
shlokas.18:
uktvA bhIShmavadhAyeti pravivesha hutAshanam |
jyeShThA kAshisutA rAjanyamunAmabhito nadIm

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
kathaM shikhaNDI gA~Ngeya kanyA bhUtvA satI tadA |
puruSho.abhavadyudhi shreShTha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
bhAryA tu tasya rAjendra drupadasya mahIpateH |
mahiShI dayitA hyAsIdaputrA cha vishAM pate
shlokas.3:
etasminneva kAle tu drupado vai mahIpatiH |
apatyArthaM mahArAja toShayAmAsa sha~Nkaram
shlokas.4:
asmadvadhArthaM nishchitya tapo ghoraM samAsthitaH |
lebhe kanyAM mahAdevAtputro me syAditi bruvan
shlokas.5:
bhagavanputramichChAmi bhIShmaM pratichikIrShayA |
ityukto devadevena strIpumA.nste bhaviShyati
shlokas.6:
nivartasva mahIpAla naitajjAtvanyathA bhavet |
sa tu gatvA cha nagaraM bhAryAmidamuvAcha ha
shlokas.7:
kRRito yatno mayA devi putrArthe tapasA mahAn |
kanyA bhUtvA pumAnbhAvI iti chokto.asmi shambhunA
shlokas.8:
punaH punaryAchyamAno diShTamityabravIchChivaH |
na tadanyaddhi bhavitA bhavitavyaM hi tattathA
shlokas.9:
tataH sA niyatA bhUtvA RRitukAle manasvinI |
patnI drupadarAjasya drupadaM sa.nvivesha ha
shlokas.10:
lebhe garbhaM yathAkAlaM vidhidRRiShTena hetunA |
pArShatAtsA mahIpAla yathA mAM nArado.abravIt
shlokas.11:
tato dadhAra taM garbhaM devI rAjIvalochanA |
tAM sa rAjA priyAM bhAryAM drupadaH kurunandana
putrasnehAnmahAbAhuH sukhaM paryacharattadA
shlokas.12:
aputrasya tato rAj~no drupadasya mahIpateH |
kanyAM pravararUpAM tAM prAjAyata narAdhipa
shlokas.13:
aputrasya tu rAj~naH sA drupadasya yashasvinI |
khyApayAmAsa rAjendra putro jAto mameti vai
shlokas.14:
tataH sa rAjA drupadaH prachChannAyA narAdhipa |
putravatputrakAryANi sarvANi samakArayat
shlokas.15:
rakShaNaM chaiva mantrasya mahiShI drupadasya sA |
chakAra sarvayatnena bruvANA putra ityuta
na hi tAM veda nagare kashchidanyatra pArShatAt
shlokas.16:
shraddadhAno hi tadvAkyaM devasyAdbhutatejasaH |
ChAdayAmAsa tAM kanyAM pumAniti cha so.abravIt
shlokas.17:
jAtakarmANi sarvANi kArayAmAsa pArthivaH |
pu.nvadvidhAnayuktAni shikhaNDIti cha tAM viduH
shlokas.18:
ahamekastu chAreNa vachanAnnAradasya cha |
j~nAtavAndevavAkyena ambAyAstapasA tathA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
chakAra yatnaM drupadaH sarvasminsvajane mahat |
tato lekhyAdiShu tathA shilpeShu cha paraM gatA
iShvastre chaiva rAjendra droNashiShyo babhUva ha
shlokas.2:
tasya mAtA mahArAja rAjAnaM varavarNinI |
chodayAmAsa bhAryArthaM kanyAyAH putravattadA
shlokas.3:
tatastAM pArShato dRRiShTvA kanyAM samprAptayauvanAm |
striyaM matvA tadA chintAM prapede saha bhAryayA
shlokas.4:
drupada uvAcha||
kanyA mameyaM samprAptA yauvanaM shokavardhinI |
mayA prachChAditA cheyaM vachanAchChUlapANinaH
shlokas.5:
na tanmithyA mahArAj~ni bhaviShyati katha~nchana |
trailokyakartA kasmAddhi tanmRRiShA kartumarhati
shlokas.6:
bhAryovAcha||
yadi te rochate rAjanvakShyAmi shRRiNu me vachaH |
shrutvedAnIM prapadyethAH svakAryaM pRRiShatAtmaja
shlokas.7:
kriyatAmasya nRRipate vidhivaddArasa~NgrahaH |
satyaM bhavati tadvAkyamiti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastau nishchayaM kRRitvA tasminkArye.atha dampatI |
varayAM chakratuH kanyAM dashArNAdhipateH sutAm
shlokas.9:
tato rAjA drupado rAjasiMhaH; sarvAnrAj~naH kulataH saMnishAmya |
dAshArNakasya nRRipatestanUjAM; shikhaNDine varayAmAsa dArAn
shlokas.10:
hiraNyavarmeti nRRipo yo.asau dAshArNakaH smRRitaH |
sa cha prAdAnmahIpAlaH kanyAM tasmai shikhaNDine
shlokas.11:
sa cha rAjA dashArNeShu mahAnAsInmahIpatiH |
hiraNyavarmA durdharSho mahAseno mahAmanAH
shlokas.12:
kRRite vivAhe tu tadA sA kanyA rAjasattama |
yauvanaM samanuprAptA sA cha kanyA shikhaNDinI
shlokas.13:
kRRitadAraH shikhaNDI tu kAmpilyaM punarAgamat |
na cha sA veda tAM kanyAM ka~nchitkAlaM striyaM kila
shlokas.14:
hiraNyavarmaNaH kanyA j~nAtvA tAM tu shikhaNDinIm |
dhAtrINAM cha sakhInAM cha vrIDamAnA nyavedayat
kanyAM pa~nchAlarAjasya sutAM tAM vai shikhaNDinIm
shlokas.15:
tatastA rAjashArdUla dhAtryo dAshArNikAstadA |
jagmurArtiM parAM duHkhAtpreShayAmAsureva cha
shlokas.16:
tato dashArNAdhipateH preShyAH sarvaM nyavedayan |
vipralambhaM yathAvRRittaM sa cha chukrodha pArthivaH
shlokas.17:
shikhaNDyapi mahArAja pu.nvadrAjakule tadA |
vijahAra mudA yuktaH strItvaM naivAtirochayan
shlokas.18:
tataH katipayAhasya tachChrutvA bharatarShabha |
hiraNyavarmA rAjendra roShAdArtiM jagAma ha
shlokas.19:
tato dAshArNako rAjA tIvrakopasamanvitaH |
dUtaM prasthApayAmAsa drupadasya niveshane
shlokas.20:
tato drupadamAsAdya dUtaH kA~nchanavarmaNaH |
eka ekAntamutsArya raho vachanamabravIt
shlokas.21:
dashArNarAjo rAja.nstvAmidaM vachanamabravIt |
abhiSha~NgAtprakupito vipralabdhastvayAnagha
shlokas.22:
avamanyase mAM nRRipate nUnaM durmantritaM tava |
yanme kanyAM svakanyArthe mohAdyAchitavAnasi
shlokas.23:
tasyAdya vipralambhasya phalaM prApnuhi durmate |
eSha tvAM sajanAmAtyamuddharAmi sthiro bhava

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktasya dUtena drupadasya tadA nRRipa |
chorasyeva gRRihItasya na prAvartata bhAratI
shlokas.2:
sa yatnamakarottIvraM sambandhairanusAntvanaiH |
dUtairmadhurasambhAShairnaitadastIti sa.ndishan
shlokas.3:
sa rAjA bhUya evAtha kRRitvA tattvata Agamam |
kanyeti pA~nchAlasutAM tvaramANo.abhiniryayau
shlokas.4:
tataH sampreShayAmAsa mitrANAmamitaujasAm |
duhiturvipralambhaM taM dhAtrINAM vachanAttadA
shlokas.5:
tataH samudayaM kRRitvA balAnAM rAjasattamaH |
abhiyAne matiM chakre drupadaM prati bhArata
shlokas.6:
tataH saMmantrayAmAsa mitraiH saha mahIpatiH |
hiraNyavarmA rAjendra pA~nchAlyaM pArthivaM prati
shlokas.7:
tatra vai nishchitaM teShAmabhUdrAj~nAM mahAtmanAm |
tathyaM chedbhavati hyetatkanyA rAja~nshikhaNDinI
baddhvA pA~nchAlarAjAnamAnayiShyAmahe gRRihAn
shlokas.8:
anyaM rAjAnamAdhAya pA~nchAleShu nareshvaram |
ghAtayiShyAma nRRipatiM drupadaM sashikhaNDinam
shlokas.9:
sa tadA dUtamAj~nAya punaH kShattAramIshvaraH |
prAsthApayatpArShatAya hanmIti tvAM sthiro bhava
shlokas.10:
sa prakRRityA cha vai bhIruH kilbiShI cha narAdhipaH |
bhayaM tIvramanuprApto drupadaH pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.11:
visRRijya dUtaM dAshArNaM drupadaH shokakarshitaH |
sametya bhAryAM rahite vAkyamAha narAdhipaH
shlokas.12:
bhayena mahatAviShTo hRRidi shokena chAhataH |
pA~nchAlarAjo dayitAM mAtaraM vai shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.13:
abhiyAsyati mAM kopAtsambandhI sumahAbalaH |
hiraNyavarmA nRRipatiH karShamANo varUthinIm
shlokas.14:
kimidAnIM kariShyAmi mUDhaH kanyAmimAM prati |
shikhaNDI kila putraste kanyeti parisha~NkitaH
shlokas.15:
iti nishchitya tattvena samitraH sabalAnugaH |
va~nchito.asmIti manvAno mAM kiloddhartumichChati
shlokas.16:
kimatra tathyaM sushroNi kiM mithyA brUhi shobhane |
shrutvA tvattaH shubhe vAkyaM sa.nvidhAsyAmyahaM tathA
shlokas.17:
ahaM hi sa.nshayaM prApto bAlA cheyaM shikhaNDinI |
tvaM cha rAj~ni mahatkRRichChraM samprAptA varavarNini
shlokas.18:
sA tvaM sarvavimokShAya tattvamAkhyAhi pRRichChataH |
tathA vidadhyAM sushroNi kRRityasyAsya shuchismite
shikhaNDini cha mA bhaistvaM vidhAsye tatra tattvataH
shlokas.19:
kriyayAhaM varArohe va~nchitaH putradharmataH |
mayA dAshArNako rAjA va~nchitashcha mahIpatiH
tadAchakShva mahAbhAge vidhAsye tatra yaddhitam
shlokas.20:
jAnatApi narendreNa khyApanArthaM parasya vai |
prakAshaM choditA devI pratyuvAcha mahIpatim

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH shikhaNDino mAtA yathAtattvaM narAdhipa |
AchachakShe mahAbAho bhartre kanyAM shikhaNDinIm
shlokas.2:
aputrayA mayA rAjansapatnInAM bhayAdidam |
kanyA shikhaNDinI jAtA puruSho vai niveditaH
shlokas.3:
tvayA chaiva narashreShTha tanme prItyAnumoditam |
putrakarma kRRitaM chaiva kanyAyAH pArthivarShabha
bhAryA choDhA tvayA rAjandashArNAdhipateH sutA
shlokas.4:
tvayA cha prAgabhihitaM devavAkyArthadarshanAt |
kanyA bhUtvA pumAnbhAvItyevaM chaitadupekShitam
shlokas.5:
etachChrutvA drupado yaj~nasenaH; sarvaM tattvaM mantravidbhyo nivedya |
mantraM rAjA mantrayAmAsa rAja;nyadyadyuktaM rakShaNe vai prajAnAm
shlokas.6:
sambandhakaM chaiva samarthya tasmi;ndAshArNake vai nRRipatau narendra |
svayaM kRRitvA vipralambhaM yathAva;nmantraikAgro nishchayaM vai jagAma
shlokas.7:
svabhAvaguptaM nagaramApatkAle tu bhArata |
gopayAmAsa rAjendra sarvataH samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.8:
ArtiM cha paramAM rAjA jagAma saha bhAryayA |
dashArNapatinA sArdhaM virodhe bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
kathaM sambandhinA sArdhaM na me syAdvigraho mahAn |
iti sa~nchintya manasA daivatAnyarchayattadA
shlokas.10:
taM tu dRRiShTvA tadA rAjandevI devaparaM tathA |
archAM prayu~njAnamatho bhAryA vachanamabravIt
shlokas.11:
devAnAM pratipattishcha satyA sAdhumatA sadA |
sA tu duHkhArNavaM prApya naH syAdarchayatAM bhRRisham
shlokas.12:
daivatAni cha sarvANi pUjyantAM bhUridakShiNaiH |
agnayashchApi hUyantAM dAshArNapratiShedhane
shlokas.13:
ayuddhena nivRRittiM cha manasA chintayAbhibho |
devatAnAM prasAdena sarvametadbhaviShyati
shlokas.14:
mantribhirmantritaM sArdhaM tvayA yatpRRithulochana |
purasyAsyAvinAshAya tachcha rAja.nstathA kuru
shlokas.15:
daivaM hi mAnuShopetaM bhRRishaM sidhyati pArthiva |
parasparavirodhAttu nAnayoH siddhirasti vai
shlokas.16:
tasmAdvidhAya nagare vidhAnaM sachivaiH saha |
archayasva yathAkAmaM daivatAni vishAM pate
shlokas.17:
evaM sambhAShamANau tau dRRiShTvA shokaparAyaNau |
shikhaNDinI tadA kanyA vrIDiteva manasvinI
shlokas.18:
tataH sA chintayAmAsa matkRRite duHkhitAvubhau |
imAviti tatashchakre matiM prANavinAshane
shlokas.19:
evaM sA nishchayaM kRRitvA bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNA |
jagAma bhavanaM tyaktvA gahanaM nirjanaM vanam
shlokas.20:
yakSheNarddhimatA rAjansthUNAkarNena pAlitam |
tadbhayAdeva cha jano visarjayati tadvanam
shlokas.21:
tatra sthUNasya bhavanaM sudhAmRRittikalepanam |
lAjollApikadhUmADhyamuchchaprAkAratoraNam
shlokas.22:
tatpravishya shikhaNDI sA drupadasyAtmajA nRRipa |
anashnatI bahutithaM sharIramupashoShayat
shlokas.23:
darshayAmAsa tAM yakShaH sthUNo madhvakShasa.nyutaH |
kimartho.ayaM tavArambhaH kariShye brUhi mAchiram
shlokas.24:
ashakyamiti sA yakShaM punaH punaruvAcha ha |
kariShyAmIti chainAM sa pratyuvAchAtha guhyakaH
shlokas.25:
dhaneshvarasyAnucharo varado.asmi nRRipAtmaje |
adeyamapi dAsyAmi brUhi yatte vivakShitam
shlokas.26:
tataH shikhaNDI tatsarvamakhilena nyavedayat |
tasmai yakShapradhAnAya sthUNAkarNAya bhArata
shlokas.27:
Apanno me pitA yakSha nachirAdvinashiShyati |
abhiyAsyati sa~Nkruddho dashArNAdhipatirhi tam
shlokas.28:
mahAbalo mahotsAhaH sa hemakavacho nRRipaH |
tasmAdrakShasva mAM yakSha pitaraM mAtaraM cha me
shlokas.29:
pratij~nAto hi bhavatA duHkhapratinayo mama |
bhaveyaM puruSho yakSha tvatprasAdAdaninditaH
shlokas.30:
yAvadeva sa rAjA vai nopayAti puraM mama |
tAvadeva mahAyakSha prasAdaM kuru guhyaka

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shikhaNDivAkyaM shrutvAtha sa yakSho bharatarShabha |
provAcha manasA chintya daivenopanipIDitaH
bhavitavyaM tathA taddhi mama duHkhAya kaurava
shlokas.2:
bhadre kAmaM kariShyAmi samayaM tu nibodha me |
ki~nchitkAlAntaraM dAsye pu.nli~NgaM svamidaM tava
AgantavyaM tvayA kAle satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.3:
prabhuH sa~Nkalpasiddho.asmi kAmarUpI viha~NgamaH |
matprasAdAtpuraM chaiva trAhi bandhU.nshcha kevalAn
shlokas.4:
strIli~NgaM dhArayiShyAmi tvadIyaM pArthivAtmaje |
satyaM me pratijAnIhi kariShyAmi priyaM tava
shlokas.5:
shikhaNDyuvAcha||
pratidAsyAmi bhagava.Nlli~NgaM punaridaM tava |
ki~nchitkAlAntaraM strItvaM dhArayasva nishAchara
shlokas.6:
pratiprayAte dAshArNe pArthive hemavarmaNi |
kanyaivAhaM bhaviShyAmi puruShastvaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktvA samayaM tatra chakrAte tAvubhau nRRipa |
anyonyasyAnabhidrohe tau sa~NkrAmayatAM tataH
shlokas.8:
strIli~NgaM dhArayAmAsa sthUNo yakSho narAdhipa |
yakSharUpaM cha taddIptaM shikhaNDI pratyapadyata
shlokas.9:
tataH shikhaNDI pA~nchAlyaH pu.nstvamAsAdya pArthiva |
vivesha nagaraM hRRiShTaH pitaraM cha samAsadat
yathAvRRittaM tu tatsarvamAchakhyau drupadasya cha
shlokas.10:
drupadastasya tachChrutvA harShamAhArayatparam |
sabhAryastachcha sasmAra maheshvaravachastadA
shlokas.11:
tataH sampreShayAmAsa dashArNAdhipaternRRipa |
puruSho.ayaM mama sutaH shraddhattAM me bhavAniti
shlokas.12:
atha dAshArNako rAjA sahasAbhyAgamattadA |
pA~nchAlarAjaM drupadaM duHkhAmarShasamanvitaH
shlokas.13:
tataH kAmpilyamAsAdya dashArNAdhipatistadA |
preShayAmAsa satkRRitya dUtaM brahmavidAM varam
shlokas.14:
brUhi madvachanAddUta pA~nchAlyaM taM nRRipAdhamam |
yadvai kanyAM svakanyArthe vRRitavAnasi durmate
phalaM tasyAvalepasya drakShyasyadya na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.15:
evamuktastu tenAsau brAhmaNo rAjasattama |
dUtaH prayAto nagaraM dAshArNanRRipachoditaH
shlokas.16:
tata AsAdayAmAsa purodhA drupadaM pure |
tasmai pA~nchAlako rAjA gAmarghyaM cha susatkRRitam
prApayAmAsa rAjendra saha tena shikhaNDinA
shlokas.17:
tAM pUjAM nAbhyanandatsa vAkyaM chedamuvAcha ha |
yaduktaM tena vIreNa rAj~nA kA~nchanavarmaNA
shlokas.18:
yatte.ahamadhamAchAra duhitrarthe.asmi va~nchitaH |
tasya pApasya karaNAtphalaM prApnuhi durmate
shlokas.19:
dehi yuddhaM narapate mamAdya raNamUrdhani |
uddhariShyAmi te sadyaH sAmAtyasutabAndhavam
shlokas.20:
tadupAlambhasa.nyuktaM shrAvitaH kila pArthivaH |
dashArNapatidUtena mantrimadhye purodhasA
shlokas.21:
abravIdbharatashreShTha drupadaH praNayAnataH |
yadAha mAM bhavAnbrahmansambandhivachanAdvachaH
tasyottaraM prativacho dUta eva vadiShyati
shlokas.22:
tataH sampreShayAmAsa drupado.api mahAtmane |
hiraNyavarmaNe dUtaM brAhmaNaM vedapAragam
shlokas.23:
samAgamya tu rAj~nA sa dashArNapatinA tadA |
tadvAkyamAdade rAjanyaduktaM drupadena ha
shlokas.24:
AgamaH kriyatAM vyaktaM kumAro vai suto mama |
mithyaitaduktaM kenApi tanna shraddheyamityuta
shlokas.25:
tataH sa rAjA drupadasya shrutvA; vimarshayukto yuvatIrvariShThAH |
sampreShayAmAsa suchArurUpAH; shikhaNDinaM strI pumAnveti vettum
shlokas.26:
tAH preShitAstattvabhAvaM viditvA; prItyA rAj~ne tachChasha.nsurhi sarvam |
shikhaNDinaM puruShaM kauravendra; dashArNarAjAya mahAnubhAvam
shlokas.27:
tataH kRRitvA tu rAjA sa AgamaM prItimAnatha |
sambandhinA samAgamya hRRiShTo vAsamuvAsa ha
shlokas.28:
shikhaNDine cha muditaH prAdAdvittaM janeshvaraH |
hastino.ashvA.nshcha gAshchaiva dAsyo bahushatAstathA
pUjitashcha pratiyayau nivartya tanayAM kila
shlokas.29:
vinItakilbiShe prIte hemavarmaNi pArthive |
pratiyAte tu dAshArNe hRRiShTarUpA shikhaNDinI
shlokas.30:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya kubero naravAhanaH |
lokAnuyAtrAM kurvANaH sthUNasyAgAnniveshanam
shlokas.31:
sa tadgRRihasyopari vartamAna; AlokayAmAsa dhanAdhigoptA |
sthUNasya yakShasya nishAmya veshma; svala~NkRRitaM mAlyaguNairvichitram
shlokas.32:
lAjaishcha gandhaishcha tathA vitAnai;rabhyarchitaM dhUpanadhUpitaM cha |
dhvajaiH patAkAbhirala~NkRRitaM cha; bhakShyAnnapeyAmiShadattahomam
shlokas.33:
tatsthAnaM tasya dRRiShTvA tu sarvataH samala~NkRRitam |
athAbravIdyakShapatistAnyakShAnanugA.nstadA
shlokas.34:
svala~NkRRitamidaM veshma sthUNasyAmitavikramAH |
nopasarpati mAM chApi kasmAdadya sumandadhIH
shlokas.35:
yasmAjjAnansumandAtmA mAmasau nopasarpati |
tasmAttasmai mahAdaNDo dhAryaH syAditi me matiH
shlokas.36:
yakShA UchuH||
drupadasya sutA rAjanrAj~no jAtA shikhaNDinI |
tasyai nimitte kasmi.nshchitprAdAtpuruShalakShaNam
shlokas.37:
agrahIllakShaNaM strINAM strIbhUtastiShThate gRRihe |
nopasarpati tenAsau savrIDaH strIsvarUpavAn
shlokas.38:
etasmAtkAraNAdrAjansthUNo na tvAdya pashyati |
shrutvA kuru yathAnyAyaM vimAnamiha tiShThatAm
shlokas.39:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AnIyatAM sthUNa iti tato yakShAdhipo.abravIt |
kartAsmi nigrahaM tasyetyuvAcha sa punaH punaH
shlokas.40:
so.abhyagachChata yakShendramAhUtaH pRRithivIpate |
strIsvarUpo mahArAja tasthau vrIDAsamanvitaH
shlokas.41:
taM shashApa susa~Nkruddho dhanadaH kurunandana |
evameva bhavatvasya strItvaM pApasya guhyakAH
shlokas.42:
tato.abravIdyakShapatirmahAtmA; yasmAdadAstvavamanyeha yakShAn |
shikhaNDine lakShaNaM pApabuddhe; strIlakShaNaM chAgrahIH pApakarman
shlokas.43:
apravRRittaM sudurbuddhe yasmAdetatkRRitaM tvayA |
tasmAdadya prabhRRityeva tvaM strI sa puruShastathA
shlokas.44:
tataH prasAdayAmAsuryakShA vaishravaNaM kila |
sthUNasyArthe kuruShvAntaM shApasyeti punaH punaH
shlokas.45:
tato mahAtmA yakShendraH pratyuvAchAnugAminaH |
sarvAnyakShagaNA.nstAta shApasyAntachikIrShayA
shlokas.46:
hate shikhaNDini raNe svarUpaM pratipatsyate |
sthUNo yakSho nirudvego bhavatviti mahAmanAH
shlokas.47:
ityuktvA bhagavAndevo yakSharAkShasapUjitaH |
prayayau saha taiH sarvairnimeShAntarachAribhiH
shlokas.48:
sthUNastu shApaM samprApya tatraiva nyavasattadA |
samaye chAgamattaM vai shikhaNDI sa kShapAcharam
shlokas.49:
so.abhigamyAbravIdvAkyaM prApto.asmi bhagavanniti |
tamabravIttataH sthUNaH prIto.asmIti punaH punaH
shlokas.50:
ArjavenAgataM dRRiShTvA rAjaputraM shikhaNDinam |
sarvameva yathAvRRittamAchachakShe shikhaNDine
shlokas.51:
yakSha uvAcha||
shapto vaishravaNenAsmi tvatkRRite pArthivAtmaja |
gachChedAnIM yathAkAmaM chara lokAnyathAsukham
shlokas.52:
diShTametatpurA manye na shakyamativartitum |
gamanaM tava cheto hi paulastyasya cha darshanam
shlokas.53:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktaH shikhaNDI tu sthUNayakSheNa bhArata |
pratyAjagAma nagaraM harSheNa mahatAnvitaH
shlokas.55:
drupadaH saha putreNa siddhArthena shikhaNDinA |
mudaM cha paramAM lebhe pA~nchAlyaH saha bAndhavaiH
shlokas.56:
shiShyArthaM pradadau chApi droNAya kurupu~Ngava |
shikhaNDinaM mahArAja putraM strIpUrviNaM tathA
shlokas.57:
pratipede chatuShpAdaM dhanurvedaM nRRipAtmajaH |
shikhaNDI saha yuShmAbhirdhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH
shlokas.58:
mama tvetachcharAstAta yathAvatpratyavedayan |
jaDAndhabadhirAkArA ye yuktA drupade mayA
shlokas.59:
evameSha mahArAja strIpumAndrupadAtmajaH |
sambhUtaH kauravashreShTha shikhaNDI rathasattamaH
shlokas.60:
jyeShThA kAshipateH kanyA ambA nAmeti vishrutA |
drupadasya kule jAtA shikhaNDI bharatarShabha
shlokas.61:
nAhamenaM dhanuShpANiM yuyutsuM samupasthitam |
muhUrtamapi pashyeyaM prahareyaM na chApyuta
shlokas.62:
vratametanmama sadA pRRithivyAmapi vishrutam |
striyAM strIpUrvake chApi strInAmni strIsvarUpiNi
shlokas.63:
na mu~ncheyamahaM bANAniti kauravanandana |
na hanyAmahametena kAraNena shikhaNDinam
shlokas.64:
etattattvamahaM veda janma tAta shikhaNDinaH |
tato nainaM haniShyAmi samareShvAtatAyinam
shlokas.65:
yadi bhIShmaH striyaM hanyAddhanyAdAtmAnamapyuta |
nainaM tasmAddhaniShyAmi dRRiShTvApi samare sthitam
shlokas.66:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu kauravyo rAjA duryodhanastadA |
muhUrtamiva sa dhyAtvA bhIShme yuktamamanyata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prabhAtAyAM tu sharvaryAM punareva sutastava |
madhye sarvasya sainyasya pitAmahamapRRichChata
shlokas.2:
pANDaveyasya gA~Ngeya yadetatsainyamuttamam |
prabhUtanaranAgAshvaM mahArathasamAkulam
shlokas.3:
bhImArjunaprabhRRitibhirmaheShvAsairmahAbalaiH |
lokapAlopamairguptaM dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamaiH
shlokas.4:
apradhRRiShyamanAvAryamudvRRittamiva sAgaram |
senAsAgaramakShobhyamapi devairmahAhave
shlokas.5:
kena kAlena gA~Ngeya kShapayethA mahAdyute |
AchAryo vA maheShvAsaH kRRipo vA sumahAbalaH
shlokas.6:
karNo vA samarashlAghI drauNirvA dvijasattamaH |
divyAstraviduShaH sarve bhavanto hi bale mama
shlokas.7:
etadichChAmyahaM j~nAtuM paraM kautUhalaM hi me |
hRRidi nityaM mahAbAho vaktumarhasi tanmama
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
anurUpaM kurushreShTha tvayyetatpRRithivIpate |
balAbalamamitrANAM sveShAM cha yadi pRRichChasi
shlokas.9:
shRRiNu rAjanmama raNe yA shaktiH paramA bhavet |
astravIryaM raNe yachcha bhujayoshcha mahAbhuja
shlokas.10:
Arjavenaiva yuddhena yoddhavya itaro janaH |
mAyAyuddhena mAyAvI ityetaddharmanishchayaH
shlokas.11:
hanyAmahaM mahAbAho pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
divase divase kRRitvA bhAgaM prAgAhnikaM mama
shlokas.12:
yodhAnAM dashasAhasraM kRRitvA bhAgaM mahAdyute |
sahasraM rathinAmekameSha bhAgo mato mama
shlokas.13:
anenAhaM vidhAnena saMnaddhaH satatotthitaH |
kShapayeyaM mahatsainyaM kAlenAnena bhArata
shlokas.14:
yadi tvastrANi mu~ncheyaM mahAnti samare sthitaH |
shatasAhasraghAtIni hanyAM mAsena bhArata
shlokas.15:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shrutvA bhIShmasya tadvAkyaM rAjA duryodhanastadA |
paryapRRichChata rAjendra droNama~NgirasAM varam
shlokas.16:
AchArya kena kAlena pANDuputrasya sainikAn |
nihanyA iti taM droNaH pratyuvAcha hasanniva
shlokas.17:
sthaviro.asmi kurushreShTha mandaprANavicheShTitaH |
astrAgninA nirdaheyaM pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.18:
yathA bhIShmaH shAntanavo mAseneti matirmama |
eShA me paramA shaktiretanme paramaM balam
shlokas.19:
dvAbhyAmeva tu mAsAbhyAM kRRipaH shAradvato.abravIt |
drauNistu dasharAtreNa pratijaj~ne balakShayam
karNastu pa~ncharAtreNa pratijaj~ne mahAstravit
shlokas.20:
tachChrutvA sUtaputrasya vAkyaM sAgaragAsutaH |
jahAsa sasvanaM hAsaM vAkyaM chedamuvAcha ha
shlokas.21:
na hi tAvadraNe pArthaM bANakhaDgadhanurdharam |
vAsudevasamAyuktaM rathenodyantamachyutam
shlokas.22:
samAgachChasi rAdheya tenaivamabhimanyase |
shakyamevaM cha bhUyashcha tvayA vaktuM yatheShTataH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu kaunteyaH sarvAnbhrAtR^Inupahvare |
AhUya bharatashreShTha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
dhArtarAShTrasya sainyeShu ye chArapuruShA mama |
te pravRRittiM prayachChanti mamemAM vyuShitAM nishAm
shlokas.3:
duryodhanaH kilApRRichChadApageyaM mahAvratam |
kena kAlena pANDUnAM hanyAH sainyamiti prabho
shlokas.4:
mAseneti cha tenokto dhArtarAShTraH sudurmatiH |
tAvatA chApi kAlena droNo.api pratyajAnata
shlokas.5:
gautamo dviguNaM kAlamuktavAniti naH shrutam |
drauNistu dasharAtreNa pratijaj~ne mahAstravit
shlokas.6:
tathA divyAstravitkarNaH sampRRiShTaH kurusa.nsadi |
pa~nchabhirdivasairhantuM sa sainyaM pratijaj~nivAn
shlokas.7:
tasmAdahamapIchChAmi shrotumarjuna te vachaH |
kAlena kiyatA shatrUnkShapayeriti sa.nyuge
shlokas.8:
evamukto guDAkeshaH pArthivena dhana~njayaH |
vAsudevamavekShyedaM vachanaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.9:
sarva ete mahAtmAnaH kRRitAstrAshchitrayodhinaH |
asa.nshayaM mahArAja hanyureva balaM tava
shlokas.10:
apaitu te manastApo yathAsatyaM bravImyaham |
hanyAmekarathenAhaM vAsudevasahAyavAn
shlokas.11:
sAmarAnapi lokA.nstrInsahasthAvaraja~NgamAn |
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha nimeShAditi me matiH
shlokas.12:
yattadghoraM pashupatiH prAdAdastraM mahanmama |
kairAte dvandvayuddhe vai tadidaM mayi vartate
shlokas.13:
yadyugAnte pashupatiH sarvabhUtAni saMharan |
prayu~Nkte puruShavyAghra tadidaM mayi vartate
shlokas.14:
tanna jAnAti gA~Ngeyo na droNo na cha gautamaH |
na cha droNasuto rAjankuta eva tu sUtajaH
shlokas.15:
na tu yuktaM raNe hantuM divyairastraiH pRRithagjanam |
Arjavenaiva yuddhena vijeShyAmo vayaM parAn
shlokas.16:
tatheme puruShavyAghrAH sahAyAstava pArthiva |
sarve divyAstraviduShaH sarve yuddhAbhinandinaH
shlokas.17:
vedAntAvabhRRithasnAtAH sarva ete.aparAjitAH |
nihanyuH samare senAM devAnAmapi pANDava
shlokas.18:
shikhaNDI yuyudhAnashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
bhImaseno yamau chobhau yudhAmanyUttamaujasau
shlokas.19:
virATadrupadau chobhau bhIShmadroNasamau yudhi |
svayaM chApi samartho.asi trailokyotsAdane api
shlokas.20:
krodhAdyaM puruShaM pashyestvaM vAsavasamadyute |
kShipraM na sa bhavedvyaktamiti tvAM vedmi kaurava

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prabhAte vimale dhArtarAShTreNa choditAH |
duryodhanena rAjAnaH prayayuH pANDavAnprati
shlokas.2:
AplAvya shuchayaH sarve sragviNaH shuklavAsasaH |
gRRihItashastrA dhvajinaH svasti vAchya hutAgnayaH
shlokas.3:
sarve vedavidaH shUrAH sarve sucharitavratAH |
sarve karmakRRitashchaiva sarve chAhavalakShaNAH
shlokas.4:
AhaveShu parA.NllokA~njigIShanto mahAbalAH |
ekAgramanasaH sarve shraddadhAnAH parasya cha
shlokas.5:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau kekayA bAhlikaiH saha |
prayayuH sarva evaite bhAradvAjapurogamAH
shlokas.6:
ashvatthAmA shAntanavaH saindhavo.atha jayadrathaH |
dAkShiNAtyAH pratIchyAshcha pArvatIyAshcha ye rathAH
shlokas.7:
gAndhArarAjaH shakuniH prAchyodIchyAshcha sarvashaH |
shakAH kirAtA yavanAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH
shlokas.8:
svaiH svairanIkaiH sahitAH parivArya mahAratham |
ete mahArathAH sarve dvitIye niryayurbale
shlokas.9:
kRRitavarmA sahAnIkastrigartAshcha mahAbalAH |
duryodhanashcha nRRipatirbhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.10:
shalo bhUrishravAH shalyaH kausalyo.atha bRRihadbalaH |
ete pashchAdavartanta dhArtarAShTrapurogamAH
shlokas.11:
te samena pathA yAtvA yotsyamAnA mahArathAH |
kurukShetrasya pashchArdhe vyavatiShThanta da.nshitAH
shlokas.12:
duryodhanastu shibiraM kArayAmAsa bhArata |
yathaiva hAstinapuraM dvitIyaM samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.13:
na visheShaM vijAnanti purasya shibirasya vA |
kushalA api rAjendra narA nagaravAsinaH
shlokas.14:
tAdRRishAnyeva durgANi rAj~nAmapi mahIpatiH |
kArayAmAsa kauravyaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.15:
pa~nchayojanamutsRRijya maNDalaM tadraNAjiram |
senAniveshAste rAjannAvisha~nshatasa~NghashaH
shlokas.16:
tatra te pRRithivIpAlA yathotsAhaM yathAbalam |
vivishuH shibirANyAshu dravyavanti sahasrashaH
shlokas.17:
teShAM duryodhano rAjA sasainyAnAM mahAtmanAm |
vyAdidesha sabAhyAnAM bhakShyabhojyamanuttamam
shlokas.18:
sagajAshvamanuShyANAM ye cha shilpopajIvinaH |
ye chAnye.anugatAstatra sUtamAgadhabandinaH
shlokas.19:
vaNijo gaNikA vArA ye chaiva prekShakA janAH |
sarvA.nstAnkauravo rAjA vidhivatpratyavaikShata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathaiva rAjA kaunteyo dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhAnvIrA.nshchodayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.2:
chedikAshikarUShANAM netAraM dRRiDhavikramam |
senApatimamitraghnaM dhRRiShTaketumathAdishat
shlokas.3:
virATaM drupadaM chaiva yuyudhAnaM shikhaNDinam |
pA~nchAlyau cha maheShvAsau yudhAmanyUttamaujasau
shlokas.4:
te shUrAshchitravarmANastaptakuNDaladhAriNaH |
AjyAvasiktA jvalitA dhiShNyeShviva hutAshanAH
ashobhanta maheShvAsA grahAH prajvalitA iva
shlokas.5:
so.atha sainyaM yathAyogaM pUjayitvA nararShabhaH |
didesha tAnyanIkAni prayANAya mahIpatiH
shlokas.6:
abhimanyuM bRRihantaM cha draupadeyA.nshcha sarvashaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhAnetAnprAhiNotpANDunandanaH
shlokas.7:
bhImaM cha yuyudhAnaM cha pANDavaM cha dhana~njayam |
dvitIyaM preShayAmAsa balaskandhaM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.8:
bhANDaM samAropayatAM charatAM sampradhAvatAm |
hRRiShTAnAM tatra yodhAnAM shabdo divamivAspRRishat
shlokas.9:
svayameva tataH pashchAdvirATadrupadAnvitaH |
tathAnyaiH pRRithivIpAlaiH saha prAyAnmahIpatiH
shlokas.10:
bhImadhanvAyanI senA dhRRiShTadyumnapuraskRRitA |
ga~Ngeva pUrNA stimitA syandamAnA vyadRRishyata
shlokas.11:
tataH punaranIkAni vyayojayata buddhimAn |
mohayandhRRitarAShTrasya putrANAM buddhinisravam
shlokas.12:
draupadeyAnmaheShvAsAnabhimanyuM cha pANDavaH |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha sarvA.nshchaiva prabhadrakAn
shlokas.13:
dasha chAshvasahasrANi dvisAhasraM cha dantinaH |
ayutaM cha padAtInAM rathAH pa~nchashatAstathA
shlokas.14:
bhImasenaM cha durdharShaM prathamaM prAdishadbalam |
madhyame tu virATaM cha jayatsenaM cha mAgadham
shlokas.15:
mahArathau cha pA~nchAlyau yudhAmanyUttamaujasau |
vIryavantau mahAtmAnau gadAkArmukadhAriNau
anvayAtAM tato madhye vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.16:
babhUvuratisa.nrabdhAH kRRitapraharaNA narAH |
teShAM vi.nshatisAhasrA dhvajAH shUrairadhiShThitAH
shlokas.17:
pa~ncha nAgasahasrANi rathava.nshAshcha sarvashaH |
padAtayashcha ye shUrAH kArmukAsigadAdharAH
sahasrasho.anvayuH pashchAdagratashcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
yudhiShThiro yatra sainye svayameva balArNave |
tatra te pRRithivIpAlA bhUyiShThaM paryavasthitAH
shlokas.19:
tatra nAgasahasrANi hayAnAmayutAni cha |
tathA rathasahasrANi padAtInAM cha bhArata
yadAshrityAbhiyuyudhe dhArtarAShTraM suyodhanam
shlokas.20:
tato.anye shatashaH pashchAtsahasrAyutasho narAH |
nadantaH prayayusteShAmanIkAni sahasrashaH
shlokas.21:
tatra bherIsahasrANi sha~NkhAnAmayutAni cha |
vAdayanti sma saMhRRiShTAH sahasrAyutasho narAH
